// ── Live preview swatch for the customizer modal ────────────────────────────
// Renders a static, scaled-up version of the player sprite using the same
// hair/face helpers + appearance fields as the in-world draw routine, so the
// preview always matches what the player will look like in-game.
function CharacterPreview({
  appearance,
  costumeColor,
  pCls,
}: {
  appearance: Appearance;
  costumeColor: string | null;
  pCls: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const cv = ref.current; if (!cv) return;
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d'); if (!ctx) return;
    const W = cv.width, H = cv.height;
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#02080a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Scale up the 32px-tall sprite into the preview area.
    const SCALE = 4;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, H - 18);
    ctx.scale(SCALE, SCALE);

    // Shared procedural paper-doll — identical to the in-world default branch
    // and the office scene, so every surface renders the same character.
    drawPlayerSprite(ctx, appearance, { costumeColor, pCls });

    ctx.restore();
  }, [appearance, costumeColor, pCls]);
  return (
    <canvas ref={ref} width={140} height={180}
      style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', background: '#02080a', imageRendering: 'pixelated' as const }} />
  );
}

// Compact on-screen quick-action button used by the mobile control overlay.
// Click-only (touch devices fire a click after the tap) so toggles never
// double-fire. The action runs through pressKey / a panel setter at the call
// site, so each button reuses the exact same path as its keyboard shortcut.
function MobileQuickBtn({ label, color, onTap }: { label: string; color: string; onTap: () => void }) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onTap}
      style={{
        width: 44, height: 38, borderRadius: 9,
        border: `1px solid ${color}59`, background: 'rgba(4,10,16,.72)', color,
        fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.62rem', letterSpacing: '.04em',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation',
      }}
    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

// ── WorldPlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function WorldPlay() {
  const { signOut } = useClerk();
  const [, navigate] = useLocation();
  // Mark this as an immersive city/full-screen view for the duration of the
  // mount, so comms pop-up alerts can honour the user's "Do Not Disturb while
  // playing" preference. Cleared on unmount (and tolerant of overlap via the
  // tracker's ref-count).
  useEffect(() => {
    setImmersiveViewActive(true);
    return () => setImmersiveViewActive(false);
  }, []);
  const { isPro, isTrial, trialDaysLeft, features: planFeatures, isOwner: isOwnerPlan } = usePlan();
  // Verified real-salary status — polled here too so a verified owner's salary
  // accrues anywhere in the world (not only in the office), and so the city's
  // employment readout can flag an unverified owner as "WORK VISA PENDING"
  // instead of silently showing them as a fully-employed OWNER.
  const { state: verifiedSalaryStatus } = useVerifiedSalary(true);
  const canvasRef     = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const gameRef       = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const wsRef         = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);
  const animRef       = useRef(0);
  const rafLoopRef    = useRef<FrameRequestCallback | null>(null);
  const documentVisibleRef = useRef(typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.hidden);
  const [documentVisible, setDocumentVisible] = useState(documentVisibleRef.current);
  useEffect(() => {
    const syncVisibility = () => {
      const visible = !document.hidden;
      documentVisibleRef.current = visible;
      setDocumentVisible(visible);
      if (!visible) {
        if (animRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current);
        animRef.current = 0;
      } else if (!animRef.current && rafLoopRef.current) {
        animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(rafLoopRef.current);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', syncVisibility);
    syncVisibility();
    return () => document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', syncVisibility);
  }, []);
  const peerConns     = useRef<Map<string, RTCPeerConnection>>(new Map());
  const localStream   = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const audioCtx      = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const frozenRef     = useRef(false);
  const npcDialogRef  = useRef(false); // true while talking to a friendly NPC
  const chatOpenRef   = useRef(false);
  // De-dupe ring for the world chat log: world speech arrives via BOTH the
  // `chat` room:world path and `proximity_chat`; this prevents double entries.
  const recentLogRef  = useRef<{ k: string; ts: number }[]>([]);
  const isOwnerPlanRef = useRef(isOwnerPlan);
  const pendingNpcActionRef = useRef<null | { type: 'newspaper'; seasonIdx: number } | { type: 'merchant'; name: string; items: MerchantItem[] }>(null);
  const zoomRef       = useRef(computeDefaultZoom());
  const targetZoomRef = useRef(computeDefaultZoom());
  const pinchStartDistRef = useRef(0);
  const pinchStartZoomRef = useRef(computeDefaultZoom());
  // Tracks the active interior def so a stale tap-to-move target is dropped on any
  // interior enter/exit/floor change (each transition creates a fresh def object).
  const interiorMoveDefRef = useRef<object | null>(null);
  const movementSpaceRef = useRef<'world' | 'interior' | null>(null);
  const [mobileSprintActive, setMobileSprintActive] = useState(false);
  const mobileSprintActiveRef = useRef(false);
  const touchMoveRef = useRef<MovementVector>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const touchStickRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const touchStickPointerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const [touchStickOffset, setTouchStickOffset] = useState<MovementVector>({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  // Hold-to-attack: while the ATK button is held we re-fire the attack on an
  // interval (the per-weapon cooldown rate-limits it). Mobile attacks are
  // dispatched as real synthetic KeyboardEvents so they run the exact same
  // keydown path (auto-aim, combos, stamina) as a physical Space press.
  const [mobileAtkActive, setMobileAtkActive] = useState(false);
  const mobileAtkIntervalRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const isTouchDeviceRef = useRef(false);
  const cameraLookAheadRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const buildingEntryZoomRef = useRef<{ active: boolean; timer: number; targetX: number; targetY: number; callback: (() => void) | null }>({ active: false, timer: 0, targetX: 0, targetY: 0, callback: null });

  useEffect(() => { mobileSprintActiveRef.current = mobileSprintActive; }, [mobileSprintActive]);

  const updateTouchMovement = useCallback((clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    const base = touchStickRef.current;
    if (!base) return;
    const rect = base.getBoundingClientRect();
    const radius = Math.max(1, rect.width * 0.34);
    const rawX = (clientX - (rect.left + rect.width / 2)) / radius;
    const rawY = (clientY - (rect.top + rect.height / 2)) / radius;
    const vector = normalizeMovementVector(rawX, rawY);
    touchMoveRef.current = vector;
    setTouchStickOffset({ x: vector.x * radius, y: vector.y * radius });
  }, []);

  const resetTouchMovement = useCallback(() => {
    touchStickPointerRef.current = null;
    touchMoveRef.current = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    setTouchStickOffset({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  }, []);

  // ── Mobile hold-to-attack helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────
  // Fire a real synthetic Space keydown so the touch button runs the identical
  // attack path (auto-aim toward nearest threat, swing combos, stamina, ranged
  // fire) as the keyboard. Holding repeats; the weapon cooldown gates the rate.
  const startMobileAttack = useCallback(() => {
    setMobileAtkActive(true);
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: ' ' }));
    if (mobileAtkIntervalRef.current == null) {
      mobileAtkIntervalRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
        window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: ' ' }));
      }, 120);
    }
  }, []);
  const stopMobileAttack = useCallback(() => {
    setMobileAtkActive(false);
    if (mobileAtkIntervalRef.current != null) {
      window.clearInterval(mobileAtkIntervalRef.current);
      mobileAtkIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: ' ' }));
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (mobileAtkIntervalRef.current != null) window.clearInterval(mobileAtkIntervalRef.current);
  }, []);

  // Fire a real synthetic keydown+keyup so on-screen quick-action buttons run
  // the EXACT same keyboard path (toggles, gating, sounds) as a physical press.
  // A short keyup follows so the held-keys set never leaks (mirrors the E/ATK
  // buttons). This is the single chokepoint every mobile quick button uses.
  const pressKey = useCallback((key: string) => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key }));
    window.setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key })), 150);
  }, []);
  // Secondary mobile quick-actions live behind a compact "MORE" expander so the
  // common actions stay prominent and the screen stays uncluttered.
  const [mobileQuickOpen, setMobileQuickOpen] = useState(false);

  // Load character from localStorage (set by WorldMenu)
  const [char] = useState<Char | null>(() => {
    try { const s = localStorage.getItem('sm_char'); return s ? JSON.parse(s) : null; } catch { return null; }
  });

  // Redirect to menu if no character
  useEffect(() => { if (!char) navigate('/office'); }, [char]);
  if (!char) return null;

  // Keep isOwnerPlanRef in sync so keydown closure always reads the latest value
  useEffect(() => { isOwnerPlanRef.current = isOwnerPlan; }, [isOwnerPlan]);

  // Auto-focus game container so keyboard events fire immediately
  useEffect(() => { gameRef.current?.focus(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { const raw = sessionStorage.getItem('sm_event_goto'); if (raw) { sessionStorage.removeItem('sm_event_goto'); try { const t = JSON.parse(raw); gs.current.moveTarget = { x: Number(t.x), y: Number(t.y) }; } catch {} } }, []);

  // Gamepad → keyboard bridge. Synthesizes WASD/E/Space/Shift/V/P key
  // events from a connected Xbox/PS5/HID controller so the existing
  // keyboard-driven input pipeline (movement, interact, jump, sprint,
  // vehicle, dialogue) just works. No WorldPlay logic changes needed.
  const gamepadState = useGamepad();

  const _localSave = (() => { try { const s = localStorage.getItem('sm_save'); if (!s) return null; const p = JSON.parse(s); if (p.name && p.name !== char.name) return null; return p; } catch { return null; } })();
  const _ss = (char as any)?._savedState ? { ...(char as any)._savedState, ...(_localSave ?? {}) } : _localSave;
  // ── Active city resolution ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A city-to-city trip hands off { cityId, x, y, at } via localStorage right
  // before navigation (mirrors the subway hand-off). Otherwise we resume the
  // city stored on the save, defaulting to Minx. setActiveCityId mutates the
  // module-level active def the renderer/collision read, so it must run before
  // the canvas loop starts.
  const _cityTravel = (() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('city_travel');
      if (raw) {
        const j = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (j && typeof j.cityId === 'string' && CITY_DEFS[j.cityId] && Date.now() - (j.at ?? 0) < 60_000) return j;
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    return null;
  })();
  setActiveCityId(_cityTravel?.cityId ?? (typeof _ss?.cityId === 'string' ? _ss.cityId : DEFAULT_CITY_ID));
  const _spawnPos = (() => {
    // City-to-city hand-off takes priority: spawn at the destination city's
    // arrival hub (or the explicit coords the travel screen passed).
    if (_cityTravel && typeof _cityTravel.x === 'number' && typeof _cityTravel.y === 'number') {
      try { localStorage.removeItem('city_travel'); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      return { px: _cityTravel.x, py: _cityTravel.y };
    }
    // Subway hand-off: if user just fast-traveled, spawn at the destination
    // station. The Subway page sets this in localStorage right before nav.
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('subway_destination');
      if (raw) {
        const j = JSON.parse(raw);
        // Honor only if recent (under 60s) — avoids re-using a stale teleport.
        if (j && typeof j.x === 'number' && typeof j.y === 'number' && Date.now() - (j.at ?? 0) < 60_000) {
          localStorage.removeItem('subway_destination');
          return { px: j.x, py: j.y };
        }
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    if (_ss) {
      const ht = (_ss?.housingTier ?? 'shelter') as string;
      const spawn = getHamletSpawn(char, ht);
      return { px: spawn.x, py: spawn.y };
    }
    return { px: char.sx, py: char.sy };
  })();
  const gs = useRef({
    px: _spawnPos.px, py: _spawnPos.py,
    moveVx: 0, moveVy: 0,
    walkDistance: 0,
    cam: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    keys: new Set<string>(),
    frame: 0, blink: 0,
    hp: _ss?.hp ?? 100, salary: _ss?.salary ?? char.salary,
    hasDevice: _ss?.hasDevice ?? true,
    deviceBroken: _ss?.deviceBroken ?? false,
    deviceDurability: _ss?.deviceDurability ?? 100,
    atPublicTerminal: false,
    invincible: 0, flash: 0,
    threats: THREATS_INIT.map(t => ({ ...t })),
    near: null as string | null,
    nearNpc: null as number | null,
    nearBillboard: null as string | null,
    nearManhole: null as number | null,
    inSewer: false,
    sewerExitTimer: 0,
    gangZone: null as string | null,
    hunger: _ss?.hunger ?? 100, thirst: _ss?.thirst ?? 100, energy: _ss?.energy ?? 100,
    survivalTick: 0,
    lastIncomeTime: Date.now(),
    interestTick: 0,
    savings: _ss?.savings ?? 0,
    loan: _ss?.loan ?? null as null | { amount: number; interest: number; issuedAt: number; dueAt: number },
    exp: _ss?.exp ?? 0, level: _ss?.level ?? 1, maxHp: _ss?.maxHp ?? 100, totalExpEarned: _ss?.totalExpEarned ?? 0, overflowExp: _ss?.overflowExp ?? 0,
    skillPoints: (_ss?.skill_points ?? 0) as number,
    perception: _ss?.perception ?? 5,
    poisoned: _ss?.poisoned ?? false, poisonTick: 0,
    attackCooldown: 0,
    attackFlash: 0,
    attackFlashMax: 0 as number,        // duration the current swing was set with — for sweep progress
    swingStartAngle: 0 as number,       // aim angle captured at swing start (so sweep stays put if player turns)
    swingIdx: 0 as number,              // cycles 0,1,2 — drives alternating R→L / L→R / overhead combo anim
    swingDir: 1 as number,              // +1 = clockwise sweep, −1 = counter-clockwise (set per swing)
    swingHeavy: false as boolean,       // true on every 3rd swing — wider arc, bigger damage
    swingLungeVx: 0 as number,          // per-frame push while swinging — applied during movement
    swingLungeVy: 0 as number,
    swingLungeFrames: 0 as number,
    killFlash: 0 as number,             // countdown frames — red vignette on kill
    critFlash: 0 as number,             // countdown frames — white/orange flash on crit
    combo: makeCombo() as ComboState,
    stamina: makeStamina() as StaminaState,
    blockingHeld: false,
    hitStopUntil: 0 as number,
    shakeFrames: 0,                     // remaining frames of camera shake
    shakeMag: 0 as number,              // peak shake magnitude in world units
    muzzleFlash: null as null | (MuzzleFlash & { wpnIcon?: string }),
    casings: [] as Casing[],            // ejected shells/cases — visual flair after firing
    recoilDx: 0 as number,              // visible weapon-kick offset (decays each frame)

  const [asleepAtDesk, setAsleepAtDesk] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {

      if (!onboarded) return false; // first-ever load — onboarding will run

  // Collections Facility takeover. Polled every minute. If the player has
  // outstanding debt AND has been arrested (jailUntil set server-side by
  // the tax-collector flow), the entire screen is replaced by the facility
  // until they work the debt down to zero. This is the engine that pays
  // for Salaryman's development — every ƒ off the debt is also free labor
  // (bug reports / data labels) or revenue (ad views / sponsor clicks).
  // Subway discovery is probed outdoors on arrival/visible return and after
  // meaningful movement, rather than continuously posting stationary coords.
  // Equipped-gear stats loader. The Armory persists the loadout server-side;
  // here we pull the resolved {attack,defense,magic,tech} bundle for the active
  // save slot once on mount and whenever the Armory signals a change (it bumps
  // localStorage 'sm_gear_rev' on equip/unequip). Same numbers the Armory shows.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!documentVisible) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    // The item catalog is static, so resolve the visual descriptors (rarity,
    // vehicleKind, type) for each equipped item once and cache them. Keyed by
    // item id so the loadout's slot->id map turns into slot->visual cheaply.
    let catalogVisuals: Map<string, EquippedGearVisual> | null = null;
    const ensureCatalog = async (): Promise<Map<string, EquippedGearVisual>> => {
      if (catalogVisuals) return catalogVisuals;
      const m = new Map<string, EquippedGearVisual>();
      try {
        const cr = await apiFetch(`/api/items/catalog`, { credentials: 'include' });
        if (cr.ok) {
          const cj = await cr.json();
          const items = Array.isArray(cj?.items) ? cj.items : [];
          for (const it of items) {
            if (it && typeof it.id === 'string') {
              m.set(it.id, { id: it.id, type: String(it.type ?? ''), vehicleKind: it.vehicleKind ? String(it.vehicleKind) : undefined, rarity: String(it.rarity ?? 'common') });
            }
          }
        }
      } catch { /* keep empty map — gear simply won't render visuals */ }
      catalogVisuals = m;
      return m;
    };
    const loadGear = async () => {
      try {
        const slot = (() => { try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sm_slot') ?? '0', 10) || 0; } catch { return 0; } })();
        const r = await apiFetch(`/api/items/loadout?slot=${slot}`, { credentials: 'include' });
        if (!r.ok || cancelled) return;
        const j = await r.json();
        const s = j?.stats;
        if (s && typeof s === 'object') {
          gs.current.gearStats = {
            attack: Number(s.attack) || 0,
            defense: Number(s.defense) || 0,
            magic: Number(s.magic) || 0,
            tech: Number(s.tech) || 0,
          };
        }
        // Resolve equipped-item visuals from the SAME loadout map. The loadout
        // is { equipSlot: itemId }; turn each into a visual descriptor so the
        // avatar render can paint the gear without recomputing anything.
        const loadout = j?.loadout;
        const visuals: Record<string, EquippedGearVisual> = {};
        if (loadout && typeof loadout === 'object') {
          const cat = await ensureCatalog();
          if (cancelled) return;
          for (const [eqSlot, itemId] of Object.entries(loadout)) {
            if (typeof itemId !== 'string') continue;
            const v = cat.get(itemId);
            if (v) visuals[eqSlot] = v;
          }
        }
        gs.current.gearLoadout = visuals;
      } catch { /* silent — combat falls back to empty gear stats */ }
    };
    loadGear();
    const onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => { if (e.key === 'sm_gear_rev') loadGear(); };
    window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage);
    return () => { cancelled = true; window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage); };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let probing = false;
    let lastProbe: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
    const probe = async () => {
      if (cancelled || probing || !documentVisibleRef.current) return;
      try {
        const g = gs.current;
        if (g.interior) return;
        const px = g?.px, py = g?.py;
        if (typeof px !== 'number' || typeof py !== 'number') return;
        if (!movementDemanded({ x: px, y: py }, lastProbe, 48)) return;
        probing = true;
        lastProbe = { x: px, y: py };
        await apiFetch('/api/subway/discover-near', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'include',
          body: JSON.stringify({ x: px, y: py }),
        });
      } catch { /* silent */ }
      finally { probing = false; }
    };
    void probe();
    const id = window.setInterval(probe, 500);
    return () => { cancelled = true; window.clearInterval(id); };
  }, [documentVisible]);

  // ── Per-gun mechanical profile ──
  // Centralizes the "feel" of each ranged weapon. Used by every fire path
  // (Space-attack, click-fire-target, click-fire-empty) so guns behave
  // consistently no matter how the player triggers them.
  //   spread     : random angle jitter (radians) per shot
  //   pellets    : extra bullets per trigger pull (shotgun = 3, slugs)
  //   speed      : projectile travel speed (px/frame)
  //   recoil     : pixels of player visible push-back (decays each frame)
  //   shake      : camera-shake magnitude on fire (0 = silent)
  //   mflashLen  : muzzle flash length in px
  //   mflashCol  : muzzle flash core color "r,g,b"
  //   casing     : ejected casing color, or null to skip ejection
  //   silent     : skip the police alert (crossbow)
  type GunProfile = { spread: number; pellets: number; speed: number; recoil: number; shake: number; mflashLen: number; mflashCol: string; casing: string | null; silent?: boolean };
  const GUN_STATS: Record<string, GunProfile> = {

    rifle:            { spread: 0.025, pellets: 1, speed: 11, recoil: 2.2, shake: 1.6, mflashLen: 22, mflashCol: '255,210,120', casing: '#bb9944' },

    smg:              { spread: 0.13, pellets: 1, speed: 10, recoil: 0.8, shake: 0.6, mflashLen: 11, mflashCol: '255,240,180', casing: '#cc9966' },
    sniper:           { spread: 0.005, pellets: 1, speed: 16, recoil: 5.0, shake: 5.0, mflashLen: 32, mflashCol: '180,255,200', casing: '#558844' },
    laser:            { spread: 0.0, pellets: 1, speed: 12, recoil: 0.4, shake: 0.3, mflashLen: 20, mflashCol: '255,120,220', casing: null },
    crossbow:         { spread: 0.02, pellets: 1, speed: 7,  recoil: 1.2, shake: 0.5, mflashLen: 0,  mflashCol: '0,0,0',       casing: null, silent: true },
    bomb:             { spread: 0.0, pellets: 1, speed: 0,  recoil: 1.5, shake: 1.5, mflashLen: 0,  mflashCol: '255,200,80',  casing: null },
    grenade_launcher: { spread: 0.04, pellets: 1, speed: 0,  recoil: 4.5, shake: 4.0, mflashLen: 18, mflashCol: '255,180,80',  casing: '#446633' },
  };
  const getGunProfile = (icon: string): GunProfile => GUN_STATS[icon] ?? GUN_STATS.pistol;

  // ── Apply firing FX (recoil, shake, ejected casing) ──
  // Pure visual/feel layer — does NOT spawn the projectile itself, so the
  // caller can decide bullet count & damage. Always called once per
  // trigger pull regardless of pellet count so shotguns still only eject
  // one shell (not three) per shot.
  const applyGunFx = (g: typeof gs.current, angle: number, profile: GunProfile) => {
    g.recoilDx = -Math.cos(angle) * profile.recoil;
    g.recoilDy = -Math.sin(angle) * profile.recoil;
    g.gunKick = Math.min(1, g.gunKick + 0.85);
    if (profile.shake > 0) {
      g.shakeFrames = Math.max(g.shakeFrames, profile.shake > 3 ? 9 : 5);
      g.shakeMag = Math.max(g.shakeMag, profile.shake);
    }
    if (profile.casing) {
      const ejectA = angle + Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
      g.casings.push({
        x: g.px + Math.cos(angle) * 8,
        y: g.py + Math.sin(angle) * 8 - 4,
        dx: Math.cos(ejectA) * (1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8),
        dy: Math.sin(ejectA) * (1.0 + Math.random() * 0.6) - 1.4,
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        vrot: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
        life: 45, maxLife: 45,
        color: profile.casing,
      });
    }
  };

  // ── Spawn projectile(s) for a gun shot ──
  // Handles spread, multi-pellet (shotgun), and bomb/grenade arc weapons
  // (which use g.bombs instead of g.projectiles). Returns true if at
  // least one projectile/bomb was spawned.
  const spawnGunProjectiles = (g: typeof gs.current, baseAngle: number, wpn: WeaponDef, ATK: number): boolean => {
    const profile = getGunProfile(wpn.icon);
    if (wpn.icon === 'bomb') {
      g.bombs.push({ x: g.px + Math.cos(baseAngle) * 30, y: g.py + Math.sin(baseAngle) * 30, timer: 45, damage: ATK, radius: wpn.range });
      return true;
    }
    if (wpn.icon === 'grenade_launcher') {
      g.bombs.push({ x: g.px + Math.cos(baseAngle) * 40, y: g.py + Math.sin(baseAngle) * 40, timer: 35, damage: ATK, radius: 120 });
      return true;
    }
    const lifeFor = (icon: string) =>
      icon === 'laser' ? 50 :
      icon === 'sniper' ? 50 :
      icon === 'crossbow' ? 42 :
      icon === 'shotgun' ? 22 :
      35;
    // Shotgun damage is split per-pellet so totals roughly match a single shot
    const dmgPerShot = wpn.icon === 'shotgun' ? Math.floor(ATK * 0.6) : ATK;
    for (let i = 0; i < profile.pellets; i++) {
      // Symmetric pellet spread for shotgun, random jitter for everything
      // else. Center pellet (i === midpoint) is exact so click-to-aim
      // shotgun shots still land where you click.
      let offset: number;
      if (profile.pellets > 1) {
        const mid = (profile.pellets - 1) / 2;
        const dev = i - mid;
        // Only add jitter to OFF-center pellets — keeps middle deterministic.
        offset = dev * profile.spread + (dev !== 0 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05 : 0);
      } else {
        offset = (Math.random() - 0.5) * profile.spread * 2;
      }
      const a = baseAngle + offset;
      g.projectiles.push({
        x: g.px, y: g.py, prevX: g.px, prevY: g.py,
        dx: Math.cos(a) * profile.speed,
        dy: Math.sin(a) * profile.speed,
        life: lifeFor(wpn.icon), damage: dmgPerShot, type: wpn.icon,
      });
    }
    return true;
  };

  const startBattle = (descriptor: BattleDescriptor, onComplete?: (o: BattleOutcome) => void) => {
    const g = gs.current;
    const atkBonusMerch = g.ownedItems.has('atk_boost') ? 5 : 0;
    const aw = WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === activeWeaponRef.current) ?? WEAPONS[0];
    const sw = WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === secondaryWeaponRef.current);

    const meleeWpn = aw.type !== 'ranged' ? aw : (sw && sw.type !== 'ranged' ? sw : aw);
    const meleeAttack = 20 + (g.level - 1) * 5 + meleeWpn.atkBonus + atkBonusMerch + gearAttackFlat(g.gearStats);

      descriptor,

    });

  };

      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = await res.json();
      const next = new Map<string, OrgDoorHint>();
      // Server returns `doors` (canonical); tolerate `locks` for back-compat.
      const list = (data.doors ?? data.locks ?? []) as Array<{ doorKey: string; orgId: number; label: string | null; spaceType: string; minRole: string }>;
      for (const d of list) {
        next.set(d.doorKey, { orgId: d.orgId, label: d.label, spaceType: d.spaceType, minRole: d.minRole });
      }
      orgDoorLocksRef.current = next;
    } catch { /* hint only; server still enforces */ }

      }
      return true;
    });
    for (const d of demolished) {
      const isFirst = char.company === d.companyName;
      if (isFirst) {
        char.hasBusiness = g.businesses.length > 0;
        if (!char.hasBusiness) {
          char.bizType = undefined;
          char.company = '';
          char.workstation = undefined;
          char.workstationLabel = undefined;
          char.workstationSlot = undefined;
          char.bizRegisteredAt = undefined;
        } else {
          const next = g.businesses[0];
          char.bizType = next.bizType;
          char.company = next.companyName;
          char.workstation = next.workstation ?? undefined;
          char.workstationLabel = next.workstationLabel ?? undefined;
          char.workstationSlot = next.workstationSlot ?? undefined;
          char.bizRegisteredAt = next.registeredAt;
        }
      }
      setNarr(`> DEPT. OF BUSINESS AFFAIRS — Your business '${d.companyName}' has been demolished due to 30 days of inactivity. The location is now available. All registrations are non-refundable.`);
    }
  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const bankTxCounter = useRef(0);
  const addBankTx = useCallback((desc: string, amount: number, bal: number, category: TransactionCategory = 'general') => {
    bankTxCounter.current++;
    const id = Date.now() * 1000 + bankTxCounter.current;
    setBankHistory(h => [{ id, desc, amount, bal, category, timestamp: Date.now() }, ...h].slice(0, 50));
  }, []);

  const recordBizRevenue = useCallback((spendingType: string, amount: number) => {
    const g = gs.current;
    if (!g.businesses || g.businesses.length === 0) return;
    const category = SPENDING_CATEGORY[spendingType];
    if (!category) return;
    const matching = g.businesses.filter((b: OwnedBusiness) => b.industry === category);
    if (matching.length === 0) return;
    const info = BIZ_INDUSTRY_INFO[category];
    const cut = Math.max(1, Math.floor(amount * info.cut));
    const perBiz = Math.max(1, Math.floor(cut / matching.length));
    for (const biz of matching) {
      biz.revenue = (biz.revenue ?? 0) + perBiz;
      biz.totalRevenue = (biz.totalRevenue ?? 0) + perBiz;
      biz.customerCount = (biz.customerCount ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    void performGameplayFiatAction('business_revenue', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:business:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
    g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 40, text: `+ƒ${cut.toLocaleString()} BIZ REVENUE`, color: info.color, life: 70, maxLife: 70 });
  }, []);

  // Player apartment assignment (persistent per character)
  const [aptUnit] = useState<string>(() => {
    const k = `sm_apt_${char?.name}`;
    let v = localStorage.getItem(k);
    if (!v) { v = `FLOOR ${Math.floor(Math.random()*7)+2}, UNIT ${Math.floor(Math.random()*8)+1}`; localStorage.setItem(k, v); }
    return v;
  });

  // ── WebSocket ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const wsSend = useCallback((m: object) => {
    if (wsRef.current?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify(m));
  }, []);
  const lastSavedSnapshotRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const canAccessTerminal = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    const nearTerminal = g.near && (IS_PUBLIC_TERMINAL(g.near) || g.near === 'terminal_shop');
    return (g.hasDevice && !g.deviceBroken) || g.atPublicTerminal || nearTerminal;
  }, []);

  const doSave = useCallback((data: object, forceCloud = false) => {
    const g = gs.current;
    const dogSave = g.dogCompanion.active ? { dogCompanion: { active: true, name: g.dogCompanion.name, breed: g.dogCompanion.breed, hp: g.dogCompanion.hp, maxHp: g.dogCompanion.maxHp, injured: g.dogCompanion.injured, stamina: g.dogCompanion.stamina, stayAt: g.dogCompanion.stayAt } } : {};
    const catSave = g.catCompanion.active ? { catCompanion: { active: true, name: g.catCompanion.name, breed: g.catCompanion.breed, hp: g.catCompanion.hp, maxHp: g.catCompanion.maxHp, injured: g.catCompanion.injured, stamina: g.catCompanion.stamina, stayAt: g.catCompanion.stayAt } } : {};
    const persistFields = {
      businesses: [...(g.businesses ?? [])],
      employedAt: g.employedAt,
      employedSalary: g.employedSalary,
      hasBusiness: char.hasBusiness,
      bizType: char.bizType,
      company: char.company,
      worldLayer: g.worldLayer,
      undergroundReturn: g.undergroundReturn,
    };
    localStorage.setItem('sm_save', JSON.stringify({ ...persistFields, ...data, ...dogSave, ...catSave }));
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sm_wanted_changed', { detail: { wantedLevel: g.wantedLevel ?? 0, bountyAmount: g.bountyAmount ?? 0 } })); } catch {}
    if (!forceCloud && !canAccessTerminal()) return Promise.resolve(true);
    const slot = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sm_slot') ?? '0', 10);
    const savePayload = {
      charName: char.name,
      charClass: char.class,
      level: g.level,
      salary: g.salary,
      lastZone: g.worldLayer === 'underground' ? 'THE UNDERCITY' : inCityBounds(g.px, g.py) ? getActiveCityDef().name : 'WASTELAND',
      playtime: g.frame,
      data: { ...char, ...persistFields, ...(data as Record<string, unknown>), px: g.px, py: g.py, hp: g.hp, hunger: g.hunger, thirst: g.thirst, energy: g.energy, exp: g.exp, level: g.level, salary: g.salary, poisoned: g.poisoned, cityId: getActiveCityId(), ...dogSave, ...catSave },
    };
    return apiFetch(`/api/salaryman/saves/${slot}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      credentials: 'include',
      body: JSON.stringify(savePayload),
    }).then(response => response.ok).catch(() => false);
  }, [char, canAccessTerminal]) as (data: object, forceCloud?: boolean) => Promise<boolean>;

  const doSaveRef = useRef(doSave);
  doSaveRef.current = doSave;

  const buildSaveData = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    return {
      name: char.name, class: char.class, level: g.level, exp: g.exp, salary: g.salary,
      hp: g.hp, maxHp: g.maxHp, hunger: g.hunger, thirst: g.thirst, energy: g.energy,
      poisoned: g.poisoned, weaponTier: g.weaponTier, vehicle: g.vehicle,
      terminalDiscount: g.terminalDiscount, hasRadioImplant: g.hasRadioImplant, passport: g.passport,
      savings: g.savings, loan: g.loan,
      hasDevice: g.hasDevice, deviceBroken: g.deviceBroken, deviceDurability: g.deviceDurability,
      ownedItems: [...g.ownedItems],
      inventory: g.inventory,
      ownedBuildings: [...g.ownedBuildings],
      cargo: { ...g.cargo },
      realEstate: [...g.realEstate],
      rentalProperties: [...(g.rentalProperties ?? [])],
      propertyDeeds: [...(g.propertyDeeds ?? [])],
      utilityUnpaidCycles: g.utilityUnpaidCycles ?? 0,
      propertiesOffline: [...(g.propertiesOffline ?? new Set<string>())],
      propertyCustomization: g.propertyCustomization ?? {},
      worldTime: g.worldTime,
      diedLastSession: g.diedLastSession,
      quests: g.quests,
      ownedClothes: [...g.ownedClothes],
      hamletBuildingId: g.hamletBuildingId,
      pabloOnboardingDone: g.pabloOnboardingDone,
      activeWeapon: activeWeaponRef.current,
      secondaryWeapon: secondaryWeaponRef.current,
      unlockedWeapons: [...unlockedWeaponsRef.current],
      totalExpEarned: g.totalExpEarned,
      overflowExp: g.overflowExp ?? 0,
      perception: g.perception,
      fogRevealed: [...g.fogRevealed],
      hasBusiness: char.hasBusiness,
      bizType: char.bizType,
      company: char.company,
      bizRegisteredAt: char.bizRegisteredAt,
      storyFlags: g.storyFlags,
      story: g.story,
      milaOutfitId: g.mila.outfitId,
      milaTask: g.mila.task,
      // Persist the calendar so quarter/season/weather survive a reload. Season
      // is re-pinned to the real quarter on load; weather only re-picks if the
      // quarter (season) changed since the save, so it visibly persists.
      calendar: { ...g.calendar },
      assets: { ...g.assets },
      stocks: { ...g.stocks },
      housingTier: g.housingTier,
      rentPaidAt: g.rentPaidAt,
      rentReminded: g.rentReminded,
      businesses: [...(g.businesses ?? [])],
      floorOccupancy: { ...(g.floorOccupancy ?? {}) },
      worldLayer: g.worldLayer,
      undergroundReturn: g.undergroundReturn,
      secretLab: g.secretLab,
      ownedVehicles: [...(g.ownedVehicles ?? [])],
      parkedLoadout: [...(g.parkedLoadout ?? [])],
      vehicleGas: { ...(g.vehicleGas ?? {}) },
      homeGas: g.homeGas ?? 0,
      ownedFurniture: [...(g.ownedFurniture ?? [])],
      placedFurniture: placedFurnitureMapRef.current,
      wantedLevel: g.wantedLevel ?? 0,
      bountyAmount: g.bountyAmount ?? 0,
      taxDebt: g.taxDebt ?? 0,
      taxCollectorTimer: g.taxCollectorTimer ?? 0,
      boCollectors: g.boCollectors.map(bc => ({ x: bc.x, y: bc.y })),
      foundSecrets: [...foundSecretsRef.current],
      unlockedBuildings: [...unlockedBuildingsRef.current],
      appearance: gs.current.appearance,
      skill_points: g.skillPoints ?? 0,
      skills: Array.isArray((_ss as any)?.skills) ? (_ss as any).skills : undefined,
      goldBalance: g.goldBalance ?? 0,
      btcBalance: g.btcBalance ?? 0,
      ethBalance: g.ethBalance ?? 0,
    };
  }, [char]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const saveChanged = () => {
      const g = gs.current;
      if (!g.hasDevice || g.deviceBroken) return;
      const data = buildSaveData();
      const decision = snapshotChanged(data, lastSavedSnapshotRef.current);
      if (!decision.changed) return;
      void doSaveRef.current(data).then(saved => {
        if (saved) lastSavedSnapshotRef.current = decision.serialized;
      });
    };
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (documentVisibleRef.current) saveChanged();
    }, 30000);
    const flushHidden = () => { if (document.hidden) saveChanged(); };
    const flushPage = () => saveChanged();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', flushHidden);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', flushPage);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', flushHidden);
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', flushPage);
      saveChanged();
    };
  }, [buildSaveData]);

  // ── Begin the story — server-authorized, one-way commitment ──────────────
  const beginStory = useCallback(async () => {
    const g = gs.current;
    if (g.story?.active) { setShowStoryWarn(false); return; }
    const slot = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sm_slot') ?? '0', 10);
    try {
      // Persist current state first so the server has up-to-date job/business
      // info to verify eligibility against (await so begin sees fresh state).
      await doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
      const r = await apiFetch(`/api/salaryman/story/${slot}/begin`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        credentials: 'include',
        body: JSON.stringify({}),
      });
      const j = await r.json().catch(() => null);
      // Server-authoritative + one-way: only begin (and relocate the home base to
      // the underground camp) when the begin endpoint confirms. A rejected/failed
      // response leaves the beacon dark; an already-active story is a silent no-op.
      const decision = decideStoryBegin(g.story?.active, r.ok, j);
      if (!decision.begin) {
        setShowStoryWarn(false);
        if (decision.reason === 'already-active') return;
        sfxError();
        setNarr('> ' + (decision.error ?? 'The beacon stays dark. Finish your first project — a job or a business — before it answers.'));
        return;
      }
      g.story = decision.story as StoryState;
      // SCENE 1 — "AND IT ALL FALLS DOWN". The beacon commits the story, but the
      // MX-75 terminal is NOT handed over here: the player has to escape out the
      // back, down through the alley, and reach the UNDERGROUND CAMP to CLAIM it.
      // The grant + relocation happen in the claim beat on camp arrival.
      g.nearStoryTrigger = false;
      g.sceneRun = { id: 'and_it_all_falls_down', phase: 'intro', startTime: Date.now(), alleyReached: false };
      // Cache the player's zoom and snap in close — "almost first person" — so the
      // collapse feels claustrophobic. Restored when the scene completes.
      g.sceneZoomPrev = targetZoomRef.current;
      targetZoomRef.current = sceneTightZoom(targetZoomRef.current);
      g.shakeFrames = 70; g.shakeMag = 7;
      setStoryActive(true);
      setShowStoryWarn(false);
      // Terminal switch-in/out: the old PABLO CORP tower terminal flickers and the
      // story's framed cinematic takes over. The boot overlay (zIndex 9000) plays
      // on top of the intro cinematic for its short duration, then clears to reveal
      // the line crawl — a deliberate "menu → scene" hand-off at story trigger.
      playTerminalBoot('office');
      setSceneCine({ id: 'and_it_all_falls_down', phase: 'intro', startTime: Date.now() });
      sfxMilestone(); sfxLoreReveal();
      setNarr('> ' + sceneLabel(0) + ' — Everything just changed. Stay on your feet.');
      doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
    } catch {
      sfxError();
      setShowStoryWarn(false);
      setNarr('> CONNECTION LOST — The beacon flickered and went dark. Try again.');
    }
  }, [buildSaveData]);

  // SCENE 1 mid-escape checkpoint persistence. The per-run sceneRun is ephemeral,
  // so mirror the breakout milestones onto the durable data.story blob and save.
  // A reload during the escape then resumes from these (see the resume backstop)
  // instead of replaying the breakout from the top.
  const persistScene1Progress = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    if (!g.story || !g.sceneRun) return;
    g.story.scene1 = snapshotScene1Checkpoint(g.sceneRun);
    doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
  }, [buildSaveData]);

  // SCENE 1 advance: from the opening "intro" cinematic into the playable ESCAPE
  // phase. Unfreezes input and sets the objective; the tight zoom stays on.
  const sceneAdvanceFromIntro = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    g.sceneRun = advanceScene1FromIntro(g.sceneRun);
    setSceneCine(null);
    setNarr('> ESCAPE — Into the SERVICE VENTS. Drop through the abandoned floors to the UNDERGROUND CAMP below.');
  }, []);

  // Mark a story assignment complete and persist it (rides the data.story blob).
  // This is the framework hook gameplay calls when an assignment objective is
  // satisfied; Q1 slot 1 is wired through sceneClaimFinalize below.
  const completeAssignment = useCallback((id: string) => {
    const g = gs.current;
    if (!g.story) return;
    const list = g.story.assignmentsCompleted ?? (g.story.assignmentsCompleted = []);
    if (list.includes(id)) return;
    list.push(id);
    setAssignmentsRev(r => r + 1);
    doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
  }, [buildSaveData]);

  // SCENE 1 finalize: the player reached the camp and CLAIMS the MX-75. Grants a
  // working device, locks home base to the camp, restores zoom, marks the scene
  // complete (missionIndex >= 1) and persists.
  const sceneClaimFinalize = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    // Idempotency guard — a double click / key-repeat must not re-run the
    // finalize (which would zero sceneZoomPrev and lose the restored zoom).
    if (!canFinalizeScene1Claim(g.sceneRun, g.story)) { setSceneCine(null); return; }
    // Apply the camp-claim reward via the pure, idempotent helper: grants the
    // working MX-75, flips mx75Granted, advances the mission past Scene 1 and
    // records the assignment exactly once. See @/lib/story-scene1.
    if (g.story) {
      const reward = applyScene1ClaimReward(g.story);
      g.story = reward.story;
      g.hasDevice = reward.device.hasDevice;
      g.deviceBroken = reward.device.deviceBroken;
      g.deviceDurability = reward.device.deviceDurability;
      setHasDevice(reward.device.hasDevice); setDeviceBroken(reward.device.deviceBroken);
      setAssignmentsRev(r => r + 1);
      if (g.story.homeBase) { g.px = g.story.homeBase.x; g.py = g.story.homeBase.y; }
    } else {
      g.hasDevice = true; g.deviceBroken = false; g.deviceDurability = 100;
      setHasDevice(true); setDeviceBroken(false);
    }
    targetZoomRef.current = restoreSceneZoom(g.sceneZoomPrev, computeDefaultZoom());
    g.sceneZoomPrev = 0;
    g.sceneRun = { id: 'and_it_all_falls_down', phase: 'done', startTime: Date.now(), alleyReached: true };
    setSceneCine(null);
    sfxMilestone(); sfxRealUsdDeposit();
    setNarr('> ' + sceneLabel(0) + ' COMPLETE — The MX-75 is yours. This camp is home now. Stay low. Stay working.');
    doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
    // The MX-75 boots a NEW signal — Pablo's help is dark; Mila comes online.
    // Mark the handoff PENDING and route to it in THIS tick (no timer): a delayed
    // navigate could be skipped forever if the component unmounts first, while the
    // finalize idempotency guard above blocks any re-fire. The pending flag is the
    // durable backstop — if this navigation is ever lost, the mount effect replays
    // it on next load, and the cutscene page clears the flag once actually shown.
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(MILA_HANDOFF_KEY, MILA_HANDOFF_PENDING);
      // Pre-seed the assistant persona so the next terminal open paints as Mila on
      // the first frame. Owner-unknown ({ uid: null }) on purpose: the terminal
      // re-tags it with the resolved user id on mount and the server persona fetch
      // confirms it. Account-tagged shape so a different account can't inherit it.
      localStorage.setItem('salaryman.persona', JSON.stringify({ uid: null, persona: 'mila' }));
    } catch { /* localStorage unavailable */ }
    navigate('/cutscene/mila-handoff');
  }, [buildSaveData, navigate]);

  const handleRadioToggle = useCallback(() => {
    const result = toggleRadio();
    if (result.on) {
      // When radio turns on, pause ambient score to avoid overlap
      if (scoreOn) { pauseMusic(); }
      const st = RADIO_STATIONS.find(s => s.id === stationId) ?? RADIO_STATIONS[0];
      setNarr(`> You turn the dial. Static. Then music. RADIO ${st.freq} — ${st.name}. The signal bleeds through the walls. Something familiar. Something human.`);
    } else {
      // When radio turns off, resume ambient score only if AMBIANCE is enabled
      if (getAmbianceEnabled() && !getScoreMuted() && !getMusicEnabled()) { playMusic(); }
      setNarr('> You switch the radio off. Silence returns. The wasteland hum fills the gap.');
    }
  }, [toggleRadio, stationId, scoreOn, scoreMuted, pauseMusic, playMusic]);

  // This is deliberately the only writer of the legacy save's salary field.
  // `salary` remains in the game save for backwards compatibility/UI hydration,
  // but Banco Ombra's wallet response is the authority.
  const reconcileAuthoritativeSalary = useCallback((newBalance: number) => {
    gs.current.salary = newBalance;
    setSalary(newBalance);
  }, []);

  const performGameplayFiatAction = useCallback(async (actionId: string, interaction: string) => {
    const idempotencyKey = stableRequestId('world-gameplay-fiat', `${actionId}:${interaction}`);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch('/api/gameplay/fiat/action', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ actionId, idempotencyKey }),
      });
      const data = await response.json() as {
        ok?: boolean; error?: string; newBalance?: number; amountFiat?: number; spendable?: number; duplicate?: boolean;
      };
      if (!response.ok || !data.ok || typeof data.newBalance !== 'number') {
        if (response.status === 402) {
          setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FIAT — Need ƒ${(data.amountFiat ?? 0).toLocaleString()}. Spendable: ƒ${(data.spendable ?? 0).toLocaleString()}.`);
        } else {
          setNarr(`> TRANSACTION FAILED — ${data.error ?? 'Could not complete wallet action.'}`);
        }
        sfxError();
        return null;
      }
      reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(data.newBalance);
      return data;
    } catch {
      sfxError();
      setNarr('> NETWORK ERROR — Wallet action could not be completed.');
      return null;
    }
  }, [reconcileAuthoritativeSalary]);

  const completeQuickJob = useCallback(async (runId: string) => {
    const idempotencyKey = stableRequestId('world-job-complete', runId);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/api/gameplay/jobs/${runId}/complete`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ idempotencyKey }),
      });
      const data = await response.json() as {
        ok?: boolean; error?: string; duplicate?: boolean;
        job?: { jobId: string; label: string; payFiat: number; cooldownUntil: string };
        wallet?: { newBalance: number };
      };
      if (!response.ok || !data.ok || !data.job || typeof data.wallet?.newBalance !== 'number') {
        if (data.error !== 'job_not_ready') {
          sfxError();
          setNarr(`> JOB FAILED — ${data.error ?? 'Could not settle job.'}`);
        }
        return;
      }
      reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(data.wallet.newBalance);
      if (!data.duplicate) {
        const g = gs.current;
        const remainingMs = Math.max(0, new Date(data.job.cooldownUntil).getTime() - Date.now());
        g.jobCooldowns[data.job.jobId] = Math.ceil(remainingMs / (1000 / 60));
        g.employedAt = data.job.label;
        g.employedSalary = data.job.payFiat;
        setEmpLabel(data.job.label);
        g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `+ƒ${data.job.payFiat}`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 70, maxLife: 70 });
        sfxCoin();
        setNarr(`> JOB COMPLETE — ${data.job.label}. +ƒ${data.job.payFiat}. You are now employed here.`);
      }
      setJobPanel(null);
    } catch {
      sfxError();
      setNarr('> NETWORK ERROR — Job completion could not be confirmed.');
    }
  }, [reconcileAuthoritativeSalary]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const slot = (() => { try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sm_slot') ?? '0', 10) || 0; } catch { return 0; } })();
    void Promise.all([
      apiFetch(`/api/gameplay/jobs/status?slot=${slot}`),
      apiFetch(`/api/gameplay/market/cargo?slot=${slot}`),
    ]).then(async ([jobResponse, cargoResponse]) => {
      if (jobResponse.ok) {
        const data = await jobResponse.json() as {
          activeJob?: { runId: string; jobId: string; label: string; payFiat: number; durationMs: number; startedAt: string; completesAt: string } | null;
          wallet?: { balance: number };
        };
        if (typeof data.wallet?.balance === 'number') reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(data.wallet.balance);
        if (data.activeJob) {
          const elapsed = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - new Date(data.activeJob.startedAt).getTime()) / 1000);
          setJobPanel({
            bid: data.activeJob.jobId, label: data.activeJob.label, pay: data.activeJob.payFiat,
            seconds: data.activeJob.durationMs / 1000, progress: Math.min(data.activeJob.durationMs / 1000, elapsed),
            runId: data.activeJob.runId, completesAt: data.activeJob.completesAt,
          });
        }
      }
      if (cargoResponse.ok) {
        const data = await cargoResponse.json() as { cargo?: { items: Record<string, number> }; wallet?: { balance: number } };
        if (data.cargo?.items) {
          gs.current.cargo = { ...data.cargo.items };
          setCargo({ ...data.cargo.items });
        }
        if (typeof data.wallet?.balance === 'number') reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(data.wallet.balance);
      }
    }).catch(() => { /* world economy hydration retries on the next mount */ });
  }, [reconcileAuthoritativeSalary]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobPanel?.runId || !jobPanel.completesAt) return;
    const runId = jobPanel.runId;
    const completesAt = new Date(jobPanel.completesAt).getTime();
    const startedAt = completesAt - jobPanel.seconds * 1000;
    const tick = () => {
      const elapsed = Math.max(0, Math.min(jobPanel.seconds, (Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000));
      setJobPanel((current) => current?.runId === runId ? { ...current, progress: elapsed } : current);
      if (Date.now() >= completesAt) {
        if (jobTimerRef.current) clearInterval(jobTimerRef.current);
        jobTimerRef.current = null;
        if (jobPanel.bid === 'water_plants') {
          setJobPanel((current) => current?.runId === runId ? { ...current, progress: current.seconds } : current);
        } else {
          void completeQuickJob(runId);
        }
      }
    };
    tick();
    if (Date.now() < completesAt) jobTimerRef.current = setInterval(tick, 250);
    return () => {
      if (jobTimerRef.current) clearInterval(jobTimerRef.current);
      jobTimerRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [jobPanel?.bid, jobPanel?.runId, jobPanel?.completesAt, jobPanel?.seconds, completeQuickJob]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showTrade) return;
    setMarketCatalog(null);
    void apiFetch('/api/gameplay/market/catalog').then(async response => {
      const data = await response.json() as { ok?: boolean; error?: string; location?: 'city'|'waste'; prices?: Record<string, CargoPrices>; capacity?: number };
      if (!response.ok || !data.ok || !data.location || !data.prices || typeof data.capacity !== 'number') {
        sfxError();
        setNarr(`> MARKET ACCESS DENIED — ${data.error ?? 'Move closer to an exchange.'}`);
        setShowTrade(null);
        return;
      }
      setMarketCatalog({ location: data.location, prices: data.prices, capacity: data.capacity });
    }).catch(() => {
      sfxError();
      setNarr('> NETWORK ERROR — Market catalog unavailable.');
      setShowTrade(null);
    });
  }, [showTrade]);

  const executeBuildingLogic = useCallback(async (bid: string) => {
    const g = gs.current;
    const isOwnerHome = bid === g.hamletBuildingId;

    // ── Apply HOME_DEFAULT_FURNITURE on first entry ────────────────────────
    if (isOwnerHome) {
      const existing = placedFurnitureMapRef.current[bid];
      if (!existing || existing.length === 0) {
        if (HOME_DEFAULT_FURNITURE.length > 0) {
          const newMap = { ...placedFurnitureMapRef.current, [bid]: HOME_DEFAULT_FURNITURE };
          setPlacedFurnitureMap(newMap);
          try { localStorage.setItem('sm_furniture', JSON.stringify(newMap)); } catch {}
        }
      }
    }

    if (bid === 'clinic') completeQuestTask('starter_explore_clinic', 'visit_clinic');
    if (bid === 'noodle_bar') completeQuestTask('starter_noodle_run', 'visit_noodle');
    if (bid === 'arcade' || bid === 'pablo_store') completeQuestTask('starter_explore_city', 'visit_poi');

    if (RADIO_BUILDINGS.has(bid)) {
      showRadio();
    }

    // ── WORKSTATION REST ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (char.hasBusiness && char.workstation === bid) {
      completeQuestTask('establish_business', 'visit_workstation');
      completeQuestTask('establish_business', 'setup_signage');
      const biz = (g.businesses ?? []).find((b: OwnedBusiness) => b.workstation === bid || b.companyName === char.company);
      if (biz) biz.lastActivityAt = Date.now();
      const daysSinceReg = char.bizRegisteredAt
        ? Math.floor((Date.now() - char.bizRegisteredAt) / 86400000)
        : 0;
      const isFree = daysSinceReg < 7;
      const wsRent = 500;
      if (!isFree && g.salary < wsRent) {
        sfxError();
        setNarr(`> ${char.workstationLabel?.toUpperCase() ?? 'WORKSTATION'} — Rent overdue. ƒ${wsRent} required. You're on the clock.`);
        return;
      }
      if (!isFree && !await performGameplayFiatAction('workstation_rent', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:workstation:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`)) return;
      g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + Math.floor(g.maxHp * 0.5)); g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + 50);
      g.hunger = Math.min(100, g.hunger + 20); g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + 20);
      setHp(g.hp); setEnergy(g.energy); setHunger(g.hunger); setThirst(g.thirst);
      doSave({ name: char.name, class: char.class, level: g.level, exp: g.exp, salary: g.salary });
      const daysLeft = Math.max(0, 7 - daysSinceReg);
      setNarr(isFree
        ? `> ${char.workstationLabel?.toUpperCase() ?? 'WORKSTATION'} — ${char.workstationSlot ?? 'Your slot'}. FREE rest. HP +50%. Energy +50. Progress saved. ${daysLeft} free day${daysLeft !== 1 ? 's' : ''} remaining before ƒ${wsRent}/rest kicks in.`
        : `> ${char.workstationLabel?.toUpperCase() ?? 'WORKSTATION'} — ${char.workstationSlot ?? 'Your slot'}. ƒ${wsRent} FIAT rent charged. HP +50%. Energy +50. Progress saved. The city takes its cut.`

      g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + Math.floor(g.maxHp * 0.6));
      g.hunger = Math.min(100, g.hunger + 50); g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + 50);
      g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + 40); g.poisoned = false;

      if (g.catCompanion.active && g.catCompanion.injured) {

        g.catCompanion.injured = false;
        setCatHp(g.catCompanion.hp); setCatInjured(false);
        c2Msg += ` ${g.catCompanion.name} partially healed.`;
      }
      setNarr(c2Msg);
