      setHp(g.hp); setHunger(g.hunger); setThirst(g.thirst); setEnergy(g.energy); setPoisoned(false); sfxHeal();
      doSave({ name: char.name, class: char.class, level: g.level, exp: g.exp, salary: g.salary });
      setNarr('> SOUTHERN TERMINAL — The deepest settlement in the wasteland. Run by survivors who gave up on the city but not on each other. HP +60%. Stats partially restored. Progress saved. "Nobody from PABLO CORP has ever been here." You believe them.');
    }
  }, [performGameplayFiatAction]);

  // ── Interior HUD suppression ──────────────────────────────────────
  // Offices, residences and other calm interiors hide the survival/combat
  // HUD and disable the weapon wheel — you don't fight at a desk. Combat
  // (a hostile present) or a story flag (g.forceWorldHud) brings the
  // battle HUD back even while indoors.
  const isPeacefulInterior = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    if (!g.interior) return false;
    if (g.forceWorldHud) return false;
    // Interior hostiles (squatters/residents who shove intruders) count as
    // combat — bring the battle HUD + weapons back when one is close.
    const idef = g.interior.def as { workers?: { x: number; y: number; hostile?: boolean }[] } | undefined;
    if (idef?.workers?.some(w => w.hostile && Math.hypot(g.interior!.px - w.x, g.interior!.py - w.y) < 160)) return false;
    // Outdoor threats that drifted into range (rare while indoors).
    return !(g.threats?.some((t: { type: string; x: number; y: number }) => Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y) < 340 && t.type !== 'STRAY_DOG' && t.type !== 'STRAY_CAT'));
  }, []);

  // True when the current interior is a workplace (office / HQ / bank / lab /
  // bureau). Drives the stamina meter swapping its katana for a yellow pencil.
  const isOfficeInterior = useCallback(() => {
    const iid = (gs.current.interior?.def?.id || gs.current.interior?.bid || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!iid) return false;
    return /office|company_hq|hq$|bureau|bank|labs|nexus|police|corp|admin/.test(iid);
  }, []);

  // ── Sleep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Instant: a short dream plays, then ~8 hours pass. Restores energy and
  // stamina fully and heals a little HP. Survival keeps ticking — you wake
  // a touch hungrier and thirstier, mirroring a normal night's rest.
  const doSleep = useCallback(() => {
    if (dreamSleepRef.current) return;
    dreamSleepRef.current = true;
    const lines = [
      'You are back at the old desk. The numbers never stop scrolling.',
      'Rain on a window that does not exist. Somewhere, a phone keeps ringing.',
      'SENIOR PABLO smiles from every billboard at once. You cannot look away.',
      'You walk the city before the fog. The streets are clean. It is quiet.',
      'A door you have never opened. Behind it, your own voice, much younger.',
    ];
    setDreamText(lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)]);
    setDreamSleep(true);
    frozenRef.current = true;
    sfxHeal();
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const g = gs.current;
      // Sleeping fast-forwards the world clock by 8 in-game hours. The calendar
      // is authoritative, so advance it (rolling the day/month) and mirror the
      // hour back onto worldTime.
      g.calendar = tickCalendar(g.calendar, 8 * (VISUAL_MS_PER_GAME_DAY / 24), quarterToSeason(getRealQuarter()));
      g.worldTime = g.calendar.hour;
      g.worldTimeTick = 0;
      g.energy = 100; setEnergy(100);
      if (g.stamina) g.stamina.current = COMBAT_CONSTANTS.STAMINA_MAX;
      const heal = Math.floor(g.maxHp * 0.12);
      g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + heal); setHp(g.hp);
      g.hunger = Math.max(0, g.hunger - 15); setHunger(g.hunger);
      g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - 12); setThirst(g.thirst);
      setDreamSleep(false);
      dreamSleepRef.current = false;
      frozenRef.current = false;
      setNarr(`> AWAKE — Eight hours gone. Energy and stamina restored. HP +${heal}. You wake a little hungrier.`);
    }, 2800);
  }, []);

  const enterInterior = useCallback((bid: string) => {
    const g = gs.current;
    let def = getInterior(bid);
    if (!def) return;
    if (bid === 'pablo_tower' && g.housingTier === 'tower_villa') {
      const bld = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'pablo_tower');
      const villaDef = INTERIOR_DEFS['_villa'];
      if (villaDef) def = { ...villaDef, id: 'pablo_tower', label: bld?.label ?? 'SHADOW TOWER' };
    }
    if (bid === 'safe_house' && g.housingTier === 'city_house') {
      const bld = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'safe_house');
      const houseDef = INTERIOR_DEFS['_house'];
      if (houseDef) def = { ...houseDef, id: 'safe_house', label: bld?.label ?? 'ROWHOUSE' };
    }
    const isOwnerHomeEntry = bid === g.hamletBuildingId;
    const qualifiesForLab = isOwnerHomeEntry && g.housingTier !== 'shelter' && g.housingTier !== 'outpost' && g.housingTier !== 'machine_bunker';
    if (qualifiesForLab) {
      const hasStaircase = def.objects.some(o => o.label === 'SECRET STAIRCASE');
      if (!hasStaircase) {
        const stairX = def.width - 55;
        const stairY = def.height - 65;
        def = { ...def, objects: [...def.objects, { x: stairX, y: stairY, w: 35, h: 35, type: 'elevator' as const, label: 'SECRET STAIRCASE', color: 'rgba(0,150,255,.2)' }] };
      }
    }
    def = ensureAtm(def);
    g.interiorFade = 0;
    g.interiorFadeDir = 1;
    g.interiorFadeCallback = () => {
      g.interior = {
        bid, def,
        px: def.exitX + def.exitW / 2,
        py: def.exitY - 20,
        savedWorldX: g.px,
        savedWorldY: g.py,
      };
      setBuildingMapContext(
        bid,
        def.label,
        BUILDING_INTERIOR_MAP[bid] ?? def.id,
        def,
        currentFloor,
      );
      // Defensive: drop any leftover world tap-to-move target so it can't linger
      // across the interior visit and re-trigger a drift the moment we step out.
      g.moveTarget = null;
      // Following pets trot in beside the player. A pet that's been left to
      // wait draws at a fixed resting spot computed in the interior render
      // (from the interior def), so it doesn't need positioning here.
      if (g.dogCompanion.active && !g.dogCompanion.stayAt) { g.dogCompanion.ix = g.interior.px - 16; g.dogCompanion.iy = g.interior.py + 12; }
      if (g.catCompanion.active && !g.catCompanion.stayAt) { g.catCompanion.ix = g.interior.px + 16; g.catCompanion.iy = g.interior.py + 12; }
      executeBuildingLogic(bid);
      g.interiorFadeDir = -1;
    };
  }, [currentFloor, executeBuildingLogic]);

  const exitInterior = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    if (!g.interior) return;
    g.interiorFadeDir = 1;
    g.interiorFadeCallback = () => {
      const saved = g.interior!;
      if (g.officeTerminalRenting) {
        const lockKey = `po_${g.officeTerminalRenting.label}`;
        g.locks.delete(lockKey);
        g.officeTerminalRenting = null;
      }
      g.nearInteriorObj = null;
      g.px = saved.savedWorldX;
      g.py = saved.savedWorldY;
      // Clear any stale tap-to-move destinations so the player stays put at the
      // exit instead of auto-walking toward an old target set before entering.
      g.moveTarget = null;
      g.interiorMoveTarget = null;
      g.interior = null;
      clearMapContext();
      setCurrentFloor(0);
      setNarr(`> You step back outside.`);
      g.interiorFadeDir = -1;
    };
  }, []);

  // Hazmat escort = safe fast-travel through the poison fog.
  const doEscort = useCallback((dest: 'city' | 'home') => {
    const g = gs.current;
    if (dest === 'home') {
      const hb = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === g.hamletBuildingId);
      if (hb) { g.px = hb.x + hb.w / 2; g.py = hb.y + hb.h / 2 + 40; }
      else { g.px = 6800; g.py = 6300; }
    } else { g.px = 6800; g.py = 6300; }
    g.gasPoison = false; g.gasExposureTick = 0; g.escortOfferCd = 1800;
    setEscortPrompt(false);
    setNarr('> A hazmat escort guided you safely through the poison fog.');
  }, []);

  const completeQuestTask = useCallback((questId: string, taskId: string) => {
    const g = gs.current;
    const quest = g.quests.find(q => q.id === questId);
    if (!quest || quest.completed) return;
    const task = quest.tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
    if (!task || task.done) return;
    task.done = true;
    if (quest.tasks.filter(t => t.id !== 'pablo_auto').every(t => t.done)) {
      quest.completed = true;
    }
    setQuests([...g.quests]);
  }, []);

  const enterBuilding = useCallback((bid: string) => {
    sfxEnter();
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('sm_visited_locations');
      const visited: string[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      if (!visited.includes(bid)) { visited.push(bid); localStorage.setItem('sm_visited_locations', JSON.stringify(visited)); }
    } catch {}
    const b = BUILDINGS.find(bl => bl.id === bid);
    if (b) sfxDoor(gs.current.px, gs.current.py, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2);
    if (b) {
      const bCenterX = b.x + b.w / 2;
      const bCenterY = b.y + b.h / 2;
      if (HAS_INTERIOR(bid)) {
        buildingEntryZoomRef.current = {
          active: true,
          timer: 45,
          targetX: bCenterX,
          targetY: bCenterY,
          callback: () => enterInterior(bid),
        };
      } else {
        buildingEntryZoomRef.current = {
          active: true,
          timer: 45,
          targetX: bCenterX,
          targetY: bCenterY,
          callback: () => executeBuildingLogic(bid),
        };
      }
      targetZoomRef.current = Math.max(targetZoomRef.current, 2.0);
    } else {
      executeBuildingLogic(bid);
    }
  }, [executeBuildingLogic, enterInterior]);

  const MERCHANT_SENNA: MerchantItem[] = [
    { id: 'forged_basic', name: 'FORGED CITY PASSPORT', desc: 'Basic forged transit pass. Grants checkpoint access with crossing fee.', price: 8000, effect: 'passport_basic_city' },
    { id: 'forged_full', name: 'FORGED FULL PASSPORT', desc: 'Premium forgery with PABLO CORP watermark. Priority access, no crossing fee.', price: 25000, effect: 'passport_full_city' },
    { id: 'forged_waste', name: 'WASTELAND PERMIT', desc: 'Forged wasteland transit authorization. Access to outer sectors.', price: 15000, effect: 'passport_wasteland' },
    { id: 'fake_work_permit', name: 'WORK PERMIT', desc: 'Counterfeit employment papers. +500 FIAT signing bonus.', price: 5000, effect: 'work_permit' },
    { id: 'identity_scrub', name: 'IDENTITY SCRUB', desc: 'Erase your criminal record. Resets wanted level.', price: 20000, effect: 'identity_scrub' },
  ];
  const MERCHANT_ROOK: MerchantItem[] = [
    { id: 'unlock_sword', name: 'UNLOCK SWORD', desc: 'Close-range slash weapon. +6 ATK.', price: 8000, effect: 'unlock_SWORD' },
    { id: 'unlock_gun', name: 'UNLOCK GUN', desc: 'Mid-range projectile weapon. +8 ATK.', price: 15000, effect: 'unlock_GUN' },
    { id: 'unlock_laser', name: 'UNLOCK LASER', desc: 'Long beam weapon. +10 ATK.', price: 25000, effect: 'unlock_LASER' },
    { id: 'unlock_bomb', name: 'UNLOCK BOMB', desc: 'Area explosion weapon. +12 ATK.', price: 30000, effect: 'unlock_BOMB' },
    { id: 'hp_up', name: 'HP UP', desc: 'Permanently increases max HP by 20.', price: 10000, effect: 'maxhp20' },
    { id: 'atk_boost', name: 'ATK BOOST', desc: 'Permanent +5 base attack damage.', price: 18000, effect: 'atk5' },
    { id: 'armor_plate', name: 'ARMOR PLATE', desc: 'Reduces incoming damage by 15%.', price: 22000, effect: 'armor15' },
  ];
  const MERCHANT_MARSH: MerchantItem[] = [
    { id: 'unlock_sword', name: 'UNLOCK SWORD', desc: 'Close-range slash weapon. +6 ATK.', price: 8000, effect: 'unlock_SWORD' },
    { id: 'unlock_gun', name: 'UNLOCK GUN', desc: 'Mid-range projectile weapon. +8 ATK.', price: 15000, effect: 'unlock_GUN' },
    { id: 'unlock_laser', name: 'UNLOCK LASER', desc: 'Long beam weapon. +10 ATK.', price: 25000, effect: 'unlock_LASER' },
    { id: 'hp_up2', name: 'HP UP II', desc: 'Permanently increases max HP by 40.', price: 20000, effect: 'maxhp40' },
    { id: 'speed_boost', name: 'SPEED BOOST', desc: 'Permanent +10% movement speed.', price: 12000, effect: 'speed10' },
    { id: 'armor_plate', name: 'ARMOR PLATE', desc: 'Reduces incoming damage by 15%.', price: 22000, effect: 'armor15' },
  ];

  const LIBRARY_BOOKS = [
    { title: `A BRIEF HISTORY OF ${CITY_NAME}`, text: 'Founded in 1979. Corporate charter signed by an entity known only as PABLO. Population: classified.' },
    { title: 'THE TOWER: AN ARCHITECTURAL STUDY', text: 'Shadow Tower rises 62 floors. Floors 40-62 are restricted. No architectural firm claims the design.' },
    { title: 'WASTELAND SURVIVAL GUIDE', text: 'Rule 1: Water. Rule 2: Shelter. Rule 3: Never trust anyone who works for PABLO CORP' },
    { title: 'MUNICIPAL CODE VOL. 47', text: 'Ordinance 4,712: All rain shall be metered and billed at PABLO CORP standard rates.' },
    { title: 'ANDROID RIGHTS MEMORANDUM', text: 'Androids classified as "peripheral hardware" under PABLO CORP Tax Code 9-B. Appeals: denied.' },
    { title: 'THE COLLAPSE: ORAL HISTORIES', text: 'Thirty-seven survivors describe the same night. The tower light went on. The sirens stopped. Nobody came.' },
  ];

  const enterNpc = useCallback((idx: number) => {
    const n = NPCS[idx];
    const storyDlg = Object.values(STORY_DIALOGUES).find(d => d.npcName === n.name);
    const baseDlg = storyDlg ?? getGenericDialogueTree(n.name, n.role, n.job, idx);
    const dlgTree: DialogueTree = { ...baseDlg, nodes: { ...baseDlg.nodes } };
    if (n.role === 'newspaper_seller') {
      const g = gs.current;
      const seasonIdx = Math.floor(((g.worldTime ?? 8) / 24 * 365) / 91.25) % 4;
      pendingNpcActionRef.current = { type: 'newspaper', seasonIdx };
      const shopNodeId = '__open_shop__';
      dlgTree.nodes[shopNodeId] = { id: shopNodeId, speaker: n.name, portrait: 'npc', text: 'Here you go. Latest issue. Don\'t get caught reading it.', choices: [{ text: '[Read the paper]', nextId: null }], effect: 'open_shop' };
      const startN = dlgTree.nodes[dlgTree.startId];
      if (startN) dlgTree.nodes[dlgTree.startId] = { ...startN, choices: [{ text: 'Let me see the paper.', nextId: shopNodeId }, ...startN.choices] };
    }
    if (n.role === 'dealer_papers') {
      pendingNpcActionRef.current = { type: 'merchant', name: n.name, items: MERCHANT_SENNA };
      const shopNodeId = '__open_shop__';
      dlgTree.nodes[shopNodeId] = { id: shopNodeId, speaker: n.name, portrait: 'npc', text: 'Take a look. Don\'t touch what you\'re not buying.', choices: [{ text: '[Browse wares]', nextId: null }], effect: 'open_shop' };
      const startN = dlgTree.nodes[dlgTree.startId];
      if (startN) dlgTree.nodes[dlgTree.startId] = { ...startN, choices: [{ text: 'Let me see what you\'ve got.', nextId: shopNodeId }, ...startN.choices] };
    }
    if (n.role === 'dealer_weapons') {
      const items = n.name === 'MARSH KETTER' ? MERCHANT_MARSH : MERCHANT_ROOK;
      pendingNpcActionRef.current = { type: 'merchant', name: n.name, items };
      const shopNodeId = '__open_shop__';
      dlgTree.nodes[shopNodeId] = { id: shopNodeId, speaker: n.name, portrait: 'npc', text: 'Alright. Spread\'s laid out. Don\'t grab anything without paying.', choices: [{ text: '[Browse wares]', nextId: null }], effect: 'open_shop' };
      const startN = dlgTree.nodes[dlgTree.startId];
      if (startN) dlgTree.nodes[dlgTree.startId] = { ...startN, choices: [{ text: 'Show me what you\'re carrying.', nextId: shopNodeId }, ...startN.choices] };
    }
    const startNode = dlgTree.nodes[dlgTree.startId];
    if (startNode) {
      setDialogueNpcName(n.name);
      setDialogueNode(startNode);
      setDialogueNpcSeed(idx);
      gs.current.activeDialogue = dlgTree;
      gs.current.activeDialogueNode = dlgTree.startId;
      setShowDialoguePanel(true);
      frozenRef.current = true;
      setNarr(`> ${n.name.toUpperCase()} — ${n.job}`);
      sfxNpcMurmur(idx);
      // Fallout-style: speak the opening line immediately so the NPC
      // actually talks to the player instead of waiting for a choice.
      if (startNode.text) speakNpcLine(n.name, startNode.text);
    }
  }, []);

  const tryEnter = useCallback((bid: string) => {
    const isOwnerHome = bid === gs.current.hamletBuildingId;
    // Front doors of every office / corporate HQ are sealed until the player
    // activates their story. Pre-story the white-collar district is on lockdown.
    if (isOfficeBuilding(bid) && !gs.current.story?.active) {
      sfxError();
      setNarr('> OFFICE SEALED — PABLO CORP has the white-collar district under lockdown. The front door won\'t open until you take the job. (Activate your story.)');
      return;
    }
    // World-defined building locks (BUILDING_LOCKS in city-config). Bunkers
    // and supply caches are gated behind a passcode the player has to figure
    // out (or guess from the hint). Once unlocked the entry is persisted.
    const wLock = getBuildingLock(bid);
    if (wLock && !unlockedBuildingsRef.current.has(bid)) {
      setWorldLockPrompt({ bid, attempt: '', error: '', attempts: 0 });
      if (wLock.flavor) setNarr(`> ${wLock.flavor}`);
      return;
    }
    // Org-locked door — server is authoritative. We only know this door is
    // locked (a hint); ask the server whether THIS player may pass. Members at
    // or above minRole are admitted silently; everyone else is asked for the
    // passcode. Never trust the client: entry only proceeds on an allowed:true.
    const orgHint = orgDoorLocksRef.current.get(bid);
    if (orgHint && !orgDoorUnlockedRef.current.has(bid) && !isOwnerHome) {
      const label = orgHint.label || (BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === bid)?.label ?? 'SECURE DOOR');
      (async () => {
        try {
          const res = await apiFetch('/api/orgs/doors/enter', {
            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ doorKey: bid }), credentials: 'include',
          });
          const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
          if (data?.allowed) {
            orgDoorUnlockedRef.current.add(bid);
            if (data.asMember) setNarr(`> ${label} — Access granted. Welcome back.`);
            enterBuilding(bid);
          } else if (data?.requiresPasscode) {
            setOrgDoorPrompt({ bid, label, spaceType: orgHint.spaceType, minRole: orgHint.minRole, mode: 'enter', canManage: false, hasLock: true });
            setOrgDoorPw(''); setOrgDoorPwError('');
            setNarr(`> ${label} — Org-secured. Enter the passcode or sign in with sufficient clearance.`);
          } else {
            setNarr(`> ${label} — Access denied.`);
          }
        } catch {
          setNarr(`> ${label} — Lock unreachable. Try again.`);
        }
      })();
      return;
    }
    if (HOME_PASSWORDS.has(bid) && !isOwnerHome) {
      setDoorLockPrompt({ bid, mode: 'enter_pw' });
      setDoorLockPw('');
      setDoorLockPwError('');
      return;
    }
    if (COMPANY_HQ_BUILDING_IDS.has(bid)) {
      const existingLock = gs.current.locks.get(bid);
      if (existingLock) {
        if (existingLock.company && char.company && existingLock.company === char.company) {
          enterBuilding(bid);
          return;
        }
        const b = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === bid);
        const lockLabel = existingLock.company
          ? `${existingLock.company} HQ`
          : (b?.label ?? bid);
        if (existingLock.message) setNarr(`> ${lockLabel} — "${existingLock.message}"`);
        setPwPrompt({ bid, label: lockLabel, mode: 'enter' });
        pendingBidRef.current = bid; setPendingBid(bid);
        return;
      }
      pendingBidRef.current = bid; setPendingBid(bid);
      wsSend({ type: 'building_lock_query', buildingId: bid });
      return;
    }
    enterBuilding(bid);
  }, [enterBuilding, char.company, wsSend]);

  // ── Org door handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Every one of these defers to the server: the client never decides access or
  // mutates a lock locally. We only reflect what the server returns.
  const submitOrgDoorEnter = useCallback(async () => {
    const prompt = orgDoorPrompt;
    if (!prompt || orgDoorBusy) return;
    const pass = orgDoorPw.trim();
    if (!pass) { setOrgDoorPwError('Enter the passcode.'); return; }
    setOrgDoorBusy(true); setOrgDoorPwError('');
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch('/api/orgs/doors/enter', {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ doorKey: prompt.bid, passcode: pass }), credentials: 'include',
      });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (data?.allowed) {
        orgDoorUnlockedRef.current.add(prompt.bid);
        setOrgDoorPrompt(null); setOrgDoorPw('');
        setNarr(`> ${prompt.label} — Passcode accepted. Access granted.`);
        enterBuilding(prompt.bid);
      } else {
        setOrgDoorPwError('ACCESS DENIED — Wrong passcode.');
      }
    } catch {
      setOrgDoorPwError('Lock unreachable. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setOrgDoorBusy(false);
    }
  }, [orgDoorPrompt, orgDoorPw, orgDoorBusy, enterBuilding]);

  const submitOrgDoorSave = useCallback(async () => {
    const prompt = orgDoorPrompt;
    if (!prompt || orgDoorBusy || !orgData?.org) return;
    const pass = orgDoorPw.trim();
    // For a new lock a passcode is required; for an existing lock a blank field
    // means "keep current passcode" — only the minRole changes.
    if (!prompt.hasLock || pass) {
      const err = VALID_PASSWORD(pass);
      if (err) { setOrgDoorPwError(err); return; }
    }
    setOrgDoorBusy(true); setOrgDoorPwError('');
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        doorKey: prompt.bid,
        label: prompt.label,
        spaceType: prompt.spaceType,
        minRole: orgDoorMinRole,
      };
      if (pass) body.passcode = pass;
      const res = await apiFetch(`/api/orgs/${orgData.org.id}/doors`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body), credentials: 'include',
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await refreshOrgDoorLocks();
        orgDoorUnlockedRef.current.add(prompt.bid); // managers can always pass their own
        setOrgDoorPrompt(null); setOrgDoorPw('');
        setNarr(`> ${prompt.label} — Lock ${prompt.hasLock ? 'updated' : 'set'}. Minimum rank: ${orgDoorMinRole.toUpperCase()}.`);
      } else {
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setOrgDoorPwError(data?.error ?? 'Could not save lock.');
      }
    } catch {
      setOrgDoorPwError('Lock unreachable. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setOrgDoorBusy(false);
    }
  }, [orgDoorPrompt, orgDoorPw, orgDoorMinRole, orgDoorBusy, orgData, refreshOrgDoorLocks]);

  const submitOrgDoorRemove = useCallback(async () => {
    const prompt = orgDoorPrompt;
    if (!prompt || orgDoorBusy || !orgData?.org) return;
    setOrgDoorBusy(true); setOrgDoorPwError('');
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/api/orgs/${orgData.org.id}/doors/${encodeURIComponent(prompt.bid)}`, {
        method: 'DELETE', credentials: 'include',
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await refreshOrgDoorLocks();
        orgDoorUnlockedRef.current.delete(prompt.bid);
        setOrgDoorPrompt(null);
        setNarr(`> ${prompt.label} — Lock removed. This space is now open.`);
      } else {
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setOrgDoorPwError(data?.error ?? 'Could not remove lock.');
      }
    } catch {
      setOrgDoorPwError('Lock unreachable. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setOrgDoorBusy(false);
    }
  }, [orgDoorPrompt, orgDoorBusy, orgData, refreshOrgDoorLocks]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const proto = location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
    const makeUrl = (x: number, y: number) =>
      `${proto}//${location.host}/ws?name=${encodeURIComponent(char.name)}&class=${char.class}&company=${encodeURIComponent(char.company ?? '')}&x=${x}&y=${y}&city=${encodeURIComponent(getActiveCityId())}`;
    const ws = new WebSocket(makeUrl(char.sx, char.sy));
    wsRef.current = ws;
    let disposed = false;
    let reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    ws.onclose = (ev) => {
      if (disposed) return;
      if (ev.code === 4001) {
        // Server rejected entry: visa required for this city.
        const params = new URLSearchParams(ws.url.split('?')[1] ?? '');
        const cityId = params.get('city') ?? getActiveCityId();
        setVisaRequiredCityId(cityId);
        setVisaApplyError('');
        setShowVisaRequired(true);
        frozenRef.current = true;
        // Do NOT auto-reconnect — the visa modal owns the reconnect path.
        wsRef.current = null;
        return;
      }
      reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!disposed && wsRef.current === ws) setWsReconnectKey(key => key + 1);
      }, 3000);
    };
    ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
      let m: any; try { m = JSON.parse(ev.data); } catch { return; }
      const g = gs.current;
      if (m.type === 'visa_required') {
        // Server says a visa is needed before entry is allowed.
        // Close the socket explicitly so the onclose handler doesn't also fire
        // an auto-reconnect (wsRef is nulled first to disarm it).
        wsRef.current = null;
        ws.close();
        const cityId = m.cityId ?? getActiveCityId();
        setVisaRequiredCityId(cityId);
        setVisaApplyError('');
        setShowVisaRequired(true);
        frozenRef.current = true;
        return;
      }
      if (m.type === 'server_full') {
        // Held in the lobby — drop our claim on this socket so the generic
        // onclose auto-reconnect doesn't spin up a handler-less zombie; the
        // lobby's own poll handles re-entry.
        setLobbyInfo({ online: m.online, max: m.max, cityId: m.cityId, region: m.region, voucherGranted: m.voucherGranted });
        setServerFull(true);
        if (wsRef.current === ws) wsRef.current = null;
        ws.close(1000, 'Capacity lobby');
        return;
      } else if (m.type === 'welcome') {
        setServerFull(false);
        g.myId = m.id;
        if (m.locks) {
          const nl = new Map<string, { ownerName: string; company?: string; message?: string }>();
          Object.entries(m.locks).forEach(([bid, v]: any) => {
            nl.set(bid, { ownerName: v.ownerName, company: v.company, message: v.message });
            g.locks.set(bid, v);
          });
          setLockMap(nl);
        }
        if (m.ownershipStats) setOwnerStats(m.ownershipStats);
        if (Array.isArray(m.activeWorldEvents) && m.activeWorldEvents.length > 0) {
          setActiveWorldEvents(m.activeWorldEvents as WorldEventClient[]);
          activeWorldEventsRef.current = m.activeWorldEvents as WorldEventClient[];
          // Toast late-joiners: events were already live when they connected
          const evList = m.activeWorldEvents as WorldEventClient[];
          const evCount = evList.length;
          const firstBanner = (evList[0] as any).banner || '> ALERT — Emergency active.';
          toast({
            title: evCount === 1 ? '🚨 City Alert (Active)' : `🚨 ${evCount} City Events Active`,
            description: evCount === 1
              ? firstBanner.replace(/^> /, '')
              : `${evCount} events are ongoing. Check the map for beacons.`,
            duration: 10000,
          });
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'world_event_start') {
        const ev: WorldEventClient = { id: m.id, eventType: m.eventType, locationX: m.locationX, locationY: m.locationY, rewardFiat: m.rewardFiat, ttlMs: m.ttlMs, spawnedAt: Date.now(), banner: m.banner };
        setActiveWorldEvents(prev => { const next = [...prev.filter(e => e.id !== m.id), ev]; activeWorldEventsRef.current = next; return next; });
        setNarr(m.banner ?? '> ALERT — Emergency reported.');
        // COMMS toaster so the alert reaches players who are online but outside the world map
        toast({ title: '🚨 City Alert', description: (m.banner ?? '> ALERT — Emergency reported.').replace(/^> /, ''), duration: 8000 });
      } else if (m.type === 'world_event_resolved') {
        setActiveWorldEvents(prev => { const next = prev.filter(e => e.id !== m.id); activeWorldEventsRef.current = next; return next; });
        if (!m.expired) setNarr('> EVENT — SITUATION RESOLVED.');
      } else if (m.type === 'event_reward') {
        const g = gs.current;
        void performGameplayFiatAction('world_message_reward', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:message:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
        setSalary(g.salary);
        sfxCoin();
        setNarr(`> ${m.message ?? `EVENT REWARD — ƒ${(m.reward ?? 0).toLocaleString()} credited.`}`);
      } else if (m.type === 'player_collapsed_ping') {
        const g = gs.current;
        if (!g.collapsedPeers) g.collapsedPeers = [];
        g.collapsedPeers = [...g.collapsedPeers.filter((p: any) => p.id !== m.id), { id: m.id, name: m.name, x: m.x, y: m.y, until: Date.now() + 120_000 }];
      } else if (m.type === 'player_revived' || m.type === 'player_revived_by') {
        const g = gs.current;
        if (g.collapsedPeers) g.collapsedPeers = g.collapsedPeers.filter((p: any) => p.id !== (m.id ?? m.rescuerId));
        if (m.type === 'player_revived_by') {
          setIsCollapsed(false);
          isCollapsedRef.current = false;
          g.energy = Math.max(20, g.energy);
          setEnergy(g.energy);
          setNarr(`> ${m.message ?? 'You were revived!'}`);
          wsSend({ type: 'player_stood_up' });
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'player_list') {
        g.peers.clear();
        (m.players as Peer[]).filter(p => p.id !== g.myId).forEach(p => g.peers.set(p.id, p));
        setOnline((m.players as Peer[]).filter(p => p.id !== g.myId));
      } else if (m.type === 'position_correction' && Number.isFinite(m.x) && Number.isFinite(m.y)) {
        g.px = m.x;
        g.py = m.y;
        g.moveTarget = null;
        g.interiorMoveTarget = null;
      } else if (m.type === 'player_move') { const p = g.peers.get(m.id); if (p) { p.x = m.x; p.y = m.y; if (m.paused !== undefined) p.paused = m.paused; if (m.sleeping !== undefined) p.sleeping = m.sleeping; else if (m.paused !== undefined) p.sleeping = m.paused; p.interiorBid = m.interiorBid; } }
      else if (m.type === 'player_speaking') {
        if (m.speaking) g.speakingSet.add(m.id); else g.speakingSet.delete(m.id);
        setSpeakIds(new Set(g.speakingSet));
      } else if (m.type === 'proximity_chat') {
        // Dialog bubble above the speaker's head (Deckard bots + real world speech).
        const bubbleText = String(m.text ?? '').slice(0, 160);
        g.bubbles.set(m.id, { text: bubbleText, expiry: Date.now() + 5200 });
        queueConversationTranslation(bubbleText, translated => {
          const bubble = g.bubbles.get(m.id);
          if (bubble && bubble.text === bubbleText && translated) bubble.translated = translated.slice(0, 160);
        });
        // Also surface in the world chat log so nothing scrolls past unseen.
        // Humans also arrive via `chat` room:world, so de-dupe on recent from+text;
        // bots/NPCs (proximity-only) fall through and get logged exactly once.
        const pName = String(m.name ?? '').slice(0, 40);
        const pText = String(m.text ?? '').slice(0, 160);
        if (pName && pText) {
          const key = `${pName}\u0001${pText}`, nowL = Date.now();
          const rl = recentLogRef.current;
          if (!rl.some(e => e.k === key && nowL - e.ts < 4000)) {
            rl.push({ k: key, ts: nowL });
            if (rl.length > 24) rl.splice(0, rl.length - 24);
            const messageId = seq++;
            setChatMsgs(prev => [...prev.slice(-99), {
              id: messageId, from: pName, text: pText,
              translationPending: translationConversationRef.current,
            }]);
            queueConversationTranslation(pText, translated => {
              if (!translated) {
                setChatMsgs(prev => prev.map(msg => msg.id === messageId ? { ...msg, translationPending: false } : msg));
                return;
              }
              setChatMsgs(prev => prev.map(msg => msg.id === messageId
                ? { ...msg, translated, translationPending: false }
                : msg));
            });
            if (!chatOpenRef.current) setUnread(n => n + 1);
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'player_left') {
        g.peers.delete(m.id);
        g.bubbles.delete(m.id);
        setOnline(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== m.id));
        setChatMsgs(prev => [...prev, { id: seq++, from: 'SERVER', text: `${m.name} left.` }]);
        // If this player was in a phone call with us, clean up call state
        const curCall = phoneCallRef.current;
        if (curCall.peerId === m.id && curCall.status !== 'idle') {
          if (phoneRingTimerRef.current) { clearTimeout(phoneRingTimerRef.current); phoneRingTimerRef.current = null; }
          if (curCall.roomId) {
            peerConnectionsRef.current.forEach(p => p.close());
            peerConnectionsRef.current.clear();
          }
          setPhoneCall({ status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null });
          phoneCallRef.current = { status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null };
          setNarr(`> CALL DROPPED — ${m.name} disconnected from the city.`);
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'chat') {
        const messageId = seq++;
        const chatText = String(m.text ?? '').slice(0, 160);
        const isWorldMessage = m.room === 'world';
        setChatMsgs(prev => [...prev.slice(-99), {
          id: messageId, from: m.from, text: chatText, dm: !isWorldMessage,
          translationPending: isWorldMessage && translationConversationRef.current,
        }]);
        if (isWorldMessage) {
          queueConversationTranslation(chatText, translated => {
            if (!translated) {
              setChatMsgs(prev => prev.map(msg => msg.id === messageId ? { ...msg, translationPending: false } : msg));
              return;
            }
            setChatMsgs(prev => prev.map(msg => msg.id === messageId
              ? { ...msg, translated, translationPending: false }
              : msg));
          });
        }
        if (m.room === 'world' && m.from && m.text) {
          const rl = recentLogRef.current;
          rl.push({ k: `${m.from}\u0001${m.text}`, ts: Date.now() });
          if (rl.length > 24) rl.splice(0, rl.length - 24);
        }
        if (!chatOpenRef.current) setUnread(n => n + 1);
      } else if (m.type === 'liberation_update') {
        if (typeof m.progress === 'number') setLiberationProgress(m.progress);
      } else if (m.type === 'ownership_update') {
        setOwnerStats(m.stats ?? {});
      } else if (m.type === 'building_lock_result') {
        if (m.success && (m.action === 'unlock' || m.action === 'open')) {
          g.locks.delete(m.buildingId);
          setLockMap(prev => { const nl = new Map(prev); nl.delete(m.buildingId); return nl; });
          if (pendingBidRef.current === m.buildingId) { pendingBidRef.current = null; setPendingBid(null); enterBuilding(m.buildingId); }
        } else if (!m.success) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> ACCESS DENIED — ${m.error}`); }
        if (m.success && m.action === 'set') setNarr('> Security code set. Building locked to your enterprise.');
        setPwPrompt(null);
      } else if (m.type === 'building_lock_status') {
        if (m.locked) {
          g.locks.set(m.buildingId, { ownerName: m.ownerName ?? '', company: m.company, message: m.message });
          setLockMap(prev => { const nl = new Map(prev); nl.set(m.buildingId, { ownerName: m.ownerName ?? '', company: m.company, message: m.message }); return nl; });
          if (pendingBidRef.current === m.buildingId) {
            const isHQBuilding = COMPANY_HQ_BUILDING_IDS.has(m.buildingId);
            const playerIsCompanyMember = isHQBuilding && m.company && char.company && m.company === char.company;
            if (playerIsCompanyMember) {
              pendingBidRef.current = null; setPendingBid(null); enterBuilding(m.buildingId);
            } else {
              const b = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === m.buildingId);
              const lockLabel = isHQBuilding && m.company ? `${m.company} HQ` : (b?.label ?? m.buildingId);
              if (m.message) setNarr(`> ${lockLabel} — LOCKED by ${m.ownerName}${m.company ? ' / ' + m.company : ''}: "${m.message}"`);
              setPwPrompt({ bid: m.buildingId, label: lockLabel, mode: 'enter' });
            }
          }
        } else {
          g.locks.delete(m.buildingId);
          setLockMap(prev => { const nl = new Map(prev); nl.delete(m.buildingId); return nl; });
          if (pendingBidRef.current === m.buildingId) { pendingBidRef.current = null; setPendingBid(null); enterBuilding(m.buildingId); }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'building_locked') {
        g.locks.set(m.buildingId, { ownerName: m.ownerName, company: m.company });
        setLockMap(prev => { const nl = new Map(prev); nl.set(m.buildingId, { ownerName: m.ownerName, company: m.company }); return nl; });
      } else if (m.type === 'building_unlocked') {
        g.locks.delete(m.buildingId); setLockMap(prev => { const nl = new Map(prev); nl.delete(m.buildingId); return nl; });
      } else if (m.type === 'floor_lock_result') {
        if (m.success && m.action === 'set') {
          if (!FLOOR_PASSWORDS.has(m.buildingId)) FLOOR_PASSWORDS.set(m.buildingId, new Map());
          FLOOR_PASSWORDS.get(m.buildingId)!.set(m.floor, { owner: true, ownerName: char.name, company: char.company, label: char.company || '' });
          setNarr(`> FLOOR ${m.floor}${char.company ? ' — ' + char.company : ''} — Lock set. Only you and your company can enter freely.`);
          setElevatorPrompt(null);
        } else if (m.success && m.action === 'remove') {
          FLOOR_PASSWORDS.get(m.buildingId)?.delete(m.floor);
          setNarr(`> FLOOR ${m.floor} — Lock removed. Floor is now open.`);
          setElevatorPrompt(null);
        } else if (m.success && m.unlocked) {
          setNarr(`> Floor ${m.floor} — Access granted.`);
          const g = gs.current;
          if (g.interior) {
            const dir3 = BUILDING_FLOORS[m.buildingId];
            const bfl3 = dir3?.floors.find((f: any) => f.floor === m.floor);
            const offDef3 = bfl3 ? generateFloorInterior(m.buildingId, bfl3, dir3?.label ?? m.buildingId) : (INTERIOR_DEFS['_office_floor'] ?? INTERIOR_DEFS['_lobby']!);
            const flLockInfo = FLOOR_PASSWORDS.get(m.buildingId)?.get(m.floor);
            const flBizName = flLockInfo?.label || (bfl3 ? bfl3.name : '');
            g.interior = { bid: g.interior.bid, def: { ...offDef3, id: g.interior.bid, label: `${BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === g.interior!.bid)?.label ?? 'BUILDING'} — FL ${String(m.floor).padStart(2,'0')}${flBizName ? ' — ' + flBizName : ''}` }, px: offDef3.exitX + offDef3.exitW / 2, py: offDef3.exitY - 20, savedWorldX: g.interior.savedWorldX, savedWorldY: g.interior.savedWorldY };
          }
          setCurrentFloor(m.floor);
          setElevatorPrompt(null);
          setElevatorPwError('');
        } else if (!m.success) {
          sfxError();
          setElevatorPwError(m.error ?? 'ACCESS DENIED');
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'floor_lock_status') {
        const bid2 = m.buildingId;
        if (!FLOOR_PASSWORDS.has(bid2)) FLOOR_PASSWORDS.set(bid2, new Map());
        const fMap = FLOOR_PASSWORDS.get(bid2)!;
        fMap.clear();
        if (m.floors) {
          for (const [flStr, info] of Object.entries(m.floors as Record<string, any>)) {
            fMap.set(parseInt(flStr, 10), { owner: !!info.isOwner, ownerName: info.ownerName, company: info.company, label: info.label });
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'pvp_hit') {
        if (!gamePausedRef.current) {
          const dmg = m.damage ?? 0;
          if (typeof m.remainingHp === 'number') g.hp = m.remainingHp;
          else g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - dmg);
          g.invincible = 15; g.flash = 8;
          g.deathReason = `Killed by ${m.attackerName} in PVP combat`;
          setHp(Math.floor(g.hp));
          sfxHit();
          g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `-${dmg} PVP HIT`, color: '#ff4444', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
          setNarr(`> PVP — ${m.attackerName} hit you for ${dmg} damage!`);
          if (g.hp <= 0) {
            g.deadBodies.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py, type: 'PLAYER', diedAtFrame: g.frame });
            g.pvpDeathBodyDropped = true;
            g.diedLastSession = true;
            setIsDead(true); sfxDeath(); try { localStorage.setItem('sm_died_last_session', 'true'); } catch {}
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'pvp_hit_confirm') {
        g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 30, text: `${m.damage} HIT ${m.targetName}`, color: '#ffaa00', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
      } else if (m.type === 'pvp_kill') {
        sfxKill();
        const lootMoney = m.loot?.money ?? 0;
        const lootItem = m.loot?.item ?? null;
        // Big-payout cascade for meaningful kills, plain coin for chump change
        if (lootMoney >= 500) sfxBigPayout(lootMoney); else sfxCoin();
        // Socket payloads are not wallet authority.  Loot has no claim identity,
        // so retain the non-money event and discard its client-supplied FIAT.
        g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 40, text: `KILLED ${m.targetName}`, color: '#ff4444', life: 70, maxLife: 70 });
        if (lootMoney > 0) g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 55, text: `+ƒ${lootMoney.toLocaleString()} LOOTED`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
        if (lootItem) g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 70, text: `LOOT: ${lootItem.name}`, color: '#67e8f9', life: 70, maxLife: 70 });
        const lootItems: { name: string; desc: string }[] = [];
        if (lootItem) lootItems.push(lootItem);
        setLootPanel({ source: m.targetName ?? 'Enemy', money: lootMoney, items: lootItems });
        setTimeout(() => setLootPanel(null), 4000);
        setNarr(`> PVP KILL — You defeated ${m.targetName}! Looted ƒ${lootMoney.toLocaleString()} FIAT${lootItem ? ` and ${lootItem.name}` : ''}.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'pvp_death') {
        const lostMoney = m.lostMoney ?? 0;
        // Never accept a socket's claimed wallet balance or debit amount.
        setSalary(g.salary);
        const lostItems: { name: string; desc: string }[] = [];
        if (m.lostItem) lostItems.push(m.lostItem);
        setLootPanel({ source: `DEFEATED BY ${m.attackerName}`, money: -lostMoney, items: lostItems });
        setTimeout(() => setLootPanel(null), 4000);
        setNarr(`> DEFEATED — ${m.attackerName} killed you. Lost ƒ${lostMoney.toLocaleString()} FIAT${m.lostItem ? ` and ${m.lostItem.name}` : ''}.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'pvp_kill_announce') {
        setChatMsgs(prev => [...prev.slice(-99), { id: seq++, from: 'PVP', text: `${m.killerName} killed ${m.victimName}` }]);
        for (const [, peer] of g.peers) {
          if (peer.name === m.victimName) {
            g.deadBodies.push({ x: peer.x, y: peer.y, type: 'PLAYER', diedAtFrame: g.frame });
            break;
          }
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'npc_loot') {
        if (m.item) {
          g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `LOOT: ${m.item.name}`, color: '#67e8f9', life: 65, maxLife: 65 });
          setLootPanel({ source: 'NPC KILL', money: 0, items: [m.item] });
          setTimeout(() => setLootPanel(null), 3000);
        }
      } else if (m.type === 'voice_offer')  handleVoiceOffer(m.from, m.sdp);
      else if (m.type === 'voice_answer')   handleVoiceAnswer(m.from, m.sdp);
      else if (m.type === 'voice_ice')      handleVoiceICE(m.from, m.candidate);
      else if (m.type === 'voice_peer_joined') initiateVoiceWith(m.id);
      else if (m.type === 'rtc_room_peers') {
        const peers = (m.peers as { id: string; name: string; isGuest?: boolean }[]) ?? [];
        setVideoCallPeers(peers.map(p => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, isGuest: p.isGuest ?? false })));
        for (const peer of peers) createPeerConnection(peer.id, peer.name, true);
      } else if (m.type === 'rtc_peer_joined') {
        setVideoCallPeers(prev => [...prev, { id: m.peerId, name: m.peerName, isGuest: false }]);
        createPeerConnection(m.peerId, m.peerName, false);
      } else if (m.type === 'rtc_peer_left') {
        const pc = peerConnectionsRef.current.get(m.peerId);
        if (pc) { pc.close(); peerConnectionsRef.current.delete(m.peerId); }
        iceCandidateQueueRef.current.delete(m.peerId);
        setVideoCallPeers(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== m.peerId));
      } else if (m.type === 'rtc_guest_joined') {
        const gName = m.guestName as string;
        setVideoCallPeers(prev => prev.some(p => p.id === m.guestId) ? prev : [...prev, { id: m.guestId, name: `${gName} [REMOTE]`, isGuest: true }]);
        createPeerConnection(m.guestId, `${gName} [REMOTE]`, false);
        sfxHologramBeamIn();
        setHologramNotification(`HOLOGRAM LINK ESTABLISHED — GUEST: ${gName}`);
        setTimeout(() => setHologramNotification(null), 4000);
        setNarr(`> HOLOGRAM LINK — ${gName} joined as remote guest.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'rtc_guest_left') {
        const lpc = peerConnectionsRef.current.get(m.guestId);
        if (lpc) { lpc.close(); peerConnectionsRef.current.delete(m.guestId); }
        iceCandidateQueueRef.current.delete(m.guestId);
        setVideoCallPeers(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== m.guestId));
        sfxHologramSignalLost();
        setHologramNotification(`SIGNAL LOST — GUEST: ${m.guestName}`);
        setTimeout(() => setHologramNotification(null), 3000);
        setNarr(`> HOLOGRAM LINK — ${m.guestName} disconnected.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'rtc_signal') {
        handleRtcSignal(m.fromId, m.fromName, m.signal);
      } else if (m.type === 'phone_call_incoming') {
        const cs: PhoneCallState = { status: 'incoming', peerId: m.callerId, peerName: m.callerName, roomId: null };
        setPhoneCall(cs); phoneCallRef.current = cs;
        setNarr(`> INCOMING CALL from ${m.callerName}. Open Terminal to accept or decline.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'phone_call_ringing') {
        const cs: PhoneCallState = { status: 'ringing', peerId: m.targetId, peerName: m.targetName, roomId: null };
        setPhoneCall(cs); phoneCallRef.current = cs;
      } else if (m.type === 'phone_call_accepted') {
        const cs: PhoneCallState = { status: 'connected', peerId: m.peerId, peerName: m.peerName, roomId: m.roomId };
        setPhoneCall(cs); phoneCallRef.current = cs;
        joinVideoCall(m.roomId);
        setNarr(`> CALL CONNECTED with ${m.peerName}.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'phone_call_connected') {
        const cs: PhoneCallState = { status: 'connected', peerId: m.peerId, peerName: m.peerName, roomId: m.roomId };
        setPhoneCall(cs); phoneCallRef.current = cs;
        joinVideoCall(m.roomId);
        setNarr(`> CALL CONNECTED with ${m.peerName}.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'phone_call_declined') {
        setPhoneCall({ status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null });
        phoneCallRef.current = { status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null };
        setNarr(`> CALL DECLINED by ${m.peerName}.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'phone_call_ended') {
        leaveVideoCall();
        setPhoneCall({ status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null });
        phoneCallRef.current = { status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null };
        setNarr(`> CALL ENDED — ${m.peerName} disconnected.`);
      } else if (m.type === 'phone_call_error') {
        setPhoneCall({ status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null });
        phoneCallRef.current = { status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null };
        setNarr(`> CALL FAILED — ${m.error}`);
      }
    };
    // Add event key handler for channeling (E key while near event)
    const handleEventKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.code !== 'KeyE') return;
      const g = gs.current;
      if (frozenRef.current) return;
      // Revive a collapsed peer in range
      const collapsed: any[] = g.collapsedPeers ?? [];
      const nearPeer = collapsed.find((p: any) => Math.hypot(g.px - p.x, g.py - p.y) < 80);
      if (nearPeer) {
        apiFetch(`/api/events/revive/${encodeURIComponent(nearPeer.id)}`, { method: 'POST' }).catch(() => {});
        g.collapsedPeers = collapsed.filter((p: any) => p.id !== nearPeer.id);
        setNarr(`> REVIVED — ${nearPeer.name} is back on their feet.`);
        return;
      }
      // Start channeling a nearby world event
      const nearEv = activeWorldEventsRef.current.find(ev => Math.hypot(g.px - ev.locationX, g.py - ev.locationY) < 96);
      if (nearEv && !channelBarRef.current) {
        const duration = nearEv.eventType === 'evt_medical' ? 15_000 : 30_000;
        const bar = { eventId: nearEv.id, eventType: nearEv.eventType, startedAt: Date.now(), duration, progress: 0 };
        channelBarRef.current = bar;
        setChannelBar({ ...bar });
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEventKey);
    let lastMove: MovementSnapshot | null = null;
    let lastStats: StatsSnapshot | null = null;
    let lastSyncMoney = gs.current.salary;
    let lastMoveSentAt = -Infinity;
    let lastStatsSentAt = -Infinity;
    let lastFinalSignature: string | null = null;
    const sendLatest = (force = false) => {
      if (wsRef.current?.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return;
      const g = gs.current;
      const now = performance.now();
      const move: MovementSnapshot = {
        x: g.interior ? g.interior.px : g.px,
        y: g.interior ? g.interior.py : g.py,
        paused: gamePausedRef.current || !documentVisibleRef.current,
        interiorBid: g.interior?.bid,
      };
      const stats: StatsSnapshot = { hp: g.hp, weaponId: activeWeaponRef.current };
      const finalSignature = stableSnapshot({ move, stats, money: g.salary });
      if (force && finalSignature === lastFinalSignature) return;
      if (force || changedMessageDue(movementChanged(move, lastMove), documentVisibleRef.current, now, lastMoveSentAt, 80)) {
        wsSend({ type: 'move', x: move.x, y: move.y, paused: move.paused, sleeping: move.paused, interiorBid: move.interiorBid });
        lastMove = move;
        lastMoveSentAt = now;
      }
      if (force || changedMessageDue(statsChanged(stats, lastStats), documentVisibleRef.current, now, lastStatsSentAt, 80)) {
        const healed = Boolean(lastStats && stats.hp > lastStats.hp);
        const weaponChangedNow = !lastStats || stats.weaponId !== lastStats.weaponId;
        if (healed) wsSend({ type: 'pve_heal', hp: stats.hp });
        if (!healed || weaponChangedNow) wsSend({ type: 'sync_stats', hp: stats.hp, weaponId: stats.weaponId });
        lastStats = stats;
        lastStatsSentAt = now;
      }
      if ((force || documentVisibleRef.current) && g.salary !== lastSyncMoney) {
        wsSend({ type: 'money_update', money: g.salary });
        lastSyncMoney = g.salary;
      }
      if (force) lastFinalSignature = finalSignature;
    };
    let posInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
    const syncPosition = () => {
      const g = gs.current;
      sendLatest();
      // Proximity narrator: fire once per event (per session) when the player
      // comes within 500 world units of an active event beacon.
      if (!g.interior) {
        for (const ev of activeWorldEventsRef.current) {
          if (!narratedEventsRef.current.has(ev.id)) {
            const dist = Math.hypot(g.px - ev.locationX, g.py - ev.locationY);
            if (dist < 500) {
              narratedEventsRef.current.add(ev.id);
              const label = ev.eventType === 'evt_blackout' ? 'GRID FAILURE'
                : ev.eventType === 'evt_fire' ? 'STRUCTURE FIRE'
                : ev.eventType === 'evt_medical' ? 'MEDICAL EMERGENCY'
                : 'CITY EVENT';
              setNarr(`> ${label} NEARBY — Reward ƒ${ev.rewardFiat.toLocaleString()} for first responders. Press [F] to channel.`);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };
    const startPositionSync = () => {
      if (posInterval || !documentVisibleRef.current) return;
      sendLatest();
      posInterval = setInterval(syncPosition, 80);
    };
    const stopPositionSync = () => {
      if (!posInterval) return;
      clearInterval(posInterval);
      posInterval = null;
    };
    const handleSocketVisibility = () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        sendLatest(true);
        stopPositionSync();
      } else {
        startPositionSync();
      }
    };
    startPositionSync();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleSocketVisibility);

    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      sendLatest(true);
      if (reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(reconnectTimer);
      if (wsRef.current === ws) wsRef.current = null;
      ws.close(); stopPositionSync();
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleSocketVisibility);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEventKey);
    };
  // wsReconnectKey is intentionally included: incrementing it forces a full
  // re-run so new sockets always get all handlers attached (used by the visa
  // apply reconnect path — see visa modal handleApply below).
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [char.name, wsReconnectKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!documentVisible) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const fetchEmployees = () => {
      if (!documentVisibleRef.current) return;
      apiFetch('/api/tools/hiring/employees')
        .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : { employeesByOwner: {} })
        .then(data => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          const emps: EmployeeNpcDef[] = [];
          const byOwner: Record<string, { name: string; role: string; businessName: string }[]> = data.employeesByOwner ?? {};
          const ownerBuildings: Record<string, string[]> = {};
          gs.current.locks.forEach((lock, bid) => {
            const owner = lock.ownerName?.toUpperCase();
            if (owner) (ownerBuildings[owner] ??= []).push(bid);
          });
          for (const [owner, staff] of Object.entries(byOwner)) {
            const bids = ownerBuildings[owner.toUpperCase()] ?? [];
            if (!bids.length) continue;
            staff.forEach((employee, idx) => {
              const bid = bids[idx % bids.length];
              const building = BUILDINGS.find(item => item.id === bid);
              if (building) emps.push({
                name: employee.name.toUpperCase(), role: employee.role,
                x: building.x + building.w / 2 + (idx % 3 - 1) * 30,
                y: building.y + building.h + 20 + Math.floor(idx / 3) * 25,
                businessName: employee.businessName ?? '', buildingId: bid,
              });
            });
          }
          gs.current.employeeNpcs = emps;
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    };
    fetchEmployees();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchEmployees, 60_000);
    return () => { cancelled = true; clearInterval(interval); };
  }, [documentVisible]);

  // ── Channel bar tick (progress → API call → clear) ─────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!channelBar) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      const bar = channelBarRef.current;
      if (!bar) { clearInterval(t); return; }
      const elapsed = Date.now() - bar.startedAt;
      const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / bar.duration);
      const updated = { ...bar, progress };
      channelBarRef.current = updated;
      setChannelBar(updated);
      if (progress >= 1) {
        clearInterval(t);
        channelBarRef.current = null;
        setChannelBar(null);
        apiFetch(`/api/events/${bar.eventId}/respond`, { method: 'POST' })
          .catch(() => {});
      }
    }, 80);
    // Cancel if player moves away
    const cancelKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.code === 'Escape' || e.code === 'KeyW' || e.code === 'KeyA' || e.code === 'KeyS' || e.code === 'KeyD' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'ArrowDown' || e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'ArrowRight') {
        clearInterval(t);
        channelBarRef.current = null;
        setChannelBar(null);
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', cancelKey);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', cancelKey);
    return () => { clearInterval(t); window.removeEventListener('keydown', cancelKey); };
  }, [channelBar?.eventId]);

  // ── Voice / WebRTC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const mkPeer = (pid: string) => {
    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: [{ urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' }] });
    peerConns.current.set(pid, pc);
    localStream.current?.getTracks().forEach(t => pc.addTrack(t, localStream.current!));
    pc.onicecandidate = e => { if (e.candidate) wsSend({ type: 'voice_ice', to: pid, candidate: e.candidate }); };
    pc.ontrack = e => {
      const ctx = audioCtx.current;
      if (ctx) {
        const a = new Audio(); a.srcObject = e.streams[0];
        const source = ctx.createMediaElementSource(a);
        const gainNode = ctx.createGain();
        gainNode.gain.value = 0;
        source.connect(gainNode);
        gainNode.connect(ctx.destination);
        a.play().catch(() => {});
        peerAudioGains.current.set(pid, { gain: gainNode, audio: a });
      } else {
        const a = new Audio(); a.srcObject = e.streams[0]; a.play().catch(() => {});
      }
    };
    return pc;
  };
  const initiateVoiceWith = async (pid: string) => {
    if (!localStream.current) return;
    const pc = mkPeer(pid); const offer = await pc.createOffer();
    await pc.setLocalDescription(offer); wsSend({ type: 'voice_offer', to: pid, sdp: offer });
  };
  const handleVoiceOffer = async (fid: string, sdp: RTCSessionDescriptionInit) => {
    if (!localStream.current) return;
    const pc = mkPeer(fid); await pc.setRemoteDescription(sdp);
    const ans = await pc.createAnswer(); await pc.setLocalDescription(ans);
    wsSend({ type: 'voice_answer', to: fid, sdp: ans });
  };
  const handleVoiceAnswer = async (fid: string, sdp: RTCSessionDescriptionInit) => { await peerConns.current.get(fid)?.setRemoteDescription(sdp); };
  const handleVoiceICE    = async (fid: string, c: RTCIceCandidateInit)          => { await peerConns.current.get(fid)?.addIceCandidate(c); };

  const RTC_ICE_SERVERS = [{ urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' }, { urls: 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302' }];

  const createPeerConnection = (peerId: string, peerName: string, initiator: boolean) => {
    if (peerConnectionsRef.current.has(peerId)) return;
    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: RTC_ICE_SERVERS });
    peerConnectionsRef.current.set(peerId, pc);
    if (vcStreamRef.current) {
      vcStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach(t => pc.addTrack(t, vcStreamRef.current!));
    }
    pc.onicecandidate = e => {
      if (e.candidate) wsSend({ type: 'rtc_signal', targetId: peerId, roomId: videoCallRoomRef.current, signal: { type: 'ice', candidate: e.candidate } });
    };
    pc.ontrack = e => {
      setVideoCallPeers(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === peerId ? { ...p, stream: e.streams[0] } : p));
    };
    if (initiator) {
      pc.createOffer().then(offer => pc.setLocalDescription(offer).then(() => {
        wsSend({ type: 'rtc_signal', targetId: peerId, roomId: videoCallRoomRef.current, signal: { type: 'offer', sdp: pc.localDescription } });
      })).catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  const flushIceCandidates = async (peerId: string) => {
    const pc = peerConnectionsRef.current.get(peerId);
    const queued = iceCandidateQueueRef.current.get(peerId);
    if (pc && queued && queued.length > 0 && pc.remoteDescription) {
      iceCandidateQueueRef.current.set(peerId, []);
      for (const c of queued) {
        try { await pc.addIceCandidate(c); } catch {}
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRtcSignal = async (fromId: string, fromName: string, signal: { type: string; sdp?: RTCSessionDescriptionInit; candidate?: RTCIceCandidateInit }) => {
    try {
      if (signal.type === 'offer') {
        if (!peerConnectionsRef.current.has(fromId)) createPeerConnection(fromId, fromName, false);
        const pc = peerConnectionsRef.current.get(fromId)!;
        await pc.setRemoteDescription(signal.sdp!);
        await flushIceCandidates(fromId);
        const answer = await pc.createAnswer();
        await pc.setLocalDescription(answer);
        wsSend({ type: 'rtc_signal', targetId: fromId, roomId: videoCallRoomRef.current, signal: { type: 'answer', sdp: pc.localDescription } });
      } else if (signal.type === 'answer') {
        const pc = peerConnectionsRef.current.get(fromId);
        if (pc) {
          await pc.setRemoteDescription(signal.sdp!);
          await flushIceCandidates(fromId);
        }
      } else if (signal.type === 'ice') {
        const pc = peerConnectionsRef.current.get(fromId);
        if (pc && signal.candidate) {
          if (pc.remoteDescription) {
            await pc.addIceCandidate(signal.candidate);
          } else {
            if (!iceCandidateQueueRef.current.has(fromId)) iceCandidateQueueRef.current.set(fromId, []);
            iceCandidateQueueRef.current.get(fromId)!.push(signal.candidate);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  };

  const joinVideoCall = useCallback(async (roomId: string) => {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
      vcStreamRef.current = stream;
      setVcStream(stream);
      videoCallRoomRef.current = roomId;
      setVideoCallRoom(roomId);
      setVideoEnabled(true);
      setAudioEnabled(true);
      wsSend({ type: 'rtc_join_room', roomId });
      setNarr('> VIDEO CALL — Connected. Other players at terminals can join this call. [C] or [ESC] to end.');
    } catch {
      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: false });
        vcStreamRef.current = stream;
        setVcStream(stream);
        videoCallRoomRef.current = roomId;
        setVideoCallRoom(roomId);
        setVideoEnabled(false);
        setAudioEnabled(true);
        wsSend({ type: 'rtc_join_room', roomId });
        setNarr('> AUDIO CALL — No camera. Audio only mode. [C] or [ESC] to end.');
      } catch {
        setNarr('> CALL FAILED — Microphone access denied. Check browser permissions.');
      }
    }
  }, [wsSend]);

  const leaveVideoCall = useCallback(() => {
    const room = videoCallRoomRef.current;
    if (room) wsSend({ type: 'rtc_leave_room', roomId: room });
    vcStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    vcStreamRef.current = null;
    setVcStream(null);
    peerConnectionsRef.current.forEach(pc => pc.close());
    peerConnectionsRef.current.clear();
    videoCallRoomRef.current = null;
    setVideoCallRoom(null);
    setVideoCallPeers([]);
    setNarr('> CALL ENDED — Disconnected.');
    gameRef.current?.focus();
  }, [wsSend]);

  leaveVideoCallRef.current = leaveVideoCall;
  useEffect(() => () => { leaveVideoCallRef.current(); }, []);

  const toggleVoice = useCallback(async () => {
    if (voice) {
      localStream.current?.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); localStream.current = null;
      peerConns.current.forEach(pc => pc.close()); peerConns.current.clear();
      peerAudioGains.current.forEach(({ audio }) => { audio.pause(); audio.srcObject = null; });
      peerAudioGains.current.clear();
      audioCtx.current?.close(); audioCtx.current = null;
      setVoice(false); setSpeaking(false); setMicMuted(false); wsSend({ type: 'speaking', speaking: false });
    } else {
      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: false });
        localStream.current = stream; setVoice(true); wsSend({ type: 'voice_join' });
        const ctx = new AudioContext(); audioCtx.current = ctx;
        const src = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream); const an = ctx.createAnalyser();
        an.fftSize = 256; src.connect(an); const data = new Uint8Array(an.frequencyBinCount);
        const tick = () => {
          if (!localStream.current) return;
          an.getByteFrequencyData(data);
          const avg = data.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / data.length;
          const spk = avg > 12;
          setSpeaking(spk); wsSend({ type: 'speaking', speaking: spk }); requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };
        tick();
      } catch { setNarr('> VOICE — Mic access denied. Check browser permissions.'); }
    }
  }, [voice, wsSend]);

  const toggleMicMute = useCallback(() => {
    if (!localStream.current) return;
    const newMuted = !micMuted;
    localStream.current.getAudioTracks().forEach(t => { t.enabled = !newMuted; });
    setMicMuted(newMuted);
    if (newMuted) { setSpeaking(false); wsSend({ type: 'speaking', speaking: false }); }
  }, [micMuted, wsSend]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!voice || !localStream.current) return;
    const PROX_RANGE = 100;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const g = gs.current;
      const myX = g.px, myY = g.py;
      const ctx = audioCtx.current;
      if (!ctx) return;
      for (const peer of Array.from(g.peers.values())) {
        const dist = Math.hypot(peer.x - myX, peer.y - myY);
        const entry = peerAudioGains.current.get(peer.id);
        if (dist <= PROX_RANGE) {
          const baseVol = phoneCallRef.current.status === 'connected' ? 0.1 : Math.max(0, 1 - dist / PROX_RANGE);
          const vol = baseVol * micVolumeRef.current;
          if (entry) {
            entry.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(vol, ctx.currentTime, 0.05);
          } else if (!peerConns.current.has(peer.id)) {
            initiateVoiceWith(peer.id);
          }
        } else {
          if (entry) {
            entry.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime, 0.05);
          }
        }
      }
    }, 200);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [voice]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try { localStorage.setItem('sm_crm_contacts', JSON.stringify(crmContacts)); } catch {}
  }, [crmContacts]);

  const handlePhoneCallInvite = useCallback((targetId: string) => {
    // Optimistically set ringing state so caller gets immediate feedback
    const cs: PhoneCallState = { status: 'ringing', peerId: targetId, peerName: targetId, roomId: null };

    }, 30000);

  const handlePhoneCallAccept = useCallback((callerId: string) => {

  const handlePhoneCallDecline = useCallback((callerId: string) => {
    if (phoneRingTimerRef.current) { clearTimeout(phoneRingTimerRef.current); phoneRingTimerRef.current = null; }
    wsSend({ type: 'phone_call_decline', callerId });
    setPhoneCall({ status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null });
    phoneCallRef.current = { status: 'idle', peerId: null, peerName: null, roomId: null };
  }, [wsSend]);

    const pc = phoneCallRef.current;
    if (pc.peerId) wsSend({ type: 'phone_call_end', peerId: pc.peerId });

  // SCENE 1 resume — if the story is active and Scene 1 hasn't completed yet but
  // the ephemeral sceneRun was lost (page reload mid-scene), drop the player
  // straight back into the playable ESCAPE phase with the tight framing.
  useEffect(() => {

    if (shouldResumeScene1(g.story, !!g.sceneRun)) {
      // Restore the mid-escape checkpoint so a reload doesn't replay the breakout.
      // battleStarted is intentionally derived from battleDone (not restored raw):
      // a battle that began but never finished must be allowed to re-arm, or the
      // camp claim (gated on battleDone) would soft-lock. So an interrupted battle
      // replays just the battle; a won battle skips straight to the camp run.
      const battleDone = !!g.story!.scene1?.battleDone;
      g.sceneRun = rebuildScene1SceneRun(g.story!.scene1);

      targetZoomRef.current = Math.max(targetZoomRef.current * 1.7, 5.6);
      setNarr(battleDone
        ? '> ESCAPE — The vents are clear. Reach the UNDERGROUND CAMP to claim your MX-75.'
        : '> ESCAPE — Down through the SERVICE VENTS. Fight clear of PABLO CORP and reach the UNDERGROUND CAMP to claim your MX-75.');
    }
    // Durable backstop for the Mila handoff: if the MX-75 was already claimed

    // lost), replay it now. The cutscene page clears the flag once it's shown.
    try {
      if (shouldReplayMilaHandoff(g.story, localStorage.getItem(MILA_HANDOFF_KEY))) {
        navigate('/cutscene/mila-handoff');
      }
    } catch { /* localStorage unavailable — skip the backstop */ }

  }, []);

  useEffect((): void | (() => void) => {
    const handleCinematicKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      const aTag = document.activeElement?.tagName;
      if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || aTag === 'INPUT' || aTag === 'TEXTAREA') return;

      if (sceneCine) {
        const elapsed = Date.now() - sceneCine.startTime;
        const SCENE_LINE_INTERVAL = 1700;
        const total = sceneCine.phase === 'intro' ? SCENE1_INTRO_LINES.length : SCENE1_CLAIM_LINES.length;
        const allLinesShown = Math.floor(elapsed / SCENE_LINE_INTERVAL) >= total - 1 && elapsed >= (total - 1) * SCENE_LINE_INTERVAL + 1200;
        if (allLinesShown) {
          (document.querySelector('[data-scene-continue]') as HTMLButtonElement)?.click();
        }
        return;
      }

      if (showIndoorStart) {
        const g = gs.current;
        const spawnBid = g.hamletBuildingId;
        const spawnB = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === spawnBid) ?? BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'minx_arms')!;
        g.px = spawnB.x + spawnB.w / 2;
        g.py = spawnB.y + spawnB.h + 20;
        const def = getInterior(spawnBid);
        if (def) {
          let spawnIx = def.exitX + def.exitW / 2;
          let spawnIy = def.exitY - 20;
          const _spawnWalk = new Set(['window', 'plant', 'chair', 'couch']);
          const spawnICol = (ipx: number, ipy: number) => {
            if (ipx < PSIZE + 6 || ipx > def.width - PSIZE - 6 || ipy < PSIZE + 20 || ipy > def.height - PSIZE) return true;
            for (const obj of def.objects) {
              if (_spawnWalk.has(obj.type)) continue;
              if (ipx + PSIZE > obj.x && ipx - PSIZE < obj.x + obj.w && ipy + PSIZE > obj.y && ipy - PSIZE < obj.y + obj.h) return true;
            }
            return false;
          };
          if (spawnICol(spawnIx, spawnIy)) {
            for (let r = 8; r <= 200; r += 8) {
              let escaped = false;
              for (const [ox, oy] of [[0,r],[0,-r],[r,0],[-r,0],[r,r],[-r,r],[r,-r],[-r,-r]]) {
                if (!spawnICol(spawnIx + ox, spawnIy + oy)) { spawnIx += ox; spawnIy += oy; escaped = true; break; }
              }
              if (escaped) break;
            }
          }
          g.interior = {
            bid: spawnBid, def,
            px: spawnIx, py: spawnIy,
            savedWorldX: g.px, savedWorldY: g.py,
          };

        return;

      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleCinematicKey);
      return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleCinematicKey);

  // ── AMBIANCE — the low ambient bed plays during the game by default ──────────
  // The procedural score IS the ambiance. It auto-starts on the first user gesture

  // background bed without the player toggling anything. Audibility is gated

  useEffect(() => {

  // ── Keyboard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {

    const dn = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      const aTag = document.activeElement?.tagName;
      // Synthetic events from useGamepad have target=window (no tagName),
      // so we also consult document.activeElement to suppress phantom

            }

          // World secrets: if standing on an undiscovered secret outdoors,

          // there isn't another legitimate interaction (building/NPC) on

              if (sec.payload.xp) { applyExpGain(g, sec.payload.xp, sfxLevelUp, setLevelUpText, setShowLevelUp, setNarr, setExp, setLevel, setHp); }

              const cutsceneId = CUTSCENE_NPC_TRIGGERS[npcName.trim().toUpperCase()];

                : roleLower.includes('guard') || roleLower.includes('security') ? 'guard'
                : roleLower.includes('military') || roleLower.includes('soldier') || roleLower.includes('trooper') ? 'corpo_military'
                : roleLower.includes('manager') || roleLower.includes('director') || roleLower.includes('executive') || roleLower.includes('chief') || roleLower.includes('engineer') || roleLower.includes('researcher') || roleLower.includes('teller') || roleLower.includes('clerk') || roleLower.includes('broker') || roleLower.includes('staff') || roleLower.includes('host') || roleLower.includes('trader') || roleLower.includes('registrar') || roleLower.includes('foreman') || roleLower.includes('finance') || roleLower.includes('sales') || roleLower.includes('creative') || roleLower.includes('producer') || roleLower.includes('editor') || roleLower.includes('instructor') || roleLower.includes('technician') || roleLower.includes('agent') || roleLower.includes('doctor') || roleLower.includes('medical') || roleLower.includes('logistics') || roleLower.includes('insurance') || roleLower.includes('real estate') || roleLower.includes('legal') || roleLower.includes('education') || roleLower.includes('publishing') || roleLower.includes('music') || roleLower.includes('e-commerce') || roleLower.includes('design') || roleLower.includes('core') ? 'corpo_worker'

          for (const t of g.threats) {
            const d = Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
            if (d < wpn.range && d < nearestThreatDist2) { nearestThreatDist2 = d; fireAngle2 = Math.atan2(t.y - g.py, t.x - g.px); }
          }
          if (fireAngle2 === null) fireAngle2 = g.aimAngle;
          const profile2 = getGunProfile(wpn.icon);
          g.muzzleFlash = { angle: fireAngle2, life: 5, wpnIcon: wpn.icon };
          // Loud-firearm police alert — silent profiles (crossbow) and
          // explosives skip the per-shot alert (explosives have their own
          // detonation alert downstream).
          const isLoudFirearm = !profile2.silent && wpn.icon !== 'bomb' && wpn.icon !== 'grenade_launcher' && wpn.icon !== 'laser';
          if (isLoudFirearm) {
            g.policeAlertTimer = Math.max(g.policeAlertTimer, 120);
            g.policeAlertX = g.px; g.policeAlertY = g.py;
          }
          spawnGunProjectiles(g, fireAngle2, wpn, ATK2);
          applyGunFx(g, fireAngle2, profile2);
          return;
        }
        // Stamina gate — out-of-stamina attacks "fizzle" and play a softer
        // narration line instead of locking the cooldown so players notice.
        if (!trySpendAttackStamina(g.stamina)) {
          setNarr('> EXHAUSTED — Catch your breath before swinging again.');
          return;
        }
        // Aim toward the nearest in-range threat so the swing actually points
        // at someone — feels much better than swinging at the cursor when
        // mouse-aim is stale (e.g. mobile / keyboard-only).
        const meleeRange = wpn.type === 'melee' ? wpn.range : 72;
        let nearestT: typeof g.threats[number] | null = null;
        let nearestTD = Infinity;
        for (const t of g.threats) {
          const d = Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
          if (d < meleeRange && d < nearestTD) { nearestT = t; nearestTD = d; }
        }
        const swingAngle = nearestT ? Math.atan2(nearestT.y - g.py, nearestT.x - g.px) : g.aimAngle;
        // 3-step swing cycle: 0 = R→L, 1 = L→R, 2 = HEAVY overhead (bigger arc, bigger dmg)
        g.swingIdx = (g.swingIdx + 1) % 3;
        g.swingDir = g.swingIdx === 1 ? -1 : 1;
        g.swingHeavy = g.swingIdx === 2;
        const isChain = wpn.icon === 'chainsaw';
        const swingDuration = g.swingHeavy ? 22 : isChain ? 10 : 14;
        // Slightly longer recovery on the heavy so it feels committed.
        g.attackCooldown = g.swingHeavy ? Math.round(wpn.cooldown * 1.4) : wpn.cooldown;
        g.attackFlash = swingDuration;
        g.attackFlashMax = swingDuration;
        g.swingStartAngle = swingAngle;
        g.aimAngle = swingAngle;
        // Forward lunge — small weighted step toward the target during the
        // swing. Heavier weapons lunge further. Applied by the movement loop.
        const lungeDist =
          wpn.icon === 'bat' ? 2.4 :
          wpn.icon === 'chainsaw' ? 1.2 :
          wpn.icon === 'katana' ? 2.6 :
          wpn.icon === 'sword' || wpn.icon === 'machete' ? 2.2 :
          1.6;
        const lungeFrames = g.swingHeavy ? 7 : 5;
        g.swingLungeVx = Math.cos(swingAngle) * lungeDist;
        g.swingLungeVy = Math.sin(swingAngle) * lungeDist;
        g.swingLungeFrames = lungeFrames;
        sfxWeaponDraw(); sfxAttack();
        const atkBonusMerch = g.ownedItems.has('atk_boost') ? 5 : 0;
        const heavyMult = g.swingHeavy ? 1.55 : 1.0;
        const baseATK = Math.round((20 + (g.level - 1) * 5 + wpn.atkBonus + atkBonusMerch + gearAttackFlat(g.gearStats)) * heavyMult * gearMagicMultiplier(g.gearStats));
        // Heavy swing has wider reach — about 25% bigger bubble.
        const swingReach = g.swingHeavy ? Math.round(meleeRange * 1.25) : meleeRange;
        let hit = false;
        let comboMult = 1;
        let firstImpactX = 0, firstImpactY = 0;
        g.threats = g.threats.map(t => {
          const d = Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
          // Streets are non-lethal: the player can only damage animals (hunting
          // for food survives) — combatant threats are inert. Real fights happen
          // in staged battle scenes. Flip OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL to re-enable.
          if (d < swingReach && (OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL || ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type))) {
            // Register the combo on the *first* in-range hit of this swing
            // so multi-target swings (sword cleave) all share one combo bump.
            if (!hit) {
              const step = registerComboHit(g.combo);
              comboMult = comboDamageMultiplier(step);
              g.hitStopUntil = performance.now() + (g.swingHeavy ? 140 : 80);
              firstImpactX = t.x; firstImpactY = t.y;
            }
            hit = true;
            // Crit: 15% chance, 1.75× dmg. Heavy swings crit at 25%.
            const critChance = g.swingHeavy ? 0.25 : 0.15;
            const isCrit = Math.random() < critChance;
            const critMult = isCrit ? 1.75 : 1;
            const ATK = Math.round(baseATK * comboMult * critMult);
            if (isCrit) {
              g.critFlash = 6;
              g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 22, text: 'CRIT', color: '#ffcc22', life: 42, maxLife: 42 });
            }
            if (t.type === 'PABLO_GUARD' || t.type === 'MINX_CITY') {
              g.policeAlertTimer = 450; g.policeAlertX = g.px; g.policeAlertY = g.py;
              setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 2), g.bountyAmount + 500); g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
            } else if (!ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type)) {
              setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 1), g.bountyAmount + 200); g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
            }
            const nhp = t.hp - ATK;
            // Blood / impact burst — red particles scaled by damage.
            const bloodCt = isCrit ? 10 : 6;
            for (let b = 0; b < bloodCt; b++) {
              const bAng = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
              const bSpd = 1.2 + Math.random() * 2.4;
              g.hitEffects.push({
                x: t.x, y: t.y - 4,
                dx: Math.cos(bAng) * bSpd,
