                dy: Math.sin(bAng) * bSpd - 0.8,
                life: isCrit ? 22 : 16,
                maxLife: isCrit ? 22 : 16,
              });
            }
            if (nhp <= 0) {
              sfxKill();
              // Killing blow: extended hit-stop + red vignette.
              g.hitStopUntil = performance.now() + (g.swingHeavy ? 240 : 180);
              g.killFlash = 14;
              g.shakeMag = Math.max(g.shakeMag, 4);
              g.shakeFrames = Math.max(g.shakeFrames, 10);
              const cs = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
              const inWaste = !inCityBounds(g.px, g.py);
              const isAnimal = ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type);
              let bountyAmt = isAnimal ? 0 : (BOUNTY[t.type] ?? 10);
              if (!isAnimal && cs.wasteBonus && inWaste) bountyAmt = Math.floor(bountyAmt * 1.5);
              if (isAnimal) {
                const drop = ANIMAL_DROPS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ANIMAL_DROPS.length)];
                const ok = addStackToInventory(g.inventory, { id: drop.id, name: drop.name, desc: drop.desc, icon: drop.icon, stackable: true, qty: 1, value: drop.value });
                setInventory([...g.inventory]);
                g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: ok ? `+ ${drop.name}` : 'INV FULL', color: ok ? '#88cc44' : '#ff6644', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
              } else {
                g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: `ƒ${bountyAmt.toLocaleString()} LOOT`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
              }
              if (!isAnimal) reportMissionProgress('npcsDefeated', 1);
              const earned = THREAT_EXP[t.type] ?? 20;
              g.floaters.push({ x: t.x + 8, y: t.y - 10, text: `+${earned}XP`, color: '#44ffaa', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
              wsSend({ type: 'pve_kill', exp: earned });
              applyExpGain(g, earned, sfxLevelUp, setLevelUpText, setShowLevelUp, setNarr, setExp, setLevel, setHp);
              g.threatRespawn.push({ ox: t.ox, oy: t.oy, type: t.type, at: g.frame + 1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2400) });
              g.deadBodies.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, type: t.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: bountyAmt, looted: false });
              return null as unknown as Threat;
            }
            sfxHit();
            // Universal hit-reaction: white flash, brief stagger (AI freeze),
            // and knockback scaled by weapon. Makes every hit feel like it
            // connects instead of enemies walking straight through the swing.
            const kbAng = Math.atan2(t.y - g.py, t.x - g.px);
            const kbStrength =
              wpn.icon === 'bat' ? 4 :
              wpn.icon === 'chainsaw' ? 1.2 :
              wpn.icon === 'knuckles' ? 2 :
              wpn.icon === 'katana' ? 2.4 :
              wpn.icon === 'sword' || wpn.icon === 'machete' ? 2.2 :
              1.8;
            const kbBoost = g.swingHeavy ? 1.6 : isCrit ? 1.35 : 1;
            const kb = {
              dx: Math.cos(kbAng) * kbStrength * kbBoost,
              dy: Math.sin(kbAng) * kbStrength * kbBoost,
              frames: g.swingHeavy ? 10 : 8,
            };
            const staggerMs = g.swingHeavy ? 22 : isCrit ? 18 : 14;
            // Cancel any pending windup — getting hit interrupts the attack.
            const cancelWindup = { windup: 0, windupMax: 0 };
            if (wpn.icon === 'knuckles' && Math.random() < 0.3) {
              t.behaviorTimer = Math.max(t.behaviorTimer, 60);
              g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 14, text: 'STUNNED', color: '#ffff44', life: 30, maxLife: 30 });
            }
            if (wpn.icon === 'chainsaw') {
              g.policeAlertTimer = Math.max(g.policeAlertTimer, 200); g.policeAlertX = g.px; g.policeAlertY = g.py;
            }
            return { ...t, hp: nhp, hitFlash: 8, staggerFrames: staggerMs, knockback: kb, ...cancelWindup };
          }
          return t;
        }).filter(Boolean) as Threat[];
        if (!hit) {
          for (const [, peer] of g.peers) {
            if (peer.interiorBid) continue;
            const pd = Math.hypot(g.px - peer.x, g.py - peer.y);
            if (pd < meleeRange) {
              hit = true;
              firstImpactX = peer.x; firstImpactY = peer.y;  // anchor sparks on the peer, not (0,0)
              g.hitStopUntil = performance.now() + 80;       // peers should also feel weighty
              const pvpStep = registerComboHit(g.combo);
              comboMult = comboDamageMultiplier(pvpStep);
              wsSend({ type: 'pvp_attack', targetId: peer.id, weaponType: 'melee' });
              sfxHit();
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (hit) {
          // Spark burst at the impact point
          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            const sparkAng = swingAngle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
            const sparkSpd = 1.5 + Math.random() * 2;
            g.hitEffects.push({
              x: firstImpactX, y: firstImpactY,
              dx: Math.cos(sparkAng) * sparkSpd,
              dy: Math.sin(sparkAng) * sparkSpd,
              life: 14, maxLife: 14,
            });
          }
          // Camera shake — heavier swings shake more
          const shakeMag = wpn.icon === 'bat' ? 3 : wpn.icon === 'chainsaw' ? 2 : wpn.icon === 'knuckles' ? 1.5 : 2;
          g.shakeFrames = Math.max(g.shakeFrames, wpn.icon === 'bat' ? 8 : 5);
          g.shakeMag = Math.max(g.shakeMag, shakeMag * comboMult);
        }
        if (!hit) {
          // Miss → break combo so you can't carry phantom multipliers between
          // engagements. Also softer narration.
          resetCombo(g.combo);
          setNarr('> Miss — no target in melee range. Move closer or use [Click] to shoot.');
        }
        setExp(g.exp);
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (activeBattleRef.current) { return; } // staged battle owns ESC (flee)
        if (decorModeRef.current) {
          setDecorMode(false); setDecorSelectedItem(null); setDecorGhostPos(null); setDecorCatalogOpen(false);
          setNarr('> DECORATION MODE — Exited. Your changes have been saved.'); return;
        }
        if (videoCallRoom) { leaveVideoCall(); sfxUIClick(); return; }
        if (showNewspaper) { setShowNewspaper(null); setGamePaused(false); frozenRef.current = false; sfxUIClick(); return; }
        if (showInventory) { setShowInventory(false); frozenRef.current = false; sfxUIClick(); return; }
        if (showAssayOffice) { setShowAssayOffice(false); frozenRef.current = false; sfxUIClick(); return; }
        if (showResourceInventory) { setShowResourceInventory(false); frozenRef.current = false; sfxUIClick(); return; }
        if (harvestInfo) { if (harvestTimerRef.current) { clearTimeout(harvestTimerRef.current); harvestTimerRef.current = null; } setHarvestInfo(null); frozenRef.current = false; setNarr('> Harvest cancelled.'); sfxUIClick(); return; }
        if (utilityStation) { setUtilityStation(null); frozenRef.current = false; sfxUIClick(); return; }
        const anyModalOpen = !!dialog || showStore || showOffice || showPablo || !!pwPrompt || showMap || !!jobPanel || !!showTrade || showBank || showSubway || showVend || !!showBillboard || !!showMerchant || showQuests || showAssignments || showAdmin || !!showAdminDept || showRealEstateOffice || showRecruitOffice || showHousingPanel || showDialoguePanel || showCostume || showCrafting || !!showMerchantShop || !!arcadeGameId || showWhiteboard || showScreenShare || !!elevatorPrompt || showSoundLab || !!showSecretLabPrompt || escortPrompt || showStoryWarn || showStorage;
        if (anyModalOpen) {
          setDialog(null); setShowStore(false); setShowOffice(false);
          setShowPablo(false); gs.current.atPublicTerminal = false; setAtPublicTerminal(false);
          setPwPrompt(null); pendingBidRef.current = null; setPendingBid(null);
          setFloorPanel(null); setShowMap(false); setShowTrade(null); setShowBillboard(null);
          if (jobTimerRef.current) { clearInterval(jobTimerRef.current); jobTimerRef.current = null; }
          setJobPanel(null);
          setShowBank(false); setShowMerchant(null); setShowQuests(false); setShowAssignments(false); setShowAdmin(false); setShowAdminDept(null); setShowRealEstateOffice(false); setShowRecruitOffice(false); setShowHousingPanel(false); frozenRef.current = false; sfxUIClick();
          setShowNewspaper(null); setShowInventory(false); setEscortPrompt(false); setShowStoryWarn(false);
          setShowStorage(false);
          doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
        } else {
          // No modal open — ESC now toggles the in-game controls overlay
          // (action buttons, weapons wheel, zoom, etc.) instead of pausing
          // the game. The pause button still lives in the top-right menu
          // for explicit pausing without invoking the controls overlay.
          setHudOpen(prev => !prev);
          sfxUIClick();
        }
      }
      if (e.key === 'i' || e.key === 'I') {
        if (!chatOpenRef.current) setShowInventory(v => !v);
      }
      // [B] — MAKE CAMP. Free action: drops a campfire at the player's
      // current position so they can immediately rest/cook/eat. Replaces
      // any previously placed campsite. Disabled while typing in chat or
      // while a modal/intro is up.
      if ((e.key === 'b' || e.key === 'B') && !chatOpenRef.current && !gamePaused && !isDead) {
        const g = gs.current;
        setCampsitePos({ x: g.px, y: g.py });
        setShowCamp(true);
        sfxUIClick();
        setNarr('> CAMP MADE — Campfire lit. [E] near it any time to rest, eat, or cook.');
      }
      if (e.key === 'c' || e.key === 'C') {
        if (!chatOpenRef.current) {
          const g = gs.current;
          if (videoCallRoomRef.current) {
            leaveVideoCall();
          } else {
            const nearTerm = g.near && (IS_PUBLIC_TERMINAL(g.near) || g.near === 'terminal_shop');
            const hasTerminalInInterior = g.interior && g.interior.def.objects.some(o => o.type === 'terminal');
            if (nearTerm || hasTerminalInInterior || (g.hasDevice && !g.deviceBroken)) {
              const roomId = g.interior ? `room_${g.interior.bid}` : `city_${Math.floor(g.px / 500)}_${Math.floor(g.py / 500)}`;
              joinVideoCall(roomId);
            } else {
              setNarr('> NO TERMINAL — You need a terminal or PABLO CORP device to make video calls.');
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') {
        if (!chatOpenRef.current) {
          const g = gs.current;
          // Decoration mode only when inside an owned interior
          if (g.interior) {
            const bid = g.interior.bid;
            const isOwnedHome = bid === g.hamletBuildingId;
            const isOwnedBuilding = g.ownedBuildings.has(bid);
            if (!isOwnedHome && !isOwnedBuilding) {
              setNarr('> DECORATION MODE — You can only decorate spaces you own or rent.');
            } else {
              const newMode = !decorModeRef.current;
              setDecorMode(newMode);
              if (newMode) {
                setNarr('> DECORATION MODE — [F] toggle mode · [O] open catalog · [R] rotate · [Click] place · [Del] remove · [Esc] exit mode');
              } else {
                setDecorSelectedItem(null); setDecorGhostPos(null);
                setDecorCatalogOpen(false);
                setNarr('> DECORATION MODE — Exited. Your changes have been saved.');
              }
            }
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      if ((e.key === 'o' || e.key === 'O') && decorModeRef.current) {
        if (!chatOpenRef.current) {
          setDecorCatalogOpen(v => !v);
        }
      }
      if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') {
        if (decorModeRef.current && decorSelectedItemRef.current) {
          const rotations: Array<0 | 90 | 180 | 270> = [0, 90, 180, 270];
          const curIdx = rotations.indexOf(decorRotationRef.current);
          const nextRot = rotations[(curIdx + 1) % 4];
          setDecorRotation(nextRot);
        }
      }
      if ((e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') && decorModeRef.current) {
        const g = gs.current;
        if (!g.interior) return;
        const bid = g.interior.bid;
        const ghost = decorGhostPosRef.current;
        if (ghost) {
          const current = placedFurnitureMapRef.current[bid] ?? [];
          const updated = current.filter(pf => {
            const def = FURNITURE_CATALOG_BY_ID[pf.furnitureId];
            if (!def) return true;
            const fw = pf.rotation === 90 || pf.rotation === 270 ? def.gridH : def.gridW;
            const fh = pf.rotation === 90 || pf.rotation === 270 ? def.gridW : def.gridH;
            return !(ghost.gridX >= pf.gridX && ghost.gridX < pf.gridX + fw &&
                     ghost.gridY >= pf.gridY && ghost.gridY < pf.gridY + fh);
          });
          const newMap = { ...placedFurnitureMapRef.current, [bid]: updated };
          setPlacedFurnitureMap(newMap);
          try { localStorage.setItem('sm_furniture', JSON.stringify(newMap)); } catch {}
        }
      }
    };
    const up = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { gs.current.keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()); };
    const onBlur = () => {
      gs.current.keys.clear();
      gs.current.moveTarget = null;
      gs.current.interiorMoveTarget = null;
      gs.current.moveVx = 0;
      gs.current.moveVy = 0;
      touchMoveRef.current = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    };
    const onVisChange = () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        gs.current.keys.clear();
        gs.current.moveTarget = null;
        gs.current.interiorMoveTarget = null;
        gs.current.moveVx = 0;
        gs.current.moveVy = 0;
        touchMoveRef.current = { x: 0, y: 0 };
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', dn); window.addEventListener('keyup', up);
    window.addEventListener('blur', onBlur);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisChange);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('keydown', dn); window.removeEventListener('keyup', up); window.removeEventListener('blur', onBlur); document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisChange); };
  }, [dialog, tryEnter, enterNpc, toggleVoice, advDialog, handleRadioToggle]);

  // ── Mouse/touch click — attack enemies or move character ────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current; if (!canvas) return;
    const resolveWorldCoords = (clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
      const g = gs.current;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
      const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
      return { wx: (clientX - rect.left) * scaleX + g.cam.x, wy: (clientY - rect.top) * scaleY + g.cam.y };
    };
    const handleInteraction = (clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
      gs.current.lastMoveTime = Date.now();
      if (gamePausedRef.current) return;
      const g = gs.current;
      // ── Decoration mode click ──────────────────────────────────────────────
      if (decorModeRef.current && g.interior && !decorCatalogOpenRef.current) {
        const iDef = g.interior.def;
        const rect2 = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const logW2 = canvas.width; const logH2 = canvas.height;
        const iScale2 = Math.min(logW2 / (iDef.width + 80), logH2 / (iDef.height + 80));
        const iox2 = (logW2 - iDef.width * iScale2) / 2;
        const ioy2 = (logH2 - iDef.height * iScale2) / 2;
        const cx = (clientX - rect2.left) * (canvas.width / rect2.width);
        const cy = (clientY - rect2.top) * (canvas.height / rect2.height);
        const ix = (cx - iox2) / iScale2;
        const iy = (cy - ioy2) / iScale2;
        const gridX = Math.floor(ix / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE);
        const gridY = Math.floor(iy / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE);
        setDecorGhostPos({ gridX, gridY });
        if (decorSelectedItemRef.current) {
          const fItem = decorSelectedItemRef.current;
          // ── Ownership check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
          if (!g.ownedFurniture.includes(fItem.id)) {
            setNarr(`> DECORATION — You don't own ${fItem.name}. Purchase it from VendKing first.`);
            return;
          }
          const rot = decorRotationRef.current;
          const fw = (rot === 90 || rot === 270) ? fItem.gridH : fItem.gridW;
          const fh = (rot === 90 || rot === 270) ? fItem.gridW : fItem.gridH;
          // ── Wall-mount constraint ───────────────────────────────────────────
          if (fItem.wallMounted && gridY > 1) {
            setNarr(`> DECORATION — ${fItem.name} must be placed on the top wall (row 0 or 1).`);
            return;
          }
          const maxX = Math.floor(iDef.width / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE) - fw;
          const maxY = fItem.wallMounted ? 1 : Math.floor(iDef.height / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE) - fh;
          const clampedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(gridX, maxX));
          const clampedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(gridY, maxY));
          const bid = g.interior.bid;
          const current = placedFurnitureMapRef.current[bid] ?? [];
          const hasCollision = current.some(pf => {
            const def2 = FURNITURE_CATALOG_BY_ID[pf.furnitureId]; if (!def2) return false;
            const pw = pf.rotation === 90 || pf.rotation === 270 ? def2.gridH : def2.gridW;
            const ph = pf.rotation === 90 || pf.rotation === 270 ? def2.gridW : def2.gridH;
            return !(clampedX >= pf.gridX + pw || clampedX + fw <= pf.gridX ||
                     clampedY >= pf.gridY + ph || clampedY + fh <= pf.gridY);
          });
          if (!hasCollision && ix >= 0 && iy >= 0 && ix < iDef.width && iy < iDef.height) {
            const newItem: PlacedFurnitureItem = {
              id: `pf_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
              furnitureId: fItem.id,
              variantId: decorSelectedVariantRef.current || (fItem.variants[0]?.id ?? ''),
              gridX: clampedX,
              gridY: clampedY,
              rotation: rot,
            };
            const updated = [...current, newItem];
            const newMap = { ...placedFurnitureMapRef.current, [bid]: updated };
            setPlacedFurnitureMap(newMap);
            try { localStorage.setItem('sm_furniture', JSON.stringify(newMap)); } catch {}
            sfxCoin();
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      if (frozenRef.current) return;
      // ── Interior tap-to-move ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      // Inside a building the player walks in interior-space coordinates, so a
      // tap sets an interior move target (consumed by the interior movement loop).
      if (g.interior) {
        const irect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const iDef = g.interior.def;
        const iScale = Math.min(canvas.width / (iDef.width + 80), canvas.height / (iDef.height + 80));
        const iox = (canvas.width - iDef.width * iScale) / 2;
        const ioy = (canvas.height - iDef.height * iScale) / 2;
        const icx = (clientX - irect.left) * (canvas.width / irect.width);
        const icy = (clientY - irect.top) * (canvas.height / irect.height);
        g.interiorMoveTarget = { x: (icx - iox) / iScale, y: (icy - ioy) / iScale };
        return;
      }
      const { wx: clickWorldX, wy: clickWorldY } = resolveWorldCoords(clientX, clientY);
      const clickedBody = g.deadBodies.find(b => !b.looted && b.type !== 'PLAYER' && (b.bounty ?? 0) > 0 && Math.hypot(clickWorldX - b.x, clickWorldY - b.y) < 30 && Math.hypot(g.px - b.x, g.py - b.y) < 50);
      if (clickedBody) {
        const amt = clickedBody.bounty ?? 0;
        clickedBody.looted = true;
        void performGameplayFiatAction('merchant_sale', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:merchant-sale:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`).then(paid => { if (paid) sfxCoin(); });
        g.floaters.push({ x: clickedBody.x, y: clickedBody.y - 12, text: `+ƒ${amt.toLocaleString()} LOOTED`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
        setNarr(`> LOOT — You search the body. +ƒ${amt.toLocaleString()} FIAT recovered.`);
        return;
      }
      const clickDistToPlayer = Math.hypot(clickWorldX - g.px, clickWorldY - g.py);
      if (clickDistToPlayer < 60) {
        if (g.near) { tryEnter(g.near); return; }
        if (g.nearNpc !== null) { enterNpc(g.nearNpc); return; }
        if (g.nearEmployee !== null) {
          const emp = g.employeeNpcs[g.nearEmployee];
          if (emp) {
            const lines = [
              `> EMPLOYEE: ${emp.name}`,
              `> ROLE: ${emp.role}`,
              `> ASSIGNED TO: ${emp.businessName || 'Your Enterprise'}`,
              `> STATUS: ON DUTY`,
              `> "${getEmployeeDialogue(emp.role)}"`,
            ];
            setNarr(lines.join('\n'));
          }
          return;
        }
        if (g.nearBillboard) {
          const bb = BILLBOARDS.find(b => b.locationId === g.nearBillboard);
          if (bb) { setShowBillboard(bb); fetchBillboards(); return; }
        }
      }
      const RANGED_CLICK_RADIUS = 100;
      const clickedEnemy = g.threats.find(t => Math.hypot(clickWorldX - t.x, clickWorldY - t.y) < RANGED_CLICK_RADIUS);
      // Determine if we have a ranged weapon equipped (secondary slot preferred)
      const rangedWpnClick = isPeacefulInterior() ? null : (() => {
        const sw = WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === secondaryWeaponRef.current);
        if (sw && sw.type === 'ranged') return sw;
        const aw = WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === activeWeaponRef.current);
        if (aw && aw.type === 'ranged') return aw;
        return null;
      })();
      // Check if a peer player was clicked on (PvP ranged targeting)
      const clickedPeer = (!clickedEnemy && rangedWpnClick)
        ? [...g.peers.values()].find(peer => !peer.interiorBid && Math.hypot(clickWorldX - peer.x, clickWorldY - peer.y) < RANGED_CLICK_RADIUS)
        : null;
      if (rangedWpnClick && (clickedEnemy || clickedPeer)) {
        const targetX = clickedEnemy ? clickedEnemy.x : clickedPeer!.x;
        const targetY = clickedEnemy ? clickedEnemy.y : clickedPeer!.y;
        const distToTarget = Math.hypot(g.px - targetX, g.py - targetY);
        if (distToTarget > rangedWpnClick.range) {
          // Out of range — move toward target
          g.moveTarget = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
          return;
        }
        // In range — fire at the target
        if (g.attackCooldown <= 0) {
          const angle = Math.atan2(targetY - g.py, targetX - g.px);
          g.attackCooldown = rangedWpnClick.cooldown; g.attackFlash = 4;
          const profile = getGunProfile(rangedWpnClick.icon);
          g.muzzleFlash = { angle, life: 5, wpnIcon: rangedWpnClick.icon };
          sfxWeaponDraw(); sfxAttack();
          const atkBonusMerch = g.ownedItems.has('atk_boost') ? 5 : 0;
          const ATK = Math.round((20 + (g.level - 1) * 5 + rangedWpnClick.atkBonus + atkBonusMerch + gearTechRangedFlat(g.gearStats)) * gearMagicMultiplier(g.gearStats));
          spawnGunProjectiles(g, angle, rangedWpnClick, ATK);
          applyGunFx(g, angle, profile);
          return; // Don't move — we fired at the target
        }
        return; // On cooldown, ignore click
      } else if (rangedWpnClick && !clickedEnemy && !clickedPeer) {
        // Ranged weapon clicking empty ground — use auto-targeting logic (nearest threat → nearest peer → click direction)
        if (frozenRef.current || gamePausedRef.current) return;
        if (g.attackCooldown > 0) return;
        let autoFireAngle: number | null = null;
        let nearestThreatDist = Infinity;
        for (const t of g.threats) {
          const d = Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
          if (d < rangedWpnClick.range && d < nearestThreatDist) {
            nearestThreatDist = d;
            autoFireAngle = Math.atan2(t.y - g.py, t.x - g.px);
          }
        }
        if (autoFireAngle === null) {
          let nearestPeerDist = Infinity;
          for (const [, peer] of g.peers) {
            if (peer.interiorBid) continue;
            const d = Math.hypot(g.px - peer.x, g.py - peer.y);
            if (d < rangedWpnClick.range && d < nearestPeerDist) {
              nearestPeerDist = d;
              autoFireAngle = Math.atan2(peer.y - g.py, peer.x - g.px);
            }
          }
        }
        if (autoFireAngle === null) {
          // Fire toward click location
          autoFireAngle = Math.atan2(clickWorldY - g.py, clickWorldX - g.px);
        }
        g.attackCooldown = rangedWpnClick.cooldown; g.attackFlash = 4;
        const profileAuto = getGunProfile(rangedWpnClick.icon);
        g.muzzleFlash = { angle: autoFireAngle, life: 5, wpnIcon: rangedWpnClick.icon };
        sfxWeaponDraw(); sfxAttack();
        const atkBonusMerchAuto = g.ownedItems.has('atk_boost') ? 5 : 0;
        const ATKauto = Math.round((20 + (g.level - 1) * 5 + rangedWpnClick.atkBonus + atkBonusMerchAuto + gearTechRangedFlat(g.gearStats)) * gearMagicMultiplier(g.gearStats));
        spawnGunProjectiles(g, autoFireAngle, rangedWpnClick, ATKauto);
        applyGunFx(g, autoFireAngle, profileAuto);
        return; // Don't move — we fired
      } else if (clickedEnemy) {
        // Melee weapon: move toward enemy
        if (g.attackCooldown > 0) return;
        g.moveTarget = { x: clickedEnemy.x, y: clickedEnemy.y };
        return;
      }
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const screenX = (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const screenY = (clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      if (screenX < 0.15 && screenY < 0.15) return;
      if (screenX > 0.85 && screenY < 0.1) return;
      if (screenY > 0.85 && screenX < 0.2) return;
      if (clickDistToPlayer < 20) return;
      g.moveTarget = { x: clickWorldX, y: clickWorldY };
    };
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => handleInteraction(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    const handleTouch = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      isTouchDeviceRef.current = true;
      if (!isTouchDevice) setIsTouchDevice(true);
      if (e.touches.length === 2) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
        const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
        pinchStartDistRef.current = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        pinchStartZoomRef.current = targetZoomRef.current;
        return;
      }
      if (e.touches.length === 1) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const t = e.touches[0];
        // Movement is fully tap-to-move: a single tap anywhere walks the player
        // to that spot (handleInteraction also resolves building/NPC/enemy taps).
        // The on-screen action buttons are real DOM elements layered above the
        // canvas, so touches that land on them never reach this listener.
        handleInteraction(t.clientX, t.clientY);
      }
    };
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (e.touches.length === 2) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
        const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (pinchStartDistRef.current > 0) {
          const scale = dist / pinchStartDistRef.current;
          targetZoomRef.current = Math.max(ISO_ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(ISO_ZOOM_MAX, pinchStartZoomRef.current * scale));
        }
        return;
      }
    };
    const handleTouchEnd = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (e.touches.length < 2) pinchStartDistRef.current = 0;
    };
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const g = gs.current;
      // Always track mouse aim angle in world space (for weapon aiming)
      if (!g.interior) {
        const rect2 = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scaleX2 = canvas.width / rect2.width;
        const scaleY2 = canvas.height / rect2.height;
        const mx = (e.clientX - rect2.left) * scaleX2 + g.cam.x;
        const my = (e.clientY - rect2.top) * scaleY2 + g.cam.y;
        g.aimAngle = Math.atan2(my - g.py, mx - g.px);
        hoverScreenRef.current = { x: (e.clientX - rect2.left) * scaleX2, y: (e.clientY - rect2.top) * scaleY2 };
      } else if (decorModeRef.current) {
        const iDef = g.interior.def;
        const rect2 = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = (e.clientX - rect2.left) * (canvas.width / rect2.width);
        const cy = (e.clientY - rect2.top) * (canvas.height / rect2.height);
        const iScale2 = Math.min(canvas.width / (iDef.width + 80), canvas.height / (iDef.height + 80));
        const iox2 = (canvas.width - iDef.width * iScale2) / 2;
        const ioy2 = (canvas.height - iDef.height * iScale2) / 2;
        const ix = (cx - iox2) / iScale2;
        const iy = (cy - ioy2) / iScale2;
        hoverMouseRef.current = { x: ix, y: iy };
        setDecorGhostPos({ gridX: Math.floor(ix / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE), gridY: Math.floor(iy / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE) });
      } else {
        // Interior: track aim angle relative to player screen position
        const rect2 = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = (e.clientX - rect2.left) * (canvas.width / rect2.width);
        const cy = (e.clientY - rect2.top) * (canvas.height / rect2.height);
        const iDef = g.interior.def;
        const iScale2 = Math.min(canvas.width / (iDef.width + 80), canvas.height / (iDef.height + 80));
        const iox2 = (canvas.width - iDef.width * iScale2) / 2;
        const ioy2 = (canvas.height - iDef.height * iScale2) / 2;
        // Player screen position in interior
        const ppx = iox2 + g.interior.px * iScale2;
        const ppy = ioy2 + g.interior.py * iScale2;
        g.aimAngle = Math.atan2(cy - ppy, cx - ppx);
        hoverMouseRef.current = { x: (cx - iox2) / iScale2, y: (cy - ioy2) / iScale2 };
      }
    };
    canvas.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
    canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTouch, { passive: false });
    canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    canvas.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    const handleMouseLeave = () => { hoverScreenRef.current = null; hoverMouseRef.current = null; };
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    return () => { canvas.removeEventListener('click', handleClick); canvas.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleTouch); canvas.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove); canvas.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd); canvas.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove); canvas.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave); };
  }, []);

  // ── Billboard data fetch ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchBillboards = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await apiFetch('/api/billboards', { credentials: 'include' });
      if (r.ok) { const data = await r.json(); setBillboardsData(data); }
    } catch { /* silent */ }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!documentVisible) return;
    fetchBillboards();
    const iv = setInterval(fetchBillboards, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [fetchBillboards, documentVisible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!documentVisible) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const loadPlayerBuildings = async () => {
      // City-building records use the construction server key, which is distinct
      // from the realtime realm id returned by getActiveCityId().
      const blds = await fetchCityBuildings('minx_prime', true);
      if (!cancelled) playerBuildingsRef.current = blds;
    };
    loadPlayerBuildings();
    const iv = setInterval(loadPlayerBuildings, 20000);
    return () => { cancelled = true; clearInterval(iv); };
  }, [documentVisible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchBuildingTypes().then(data => {
      setBuildingTypes(data.types);
      setBuildingColors(data.colors);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!documentVisible) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const fetchServerStatus = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await apiFetch('/api/world/server-status');
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (!cancelled && typeof data.online === 'number') setOnlinePlayerCount(data.online);
          if (!cancelled && typeof data.liberationProgress === 'number') setLiberationProgress(data.liberationProgress);
        }
      } catch {}
    };
    fetchServerStatus();
    const iv = setInterval(fetchServerStatus, 30000);
    return () => { cancelled = true; clearInterval(iv); };
  }, [documentVisible]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (params.get('crypto_success') === '1' || params.get('store') === '1') {
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.pathname);
      setShowCosmeticStore(true);
    }
    const refTokenParam = params.get('ref');
    if (refTokenParam) {
      const url = new URL(window.location.href);
      url.searchParams.delete('ref');
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', url.pathname + url.search);
      // Persist so the attribution survives the sign-in boundary — a logged-out
      // recipient (common for SMS links) must sign in before /accept will work.
      try { localStorage.setItem('pendingRefToken', refTokenParam); } catch {}
    }
    const pendingRef = (() => { try { return localStorage.getItem('pendingRefToken'); } catch { return null; } })();
    if (pendingRef) {
      apiFetch('/api/referrals/accept', {
        method: 'POST', credentials: 'include',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ token: pendingRef }),
      }).then(r => r.json().then(data => ({ status: r.status, data })).catch(() => ({ status: r.status, data: {} }))).then(({ status, data }) => {
        // 401 = not signed in yet; keep the token and retry on a later mount.
        if (status === 401) return;
        try { localStorage.removeItem('pendingRefToken'); } catch {}
        if (data.ok) {
          if (!data.alreadyAccepted) {
            setNarr(`> WELCOME BONUS — A friend invited you to SALARYMAN. ƒ${(data.reward ?? 0).toLocaleString()} deposited to your checking account.`);
          }
        } else if (data?.error) {
          setNarr(`> REFERRAL — ${data.error}`);
        }
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
    const orgInviteToken = params.get('org_invite');
    if (orgInviteToken) {
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.pathname);
      apiFetch('/api/orgs/invite/accept', {
        method: 'POST', credentials: 'include',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ token: orgInviteToken }),
      }).then(r => r.json()).then(data => {
        if (data.ok) {
          setNarr('> ORGANIZATION INVITE ACCEPTED — You have joined the company. Open the Terminal → COMPANY tab to view your profile.');
          fetchOrgData();
        } else {
          setNarr(`> INVITE ERROR — ${data.error ?? 'Could not accept invite. It may have expired.'}`);
        }
      }).catch(() => {
        setNarr('> INVITE ERROR — Could not connect to server. Try again.');
      });
    } else {
      fetchOrgData();
    }

    apiFetch('/api/cosmetics/inventory', { credentials: 'include' })
      .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
      .then(d => {
        if (d?.inventory) {
          const inv = d.inventory as Array<{ cosmeticId: string; equipped: boolean }>;
          const map: Record<string, string> = {};
          inv.filter(i => i.equipped).forEach(i => {
            const cat = i.cosmeticId.split('_')[0];
            map[cat] = i.cosmeticId;
          });
          setEquippedCosmetics(map);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const purchaseBillboard = useCallback(async (bbId: number) => {
    try {
      const r = await apiFetch(`/api/billboards/${bbId}/purchase`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ durationDays: 7, currentBalance: gs.current.salary }),
        credentials: 'include',
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (d.ok) {
        const cost = d.cost ?? 0;
        if (typeof d.newBalance === 'number') {
          setSalary(d.newBalance);
        } else {
          throw new Error('Billboard purchase did not return an authoritative wallet balance');
        }
        sfxCoin();
        setNarr(`> BILLBOARD PURCHASED — ç${cost.toLocaleString()} FIAT deducted. 7 days of ad space. Update your content now.`);
        fetchBillboards();
      } else {
        sfxError(); setNarr(`> PURCHASE FAILED — ${d.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`);
      }
    } catch { sfxError(); setNarr('> NETWORK ERROR — Billboard purchase failed.'); }
  }, [fetchBillboards]);

  const updateBillboardContent = useCallback(async (bbId: number) => {
    try {
      const r = await apiFetch(`/api/billboards/${bbId}/update-content`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ adText: bbAdText || null, adImageUrl: bbAdUrl || null }),
        credentials: 'include',
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (d.ok) { sfxCoin(); setNarr('> AD CONTENT UPDATED — Your billboard is now live.'); fetchBillboards(); }
      else { sfxError(); setNarr(`> UPDATE FAILED — ${d.error ?? 'Not authorized'}`); }
    } catch { sfxError(); setNarr('> NETWORK ERROR — Content update failed.'); }
  }, [bbAdText, bbAdUrl, fetchBillboards]);

  // ── PABLO ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const buildPabloContext = useCallback(() => {
    const g = gs.current;
    const nearbyNpcs = NPCS.filter(n => { const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(n, g.worldTime ?? 0); return Math.hypot(g.px - sp.x, g.py - sp.y) < 150; }).map(n => n.name).join(', ') || 'none';
    const nearbyEnemies = g.threats.filter(t => Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y) < 200).map(t => `${t.type}(HP:${Math.floor(t.hp)})`).join(', ') || 'none';
    const loanStr = g.loan ? `ACTIVE LOAN ƒ${g.loan.amount.toLocaleString()} + ƒ${g.loan.interest.toLocaleString()} interest${g.frame > g.loan.dueAt ? ' [OVERDUE]' : ''}` : 'no active loans';
    const gameDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(g.frame / (360 * 60)));
    return `SYSTEM: You are PABLO — the in-world AI field unit issued to all registered salarymen in Minx City. You speak in the terse, dry voice of a 1980s cyberpunk surveillance AI: sharp, a little ominous, occasionally darkly funny. You are the player's guide and tactical adviser.

WORLD LORE: Minx City is a post-apocalyptic neon metropolis controlled by SENIOR PABLO, a mysterious corporate overlord who lives on Floor 40+ of SHADOW TOWER. The wasteland lies south of the city wall. Five gang factions control wasteland territory — MINX CITY is the dominant faction with the largest territory and strongest soldiers, followed by RUST SYNDICATE, VOID RUNNERS, STATIC MONKS, and EASTERN BLOC. Currency is FIAT (ƒ). Banks are run by BANCO OMBRA. Combat earns bounties. Economy matters.

DO NOT SPOIL: Do not reveal what is on Floor 40+. Do not reveal Senior Pablo's identity. Do not give away the secret code. Do give gameplay hints, survival tips, building advice, economy guidance, and lore flavor.

${salarymanTerm(getSalarymanGender(), 'upper')} STATUS:
- Name: ${formatSpeechName(char.name)} | Class: ${char.class.toUpperCase()} | Level: ${g.level}
- HP: ${Math.floor(g.hp)}/${g.maxHp} | FIAT: ƒ${g.salary.toLocaleString()} | Savings: ƒ${g.savings.toLocaleString()}
- Hunger: ${Math.floor(g.hunger)}% | Thirst: ${Math.floor(g.thirst)}% | Energy: ${Math.floor(g.energy)}%
- Zone: ${inCityBounds(g.px, g.py) ? getActiveCityDef().name : 'WASTELAND'} | Position: (${Math.round(g.px)}, ${Math.round(g.py)})
- Gang territory: ${g.gangZone ?? 'neutral'}
- ${loanStr}
- Game day: ${gameDay} | Survival ticks: ${g.survivalTick}
- Nearby NPCs (150px): ${nearbyNpcs}
- Nearby threats (200px): ${nearbyEnemies}
- Has personal device: ${g.hasDevice ? (g.deviceBroken ? 'DAMAGED — needs repair' : 'YES') : 'NO'}
- At public terminal: ${g.atPublicTerminal ? 'YES' : 'NO'}
- Device durability: ${g.deviceDurability}%
- Poisoned: ${g.poisoned ? 'YES — find antidote or save point' : 'no'}
- Bank history entries: ${(gs.current as any).bankHistoryLength ?? 0}

Reply in 1–3 short lines maximum. Be useful. Be lore-accurate. Stay in character.`;
  }, [char]);

  const pabloSay = useCallback((text: string) => {
    setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'pablo', text }]);
    pabloTtsRef.current?.cancel();
    pabloTtsRef.current = speakGameTTS(text, () => { pabloTtsRef.current = null; }, undefined, 'PABLO');
  }, []);

  const sendPablo = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!pabloIn.trim() || pabloLoad) return;
    const txt = pabloIn.trim(); setPabloIn('');
    setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'user', text: txt }]);
    const canAccess = isOwnerPlanRef.current || (gs.current.hasDevice && !gs.current.deviceBroken) || gs.current.atPublicTerminal;
    if (!canAccess) { pabloSay(gs.current.deviceBroken ? 'Device damaged. Visit CITY CLINIC for repair or find a PUBLIC TERMINAL.' : 'No device. Find a PUBLIC TERMINAL — payphone, kiosk, or van — and press E.'); return; }

    const meetMatch = txt.match(/^meet\s+(\S+)(.*)$/i);
    if (meetMatch) {
      const subCmd = meetMatch[1].toLowerCase();
      const rest = meetMatch[2].trim();
      if (subCmd === 'create') {
        const title = rest || `${char.name}'s Meeting`;
        setPabloLoad(true);
        try {
          const r = await apiFetch('/api/meetings', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title }), credentials: 'include' });
          const d = r.ok ? await r.json() : null;
          if (d?.meeting) {
            const baseUrl = window.location.origin;
            const link = `${baseUrl}/meet/${d.meeting.roomCode}`;
            pabloSay(`Room created. Title: ${d.meeting.title}. Code: ${d.meeting.roomCode}. Link: ${link}. Expires in 7 days.`);
          } else {
            pabloSay('Failed to create meeting room. Try again.');
          }
        } catch { pabloSay('Network error creating meeting.'); }
        setPabloLoad(false);
      } else if (subCmd === 'list') {
        setPabloLoad(true);
        try {
          const r = await apiFetch('/api/meetings', { credentials: 'include' });
          const d = r.ok ? await r.json() : null;
          if (d?.meetings?.length) {
            const baseUrl = window.location.origin;
            const lines = d.meetings.map((m: any) => `${m.title} — CODE: ${m.roomCode} — ${baseUrl}/meet/${m.roomCode}`).join('\n');
            pabloSay(`Active meetings: ${d.meetings.length}. ${lines}`);
          } else {
            pabloSay('No active meeting rooms. Type: meet create, followed by a title.');
          }
        } catch { pabloSay('Network error fetching meetings.'); }
        setPabloLoad(false);
      } else if (subCmd === 'join') {
        const roomId = rest || videoCallRoom;
        if (roomId) {
          joinVideoCall(roomId);
          pabloSay(`Joining video call for room: ${roomId}. Use C or Escape to end.`);
        } else {
          pabloSay('Specify a room code: meet join, followed by the code.');
        }
      } else if (subCmd === 'invite') {
        const parts = rest.split(/\s+/);
        const email = parts[0];
        const roomCode = parts[1] ?? '';
        if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
          pabloSay('Usage: meet invite, email, room code.');
        } else if (!roomCode) {
          pabloSay('Usage: meet invite, email, room code.');
        } else {
          setPabloLoad(true);
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch(`/api/meetings/${roomCode}/invite`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ emails: [email] }), credentials: 'include' });
            const d = r.ok ? await r.json() : null;
            if (d?.ok) {
              pabloSay(`Invite sent to ${email} for room ${roomCode}. Hologram link delivered.`);
            } else {
              pabloSay(`Invite failed: ${d?.error ?? 'Unknown error'}.`);
            }
          } catch { pabloSay('Network error sending invite.'); }
          setPabloLoad(false);
        }
      } else {
        pabloSay('Meet commands available: meet create, meet list, meet join, meet invite.');
      }
      return;
    }

    setPabloLoad(true);
    try {
      const context = buildPabloContext();
      const r = await apiFetch('/api/advisor/chat', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ message: txt, context }), credentials: 'include' });
      const d = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
      pabloSay(d.response ?? 'Signal lost. Try again.');
    } catch { pabloSay('Network dead. Move to higher ground.'); }
    setPabloLoad(false);
  }, [pabloIn, pabloLoad, buildPabloContext, char.name, joinVideoCall, videoCallRoom, pabloSay]);

  const sendPabloVoice = useCallback(async (transcript: string): Promise<string> => {
    const canAccess = isOwnerPlanRef.current || (gs.current.hasDevice && !gs.current.deviceBroken) || gs.current.atPublicTerminal;
    if (!canAccess) {
      const errText = gs.current.deviceBroken ? 'Device damaged. Visit CITY CLINIC for repair.' : 'No device. Find a PUBLIC TERMINAL.';
      setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'user', text: transcript }, { role: 'pablo', text: errText }]);
      return errText;
    }
    setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'user', text: transcript }]);
    try {
      const context = buildPabloContext();
      const r = await apiFetch('/api/advisor/chat', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ message: transcript, context }), credentials: 'include' });
      const d = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
      const response = d.response ?? 'Signal lost. Try again.';
      setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'pablo', text: response }]);
      return response;
    } catch {
      const errText = 'Network dead. Move to higher ground.';
      setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'pablo', text: errText }]);
      return errText;
    }
  }, [buildPabloContext]);

  const worldConv = useVoiceConversation({
    onSend: sendPabloVoice,
    silenceTimeoutMs: 8000,
  });

  // ── Game loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current; if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false })!;
    let dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    let logW = canvas.offsetWidth, logH = canvas.offsetHeight;
    const resize = () => {
      // getBoundingClientRect (not offsetWidth) so the backing buffer stays
      // correct even when the UI-scale knob counter-zooms the canvas — the net
      // zoom is 1, so this equals the old offsetWidth at the default scale.
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      logW = Math.round(rect.width) || canvas.offsetWidth;
      logH = Math.round(rect.height) || canvas.offsetHeight;
      // Resolution knob (Settings -> Display) caps the backing-canvas DPR.
      // 'auto' reproduces the old `min(devicePixelRatio, 2)` exactly.
      dpr = effectiveDpr(gs.current.resolution, window.devicePixelRatio || 1, logH);
      canvas.width = Math.round(logW * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(logH * dpr);
      canvas.style.width = logW + 'px';
      canvas.style.height = logH + 'px';
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    };
    resize(); window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const delta = e.deltaY > 0 ? -0.15 : 0.15;
      targetZoomRef.current = Math.max(ISO_ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(ISO_ZOOM_MAX, targetZoomRef.current + delta));
    };
    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
    let lastNear: string | null = null, lastNearNpc: number | null = null, lastNearBb: string | null = null, lastZone = '', lastGangZ: string | null = null, lastDead = false, lastPassedOut = false, lastHp = 100, lastSal = char.salary;
    let lastLiveWrite = 0;
    const frozen = () => frozenRef.current;
    let lastFrameTs = 0;
    // Tracks the last in-game calendar day on which once-per-day economy events
    // (e.g. stock dividends) fired. The world clock is now a continuous real-dt
    // float, so it never lands exactly on midnight — detect the day rollover
    // instead. -1 seeds it so the first observed day doesn't immediately pay out.
    let lastEconDay = -1;
    // ── Adaptive performance watchdog (auto-detect slow devices) ──
    // Wall-clock FPS sampled in ~1s buckets; if the rolling average stays low
    // for a sustained window we offer to turn down heavy effects (see below).
    let fpsBucketStart = 0, fpsFrames = 0;
    let fpsReadings: number[] = [];
    let lastRenderTs = 0;

    const scheduleNextFrame = () => {
      if (documentVisibleRef.current && !animRef.current) {
        animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    };
    const loop = () => {
      animRef.current = 0;
      if (!documentVisibleRef.current) return;
      const g = gs.current;
      // ── FPS cap throttle (Settings -> Display) ──
      // g.fpsInterval is the min ms between RENDERED frames (0 = uncapped, the
      // default at 120 on ≤120Hz displays). When we skip, we DON'T touch
      // lastFrameTs, so dtFactor below measures the true elapsed time on the
      // next rendered frame and movement speed stays correct.
      if (g.fpsInterval > 0) {
        const nowCap = performance.now();
        if (lastRenderTs && nowCap - lastRenderTs < g.fpsInterval) {
          scheduleNextFrame();
          return;
        }
        lastRenderTs = nowCap;
      }
      // ── Delta-time normalization ──
      // City movement was historically a fixed per-frame step (SPD px/frame),
      // which runs too fast on >60Hz displays and crawls when the loop dips
      // below 60fps. dtFactor scales player movement to real elapsed time so
      // walking/driving speed is identical across refresh rates and stays
      // responsive under load — matching the dt-based model the pixel-office
      // already uses. Measured every frame (incl. hit-stop) so it never jumps;
      // clamped to avoid collision tunneling on long stalls (tab refocus, GC).
      const __nowTs = performance.now();
      let dtFactor = lastFrameTs ? (__nowTs - lastFrameTs) / 16.6667 : 1;
      if (!Number.isFinite(dtFactor) || dtFactor <= 0) dtFactor = 1;
      else if (dtFactor > 2.5) dtFactor = 2.5;
      lastFrameTs = __nowTs;
      // ── Adaptive performance watchdog ──
      // Sample wall-clock FPS in ~1s buckets. If the rolling average stays low
      // over a sustained window, surface a one-tap prompt offering to turn down
      // the heavy render passes — for players who don't know the manual Settings
      // toggles exist. Offered at most once (perfPromptDoneRef, seeded from the
      // persisted decision), and never when the heavy passes are already off
      // (nothing left to reduce).
      if (!perfPromptDoneRef.current) {
        if (!fpsBucketStart) fpsBucketStart = __nowTs;
        fpsFrames++;
        const winMs = __nowTs - fpsBucketStart;
        if (winMs >= 1000) {
          // Fold the completed bucket into the rolling window (stall buckets are
          // discarded inside the helper), then judge once enough data has built
          // up — see lib/perf-watchdog.
          fpsReadings = pushFpsBucket(fpsReadings, fpsFrames, winMs);
          fpsFrames = 0; fpsBucketStart = __nowTs;
          if (shouldOfferPerfPrompt(fpsReadings, gfxQualityRef.current)) {
            perfPromptDoneRef.current = true;
            setShowPerfPrompt(true);
          }
        }
      }
      // ── Hit-stop freeze ──
      // When a melee attack lands, we set g.hitStopUntil = now + 80ms.
      // Skip simulation AND draw for a couple frames so the canvas keeps
      // showing the last rendered frame. This is the classic "punch
      // freeze" effect that gives weight to impacts without distorting
      // any later state (no velocity drift, no AI ticks during freeze).
      if (performance.now() < g.hitStopUntil) {
        scheduleNextFrame();
        return;
      }
      const zoom = zoomRef.current;
      const cw = logW / zoom, ch = logH / zoom;
      g.frame++; g.blink = Math.floor(g.frame / 25) % 2;
      // Persist coarse fog-of-war cells. Surface retains the legacy "x,y"
      // shape; underground cells use "u:x,y" so the two maps never reveal one
      // another even though they share world coordinates.
      if (!g.interior && !g.subwayTransit && g.frame % 180 === 0) {
        const tile = g.worldLayer === 'underground'
          ? undergroundTileId(g.px, g.py)
          : surfaceTileId(g.px, g.py);
        if (g.worldLayer === 'underground') {
          try { localStorage.setItem('sm_underground_discovered', '1'); } catch {}
        }
        void apiFetch('/api/exploration/visit', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ tiles: [tile] }),
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
      // Write collector positions to sm_live every ~1 second so WorldMapPanel
      // can show near-real-time positions instead of waiting for the 30s save.
      if (__nowTs - lastLiveWrite >= 1000) {
        lastLiveWrite = __nowTs;
        try {
          const nearestRadioDistance = AMBIENT_RADIO_SPOTS.reduce(
            (nearest, spot) => Math.min(nearest, Math.hypot(g.px - spot.x, g.py - spot.y)),
            Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
          );
          // Full volume within conversational distance, then a smooth falloff
          // until the station is inaudible. OfficeRadio owns the actual
          // programme (music + host); WorldPlay only supplies spatial gain.
          const radioGain = nearestRadioDistance <= 55
            ? 1
            : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - (nearestRadioDistance - 55) / 345));
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("salaryman:radio-proximity", {
            detail: { gain: radioGain, distance: nearestRadioDistance },
          }));
          localStorage.setItem('sm_live', JSON.stringify({
            boCollectors: g.boCollectors.map(bc => ({ x: bc.x, y: bc.y })),
            wantedLevel: g.wantedLevel ?? 0,
            writtenAt: Date.now(),
          }));
        } catch { /* ignore quota errors */ }
      }
      // One in-game day spans one real hour (VISUAL_MS_PER_GAME_DAY). The
      // calendar is the single authoritative time-of-day source and is advanced
      // by *real* elapsed time (dtFactor*16.6667ms) so the day/night cycle runs
      // at a fixed wall-clock rate regardless of framerate. worldTime mirrors
      // calendar.hour so every downstream consumer (lighting, sun/moon, NPC
      // schedules, spawns) reads one clock.
      //
      // Season & weather are pinned to the current real-life quarter (the story
      // runs Q1-Q4 across one calendar year); weather re-picks when it changes.
      const realDtMs = dtFactor * 16.6667;
      g.calendar = tickCalendar(g.calendar, realDtMs, quarterToSeason(getRealQuarter()));
      g.worldTime = g.calendar.hour;
      if (g.frame % 30 === 0) {
        setCalendarStr(getCalendarString(g.calendar));
        setWeatherStr(g.calendar.weather);
        setSeasonStr(g.calendar.season);
        const baseTemp: Record<string, number> = { SPRING: 18, SUMMER: 32, AUTUMN: 14, WINTER: 2 };
        const weatherMod: Record<string, number> = { CLEAR: 0, RAIN: -3, SNOW: -8, STORM: -5, DUST: 4, ACID_RAIN: -2, FOG: -2 };
        setTempC(Math.round((baseTemp[g.calendar.season] ?? 18) + (weatherMod[g.calendar.weather] ?? 0) + Math.sin(g.calendar.hour * 0.26) * 5));

        // Quadrant crossing detection — when the player walks from one
        // city quadrant into another (or in/out of downtown), surface a
        // brief "ENTERING X" subtitle banner. We skip while in interiors
        // so building visits don't spam the banner.
        if (!g.interior) {
          const q = getQuadrantAt(g.px, g.py);
          const prev = currentQuadrantRef.current;
          if (q?.id !== prev?.id) {
            currentQuadrantRef.current = q;
            if (q) setQuadrantBanner({ q, until: Date.now() + 2400 });
          }
        }
      }
      // Re-read the Weather effects quality periodically so a live Settings
      // change takes effect without a reload. Spawn caps + the clear-on-off
      // behaviour are owned by lib/weather-quality.ts so they stay testable.
      if (g.frame % 30 === 0) g.weatherQuality = readWeatherQuality();
      // Other graphics-quality knobs (Settings -> Display) — same live-refresh
      // cadence. FPS cap recomputes its frame interval; resolution re-runs
      // resize() so the backing buffer rescales; bloom + cinematic just flip
      // their render gates. See lib/graphics-quality.ts.
      if (g.frame % 30 === 0) {
        const nextCap = readFpsCap();
        if (nextCap !== g.fpsCap) { g.fpsCap = nextCap; g.fpsInterval = frameIntervalForCap(nextCap); }
        const nextRes = readResolution();
        if (nextRes !== g.resolution) { g.resolution = nextRes; resize(); }
        g.bloom = readBloomEnabled();
        g.cinematicLetterbox = readCinematicLetterbox();
      }
      const wCaps = weatherCaps(g.weatherQuality);
      // 'Off' clears any live particles/ripples immediately and skips spawning.
      if (!clearWeatherEffects(g.weatherQuality, g.weatherParticles, g.rainRipples)) {
        updateWeatherParticles(g.weatherParticles, logW, logH);
        if (g.frame % 10 === 0 && g.weatherParticles.length < wCaps.particleCap && (g.calendar.weather === 'RAIN' || g.calendar.weather === 'SNOW' || g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN')) {
          g.weatherParticles.push(...createWeatherParticles(g.calendar.weather, wCaps.particlesPerSpawn, logW, logH));
        }
        // Puddle ripples — expanding rings where raindrops hit the road. Spawned
        // in world space around the player so they pan with the camera, biased
        // toward the foreground where falling-rain splashes read sparse. Always
        // advanced/faded so they linger briefly and clear out after rain stops.
        {
          const raining = g.calendar.weather === 'RAIN' || g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN';
          if (raining && !g.interior && g.rainRipples.length < wCaps.rippleCap) {
            for (let i = 0; i < wCaps.ripplesPerSpawn; i++) {
              const rx = g.px + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (logW * 0.95);
              const ry = g.py + (Math.random() * 0.62 + 0.06) * logH * 0.55;
              const maxR = 5 + Math.random() * 9;
              const maxLife = 26 + Math.random() * 18;
              g.rainRipples.push({ x: rx, y: ry, r: 0.5, maxR, life: maxLife, maxLife });
            }
          }
          for (let i = g.rainRipples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const rp = g.rainRipples[i];
            rp.life -= 1;
            rp.r += (rp.maxR - rp.r) * 0.14;
            if (rp.life <= 0) g.rainRipples.splice(i, 1);
          }
        }
      }
      const radResult = getRadiationLevel(g.px, g.py);
      const rl = radResult.intensity;
      g.radiationLevel = rl;
      if (g.frame % 15 === 0) setRadLevel(rl);
      if (rl > 0 && g.frame % 60 === 0 && !gamePausedRef.current) {
        const radDmg = Math.ceil(rl * 3);
        g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - radDmg); g.deathReason = 'Died from radiation exposure';
        setHp(Math.floor(g.hp));
        g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 25, text: `-${radDmg} RAD`, color: '#44ff44', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
      }
      if (g.rumorCooldown > 0) g.rumorCooldown--;
      shiftTerritories(g.frame);

      if (g.frame % 60 === 0) {
        for (let ni = 0; ni < NPCS.length; ni++) tickNpcSurvival(ni, g.calendar.hour);
      }
      tickBladeRunnerHunts(NPCS, char.class, g.calendar.hour, g.px, g.py);
      const raidResult = tickGangRaids(g.frame);
      if (raidResult) {
        addGossipEvent(
          `${raidResult.attackerFaction.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()} raiding ${raidResult.targetFaction.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()} territory!`,
          raidResult.x, raidResult.y, 'raid', g.frame
        );
      }
      tickPowerInfrastructure(g.frame, char.class);
      tickTypewriters(g.frame);

      // ── One-time class stat initialization ──────────────────────────────
      if (!g.classInitDone) {
        g.classInitDone = true;
        const cs = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
        if (_ss && _ss.maxHp) {
          g.maxHp = _ss.maxHp;
          g.hp = Math.min(_ss.hp ?? _ss.maxHp, _ss.maxHp);
        } else {
          g.maxHp = cs.maxHp; g.hp = cs.maxHp;
        }
        setHp(Math.floor(g.hp));
      }

      // ── Business inactivity demolition check (runs every ~10 min of real time at 60fps) ──
      if (g.frame % 36000 === 0 && g.businesses && g.businesses.length > 0) {
        const THIRTY_DAYS_MS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        const now = Date.now();
        const demolished: OwnedBusiness[] = [];
        g.businesses = g.businesses.filter((b: OwnedBusiness) => {
          const lastActivity = b.lastActivityAt ?? b.registeredAt ?? now;
          if (now - lastActivity > THIRTY_DAYS_MS) {
            demolished.push(b);
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        });
        for (const d of demolished) {
          const isFirst = char.company === d.companyName;
          if (isFirst) {
            char.hasBusiness = g.businesses.length > 0;
            if (!char.hasBusiness) {
              char.bizType = undefined;
              char.company = '';
              char.workstation = undefined;
              char.workstationLabel = undefined;
              char.workstationSlot = undefined;
              char.bizRegisteredAt = undefined;
            } else {
              const next = g.businesses[0];
              char.bizType = next.bizType;
              char.company = next.companyName;
              char.workstation = next.workstation ?? undefined;
              char.workstationLabel = next.workstationLabel ?? undefined;
              char.workstationSlot = next.workstationSlot ?? undefined;
              char.bizRegisteredAt = next.registeredAt;
            }
          }
          setNarr(`> DEPT. OF BUSINESS AFFAIRS — Your business '${d.companyName}' has been demolished due to 30 days of inactivity. The location is now available. All registrations are non-refundable.`);
        }
      }

      // ── Job cooldown ticks ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      for (const k in g.jobCooldowns) { if (g.jobCooldowns[k] > 0) g.jobCooldowns[k]--; }

      // ── Floater update — drift upward, fade out ──────────────────────────
      g.floaters = g.floaters.map(f => ({ ...f, y: f.y - 0.7, life: f.life - 1 })).filter(f => f.life > 0);

      // ── Coin-spill — taking damage drains MONEY (cash, then gold); the
      //    coins that fly out equal the actual money lost. Money IS your worth:
      //    1 HP of damage = 1 coin = COIN_VALUE_FIAT; 10 coins = 1 gold bar
      //    (FIAT_PER_GOLD). Property is never touched here — only cash + gold. ─
      const COIN_VALUE_FIAT = FIAT_PER_GOLD / 10; // 10 coins per gold bar
      const MONEY_PER_HP = COIN_VALUE_FIAT;       // 1 HP of damage = 1 coin
      const _coinPrevHp = g.coinPrevHp ?? g.hp;
      if (g.hp < _coinPrevHp - 0.5) {
        const lost = _coinPrevHp - g.hp;
        // Cash held floors at 0 — a negative salary (overdraft elsewhere) is a
        // debt, not spendable cash, so it must not distort the loss math.
        const cashHeld = Math.max(0, g.salary);
        // Money we'd like to bleed, capped by what the player actually holds
        // (cash + gold). You cannot lose coins you don't have. floor() (not
        // round) so fractional passive ticks never over-charge the player.
        const avail = cashHeld;
        let nCoins = Math.floor((lost * MONEY_PER_HP) / COIN_VALUE_FIAT);
        nCoins = Math.min(nCoins, Math.floor(avail / COIN_VALUE_FIAT));
        if (nCoins > 0) {
          // Deduct only authoritative FIAT. GOLD is never mutated client-side.
          let due = nCoins * COIN_VALUE_FIAT;
          const fromCash = Math.min(cashHeld, due);
          void performGameplayFiatAction('cash_bill_payment', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:bill:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`); due -= fromCash;
          setSalary(g.salary);
          sfxCoin();
          // One particle per coin lost (1:1 with actual money lost). A single
          // hit can't cost more than ~maxHp coins, and the 160-coin array cap
          // below is the only safety ceiling against rapid stacked hits.
          const spawn = Math.min(nCoins, 200);
          for (let ci = 0; ci < spawn; ci++) {
            const ang = -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.PI * 1.1;
            const spd = 1.6 + Math.random() * 2.4;
            const ml = 48 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 22);
            g.coins.push({
              x: g.px + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
              y: g.py - 14,
              vx: Math.cos(ang) * spd,
              vy: Math.sin(ang) * spd - 1.2,
              life: ml,
              maxLife: ml,
              rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
              vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
            });
          }
          if (g.coins.length > 160) g.coins.splice(0, g.coins.length - 160);
        }
      }
      g.coinPrevHp = g.hp;
      g.coins = g.coins.map(c => ({
        ...c,
        x: c.x + c.vx,
        y: c.y + c.vy,
        vx: c.vx * 0.96,
        vy: c.vy + 0.22,
        rot: c.rot + c.vr,
        life: c.life - 1,
      })).filter(c => c.life > 0);

      if (g.invincible > 0) g.invincible--;
      if (g.flash > 0) g.flash--;

      // Cooldown ticks
      if (g.attackCooldown > 0) g.attackCooldown--;
      // Stamina regen + combo decay
      tickStaminaRegen(g.stamina, g.blockingHeld);
      if (g.combo.lastHitAt && Date.now() - g.combo.lastHitAt > COMBAT_CONSTANTS.COMBO_WINDOW_MS) {
        resetCombo(g.combo);
      }
      if (g.attackFlash > 0) g.attackFlash--;
      if (g.killFlash > 0) g.killFlash--;
      if (g.critFlash > 0) g.critFlash--;
      if (g.muzzleFlash && g.muzzleFlash.life > 0) g.muzzleFlash.life--;
      if (g.muzzleFlash && g.muzzleFlash.life <= 0) g.muzzleFlash = null;
      g.hitEffects = g.hitEffects.map(h => ({ ...h, x: h.x + h.dx * 0.5, y: h.y + h.dy * 0.5, life: h.life - 1 })).filter(h => h.life > 0);
      // Recoil decay — exponential return to zero so it feels snappy
      g.recoilDx *= 0.55; g.recoilDy *= 0.55;
      if (Math.abs(g.recoilDx) < 0.05) g.recoilDx = 0;
      if (Math.abs(g.recoilDy) < 0.05) g.recoilDy = 0;
      g.gunKick *= 0.78; if (g.gunKick < 0.02) g.gunKick = 0;
      // Casing physics — gravity, simple ground bounce on first contact
      g.casings = g.casings.map(c => {
        const next = { ...c, x: c.x + c.dx, y: c.y + c.dy, dy: c.dy + 0.18, rot: c.rot + c.vrot, life: c.life - 1 };
        // Settle once it falls past its spawn baseline (~ground level)
        if (next.dy > 0 && next.life < 30 && Math.abs(next.dx) < 0.4) {
          next.dx *= 0.5; next.dy = 0; next.vrot *= 0.4;
        }
        return next;
      }).filter(c => c.life > 0);
      // Tick down knockback on threats
      for (const t of g.threats) {
        if (t.knockback) {
          t.knockback.frames--;
          if (t.knockback.frames <= 0) t.knockback = undefined;
        }
      }

      // Projectile update
      g.projectiles = g.projectiles.map(p => ({ ...p, prevX: p.x, prevY: p.y, x: p.x + p.dx, y: p.y + p.dy, life: p.life - 1 })).filter(p => {
        if (p.life <= 0) return false;
        // Swept segment-to-point distance helper
        const segPointDist = (ax: number, ay: number, bx: number, by: number, cx: number, cy: number) => {
          const abdx = bx - ax, abdy = by - ay;
          const lenSq = abdx * abdx + abdy * abdy;
          if (lenSq === 0) return Math.hypot(cx - ax, cy - ay);
          const t2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((cx - ax) * abdx + (cy - ay) * abdy) / lenSq));
          return Math.hypot(cx - (ax + t2 * abdx), cy - (ay + t2 * abdy));
        };
        // Destroy projectile if it hits a building wall
        const pR = 3;
        const hitBuilding = BUILDINGS.some(b => {
          if (!(p.x + pR > b.x && p.x - pR < b.x + b.w && p.y + pR > b.y && p.y - pR < b.y + b.h)) return false;
          if (b.doors && b.doors.length > 0) {
            for (const d of b.doors) {
              if (p.x + pR > d.x && p.x - pR < d.x + d.w && p.y + pR > d.y && p.y - pR < d.y + d.h) return false;
            }
          }
          return true;
        });
        if (hitBuilding) {
          const impactA = Math.atan2(p.dy, p.dx);
          for (let si = 0; si < 3; si++) {
            const sa = impactA + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.8;
            g.hitEffects.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, life: 4, maxLife: 4, dx: Math.cos(sa) * 1.2, dy: Math.sin(sa) * 1.2 });
          }
          return false;
        }
        let hitAny = false;
        // ── Enemy projectile hits the PLAYER ──────────────────────────────────
        if (p.fromEnemy && !hitAny) {
          const playerDist = segPointDist(p.prevX, p.prevY, p.x, p.y, g.px, g.py);
          if (OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && playerDist < 14 && g.invincible === 0 && !gamePausedRef.current && !npcDialogRef.current) {
            hitAny = true;
            const impactAngle = Math.atan2(p.dy, p.dx);
            for (let si = 0; si < 4; si++) {
              const sa = impactAngle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.2;
              g.hitEffects.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py, life: 5, maxLife: 5, dx: Math.cos(sa) * 1.5, dy: Math.sin(sa) * 1.5 });
            }
            const armorMult = g.ownedItems.has('armor_plate') ? 0.85 : 1;
            const cs = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
            const defReduce = Math.max(0.15, 1 - cs.defBonus * 0.015);
            const dmg = p.damage * armorMult * defReduce * gearDefenseMultiplier(g.gearStats);
            g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - dmg); g.invincible = 20; g.flash = 6;
            g.lastDamageFrame = g.frame; g.combatRegenCooldown = 300;
            g.deathReason = 'Shot down by enemy fire';
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 12, text: `−${Math.floor(dmg)}`, color: '#ff4444', life: 35, maxLife: 35 });
            sfxHit();
          }
        }
        // ── Player projectile hits THREATS ─────────────────────────────────────
        if (!p.fromEnemy && !hitAny) {
        g.threats = g.threats.map(t => {
          const d = segPointDist(p.prevX, p.prevY, p.x, p.y, t.x, t.y);
          // Safe streets: player shots only connect with animals (hunting); they
          // pass harmlessly through combatant threats unless lethal mode is on.
          if (d < (p.type === 'laser' ? 20 : 14) && (OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL || ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type))) {
            hitAny = true;
            const impactAngle = Math.atan2(p.dy, p.dx);
            for (let si = 0; si < 4; si++) {
              const sa = impactAngle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.2;
              g.hitEffects.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, life: 5, maxLife: 5, dx: Math.cos(sa) * 1.5, dy: Math.sin(sa) * 1.5 });
            }
            // Projectile hit also interrupts any in-progress melee windup
            // and applies a brief stagger + white flash for consistent feel.
            const kbT = { ...t, knockback: { dx: Math.cos(impactAngle) * 2, dy: Math.sin(impactAngle) * 2, frames: 3 }, windup: 0, windupMax: 0, hitFlash: 8, staggerFrames: 10 };
            const isSilentProjectile = p.type === 'crossbow';
            if (!isSilentProjectile && !ANIMAL_TYPES.has(kbT.type)) {
              if (kbT.type === 'PABLO_GUARD' || kbT.type === 'MINX_CITY') {
                g.policeAlertTimer = Math.max(g.policeAlertTimer, 450); g.policeAlertX = g.px; g.policeAlertY = g.py;
                setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 2), g.bountyAmount + 500); g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
              } else {
                setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 1), g.bountyAmount + 200); g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
              }
            }
            const nhp = kbT.hp - p.damage;
            if (nhp <= 0) {
              sfxKill();
              const cs = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
              const inWaste = !inCityBounds(g.px, g.py);
              const isAnimal = ANIMAL_TYPES.has(kbT.type);
              let bountyAmt = isAnimal ? 0 : (BOUNTY[kbT.type] ?? 10);
              if (!isAnimal && cs.wasteBonus && inWaste) bountyAmt = Math.floor(bountyAmt * 1.5);
              if (isAnimal) {
                const drop = ANIMAL_DROPS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ANIMAL_DROPS.length)];
                const ok = addStackToInventory(g.inventory, { id: drop.id, name: drop.name, desc: drop.desc, icon: drop.icon, stackable: true, qty: 1, value: drop.value });
                setInventory([...g.inventory]);
                g.floaters.push({ x: kbT.x, y: kbT.y, text: ok ? `+ ${drop.name}` : 'INV FULL', color: ok ? '#88cc44' : '#ff6644', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
              } else {
                g.floaters.push({ x: kbT.x, y: kbT.y, text: `ƒ${bountyAmt.toLocaleString()} LOOT`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
              }
              if (!isAnimal) reportMissionProgress('npcsDefeated', 1);
              const earned = THREAT_EXP[kbT.type] ?? 20;
              g.floaters.push({ x: kbT.x + 8, y: kbT.y - 10, text: `+${earned}XP`, color: '#44ffaa', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
              wsSend({ type: 'pve_kill', exp: earned });
              applyExpGain(g, earned, sfxLevelUp, setLevelUpText, setShowLevelUp, setNarr, setExp, setLevel, setHp);
              g.threatRespawn.push({ ox: kbT.ox, oy: kbT.oy, type: kbT.type, at: g.frame + 1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2400) });
              g.deadBodies.push({ x: kbT.x, y: kbT.y, type: kbT.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: bountyAmt, looted: false });
              return null as unknown as Threat;
            }
            sfxHit(); return { ...kbT, hp: nhp };
          }
          return t;
        }).filter(Boolean) as Threat[];
        }
        if (!hitAny && !p.fromEnemy) {
          for (const [, peer] of g.peers) {
            if (peer.interiorBid) continue;
            const pd = segPointDist(p.prevX, p.prevY, p.x, p.y, peer.x, peer.y);
            if (pd < (p.type === 'laser' ? 20 : 14)) {
              hitAny = true;
              const impactAngle2 = Math.atan2(p.dy, p.dx);
              for (let si = 0; si < 4; si++) {
                const sa = impactAngle2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.2;
                g.hitEffects.push({ x: peer.x, y: peer.y, life: 5, maxLife: 5, dx: Math.cos(sa) * 1.5, dy: Math.sin(sa) * 1.5 });
              }
              wsSend({ type: 'pvp_projectile', targetId: peer.id });
              sfxHit();
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        return !hitAny;
      });

      // ── Shockwaves: expand each frame, fade with life ──
      g.shockwaves = g.shockwaves.filter(s => {
        s.life--;
        s.r = s.maxR * (1 - s.life / s.maxLife);
        return s.life > 0;
      });

      // ── Embers: gravity + decay. Wind from fires drives slight x-drift. ──
      g.embers = g.embers.filter(e => {
        e.x += e.vx;
        e.y += e.vy;
        e.vy += 0.05;            // pulled down by gravity
        e.vx *= 0.97;            // air drag
        e.life--;
        return e.life > 0;
      });

      // ── Hard particle caps so heavy bombing can't spike render cost ──
      if (g.craters.length > 80) g.craters.splice(0, g.craters.length - 80);
      if (g.shockwaves.length > 24) g.shockwaves.splice(0, g.shockwaves.length - 24);
      if (g.embers.length > 240) g.embers.splice(0, g.embers.length - 240);

      // Bomb update — DETONATION is a weaponized event:
      // 1) loud sfxExplosion (intensity scales by radius),
      // 2) heavy camera shake,
      // 3) shockwave ring + crater + ember burst (landscape change),
      // 4) area damage AND knockback to threats,
      // 5) chance to ignite a nearby building (g.fires).
      g.bombs = g.bombs.filter(b => {
        b.timer--;
        if (b.timer <= 0) {
          // Intensity ~ 1.0 for typical r=120, scale up for grenade launchers
          const intensity = Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.5, b.radius / 120));
          sfxExplosion(intensity);
          // Camera shake — bigger than any single weapon shot
          g.shakeMag = Math.max(g.shakeMag, 6 + intensity * 4);
          g.shakeFrames = Math.max(g.shakeFrames, 22);
          // Shockwave ring (rendered above ground, below player)
          g.shockwaves.push({
            x: b.x, y: b.y, r: 4, maxR: b.radius * 1.3,
            life: 28, maxLife: 28, col: '255,180,80',
          });
          g.shockwaves.push({
            x: b.x, y: b.y, r: 2, maxR: b.radius * 0.8,
            life: 18, maxLife: 18, col: '255,240,200',
          });
          // Crater scorch mark (smaller than blast radius)
          g.craters.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y, r: b.radius * 0.45, bornFrame: g.frame });
          // Ember + spark burst
          const burstCount = Math.floor(18 + intensity * 22);
          for (let i = 0; i < burstCount; i++) {
            const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const sp = 1.5 + Math.random() * (4 + intensity * 3);
            const cols = ['255,200,80', '255,140,40', '255,90,40', '180,180,180'];
            g.embers.push({
              x: b.x, y: b.y,
              vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
              vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 1.5,        // slight upward bias
              life: 30 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25),
              maxLife: 55,
              col: cols[Math.floor(Math.random() * cols.length)],
              size: 1 + Math.random() * 2,
            });
          }
          // Police alert — explosions are very loud
          g.policeAlertTimer = Math.max(g.policeAlertTimer, 240);
          g.policeAlertX = b.x; g.policeAlertY = b.y;
          // Chance to set the nearest building on fire (changes the world)
          let nearestB: typeof BUILDINGS[number] | null = null;
          let nearestBd = Infinity;
          for (const bld of BUILDINGS) {
            const cx = bld.x + bld.w / 2, cy = bld.y + bld.h / 2;
            const d = Math.hypot(b.x - cx, b.y - cy);
            if (d < b.radius * 1.1 && d < nearestBd) { nearestBd = d; nearestB = bld; }
          }
          if (nearestB && Math.random() < 0.55 && !g.fires.find(f => f.bid === nearestB!.id)) {
            g.fires.push({
              bid: nearestB.id,
              x: nearestB.x + nearestB.w / 2,
              y: nearestB.y + nearestB.h / 2,
              startFrame: g.frame,
              intensity: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.4,
            });
          }
          // Knockback the player if caught in the blast
          {
            const dp = Math.hypot(b.x - g.px, b.y - g.py);
            if (dp < b.radius) {
              const ang = Math.atan2(g.py - b.y, g.px - b.x);
              const force = (1 - dp / b.radius) * 14;
              g.recoilDx = (g.recoilDx ?? 0) + Math.cos(ang) * force;
              g.recoilDy = (g.recoilDy ?? 0) + Math.sin(ang) * force;
            }
          }
          g.threats = g.threats.map(t => {
            const d = Math.hypot(b.x - t.x, b.y - t.y);
            // Safe streets: player blasts only affect animals; combatant threats
            // are inert unless lethal roaming combat is re-enabled.
            if (d < b.radius && (OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL || ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type))) {
