              // Knockback — push threats radially out from blast
              const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - b.y, t.x - b.x);
              const kb = (1 - d / b.radius) * 28;
              t.x += Math.cos(ang) * kb;
              t.y += Math.sin(ang) * kb;
              const nhp = t.hp - b.damage;
              if (nhp <= 0) {
                sfxKill();
                const cs = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
                const inWaste = !inCityBounds(g.px, g.py);
                const isAnimal = ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type);
                let bountyAmt = isAnimal ? 0 : (BOUNTY[t.type] ?? 10);
                if (!isAnimal && cs.wasteBonus && inWaste) bountyAmt = Math.floor(bountyAmt * 1.5);
                if (isAnimal) {
                  const drop = ANIMAL_DROPS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ANIMAL_DROPS.length)];
                  const ok = addStackToInventory(g.inventory, { id: drop.id, name: drop.name, desc: drop.desc, icon: drop.icon, stackable: true, qty: 1, value: drop.value });
                  setInventory([...g.inventory]);
                  g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: ok ? `+ ${drop.name}` : 'INV FULL', color: ok ? '#88cc44' : '#ff6644', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
                } else {
                  g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: `ƒ${bountyAmt.toLocaleString()} LOOT`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
                }
                const earned = THREAT_EXP[t.type] ?? 20;
                g.floaters.push({ x: t.x + 8, y: t.y - 10, text: `+${earned}XP`, color: '#44ffaa', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
                wsSend({ type: 'pve_kill', exp: earned });
                applyExpGain(g, earned, sfxLevelUp, setLevelUpText, setShowLevelUp, setNarr, setExp, setLevel, setHp);
                g.threatRespawn.push({ ox: t.ox, oy: t.oy, type: t.type, at: g.frame + 1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2400) });
                g.deadBodies.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, type: t.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: bountyAmt, looted: false });
                return null as unknown as Threat;
              }
              sfxHit(); return { ...t, hp: nhp };
            }
            return t;
          }).filter(Boolean) as Threat[];
          g.floaters.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y, text: '💥 BOOM', color: '#ffcc00', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      g.threatRespawn = g.threatRespawn.filter(r => {
        if (g.frame < r.at) return true;
        // Never let a corpse re-appear at its own spot. Spawn off-screen
        // from a random bearing relative to the player so arrivals feel
        // like the world is bringing reinforcements, not teleporting them
        // back. Randomize the type occasionally and spawn packs.
        const SPAWN_UPGRADES: Record<string, string[]> = {
          SCAVENGER: ['SCAVENGER', 'RAT', 'PROWLER'],
          RAT: ['RAT', 'STRAY_DOG', 'SCAVENGER'],
          STRAY_DOG: ['STRAY_DOG', 'PROWLER', 'SCAVENGER'],
          PROWLER: ['PROWLER', 'BORDER_GANG', 'MUTANT'],
          BORDER_GANG: ['BORDER_GANG', 'RAIDER', 'EASTERN_BLOC'],
          RAIDER: ['RAIDER', 'MUTANT', 'RUST_SYNDICATE'],
          MUTANT: ['MUTANT', 'RAIDER', 'VOID_RUNNERS'],
          RUST_SYNDICATE: ['RUST_SYNDICATE', 'VOID_RUNNERS', 'STATIC_MONKS'],
          VOID_RUNNERS: ['VOID_RUNNERS', 'RUST_SYNDICATE', 'STATIC_MONKS'],
          STATIC_MONKS: ['STATIC_MONKS', 'RUST_SYNDICATE', 'SPY'],
          EASTERN_BLOC: ['EASTERN_BLOC', 'SPY', 'PABLO_GUARD'],
          SPY: ['SPY', 'PABLO_GUARD', 'EASTERN_BLOC'],
          PABLO_GUARD: ['PABLO_GUARD', 'SPY'],
          VAGRANT: ['VAGRANT', 'SCAVENGER', 'RAT'],
          MINX_CITY: ['MINX_CITY', 'PABLO_GUARD'],
        };
        const variants = SPAWN_UPGRADES[r.type] ?? [r.type];
        const pickType = Math.random() < 0.55
          ? variants[0]
          : variants[Math.floor(Math.random() * variants.length)];

        // Spawn bearing: prefer "downwind" of the player (opposite of last
        // movement heading) so new threats close in from behind / ahead
        // instead of materialising on the exact spot of the kill.
        const baseAng = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const dist = 720 + Math.random() * 480;
        const sx = g.px + Math.cos(baseAng) * dist;
        const sy = g.py + Math.sin(baseAng) * dist;
        if (sx < 200 || sx > W - 200 || sy < 200 || sy > H - 200) return true;
        if (Math.hypot(g.px - sx, g.py - sy) < 500) return true;

        // Pack spawn: small chance several arrive together.
        const isPackType = ['STRAY_DOG','PROWLER','RAIDER','BORDER_GANG','VOID_RUNNERS'].includes(pickType);
        const packSize = isPackType && Math.random() < 0.3
          ? 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2)
          : 1;
        for (let pk = 0; pk < packSize; pk++) {
          const jitter = pk === 0 ? 0 : 40 + Math.random() * 60;
          const jAng = baseAng + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2;
          g.threats.push(mkThreat(
            sx + Math.cos(jAng) * jitter,
            sy + Math.sin(jAng) * jitter,
            pickType,
          ));
        }

        // Flavor: occasional narrative whisper when reinforcements close in.
        if (Math.random() < 0.22) {
          const FLAVOR: Record<string, string[]> = {
            SCAVENGER: ['> Something picks through the rubble downwind.', '> A carrion shape noses out of the ash.'],
            RAT: ['> Claws scratch over concrete. Close.', '> The gutter moves on its own.'],
            STRAY_DOG: ['> A pack howls from the alleys.', '> Dog breath on the wind. Wrong side of it.'],
            PROWLER: ['> A shadow detaches from a doorway.', '> Something is stalking the edge of the block.'],
            MUTANT: ['> Wet footsteps from the sewer grate.', '> The air tastes wrong. Something big is out there.'],
            RAIDER: ['> Engine noise, two blocks over. Getting louder.', '> Raider chatter crackles on a cheap radio.'],
            BORDER_GANG: ['> Border patrol off-books. They saw you.', '> Gang markings on the next wall are fresh.'],
            EASTERN_BLOC: ['> Eastern Bloc boots. No insignia. No good.', '> Foreign comms pulse on band seven.'],
            RUST_SYNDICATE: ['> RUST SYNDICATE is moving on this district.', '> Red bandanas. Count them. Then move.'],
            VOID_RUNNERS: ['> Void Runners just jumped in from nowhere.', '> The static thickens. They bring it with them.'],
            STATIC_MONKS: ['> Static Monks chant somewhere behind you.', '> The radio hum just turned into a prayer.'],
            SPY: ['> Someone is watching. Someone you cannot see.', '> Optics glint from a roofline.'],
            PABLO_GUARD: ['> PABLO CORP dispatch. You were flagged.', '> Corp drones cut a new orbit over this block.'],
            VAGRANT: ['> A shape in a trashbag coat turns toward you.', '> Mumbling from the next alley.'],
            MINX_CITY: ['> MINX CITY reinforcements inbound.', '> City patrol rerouting to your position.'],
          };
          const lines = FLAVOR[pickType];
          if (lines && lines.length) setNarr(lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)]);
          g.floaters.push({
            x: g.px + Math.cos(baseAng) * 120,
            y: g.py + Math.sin(baseAng) * 120 - 20,
            text: packSize > 1 ? '⚠ CONTACT — MULTIPLE' : '⚠ CONTACT',
            color: '#ff7744',
            life: 70,
            maxLife: 70,
          });
        }
        return false;
      });

      // Wasteland danger: spawn extra hostiles when deep in wasteland (varied locations)
      const nightSpawnActive = g.worldTime >= 19 || g.worldTime < 4;
      const threatCap = nightSpawnActive ? 90 : 60;
      const nightSpawnMult = nightSpawnActive ? 2.0 : 1.0;
      if (g.frame % 300 === 0) {
        const dangerLevel = getWastelandDangerLevel(g.px, g.py, char.class);
        if (dangerLevel > 0.3 && Math.random() < dangerLevel * 0.4 * nightSpawnMult && g.threats.length < threatCap) {
          const spawnDist = 350 + Math.random() * 300;
          const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const sx = g.px + Math.cos(angle) * spawnDist;
          const sy = g.py + Math.sin(angle) * spawnDist;
          const nearPlayer = Math.hypot(g.px - sx, g.py - sy) < 250;
          if (!nearPlayer) {
            const wasteThreatTypes = ['PROWLER', 'MUTANT', 'RAIDER', 'BORDER_GANG'];
            const tType = wasteThreatTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * wasteThreatTypes.length)];
            g.threats.push(mkThreat(sx, sy, tType));
          }
        }
      }

      // Gang raid: spawn temporary hostiles at raid location
      for (const raid of activeRaids) {
        if (raid.timer === RAID_DURATION - 1 && g.threats.length < threatCap) {
          const raidThreatCount = Math.floor(2 + raid.intensity * 3);
          for (let ri = 0; ri < raidThreatCount; ri++) {
            const rx = raid.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200;
            const ry = raid.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200;
            g.threats.push(mkThreat(rx, ry, raid.attackerFaction.toUpperCase()));
          }
        }
      }

      // Poison tick — lasts 10 seconds (600 frames), 0.5 HP per tick
      if (g.poisoned) {
        g.poisonTick++;
        if (g.poisonTick >= 600) { g.poisoned = false; g.poisonTick = 0; setPoisoned(false); }
        if (g.poisonTick % 60 === 0 && !gamePausedRef.current && !frozenRef.current) { g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 0.5); g.deathReason = 'Died from poison'; setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); }
      }

      // ── POISON GAS EXPOSURE — the land is drowned in toxic fog ──
      // Kept fully independent of the combat/mutant `poisoned` status so it
      // never cures or extends other poison sources. The fog overlay is the
      // visual cue; damage is driven by gasExposureTick alone.
      if (!g.interior && g.worldLayer === 'surface' && !g.subwayTransit && !frozenRef.current) {
        // Once the story is active the home base is permanently relocated to
        // the underground camp — its coords become the gas-safe center instead
        // of the old hamlet building.
        let _gHomeCx: number | null;
        let _gHomeCy: number | null;
        if (g.story?.active && g.story.homeBase) {
          _gHomeCx = g.story.homeBase.x;
          _gHomeCy = g.story.homeBase.y;
        } else {
          const _gHb = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === g.hamletBuildingId);
          _gHomeCx = _gHb ? _gHb.x + _gHb.w / 2 : null;
          _gHomeCy = _gHb ? _gHb.y + _gHb.h / 2 : null;
        }
        const gasSafe = gasSafeZone(g.px, g.py, _gHomeCx, _gHomeCy);
        const gasProtected = g.ownedItems?.has?.('gasmask') === true;
        // Subway arrival grace — surfacing from the deep line is safe for a
        // short window so DEEP LINE stops can open into the poison.
        const subwayGraceActive = g.subwayGrace > 0;
        if (subwayGraceActive && !gamePausedRef.current) g.subwayGrace--;
        if (!gasSafe && !gasProtected && !subwayGraceActive) {
          g.gasPoison = true;
          g.gasExposureTick++;
          // The poison fog is LETHAL. Unprotected exposure kills in ~15 seconds
          // from full health (drains maxHp / 15 per second). Get a GASMASK, take
          // a hazmat escort, or get back inside the safe zone before it finishes
          // you. dt-scaled so the per-second rate is the same on any refresh rate.
          if (!gamePausedRef.current) {
            const _hpBefore = Math.floor(g.hp);
            g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - (g.maxHp / 15 / 60) * dtFactor);
            g.deathReason = 'Killed by the poison gas';
            if (Math.floor(g.hp) !== _hpBefore) setHp(Math.floor(g.hp));
          }
          if (g.gasExposureTick === 75 && g.escortOfferCd <= 0) { setEscortPrompt(true); }
        } else {
          g.gasPoison = false;
          g.gasExposureTick = 0;
        }
        if (g.escortOfferCd > 0) g.escortOfferCd--;
      }

      // ── Interior fade transition ──
      if (g.interiorFadeDir !== 0) {
        g.interiorFade += g.interiorFadeDir * 0.04;
        if (g.interiorFade >= 1 && g.interiorFadeDir === 1) {
          g.interiorFade = 1;
          if (g.interiorFadeCallback) { g.interiorFadeCallback(); g.interiorFadeCallback = null; }
        }
        if (g.interiorFade <= 0 && g.interiorFadeDir === -1) {
          g.interiorFade = 0; g.interiorFadeDir = 0;
        }
      }

      // ── Interior movement & collision ──
      if (g.interior && !frozen()) {
        const itr = g.interior;
        const iDef = itr.def;
        if (interiorMoveDefRef.current !== iDef) { interiorMoveDefRef.current = iDef; g.interiorMoveTarget = null; }
        const WALKTHROUGH_TYPES = new Set(['window', 'plant', 'chair', 'couch']);
        const iCol = (ipx: number, ipy: number) => {
          if (ipx < PSIZE + 6 || ipx > iDef.width - PSIZE - 6 || ipy < PSIZE + 20 || ipy > iDef.height - PSIZE) return true;
          for (const obj of iDef.objects) {
            if (WALKTHROUGH_TYPES.has(obj.type)) continue;
            if (ipx + PSIZE > obj.x && ipx - PSIZE < obj.x + obj.w && ipy + PSIZE > obj.y && ipy - PSIZE < obj.y + obj.h) return true;
          }
          return false;
        };
        if (iCol(itr.px, itr.py)) {
          const tryDirs: [number,number][] = [[0,-8],[0,8],[-8,0],[8,0],[-8,-8],[8,-8],[-8,8],[8,8]];
          for (let r = 8; r <= 200; r += 8) {
            let escaped = false;
            for (const [dox, doy] of tryDirs) {
              const sc = r / 8;
              if (!iCol(itr.px + dox * sc, itr.py + doy * sc)) { itr.px += dox * sc; itr.py += doy * sc; escaped = true; break; }
            }
            if (escaped) break;
          }
        }
        if (movementSpaceRef.current !== 'interior') {
          movementSpaceRef.current = 'interior';
          g.moveVx = 0;
          g.moveVy = 0;
        }
        const touchInput = touchMoveRef.current;
        const gamepadInput = gamepadState.movementRef.current;
        const keyboardInput = keyboardMovementVector(g.keys);
        let input = Math.hypot(touchInput.x, touchInput.y) > 0.001
          ? touchInput
          : Math.hypot(gamepadInput.x, gamepadInput.y) > 0.001
            ? gamepadInput
            : keyboardInput;
        if (Math.hypot(input.x, input.y) > 0.001) g.interiorMoveTarget = null;
        // Tap-to-move (mobile + click): walk toward the interior move target.
        if (Math.hypot(input.x, input.y) <= 0.001 && g.interiorMoveTarget) {
          const mtdx = g.interiorMoveTarget.x - itr.px;
          const mtdy = g.interiorMoveTarget.y - itr.py;
          const mtDist = Math.hypot(mtdx, mtdy);
          if (mtDist < 8) { g.interiorMoveTarget = null; }
          else input = normalizeMovementVector(mtdx, mtdy);
        }
        const _iCreep = g.keys.has('control');
        const targetSpeed = SPD * (_iCreep ? 0.5 : 1);
        const velocity = approachMovementVelocity(
          { x: g.moveVx, y: g.moveVy },
          { x: input.x * targetSpeed, y: input.y * targetSpeed },
          dtFactor,
        );
        g.moveVx = velocity.x;
        g.moveVy = velocity.y;
        const dx = velocity.x * dtFactor;
        const dy = velocity.y * dtFactor;
        const moved = moveWithCollision({ x: itr.px, y: itr.py }, { x: dx, y: dy }, iCol);
        const travelX = moved.x - itr.px;
        const travelY = moved.y - itr.py;
        const iBlocked = Math.hypot(travelX, travelY) < 0.001 && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0.001;
        if (Math.abs(travelX) < 0.001 && Math.abs(dx) > 0.001) g.moveVx = 0;
        if (Math.abs(travelY) < 0.001 && Math.abs(dy) > 0.001) g.moveVy = 0;
        itr.px = moved.x;
        itr.py = moved.y;
        if (g.interiorMoveTarget && iBlocked) g.interiorMoveTarget = null;
        // Pets follow the player around inside interiors (interior-space coords).
        for (const pet of [g.dogCompanion, g.catCompanion]) {
          if (!pet.active || pet.injured) continue;
          const pd = Math.hypot(itr.px - pet.ix, itr.py - pet.iy);
          if (pd > 20) {
            const pa = Math.atan2(itr.py - pet.iy, itr.px - pet.ix);
            const psp = pd > 140 ? 3.2 : 1.5;
            let pnx = pet.ix + Math.cos(pa) * psp;
            let pny = pet.iy + Math.sin(pa) * psp;
            if (iCol(pnx, pet.iy)) pnx = pet.ix;
            if (iCol(pet.ix, pny)) pny = pet.iy;
            pet.ix = pnx; pet.iy = pny;
          }
          if (pd > 360) { pet.ix = itr.px - 14; pet.iy = itr.py + 12; }
        }
        const interiorTravel = Math.hypot(travelX, travelY);
        if (interiorTravel > 0.001) {
          stepFrame.current++;
          g.walkDistance += interiorTravel;
          g.walkFrame = Math.floor(g.walkDistance / SPD) % 28;
          if (stepFrame.current % (_iCreep ? 22 : 14) === 0) sfxStep(_iCreep ? 0.4 : 1, _iCreep ? 150 : 200);
          const moveFacing = Math.atan2(travelY, travelX);
          g.facingAngle = approachAngle(g.facingAngle, moveFacing, 0.32 * dtFactor);
          const fa = g.facingAngle;
          if (Math.abs(Math.cos(fa)) > Math.abs(Math.sin(fa))) g.facing = Math.cos(fa) > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
          else g.facing = Math.sin(fa) > 0 ? 'down' : 'up';
        } else { g.walkFrame = 0; }
        const inExitZone = itr.px + PSIZE > iDef.exitX && itr.px - PSIZE < iDef.exitX + iDef.exitW
          && itr.py + PSIZE > iDef.exitY && itr.py - PSIZE < iDef.exitY + iDef.exitH;
        if (inExitZone && g.interiorFadeDir === 0) {
          g.near = '__interior_exit';
          setNearArcadeMachine(null);
          g.nearInteriorObj = null;
        } else {
          g.near = null;
          let foundArcade: string | null = null;
          let foundWC = false;
          let closestObj: InteriorObject | null = null;
          let closestEdgeDist = 40;
          const edgeDist = (px2: number, py2: number, obj2: InteriorObject) => {
            const cx = Math.max(obj2.x, Math.min(px2, obj2.x + obj2.w));
            const cy = Math.max(obj2.y, Math.min(py2, obj2.y + obj2.h));
            return Math.hypot(px2 - cx, py2 - cy);
          };
          for (const obj of iDef.objects) {
            if (obj.type === 'arcade_machine' && obj.gameId) {
              const ocx = obj.x + obj.w / 2, ocy = obj.y + obj.h / 2;
              if (Math.hypot(itr.px - ocx, itr.py - ocy) < 35) {
                foundArcade = obj.gameId;
              }
            }
            if (obj.type === 'water_cooler') {
              const ocx = obj.x + obj.w / 2, ocy = obj.y + obj.h / 2;
              if (Math.hypot(itr.px - ocx, itr.py - ocy) < 30) foundWC = true;
            }
            {
              const d = edgeDist(itr.px, itr.py, obj);
              if (d < closestEdgeDist) { closestEdgeDist = d; closestObj = obj; }
            }
          }
          setNearArcadeMachine(foundArcade);
          setNearWaterCooler(foundWC);
          g.nearInteriorObj = closestObj;
        }

        if (iDef.workers) {
          for (const w of iDef.workers) {
            const wd = Math.hypot(itr.px - w.x, itr.py - w.y);
            if (w.hostile) {
              if (wd < 25 && g.frame % 120 === 0) {
                const warnings = [
                  `"Get out of my place before I call someone."`,
                  `"You don't belong here. Leave. Now."`,
                  `"I'm giving you five seconds."`,
                  `"Touch anything and you're dead."`,
                ];
                setNarr(`> ${w.name} — ${warnings[Math.floor(g.frame / 120) % warnings.length]}`);
              }
              if (wd < 15 && g.frame % 60 === 0) {
                g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 5);
                setNarr(`> ${w.name} shoves you! -5 HP. Get out!`);
              }
            } else {
              if (wd < 30 && g.keys.has('e') && w.dialogue) {
                g.keys.delete('e');
                setNarr(`> ${w.name} — "${w.dialogue}"`);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const __colCity = getActiveCityDef();
      // ── Dynamic solid obstacles: vehicles + hard stationary props ─────────
      // Rebuilt once per frame and proximity-culled to the player so the
      // per-frame col() check (called many times by movement + the stuck
      // escape) stays cheap even though traffic is constantly moving. Each
      // entry is an axis-aligned half-extent box {x,y,hx,hy} in world space.
      const SOLID_CULL = 260; // only obstacles within this radius matter
      const solidObstacles: { x: number; y: number; hx: number; hy: number }[] = [];
      if (!g.interior) {
        const nearPlayer = (sx: number, sy: number) =>
          Math.abs(sx - g.px) < SOLID_CULL && Math.abs(sy - g.py) < SOLID_CULL;
        // Parked street vehicles (skip stolen — they've been driven off).
        for (const pv of g.parkedVehicles) {
          if (pv.stolen || !nearPlayer(pv.x, pv.y)) continue;
          const vd = getVehicleDef(pv.type);
          solidObstacles.push({ x: pv.x, y: pv.y, hx: vd.bodyW / 2, hy: vd.bodyH / 2 });
        }
        // Player-dropped (exited) vehicles parked in the world.
        for (const ev of g.exitedVehicles) {
          if (!nearPlayer(ev.x, ev.y)) continue;
          const vd = getVehicleDef(ev.type);
          solidObstacles.push({ x: ev.x, y: ev.y, hx: vd.bodyW / 2, hy: vd.bodyH / 2 });
        }
        // Moving traffic — footprint orients with travel direction.
        for (const tv of g.trafficVehicles) {
          if (!nearPlayer(tv.x, tv.y)) continue;
          const vd = getVehicleDef(tv.type);
          const vert = Math.abs(tv.dy) > Math.abs(tv.dx);
          solidObstacles.push({
            x: tv.x, y: tv.y,
            hx: vert ? vd.bodyH / 2 : vd.bodyW / 2,
            hy: vert ? vd.bodyW / 2 : vd.bodyH / 2,
          });
        }
        // Hard stationary props (strut boards / pole banners). Flat wall decals
        // (display/flyer) and steam vents have no footprint and stay pass-through.
        for (const ds of DYSTOPIAN_SIGNS) {
          if (!SOLID_SIGN_KINDS.has(ds.kind) || !nearPlayer(ds.x, ds.y)) continue;
          const hy = ds.kind === 'banner' ? 8 : (12 + ds.lines.length * 9) / 2;
          solidObstacles.push({ x: ds.x, y: ds.y, hx: ds.w / 2, hy });
        }
      }
      const col = (px: number, py: number) => {
        if (g.worldLayer === 'underground') {
          if (!isUndergroundPoint(px, py)) return true;
          return UNDERGROUND_SOLIDS.some(s =>
            px + PSIZE > s.x && px - PSIZE < s.x + s.w
            && py + PSIZE > s.y && py - PSIZE < s.y + s.h,
          );
        }
        // Walled cities (e.g. Huda) confine the player inside the enclave.
        if (__colCity.walls && hitsCityWall(__colCity, px, py, PSIZE)) return true;
        // Vehicles + hard props (the player's own active vehicle is g.vehicle
        // and never appears in these lists, so driving never self-collides).
        for (const s of solidObstacles) {
          if (px + PSIZE > s.x - s.hx && px - PSIZE < s.x + s.hx &&
              py + PSIZE > s.y - s.hy && py - PSIZE < s.y + s.hy) return true;
        }
        return BUILDINGS.some(b => {
          if (!(px + PSIZE > b.x && px - PSIZE < b.x + b.w && py + PSIZE > b.y && py - PSIZE < b.y + b.h)) return false;
          if (b.doors && b.doors.length > 0) {
            for (const d of b.doors) {
              if (px + PSIZE > d.x && px - PSIZE < d.x + d.w && py + PSIZE > d.y && py - PSIZE < d.y + d.h) return false;
            }
          }
          return true;
        });
      };

      if (!g.interior) {

      if (col(g.px, g.py)) {
        for (let r = 8; r <= 200; r += 8) {
          let escaped = false;
          for (const [ox, oy] of [[0,r],[0,-r],[r,0],[-r,0],[r,r],[-r,r],[r,-r],[-r,-r]]) {
            if (!col(g.px + ox, g.py + oy)) { g.px += ox; g.py += oy; escaped = true; break; }
          }
          if (escaped) break;
        }
      }

      if (isTouchDevice && !g.interior && !g.subwayTransit) {
        const spawnBid = g.hamletBuildingId;
        const spawnB = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === spawnBid) ?? BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'minx_arms')!;
        g.px = spawnB.x + spawnB.w / 2;
        g.py = spawnB.y + spawnB.h + 20;
        enterInterior(spawnBid);
      }

      if (!frozen() && !g.subwayTransit && !gamePausedRef.current) {
        if (movementSpaceRef.current !== 'world') {
          movementSpaceRef.current = 'world';
          g.moveVx = 0;
          g.moveVy = 0;
        }
        const shiftHeld = g.keys.has('shift') || mobileSprintActiveRef.current;
        const creepHeld = g.keys.has('control') && !shiftHeld;
        const sprintMult = creepHeld ? 0.45 : shiftHeld ? 1.6 : 1;
        const onRoad = isOnRoad(g.px, g.py);
        // PABLO POWER & GAS — a gas vehicle with an empty tank can't drive: the
        // engine is dead, so it moves at walking speed (no vehicle multiplier)
        // until refueled at a pump. Electric/manual vehicles are unaffected.
        const gasOut = !!g.vehicle && vehicleNeedsGas(g.vehicle) && (g.vehicleGas[g.vehicle] ?? 0) <= 0;
        const baseVehicleSpeed = (g.vehicle && !gasOut) ? (VEHICLE_SPEED[g.vehicle] ?? 1) : 1;
        // Off-road penalty: vehicles crawl at near-walking speed off-road
        const offRoadPenalty = (g.vehicle && !gasOut && !onRoad && inCityBounds(g.px, g.py)) ? 0.18 : 1;
        const vMult = ((g.vehicle && !gasOut) ? (onRoad ? baseVehicleSpeed : baseVehicleSpeed * offRoadPenalty) : 1) * (g.ownedItems.has('speed_boost') ? 1.1 : 1) * sprintMult;
        // Show warning when driving off-road in the city
        if (g.vehicle && !gasOut && !onRoad && inCityBounds(g.px, g.py) && g.frame % 150 === 0) {
          setNarr(`> OFF-ROAD — Terrain is rough. ${g.vehicle.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()} crawling at low speed. Return to a road.`);
        }
        // Out-of-gas nag — periodic reminder to refuel at a pump.
        if (gasOut && g.frame % 150 === 0) {
          setNarr(`> OUT OF GAS — ${g.vehicle!.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()} tank is empty. Refuel at a GAS PUMP. (Engine dead — walking pace.)`);
        }
        const touchInput = touchMoveRef.current;
        const gamepadInput = gamepadState.movementRef.current;
        const keyboardInput = keyboardMovementVector(g.keys);
        let input = Math.hypot(touchInput.x, touchInput.y) > 0.001
          ? touchInput
          : Math.hypot(gamepadInput.x, gamepadInput.y) > 0.001
            ? gamepadInput
            : keyboardInput;
        if (Math.hypot(input.x, input.y) > 0.001) g.moveTarget = null;
        if (Math.hypot(input.x, input.y) <= 0.001 && g.moveTarget) {
          const mtDist = Math.hypot(g.moveTarget.x - g.px, g.moveTarget.y - g.py);
          if (mtDist < 8) { g.moveTarget = null; }
          else input = normalizeMovementVector(g.moveTarget.x - g.px, g.moveTarget.y - g.py);
        }
        const velocity = approachMovementVelocity(
          { x: g.moveVx, y: g.moveVy },
          { x: input.x * SPD * vMult, y: input.y * SPD * vMult },
          dtFactor,
        );
        g.moveVx = velocity.x;
        g.moveVy = velocity.y;
        let dx = velocity.x * dtFactor;
        let dy = velocity.y * dtFactor;
        // PABLO POWER & GAS — burn gas as a gas vehicle actually travels. The
        // tank drains with distance; once empty the engine dies (handled above
        // via gasOut next frame).
        if (g.vehicle && !gasOut && vehicleNeedsGas(g.vehicle) && (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0)) {
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          const cur = g.vehicleGas[g.vehicle] ?? 0;
          const next = Math.max(0, cur - dist * GAS_BURN_PER_PX);
          g.vehicleGas[g.vehicle] = next;
          if (next <= 0 && cur > 0) {
            sfxError?.();
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 18, text: 'OUT OF GAS', color: '#ff4444', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
            setNarr(`> OUT OF GAS — ${g.vehicle.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()} sputters to a halt. Refuel at a GAS PUMP.`);
          } else if (next > 0 && next <= vehicleGasCap(g.vehicle) * 0.2 && g.frame % 240 === 0) {
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 18, text: 'LOW FUEL', color: '#ffaa33', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
          }
        }
        // Swing lunge — additive push toward the swing target for a few
        // frames after a melee attack. Decays each frame.
        if (g.swingLungeFrames > 0) {
          const t01 = g.swingLungeFrames / 7;
          dx += g.swingLungeVx * t01;
          dy += g.swingLungeVy * t01;
          g.swingLungeFrames--;
        }
        const swept = moveWithCollision({ x: g.px, y: g.py }, { x: dx, y: dy }, col);
        let nx = swept.x, ny = swept.y;
        if (Math.abs(nx - g.px) < 0.001 && Math.abs(dx) > 0.001) g.moveVx = 0;
        if (Math.abs(ny - g.py) < 0.001 && Math.abs(dy) > 0.001) g.moveVy = 0;
        // ── Checkpoint: passport + entry cost system ──
        const crossingSouth = ny > CITY_BOTTOM && g.py <= CITY_BOTTOM;
        const crossingNorth = ny < CITY_TOP && g.py >= CITY_TOP;
        const crossingBorder = crossingSouth || crossingNorth;
        if (crossingBorder) {
          const hasPassport = !!g.passport;
          const CHECKPOINT_FEE = 2000;
          if (!hasPassport) {
            if (crossingSouth) ny = CITY_BOTTOM - PSIZE - 1;
            else ny = CITY_TOP + PSIZE + 1;
            if (g.frame % 120 === 0) setNarr('> CHECKPOINT — You cannot cross without a PASSPORT. Obtain one at PABLO CORP NORTH or the PRINT SHOP. [ƒ12,000 FIAT]');
          } else if (g.passport === 'full_city') {
            // Corporate full passport — free crossing
          } else if (g.salary >= CHECKPOINT_FEE) {
            // Hold at the gate until the authoritative debit succeeds.
            ny = crossingSouth ? CITY_BOTTOM - PSIZE - 1 : CITY_TOP + PSIZE + 1;
            void performGameplayFiatAction('checkpoint_fee', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:checkpoint:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`).then(paid => {
              if (!paid || paid.duplicate) return;
              g.py = crossingSouth ? CITY_BOTTOM + PSIZE + 2 : CITY_TOP - PSIZE - 2;
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `-ƒ${CHECKPOINT_FEE.toLocaleString()} CROSSING FEE`, color: '#ff6644', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
              setNarr(`> CHECKPOINT — Guard scans your passport. "ƒ${CHECKPOINT_FEE.toLocaleString()} crossing fee deducted. Move along." [−ƒ${CHECKPOINT_FEE.toLocaleString()} FIAT]`);
            });
          } else {
            if (crossingSouth) ny = CITY_BOTTOM - PSIZE - 1;
            else ny = CITY_TOP + PSIZE + 1;
            if (g.frame % 120 === 0) setNarr(`> CHECKPOINT — "Passport valid but crossing fee is ƒ${CHECKPOINT_FEE.toLocaleString()} FIAT. Current balance insufficient. Come back with funds."`);
          }
        }
        // ── Natural border: terrain-based passability ─────────────────────────
        // Ocean shores: gradual slow-down in surf zone, hard stop at deep water
        const BEACH_ZONE = BORDER + 80;   // surf / shallow water — wading slows player
        const DEEP_WATER  = BORDER + PSIZE; // impassable deep ocean
        // Mountain cliffs: foothills slow the player, cliff face is impassable
        const FOOTHILL_ZONE = BORDER + 120; // rocky terrain, movement penalised by caller
        const CLIFF_HARD    = BORDER + PSIZE;

        // West coast — sandy surf zone before deep water
        if (nx < BEACH_ZONE) {
          // scale back towards shore: deeper = more resistance
          const depth = BEACH_ZONE - nx;
          if (nx < DEEP_WATER) {
            nx = DEEP_WATER;
            if (g.frame % 150 === 0) setNarr('> WESTERN OCEAN — The current drags hard. Deep water — you cannot swim across.');
          } else {
            // surf drag: push player shoreward proportionally to depth
            nx += depth * 0.08;
            if (g.frame % 180 === 0) setNarr('> WESTERN SHORE — Waves crash around your feet. The ocean is impassable.');
          }
        }
        // East coast
        if (nx > W - BEACH_ZONE) {
          const depth = nx - (W - BEACH_ZONE);
          if (nx > W - DEEP_WATER) {
            nx = W - DEEP_WATER;
            if (g.frame % 150 === 0) setNarr('> EASTERN OCEAN — The cliffs drop straight to open sea. You are turned back.');
          } else {
            nx -= depth * 0.08;
            if (g.frame % 180 === 0) setNarr('> EASTERN SHORE — Surf pounds the rocks. The ocean is impassable.');
          }
        }
        // North mountains — foothills then sheer cliff
        if (ny < FOOTHILL_ZONE) {
          const slope = FOOTHILL_ZONE - ny;
          if (ny < CLIFF_HARD) {
            ny = CLIFF_HARD;
            if (g.frame % 150 === 0) setNarr('> NORTHERN RANGE — Sheer cliff face. The wind cuts like a blade. No passage.');
          } else {
            ny += slope * 0.1;
            if (g.frame % 180 === 0) setNarr('> NORTHERN FOOTHILLS — The slope steepens. The mountain range is impassable.');
          }
        }
        // South mountains
        if (ny > H - FOOTHILL_ZONE) {
          const slope = ny - (H - FOOTHILL_ZONE);
          if (ny > H - CLIFF_HARD) {
            ny = H - CLIFF_HARD;
            if (g.frame % 150 === 0) setNarr('> SOUTHERN MOUNTAINS — Sheer rock. No trail leads through these peaks.');
          } else {
            ny -= slope * 0.1;
            if (g.frame % 180 === 0) setNarr('> SOUTHERN FOOTHILLS — The ground rises sharply. The mountains are impassable.');
          }
        }
        // ── River collision — bezier-based, slowed unless near a bridge ────
        const COLLISION_RIVERS = [
          { sx: 3200, sy: BORDER + 80,      ex: BORDER + 60,      ey: 5000,
            cp1x: 3600, cp1y: 1400, cp2x: 600,  cp2y: 3200 },
          { sx: 8500, sy: BORDER + 100,     ex: W - BORDER - 80,  ey: 4200,
            cp1x: 7800, cp1y: 1200, cp2x: 12200, cp2y: 2400 },
          { sx: 5800, sy: H - BORDER - 90,  ex: BORDER + 80,      ey: 8800,
            cp1x: 4200, cp1y: 11200, cp2x: 1800, cp2y: 9200 },
          { sx: 9200, sy: H - BORDER - 110, ex: W - BORDER - 70,  ey: 9400,
            cp1x: 10800, cp1y: 11800, cp2x: 12000, cp2y: 9800 },
        ];
        const RIVER_BRIDGES = [
          { wx: 2369, wy: 1800 }, { wx: 2000, wy: 2329 },
          { wx: 11000, wy: 2347 }, { wx: 12257, wy: 3200 },
          { wx: 3742, wy: 10500 }, { wx: 2000, wy: 9737 },
          { wx: 11802, wy: 10500 }, { wx: 11000, wy: 10920 },
        ];
        const RIVER_HALF = 22;
        const BRIDGE_RADIUS = 55;
        const bezPt = (t: number, p0: number, p1: number, p2: number, p3: number) => {
          const mt = 1-t, mt2 = mt*mt, mt3 = mt2*mt;
          return mt3*p0 + 3*mt2*t*p1 + 3*mt*t*t*p2 + t*t*t*p3;
        };
        const RIVER_SEG_COUNT = 200;
        const riverPolylines = COLLISION_RIVERS.map(rv => {
          const pts: { x: number; y: number }[] = [];
          for (let i = 0; i <= RIVER_SEG_COUNT; i++) {
            const t = i / RIVER_SEG_COUNT;
            pts.push({ x: bezPt(t, rv.sx, rv.cp1x, rv.cp2x, rv.ex), y: bezPt(t, rv.sy, rv.cp1y, rv.cp2y, rv.ey) });
          }
          return pts;
        });
        const pointNearPolyline = (px: number, py: number, pts: { x: number; y: number }[], halfW: number) => {
          for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
            const ax = pts[i].x, ay = pts[i].y, bx2 = pts[i+1].x, by2 = pts[i+1].y;
            if (Math.abs(px - ax) > halfW * 3 && Math.abs(px - bx2) > halfW * 3) continue;
            if (Math.abs(py - ay) > halfW * 3 && Math.abs(py - by2) > halfW * 3) continue;
            const dx = bx2 - ax, dy = by2 - ay;
            const lenSq = dx*dx + dy*dy;
            const t = lenSq === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - ax)*dx + (py - ay)*dy) / lenSq));
            const dist = Math.hypot(px - (ax + t*dx), py - (ay + t*dy));
            if (dist < halfW) return true;
          }
          return false;
        };
        const nearBridge = (px: number, py: number) =>
          RIVER_BRIDGES.some(b => Math.hypot(px - b.wx, py - b.wy) < BRIDGE_RADIUS);
        const inRiver = (px: number, py: number) =>
          !nearBridge(px, py) && riverPolylines.some(pts => pointNearPolyline(px, py, pts, RIVER_HALF));
        const wasInRiver = inRiver(g.px, g.py);
        const nowInRiver = inRiver(nx, ny);
        if (nowInRiver) {
          const riverSlow = 0.35;
          nx = g.px + (nx - g.px) * riverSlow;
          ny = g.py + (ny - g.py) * riverSlow;
          if (!wasInRiver) {
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 15, text: 'WADING', color: '#66aaff', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
            setNarr('> RIVER — You wade into the current. Movement slowed. Bridges are faster.');
          } else if (g.frame % 300 === 0) {
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 12, text: '~', color: 'rgba(100,180,255,.5)', life: 30, maxLife: 30 });
          }
          (g as any).inWater = true;
        } else {
          if (wasInRiver) {
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 15, text: 'DRY LAND', color: '#88cc44', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
          }
          (g as any).inWater = false;
        }
        const travelX = nx - g.px;
        const travelY = ny - g.py;
        const travelDistance = Math.hypot(travelX, travelY);
        g.px = nx;
        g.py = ny;
        if (travelDistance > 0.001) {
          g.playerIdleTicks = 0;
          stepFrame.current++;
          g.walkDistance += travelDistance;
          g.walkFrame = Math.floor(g.walkDistance / SPD) % 28;
          const _cad = creepHeld ? 22 : shiftHeld ? 9 : 14;
          if (stepFrame.current % _cad === 0) sfxStep(creepHeld ? 0.4 : shiftHeld ? 1.3 : 1, creepHeld ? 150 : shiftHeld ? 230 : 200);
          const moveFacing = Math.atan2(travelY, travelX);
          const hasWeapon = activeWeaponRef.current && activeWeaponRef.current !== 'FISTS';
          g.facingAngle = hasWeapon ? g.aimAngle : approachAngle(g.facingAngle, moveFacing, 0.32 * dtFactor);
          if (g.vehicle) {
            if (Math.abs(travelX) > Math.abs(travelY)) { g.facing = travelX > 0 ? 'right' : 'left'; } else { g.facing = travelY > 0 ? 'down' : 'up'; }
          } else {
            const fa = g.facingAngle;
            if (Math.abs(Math.cos(fa)) > Math.abs(Math.sin(fa))) { g.facing = Math.cos(fa) > 0 ? 'right' : 'left'; } else { g.facing = Math.sin(fa) > 0 ? 'down' : 'up'; }
          }
        } else {
          g.walkFrame = 0;
          g.idleFrame = (g.idleFrame + 1) % 120;
          g.playerIdleTicks++;
          const hasWeapon = activeWeaponRef.current && activeWeaponRef.current !== 'FISTS';
          if (hasWeapon) {
            g.facingAngle = g.aimAngle;
            const fa = g.facingAngle;
            if (Math.abs(Math.cos(fa)) > Math.abs(Math.sin(fa))) { g.facing = Math.cos(fa) > 0 ? 'right' : 'left'; } else { g.facing = Math.sin(fa) > 0 ? 'down' : 'up'; }
          }
        }
      }
      } // end !g.interior

      for (const t of g.threats) {
        t.timer--;
        // Tick down hit feedback & stagger. Staggered enemies skip AI/move
        // this frame — reads as "reeling from a hit" instead of marching
        // through swings.
        if (t.hitFlash && t.hitFlash > 0) t.hitFlash--;
        if (t.staggerFrames && t.staggerFrames > 0) {
          t.staggerFrames--;
          t.dx = 0; t.dy = 0;
          continue;
        }
        // Streets are safe: clear any threat left in a HOSTILE/windup state so it
        // returns to ambient roaming instead of freezing in an attack pose.
        if (!OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && t.behavior === 'HOSTILE') {
          t.behavior = 'PATROLLING'; t.behaviorTimer = 200; t.windup = 0;
        }
        const dist = g.interior ? 99999 : Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
        // ── Windup gate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // If the enemy has already committed to a strike, it must stand its
        // ground and resolve. Handled BEFORE movement/chase logic so the
        // enemy doesn't glide forward one frame between telegraph and
        // impact.
        if ((t.windup ?? 0) > 0) {
          t.dx = 0; t.dy = 0;
          if (!g.interior && !gamePausedRef.current) t.windup = (t.windup ?? 0) - 1;
          if ((t.windup ?? 0) === 0) {
            const canLand = OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && dist < 24 && g.invincible === 0 && !npcDialogRef.current && !gamePausedRef.current;
            if (canLand) {
              const armorMult = g.ownedItems.has('armor_plate') ? 0.85 : 1;
              const baseThreatAtk = THREAT_ATK[t.type] ?? 3;
              const cs = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
              const defReduce = Math.max(0.15, 1 - cs.defBonus * 0.015);
              const nightActiveLocal = g.worldTime >= 19 || g.worldTime < 4;
              const nightMult = nightActiveLocal ? 1.4 : 1.0;
              const dmg = baseThreatAtk * armorMult * defReduce * nightMult * gearDefenseMultiplier(g.gearStats);
              g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - dmg); g.invincible = 25; g.flash = 6;
              g.deathReason = `Killed by ${t.type.replace(/_/g, ' ')} in combat`;
              g.lastDamageFrame = g.frame; g.combatRegenCooldown = 300;
              t.attackCd = 30;
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 12, text: `−${Math.floor(dmg)}`, color: '#ff4444', life: 35, maxLife: 35 });
              g.shakeMag = Math.max(g.shakeMag, 3);
              g.shakeFrames = Math.max(g.shakeFrames, 6);
              if (!g.poisoned && (t.type === 'MUTANT' || t.type === 'STATIC_MONKS') && Math.random() < 0.12) {
                g.poisoned = true; g.poisonTick = 0;
                sfxPoison(); setPoisoned(true); setNarr('> POISONED — HP drains slowly. Find the SAVE POINT or an antidote.');
              }
              if (g.hasDevice && !g.deviceBroken && Math.random() < 0.03) {
                g.deviceDurability = Math.max(0, g.deviceDurability - 35);
                if (g.deviceDurability <= 0) {
                  g.deviceBroken = true; setDeviceBroken(true);
                  setNarr('> DEVICE DAMAGED — Your personal terminal took a hit. Screen cracked. Find a PUBLIC TERMINAL or repair at CITY CLINIC (ƒ5,000).');
                }
              }
            } else {
              t.attackCd = 18;
              g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 14, text: 'MISS', color: '#aaaaaa', life: 22, maxLife: 22 });
            }
            t.windupMax = 0;
          }
          continue;
        }

        const isMajorThreat = ['RUST_SYNDICATE','VOID_RUNNERS','STATIC_MONKS','EASTERN_BLOC','MUTANT','RAIDER','BORDER_GANG'].includes(t.type);
        const isSpy = t.type === 'SPY';
        const CITY_WALL_NORTH = CITY_TOP + 40;
        const CITY_WALL_SOUTH = CITY_BOTTOM - 40;
        const inCity = t.y > CITY_WALL_NORTH && t.y < CITY_WALL_SOUTH;
        if (isMajorThreat && inCity && t.behavior !== 'HOSTILE') {
          if (t.y < (CITY_TOP + CITY_BOTTOM) / 2) {
            t.y = CITY_WALL_NORTH - 5;
            t.dy = -(Math.abs(t.dy) + 0.2);
          } else {
            t.y = CITY_WALL_SOUTH + 5;
            t.dy = Math.abs(t.dy) + 0.2;
          }
        }
        // SPY cannot enter govt buildings (push away if inside bounding box)
        if (isSpy) {
          for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
            if (GOVT_BIDS.has(b.id) && t.x > b.x && t.x < b.x+b.w && t.y > b.y && t.y < b.y+b.h) {
              const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - (b.y+b.h/2), t.x - (b.x+b.w/2));
              t.x += Math.cos(ang) * 8; t.y += Math.sin(ang) * 8;
            }
          }
        }

        // ── Passive threats — wander only, never aggro ───────────────────────
        const isPassive = PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type);
        if (isPassive) {
          t.behavior = 'PATROLLING';
          if (t.timer <= 0) {
            const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            t.dx = Math.cos(ang) * 0.2 * NPC_SPEED_MULT; t.dy = Math.sin(ang) * 0.2 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
            t.timer = 120 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 160);
          }
          let pnx = t.x + t.dx, pny = t.y + t.dy;
          if (col(pnx, t.y)) pnx = t.x;
          if (col(t.x, pny)) pny = t.y;
          t.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, pnx));
          t.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, pny));
          continue;
        }

        // ── Behavior state machine ───────────────────────────────────────────
        t.behaviorTimer--;
        if (t.attackCd > 0) t.attackCd--;
        if (t.behaviorTimer <= 0 && t.behavior !== 'HOSTILE') {
          t.behavior = pickBehavior(t.type, g.worldTime);
          t.behaviorTimer = 300 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300);
        }

        const pClass = char.class.toLowerCase();
        const factionMap: Record<string,string> = { RUST_SYNDICATE:'rust_syndicate', VOID_RUNNERS:'void_runners', STATIC_MONKS:'static_monks', EASTERN_BLOC:'eastern_bloc', MINX_CITY:'minx_city' };
        const hasFaction = t.type in factionMap;
        const threatFactionId = factionMap[t.type] ?? '';
        const playerInThreatZone = hasFaction && GANG_ZONES.some(gz => {
          return (threatFactionId === gz.id || gz.id === threatFactionId + '_frag') && g.px >= gz.x && g.px <= gz.x + gz.w && g.py >= gz.y && g.py <= gz.y + gz.h;
        });

        const isAlly = hasFaction && (GANG_FACTION_ALLIES[pClass] ?? []).includes(threatFactionId);
        const isEnemy = hasFaction && (GANG_FACTION_ENEMIES[pClass] ?? []).includes(threatFactionId);

        let hostilityMult = 1.0;
        if (hasFaction) {
          if (isAlly) {
            hostilityMult = playerInThreatZone ? 0.15 : 0;
          } else if (isEnemy) {
            hostilityMult = playerInThreatZone ? 3.0 : 1.8;
          } else {
            hostilityMult = playerInThreatZone ? 1.2 : 0.6;
          }
        } else {
          if (pClass === 'corporate') hostilityMult = 1.2;
          else if (pClass === 'outlaw') hostilityMult = 0.7;
          else if (pClass === 'replicant') hostilityMult = 0.8;
          else hostilityMult = 0.9;
        }

        const nightActive = g.worldTime >= 19 || g.worldTime < 4;
        const nightAggroBoost = nightActive ? 1.5 : 1.0;
        const nightSpeedBoost = nightActive ? 1.3 : 1.0;
        const baseAggroRange = isSpy ? 100 : (t.type === 'PABLO_GUARD' || t.type === 'MINX_CITY') ? 140 : (t.type === 'PROWLER' || t.type === 'BORDER_GANG') ? 90 : (['RAIDER','EASTERN_BLOC'].includes(t.type) ? 120 : 100);
        const aggroRange = baseAggroRange * hostilityMult * nightAggroBoost;
        const chaseSpeed  = (isSpy ? 0.65 : (t.type === 'PROWLER' || t.type === 'BORDER_GANG') ? 0.52 : (['RAIDER','EASTERN_BLOC'].includes(t.type) ? 0.58 : (t.type === 'PABLO_GUARD' || t.type === 'MINX_CITY') ? 0.62 : 0.48)) * NPC_SPEED_MULT * nightSpeedBoost;
        const wanderSpeed = (isSpy ? 0.25 : 0.15) * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
        const rangedCfg = THREAT_RANGED[t.type] ?? null;
        const hasRanged = !!rangedCfg;

        const shouldAggro = OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && dist < aggroRange && !npcDialogRef.current && hostilityMult > 0.1;

        if (t.behavior === 'SLEEPING') {
          t.dx = 0; t.dy = 0;
          if (shouldAggro && dist < aggroRange * 0.5) {
            t.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; t.behaviorTimer = 300;
            const nearby = g.threats.filter(o => o !== t && o.type === t.type && o.behavior !== 'HOSTILE' && Math.hypot(o.x - t.x, o.y - t.y) < 150);
            for (const ally of nearby) { ally.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; ally.behaviorTimer = 250; }
          }
        } else if (t.behavior === 'CAMPING') {
          t.dx *= 0.9; t.dy *= 0.9;
          if (shouldAggro && dist < aggroRange * 0.6) {
            t.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; t.behaviorTimer = 300;
            const nearby = g.threats.filter(o => o !== t && o.type === t.type && o.behavior !== 'HOSTILE' && Math.hypot(o.x - t.x, o.y - t.y) < 150);
            for (const ally of nearby) { ally.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; ally.behaviorTimer = 250; }
          }
        } else if (t.behavior === 'WORKING') {
          if (t.timer <= 0) {
            const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            t.dx = Math.cos(ang) * wanderSpeed * 0.5; t.dy = Math.sin(ang) * wanderSpeed * 0.5;
            t.timer = 180 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200);
          }
          if (shouldAggro) {
            t.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; t.behaviorTimer = 300;
          }
        } else if (t.behavior === 'SOCIALIZING') {
          const nearby = g.threats.filter(o => o !== t && o.type === t.type && o.behavior === 'SOCIALIZING' && Math.hypot(o.x - t.x, o.y - t.y) < 120);
          if (nearby.length > 0) {
            const cx = nearby.reduce((s, o) => s + o.x, t.x) / (nearby.length + 1);
            const cy = nearby.reduce((s, o) => s + o.y, t.y) / (nearby.length + 1);
            const dToGroup = Math.hypot(cx - t.x, cy - t.y);
            if (dToGroup > 25) {
              const ga = Math.atan2(cy - t.y, cx - t.x);
              t.dx = Math.cos(ga) * wanderSpeed * 0.4;
              t.dy = Math.sin(ga) * wanderSpeed * 0.4;
            } else {
              t.dx *= 0.85; t.dy *= 0.85;
            }
          } else {
            if (t.timer <= 0) {
              const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
              t.dx = Math.cos(ang) * wanderSpeed * 0.3; t.dy = Math.sin(ang) * wanderSpeed * 0.3;
              t.timer = 200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200);
            }
          }
          if (shouldAggro) {
            t.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; t.behaviorTimer = 300;
            for (const ally of nearby) { ally.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; ally.behaviorTimer = 250; }
          }
        } else if (t.behavior === 'HOSTILE' || shouldAggro) {
          t.behavior = 'HOSTILE';
          const ang = Math.atan2(g.py - t.y, g.px - t.x);
          const lowHp = t.hp < t.maxHp * 0.25;
          if (hasRanged && dist < rangedCfg!.range && dist > 40) {
            t.strafeAngle += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15;
            const strafeSpd = chaseSpeed * 0.7;
            t.dx = Math.cos(ang + Math.PI / 2 + t.strafeAngle) * strafeSpd;
            t.dy = Math.sin(ang + Math.PI / 2 + t.strafeAngle) * strafeSpd;
          } else if (lowHp && hasRanged) {
            t.dx = -Math.cos(ang) * chaseSpeed * 0.8;
            t.dy = -Math.sin(ang) * chaseSpeed * 0.8;
          } else {
            t.dx = Math.cos(ang) * chaseSpeed; t.dy = Math.sin(ang) * chaseSpeed;
          }
          if (dist > aggroRange * 4) {
            t.behavior = pickBehavior(t.type, g.worldTime);
            t.behaviorTimer = 200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200);
          }
        } else if (t.timer <= 0) {
          const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          t.dx = Math.cos(ang) * wanderSpeed; t.dy = Math.sin(ang) * wanderSpeed;
          t.timer = 180 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200);
        }

        let nx2 = t.x + t.dx;
        let ny2 = t.y + t.dy;
        if (isMajorThreat && ny2 > CITY_WALL_NORTH && ny2 < CITY_WALL_SOUTH) {
          ny2 = (t.y <= (CITY_TOP + CITY_BOTTOM) / 2) ? CITY_WALL_NORTH : CITY_WALL_SOUTH;
        }
        if (col(nx2, t.y)) nx2 = t.x;
        if (col(t.x, ny2)) ny2 = t.y;
        t.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, nx2));
        t.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, ny2));

        // ── Commit to a melee windup ──────────────────────────────────────────
        // Entering a windup freezes the enemy until it resolves (handled at
        // the top of this loop next frame). Gives the player a fair window
        // to dodge or interrupt.
        if (OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && t.behavior === 'HOSTILE' && dist < 22 && t.attackCd <= 0 && (t.windup ?? 0) === 0 && g.invincible === 0 && !npcDialogRef.current && !gamePausedRef.current) {
          const wu = (t.type === 'PROWLER' || t.type === 'STRAY_DOG' || t.type === 'RAT') ? 14
                   : (t.type === 'MUTANT' || t.type === 'MINX_CITY') ? 28
                   : 22;
          t.windup = wu; t.windupMax = wu;
          t.dx = 0; t.dy = 0;
        }
        // ── Ranged attack (enemy shoots projectile at player) ─────────────────
        if (OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && t.behavior === 'HOSTILE' && hasRanged && dist < rangedCfg!.range && dist > 25 && t.attackCd <= 0 && !gamePausedRef.current && (t.windup ?? 0) === 0) {
          // Line-of-sight — don't fire through solid walls. Uses a cheap
          // Liang–Barsky AABB clip against every building's bbox.
          let loSeen = true;
          for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
            const dxs = g.px - t.x, dys = g.py - t.y;
            let tmin = 0, tmax = 1;
            const clip = (p: number, q: number): boolean => {
              if (p === 0) return q >= 0;
              const r = q / p;
              if (p < 0) { if (r > tmax) return false; if (r > tmin) tmin = r; }
              else       { if (r < tmin) return false; if (r < tmax) tmax = r; }
              return true;
            };
            if (clip(-dxs, t.x - b.x) && clip(dxs, (b.x + b.w) - t.x) && clip(-dys, t.y - b.y) && clip(dys, (b.y + b.h) - t.y)) {
              loSeen = false; break;
            }
          }
          if (loSeen) {
            t.attackCd = rangedCfg!.cooldown;
            const finalAng = Math.atan2(g.py - t.y, g.px - t.x) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18;
            g.projectiles.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, prevX: t.x, prevY: t.y, dx: Math.cos(finalAng) * rangedCfg!.speed, dy: Math.sin(finalAng) * rangedCfg!.speed, life: 40, damage: rangedCfg!.dmg, type: rangedCfg!.type, fromEnemy: true });
            g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 10, text: `${t.type.replace(/_/g, ' ')} FIRE`, color: '#ff6644', life: 20, maxLife: 20 });
          } else {
            // No LOS — take a couple of frames to reposition.
            t.attackCd = 8;
          }
        }
      }

      const MIN_SEP = 18;
      const PUSH_STR = 0.4;
      for (let i = 0; i < g.threats.length; i++) {
        const a = g.threats[i];
        const dpx = g.px - a.x, dpy = g.py - a.y;
        const pdist = Math.sqrt(dpx * dpx + dpy * dpy);
        if (pdist < MIN_SEP) {
          const safeDist = pdist < 0.01 ? 0.01 : pdist;
          const ux = (pdist < 0.01 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 : dpx / safeDist);
          const uy = (pdist < 0.01 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 : dpy / safeDist);
          const overlap = (MIN_SEP - safeDist) * 0.5;
          const pushX = -ux * overlap * PUSH_STR;
          const pushY = -uy * overlap * PUSH_STR;
          if (!col(a.x + pushX, a.y)) a.x += pushX;
          if (!col(a.x, a.y + pushY)) a.y += pushY;
          a.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, a.x));
          a.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, a.y));
        }
        for (let j = i + 1; j < g.threats.length; j++) {
          const b = g.threats[j];
          const ddx = b.x - a.x, ddy = b.y - a.y;
          const dd = Math.sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy);
          if (dd < MIN_SEP) {
            const safeDd = dd < 0.01 ? 0.01 : dd;
            const ux2 = (dd < 0.01 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 : ddx / safeDd);
            const uy2 = (dd < 0.01 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 : ddy / safeDd);
            const overlap = (MIN_SEP - safeDd) * 0.5;
            const pxA = -ux2 * overlap * PUSH_STR, pyA = -uy2 * overlap * PUSH_STR;
            const pxB = ux2 * overlap * PUSH_STR, pyB = uy2 * overlap * PUSH_STR;
            if (!col(a.x + pxA, a.y)) a.x += pxA;
            if (!col(a.x, a.y + pyA)) a.y += pyA;
            if (!col(b.x + pxB, b.y)) b.x += pxB;
            if (!col(b.x, b.y + pyB)) b.y += pyB;
            a.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, a.x));
            a.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, a.y));
            b.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, b.x));
            b.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, b.y));
          }
        }
      }

      // ── PABLO CORP android guard patrol + ACTIVE CITY CLEANUP ─────────────
      if (g.guardCooldowns.length < g.guards.length) {
        g.guardCooldowns = new Array(g.guards.length).fill(0);
      }

      const cityThreats = g.threats.filter(t => !PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type) && t.y > CITY_TOP - 80 && t.y < CITY_BOTTOM + 80);
      const playerInCity = g.px >= CITY_LEFT && g.px <= CITY_RIGHT && g.py >= CITY_TOP && g.py <= CITY_BOTTOM;
      if (g.frame % 3000 === 0 && cityThreats.length > 0 && playerInCity) {
        const nearbyThreat = cityThreats.find(t => Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y) < 600);
        if (nearbyThreat) {
          setNarr(`> PABLO CORP BROADCAST: "Cleanup Unit dispatched to your sector. Citizens are advised to clear the area."`);
        }
      }
      if (g.frame % 5400 === 600 && cityThreats.length > 3 && playerInCity) {
        const nearCityThreats = cityThreats.filter(t => Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y) < 500);
        if (nearCityThreats.length > 1) {
          setNarr('> PABLO CORP SECURITY: Elevated threat activity detected near your position. Strike teams deployed.');
        }
      }

      for (let gi = 0; gi < g.guards.length; gi++) {
        const guard = g.guards[gi];
        if (g.guardCooldowns[gi] > 0) g.guardCooldowns[gi]--;

        // Restore persisted hunt target if still alive
        let nearestThreat: Threat | null = null, nearestDist = 9999;
        if (guard.huntTarget !== undefined) {
          const prev = g.threats[guard.huntTarget];
          if (prev && !PASSIVE_THREATS.has(prev.type) && prev.y < CITY_THREAT_SCAN_Y) {
            nearestThreat = prev;
            nearestDist = Math.hypot(guard.x - prev.x, guard.y - prev.y);
          } else {
            guard.huntTarget = undefined;
          }
        }

        // Corpo military AI: only engage threats near Pablo Corp employees/assets
        const corpoWorkerNpcs = NPCS.filter(n => n.role === 'corpo_worker');
        for (let ti = 0; ti < g.threats.length; ti++) {
          const t = g.threats[ti];
          if (PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type)) continue;
          if (t.y >= CITY_THREAT_SCAN_Y) continue;
          const dToGuard = Math.hypot(guard.x - t.x, guard.y - t.y);
          if (dToGuard >= 400) continue;
          let nearCorpAsset = false;
          for (const cw of corpoWorkerNpcs) {
            const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(cw, g.worldTime ?? 0);
            if (Math.hypot(t.x - sp.x, t.y - sp.y) < 250) { nearCorpAsset = true; break; }
          }
          if (!nearCorpAsset) {
            const pabloTower = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'pablo_tower');
            if (pabloTower && Math.hypot(t.x - (pabloTower.x + pabloTower.w / 2), t.y - (pabloTower.y + pabloTower.h / 2)) < 350) nearCorpAsset = true;
          }
          if (nearCorpAsset && dToGuard < nearestDist) { nearestThreat = t; nearestDist = dToGuard; guard.huntTarget = ti; }
        }

        if (nearestThreat) {
          // Aggressive pursuit — fast sprint toward target
          const ang = Math.atan2(nearestThreat.y - guard.y, nearestThreat.x - guard.x);
          const spd = (nearestDist > 60 ? 1.5 : 1.1) * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
          guard.x += Math.cos(ang) * spd;
          guard.y += Math.sin(ang) * spd;
          // Engage in melee
          if (nearestDist < 18 && g.guardCooldowns[gi] === 0) {
            g.guardCooldowns[gi] = 28;
            nearestThreat.hp -= 45;
            g.floaters.push({ x: nearestThreat.x, y: nearestThreat.y - 8, text: '[ CORP HIT ]', color: '#4488ff', life: 38, maxLife: 38 });
            if (nearestThreat.hp <= 0) {
              g.floaters.push({ x: nearestThreat.x, y: nearestThreat.y - 16, text: '[ ELIMINATED ]', color: '#38bdf8', life: 90, maxLife: 90 });
              g.threatRespawn.push({ ox: nearestThreat.ox, oy: nearestThreat.oy, type: nearestThreat.type, at: g.frame + 2400 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3000) });
              g.deadBodies.push({ x: nearestThreat.x, y: nearestThreat.y, type: nearestThreat.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame });
              g.threats = g.threats.filter(t => t !== nearestThreat);
              // Clear all guard hunt references to dead target
              for (const gu of g.guards) { if (gu.huntTarget !== undefined && g.threats[gu.huntTarget] === undefined) gu.huntTarget = undefined; }
              guard.huntTarget = undefined;
              // Occasional cleanup confirmation
              if (Math.random() < 0.35) setNarr('> PABLO CORP: "Target down. Area secured." — Cleanup unit returning to post.');
            }
          }
        } else {
          // No threat found — return to waypoint patrol
          guard.huntTarget = undefined;
          const route = GUARD_ROUTES[gi % GUARD_ROUTES.length];
          const wp = route[guard.wpIdx % route.length];
          const gdx = wp.x - guard.x, gdy = wp.y - guard.y;
          const gdist = Math.hypot(gdx, gdy);
          if (gdist < 4) {
            guard.wpIdx = (guard.wpIdx + 1) % route.length;
          } else {
            guard.x += (gdx / gdist) * 0.55 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
            guard.y += (gdy / gdist) * 0.55 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Dog companion AI ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      const dog = g.dogCompanion;
      const dogBreedDef = getDogBreed(dog.breed);
      if (dog.active && !dog.injured && !dog.stayAt) {
        const dDist = Math.hypot(g.px - dog.x, g.py - dog.y);
        let dogTargeting = false;
        if (dog.attackCooldown > 0) dog.attackCooldown--;
        for (const t of g.threats) {
          if (PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type)) continue;
          // Safe streets: the dog won't engage combatant threats (no biting, no
          // counter-damage/injury) — it stays a companion, not a brawler.
          if (!OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && !ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type)) continue;
          const tDist = Math.hypot(dog.x - t.x, dog.y - t.y);
          if (tDist < DOG_DETECT_RANGE) {
            dogTargeting = true;
            const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - dog.y, t.x - dog.x);
            dog.x += Math.cos(ang) * dogBreedDef.speed;
            dog.y += Math.sin(ang) * dogBreedDef.speed;
            if (tDist < 20 && dog.attackCooldown === 0) {
              dog.attackCooldown = DOG_ATTACK_COOLDOWN;
              t.hp -= dogBreedDef.atk;
              const bark = DOG_COMBAT_BARKS[Math.floor(Math.random() * DOG_COMBAT_BARKS.length)];
              g.floaters.push({ x: dog.x, y: dog.y - 12, text: bark, color: '#ffaa44', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
              const counterDmg = Math.round(((THREAT_HP[t.type] ?? 30) > 30 ? 3 : 2));
              dog.hp = Math.max(0, dog.hp - counterDmg);
              if (dog.hp <= 0) {
                dog.injured = true;
                setDogInjured(true);
                setNarr(`> ${dog.name} is INJURED! Find a Save Crystal or clinic to help your companion recover.`);
              }
              setDogHp(Math.floor(dog.hp));
              if (t.hp <= 0) {
                sfxKill();
                const isAnimal = ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type);
                const bountyAmt = isAnimal ? 0 : (BOUNTY[t.type] ?? 10);
                if (isAnimal) {
                  const drop = ANIMAL_DROPS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ANIMAL_DROPS.length)];
                  const ok = addStackToInventory(g.inventory, { id: drop.id, name: drop.name, desc: drop.desc, icon: drop.icon, stackable: true, qty: 1, value: drop.value });
                  setInventory([...g.inventory]);
                  g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: ok ? `+ ${drop.name}` : 'INV FULL', color: ok ? '#88cc44' : '#ff6644', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
                } else {
                  g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: `ƒ${bountyAmt.toLocaleString()} LOOT`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
                }
                const earned = THREAT_EXP[t.type] ?? 20;
                g.floaters.push({ x: t.x + 8, y: t.y - 10, text: `+${earned}XP`, color: '#44ffaa', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
                applyExpGain(g, earned, sfxLevelUp, setLevelUpText, setShowLevelUp, setNarr, setExp, setLevel, setHp);
                g.threatRespawn.push({ ox: t.ox, oy: t.oy, type: t.type, at: g.frame + 1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2400) });
                g.deadBodies.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, type: t.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: bountyAmt, looted: false });
                g.threats = g.threats.filter(th => th !== t);
                if (dog.dialogueCooldown <= 0 && Math.random() < 0.4) {
                  const line = DOG_KILL_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * DOG_KILL_LINES.length)];
                  setNarr(`> [${dog.name}]: "${line}"`);
                  dog.dialogueCooldown = 600;
                }
              }
            }
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!dogTargeting) {
          // Low stamina makes the dog sluggish.
          const dogStamFactor = dog.stamina < 20 ? 0.55 : 1;
          if (dDist > DOG_FOLLOW_OFFSET) {
            const ang = Math.atan2(g.py - dog.y, g.px - dog.x);
            const spd = (dDist > 200 ? dogBreedDef.speed * 2 : dogBreedDef.speed) * dogStamFactor;
            dog.x += Math.cos(ang) * spd;
            dog.y += Math.sin(ang) * spd;
          }
          if (dDist > 600) {
            dog.x = g.px + 30;
            dog.y = g.py + 30;
          }
          // Idle/social behaviours (infrequent). The dog naps when the PLAYER
          // has been standing still a while and is settled right beside them,
          // or when it's worn out (low stamina).
          if ((g.playerIdleTicks > 300 || dog.stamina < 15) && dDist <= DOG_FOLLOW_OFFSET) {
            if (!dog.sleeping && Math.random() < 0.005) dog.sleeping = true;
          } else {
            dog.sleeping = false;
          }
          // Bark at a nearby stray dog (low-probability, cooldowned).
          if (dog.barkCd > 0) dog.barkCd--;
          if (!dog.sleeping && dog.barkCd <= 0) {
            const otherDog = g.threats.find(t => t.type === 'STRAY_DOG' && Math.hypot(dog.x - t.x, dog.y - t.y) < 95);
            if (otherDog && Math.random() < 0.012) {
              g.floaters.push({ x: dog.x, y: dog.y - 12, text: 'WOOF!', color: '#ffcc66', life: 38, maxLife: 38 });
              dog.barkCd = 540 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 720);
            }
          }
        } else {
          dog.sleeping = false;
        }
        dog.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, dog.x));
        dog.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, dog.y));

        if (dog.dialogueCooldown > 0) dog.dialogueCooldown--;
        const currentZone = inCityBounds(g.px, g.py) ? getActiveCityDef().name : 'WASTELAND';
        if (dog.lastZone && dog.lastZone !== currentZone && dog.dialogueCooldown <= 0) {
          const line = DOG_ZONE_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * DOG_ZONE_LINES.length)];
          setNarr(`> [${dog.name}]: "${line}"`);
          dog.dialogueCooldown = 900;
        }
        dog.lastZone = currentZone;
        if (dog.dialogueCooldown <= 0 && g.hp < g.maxHp * 0.3 && Math.random() < 0.002) {
          const line = DOG_LOW_HP_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * DOG_LOW_HP_LINES.length)];
          setNarr(`> [${dog.name}]: "${line}"`);
          dog.dialogueCooldown = 1200;
        }
        if (dog.dialogueCooldown <= 0 && g.frame % 1200 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.35) {
          const line = DOG_DIALOGUE_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * DOG_DIALOGUE_LINES.length)];
          setNarr(`> [${dog.name}]: "${line}"`);
          dog.dialogueCooldown = 1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1200);
        }
      }

      // ── Cat companion AI (independent of the dog) ────────────────────────
      const cat = g.catCompanion;
      const catBreedDef = getCatBreed(cat.breed);
      if (cat.active && !cat.injured && !cat.stayAt) {
        const cDist = Math.hypot(g.px - cat.x, g.py - cat.y);
        let catTargeting = false;
        if (cat.attackCooldown > 0) cat.attackCooldown--;
        for (const t of g.threats) {
          if (PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type)) continue;
          // Safe streets: the cat won't engage combatant threats either — it
          // stays a companion, only striking huntable animals.
          if (!OPEN_WORLD_COMBAT_LETHAL && !ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type)) continue;
          const tDist = Math.hypot(cat.x - t.x, cat.y - t.y);
          if (tDist < CAT_DETECT_RANGE) {
            catTargeting = true;
            const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - cat.y, t.x - cat.x);
            cat.x += Math.cos(ang) * catBreedDef.speed;
            cat.y += Math.sin(ang) * catBreedDef.speed;
            if (tDist < 20 && cat.attackCooldown === 0) {
              cat.attackCooldown = CAT_ATTACK_COOLDOWN;
              t.hp -= catBreedDef.atk;
              const bark = CAT_COMBAT_BARKS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CAT_COMBAT_BARKS.length)];
              g.floaters.push({ x: cat.x, y: cat.y - 12, text: bark, color: '#aaccff', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
              const counterDmg = Math.round(((THREAT_HP[t.type] ?? 30) > 30 ? 3 : 2));
              cat.hp = Math.max(0, cat.hp - counterDmg);
              if (cat.hp <= 0) {
                cat.injured = true;
                setCatInjured(true);
                setNarr(`> ${cat.name} is INJURED! Find a Save Crystal or clinic to help your companion recover.`);
              }
              setCatHp(Math.floor(cat.hp));
              if (t.hp <= 0) {
                sfxKill();
                const isAnimal = ANIMAL_TYPES.has(t.type);
                const bountyAmt = isAnimal ? 0 : (BOUNTY[t.type] ?? 10);
                if (isAnimal) {
                  const drop = ANIMAL_DROPS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ANIMAL_DROPS.length)];
                  const ok = addStackToInventory(g.inventory, { id: drop.id, name: drop.name, desc: drop.desc, icon: drop.icon, stackable: true, qty: 1, value: drop.value });
                  setInventory([...g.inventory]);
                  g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: ok ? `+ ${drop.name}` : 'INV FULL', color: ok ? '#88cc44' : '#ff6644', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
                } else {
                  g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, text: `ƒ${bountyAmt.toLocaleString()} LOOT`, color: '#ffdd44', life: 55, maxLife: 55 });
                }
                const earned = THREAT_EXP[t.type] ?? 20;
                g.floaters.push({ x: t.x + 8, y: t.y - 10, text: `+${earned}XP`, color: '#44ffaa', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
                applyExpGain(g, earned, sfxLevelUp, setLevelUpText, setShowLevelUp, setNarr, setExp, setLevel, setHp);
                g.threatRespawn.push({ ox: t.ox, oy: t.oy, type: t.type, at: g.frame + 1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2400) });
                g.deadBodies.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, type: t.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: bountyAmt, looted: false });
                g.threats = g.threats.filter(th => th !== t);
                if (cat.dialogueCooldown <= 0 && Math.random() < 0.4) {
                  const line = CAT_KILL_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * CAT_KILL_LINES.length)];
                  setNarr(`> [${cat.name}]: "${line}"`);
                  cat.dialogueCooldown = 600;
                }
              }
            }
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!catTargeting) {
          // Low stamina makes the cat sluggish.
          const catStamFactor = cat.stamina < 20 ? 0.55 : 1;
          if (cDist > CAT_FOLLOW_OFFSET) {
            const ang = Math.atan2(g.py - cat.y, g.px - cat.x);
            const spd = (cDist > 200 ? catBreedDef.speed * 2 : catBreedDef.speed) * catStamFactor;
            cat.x += Math.cos(ang) * spd;
            cat.y += Math.sin(ang) * spd;
          }
          if (cDist > 600) {
            cat.x = g.px - 30;
            cat.y = g.py + 30;
          }
        }
        cat.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, cat.x));
        cat.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, cat.y));

        if (cat.dialogueCooldown > 0) cat.dialogueCooldown--;
        const currentZoneCat = inCityBounds(g.px, g.py) ? getActiveCityDef().name : 'WASTELAND';
        if (cat.lastZone && cat.lastZone !== currentZoneCat && cat.dialogueCooldown <= 0) {
          const line = CAT_ZONE_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * CAT_ZONE_LINES.length)];
          setNarr(`> [${cat.name}]: "${line}"`);
          cat.dialogueCooldown = 900;
        }
        cat.lastZone = currentZoneCat;
        if (cat.dialogueCooldown <= 0 && g.hp < g.maxHp * 0.3 && Math.random() < 0.002) {
          const line = CAT_LOW_HP_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * CAT_LOW_HP_LINES.length)];
          setNarr(`> [${cat.name}]: "${line}"`);
          cat.dialogueCooldown = 1200;
        }
        if (cat.dialogueCooldown <= 0 && g.frame % 1300 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.35) {
          const line = CAT_DIALOGUE_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * CAT_DIALOGUE_LINES.length)];
          setNarr(`> [${cat.name}]: "${line}"`);
          cat.dialogueCooldown = 1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1200);
        }
      }

      // ── Mila replicant companion AI (follows during story missions) ──────
      const mila = g.mila;
      if (g.story?.active && mila.task === 'follow') {
        if (mila.spawnAt === 0) { mila.spawnAt = g.frame; mila.x = g.px - 26; mila.y = g.py + 22; }
        const mDist = Math.hypot(g.px - mila.x, g.py - mila.y);
        if (mDist > MILA_FOLLOW_OFFSET) {
          const mAng = Math.atan2(g.py - mila.y, g.px - mila.x);
          const mSpd = mDist > 200 ? MILA_SPEED * 2 : MILA_SPEED;
          mila.x += Math.cos(mAng) * mSpd;
          mila.y += Math.sin(mAng) * mSpd;
        }
        if (mDist > 600) { mila.x = g.px + 26; mila.y = g.py + 26; }
        mila.x = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(W - BORDER, mila.x));
        mila.y = Math.max(BORDER, Math.min(H - BORDER, mila.y));
        if (mila.dialogueCooldown > 0) mila.dialogueCooldown--;
      } else if (mila.spawnAt !== 0) {
        // Off-duty (no active story, or told to stay) — reset so she
        // re-materialises beside the player the next time a mission goes live.
        mila.spawnAt = 0;
      }

      if (g.hp <= 0 && !lastDead) {
        lastDead = true;
        sfxDeath();
        if (g.interior) {
          g.px = g.interior.savedWorldX; g.py = g.interior.savedWorldY;
          g.moveTarget = null; g.interiorMoveTarget = null;
          g.interior = null; g.interiorFade = 0; g.interiorFadeDir = 0; g.interiorFadeCallback = null;
        }
        if (!g.pvpDeathBodyDropped) {
          g.deadBodies.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py, type: 'PLAYER', diedAtFrame: g.frame });
        }
        g.pvpDeathBodyDropped = false;
        g.diedLastSession = true;
        try { localStorage.setItem('sm_died_last_session', 'true'); } catch {}
        setIsDead(true);
      }

      // ── Stamina collapse → CRITICAL grace period (rescuable) or hospital ──
      // Energy is "soft HP": when it bottoms out (poison gas, exhaustion) the
      // player enters a CRITICAL state. Nearby responders have 2 minutes to
      // revive them via [E] interact; if no rescue arrives the hospital cinematic
      // fires instead. HP (the sword) hitting zero is the lethal route above.
      if (g.energy <= 0 && g.hp > 0 && !lastPassedOut && !lastDead) {
        lastPassedOut = true;
        sfxDeath();
        if (g.interior) {
          g.px = g.interior.savedWorldX; g.py = g.interior.savedWorldY;
          g.moveTarget = null; g.interiorMoveTarget = null;
          g.interior = null; g.interiorFade = 0; g.interiorFadeDir = 0; g.interiorFadeCallback = null;
        }
        g.gasPoison = false; g.gasExposureTick = 0;
        if (!g.deathReason) g.deathReason = 'Collapsed from exhaustion';
        isCollapsedRef.current = true;
        setIsCollapsed(true);
        collapseDeadlineRef.current = Date.now() + 120_000;
        wsSend({ type: 'player_collapsed_notify' });
      }
      // If nobody rescued in time, proceed to hospital cinematic
      if (isCollapsedRef.current && collapseDeadlineRef.current > 0 && Date.now() >= collapseDeadlineRef.current) {
        isCollapsedRef.current = false;
        setIsCollapsed(false);
        collapseDeadlineRef.current = 0;
        setHospitalCinematic({ phase: 0, lineIdx: 0, fadeAlpha: 1, startTime: Date.now() });
      }

      // ── Dead body cleanup (1 in-game day ≈ 14400 frames, remove when no real players nearby) ──
      const BODY_TTL_FRAMES = 14400;
      g.deadBodies = g.deadBodies.filter(body => {
        if (g.frame - body.diedAtFrame < BODY_TTL_FRAMES) return true;
        const localDist = Math.hypot(g.px - body.x, g.py - body.y);
        if (localDist < 600) return true;
        for (const [, peer] of g.peers) {
          if (Math.hypot(peer.x - body.x, peer.y - body.y) < 600) return true;
        }
        return false;
      });

      // HP regen handled in post-combat regen block below (no duplicate here)
      if (g.hp > 0 && lastDead) lastDead = false;
      if (g.energy > 0 && lastPassedOut) lastPassedOut = false;
      if (g.hp !== lastHp) { lastHp = g.hp; setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); }
      if (g.salary !== lastSal) { lastSal = g.salary; setSalary(g.salary); }

      const zoomLerp = 0.08;
      zoomRef.current += (targetZoomRef.current - zoomRef.current) * zoomLerp;

      const entryZoom = buildingEntryZoomRef.current;
      if (entryZoom.active) {
        entryZoom.timer--;
        if (entryZoom.timer <= 0) {
          entryZoom.active = false;
          if (entryZoom.callback) entryZoom.callback();
          entryZoom.callback = null;
        }
      }

      // Look-ahead: camera leads in the movement direction
      let dx2 = 0, dy2 = 0;
      if (g.keys.has('arrowleft') || g.keys.has('a')) dx2 = -1;
      if (g.keys.has('arrowright') || g.keys.has('d')) dx2 = 1;
      if (g.keys.has('arrowup') || g.keys.has('w')) dy2 = -1;
      if (g.keys.has('arrowdown') || g.keys.has('s')) dy2 = 1;
      const isMoving = dx2 !== 0 || dy2 !== 0;
      const lookAheadDist = 60;
      const laLerp = isMoving ? 0.10 : 0.14;
      cameraLookAheadRef.current.x += (dx2 * lookAheadDist - cameraLookAheadRef.current.x) * laLerp;
      cameraLookAheadRef.current.y += (dy2 * lookAheadDist - cameraLookAheadRef.current.y) * laLerp;

      // During building entry, pan camera toward building entrance
      let focusX = g.px + cameraLookAheadRef.current.x;
      let focusY = g.py + cameraLookAheadRef.current.y;
      if (entryZoom.active) {
        const blend = 1 - (entryZoom.timer / 45);
        focusX += (entryZoom.targetX - focusX) * blend * 0.5;
        focusY += (entryZoom.targetY - focusY) * blend * 0.5;
      }

      const camTargetX = focusX - cw / 2;
      const camTargetY = focusY - ch / 2;
      const clampedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - cw, camTargetX));
      const clampedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ch, camTargetY));
      const camDiffX = clampedX - g.cam.x;
      const camDiffY = clampedY - g.cam.y;
      const DEADZONE = 2;
      if (Math.abs(camDiffX) > DEADZONE || Math.abs(camDiffY) > DEADZONE) {
        const camSpeed = isMoving ? 0.16 : 0.22;
        g.cam.x += camDiffX * camSpeed;
        g.cam.y += camDiffY * camSpeed;
      } else {
        g.cam.x = clampedX;
        g.cam.y = clampedY;
      }
      // Apply camera shake — random per-frame offset that decays with shakeFrames
      let shakeX = 0, shakeY = 0;
      if (g.shakeFrames > 0) {
        const k = g.shakeFrames / 8; // normalize ~ to swing duration
        shakeX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * g.shakeMag * k;
        shakeY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * g.shakeMag * k;
        g.shakeFrames--;
        if (g.shakeFrames <= 0) g.shakeMag = 0;
      }
      const ox = -g.cam.x + shakeX, oy = -g.cam.y + shakeY;

      // Recompute the city hover target PER FRAME from the raw cursor so the
      // private-name reveal tracks the camera as it follows the player. Interior
      // hover is camera-free and stays as written in handleMouseMove.
      if (!g.interior) {
        hoverMouseRef.current = hoverScreenRef.current
