          ? { x: hoverScreenRef.current.x + g.cam.x, y: hoverScreenRef.current.y + g.cam.y }
          : null;
      }

      ctx.save();
      ctx.scale(zoom, zoom);

      const _wt = g.worldTime;
      const _isNight = _wt >= 19 || _wt < 4;
      const _tileHash = (x: number, y: number) => {
        const h = Math.sin(x * 12.9898 + y * 78.233) * 43758.5453;
        return h - Math.floor(h);
      };

      // ── Interior rendering ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
      if (g.interior) {
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.save();
        const icw = logW, ich = logH;
        const itr = g.interior;
        const iDef = itr.def;
        const iScale = Math.min(icw / (iDef.width + 80), ich / (iDef.height + 80));
        const iox = (icw - iDef.width * iScale) / 2;
        const ioy = (ich - iDef.height * iScale) / 2;
        ctx.translate(iox, ioy);
        ctx.scale(iScale, iScale);
        // Player customization override — themeColor wins over the floor's
        // default accent color, signage replaces the floor label in the banner.
        const _iCust = (g.propertyCustomization ?? {})[itr.bid] as PropertyCustomization | undefined;
        const _iIsOffline = (g.propertiesOffline?.has?.(itr.bid)) ?? false;
        const _iAcc = iDef.accentColor ?? 'rgba(0,200,255,.2)';
        const _iAccRgbDefault = _iAcc.match(/\d+/g)?.slice(0,3).map(Number) ?? [0,200,255];
        const _iAccRgbCustom = (() => {
          const tc = _iCust?.themeColor;
          if (!tc) return null;
          const m = tc.match(/^#?([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/);
          if (!m) {
            const dm = tc.match(/\d+/g)?.slice(0,3).map(Number);
            return dm && dm.length === 3 ? dm : null;
          }
          const hex = m[1];
          return [parseInt(hex.slice(0,2),16), parseInt(hex.slice(2,4),16), parseInt(hex.slice(4,6),16)];
        })();
        const _iAccRgb = _iAccRgbCustom ?? _iAccRgbDefault;
        const _iSignage = (_iCust?.signage && _iCust.signage.trim().length > 0) ? _iCust.signage.trim().slice(0, 28) : null;
        const _iFloorType: 'carpet'|'tile'|'wood'|'concrete' = (() => {
          const bid = itr.bid;
          if (bid.includes('office') || bid === 'nexus_hub' || bid === 'admin_bureau' || bid === 'picassoo_hq' || bid === 'public_office') return 'carpet';
          if (bid === 'clinic' || bid === 'oxide_labs' || bid === 'megabank' || bid === 'gold_exchange') return 'tile';
          if (bid.includes('hotel') || bid === 'minx_arms' || bid === 'overlook' || bid.includes('flat') || bid.includes('apartment') || bid.includes('house') || bid.includes('villa')) return 'wood';
          return 'concrete';
        })();

        ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0806';
        ctx.fillRect(-40, -40, iDef.width + 80, iDef.height + 80);

        ctx.fillStyle = iDef.floorColor;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, iDef.width, iDef.height);

        const ITILE = INTERIOR_TILE;
        for (let tx = 0; tx < iDef.width; tx += ITILE) {
          for (let ty = 0; ty < iDef.height; ty += ITILE) {
            const fh = _tileHash(tx + iDef.width, ty + iDef.height);
            if (_iFloorType === 'tile') {
              ctx.fillStyle = fh > 0.5 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.03)';
              ctx.fillRect(tx, ty, ITILE, ITILE);
              if (fh > 0.85) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)'; ctx.fillRect(tx+1, ty+1, ITILE*0.4, ITILE*0.3); }
            } else if (_iFloorType === 'wood') {
              const plankShade = 0.03 + (fh * 0.04);
              ctx.fillStyle = fh > 0.5 ? `rgba(140,100,50,${plankShade})` : `rgba(90,60,30,${plankShade})`;
              ctx.fillRect(tx, ty, ITILE, ITILE);
              if (fh > 0.7) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,50,20,0.03)'; ctx.fillRect(tx+2, ty+ITILE*0.3, ITILE-4, 1); }
            } else if (_iFloorType === 'carpet') {
              const cv = fh * 0.06;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},${cv * 0.3})`;
              ctx.fillRect(tx, ty, ITILE, ITILE);
              if (fh > 0.8) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.02)`; ctx.fillRect(tx, ty, ITILE, ITILE); }
            } else {
              if (fh > 0.6) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)'; ctx.fillRect(tx, ty, ITILE, ITILE); }
              else if (fh < 0.2) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.04)'; ctx.fillRect(tx, ty, ITILE, ITILE); }
            }
          }
        }

        const _wallH = 24;
        const _wallDepth = 8;
        const _baseboardH = 3;
        const wallTopR = 85, wallTopG = 75, wallTopB = 60;
        const wallSideR = 70, wallSideG = 62, wallSideB = 48;

        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${wallTopR},${wallTopG},${wallTopB})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, iDef.width, _wallH);
        const wallGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, _wallH);
        wallGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)');
        wallGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        wallGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)');
        ctx.fillStyle = wallGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, iDef.width, _wallH);

        for (let wx = 0; wx < iDef.width; wx += 32) {
          const wh = _tileHash(wx, 999);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.02 + wh * 0.03})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.3;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(wx, 0); ctx.lineTo(wx, _wallH); ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.06)`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, _wallH - 2, iDef.width, 2);

        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${wallSideR},${wallSideG},${wallSideB})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, _wallDepth, iDef.height);
        ctx.fillRect(iDef.width - _wallDepth, 0, _wallDepth, iDef.height);
        const leftWallGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, _wallDepth, 0);
        leftWallGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)');
        leftWallGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)');
        ctx.fillStyle = leftWallGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, _wallDepth, iDef.height);
        const rightWallGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(iDef.width - _wallDepth, 0, iDef.width, 0);
        rightWallGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)');
        rightWallGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)');
        ctx.fillStyle = rightWallGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(iDef.width - _wallDepth, 0, _wallDepth, iDef.height);

        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(55,48,38)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, iDef.height - _baseboardH, iDef.width, _baseboardH);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, iDef.height - _baseboardH, iDef.width, 1);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(50,44,34)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, _wallH, _wallDepth, _baseboardH);
        ctx.fillRect(iDef.width - _wallDepth, _wallH, _wallDepth, _baseboardH);

        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.04)`;
        ctx.fillRect(_wallDepth, _wallH, iDef.width - _wallDepth*2, 1);

        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,180,140,0.12)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, iDef.width, iDef.height);

        // === OFFICE-MODE VISUAL OVERHAUL ===
        // Office floors get: branded wall banner, drop-ceiling fluorescent grid w/ flicker,
        // accent reception inlay. Detected via carpet floor type (offices, admin, HQs).
        const _isOfficeFloor = _iFloorType === 'carpet';
        if (_isOfficeFloor) {
          // 1. Branded wall accent banner along top wall — picks up floor accent color,
          //    becomes the floor's signature stripe; brighter for player-owned floors.
          ctx.save();
          const _bannerY = _wallH - 9;
          const _bannerH = 6;
          const _bannerX0 = _wallDepth + 24;
          const _bannerX1 = iDef.width - _wallDepth - 24;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.16)`;
          ctx.fillRect(_bannerX0, _bannerY, _bannerX1 - _bannerX0, _bannerH);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.42)`;
          ctx.fillRect(_bannerX0, _bannerY, _bannerX1 - _bannerX0, 1);
          ctx.fillRect(_bannerX0, _bannerY + _bannerH - 1, _bannerX1 - _bannerX0, 1);
          for (let _bx = _bannerX0 + 6; _bx < _bannerX1 - 6; _bx += 22) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.55)`;
            ctx.fillRect(_bx, _bannerY + 2, 10, 2);
          }
          // Floor label burned into the banner
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.85)`;
          ctx.font = 'bold 9px "Fira Code", monospace';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillText((_iSignage ?? iDef.label).toUpperCase(), iDef.width / 2, _bannerY + _bannerH / 2);
          // Work dress code notice — only on actual office floors. Tells the
          // player WHY their look changes on the clock; the swap itself is
          // rendered on the sprite and never written back to their save.
          if (isOfficeBuilding(g.interior?.bid ?? '')) {
            const _dc = !isWorkAppropriate(g.appearance ?? defaultAppearance(char.class.toLowerCase()));
            ctx.font = 'bold 5px "Fira Code", monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillStyle = _dc ? 'rgba(125,211,252,0.92)' : 'rgba(125,211,252,0.55)';
            ctx.fillText(
              _dc ? 'DRESS CODE — BUSINESS ATTIRE REQUIRED ON THE FLOOR' : 'DRESS CODE — BUSINESS ATTIRE',
              iDef.width / 2, _bannerY + _bannerH + 5,
            );
          }
          ctx.textAlign = 'left';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
          ctx.restore();

          // 2. Drop-ceiling fluorescent grid — soft circular light pools cast onto carpet,
          //    each with a thin diffuser bar at center. Dim flicker keyed by frame + position.
          ctx.save();
          const _lspX = 280, _lspY = 240;
          const _loffX = 160, _loffY = 140;
          for (let _lx = _loffX; _lx < iDef.width - 60; _lx += _lspX) {
            for (let _ly = _loffY; _ly < iDef.height - 60; _ly += _lspY) {
              const _flick = 0.84 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.014 + _lx * 0.011 + _ly * 0.013) * 0.16;
              const _lightGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(_lx, _ly, 6, _lx, _ly, 110);
              _lightGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,250,225,${0.11 * _flick})`);
              _lightGrad.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(255,245,210,${0.045 * _flick})`);
              _lightGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,200,0)');
              ctx.fillStyle = _lightGrad;
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(_lx, _ly, 110, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
              // Diffuser fixture
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,240,${0.24 * _flick})`;
              ctx.fillRect(_lx - 18, _ly - 4, 36, 8);
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.45 * _flick})`;
              ctx.fillRect(_lx - 16, _ly - 3, 32, 1);
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,30,15,0.32)';
              ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
              ctx.strokeRect(_lx - 18, _ly - 4, 36, 8);
              // Tiny corner mounts
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,15,10,0.4)';
              ctx.fillRect(_lx - 18, _ly - 4, 2, 2);
              ctx.fillRect(_lx + 16, _ly - 4, 2, 2);
              ctx.fillRect(_lx - 18, _ly + 2, 2, 2);
              ctx.fillRect(_lx + 16, _ly + 2, 2, 2);
            }
          }
          ctx.restore();

          // 3. Reception inlay rug — dashed accent border framing the front desk area
          ctx.save();
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.28)`;
          ctx.setLineDash([10, 7]);
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.strokeRect(iDef.width * 0.34, iDef.height - 210, iDef.width * 0.32, 95);
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
          // Inner accent line
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${_iAccRgb[0]},${_iAccRgb[1]},${_iAccRgb[2]},0.12)`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
          ctx.strokeRect(iDef.width * 0.34 + 4, iDef.height - 206, iDef.width * 0.32 - 8, 87);
          ctx.restore();
        }
        // === END OFFICE OVERHAUL ===

        // Utility-offline tint — properties with cut utilities render in
        // a brownout: heavy red-shifted dim over floor + walls. Furniture is
        // still drawn on top so the player can see what's there.
        if (_iIsOffline) {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,8,12,0.55)';
          ctx.fillRect(-_wallDepth, -_wallH, iDef.width + _wallDepth * 2, iDef.height + _wallH + _baseboardH);
          // Sparse "no signal" red flicker dots
          const _flickF = (Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08) * 0.5 + 0.5);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220,40,30,${0.18 + _flickF * 0.18})`;
          ctx.fillRect(iDef.width / 2 - 60, _wallH + 4, 120, 11);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,140,120,${0.45 + _flickF * 0.3})`;
          ctx.font = 'bold 8px "Fira Code", monospace';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillText('● UTILITIES CUT — PAY BILL TO RESTORE', iDef.width / 2, _wallH + 9);
          ctx.textAlign = 'left';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
          ctx.restore();
        }

        const _drawObjShadow = (sx: number, sy: number, sw: number, sh: number) => {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';
          ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, sy + sh, sw, 3);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';
          ctx.fillRect(sx + 3, sy + sh + 3, sw - 2, 2);
        };

        const _windowLightShaft = (wx: number, wy: number, ww: number, wh: number) => {
          if (!_isNight) {
            ctx.save();
            const shaftGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(wx, wy + wh, wx + ww * 2, wy + wh + 80);
            shaftGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,200,0.08)');
            shaftGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,200,0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = shaftGrad;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(wx, wy + wh);
            ctx.lineTo(wx + ww, wy + wh);
            ctx.lineTo(wx + ww * 2.5, wy + wh + 80);
            ctx.lineTo(wx + ww * 0.5, wy + wh + 80);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
          }
        };

        for (const obj of iDef.objects) {
          if (obj.type !== 'window' && obj.type !== 'door_lock') {
            _drawObjShadow(obj.x, obj.y, obj.w, obj.h);
          }
        }

        for (const obj of iDef.objects) {
          const osx = obj.x, osy = obj.y;

          if (obj.type === 'window') {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(50,42,32)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx - 1, osy - 1, obj.w + 2, obj.h + 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(65,55,42)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx, osy, obj.w, obj.h);
            if (_isNight) {
              const nightGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(osx, osy, osx, osy + obj.h);
              nightGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgb(12,18,35)');
              nightGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgb(8,12,25)');
              ctx.fillStyle = nightGrad;
              const starBlink = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.02 + osx) > 0.7;
              ctx.fillRect(osx + 2, osy + 2, obj.w - 4, obj.h - 4);
              if (starBlink) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(osx + obj.w * 0.3, osy + 5, 1, 1); ctx.fillRect(osx + obj.w * 0.7, osy + 8, 1, 1); }
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,180,80,0.06)';
              ctx.fillRect(osx + 2, osy + obj.h - 8, obj.w - 4, 6);
            } else {
              const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(osx, osy, osx, osy + obj.h);
              skyGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgb(140,180,230)');
              skyGrad.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgb(170,200,240)');
              skyGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgb(200,220,250)');
              ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
              ctx.fillRect(osx + 2, osy + 2, obj.w - 4, obj.h - 4);
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
              ctx.fillRect(osx + 3, osy + 3, (obj.w - 6) * 0.35, (obj.h - 6) * 0.4);
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,200,220,0.15)';
              ctx.fillRect(osx + 3, osy + obj.h * 0.7, obj.w - 6, 3);
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(55,45,35)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + obj.w / 2 - 0.7, osy, 1.4, obj.h);
            ctx.fillRect(osx, osy + obj.h / 2 - 0.7, obj.w, 1.4);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
            ctx.strokeRect(osx + 1, osy + 1, obj.w - 2, obj.h - 2);
            _windowLightShaft(osx, osy, obj.w, obj.h);
          } else if (obj.type === 'medical_bed') {
            // Frame
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(160,170,185)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx, osy, obj.w, obj.h);
            // Side rails (metal)
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(190,200,215)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + 2, osy + 2, obj.w - 4, obj.h - 4);
            // Mattress
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(230,235,240)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + 3, osy + 4, obj.w - 6, obj.h - 10);
            // Pillow
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(245,245,250)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + 3, osy + 4, obj.w - 6, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,190,200,0.5)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + 4, osy + 5, obj.w - 8, 5);
            // IV drip pole (right side)
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(150,155,165)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + obj.w - 4, osy + 2, 3, obj.h - 4);
            // IV bag
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(180,220,255)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + obj.w - 6, osy + 2, 5, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,200,255,0.6)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + obj.w - 5, osy + 3, 3, 3);
            // Vital monitor blink
            const blink = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06 + obj.x * 0.1) > 0.5;
            ctx.fillStyle = blink ? 'rgb(0,220,80)' : 'rgb(0,120,50)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + obj.w - 9, osy + 2, 4, 4);
            // Tube from IV
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,210,255,0.7)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(osx + obj.w - 4, osy + 6); ctx.lineTo(osx + obj.w - 8, osy + obj.h * 0.5); ctx.stroke();
          } else if (obj.type === 'bed') {
            // Bed frame (wood)
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(100,65,35)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx, osy, obj.w, obj.h);
            // Headboard
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(120,80,45)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx, osy, obj.w, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(90,58,30)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + 2, osy + 1, obj.w - 4, 3);
            // Footboard
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(110,72,40)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx, osy + obj.h - 4, obj.w, 4);
            // Mattress / blanket
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(70,100,130)';
            ctx.fillRect(osx + 3, osy + 5, obj.w - 6, obj.h - 12);
            // Blanket fold highlight
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,160,190,0.4)';

            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx + fw_px / 2, fy + fh_px * 0.45, fw_px * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

            ctx.fillStyle = fDef.variants.find(v => v.id === pf.variantId)?.accent ?? variant.color;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx + fw_px / 2 + sway, fy + fh_px * 0.2, fw_px * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          } else if (fDef.category === 'beds') {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(110,75,45)';
            ctx.fillRect(fx, fy, fw_px, fh_px);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(90,60,35)';
            ctx.fillRect(fx, fy, fw_px, 4); ctx.fillRect(fx, fy + fh_px - 4, fw_px, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = variant.color;
            ctx.fillRect(fx + 3, fy + 5, fw_px - 6, fh_px - 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(220,210,190)';
            ctx.fillRect(fx + 3, fy + 5, fw_px - 6, 8);
          } else if (fDef.category === 'seating' && (fDef.id === 'sofa_2seat' || fDef.id === 'armchair')) {
            ctx.fillStyle = (variant.accent ?? variant.color).replace(/[0-9.]+\)$/, '1)');
            ctx.fillRect(fx, fy, fw_px, fh_px);
            ctx.fillStyle = variant.color;
            ctx.fillRect(fx + 3, fy + 3, fw_px - 6, fh_px - 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = (variant.accent ?? variant.color);
            ctx.fillRect(fx, fy, fw_px, 4);
          } else if (fDef.category === 'decor' && fDef.id === 'fireplace') {
            ctx.fillStyle = variant.color;
            ctx.fillRect(fx, fy, fw_px, fh_px);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(15,15,20)';
            ctx.fillRect(fx + 4, fy + 3, fw_px - 8, fh_px - 5);
            const flamePulse = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,100,20,${flamePulse})`;
            ctx.fillRect(fx + 6, fy + 5, fw_px - 12, fh_px - 8);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,50,${flamePulse * 0.8})`;
            ctx.fillRect(fx + 8, fy + 7, fw_px - 16, fh_px - 12);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = variant.color;
            ctx.fillRect(fx, fy, fw_px, fh_px);
            if (variant.accent) {
              ctx.fillStyle = variant.accent;
              ctx.fillRect(fx + 2, fy + 2, fw_px - 4, 3);
            }
          }
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
          ctx.strokeRect(fx, fy, fw_px, fh_px);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,210,190,0.7)';
          ctx.font = `5px "Fira Code"`;
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(fDef.name, fx + fw_px / 2, fy + fh_px / 2 + 2);
          ctx.restore();

        // ── Decoration mode overlay ──────────────────────────────────────────
        if (decorModeRef.current && itr.bid === (g.interior?.bid ?? '')) {
          const iw = iDef.width; const ih = iDef.height;
          const ghost = decorGhostPosRef.current;

          if (ghost && selItem) {
            const rot = decorRotationRef.current;
            const fw2 = (rot === 90 || rot === 270) ? selItem.gridH : selItem.gridW;
            const fh2 = (rot === 90 || rot === 270) ? selItem.gridW : selItem.gridH;
            const gx3 = ghost.gridX * FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE;
            const gy3 = ghost.gridY * FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE;
            const fw2px = fw2 * FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE;
            const fh2px = fh2 * FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE;

            const clampedX2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(ghost.gridX, Math.floor(iDef.width / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE) - fw2));
            const clampedY2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(ghost.gridY, Math.floor(iDef.height / FURNITURE_GRID_SIZE) - fh2));

              return !(clampedX2 >= pf.gridX + pw2 || clampedX2 + fw2 <= pf.gridX ||

            ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(selItem.name, gx3 + fw2px / 2, gy3 + fh2px / 2 + 2);
          }
          const dmPulse = 0.4 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06) * 0.3;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${dmPulse * 0.9})`;
          ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';

          const isVending = nObj.type === 'vending_machine';
          const isWhiteboard = nObj.type === 'whiteboard';
          const isElevator = nObj.type === 'elevator';
          const isDoorLock = nObj.type === 'door_lock';
          const isBed = nObj.type === 'bed';
          const isMedBed = nObj.type === 'medical_bed';
          const isDesk = nObj.type === 'desk';
          const isChair = nObj.type === 'chair' || nObj.type === 'couch';
          const isLocker = nObj.type === 'locker';
          const isFiling = nObj.type === 'filing_cabinet';

          const isNightstand = nObj.type === 'nightstand';
          const isCrate = nObj.type === 'crate';
          const isEquipment = nObj.type === 'equipment';

          const isGenTerminal = nObj.type === 'terminal' && !(nObj.label && PUBLIC_OFFICE_TERMINALS.has(nObj.label) && itr.bid === 'public_office');

          const isConferenceTable = nObj.type === 'conference_table';

          if (isTerminal) prompt = g.officeTerminalRenting?.label === nObj.label ? '[E] RELEASE' : '[E] RENT';
          else if (isGenTerminal) prompt = '[E] USE TERMINAL';
          else if (isWhiteboard) prompt = '[E] WRITE';
          else if (isElevator) prompt = '[E] FLOORS';
          else if (isDoorLock) prompt = HOME_PASSWORDS.has(itr.bid) ? '[E] LOCK' : '[E] SET LOCK';
          else if (isVending) prompt = '[E] SHOP';
          else if (isMedBed) prompt = '[E] USE BED';
          else if (isBed) prompt = '[E] SLEEP';
          else if (isDesk) prompt = '[E] SEARCH DESK';
          else if (isChair) prompt = '[E] SIT';
          else if (isLocker) prompt = '[E] SEARCH';
          else if (isFiling) prompt = '[E] SEARCH FILES';
          else if (isBookshelf) prompt = '[E] READ (+XP)';
          else if (isNightstand) prompt = '[E] SEARCH';
          else if (isCrate) prompt = '[E] OPEN';
          else if (isEquipment) prompt = '[E] EXAMINE (+XP)';
          else if (isCounter) prompt = '[E] SEARCH';
          else if (isTable) prompt = '[E] SEARCH';
          else if (isShelf) prompt = '[E] SEARCH';
          else if (isPlant) prompt = '[E] EXAMINE';
          else if (isReception) prompt = '[E] CHECK IN (+XP)';
          else if (isPhotocopier) prompt = '[E] USE COPIER';

            ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';

        const exX = iDef.exitX, exY = iDef.exitY;
        const exitPulse = 0.4 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06) * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${exitPulse * 0.15})`;
        ctx.fillRect(exX, exY, iDef.exitW, iDef.exitH);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${exitPulse * 0.6})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(exX, exY, iDef.exitW, iDef.exitH);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${exitPulse * 0.8})`;
        ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';

        for (const obj of iDef.objects) {
          if (obj.type === 'arcade_machine' && obj.gameId) {

            if (Math.hypot(itr.px - ocx, itr.py - ocy) < 35) {
              ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(255,0,255,.9)' : 'rgba(255,0,255,.3)';

              ctx.fillText(`[E] PLAY — 1 FIAT`, ocx, obj.y - 6);
            }
          }
          if (obj.type === 'elevator' && obj.label === 'SECRET STAIRCASE') {
            const ocx = obj.x + obj.w / 2, ocy = obj.y + obj.h / 2;
            if (Math.hypot(itr.px - ocx, itr.py - ocy) < 35) {

              ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';

            if (Math.hypot(itr.px - ocx, itr.py - ocy) < 30) {
              ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(0,200,255,.9)' : 'rgba(0,200,255,.3)';

        if (g.near === '__interior_exit') {

          ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] EXIT', exX + iDef.exitW / 2, exY - 6);
        }

        // ── NPC sprite helper — draws a role-appropriate character ────────────
        const drawInteriorNpcSprite = (nx: number, ny: number, name: string, role: string, hostile: boolean, seed: number, serial?: string | null, isPrime?: boolean, isHovered?: boolean) => {
          const roleLow = role.toLowerCase();
          const isForeman = roleLow === 'foreman' || name === 'JEAN CLAW';
          const isClawWorker = roleLow.includes('finance') || roleLow.includes('sales') || roleLow.includes('creative') || roleLow.includes('operations') || roleLow.includes('trades') || roleLow.includes('publishing') || roleLow.includes('music') || roleLow.includes('education') || roleLow.includes('logistics') || roleLow.includes('e-commerce') || roleLow.includes('design') || roleLow.includes('insurance') || roleLow.includes('real estate') || roleLow.includes('legal') || roleLow.includes('medical') || roleLow.includes('core');
          const isDoc = !isForeman && !isClawWorker && (roleLow.includes('doc') || roleLow.includes('phys') || roleLow.includes('nurse') || roleLow.includes('med'));
          const isGuard2 = !isForeman && !isClawWorker && (roleLow.includes('guard') || roleLow.includes('security') || roleLow.includes('police') || roleLow.includes('cop') || roleLow.includes('officer') || hostile);
          const isCleaner2 = !isForeman && !isClawWorker && (roleLow.includes('clean') || roleLow.includes('maid') || roleLow.includes('jan'));
          const isCorp2 = !isForeman && !isClawWorker && (roleLow.includes('manager') || roleLow.includes('exec') || roleLow.includes('director') || roleLow.includes('chief') || roleLow.includes('teller') || roleLow.includes('broker') || roleLow.includes('clerk') || roleLow.includes('host'));
          const nBob2 = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.04 + nx * 0.07) * 0.8;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(nx, ny + 7, 5, 1.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          // Legs
          if (isForeman) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2010'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 2, 3, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1008'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 6, 3, 2); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 6, 3, 2);
          } else if (isClawWorker) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a2a2a'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 2, 3, 5);
          } else if (isGuard2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a22'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 2, 3, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 6, 3, 2); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 6, 3, 2);
          } else if (isDoc) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#334455'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 2, 3, 5);
          } else if (isCleaner2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a3a'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 2, 3, 5);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#222233'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 3, ny + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx, ny + 2, 3, 5);
          }
          // Body
          if (isForeman) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2a10'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 5 + nBob2, 10, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f0d060'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 1, ny - 4 + nBob2, 2, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#aa8020'; ctx.fillRect(nx, ny - 3 + nBob2, 1, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a08'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 6, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4); ctx.fillRect(nx + 4, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f0c040'; ctx.fillRect(nx + 3, ny - 4 + nBob2, 1, 1);
          } else if (isClawWorker) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3535'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 5 + nBob2, 10, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2a5555'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 1, ny - 4 + nBob2, 2, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0a2525'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 6, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4); ctx.fillRect(nx + 4, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4);
          } else if (isGuard2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = hostile ? '#3a1515' : '#1a2235';
            ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 5 + nBob2, 10, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = hostile ? '#cc2233' : '#4466aa';
            ctx.fillRect(nx - 1, ny - 4 + nBob2, 2, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = hostile ? '#552222' : '#2a3a55';
            ctx.fillRect(nx - 6, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4); ctx.fillRect(nx + 4, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4);
          } else if (isDoc) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ddeeff'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 5 + nBob2, 10, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#aaccdd'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 1, ny - 4 + nBob2, 2, 5);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#336677'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx + 2, ny - 1 + nBob2, 2, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
          } else if (isCleaner2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#336633'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 5 + nBob2, 10, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#224422'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 1, ny - 4 + nBob2, 2, 5);
          } else if (isCorp2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a3a'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 5 + nBob2, 10, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 1, ny - 4 + nBob2, 2, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1111'; ctx.fillRect(nx, ny - 3 + nBob2, 1, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2a'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 4, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4); ctx.fillRect(nx + 2, ny - 5 + nBob2, 2, 4);
          } else {
            const nColorArr2 = ['#333355','#443355','#335544','#554433'];
            ctx.fillStyle = nColorArr2[seed % nColorArr2.length]; ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 5 + nBob2, 10, 7);
          }
          // Arms
          const narmCol2 = isForeman ? '#3a2a10' : isClawWorker ? '#1a3535' : isGuard2 ? (hostile ? '#3a1515' : '#1a2235') : isDoc ? '#ddeeff' : isCleaner2 ? '#336633' : isCorp2 ? '#2a2a3a' : '#333355';
          ctx.fillStyle = narmCol2;
          ctx.fillRect(nx - 8, ny - 4 + nBob2, 3, 6); ctx.fillRect(nx + 5, ny - 4 + nBob2, 3, 6);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a07a';
          ctx.fillRect(nx - 8, ny + 1 + nBob2, 3, 2); ctx.fillRect(nx + 5, ny + 1 + nBob2, 3, 2);
          // Neck + head
          ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a07a'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 1, ny - 7 + nBob2, 3, 3);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a07a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx, ny - 11 + nBob2, 3.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#111'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 2, ny - 12 + nBob2, 1, 1); ctx.fillRect(nx + 1, ny - 12 + nBob2, 1, 1);
          // Hair / hat
          if (isForeman) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1008'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 4, ny - 16 + nBob2, 8, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f0c040'; ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 14 + nBob2, 10, 1);
          } else if (isClawWorker) {
            const cwHair = ['#1a1a1a','#2a1a00','#0a1a1a','#222222'];
            ctx.fillStyle = cwHair[seed % cwHair.length]; ctx.fillRect(nx - 4, ny - 16 + nBob2, 8, 4);
          } else if (isGuard2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = hostile ? '#882222' : '#334466';
            ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 17 + nBob2, 10, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = hostile ? '#662222' : '#223355';
            ctx.fillRect(nx - 6, ny - 14 + nBob2, 12, 2);
          } else {
            const hairArr2 = ['#2a1800','#1a1a1a','#553322','#334455'];
            ctx.fillStyle = hairArr2[seed % hairArr2.length]; ctx.fillRect(nx - 4, ny - 16 + nBob2, 8, 4);
          }
          // Labels — names are PRIVATE. Default shows the serial (org units) or
          // role (originals); the real name reveals on hover. Primes show their
          // name in gold (they are the advertised faces of the org).
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          const labelY2 = ny - 20 + nBob2;
          const prime2 = isPrime ?? (name === 'JEAN CLAW' || isPrimeName(name));
          if (prime2) {
            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,200,60,.85)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,80,.97)'; ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText(name, nx, labelY2);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,80,.5)'; ctx.font = '4px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText('PRIME', nx, labelY2 + 5);
          } else if (isHovered) {
            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(56,189,248,.95)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 7;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(236,246,255,.98)'; ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText(name, nx, labelY2);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.6)'; ctx.font = '4px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText(serial ?? role, nx, labelY2 + 5);
          } else if (serial) {
            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.88)'; ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText(serial, nx, labelY2);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,170,190,.62)'; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText(role, nx, labelY2);
          }
          if (isForeman) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,192,64,.15)';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx, ny - 2 + nBob2, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        };

        if (iDef.workers) {
          for (const w of iDef.workers) {
            const wx = w.x, wy = w.y;
            const wSeed = (w.name.charCodeAt(0) + w.name.length) % 8;
            const wHover = !!(hoverMouseRef.current && Math.hypot(wx - hoverMouseRef.current.x, wy - hoverMouseRef.current.y) < 16);
            drawInteriorNpcSprite(wx, wy, w.name, w.role, !!w.hostile, wSeed, w.serial ?? null, w.isPrime ?? isPrimeName(w.name), wHover);
            const nearW = Math.hypot(itr.px - wx, itr.py - wy) < 30;
            if (nearW && w.hostile) {
              ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(255,60,60,.9)' : 'rgba(255,60,60,.3)';
              ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.fillText('⚠ HOSTILE', wx, wy + 14);
            } else if (nearW && !w.hostile) {
              ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(0,200,255,.9)' : 'rgba(0,200,255,.4)';
              ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.fillText('[E] TALK', wx, wy + 16);
            }
          }

                ctx.rotate(g.aimAngle);
                ctx.fillStyle = bCol; ctx.shadowColor = bGlow; ctx.shadowBlur = 2;
                ctx.fillRect(0, -bH / 2, bW, bH);
                ctx.fillRect(4, bH / 2, 2, 4);
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.restore();
              } else {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#556677'; ctx.fillRect(ipHandX - 2, ipHandY - 4, 4, 8);
              }
            }
          }
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }

        ctx.fillStyle = iDef.accentColor;
        ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(iDef.label, iDef.width / 2, -8);

        if (iDef.ambientText) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.2)';
          ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(iDef.ambientText, iDef.width / 2, iDef.height + 14);
        }

        if (g.interiorFade > 0) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${g.interiorFade})`;
          ctx.fillRect(-40, -40, iDef.width + 80, iDef.height + 80);
        }

        ctx.restore();
        scheduleNextFrame();
        return;
      }

      // Proximity check — the active vertical layer owns its own interactables.
      // Underground POIs deliberately reuse `g.near` so keyboard, controller,
      // and mobile all flow through the same interaction key path.
      let nb: string | null = null;
      if (g.worldLayer === 'underground') {
        if (Math.hypot(g.px - UNDERGROUND_EXIT.x, g.py - UNDERGROUND_EXIT.y) < 78) {
          nb = '__underground_exit';
        } else {
          const poi = UNDERGROUND_POIS.find(p => Math.hypot(g.px - p.x, g.py - p.y) < p.radius);
          if (poi) nb = `__underground_poi:${poi.id}`;
        }
      } else {
        for (const b of BUILDINGS) { if (Math.hypot(g.px - (b.x + b.w / 2), g.py - (b.y + b.h / 2)) < RANGE + (b.id === 'pablo_tower' ? 40 : 0)) { nb = b.id; break; } }
      }
      g.near = nb;
      if (nb !== lastNear) {
        if (lastNear && RADIO_BUILDINGS.has(lastNear) && (!nb || !RADIO_BUILDINGS.has(nb)) && !g.hasRadioImplant) {
          hideRadio();
        }
        lastNear = nb; setNear(nb);
        if (nb?.startsWith('__underground_poi:')) {
          const poi = UNDERGROUND_POIS.find(p => p.id === nb!.slice('__underground_poi:'.length));
          if (poi) setNarr(`> ${poi.title} — ${poi.description} [E] to interact.`);
        } else if (nb === '__underground_exit') {
          setNarr('> DEEP LINE ELEVATOR — [E] return to Metro Central / surface.');
        } else if (nb) {
          const b = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === nb);
          const lk = g.locks.get(nb);
          if (nb === 'pablo_tower') setNarr('> ' + towerNarrName() + ' — The city trembles at its shadow. [E] to approach.');
          else if (lk?.ownerName) {
            const who = lk.company ? `${lk.ownerName} / ${lk.company}` : lk.ownerName;
            const msg = lk.message ? ` "${lk.message}"` : '';
            setNarr(`> ${b?.label} [LOCKED by ${who}]${msg} — [E] to attempt entry.`);
          }
          else {
            const cost = BUILDING_COST[nb];
            const costLabel = BUILDING_COST_LABEL[nb];
            if (cost && cost > 0) setNarr(`> ${b?.label} [${costLabel} FIAT] — press [E] to enter. Earn FIAT to access.`);
            else if (costLabel === 'FREE') setNarr(`> ${b?.label} [FREE] — press [E] to enter.`);
            else if (costLabel === 'SHOP') setNarr(`> ${b?.label} [SHOP] — press [E] to browse. FIAT required to purchase.`);
            else setNarr(`> ${b?.label} — press [E] to enter.`);
          }
        }
      }
      // Proximity check — NPCs (only when no building nearby)
      let nn: number | null = null;
      if (!nb) { for (let i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) { const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(NPCS[i], g.worldTime ?? 0); if (Math.hypot(g.px - sp.x, g.py - sp.y) < NPC_RANGE) { nn = i; break; } } }
      g.nearNpc = nn;
      if (nn !== lastNearNpc) {
        lastNearNpc = nn; setNearNpc(nn);
        if (nn !== null && !nb) setNarr(`> ${NPCS[nn].name} — press [E] to listen.`);
      }

      // Proximity check — enemies (show [F] attack prompt if close enough)
      if (!nb && nn === null) {
        const nearStray = !g.dogCompanion.active ? g.threats.find(t => t.type === 'STRAY_DOG' && Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y) < 60) : null;
        const nearStrayCat = !g.catCompanion.active ? g.threats.find(t => t.type === 'STRAY_CAT' && Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y) < 60) : null;
        if (nearStray) {
          setNarr('> STRAY DOG — Wary eyes. Wagging tail. Press [E] to adopt this companion.');
        } else if (nearStrayCat) {
          setNarr('> STRAY CAT — Slow blink. Tail held high. Press [E] to adopt this companion.');
        } else {
          const nearLoot = g.deadBodies.find(b => !b.looted && b.type !== 'PLAYER' && (b.bounty ?? 0) > 0 && Math.hypot(g.px - b.x, g.py - b.y) < 40);
          if (nearLoot) {
            setNarr(`> LOOTABLE BODY [${nearLoot.type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}] — ƒ${(nearLoot.bounty ?? 0).toLocaleString()} FIAT. Press [E] or [Click] to loot.`);
          } else {
            const nearEnemy = g.threats.find(t => Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y) < 90);
            if (nearEnemy) {
              const typeLabel = nearEnemy.type.replace(/_/g, ' ');
              const isAnimalE = ANIMAL_TYPES.has(nearEnemy.type);
              const bountyLabel = isAnimalE ? 'Drops: FOOD ITEMS' : `Bounty: ƒ${(BOUNTY[nearEnemy.type] ?? 1000).toLocaleString()}`;
              setNarr(`> ${typeLabel} [HP: ${Math.floor(nearEnemy.hp)}/${nearEnemy.maxHp}] — [Space] melee · [Click] shoot. ${bountyLabel}.`);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Proximity check — Billboards
      let nbb: string | null = null;
      if (!nb && nn === null) {
        for (const bb of BILLBOARDS) {
          if (Math.hypot(g.px - bb.x, g.py - bb.y) < 80) { nbb = bb.locationId; break; }
        }
      }
      g.nearBillboard = nbb;
      if (nbb !== lastNearBb) {
        lastNearBb = nbb; setNearBillboard(nbb);
        if (nbb) {
          const bb = BILLBOARDS.find(b => b.locationId === nbb);
          if (bb) setNarr(`> ${bb.label} — press [E] to view billboard marketplace.`);
        }
      }

      // Proximity check — Manholes (sewer system)
      let nmh: number | null = null;
      if (!nb && nn === null && !g.inSewer) {
        for (let mi = 0; mi < MANHOLES.length; mi++) {
          if (Math.hypot(g.px - MANHOLES[mi].x, g.py - MANHOLES[mi].y) < MANHOLE_RANGE) { nmh = mi; break; }
        }
      }
      if (nmh !== g.nearManhole) {
        g.nearManhole = nmh;
        if (nmh !== null) setNarr('> MANHOLE — Sewer access point. Press [E] to descend into the sewer network.');
      }
      if (g.sewerExitTimer > 0) g.sewerExitTimer--;

      // Proximity — MX-75 uplink beacon (story trigger). Only "live" once the
      // player has finished their first project (job or business); the server
      // re-verifies on commit, this is just the in-world prompt gate.
      if (!g.story?.active) {
        const _nearStory = canContactStoryBeacon(
          g.story?.active, g.employedAt, g.businesses?.length ?? 0, g.px, g.py,
        );
        if (_nearStory !== g.nearStoryTrigger) {
          g.nearStoryTrigger = _nearStory;
          if (_nearStory) setNarr('> ' + STORY_TRIGGER.label + ' — A dormant uplink pulses in the plaza. Press [E] to make contact. WARNING: this is a one-way door.');
        }
      } else if (g.nearStoryTrigger) {
        g.nearStoryTrigger = false;
      }

      // SCENE 1 — ESCAPE phase tracking. While the story is begun and the player
      // is in the playable escape, watch for the BACK ALLEY waypoint (flavor) and
      // arrival at the UNDERGROUND CAMP, which flips into the CLAIM cinematic.
      if (g.sceneRun && g.sceneRun.phase === 'escape' && g.story?.active) {
        const hb = g.story.homeBase ?? STORY_HOME;
        const distToCamp = Math.hypot(g.px - hb.x, g.py - hb.y);
        // Run the three escape milestone gates IN ORDER (descent → battle → claim)
        // through the pure helper so the ordering is a unit-tested contract: a
        // beeliner trips descent+battle in one frame, but the claim can never fire
        // in the same frame the battle starts (it's gated on battleDone, which
        // only flips on the battle's async onComplete below). See stepScene1EscapeFrame.
        const step = stepScene1EscapeFrame({
          sceneRun: g.sceneRun,
          distToVent: Math.hypot(g.px - STORY_ALLEY.x, g.py - STORY_ALLEY.y),
          ventRadius: STORY_ALLEY.r,
          distToCamp,
          battleActive: activeBattleRef.current,
        });
        for (const ev of step.events) {
          if (ev === 'descent') {
            // Midpoint: drop into the service vent / abandoned-floor descent.
            g.sceneRun.alleyReached = true;
            persistScene1Progress();
            setNarr('> SERVICE VENT — You drop into the abandoned floors. MILA (static): "—got you on a back-channel. Keep going down."');
          } else if (ev === 'battle-start') {
            // Culminating staged battle: PABLO CORP security seals the descent.
            // NON-LETHAL, so win OR lose the mission proceeds (see
            // makeShadowTowerEscapeBattle); the onComplete hook flips battleDone
            // and is what gates the camp claim.
            g.sceneRun.battleStarted = true;
            persistScene1Progress();
            setNarr('> SHADOW TOWER — BREAKOUT. PABLO CORP security blocks the vents. Fight through!');
            startBattle(makeShadowTowerEscapeBattle(g.level), () => {
              const gg = gs.current;
              if (gg.sceneRun) gg.sceneRun.battleDone = true;
              persistScene1Progress();
              setNarr('> The way down is clear. MILA: "Move — the UNDERGROUND CAMP is just below. I\'ll meet you there."');
            });
          } else if (ev === 'claim') {
            // Only after the breakout battle is won can the player CLAIM the camp.
            g.sceneRun.phase = 'claim';
            g.px = hb.x; g.py = hb.y;
            setSceneCine({ id: 'and_it_all_falls_down', phase: 'claim', startTime: Date.now() });
          }
        }
      }

      if (g.frame % 15 === 0) {
        let nearbyCount = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) {
          const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(NPCS[i], g.worldTime ?? 0);
          if (Math.hypot(g.px - sp.x, g.py - sp.y) < 600) nearbyCount++;
        }
        updateCrowdMurmurVolume(nearbyCount);
      }

      if (g.frame % 20 === 0) {
        const convos = activeConvosRef.current;
        for (let ci = convos.length - 1; ci >= 0; ci--) {
          const prev = convos[ci];
          const ev = tickConversationEvent(prev, 0.33);
          convos[ci] = ev;
          if (ev.currentLine !== prev.currentLine && !ev.finished) {
            const lineObj = ev.lines[ev.currentLine];
            const speakerName = lineObj?.speaker ?? '';
            const isPlayer = speakerName === 'YOU';
            if (!isPlayer) {
              const seed = (speakerName.charCodeAt(0) * 31 + speakerName.charCodeAt(Math.max(0, speakerName.length - 1))) % 200;
              sfxNpcMurmur(seed);
              // Major characters also speak in their own ElevenLabs voice
              if (lineObj?.text) speakNpcLine(speakerName, lineObj.text);
            }
          }
          if (ev.finished) { convos.splice(ci, 1); }
        }
      }

      if (g.frame % 300 === 0 && !g.interior && activeConvosRef.current.length < 3) {
        const pedestrians = NPCS.filter(n => n.role === 'pedestrian' || n.role === 'corpo_worker' || n.role === 'homeless');
        for (const officer of NPCS) {
          if (officer.role !== 'police' && officer.role !== 'corpo_military') continue;
          const oPos = getNpcSchedulePos(officer, g.worldTime ?? 0);
          const distToPlayer = Math.hypot(g.px - oPos.x, g.py - oPos.y);
          const pabloTwr = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'pablo_tower');
          const nearCorpZone = officer.role !== 'corpo_military' || (pabloTwr && Math.hypot(oPos.x - (pabloTwr.x + pabloTwr.w / 2), oPos.y - (pabloTwr.y + pabloTwr.h / 2)) < 400) || NPCS.some(cw => cw.role === 'corpo_worker' && Math.hypot(oPos.x - getNpcSchedulePos(cw, g.worldTime ?? 0).x, oPos.y - getNpcSchedulePos(cw, g.worldTime ?? 0).y) < 250);
          if (distToPlayer < 150 && Math.random() < 0.15 && nearCorpZone) {
            const playerStopLines: ConversationLine[] = officer.role === 'police'
              ? [
                  { speaker: officer.name, text: 'You. Stop right there. Identification.', gender: officer.gender as 'm' | 'f' },
                  { speaker: 'YOU', text: '...', gender: 'm' },
                  { speaker: officer.name, text: officer.personality === 'corrupt_bureaucratic' ? 'These papers look... negotiable. ƒ200 and we forget this happened.' : 'Move along. Quickly.', gender: officer.gender as 'm' | 'f' },
                ]
              : [
                  { speaker: officer.name, text: 'Halt. You are within PABLO CORP jurisdiction. State your purpose.', gender: officer.gender as 'm' | 'f' },
                  { speaker: 'YOU', text: '...', gender: 'm' },
                  { speaker: officer.name, text: 'No badge. No purpose. You have five seconds to vacate.', gender: officer.gender as 'm' | 'f' },
                ];
            activeConvosRef.current.push(createConversationEvent(oPos.x, oPos.y, playerStopLines));
            setNarr(`> ${officer.name} stops you. "${playerStopLines[0].text}"`);
            { const s = officer.name; sfxNpcMurmur((s.charCodeAt(0) * 31 + s.charCodeAt(Math.max(0, s.length - 1))) % 200); }
            speakNpcLine(officer.name, playerStopLines[0].text);
            continue;
          }
          for (const ped of pedestrians) {
            const pPos = getNpcSchedulePos(ped, g.worldTime ?? 0);
            const dist = Math.hypot(oPos.x - pPos.x, oPos.y - pPos.y);
            if (dist < 120 && Math.random() < 0.12) {
              const dialogs = officer.role === 'police'
                ? POLICE_STOP_DIALOGS[Math.floor(Math.random() * POLICE_STOP_DIALOGS.length)]
                : CORPO_MILITARY_STOP_DIALOGS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CORPO_MILITARY_STOP_DIALOGS.length)];
              activeConvosRef.current.push(createConversationEvent(oPos.x, oPos.y, dialogs));
              { const s = dialogs[0]?.speaker ?? ''; if (s && s !== 'YOU') { sfxNpcMurmur((s.charCodeAt(0) * 31 + s.charCodeAt(Math.max(0, s.length - 1))) % 200); if (dialogs[0]?.text) speakNpcLine(s, dialogs[0].text); } }
              break;
            }
          }
          if (activeConvosRef.current.length >= 3) break;
        }
      }

      if (g.frame % 45 === 0 && !g.interior) {
        if (g.calendar.weather === 'RAIN' || g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN') sfxWeatherRain(g.px, g.py);
        if (g.calendar.weather === 'SNOW' || g.calendar.weather === 'DUST' || g.calendar.weather === 'STORM') sfxWeatherWind();
      }

      if (g.frame % 60 === 0 && !g.interior) {
        for (let i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) {
          const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(NPCS[i], g.worldTime ?? 0);
          const d = Math.hypot(g.px - sp.x, g.py - sp.y);
          if (d < 300 && d > 40) {
            const surface = inCityBounds(sp.x, sp.y) ? 'concrete' : 'dirt';
            sfxSpatialStep(g.px, g.py, sp.x, sp.y, surface);
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (g.frame % 300 === 0 && !g.interior && inCityBounds(g.px, g.py)) {
        if (Math.random() < 0.25) {
          const vx = g.px + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 600;
          const vy = g.py + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400;
          sfxVehicle(g.px, g.py, vx, vy);
        }
        if (Math.random() < 0.15) {
          const mx = g.px + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 500;
          const my = g.py + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 500;
          sfxMachinery(g.px, g.py, mx, my);
        }
      }

      const newZone = getCurrentSector(g.px, g.py);
      if (newZone !== lastZone) { lastZone = newZone; g.zone = newZone; setZone(newZone); sfxZoneCross(); reportMissionProgress('districtsVisited', 1); }

      // Gang zone detection
      let newGang: string | null = null;
      for (const gz of GANG_ZONES) {
        if (g.px >= gz.x && g.px <= gz.x + gz.w && g.py >= gz.y && g.py <= gz.y + gz.h) { newGang = gz.id; break; }
      }
      if (newGang !== g.gangZone) {
        g.gangZone = newGang; setGangZone(newGang);
        if (newGang !== lastGangZ) {
          lastGangZ = newGang;
          if (newGang) {
            const factionId = newGang.replace('_frag', '');
            try {
              const raw = localStorage.getItem('sm_visited_factions');
              const visited: string[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
              if (!visited.includes(factionId)) { visited.push(factionId); localStorage.setItem('sm_visited_factions', JSON.stringify(visited)); }
            } catch {}
          }
          const pc = char.class.toLowerCase();
          const allyGangs = GANG_FACTION_ALLIES[pc] ?? [];
          const enemyGangs = GANG_FACTION_ENEMIES[pc] ?? [];
          const baseGang = newGang?.replace('_frag', '') ?? '';
          const isFrag = newGang?.endsWith('_frag') ?? false;
          const factionTag = baseGang && allyGangs.includes(baseGang) ? ' [ALLIED — safe passage]' : baseGang && enemyGangs.includes(baseGang) ? ' [HOSTILE — enemy territory!]' : '';
          const fragTag = isFrag ? ' (OUTPOST — fractured territory)' : '';
          if (baseGang === 'minx_city') setNarr(`> ${CITY_NAME} LIMITS${factionTag}${fragTag} — The dominant faction. SENIOR PABLO's reach extends even here. The other gangs operate in their shadow.`);
          else if (baseGang === 'rust_syndicate') setNarr(`> RUST SYNDICATE TERRITORY${factionTag}${fragTag} — Spray-paint everywhere: GAME OVER / NO CONTINUES. These are PIKE RENNER's old crew. He doesn't claim them anymore.`);
          else if (baseGang === 'void_runners') setNarr(`> VOID RUNNERS TERRITORY${factionTag}${fragTag} — They broadcast static on loop. The code in the static is an old arcade game. Nobody has decoded it. Nobody that lived, anyway.`);
          else if (baseGang === 'static_monks') setNarr(`> STATIC MONKS TERRITORY${factionTag}${fragTag} — Silent. They move like shadows. KAEL VERNE says they guard something buried here from before the collapse.`);
          else if (baseGang === 'eastern_bloc') setNarr(`> EASTERN BLOC TERRITORY${factionTag}${fragTag} — They don't speak. They don't negotiate. NOVA PRYCE tracked their signal origin back to a server in SHADOW TOWER. Nobody was surprised.`);

        }
      }

      // Survival tick — every 540 frames (~9s)
      g.survivalTick++;
      if (g.survivalTick >= 540) {
        g.survivalTick = 0;
        const inWaste = !inCityBounds(g.px, g.py);
        const cs2 = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
        const wasteMultiplier = (cs2.wasteBonus && inWaste) ? 0.6 : 1.0;
        const hDrain = (inWaste ? 1.5 : 0.9) * wasteMultiplier;
        let tDrain = (inWaste ? 1.8 : 1.2) * wasteMultiplier;
        let eDrain = char.class.toLowerCase() === 'replicant' ? 0 : ((inWaste ? 0.9 : 0.6) * wasteMultiplier);

        const temp = getTemperatureLevel(g.calendar.season, g.calendar.weather, g.calendar.hour);
        g.temperature = temp;
        setTemperatureDisplay(temp);
        const isIndoors = !!g.interior;
        if (!isIndoors) {
          if (temp === 'COLD') {
            eDrain += 1.5;
            if (!gamePausedRef.current) { g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 1); g.deathReason = 'Died from hypothermia — exposure to extreme cold'; }
          }
          if (temp === 'HOT') {
            tDrain += 2.0;
          }
        }
        if (isIndoors) {
          const idleMs = Date.now() - g.lastMoveTime;
          if (idleMs > 2000) {
            const nearBld = (g.interior as { bid: string } | null)?.bid ?? '';
            const isRestLoc = REST_LOCATION_IDS.has(nearBld);
            const energyRecovery = isRestLoc ? 8 : 4;
            g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + energyRecovery);
          }
        }

        g.hunger = Math.max(0, g.hunger - hDrain);
        g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - tDrain);
        g.energy = Math.max(0, g.energy - eDrain);
        // Replicants (player or Mila) don't eat — they auto-charge over time,
        // even out in the open, drawing on internal power cells.
        if (char.class.toLowerCase() === 'replicant') {
          g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + 1.2);
        }
        // Pet stamina: a well-fed owner shares food, resting indoors restores,
        // otherwise it drains slowly. Animals always eat (unlike replicants).
        for (const pet of [g.dogCompanion, g.catCompanion]) {
          if (!pet.active || pet.injured) continue;
          if (g.hunger > 50) pet.stamina = Math.min(100, pet.stamina + 1.5);
          else if (isIndoors) pet.stamina = Math.min(100, pet.stamina + 0.8);
          else pet.stamina = Math.max(0, pet.stamina - 1.0);
        }
        if ((g.hunger <= 0 || g.thirst <= 0) && !gamePausedRef.current) { g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 2); g.deathReason = g.hunger <= 0 && g.thirst <= 0 ? 'Died from starvation and dehydration' : g.hunger <= 0 ? 'Died from starvation' : 'Died from dehydration'; }
        if (g.energy <= 20) { void performGameplayFiatAction('low_energy_fee', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:energy:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`); }
        setHunger(Math.floor(g.hunger)); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); setEnergy(Math.floor(g.energy));

        // ── Health regeneration outside combat ──
        if (g.combatRegenCooldown > 0) g.combatRegenCooldown--;
        if (g.combatRegenCooldown <= 0 && g.hp < g.maxHp && g.hp > 0 && !gamePausedRef.current) {
          const regenInterval = 90;
          if (g.frame % regenInterval === 0) {
            const nearBld2 = (g.interior as { bid: string } | null)?.bid ?? '';
            const isRestLoc2 = REST_LOCATION_IDS.has(nearBld2);
            const regenAmt = isRestLoc2 ? 5 : isIndoors ? 3 : 1;
            g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + regenAmt);
            setHp(Math.floor(g.hp));
            if (g.hp < g.maxHp * 0.5 && g.frame % (regenInterval * 4) === 0) {
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `+${regenAmt} HP`, color: '#44ff88', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
            }
          }
        }

        // ── Wanted level decay over time (slower: ~4 min per star) ──
        if (g.wantedLevel > 0 && g.frame - g.lastCrimeFrame > 14400) {
          const _decayLevel = Math.max(0, g.wantedLevel - 1);
          g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
          if (_decayLevel === 0) {
            setWanted(g, 0, 0);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: 'BOUNTY CLEARED', color: '#44ff88', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
          } else {
            setWanted(g, _decayLevel);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `BOUNTY ★ ${g.wantedLevel}`, color: '#ffcc00', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
          }
        }

        // ── Tax collector periodic visit ──
        if (g.taxCollectorTimer > 0) g.taxCollectorTimer--;
        if (g.taxCollectorTimer <= 0 && (g.taxDebt > 0 || g.bountyAmount > 200 || g.salary > 5000)) {
          g.taxCollectorTimer = 12000;
          const tax = Math.floor(g.salary * 0.18) + Math.floor(g.bountyAmount * 0.15) + (g.salary > 20000 ? Math.floor((g.salary - 20000) * 0.05) : 0);
          g.taxDebt += tax;
          if (g.taxDebt > 0 && g.salary >= g.taxDebt) {
            void performGameplayFiatAction('tax_debt_payment', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:tax-debt:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `TAX COLLECTED ƒ${g.taxDebt.toLocaleString()}`, color: '#ff8844', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
            setNarr(`> TAX COLLECTOR — ƒ${g.taxDebt.toLocaleString()} collected as tax on your earnings and fines.`);
            g.taxDebt = 0;
            setSalary(g.salary);
          } else if (g.taxDebt > 0) {
            setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 1));
            g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `TAX EVASION ★+1`, color: '#ff4444', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
            setNarr(`> TAX COLLECTOR — Cannot pay ƒ${g.taxDebt.toLocaleString()} debt. Wanted level increased!`);
          }
        }

        // ── Banco Ombra: negative net worth → debt collector pursuit ──────────────────
        // Checked every ~90 s (5400 frames at 60fps). If the player's combined net
        // worth drops below zero and no collectors are already pursuing, Banco Ombra
        // dispatches a team. Collectors stand down inside the player's own office or
        // home dwelling (the existing OFFICE_INTERIOR_IDS safe-zone already handles it).
        // Wave 1: first notice, wantedLevel must be 0 (fresh debt situation).
        if (g.frame % 5400 === 1 && g.wantedLevel === 0) {
          const _boPropVal = (g.propertyDeeds ?? []).reduce((s: number, d: PropertyDeed) => s + (d.currentValue ?? d.purchasePrice ?? 0), 0);
          const _boNW = g.salary + (g.savings ?? 0) + (g.goldBalance ?? 0) * FIAT_PER_GOLD + _boPropVal - (g.taxDebt ?? 0);
          if (_boNW < 0) {
            g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
            setWanted(g, 1, Math.abs(Math.floor(_boNW)));
            g.policeAlertTimer = Math.max(g.policeAlertTimer, 300);
            g.policeAlertX = g.px; g.policeAlertY = g.py;
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 24, text: 'BANCO OMBRA NOTICE', color: '#ff4444', life: 100, maxLife: 100 });
            setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Net worth negative. Debt collectors dispatched. Safe in your home or office.');
            // Wave 1: spawn exactly 1 collector
            if (g.boCollectors.length === 0) {
              g.boWaveCount = 1;
              const _boAng = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
              const _boDist = 280 + Math.random() * 180;
              g.boCollectors.push({
                x: g.px + Math.cos(_boAng) * _boDist,
                y: g.py + Math.sin(_boAng) * _boDist,
                id: 0,
                spawnFrame: g.frame,
                confrontCd: 0,
              });
            }
          }
        }
        // Wave 2 / 3 respawn: player escaped collectors but net worth is still negative.
        // Fires on the same 5400-frame cycle offset so it can't double-trigger with wave 1.
        if (g.frame % 5400 === 1 && g.wantedLevel > 0 && g.boCollectors.length === 0) {
          const _boRPropVal = (g.propertyDeeds ?? []).reduce((s: number, d: PropertyDeed) => s + (d.currentValue ?? d.purchasePrice ?? 0), 0);
          const _boRNW = g.salary + (g.savings ?? 0) + (g.goldBalance ?? 0) * FIAT_PER_GOLD + _boRPropVal - (g.taxDebt ?? 0);
          if (_boRNW < 0) {
            const _boPrevWave = g.boWaveCount ?? 0;
            g.boWaveCount = Math.min(3, _boPrevWave + 1);
            if (g.boWaveCount >= 3 && _boPrevWave < 3) sfxFinalNotice();
            const _boRCount = g.boWaveCount; // 1 on wrap, 2 second, 3 final
            const _boRLabel = g.boWaveCount >= 3 ? 'FINAL NOTICE' : 'SECOND NOTICE';
            const _boRColor = g.boWaveCount >= 3 ? '#ff0000' : '#ff8800';
            g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
            setWanted(g, g.wantedLevel, Math.abs(Math.floor(_boRNW)));
            g.policeAlertTimer = Math.max(g.policeAlertTimer, 300);
            g.policeAlertX = g.px; g.policeAlertY = g.py;
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 24, text: `BANCO OMBRA — ${_boRLabel}`, color: _boRColor, life: 120, maxLife: 120 });
            setNarr(`> BANCO OMBRA — ${_boRLabel}. Debt ƒ${g.bountyAmount.toLocaleString()} outstanding. Escalating collection team dispatched.`);
            for (let _bri = 0; _bri < _boRCount; _bri++) {
              const _brAng = (_bri * (Math.PI * 2 / _boRCount)) + Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25;
              const _brDist = 260 + Math.random() * 200;
              g.boCollectors.push({
                x: g.px + Math.cos(_brAng) * _brDist,
                y: g.py + Math.sin(_brAng) * _brDist,
                id: _bri,
                spawnFrame: g.frame,
                confrontCd: 0,
              });
            }
          }
        }
        // Despawn collectors when net worth turns positive — checked every 90 s; no wantedLevel gate
        // because Banco Ombra set wantedLevel=1 and it clears separately from net-worth recovery.
        if (g.boCollectors.length > 0 && g.frame % 5400 === 50) {
          const _boPropVal2 = (g.propertyDeeds ?? []).reduce((s: number, d: PropertyDeed) => s + (d.currentValue ?? d.purchasePrice ?? 0), 0);
          const _boNW2 = g.salary + (g.savings ?? 0) + (g.goldBalance ?? 0) * FIAT_PER_GOLD + _boPropVal2 - (g.taxDebt ?? 0);
          if (_boNW2 >= 0) {
            g.boCollectors = [];
            g.boWaveCount = 0;
            // Also stand down the bounty set by Banco Ombra if it was the sole trigger
            if (g.wantedLevel <= 1) { setWanted(g, 0, 0); }
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 24, text: 'BANCO OMBRA STANDS DOWN', color: '#44ffaa', life: 100, maxLife: 100 });
            setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Net worth recovered. Collectors withdrawn.');
          }
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Periodic income — ONLY if player has a real job or owns a business ──────
        const cls = char.class.toLowerCase();
        const factionName = CLASS_DISPLAY_NAME[cls] ?? 'FACTION';
        const now = Date.now();
        const hasGameJob = (g.employedAt ?? null) !== null;
        const hasRealOrg = !!(char as any).orgId;
        const hasBiz = (g.businesses ?? []).length > 0;
        const hasIncome = hasGameJob || hasRealOrg || hasBiz;
        if (now - g.lastIncomeTime >= 60000) {
          g.lastIncomeTime = now;
          reportMissionProgress('minutesPlayed', 1);
          if (hasIncome) {
            const jobPay = hasGameJob ? (g.employedSalary ?? 50) : 0;
            const orgPay = hasRealOrg ? 30 : 0;
            const total = jobPay + orgPay;
            if (total > 0) {
              void performGameplayFiatAction('business_cycle_revenue', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:biz-cycle:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
              const label = hasGameJob ? `${g.employedAt ?? 'JOB'} PAYCHECK` : 'ORG SALARY';
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 30, text: `+ƒ${total.toLocaleString()} ${label}`, color: '#38bdf8', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
              sfxCoin();
              addBankTx(label, total, g.salary);
              reportMissionProgress('fiatEarned', total);
            }
          }
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Real estate passive income (every 15 ticks) ────────────
        g.realEstateIncomeTick++;
        if (g.realEstateIncomeTick >= 15 && g.realEstate.length > 0) {
          g.realEstateIncomeTick = 0;
          let reTotal = 0;
          for (const rid of g.realEstate) {
            // Skip offline properties — no power, no rent.
            if (g.propertiesOffline?.has?.(rid)) continue;
            const base = REAL_ESTATE_INCOME[rid] ?? 0;
            reTotal += (g.rentalProperties ?? []).includes(rid) ? Math.floor(base * 1.5) : base;
          }
          if (g.ownedItems.has('neon_sign')) reTotal = Math.floor(reTotal * 1.1);
          if (reTotal > 0) {
            void performGameplayFiatAction('real_estate_revenue', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:realestate:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px + 30, y: g.py - 50, text: `+ƒ${reTotal.toLocaleString()} RENTAL INCOME`, color: '#cc44ff', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
            sfxCoin();
          }
        }

        g.propertyTaxTick = (g.propertyTaxTick ?? 0) + 1;
        if (g.propertyTaxTick >= PROPERTY_TAX_CYCLE_FRAMES && (g.propertyDeeds ?? []).length > 0) {
          g.propertyTaxTick = 0;
          let totalTax = 0;
          for (const deed of g.propertyDeeds) {
            const currentVal = getPropertyValue(deed);
            deed.currentValue = currentVal;
            const tax = calcPropertyTax(currentVal);
            deed.taxesPaid += tax;
            totalTax += tax;
          }
          if (totalTax > 0) {
            if (g.salary >= totalTax) {
              void performGameplayFiatAction('property_tax', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:property-tax:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
              addBankTx(`PROPERTY TAX (${g.propertyDeeds.length} properties)`, -totalTax, g.salary, 'property_tax');
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px + 30, y: g.py - 30, text: `-ƒ${totalTax.toLocaleString()} PROPERTY TAX`, color: '#ff4488', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
            } else {
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px + 30, y: g.py - 30, text: `TAX DELINQUENT`, color: '#ff4444', life: 100, maxLife: 100 });
            }
          }
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Utility-network billing (power / water / comms) ────────
        // Owned floors, vehicles, and real-estate plots all draw on city utilities.
        // Bill auto-deducts every UTILITY_TICK_FRAMES; if balance insufficient,
        // unpaid-cycles count climbs and after the grace period properties go
        // OFFLINE — visually dimmed, banner suppressed, rental income halted
        // until the bill is paid in full.
        g.utilityTick = (g.utilityTick ?? 0) + 1;
        if (g.utilityTick >= UTILITY_TICK_FRAMES) {
          g.utilityTick = 0;
          // Dedupe across the three sources — a building can theoretically appear
          // in both ownedBuildings and realEstate; bill it once.
          const utilityIds: string[] = Array.from(new Set<string>([
            ...(g.realEstate ?? []),
            ...(g.ownedBuildings ? [...g.ownedBuildings] : []),
            ...(g.ownedVehicles ?? []),
          ]));
          if (utilityIds.length > 0) {
            const bill: UtilityBill = calcUtilityBill(utilityIds, g.propertyCustomization ?? {});
            g.lastUtilityBill = bill.total;
            if (bill.total > 0) {
              if (g.salary >= bill.total) {
                void performGameplayFiatAction('utility_bill', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:utility:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
                addBankTx(`UTILITIES (P:ƒ${bill.power} W:ƒ${bill.water} C:ƒ${bill.comms})`, -bill.total, g.salary, 'expense');
                g.floaters.push({ x: g.px + 30, y: g.py - 70, text: `-ƒ${bill.total.toLocaleString()} UTILITIES`, color: '#67e8f9', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
                // Restoring service if previously offline
                if (g.utilityUnpaidCycles > 0 || (g.propertiesOffline?.size ?? 0) > 0) {
                  g.propertiesOffline = new Set<string>();
                  g.utilityUnpaidCycles = 0;
                  setNarr(`> UTILITIES RESTORED — All properties back online. Power/water/comms streaming.`);
                }
                sfxCoin();
              } else {
                g.utilityUnpaidCycles = (g.utilityUnpaidCycles ?? 0) + 1;
                if (g.utilityUnpaidCycles > UTILITY_GRACE_TICKS) {
                  // Knock everything offline
                  g.propertiesOffline = new Set<string>(utilityIds);
                  g.floaters.push({ x: g.px + 30, y: g.py - 70, text: `UTILITIES CUT — ƒ${bill.total.toLocaleString()} OWED`, color: '#ff4444', life: 100, maxLife: 100 });
                  setNarr(`> UTILITY DELINQUENCY — All properties OFFLINE. Power/water/comms cut. Rental income halted. Need ƒ${bill.total.toLocaleString()} to restore.`);
                } else {
                  const grace = UTILITY_GRACE_TICKS - g.utilityUnpaidCycles + 1;
                  g.floaters.push({ x: g.px + 30, y: g.py - 70, text: `UTILITIES OVERDUE (${grace} CYCLE${grace !== 1 ? 'S' : ''} LEFT)`, color: '#fbbf24', life: 90, maxLife: 90 });
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Rent check (per-day or per-week depending on tier) ────
        {
          const tier = HOUSING_TIERS.find(t => t.id === g.housingTier);
          if (tier && tier.rent > 0) {
            const cycleDays = RENT_PERIOD_DAYS(tier);
            const daysSinceRent = Math.floor((Date.now() - g.rentPaidAt) / 86400000);
            const daysSinceRemind = Math.floor((Date.now() - g.rentReminded) / 86400000);
            const autoRent = Math.round(tier.rent * getZoneRentMultiplier(g.hamletBuildingId ?? 'bunker'));
            if (daysSinceRent >= cycleDays + RENT_GRACE_DAYS) {
              if (g.salary >= autoRent) {
                void performGameplayFiatAction('housing_rent', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:rent:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
                g.rentPaidAt = Date.now(); g.rentReminded = Date.now();
                g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 40, text: `-ƒ${autoRent.toLocaleString()} RENT`, color: '#ff4444', life: 90, maxLife: 90 });
                const periodLabel = tier.rentPeriod === 'week' ? `${cycleDays} days` : 'tomorrow';
                setNarr(`> RENT AUTO-DEDUCTED — ƒ${autoRent.toLocaleString()} paid for ${tier.label}. Next payment ${periodLabel}.`);
              } else {
                g.housingTier = 'shelter'; g.rentPaidAt = Date.now(); g.rentReminded = Date.now();
                const spawn = getHamletSpawn(char, 'shelter');
                g.hamletBuildingId = spawn.buildingId;
                setNarr(`> EVICTION NOTICE — You couldn't pay ƒ${autoRent.toLocaleString()} rent. Relocated to CITY SHELTER. Visit REAL ESTATE OFFICE to upgrade.`);
              }
            } else if (daysSinceRent >= cycleDays - 1 && daysSinceRemind >= 1) {
              g.rentReminded = Date.now();
              const daysLeft = Math.max(0, cycleDays + RENT_GRACE_DAYS - daysSinceRent);
              setNarr(`> RENT REMINDER — ƒ${autoRent.toLocaleString()} due at ${tier.label}. ${daysLeft} day${daysLeft !== 1 ? 's' : ''} until auto-deduction or eviction.`);
            }
          }
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Stock dividends (once per in-game day) ─────────────────
        // Fires on the calendar day rollover (the clock is a continuous float so
        // it never equals exactly midnight). The -1 seed skips the first frame.
        if (g.calendar.day !== lastEconDay) {
          const firstObservation = lastEconDay === -1;
          lastEconDay = g.calendar.day;
          if (!firstObservation) {
          const totalShares = Object.values(g.stocks).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          if (totalShares > 0) {
            let divTotal = 0;
            for (const [ticker, qty] of Object.entries(g.stocks)) {
              if (qty <= 0) continue;
              const stockDef = PRE_LISTED_STOCKS.find(s => s.ticker === ticker);
              if (!stockDef) continue;
              const price = getStockPrice(stockDef, g.worldTime);
              const div = Math.floor(price * 0.003 * qty);
              divTotal += div;
            }
            if (divTotal > 0) {
              void performGameplayFiatAction('investment_dividend', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:dividend:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px - 20, y: g.py - 55, text: `+ƒ${divTotal.toLocaleString()} DIVIDENDS`, color: '#44aaff', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
              sfxCoin();
            }
          }
          }
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Public Office terminal rental (ƒ50/min) ─────────────
        if (g.officeTerminalRenting) {
          const now2 = Date.now();
          if (now2 - g.officeTerminalRenting.lastCharge >= 60000) {
            g.officeTerminalRenting.lastCharge = now2;
            if (g.salary >= PUBLIC_OFFICE_TERMINAL_RATE) {
              void performGameplayFiatAction('office_terminal_rent', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:office-cycle:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`).then(paid => { if (paid) recordBizRevenue('office_rent', PUBLIC_OFFICE_TERMINAL_RATE); });
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 25, text: `−ƒ${PUBLIC_OFFICE_TERMINAL_RATE} TERMINAL RENT`, color: '#ff8844', life: 70, maxLife: 70 });
            } else {
              const lockKey = `po_${g.officeTerminalRenting.label}`;
              g.locks.delete(lockKey);
              setNarr(`> ${g.officeTerminalRenting.label} — Funds depleted. Session terminated. Terminal released.`);
              g.officeTerminalRenting = null;
            }
          }
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Savings interest (every 30 ticks = ~3 min) ───────────
        g.interestTick++;
        if (g.interestTick >= 30 && g.savings > 0) {
          g.interestTick = 0;
          const rawInterest = Math.floor(g.savings * 0.008);
          if (rawInterest > 0) {
            const pabloTax = Math.floor(rawInterest * 0.15);
            const netInterest = rawInterest - pabloTax;
            g.savings += netInterest; setSavings(g.savings);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px + 20, y: g.py - 40, text: `+ƒ${netInterest.toLocaleString()} SAVINGS INTEREST`, color: '#44ffaa', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
            addBankTx('SAVINGS INTEREST (0.8% APY)', netInterest, g.savings);
            if (pabloTax > 0) addBankTx('PABLO CORP INTEREST TAX (15%)', -pabloTax, g.savings);
          }
        } else if (g.interestTick >= 30) {
          g.interestTick = 0;
        }

        // ── ECONOMY: Loan overdue check ───────────────────────────────────
        if (g.loan && g.frame > g.loan.dueAt) {
          const penalty = Math.floor(g.loan.amount * 0.05);
          void performGameplayFiatAction('world_penalty', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:penalty:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
          g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `−ƒ${penalty.toLocaleString()} DEBT PENALTY`, color: '#ff4444', life: 90, maxLife: 90 });
          addBankTx('PABLO CORP DEBT PENALTY (5%)', -penalty, g.salary);
          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA ALERT — Your loan is overdue. PABLO CORP Debt Collection is now active. ƒ' + penalty.toLocaleString() + ' FIAT deducted. Repay at BANCO OMBRA immediately.');
        }

        // ── OREGON TRAIL RANDOM EVENTS (every 12 survival ticks ≈ 72s) ────
        g.oregonTick++;
        if (g.oregonTick >= 12 && Math.random() < 0.35) {
          g.oregonTick = 0;
          const inWaste2 = !inCityBounds(g.px, g.py);
          const cityEvents = [
            () => { void performGameplayFiatAction('city_tax_audit', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:audit:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`); sfxError(); return '> CITY TAX AUDIT — PABLO CORP seized a server-calculated compliance fee. No appeal. No tribunal.'; },
            () => { g.hunger = Math.max(0, g.hunger - 20); setHunger(Math.floor(g.hunger)); sfxError(); return '> FOOD RECALL — All vendor synth-protein recalled. Contaminated batch traced to Pablo Corp. Processing Unit 9. "Regrettable." −20 Hunger.'; },
            () => { g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - 25); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); sfxError(); return '> WATER RATION CUT — Sector 2–7 on reduced supply. "Infrastructure maintenance." −25 Thirst.'; },
