            () => { void performGameplayFiatAction('mobility_tax', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:mobility:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`); sfxError(); return '> MOBILITY TAX — Your movement pattern flagged by City-AI. A server-calculated fee was assessed.'; },
            () => { g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + 8); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); sfxHeal(); return '> CORPORATE MORALE DROP — PABLO CORP deployed diluted stim-packs city-wide. "Productivity metric: normalized." HP +8.'; },
            () => { g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + 30); setEnergy(Math.floor(g.energy)); sfxHeal(); return '> REST CYCLE — Mandatory 2-hour curfew across Sectors 4–6. You used the time. Energy +30.'; },
            () => { void performGameplayFiatAction('found_stash', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:stash:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`).then(paid => { if (paid) sfxCoin(); }); return '> FOUND STASH — Loose FIAT tokens wedged behind a maintenance panel. Banco Ombra verified the transfer.'; },
          ];
          const wasteEvents = [
            () => { if (!gamePausedRef.current) { g.hp = Math.max(1, g.hp - 25); g.deathReason = 'Died from acid rain exposure'; setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); } sfxError(); return '> ACID RAIN — Wasteland squall. Unprotected exposure. HP −25. Find shelter.'; },
            () => { g.hunger = Math.max(0, g.hunger - 30); g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - 30); setHunger(Math.floor(g.hunger)); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); sfxError(); return '> SUPPLY SPOILED — Heat and radiation destroyed your rations. Hunger −30. Thirst −30.'; },
            () => { g.poisoned = true; g.poisonTick = 0; setPoisoned(true); sfxPoison(); return '> MUTANT SPORE CLOUD — Inhaled a dense patch of spores. POISONED. HP slowly draining.'; },
            () => { void performGameplayFiatAction('dead_runner_cache', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:runner:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`).then(paid => { if (paid) sfxCoin(); }); return '> DEAD RUNNER — A courier. Expired. Banco Ombra verified their cache transfer.'; },
            () => { g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + 10); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); sfxHeal(); return '> SHELTER FOUND — A reinforced alcove. Pre-collapse. Someone patched it. HP +10. Someone was looking out for you.'; },
            () => { g.hunger = Math.min(100, g.hunger + 25); g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + 25); setHunger(Math.floor(g.hunger)); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); sfxHeal(); return '> WILD GROVE — Impossible. But here: a cluster of growing things. Clean moisture. Hunger +25. Thirst +25.'; },
            () => { g.energy = Math.max(0, g.energy - 20); setEnergy(Math.floor(g.energy)); sfxError(); return '> DEAD ZONE PULSE — Electromagnetic burst from an unknown source. Your equipment flickered. Energy −20. Systems recovering.'; },
            () => { g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + 50); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); sfxHeal(); return '> SCAVENGE — Sealed water bottle found in a collapsed storefront. Label faded. Contents clear. Thirst +50.'; },
            () => { g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + 60); g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - 10); setEnergy(Math.floor(g.energy)); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); sfxHeal(); return '> SCAVENGE — JOLT energy drink wedged under rubble. Expired by two years. Still carbonated. Energy +60. Thirst −10.'; },
            () => { g.powerLevel = Math.min(100, g.powerLevel + 35); setPowerPct(g.powerLevel); sfxHeal(); return '> SCAVENGE — Intact power cell recovered from an abandoned relay station. Grid charge +35%.'; },
            () => { g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + 30); g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + 15); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); setEnergy(Math.floor(g.energy)); sfxHeal(); if (Math.random() < 0.1) { g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 5); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); } return '> SCAVENGE — Warm beer in a shattered cooler. Label reads: PABLO BREW. Thirst +30. Energy +15. Tastes like regret.'; },
            () => { g.hunger = Math.min(100, g.hunger + 40); g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + 20); setHunger(Math.floor(g.hunger)); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); sfxHeal(); return '> SCAVENGE — Sealed ration pack wedged in a collapsed vent. Expiry: three years ago. Still edible. Hunger +40. Thirst +20.'; },
          ];
          const pool = inWaste2 ? wasteEvents : cityEvents;
          const msg = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]();
          setNarr(msg);
        } else if (g.oregonTick >= 12) {
          g.oregonTick = 0;
        }

        // ── TAXES: Street tax (police-enforced, city only, every ~45s) ──────
        const inCity = inCityBounds(g.px, g.py);
        if (g.shakedownCd > 0) g.shakedownCd--;
        if (g.shakedownCd <= 0 && inCity && !g.interior && !gamePausedRef.current) {
          g.shakedownCd = 2700 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900);
          const nearPol = g.police.some(p => Math.hypot(g.px - p.x, g.py - p.y) < 200);
          if (nearPol && Math.random() < 0.55) {
            const taxTypes = [
              { amt: 800, msg: 'PEDESTRIAN TAX' },
              { amt: 1200, msg: 'BREATHING TAX' },
              { amt: 2000, msg: 'TRANSIT TAX' },
              { amt: 1500, msg: 'CURFEW TAX' },
              { amt: 2500, msg: 'EXISTENCE TAX' },
              { amt: 3000, msg: 'LOITERING TAX' },
            ];
            const pick = taxTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * taxTypes.length)];
            const nightMult = (g.worldTime >= 20 || g.worldTime < 5) ? 1.8 : 1;
            const wantedMult = 1 + g.wantedLevel * 0.5;
            const tax = Math.floor(pick.amt * nightMult * wantedMult);
            if (g.salary >= tax) {
              void performGameplayFiatAction('transaction_tax', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:transaction-tax:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `−ƒ${tax.toLocaleString()} ${pick.msg}`, color: '#ff4444', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
              setNarr(`> PABLO CORP TAXES — ${pick.msg}: ƒ${tax.toLocaleString()} collected. "Taxation is civilization."`);
              sfxError();
              addBankTx(`TAX: ${pick.msg}`, -tax, g.salary);
            } else {
              setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 1), g.bountyAmount + tax);
              g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `BOUNTY ★+1 — UNPAID TAX`, color: '#ff2222', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
              setNarr(`> PABLO CORP TAXES — ${pick.msg}: ƒ${tax.toLocaleString()} owed. Insufficient funds. UNPAID TAX — BOUNTY INCREASED.`);
              sfxError();
            }
          }
        }

        // ── TAXES: City services tax (every ~3 min) ───────────────────────
        if (g.cityBillCd > 0) g.cityBillCd--;
        if (g.cityBillCd <= 0) {
          g.cityBillCd = 10800 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3600);
          const taxes = [
            { amt: 1000, label: 'GRID TAX' },
            { amt: 1500, label: 'WATER TAX' },
            { amt: 2000, label: 'INFRASTRUCTURE TAX' },
            { amt: 800,  label: 'COMMUNICATIONS TAX' },
            { amt: 2500, label: 'CITIZEN REGISTRATION TAX' },
            { amt: 3500, label: 'PROTECTION TAX' },
          ];
          const t = taxes[Math.floor(Math.random() * taxes.length)];
          if (g.salary >= t.amt) {
            void performGameplayFiatAction('world_toll', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:toll:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 25, text: `−ƒ${t.amt.toLocaleString()} ${t.label}`, color: '#ff8844', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
            setNarr(`> PABLO CORP TAXES — ${t.label}: ƒ${t.amt.toLocaleString()} auto-collected. "Non-payment is tax evasion. Tax evasion is a crime."`);
            addBankTx(t.label, -t.amt, g.salary);
          } else {
            g.taxDebt += t.amt;
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 25, text: `${t.label} — DEBT +ƒ${t.amt.toLocaleString()}`, color: '#ff4444', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
          }
        }

        // ── TAXES: Surveillance tax (city, random assessments) ────────────
        if (g.surveillanceCd > 0) g.surveillanceCd--;
        if (g.surveillanceCd <= 0 && inCity && !g.interior) {
          g.surveillanceCd = 3600 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1800);
          if (Math.random() < 0.4) {
            const assessments = [
              { amt: 600, msg: 'JAYWALKING TAX' },
              { amt: 1000, msg: 'ZONE ENTRY TAX' },
              { amt: 1800, msg: 'FACIAL SCAN TAX' },
              { amt: 2200, msg: 'BIOMETRIC TAX' },
              { amt: 500, msg: 'SPEED TAX' },
              { amt: 1500, msg: 'NOISE TAX' },
            ];
            const v = assessments[Math.floor(Math.random() * assessments.length)];
            void performGameplayFiatAction('world_vendor_fee', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:vendor-fee:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 30, text: `−ƒ${v.amt.toLocaleString()} ${v.msg}`, color: '#ff6644', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
            setNarr(`> PABLO CORP TAXES — ${v.msg}: ƒ${v.amt.toLocaleString()} auto-assessed. "The cameras see everything. The tax man sees more."`);
            sfxError();
            if (g.salary < 0) {
              g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
              setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 1), g.bountyAmount + Math.abs(g.salary));
            }
          }
        }

        // ── TAXES: Territory tax (wasteland gang zones) ─────────────────
        if (g.gangTollCd > 0) g.gangTollCd--;
        if (g.gangTollCd <= 0 && !inCity && !g.interior) {
          g.gangTollCd = 4200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1800);
          const inGangZone = GANG_ZONES.find(gz => g.px >= gz.x && g.px <= gz.x + gz.w && g.py >= gz.y && g.py <= gz.y + gz.h && gz.id !== 'minx_city');
          if (inGangZone) {
            const taxAmt = 2000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4000);
            if (g.salary >= taxAmt) {
              void performGameplayFiatAction('world_tax', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:world-tax:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `−ƒ${taxAmt.toLocaleString()} TERRITORY TAX`, color: '#ff6622', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
              setNarr(`> ${inGangZone.name} TERRITORY TAX — "Our turf, our tax. ƒ${taxAmt.toLocaleString()} or your corpse." You paid.`);
              sfxError();
            } else {
              for (const t of g.threats) {
                if (t.type === inGangZone.id.toUpperCase().replace(/_FRAG$/, '') && Math.hypot(t.x - g.px, t.y - g.py) < 300) {
                  t.behavior = 'HOSTILE'; t.behaviorTimer = 400;
                }
              }
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: `CAN'T PAY — TAX EVADER`, color: '#ff2222', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
              setNarr(`> ${inGangZone.name} TERRITORY TAX — "No money? Tax evaders get dealt with." Gang turns hostile.`);
              sfxError();
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // ── LIVING WORLD: Power Grid ─────────────────────────────────────────
      g.powerTick++;
      if (g.powerEventFrames > 0) {
        g.powerEventFrames--;
        if (g.powerEventFrames === 0) { g.powerLevel = 100; setPowerPct(100); }
      } else if (g.powerTick >= 480) {
        g.powerTick = 0;
        if (Math.random() < 0.15) {
          const evts = [
            { level: 40, dur: 180, msg: '> POWER GRID: Brownout detected — Sector 3. Emergency crews responding.' },
            { level: 10, dur: 120, msg: '> EMERGENCY: BLACKOUT — City power grid failure. Backup systems online.' },
            { level: 70, dur: 90,  msg: '> CITY ALERT: Power fluctuation detected. Grid operating at reduced capacity.' },
          ];
          const ev = evts[Math.floor(Math.random() * evts.length)];
          g.powerLevel = ev.level; g.powerEventFrames = ev.dur;
          setPowerPct(ev.level); setNarr(ev.msg);
        }
      }

      // ── LIVING WORLD: Police patrol movement + player aggro response ──
      if (g.policeAlertTimer > 0) g.policeAlertTimer--;

      // ── Pending delayed police alert (civilian witness called it in) ──
      if (g.pendingPoliceAlert > 0) {
        g.pendingPoliceAlert--;
        if (g.pendingPoliceAlert === 0) {
          g.policeAlertTimer = 300;
          g.policeAlertX = g.pendingPoliceAlertX;
          g.policeAlertY = g.pendingPoliceAlertY;
          setNarr('> COLLECTIONS ALERT — Your location has been reported. Debt collectors dispatched.');
          g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: 'COLLECTORS DISPATCHED', color: '#ff8844', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
        }
      }
      for (let pi = 0; pi < g.police.length; pi++) {
        const p = g.police[pi];
        if (!g.policeCooldowns[pi]) g.policeCooldowns[pi] = 0;
        if (g.policeCooldowns[pi] > 0) g.policeCooldowns[pi]--;

        const dPolToPlayer = Math.hypot(g.px - p.x, g.py - p.y);
        if (g.policeConfrontCd > 0) g.policeConfrontCd--;
        if (g.policeAlertTimer > 0 || g.wantedLevel > 0) {
          const alertRadius = 600 + g.wantedLevel * 200;
          const dToOrigin = g.wantedLevel > 0 ? dPolToPlayer : Math.hypot(g.policeAlertX - p.x, g.policeAlertY - p.y);
          if (dToOrigin < alertRadius) {
            const ang = Math.atan2(g.py - p.y, g.px - p.x);
            const wantedSpeedMult = 1 + g.wantedLevel * 0.15;
            const polSpd = 1.5 * NPC_SPEED_MULT * wantedSpeedMult;
            const polR = 8;
            const pmx = p.x + Math.cos(ang) * polSpd;
            const pmy = p.y + Math.sin(ang) * polSpd;
            const polHitX = BUILDINGS.some(b => pmx + polR > b.x && pmx - polR < b.x + b.w && p.y + polR > b.y && p.y - polR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => pmx + polR > d.x && pmx - polR < d.x + d.w && p.y + polR > d.y && p.y - polR < d.y + d.h)));
            const polHitY = BUILDINGS.some(b => p.x + polR > b.x && p.x - polR < b.x + b.w && pmy + polR > b.y && pmy - polR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => p.x + polR > d.x && p.x - polR < d.x + d.w && pmy + polR > d.y && pmy - polR < d.y + d.h)));
            if (!polHitX) p.x = pmx;
            if (!polHitY) p.y = pmy;
            const dToPlayer = Math.hypot(g.px - p.x, g.py - p.y);
            if (dToPlayer < 30 && g.policeConfrontCd <= 0 && !gamePausedRef.current && !showDialoguePanel) {
              g.policeConfrontCd = 2400;
              g.policeCooldowns[pi] = 120;
              const totalDebt = g.bountyAmount + g.taxDebt;
              const fineAmt = totalDebt > 0 ? totalDebt : Math.floor(500 + g.wantedLevel * 1000);
              const lateFee = Math.floor(fineAmt * 0.15);
              const canPay = g.salary >= fineAmt;
              const collectorLines = [
                'Outstanding balance on your account.',
                'PABLO CORP ledger shows unpaid obligations.',
                'You have an overdue invoice. Let\'s settle this.',
                'Delinquent account flagged. I\'m here to collect.',
                'Your FIAT deficit has been forwarded to collections.',
              ];
              const lineText = collectorLines[Math.floor(Math.random() * collectorLines.length)];
              const dlgNodes: Record<string, DialogueNode> = {
                start: { id: 'start', speaker: 'COLLECTOR', portrait: 'npc', text: `"${lineText} Total owed: ƒ${fineAmt.toLocaleString()}. Pay now or late fees apply."`, choices: canPay ? [{ text: `PAY ƒ${fineAmt.toLocaleString()}`, nextId: 'pay' }, { text: 'I\'M NOT PAYING', nextId: 'refuse' }, { text: 'WALK AWAY', nextId: 'flee' }] : [{ text: 'I DON\'T HAVE THE MONEY', nextId: 'cantpay' }, { text: 'I\'M NOT PAYING', nextId: 'refuse' }] },
                pay: { id: 'pay', speaker: 'COLLECTOR', portrait: 'npc', text: `"ƒ${fineAmt.toLocaleString()} received. Account settled. Keep it clean — next time the fee doubles."`, choices: [], effect: 'pay_fine' },
                refuse: { id: 'refuse', speaker: 'COLLECTOR', portrait: 'npc', text: `"Refusal noted. Late fee of ƒ${lateFee.toLocaleString()} added to your account. I'll be back. And I always find you."`, choices: [], effect: 'resist_arrest' },
                flee: { id: 'flee', speaker: 'COLLECTOR', portrait: 'npc', text: `"Walking away doesn't erase debt. ƒ${lateFee.toLocaleString()} late fee added. Clock's ticking."`, choices: [], effect: 'flee_collector' },
                cantpay: { id: 'cantpay', speaker: 'COLLECTOR', portrait: 'npc', text: `"Insufficient funds. ƒ${lateFee.toLocaleString()} late fee added. Total now ƒ${(fineAmt + lateFee).toLocaleString()}. Get the money. I'll be back."`, choices: [], effect: 'cantpay_collector' },
              };
              const dlgTree: DialogueTree = { npcName: 'COLLECTOR', startId: 'start', nodes: dlgNodes };
              pendingNpcActionRef.current = { type: 'newspaper', seasonIdx: 0 };
              const _pFine = fineAmt;
              (window as any).__pendingPoliceFine = _pFine;
              (window as any).__pendingLateFee = lateFee;
              setDialogueNpcName('PABLO CORP DEBT COLLECTOR');
              setDialogueNode(dlgNodes.start as any);
              setDialogueNpcSeed(pi + 100);
              gs.current.activeDialogue = dlgTree;
              gs.current.activeDialogueNode = 'start';
              setShowDialoguePanel(true);
              frozenRef.current = true;
              sfxError();
              setNarr(`> DEBT COLLECTOR — A PABLO CORP collections agent has found you.`);
            } else if (g.wantedLevel >= 4 && dToPlayer < 28 && g.policeCooldowns[pi] <= 0 && g.invincible === 0 && !gamePausedRef.current) {
              g.policeCooldowns[pi] = 90;
              const armorMult = g.ownedItems.has('armor_plate') ? 0.85 : 1;
              const csP = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
              const defReduceP = Math.max(0.1, 1 - csP.defBonus * 0.02);
              g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 2 * armorMult * defReduceP * gearDefenseMultiplier(g.gearStats)); g.invincible = 50; g.flash = 6; g.deathReason = 'Beaten by PABLO CORP debt enforcement';
              g.lastDamageFrame = g.frame; g.combatRegenCooldown = 300;
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 12, text: 'ENFORCER STRIKE', color: '#ff4444', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
            }
            continue;
          }
        }

        if (dPolToPlayer < 250 && dPolToPlayer > 50 && !g.interior && inCityBounds(g.px, g.py)) {
          const ang = Math.atan2(g.py - p.y, g.px - p.x);
          const patrolSpd = 0.4 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
          const polR2 = 8;
          const pmx2 = p.x + Math.cos(ang) * patrolSpd;
          const pmy2 = p.y + Math.sin(ang) * patrolSpd;
          const phx2 = BUILDINGS.some(b => pmx2 + polR2 > b.x && pmx2 - polR2 < b.x + b.w && p.y + polR2 > b.y && p.y - polR2 < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => pmx2 + polR2 > d.x && pmx2 - polR2 < d.x + d.w && p.y + polR2 > d.y && p.y - polR2 < d.y + d.h)));
          const phy2 = BUILDINGS.some(b => p.x + polR2 > b.x && p.x - polR2 < b.x + b.w && pmy2 + polR2 > b.y && pmy2 - polR2 < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => p.x + polR2 > d.x && p.x - polR2 < d.x + d.w && pmy2 + polR2 > d.y && pmy2 - polR2 < d.y + d.h)));
          if (!phx2) p.x = pmx2;
          if (!phy2) p.y = pmy2;
          continue;
        }

        const route = POLICE_ROUTES[p.routeIdx];
        const next  = (p.wpIdx + 1) % route.length;
        const wpA   = route[p.wpIdx], wpB = route[next];
        p.progress  += 0.001 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
        if (p.progress >= 1) { p.progress = 0; p.wpIdx = next; }
        p.x = wpA.x + (wpB.x - wpA.x) * p.progress;
        p.y = wpA.y + (wpB.y - wpA.y) * p.progress;
        if (p.x >= CITY_LEFT && p.x <= CITY_RIGHT && p.y >= CITY_TOP && p.y <= CITY_BOTTOM && g.policeCooldowns[pi] <= 0) {
          for (let ti = 0; ti < g.threats.length; ti++) {
            const t = g.threats[ti];
            if (PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type) || t.type === 'PABLO_GUARD') continue;
            if (t.x < CITY_LEFT || t.x > CITY_RIGHT || t.y < CITY_TOP || t.y > CITY_BOTTOM) continue;
            const dx = t.x - p.x, dy = t.y - p.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
            if (dist < 120) {
              const dmg = 25 + Math.random() * 15;
              t.hp -= dmg;
              g.policeCooldowns[pi] = 35;
              g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 10, text: `−${Math.floor(dmg)} POLICE`, color: '#4488ff', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
              if (t.hp <= 0) {
                g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 18, text: `${t.type} NEUTRALIZED`, color: '#4488ff', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
                const pBounty = BOUNTY[t.type] ?? 10;
                g.deadBodies.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, type: t.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: pBounty, looted: false });
                g.threats.splice(ti, 1); ti--;
              }
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // ── BANCO OMBRA COLLECTORS: Movement toward player, stand down indoors ──
      if (g.boCollectors.length > 0) {
        // Safe only in player's own home or a registered office interior, not arbitrary buildings
        const _boIntBid = (g.interior as { bid: string } | null)?.bid ?? '';
        const boPlayerSafe = !!g.interior && (
          _boIntBid === g.hamletBuildingId ||
          isOfficeBuilding(_boIntBid)
        );
        for (const bc of g.boCollectors) {
          if (bc.confrontCd > 0) bc.confrontCd--;
          if (boPlayerSafe) continue;
          const boAng = Math.atan2(g.py - bc.y, g.px - bc.x);
          const boSpd = 0.9 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
          const boR = 8;
          const boNewX = bc.x + Math.cos(boAng) * boSpd;
          const boNewY = bc.y + Math.sin(boAng) * boSpd;
          const boHitX = BUILDINGS.some(b => boNewX + boR > b.x && boNewX - boR < b.x + b.w && bc.y + boR > b.y && bc.y - boR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => boNewX + boR > d.x && boNewX - boR < d.x + d.w && bc.y + boR > d.y && bc.y - boR < d.y + d.h)));
          const boHitY = BUILDINGS.some(b => bc.x + boR > b.x && bc.x - boR < b.x + b.w && boNewY + boR > b.y && boNewY - boR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => bc.x + boR > d.x && bc.x - boR < d.x + d.w && boNewY + boR > d.y && boNewY - boR < d.y + d.h)));
          if (!boHitX) bc.x = boNewX;
          if (!boHitY) bc.y = boNewY;
          // On close approach trigger dedicated Banco Ombra confrontation dialogue
          const boDist = Math.hypot(g.px - bc.x, g.py - bc.y);
          if (boDist < 34 && bc.confrontCd <= 0 && !gamePausedRef.current && !showDialoguePanel) {
            bc.confrontCd = 2400;
            const boDebt = (g.bountyAmount ?? 0) + (g.taxDebt ?? 0);
            const boFine = boDebt > 0 ? boDebt : 500;
            const boLateFee = Math.max(50, Math.floor(boFine * 0.15));
            const canBoP = g.salary >= boFine;
            const boLines = [
              'BANCO OMBRA never forgets a debt.',
              'Your account is overdue. Settle now or face consequences.',
              'We have been very patient. No more extensions.',
              'Outstanding balance flagged. Pay or restructure — your choice.',
            ];
            const boLine = boLines[Math.floor(Math.random() * boLines.length)];
            const boDlgNodes: Record<string, DialogueNode> = {
              start: {
                id: 'start', speaker: 'BANCO OMBRA', portrait: 'npc',
                text: `"${boLine} Total owed: ƒ${boFine.toLocaleString()}. Settle this now."`,
                choices: canBoP
                  ? [
                      { text: `PAY ƒ${boFine.toLocaleString()} (SETTLE NOW)`, nextId: 'pay' },
                      { text: 'RESTRUCTURE — set up payment plan', nextId: 'restructure' },
                      { text: 'FLEE', nextId: 'flee' },
                    ]
                  : [
                      { text: 'RESTRUCTURE — set up payment plan', nextId: 'restructure' },
                      { text: "I DON'T HAVE THE MONEY", nextId: 'cantpay' },
                    ],
              },
              pay: {
                id: 'pay', speaker: 'BANCO OMBRA', portrait: 'npc',
                text: `"ƒ${boFine.toLocaleString()} received. ACCOUNT SETTLED. Our agents are withdrawing. Stay solvent."`,
                choices: [], effect: 'bo_pay_settle',
              },
              restructure: {
                id: 'restructure', speaker: 'BANCO OMBRA', portrait: 'npc',
                text: `"Restructuring noted. Visit the bank terminal to enroll in a payment plan. Our agents will stand down — temporarily. Miss a payment and we return."`,
                choices: [], effect: 'bo_restructure',
              },
              flee: {
                id: 'flee', speaker: 'BANCO OMBRA', portrait: 'npc',
                text: `"Running costs extra. ƒ${boLateFee.toLocaleString()} late fee added to your account. We always find our debtors."`,
                choices: [], effect: 'bo_flee',
              },
              cantpay: {
                id: 'cantpay', speaker: 'BANCO OMBRA', portrait: 'npc',
                text: `"Insufficient funds noted. ƒ${boLateFee.toLocaleString()} late fee added. New total: ƒ${(boFine + boLateFee).toLocaleString()}. Visit the bank. Enroll in a plan."`,
                choices: [], effect: 'bo_cantpay',
              },
            };
            const boDlgTree: DialogueTree = { npcName: 'BANCO OMBRA COLLECTOR', startId: 'start', nodes: boDlgNodes };
            (window as any).__pendingBOFine = boFine;
            (window as any).__pendingBOLateFee = boLateFee;
            pendingNpcActionRef.current = { type: 'newspaper', seasonIdx: 0 };
            setDialogueNpcName('BANCO OMBRA COLLECTOR');
            setDialogueNode(boDlgNodes.start as any);
            setDialogueNpcSeed(bc.id + 200);
            gs.current.activeDialogue = boDlgTree;
            gs.current.activeDialogueNode = 'start';
            setShowDialoguePanel(true);
            frozenRef.current = true;
            sfxError();
            setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — A debt collector has cornered you. Settle your account now.');
          }
        }
      }

      // ── PATROL BANDS: Movement, inter-band combat, player engagement ──
      for (const band of g.bands) {
        const aliveMembers = band.members.filter(m => !m.dead);
        if (aliveMembers.length === 0) continue;

        const route = POLICE_ROUTES[band.routeIdx];
        const next = (band.wpIdx + 1) % route.length;
        const wpA = route[band.wpIdx], wpB = route[next];
        band.progress += 0.0008 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
        if (band.progress >= 1) { band.progress = 0; band.wpIdx = next; }
        const bandCX = wpA.x + (wpB.x - wpA.x) * band.progress;
        const bandCY = wpA.y + (wpB.y - wpA.y) * band.progress;

        for (const m of aliveMembers) {
          m.x = bandCX + m.ox;
          m.y = bandCY + m.oy;
          // Nudge member out of any building they may overlap
          const bmR = 8;
          for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
            if (m.x + bmR > b.x && m.x - bmR < b.x + b.w && m.y + bmR > b.y && m.y - bmR < b.y + b.h) {
              if (b.doors && b.doors.some(d => m.x + bmR > d.x && m.x - bmR < d.x + d.w && m.y + bmR > d.y && m.y - bmR < d.y + d.h)) continue;
              const overlapL = (m.x + bmR) - b.x;
              const overlapR = (b.x + b.w) - (m.x - bmR);
              const overlapT = (m.y + bmR) - b.y;
              const overlapB = (b.y + b.h) - (m.y - bmR);
              const minX = Math.min(overlapL, overlapR);
              const minY = Math.min(overlapT, overlapB);
              if (minX < minY) {
                m.x += overlapL < overlapR ? -overlapL : overlapR;
              } else {
                m.y += overlapT < overlapB ? -overlapT : overlapB;
              }
            }
          }
          if (m.attackCd > 0) m.attackCd--;
        }

        for (const otherBand of g.bands) {
          if (otherBand === band || otherBand.type === band.type) continue;
          const otherAlive = otherBand.members.filter(om => !om.dead);
          if (otherAlive.length === 0) continue;
          const bdx = bandCX - (otherAlive[0]?.x ?? 0);
          const bdy = bandCY - (otherAlive[0]?.y ?? 0);
          const bandDist = Math.sqrt(bdx * bdx + bdy * bdy);
          if (bandDist > 200) continue;

          for (const attacker of aliveMembers) {
            if (attacker.attackCd > 0) continue;
            const attackRange = attacker.weapon === 'ranged' ? band.rangedRange : 30;
            let closestTarget: BandMember | null = null;
            let closestDist = attackRange;
            for (const target of otherAlive) {
              const td = Math.hypot(attacker.x - target.x, attacker.y - target.y);
              if (td < closestDist) { closestDist = td; closestTarget = target; }
            }
            if (closestTarget) {
              const dmg = band.atkDmg + Math.random() * 10;
              closestTarget.hp -= dmg;
              attacker.attackCd = attacker.weapon === 'ranged' ? 45 : 30;
              if (attacker.weapon === 'ranged') {
                g.projectiles.push({ x: attacker.x, y: attacker.y, prevX: attacker.x, prevY: attacker.y, dx: (closestTarget.x - attacker.x) / closestDist * 5, dy: (closestTarget.y - attacker.y) / closestDist * 5, damage: 0, type: 'laser', life: 25 });
              }
              g.floaters.push({ x: closestTarget.x, y: closestTarget.y - 10, text: `−${Math.floor(dmg)}`, color: band.color, life: 35, maxLife: 35 });
              if (closestTarget.hp <= 0) {
                closestTarget.dead = true;
                g.floaters.push({ x: closestTarget.x, y: closestTarget.y - 18, text: `${otherBand.label} DOWN`, color: band.color, life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
                g.deadBodies.push({ x: closestTarget.x, y: closestTarget.y, type: otherBand.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: 5, looted: false });
              }
            }
          }
        }

        if (band.type === 'POLICE' && (g.policeAlertTimer > 0 || g.wantedLevel > 0)) {
          for (const m of aliveMembers) {
            if (m.attackCd > 0) continue;
            const dToPlayer = Math.hypot(g.px - m.x, g.py - m.y);
            const atkRange = m.weapon === 'ranged' ? band.rangedRange : 22;
            if (dToPlayer < atkRange && g.invincible === 0 && !gamePausedRef.current) {
              m.attackCd = m.weapon === 'ranged' ? 50 : 30;
              const armorMult = g.ownedItems.has('armor_plate') ? 0.85 : 1;
              const csP = CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate;
              const defReduceP = Math.max(0.1, 1 - csP.defBonus * 0.02);
              const bandNightMult = (g.worldTime >= 19 || g.worldTime < 4) ? 1.5 : 1.0;
              const dmgP = band.atkDmg * armorMult * defReduceP * bandNightMult * gearDefenseMultiplier(g.gearStats);
              g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - dmgP); g.invincible = 40; g.flash = 6;
              g.lastDamageFrame = g.frame; g.combatRegenCooldown = 300;
              g.deathReason = `Killed by ${band.label} enforcement`;
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 12, text: `${band.label} STRIKE`, color: band.color, life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
              if (m.weapon === 'ranged') {
                g.projectiles.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y, prevX: m.x, prevY: m.y, dx: (g.px - m.x) / dToPlayer * 5, dy: (g.py - m.y) / dToPlayer * 5, damage: 0, type: 'laser', life: 25 });
              }
            }
          }
        }

        for (const m of aliveMembers) {
          if (m.attackCd > 0) continue;
          for (let ti = 0; ti < g.threats.length; ti++) {
            const t = g.threats[ti];
            if (PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type) || t.type === 'PABLO_GUARD') continue;
            const td = Math.hypot(m.x - t.x, m.y - t.y);
            const atkRange = m.weapon === 'ranged' ? band.rangedRange : 25;
            if (td < atkRange) {
              const dmg = band.atkDmg + Math.random() * 10;
              t.hp -= dmg;
              m.attackCd = m.weapon === 'ranged' ? 45 : 30;
              g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 10, text: `−${Math.floor(dmg)} ${band.label}`, color: band.color, life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
              if (m.weapon === 'ranged') {
                g.projectiles.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y, prevX: m.x, prevY: m.y, dx: (t.x - m.x) / td * 5, dy: (t.y - m.y) / td * 5, damage: 0, type: 'laser', life: 20 });
              }
              if (t.hp <= 0) {
                g.floaters.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y - 18, text: `${t.type} NEUTRALIZED`, color: band.color, life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
                g.deadBodies.push({ x: t.x, y: t.y, type: t.type, diedAtFrame: g.frame, bounty: BOUNTY[t.type] ?? 10, looted: false });
                g.threats.splice(ti, 1); ti--;
              }
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (g.frame % 3600 === 0) {
        for (let bi = 0; bi < g.bands.length; bi++) {
          const band = g.bands[bi];
          const alive = band.members.filter(m => !m.dead).length;
          if (alive === 0) {
            g.bands[bi] = createBand(BAND_TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * BAND_TYPES.length)], band.routeIdx);
          }
        }
      }

      // ── NPC event reaction system — flee or spectate on nearby combat/fire ──
      {
        const combatActive = g.threats.some(t => t.behavior === 'HOSTILE' && Math.hypot(t.x - g.px, t.y - g.py) < 150);
        const fireNearby = g.fires.length > 0;
        const eventX = combatActive ? g.px : (fireNearby ? g.fires[0].x : 0);
        const eventY = combatActive ? g.py : (fireNearby ? g.fires[0].y : 0);
        const hasEvent = combatActive || fireNearby;
        for (const npc of NPCS) {
          if (!npc.origX) { npc.origX = npc.x; npc.origY = npc.y; }
          if (!npc.reactTimer) npc.reactTimer = 0;
          if (npc.reactTimer > 0) npc.reactTimer--;
          if (g.frame % 30 === 0 && hasEvent) {
            const npcEvtDist = Math.hypot(npc.x - eventX, npc.y - eventY);
            if (npcEvtDist < 200 && npc.reactState !== 'FLEEING' && npc.reactState !== 'SPECTATING' && npc.reactTimer === 0) {
              const willFlee = Math.random() < 0.65 || npc.role === 'pedestrian';
              npc.reactState = willFlee ? 'FLEEING' : 'SPECTATING';
              npc.reactTimer = 300;
            }
          }
          if (npc.reactState === 'FLEEING') {
            const fleeAng = Math.atan2(npc.y - eventY, npc.x - eventX);
            const fmx = npc.x + Math.cos(fleeAng) * 1.5 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
            const fmy = npc.y + Math.sin(fleeAng) * 1.5 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
            const npcR = 8;
            const npcHitX = BUILDINGS.some(b => fmx + npcR > b.x && fmx - npcR < b.x + b.w && npc.y + npcR > b.y && npc.y - npcR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => fmx + npcR > d.x && fmx - npcR < d.x + d.w && npc.y + npcR > d.y && npc.y - npcR < d.y + d.h)));
            const npcHitY = BUILDINGS.some(b => npc.x + npcR > b.x && npc.x - npcR < b.x + b.w && fmy + npcR > b.y && fmy - npcR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => npc.x + npcR > d.x && npc.x - npcR < d.x + d.w && fmy + npcR > d.y && fmy - npcR < d.y + d.h)));
            if (!npcHitX) npc.x = fmx;
            if (!npcHitY) npc.y = fmy;
            if (npc.reactTimer <= 0) { npc.reactState = 'NORMAL'; npc.x = npc.origX!; npc.y = npc.origY!; }
          } else if (npc.reactState === 'SPECTATING') {
            const npcDist = Math.hypot(npc.x - eventX, npc.y - eventY);
            if (npcDist > 80) {
              const watchAng = Math.atan2(eventY - npc.y, eventX - npc.x);
              const smx = npc.x + Math.cos(watchAng) * 0.3 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
              const smy = npc.y + Math.sin(watchAng) * 0.3 * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
              const npcR = 8;
              const specHitX = BUILDINGS.some(b => smx + npcR > b.x && smx - npcR < b.x + b.w && npc.y + npcR > b.y && npc.y - npcR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => smx + npcR > d.x && smx - npcR < d.x + d.w && npc.y + npcR > d.y && npc.y - npcR < d.y + d.h)));
              const specHitY = BUILDINGS.some(b => npc.x + npcR > b.x && npc.x - npcR < b.x + b.w && smy + npcR > b.y && smy - npcR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => npc.x + npcR > d.x && npc.x - npcR < d.x + d.w && smy + npcR > d.y && smy - npcR < d.y + d.h)));
              if (!specHitX) npc.x = smx;
              if (!specHitY) npc.y = smy;
            }
            if (npc.reactTimer <= 0) { npc.reactState = 'NORMAL'; npc.x = npc.origX!; npc.y = npc.origY!; }
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Gang patrol territory movement ──
      if (g.frame % 4 === 0) {
        for (const npc of NPCS) {
          if (npc.role !== 'gang_patrol' || npc.reactState === 'FLEEING') continue;
          const zone = GANG_ZONES.find(gz => gz.id === npc.faction);
          if (!zone) continue;
          if (!npc.origX) { npc.origX = npc.x; npc.origY = npc.y; }
          const speed = (npc.walkSpeed ?? 0.7) * NPC_SPEED_MULT;
          const cx = zone.x + zone.w / 2;
          const cy = zone.y + zone.h / 2;
          const patrolRadius = Math.min(zone.w, zone.h) * 0.35;
          const phase = (g.frame * 0.002 + (npc.origX ?? 0) * 0.01) % (Math.PI * 2);
          const targetX = cx + Math.cos(phase) * patrolRadius;
          const targetY = cy + Math.sin(phase * 1.3) * patrolRadius;
          const dx = targetX - npc.x;
          const dy = targetY - npc.y;
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (dist > 10) {
            const gpR = 8;
            const gpMx = npc.x + (dx / dist) * speed;
            const gpMy = npc.y + (dy / dist) * speed;
            const gpHitX = BUILDINGS.some(b => gpMx + gpR > b.x && gpMx - gpR < b.x + b.w && npc.y + gpR > b.y && npc.y - gpR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => gpMx + gpR > d.x && gpMx - gpR < d.x + d.w && npc.y + gpR > d.y && npc.y - gpR < d.y + d.h)));
            const gpHitY = BUILDINGS.some(b => npc.x + gpR > b.x && npc.x - gpR < b.x + b.w && gpMy + gpR > b.y && gpMy - gpR < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => npc.x + gpR > d.x && npc.x - gpR < d.x + d.w && gpMy + gpR > d.y && gpMy - gpR < d.y + d.h)));
            if (!gpHitX) npc.x = gpMx;
            if (!gpHitY) npc.y = gpMy;
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Ambient traffic vehicle movement ──
      for (const tv of g.trafficVehicles) {
        const route = TRAFFIC_ROUTES[tv.routeIdx];
        if (!route || route.length < 2) continue;
        const target = route[tv.wpIdx];
        const tdx = target.x - tv.x;
        const tdy = target.y - tv.y;
        const tdist = Math.hypot(tdx, tdy);
        if (tdist < 15) {
          tv.wpIdx = (tv.wpIdx + 1) % route.length;
        } else {
          const ndx = (tdx / tdist) * tv.speed;
          const ndy = (tdy / tdist) * tv.speed;
          const nx = tv.x + ndx;
          const ny = tv.y + ndy;
          // Building collision avoidance — skip move tick if next pos is inside a building
          const hitBuilding = BUILDINGS.some(b => nx + 8 > b.x && nx - 8 < b.x + b.w && ny + 8 > b.y && ny - 8 < b.y + b.h);
          if (hitBuilding) {
            // Advance to next waypoint to reroute rather than getting stuck
            tv.wpIdx = (tv.wpIdx + 1) % route.length;
          } else {
            tv.dx = ndx;
            tv.dy = ndy;
            tv.x = nx;
            tv.y = ny;
          }
        }
        // Snap traffic vehicle back to nearest road if it drifts off (faster correction)
        if (!isOnRoad(tv.x, tv.y)) {
          const snap = nearestRoadPoint(tv.x, tv.y);
          tv.x += (snap.x - tv.x) * 0.5;
          tv.y += (snap.y - tv.y) * 0.5;
        }
      }

      // ── Subway transit animation ──
      if (g.subwayTransit) {
        g.subwayTransitTimer--;
        if (g.subwayTransitTimer <= 0 && g.subwayTransitDest) {
          g.px = g.subwayTransitDest.x; g.py = g.subwayTransitDest.y;
          const arrLabel = g.subwayTransitDest.label;
          if (g.subwayTransitDest.layer) g.worldLayer = g.subwayTransitDest.layer;
          g.subwayTransit = false;
          g.subwayTransitDest = null;
          // Surfacing from the deep line is safe for a few seconds — the gas
          // sits higher than the platforms. Lets DEEP LINE stops open into the
          // poison without instant damage. ~6s at 60fps.
          g.subwayGrace = 360;
          if (g.worldLayer === 'underground') {
            setNarr(`> METRO — Arrived at ${arrLabel}. The doors open below the city: neon, pipes, voices, no sky.`);
          } else {
            setNarr(`> METRO — Arrived at ${arrLabel}. "Please watch the gap. Surface air is unsafe — keep moving."`);
          }
          doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
          sfxEnter();
        }
      }

      // ── Debris particle tick ──
      if (inCityBounds(g.px, g.py) && g.frame % 40 === 0 && g.debrisParticles.length < MAX_DEBRIS) {
        const cols = ['#887766', '#aa9977', '#665544', '#997755', '#ccbbaa'];
        g.debrisParticles.push({
          x: CITY_LEFT + Math.random() * (CITY_RIGHT - CITY_LEFT),
          y: CITY_TOP + Math.random() * (CITY_BOTTOM - CITY_TOP),
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
          vy: -0.15 - Math.random() * 0.2,
          life: 180 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 120),
          maxLife: 300,
          size: 1 + Math.random() * 2,
          col: cols[Math.floor(Math.random() * cols.length)],
        });
      }
      for (const dp of g.debrisParticles) { dp.x += dp.vx; dp.y += dp.vy; dp.life--; }
      g.debrisParticles = g.debrisParticles.filter(dp => dp.life > 0);

      // ── Vehicle exit: press E while in a vehicle ──
      if (g.keys.has('e') && g.vehicle) {
        g.keys.delete('e');
        const exitOffsets = [[20,0],[-20,0],[0,20],[0,-20],[14,14],[-14,14],[14,-14],[-14,-14]];
        let exitX = g.px, exitY = g.py;
        let foundSpot = false;
        for (const [ox, oy] of exitOffsets) {
          const tx = g.px + ox, ty = g.py + oy;
          const blocked = BUILDINGS.some(b => tx + PSIZE > b.x && tx - PSIZE < b.x + b.w && ty + PSIZE > b.y && ty - PSIZE < b.y + b.h && !(b.doors?.some(d => tx + PSIZE > d.x && tx - PSIZE < d.x + d.w && ty + PSIZE > d.y && ty - PSIZE < d.y + d.h)));
          if (!blocked) { exitX = tx; exitY = ty; foundSpot = true; break; }
        }
        if (!foundSpot) { exitX = g.px; exitY = g.py; }
        g.exitedVehicles.push({ type: g.vehicle, x: g.px, y: g.py, frame: g.frame });
        g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: `EXITED ${g.vehicle.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()}`, color: '#00ffcc', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
        setNarr(`> VEHICLE — Exited ${getVehicleDef(g.vehicle).label}. Vehicle remains parked here.`);
        g.vehicle = null;
        g.px = exitX; g.py = exitY;
      }

      // ── Parked vehicle steal & park interaction ──
      const nearAnyBuilding = BUILDINGS.some(b => g.px >= b.x - 20 && g.px <= b.x + b.w + 20 && g.py >= b.y - 20 && g.py <= b.y + b.h + 20);
      const nearAnyNpc = NPCS.some(nn => Math.hypot(g.px - nn.x, g.py - nn.y) < NPC_RANGE);

      // Park vehicle at a parking spot
      if (g.keys.has('p') && g.vehicle) {
        for (let si = 0; si < PARKING_SPOTS.length; si++) {
          const sp = PARKING_SPOTS[si];
          if (Math.hypot(g.px - sp.x, g.py - sp.y) < PARKING_RANGE) {
            g.keys.delete('p');
            const already = g.parkedLoadout.findIndex(pl => pl.spotIdx === si);
            if (already >= 0) {
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: 'SPOT OCCUPIED', color: '#ff4444', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
            } else {
              g.parkedLoadout.push({ type: g.vehicle, spotIdx: si });
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: `PARKED ${g.vehicle.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()}`, color: '#00ffcc', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
              setNarr(`> VEHICLE — ${getVehicleDef(g.vehicle).label} parked at ${sp.label}. Press [E] near spot to retrieve.`);
              g.vehicle = null;
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      // Re-enter an exited vehicle nearby
      if (g.keys.has('e') && !g.vehicle && g.exitedVehicles.length > 0) {
        for (let evi = 0; evi < g.exitedVehicles.length; evi++) {
          const ev = g.exitedVehicles[evi];
          if (Math.hypot(g.px - ev.x, g.py - ev.y) < 30) {
            g.keys.delete('e');
            g.vehicle = ev.type;
            g.px = ev.x; g.py = ev.y;
            g.exitedVehicles.splice(evi, 1);
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: `ENTERED ${ev.type.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()}`, color: '#00ffcc', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      // Retrieve parked vehicle from spot — parking retrieval checked BEFORE
      // building/NPC gate so spots near buildings always work
      if (g.keys.has('e') && !g.vehicle) {
        let retrieved = false;
        for (let si = 0; si < PARKING_SPOTS.length; si++) {
          const sp = PARKING_SPOTS[si];
          if (Math.hypot(g.px - sp.x, g.py - sp.y) < PARKING_RANGE) {
            const idx = g.parkedLoadout.findIndex(pl => pl.spotIdx === si);
            if (idx >= 0) {
              const vt = g.parkedLoadout[idx].type;
              g.parkedLoadout.splice(idx, 1);
              g.vehicle = vt;
              g.keys.delete('e');
              retrieved = true;
              g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: `RETRIEVED ${vt.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()}`, color: '#00ffcc', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });
              setNarr(`> VEHICLE — ${getVehicleDef(vt).label} retrieved. Press [P] near a parking spot to park.`);
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        // Steal a parked street vehicle if not near a spot with a stored vehicle,
        // and the player is not near a building/NPC (standard interaction priority)
        if (!retrieved && !nearAnyBuilding && !nearAnyNpc) {
          for (const pv of g.parkedVehicles) {
            if (pv.stolen) continue;
            const pvDist = Math.hypot(g.px - pv.x, g.py - pv.y);
            if (pvDist < STEAL_RANGE) {
              g.keys.delete('e');
              if (Math.random() < STEAL_CHANCE) {
                pv.stolen = true;
                g.vehicle = pv.type;
                if (!g.ownedVehicles.includes(pv.type)) g.ownedVehicles.push(pv.type);
                setWanted(g, Math.min(5, g.wantedLevel + 1), g.bountyAmount + 300); g.lastCrimeFrame = g.frame;
                g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: `STOLE ${pv.type.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()}`, color: '#ffcc00', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });

                // ── Witness detection ─────────────────────────────────────────
                const WITNESS_RADIUS = 175;
                const vxT = g.px, vyT = g.py;

                // Check police-role NPC witnesses using schedule-aware positions
                // Includes 'police', 'guard', and 'corpo_military' roles
                const wt = g.worldTime ?? 0;
                const isPoliceRole = (r?: string) => r === 'police' || r === 'guard' || r === 'corpo_military';
                const policeNpcWitness = NPCS.some(npc => {
                  if (!isPoliceRole(npc.role)) return false;
                  const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(npc, wt);
                  return Math.hypot(sp.x - vxT, sp.y - vyT) < WITNESS_RADIUS;
                });

                // Check police patrol units (PoliceUnit array)
                const policeUnitWitness = g.police.some(p =>
                  Math.hypot(p.x - vxT, p.y - vyT) < WITNESS_RADIUS
                );

                // Check POLICE-type band members
                const policeBandWitness = g.bands.some(band =>
                  band.type === 'POLICE' && band.members.some(m => !m.dead && Math.hypot(m.x - vxT, m.y - vyT) < WITNESS_RADIUS)
                );

                const policeWitness = policeNpcWitness || policeUnitWitness || policeBandWitness;

                // Check civilian NPC witnesses using schedule-aware positions
                const civilianNpcWitness = !policeWitness && NPCS.some(npc => {
                  if (isPoliceRole(npc.role)) return false;
                  const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(npc, wt);
                  return Math.hypot(sp.x - vxT, sp.y - vyT) < WITNESS_RADIUS;
                });

                // Trigger NPC reactions for all nearby NPCs using schedule-aware positions
                for (const npc of NPCS) {
                  const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(npc, wt);
                  const npcWitDist = Math.hypot(sp.x - vxT, sp.y - vyT);
                  if (npcWitDist < WITNESS_RADIUS) {
                    if (!npc.origX) { npc.origX = sp.x; npc.origY = sp.y; }
                    if (!npc.reactTimer) npc.reactTimer = 0;
                    if (isPoliceRole(npc.role)) {
                      // Police-role NPCs move toward the scene (SPECTATING = approach behavior)
                      npc.x = sp.x; npc.y = sp.y;
                      npc.reactState = 'SPECTATING';
                      npc.reactTimer = 400;
                    } else if (npc.reactState !== 'FLEEING' && npc.reactState !== 'SPECTATING') {
                      npc.x = sp.x; npc.y = sp.y;
                      const willFlee = Math.random() < 0.65 || npc.role === 'pedestrian';
                      npc.reactState = willFlee ? 'FLEEING' : 'SPECTATING';
                      npc.reactTimer = 300;
                    }
                  }
                }

                if (policeWitness) {
                  // Police saw it — immediate alert, longer timer for stronger response
                  g.policeAlertTimer = 450;
                  g.policeAlertX = vxT; g.policeAlertY = vyT;
                  g.pendingPoliceAlert = 0;
                  setNarr(`> COLLECTIONS ALERT — Your theft was reported. Debt collectors converging.`);
                } else if (civilianNpcWitness) {
                  // Civilian witness — delayed alert (4 seconds = 240 frames at 60fps)
                  g.pendingPoliceAlert = 240;
                  g.pendingPoliceAlertX = vxT; g.pendingPoliceAlertY = vyT;
                  g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 28, text: 'WITNESS CALLING POLICE!', color: '#ff8800', life: 80, maxLife: 80 });
                  setNarr(`> A witness is calling the police! You have a few seconds to disappear.`);
                } else {
                  // No witnesses — silent theft
                  g.pendingPoliceAlert = 0;
                  setNarr(`> You hotwired the ${pv.type.replace(/_/g,' ')} unnoticed. No witnesses.`);
                }
              } else {
                g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: 'STEAL FAILED', color: '#ff4444', life: 40, maxLife: 40 });
                setNarr('> Hotwire attempt failed. The alarm triggered briefly.');
              }
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // [V] — cycle through ownedVehicles loadout: select next owned vehicle as active
      if (g.keys.has('v') && g.ownedVehicles.length > 0) {
        g.keys.delete('v');
        // Only cycle vehicles not currently parked in a spot
        const parkedTypes = new Set(g.parkedLoadout.map(pl => pl.type));
        const available = g.ownedVehicles.filter(vid => !parkedTypes.has(vid));
        if (available.length > 0) {
          const curIdx = g.vehicle ? available.indexOf(g.vehicle) : -1;
          const nextIdx = (curIdx + 1) % available.length;
          const nextVehicle = available[nextIdx];
          g.vehicle = nextVehicle ?? null;
          if (nextVehicle) {
            g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 18, text: `VEHICLE: ${nextVehicle.replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase()}`, color: '#00ffcc', life: 70, maxLife: 70 });
            setNarr(`> LOADOUT — Switched to ${getVehicleDef(nextVehicle).label}. [V] to cycle, [P] to park.`);
          }
        } else {
          g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 16, text: 'ALL VEHICLES PARKED', color: '#ffcc00', life: 50, maxLife: 50 });
        }
      }

      // ── LIVING WORLD: Random fire events (reduced ~1/3 of original rate) ──
      g.fireTick++;
      if (g.fireTick >= 5400 && Math.random() < 0.002 && g.fires.length < 2) {
        g.fireTick = 0;
        const cityBlds = BUILDINGS.filter(b => b.y >= CITY_TOP && b.y < CITY_BOTTOM - 50);
        const fb = cityBlds[Math.floor(Math.random() * cityBlds.length)];
        if (!g.fires.find(f => f.bid === fb.id)) {
          g.fires.push({ bid: fb.id, x: fb.x + fb.w/2, y: fb.y + fb.h/2, startFrame: g.frame, intensity: 0.6 + Math.random()*0.4 });
          setNarr(`> FIRE DEPT DISPATCH: Structure fire reported at ${fb.label}. Unit 4 responding.`);
        }
      }
      // Extinguish old fires after ~1800 frames
      g.fires = g.fires.filter(f => {
        const age = g.frame - f.startFrame;
        if (age > 1800) { setNarr(`> FIRE DEPT: Fire at ${BUILDINGS.find(b=>b.id===f.bid)?.label??'UNKNOWN'} contained. Cause under investigation.`); return false; }
        return true;
      });

      // ── LIVING WORLD: Ambient city events (removed — news spreads via NPC conversations) ──
      if (cityEventTimer.current > 0) { cityEventTimer.current--; if (cityEventTimer.current === 0) setCityEvent(null); }

      // ── DRAW ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      if (g.flash > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,0,0,${g.flash * .05})`; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch); }
      // Kill flash — red radial vignette on killing blow.
      if (g.killFlash > 0) {
        const kfT = g.killFlash / 14;
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.min(cw, ch) * 0.2, cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.max(cw, ch) * 0.65);
        grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,40,20,0)');
        grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(200,15,10,${0.55 * kfT})`);
        ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
      }
      // Crit flash — quick warm pulse on crit hit.
      if (g.critFlash > 0) {
        const cfT = g.critFlash / 6;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,210,80,${0.18 * cfT})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
      }
      const pwDark = (100 - g.powerLevel) / 100;

      const wt = g.worldTime;
      let dayBright = 1;
      if (wt >= 7 && wt <= 17) {
        const midDay = 1 - Math.abs(wt - 12) / 5;
        dayBright = 0.85 + midDay * 0.15;
      } else if (wt > 5 && wt < 7) {
        const t2 = (wt - 5) / 2;
        dayBright = 0.35 + t2 * 0.5;
      } else if (wt > 17 && wt < 19) {
        const t2 = 1 - (wt - 17) / 2;
        dayBright = 0.35 + t2 * 0.5;
      } else {
        dayBright = 0.3;
      }
      const isNight = wt >= 19 || wt < 4;
      const isDusk = wt >= 17 && wt < 19;
      const isDawn = wt >= 4 && wt < 6;

      // Single source of truth for sun/moon position + the sun-driven shadow
      // vector. Read by the celestial render (screen-space sky bodies) and by
      // every ground-shadow site so the shadow direction/length track the sun.
      const sky = getSkyState(wt);
      // Base screen-space throw, scaled by the sun's shadow length (long at
      // dawn/dusk, short at noon). Feeds the contact/cast shadow sites below.
      const shadowDX = sky.shadow.dx * sky.shadow.len;
      const shadowDY = sky.shadow.dy * sky.shadow.len;

      const tileHash = (x: number, y: number) => {
        const h = Math.sin(x * 12.9898 + y * 78.233) * 43758.5453;
        return h - Math.floor(h);
      };

      // ── UNDERCITY vertical layer ──────────────────────────────────────────
      // This is a true world-engine layer: movement/camera/collision continue
      // to use the main loop, while surface terrain and entities are replaced
      // by the district's own subterranean geometry and atmosphere.
      if (g.worldLayer === 'underground') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#03040b';
        ctx.fillRect(-ox, -oy, cw, ch);

        const chamber = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.top + oy, 0, UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.bottom + oy);
        chamber.addColorStop(0, '#0a1022');
        chamber.addColorStop(.55, '#100b1d');
        chamber.addColorStop(1, '#050914');
        ctx.fillStyle = chamber;
        ctx.fillRect(
          UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.left + ox,
          UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.top + oy,
          UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.right - UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.left,
          UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.bottom - UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.top,
        );

        // Service-grid floor and glowing conduit routes.
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(87,118,160,.13)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let x = UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.left; x <= UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.right; x += 96) {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + ox, UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.top + oy); ctx.lineTo(x + ox, UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.bottom + oy); ctx.stroke();
        }
        for (let y = UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.top; y <= UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.bottom; y += 96) {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.left + ox, y + oy); ctx.lineTo(UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.right + ox, y + oy); ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(192,132,252,.28)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 16;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(UNDERGROUND_ENTRY.x + ox, UNDERGROUND_ENTRY.y + oy);
        ctx.lineTo(UNDERGROUND_ENTRY.x + ox, 7900 + oy);
        ctx.lineTo(5920 + ox, 7900 + oy);
        ctx.moveTo(UNDERGROUND_ENTRY.x + ox, 7900 + oy);
        ctx.lineTo(7900 + ox, 7790 + oy);
        ctx.moveTo(6500 + ox, 7900 + oy);
        ctx.lineTo(6500 + ox, 8240 + oy);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(34,211,238,.65)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.setLineDash([18, 12]);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        for (const wall of UNDERGROUND_SOLIDS) {
          const wx = wall.x + ox, wy = wall.y + oy;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#161827';
          ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, wall.w, wall.h);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.22)';
          ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, wall.w, 3);
        }

        for (const poi of UNDERGROUND_POIS) {
          const sx = poi.x + ox, sy = poi.y + oy;
          const pulse = 18 + Math.sin(g.frame * .04 + poi.x) * 4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `${poi.color}22`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = poi.color;
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.strokeRect(sx - 34, sy - 24, 68, 48);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#070914';
          ctx.fillRect(sx - 30, sy - 20, 60, 40);
          ctx.fillStyle = poi.color;
          ctx.font = 'bold 8px "Share Tech Mono"';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(poi.title, sx, sy - 34);
          ctx.font = '6px "Share Tech Mono"';
          ctx.fillText(poi.subtitle, sx, sy + 38);
        }

        // Pipes and suspended lamps create depth without changing collision.
        for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
          const lx = UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.left + 120 + i * 195 + ox;
          const ly = UNDERGROUND_BOUNDS.top + 70 + (i % 3) * 18 + oy;
          ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 ? 'rgba(34,211,238,.5)' : 'rgba(236,72,153,.45)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lx, ly - 35); ctx.lineTo(lx, ly); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.shadowColor = i % 2 ? '#22d3ee' : '#ec4899'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
          ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? '#67e8f9' : '#f9a8d4';
          ctx.fillRect(lx - 5, ly, 10, 3);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }

        // Player marker uses the shared paper-doll renderer.
        drawPlayerSprite(ctx, g.appearance ?? defaultAppearance(char.class), {
          px: g.px + ox,
          py: g.py + oy,
          pCls: char.class.toLowerCase(),
        });
        if (g.near === '__underground_exit' || g.near?.startsWith('__underground_poi:')) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#e9d5ff' : 'rgba(233,213,255,.5)';
          ctx.font = '9px "Share Tech Mono"';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] INTERACT', g.px + ox, g.py + oy - 24);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,2,12,.32)';
        for (let y = 0; y < ch; y += 4) ctx.fillRect(-ox, -oy + y, cw, 1);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c084fc';
        ctx.font = 'bold 10px "Share Tech Mono"';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText('MINX CITY // UNDERGROUND LEVEL B1', -ox + 18, -oy + 26);
        if (g.subwayTransit) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.82)';
          ctx.fillRect(-ox, -oy, cw, ch);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
          ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Share Tech Mono"';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('VERTICAL TRANSIT', -ox + cw / 2, -oy + ch / 2);
        }
        ctx.restore();
        animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        return;
      }

      // ── Smooth terrain rendering — offscreen chunk cache ─────────────────
      // Replaces per-tile diamond rendering with pre-rendered biome textures
      // blended across zone boundaries. Chunks are cached and only redrawn
      // when the lighting level changes.
      const CHUNK = 512; // world-space chunk size in pixels
      const noiseT = (wx: number, wy: number, freq: number, offset = 0) => {
        const v =
          Math.sin(wx * freq * 0.0031 + wy * freq * 0.0017 + offset) * 0.5 +
          Math.sin(wx * freq * 0.0053 + wy * freq * 0.0041 + offset + 1.7) * 0.3 +
          Math.sin(wx * freq * 0.0019 + wy * freq * 0.0067 + offset + 3.2) * 0.2;
        return v * 0.5 + 0.5;
      };

      const getBiomeColor = (wx: number, wy: number, br: number): [number, number, number] => {
        const distW2 = wx - BORDER;
        const distE2 = W - BORDER - wx;
        const distN2 = wy - BORDER;
        const distS2 = H - BORDER - wy;

        const n1 = noiseT(wx, wy, 1.0);
        const n2 = noiseT(wx, wy, 2.3, 50);
        const n3 = noiseT(wx, wy, 0.5, 100);

        const inCity = wx >= CITY_LEFT && wx <= CITY_RIGHT && wy >= CITY_TOP && wy <= CITY_BOTTOM;
        const shoreW = Math.max(0, 1 - distW2 / 280);
        const shoreE = Math.max(0, 1 - distE2 / 280);
        const footN = Math.max(0, 1 - distN2 / 420);
        const footS = Math.max(0, 1 - distS2 / 420);
        const shoreBlend = Math.max(shoreW, shoreE);
        const footBlend = Math.max(footN, footS);
        const suburbanBlend = inCity ? 0 : Math.max(0, 1 - Math.min(
          Math.abs(wx - (CITY_LEFT + CITY_RIGHT) / 2) / 900,
          Math.abs(wy - (CITY_TOP + CITY_BOTTOM) / 2) / 900
        ));

        let r = 0, g3 = 0, b = 0;

        if (inCity) {
          const inDowntown2 = wx >= CITY_LEFT + 100 && wx < CITY_LEFT + 600 && wy >= CITY_TOP + 100;
          const inNeonStrip2 = wx >= CITY_LEFT + 600 && wy < CITY_TOP + 500;
          const inIndustrial2 = wx >= CITY_LEFT + 600 && wy >= CITY_TOP + 500;
          const inOldDistrict2 = wx < CITY_LEFT + 100;
          // ── Neon-noir ground grade — cool cousins of the building palette ──
          // Re-graded from the old warm grey/brown "daytime town" tones to the
          // same indigo/slate/teal/plum noir key as the buildings, so the city
          // surface reads as one cohesive world. Each district keeps a distinct
          // hue (cool slate / indigo-plum / teal-steel / plum-slate) but all
          // sit blue-dominant so amber-lit windows still pop. Colour-only.
          if (inDowntown2) {
            r = 58 + n1 * 12 + n2 * 6; g3 = 62 + n1 * 11 + n2 * 4; b = 78 + n1 * 12 + n2 * 5;
          } else if (inNeonStrip2) {
            r = 64 + n1 * 12 + n3 * 5; g3 = 56 + n1 * 10 + n3 * 4; b = 84 + n1 * 14 + n3 * 8;
          } else if (inIndustrial2) {
            r = 56 + n1 * 10 + n2 * 7; g3 = 72 + n1 * 11 + n2 * 7; b = 84 + n1 * 10 + n2 * 6;
          } else if (inOldDistrict2) {
            r = 78 + n1 * 14 + n3 * 7; g3 = 66 + n1 * 11 + n3 * 6; b = 88 + n1 * 12 + n3 * 6;
          } else {
            r = 62 + n1 * 12 + n2 * 6; g3 = 66 + n1 * 10 + n2 * 5; b = 82 + n1 * 11 + n2 * 5;
          }
        } else {
          // Wasteland/open terrain base
          r = 108 + n1 * 24 + n3 * 12; g3 = 90 + n1 * 22 + n3 * 10; b = 58 + n1 * 16 + n3 * 8;
          // Suburban grass blend
          if (suburbanBlend > 0) {
            const sr = 72 + n1 * 18 + n2 * 10; const sg3 = 92 + n1 * 24 + n2 * 14; const sb = 44 + n1 * 14 + n2 * 8;
            r = r + (sr - r) * suburbanBlend; g3 = g3 + (sg3 - g3) * suburbanBlend; b = b + (sb - b) * suburbanBlend;
          }
          // Sandy shore blend
          if (shoreBlend > 0) {
            const sr = 178 + n1 * 18 + n2 * 8; const sg3 = 160 + n1 * 14 + n2 * 6; const sb = 112 + n1 * 10 + n2 * 4;
            r = r + (sr - r) * shoreBlend; g3 = g3 + (sg3 - g3) * shoreBlend; b = b + (sb - b) * shoreBlend;
          }
          // Rocky foothills blend
          if (footBlend > 0) {
            const fr = 100 + n2 * 22 + n3 * 10; const fg3 = 86 + n2 * 17 + n3 * 8; const fb = 64 + n2 * 12 + n3 * 6;
            r = r + (fr - r) * footBlend; g3 = g3 + (fg3 - g3) * footBlend; b = b + (fb - b) * footBlend;
          }
        }

        return [
          Math.min(255, Math.max(0, Math.round(r * br))),
          Math.min(255, Math.max(0, Math.round(g3 * br))),
          Math.min(255, Math.max(0, Math.round(b * br))),
        ];
      };

      const terrainBr = dayBright * (1 - pwDark * 0.7);
      // Invalidate all chunks when lighting changes significantly
      if (Math.abs(lastTerrainDayBright.current - terrainBr) > 0.025) {
        terrainChunkCache.current.clear();
        lastTerrainDayBright.current = terrainBr;
      }

      // OffscreenCanvas helper with HTMLCanvasElement fallback
      const makeOffscreenCtx = (w: number, h: number): { canvas: OffscreenCanvas | HTMLCanvasElement; ctx2d: OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D | CanvasRenderingContext2D } => {
        if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'undefined') {
          const oc = new OffscreenCanvas(w, h);
          return { canvas: oc, ctx2d: oc.getContext('2d') as OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D };
        }
        const fc = document.createElement('canvas');
        fc.width = w; fc.height = h;
        return { canvas: fc as unknown as OffscreenCanvas, ctx2d: fc.getContext('2d') as CanvasRenderingContext2D };
      };

      // Determine which chunks are visible and draw them
      const camWorldX = g.cam.x, camWorldY = g.cam.y;
      const chunkStartX = Math.floor(camWorldX / CHUNK) * CHUNK;
      const chunkStartY = Math.floor(camWorldY / CHUNK) * CHUNK;
      const chunksWide = Math.ceil((cw + CHUNK) / CHUNK) + 1;
      const chunksTall = Math.ceil((ch + CHUNK) / CHUNK) + 1;

      // LRU-style cache eviction: keep max 64 chunks (covers >5x the visible area)
      const MAX_TERRAIN_CHUNKS = 64;
      if (terrainChunkCache.current.size > MAX_TERRAIN_CHUNKS) {
        const cachePlayerChunkX = Math.floor(g.px / CHUNK) * CHUNK;
        const cachePlayerChunkY = Math.floor(g.py / CHUNK) * CHUNK;
        // Remove chunks farthest from player
        const entries = [...terrainChunkCache.current.entries()];
        entries.sort(([ka], [kb]) => {
          const [axS, ayS] = ka.split(',').map(Number);
          const [bxS, byS] = kb.split(',').map(Number);
          const da = Math.abs(axS - cachePlayerChunkX) + Math.abs(ayS - cachePlayerChunkY);
          const db = Math.abs(bxS - cachePlayerChunkX) + Math.abs(byS - cachePlayerChunkY);
          return db - da; // farthest first
        });
        const toRemove = entries.slice(0, terrainChunkCache.current.size - MAX_TERRAIN_CHUNKS);
        for (const [k] of toRemove) terrainChunkCache.current.delete(k);
      }

      for (let ci = 0; ci < chunksWide; ci++) {
        for (let cj = 0; cj < chunksTall; cj++) {
          const chunkWX = chunkStartX + ci * CHUNK - CHUNK;
          const chunkWY = chunkStartY + cj * CHUNK - CHUNK;
          const chunkKey = `${chunkWX},${chunkWY}`;

          // Screen position of this chunk's top-left corner
          const screenX = Math.round(chunkWX - camWorldX);
          const screenY = Math.round(chunkWY - camWorldY);

          if (screenX > cw + 8 || screenX + CHUNK < -8 || screenY > ch + 8 || screenY + CHUNK < -8) continue;

          let cached = terrainChunkCache.current.get(chunkKey);
          if (!cached) {
            // Build the offscreen canvas for this chunk
            const { canvas: oc, ctx2d: oc2d } = makeOffscreenCtx(CHUNK, CHUNK);
            const STEP = 16; // sample every 16 pixels for smooth gradients
            for (let px2 = 0; px2 < CHUNK; px2 += STEP) {
              for (let py2 = 0; py2 < CHUNK; py2 += STEP) {
                const wx2 = chunkWX + px2;
                const wy2 = chunkWY + py2;
                const [r2, g2, b2] = getBiomeColor(wx2, wy2, terrainBr);
                oc2d.fillStyle = `rgb(${r2},${g2},${b2})`;
                oc2d.fillRect(px2, py2, STEP, STEP);
              }
            }
            const newCached = { canvas: oc, dayBright: terrainBr };
            terrainChunkCache.current.set(chunkKey, newCached);
            cached = newCached;
          }

          ctx.drawImage(cached!.canvas, screenX, screenY);
        }
      }

      // Neon puddle reflections at night (neon strip, drawn on top of terrain)
      if (isNight) {
        const neonNoiseHash = (x: number, y: number) => {
          const hv = Math.sin(x * 4.1 + y * 3.7 + 20) * 43758.5;
          return hv - Math.floor(hv);
        };
        const neonLeft = CITY_LEFT + 600, neonRight = CITY_RIGHT;
        const neonTop = CITY_TOP, neonBot = CITY_TOP + 500;
        const nxStart = Math.max(neonLeft, camWorldX - TILE);
        const nxEnd = Math.min(neonRight, camWorldX + cw + TILE);
        const nyStart = Math.max(neonTop, camWorldY - TILE);
        const nyEnd = Math.min(neonBot, camWorldY + ch + TILE);
        for (let nx2 = nxStart; nx2 < nxEnd; nx2 += TILE) {
          for (let ny2 = nyStart; ny2 < nyEnd; ny2 += TILE) {
            const ph4 = neonNoiseHash(nx2 / TILE, ny2 / TILE);
            if (ph4 > 0.76) {
              const rc2 = Math.floor(ph4 * 3) % 3;
              const pudA = (ph4 - 0.76) * 0.45;
              const sx2 = nx2 + ox, sy2 = ny2 + oy;
              ctx.fillStyle = rc2 === 0 ? `rgba(255,80,150,${pudA})` : rc2 === 1 ? `rgba(0,200,255,${pudA})` : `rgba(180,0,255,${pudA * 0.8})`;
              ctx.fillRect(sx2, sy2, TILE, TILE);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const drawBorderTerrain = () => {
        const northEdge = BORDER + oy;
        const southEdge = (H - BORDER) + oy;
        const westEdge = BORDER + ox;
        const eastEdge = (W - BORDER) + ox;
        const mtnBr = dayBright;
        const waterBr = isNight ? 0.38 : mtnBr;
        const waveT = g.frame * 0.022;
        const noiseS = (x: number, y: number, freq: number) =>
          (Math.sin(x * freq * 0.013 + y * freq * 0.007) * 0.5 +
           Math.sin(x * freq * 0.019 + y * freq * 0.011 + 1.3) * 0.35 +
           Math.sin(x * freq * 0.007 + y * freq * 0.023 + 2.7) * 0.15) * 0.5 + 0.5;

        // ── NORTH BORDER — Mountain range ────────────────────────────────────
        if (northEdge > -220) {
          // Rocky base fill
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(72 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(60 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(45 * mtnBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, Math.max(0, oy), cw, Math.max(0, northEdge - oy + 40));

          // Foothills gradient band (playable side) — smooth gradient fill
          const foothillDepth = 160;
          const foothillGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, northEdge, 0, northEdge + foothillDepth);
          foothillGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${Math.floor(55 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(80 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(35 * mtnBr)},0.32)`);
          foothillGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${Math.floor(90 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(125 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(55 * mtnBr)},0)`);
          ctx.fillStyle = foothillGrad;
          ctx.fillRect(0, northEdge, cw, foothillDepth);

          // Mountain back layer — distant peaks, darkest/smallest
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, northEdge + 15);
          for (let mx = 0; mx <= cw; mx += 12) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const peakH = 45 + noiseS(wPos, 0, 0.6) * 60 + noiseS(wPos, 1000, 1.2) * 20;
            ctx.lineTo(mx, northEdge - peakH);
          }
          ctx.lineTo(cw, northEdge + 15);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(45 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(38 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(30 * mtnBr)})`;
          ctx.fill();

          // Mountain mid layer
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, northEdge + 10);
          for (let mx = 0; mx <= cw; mx += 10) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const peakH = 38 + noiseS(wPos, 300, 0.9) * 48 + noiseS(wPos, 700, 1.8) * 18;
            ctx.lineTo(mx, northEdge - peakH);
          }
          ctx.lineTo(cw, northEdge + 10);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(62 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(52 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(40 * mtnBr)})`;
          ctx.fill();

          // Mountain front layer — closest peaks, lightest
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, northEdge + 4);
          for (let mx = 0; mx <= cw; mx += 6) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const peakH = 22 + noiseS(wPos, 200, 1.5) * 44 + noiseS(wPos, 800, 3.2) * 14 + noiseS(wPos, 1500, 5.0) * 6;
            ctx.lineTo(mx, northEdge - peakH);
          }
          ctx.lineTo(cw, northEdge + 4);
          ctx.closePath();
          // Gradient from rock face color to slightly lighter at base
          const mtnFrontGradN = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, northEdge - 80, 0, northEdge + 5);
          mtnFrontGradN.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${Math.floor(100 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(84 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(64 * mtnBr)})`);
          mtnFrontGradN.addColorStop(0.5, `rgb(${Math.floor(88 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(72 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(55 * mtnBr)})`);
          mtnFrontGradN.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${Math.floor(78 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(64 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(48 * mtnBr)})`);
          ctx.fillStyle = mtnFrontGradN;
          ctx.fill();

          // Rock ledges / strata lines for natural texture
          for (let mx = 0; mx < cw; mx += 4) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const ledge1 = noiseS(wPos * 1.8, 100, 2.2);
            const ledge2 = noiseS(wPos * 2.5, 400, 3.0);
            if (ledge1 > 0.65) {
              const ly = northEdge - 10 - ledge1 * 16;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(150 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(122 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(90 * mtnBr)},${(ledge1 - 0.65) * 1.4})`;
              ctx.fillRect(mx, ly, 4, 1.5);
            }
            if (ledge2 > 0.68) {
              const ly2 = northEdge - 25 - ledge2 * 20;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(130 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(106 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(80 * mtnBr)},${(ledge2 - 0.68) * 1.2})`;
              ctx.fillRect(mx, ly2, 4, 1.5);
            }
          }

          // Snow caps — smooth gradient-filled triangles on tallest peaks
          for (let mx = 4; mx < cw - 4; mx += 16) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const n1 = noiseS(wPos, 200, 1.5);
            const n2 = noiseS(wPos, 800, 3.2);
            const peakH = 22 + n1 * 44 + n2 * 14;
            if (n1 > 0.55) {
              const snowBase = northEdge - peakH;
              const snowH = (n1 - 0.55) * 45;
              const snowW = 8 + n1 * 12;
              const snowGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(mx, snowBase, mx, snowBase + snowH);
              snowGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(245,248,255,${0.9 * mtnBr})`);
              snowGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(230,238,255,${0.7 * mtnBr})`);
              snowGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(210,225,255,${0.0})`);
              ctx.fillStyle = snowGrad;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(mx - snowW * 0.5, snowBase + snowH);
              ctx.lineTo(mx + snowW * 0.5, snowBase + snowH);
              ctx.lineTo(mx + snowW * 0.15, snowBase + snowH * 0.3);
              ctx.lineTo(mx, snowBase);
              ctx.lineTo(mx - snowW * 0.15, snowBase + snowH * 0.3);
              ctx.closePath();
              ctx.fill();
            }
          }

          // Wind particles near north mountains
          for (let wi = 0; wi < 8; wi++) {
            const wSeed = Math.sin(wi * 3.7 + g.frame * 0.008) * 0.5 + 0.5;
            const windX = ((g.frame * 0.8 + wi * 180) % (cw + 40)) - 20;
            const windY = northEdge + 20 + wSeed * 80;
            const windAlpha = 0.12 + wSeed * 0.1;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,220,240,${windAlpha})`;
            ctx.fillRect(windX, windY, 18 + wSeed * 10, 1.5);
            ctx.fillRect(windX + 4, windY + 3, 10 + wSeed * 6, 1);
          }
        }

        // ── SOUTH BORDER — Mountain range ────────────────────────────────────
        if (southEdge < ch + 220) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(68 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(55 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(42 * mtnBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, southEdge - 30, cw, ch - southEdge + 260);

          // Foothills on playable side — smooth gradient fill
          const foothillDepth = 160;
          const sfoothillGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, southEdge, 0, southEdge - foothillDepth);
          sfoothillGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${Math.floor(50 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(75 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(30 * mtnBr)},0.28)`);
          sfoothillGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${Math.floor(80 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(115 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(45 * mtnBr)},0)`);
          ctx.fillStyle = sfoothillGrad;
          ctx.fillRect(0, southEdge - foothillDepth, cw, foothillDepth);

          // Mountain back layer
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, southEdge - 12);
          for (let mx = 0; mx <= cw; mx += 12) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const peakH = 45 + noiseS(wPos, 3000, 0.6) * 62 + noiseS(wPos, 4000, 1.2) * 20;
            ctx.lineTo(mx, southEdge + peakH);
          }
          ctx.lineTo(cw, southEdge - 12);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(44 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(36 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(28 * mtnBr)})`;
          ctx.fill();

          // Mountain mid layer
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, southEdge - 8);
          for (let mx = 0; mx <= cw; mx += 10) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const peakH = 36 + noiseS(wPos, 3300, 0.9) * 50 + noiseS(wPos, 3700, 1.8) * 18;
            ctx.lineTo(mx, southEdge + peakH);
          }
          ctx.lineTo(cw, southEdge - 8);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(60 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(50 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(38 * mtnBr)})`;
          ctx.fill();

          // Mountain front layer with gradient
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, southEdge - 3);
          for (let mx = 0; mx <= cw; mx += 6) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const peakH = 20 + noiseS(wPos, 3200, 1.6) * 42 + noiseS(wPos, 4000, 3.2) * 14 + noiseS(wPos, 5000, 5.0) * 6;
            ctx.lineTo(mx, southEdge + peakH);
          }
          ctx.lineTo(cw, southEdge - 3);
          ctx.closePath();
          const mtnFrontGradS = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, southEdge + 80, 0, southEdge - 4);
          mtnFrontGradS.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${Math.floor(98 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(82 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(62 * mtnBr)})`);
          mtnFrontGradS.addColorStop(0.5, `rgb(${Math.floor(86 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(70 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(53 * mtnBr)})`);
          mtnFrontGradS.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${Math.floor(76 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(62 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(46 * mtnBr)})`);
          ctx.fillStyle = mtnFrontGradS;
          ctx.fill();

          // Rock strata ledges
          for (let mx = 0; mx < cw; mx += 4) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const ledge1 = noiseS(wPos * 1.9, 3100, 2.2);
            const ledge2 = noiseS(wPos * 2.6, 3400, 3.1);
