            if (ledge1 > 0.64) {
              const ly = southEdge + 10 + ledge1 * 16;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(148 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(118 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(88 * mtnBr)},${(ledge1 - 0.64) * 1.4})`;
              ctx.fillRect(mx, ly, 4, 1.5);
            }
            if (ledge2 > 0.68) {
              const ly2 = southEdge + 28 + ledge2 * 18;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(128 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(102 * mtnBr)},${Math.floor(76 * mtnBr)},${(ledge2 - 0.68) * 1.1})`;
              ctx.fillRect(mx, ly2, 4, 1.5);
            }
          }

          // Snow caps
          for (let mx = 4; mx < cw - 4; mx += 16) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const n1 = noiseS(wPos, 3200, 1.6);
            const n2 = noiseS(wPos, 4000, 3.2);
            const peakH = 20 + n1 * 42 + n2 * 14;
            if (n1 > 0.57) {
              const snowBase = southEdge + peakH;
              const snowH = (n1 - 0.57) * 42;
              const snowW = 8 + n1 * 12;
              const snowGradS = ctx.createLinearGradient(mx, snowBase, mx, snowBase - snowH);
              snowGradS.addColorStop(0, `rgba(245,248,255,${0.88 * mtnBr})`);
              snowGradS.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(230,238,255,${0.65 * mtnBr})`);
              snowGradS.addColorStop(1, `rgba(210,225,255,${0.0})`);
              ctx.fillStyle = snowGradS;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(mx - snowW * 0.5, snowBase - snowH);
              ctx.lineTo(mx + snowW * 0.5, snowBase - snowH);
              ctx.lineTo(mx + snowW * 0.15, snowBase - snowH * 0.3);
              ctx.lineTo(mx, snowBase);
              ctx.lineTo(mx - snowW * 0.15, snowBase - snowH * 0.3);
              ctx.closePath();
              ctx.fill();
            }
          }

          // Wind particles near south mountains
          for (let wi = 0; wi < 8; wi++) {
            const wSeed = Math.sin(wi * 4.1 + g.frame * 0.009 + 5) * 0.5 + 0.5;
            const windX = cw - ((g.frame * 0.7 + wi * 160) % (cw + 40));
            const windY = southEdge - 20 - wSeed * 70;
            const windAlpha = 0.1 + wSeed * 0.1;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(195,215,235,${windAlpha})`;
            ctx.fillRect(windX, windY, 16 + wSeed * 12, 1.5);
          }
        }

        // ── WEST BORDER — Ocean coastline ────────────────────────────────────
        // Pre-render static elements (ocean gradient, coastline shape, beach strip)
        // into a cached offscreen canvas. Re-render only when camera Y or waterBr changes.
        if (westEdge > -300) {
          const camYBucket = Math.round(g.cam.y / 64) * 64;
          const wcCached = coastCacheWest.current;
          if (!wcCached || Math.abs(wcCached.camY - camYBucket) > 64 || Math.abs(wcCached.waterBr - waterBr) > 0.02) {
            // Build static coast canvas (OffscreenCanvas with HTMLCanvasElement fallback)
            const { canvas: wOc, ctx2d: wOc2d } = makeOffscreenCtx(cw + 80, ch);
            const deepR = Math.floor(18 * waterBr), deepG = Math.floor(55 * waterBr), deepB = Math.floor(130 * waterBr);
            const shallR = Math.floor(35 * waterBr), shallG = Math.floor(110 * waterBr), shallB = Math.floor(180 * waterBr);
            // Ocean depth gradient (full strip width)
            const oceanGradOff = wOc2d.createLinearGradient(0, 0, wOc.width, 0);
            oceanGradOff.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${deepR},${deepG},${deepB})`);
            oceanGradOff.addColorStop(0.7, `rgb(${Math.floor(25 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(80 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(155 * waterBr)})`);
            oceanGradOff.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${shallR},${shallG},${shallB})`);
            wOc2d.fillStyle = oceanGradOff;
            wOc2d.fillRect(0, 0, wOc.width, ch);
            // Coastline shape overlay
            wOc2d.beginPath();
            const wEdgeOff = wOc.width - 40;
            wOc2d.moveTo(wOc.width, 0);
            for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 <= ch; wy2 += 6) {
              const wPos = wy2 + camYBucket;
              const coastN = noiseS(0, wPos, 1.0) * 22 + noiseS(100, wPos, 2.8) * 10;
              wOc2d.lineTo(wEdgeOff + coastN, wy2);
            }
            wOc2d.lineTo(wOc.width, ch);
            wOc2d.closePath();
            wOc2d.fillStyle = `rgba(${shallR},${shallG},${shallB},0.55)`;
            wOc2d.fill();
            // Sandy beach strip (baked, no per-pixel wave sine)
            for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 < ch; wy2 += 4) {
              const wPos = wy2 + camYBucket;
              const beachX = wEdgeOff + noiseS(0, wPos, 1.0) * 18 + 4;
              const beachW = 14 + noiseS(50, wPos, 1.4) * 12;
              const sandR = Math.floor((184 + noiseS(wPos * 0.3, 0, 2) * 18) * mtnBr);
              const sandG = Math.floor((164 + noiseS(wPos * 0.3, 100, 2) * 14) * mtnBr);
              const sandB2 = Math.floor((114 + noiseS(wPos * 0.3, 200, 2) * 10) * mtnBr);
              wOc2d.fillStyle = `rgb(${sandR},${sandG},${sandB2})`;
              wOc2d.fillRect(beachX, wy2, beachW, 4);
            }
            coastCacheWest.current = { canvas: wOc, camY: camYBucket, waterBr };
          }
          // Draw cached static coast layer (offset adjusted for camera drift since last cache)
          const camYDrift = g.cam.y - camYBucket;
          ctx.drawImage(coastCacheWest.current!.canvas, Math.max(0, ox) - 40, -camYDrift);

          // Animated wave bands (reduced: 2 layers, 14px stride)
          for (let wl = 0; wl < 2; wl++) {
            const wOffset = wl * 18 + waveT * (1 + wl * 0.5);
            for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 < ch; wy2 += 14) {
              const wx2 = westEdge + Math.sin(wy2 * 0.07 + wOffset) * 8 + Math.sin(wy2 * 0.02 + wOffset * 0.5) * 14;
              const wBr2 = 0.7 + Math.sin(wy2 * 0.04 + wOffset) * 0.3;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(60 * wBr2 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(155 * wBr2 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(225 * wBr2 * waterBr)},0.55)`;
              ctx.fillRect(wx2 - 12, wy2, 14, 4);
            }
          }

          // Foam surf line (animated)
          for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 < ch; wy2 += 6) {
            const wPos = wy2 - oy + g.cam.y;
            const foamX = westEdge + noiseS(0, wPos, 1.0) * 16 + Math.sin(waveT * 1.4 + wPos * 0.008) * 6;
            const foamBr = 0.5 + Math.sin(waveT * 2 + wy2 * 0.1) * 0.5;
            if (foamBr > 0.3) {
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${foamBr * 0.3 * waterBr})`;
              ctx.fillRect(foamX - 2, wy2, Math.floor(foamBr * 8), 2);
            }
          }

          // Seabirds near west coast (animated)
          const nearWestCoast = g.px < BORDER + 800;
          if (nearWestCoast) {
            for (let bi = 0; bi < 4; bi++) {
              const bTime = g.frame * 0.012 + bi * 1.8;
              const bx2 = westEdge + 30 + Math.sin(bTime * 0.7 + bi) * 55;
              const by2 = (ch * (0.15 + bi * 0.2)) + Math.sin(bTime + bi * 0.5) * 18;
              if (bx2 < 0 || bx2 > cw || by2 < 0 || by2 > ch) continue;
              const wingFlap = Math.sin(bTime * 3.5) * 3;
              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(240,240,250,${0.65 * waterBr})`;
              ctx.lineWidth = 1;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(bx2, by2);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx2 - 5, by2 - wingFlap, bx2 - 9, by2 - 1);
              ctx.moveTo(bx2, by2);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx2 + 5, by2 - wingFlap, bx2 + 9, by2 - 1);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }

        // ── EAST BORDER — Ocean coastline ────────────────────────────────────
        if (eastEdge < cw + 300) {
          const camYBucketE = Math.round(g.cam.y / 64) * 64;
          const ecCached = coastCacheEast.current;
          if (!ecCached || Math.abs(ecCached.camY - camYBucketE) > 64 || Math.abs(ecCached.waterBr - waterBr) > 0.02) {
            const { canvas: eOc, ctx2d: eOc2d } = makeOffscreenCtx(cw + 80, ch);
            // Ocean gradient (east side goes deep to shallow right-to-left from screen)
            const eOceanGrad = eOc2d.createLinearGradient(eOc.width, 0, 0, 0);
            eOceanGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${Math.floor(14 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(45 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(110 * waterBr)})`);
            eOceanGrad.addColorStop(0.55, `rgb(${Math.floor(22 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(68 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(140 * waterBr)})`);
            eOceanGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${Math.floor(30 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(95 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(165 * waterBr)})`);
            eOc2d.fillStyle = eOceanGrad;
            eOc2d.fillRect(0, 0, eOc.width, ch);
            // Coastline edge shape
            const eEdgeOff = 40;
            eOc2d.beginPath();
            eOc2d.moveTo(0, 0);
            for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 <= ch; wy2 += 6) {
              const wPos = wy2 + camYBucketE;
              const coastN = noiseS(5000, wPos, 1.0) * 22 + noiseS(5100, wPos, 2.8) * 10;
              eOc2d.lineTo(eEdgeOff - coastN, wy2);
            }
            eOc2d.lineTo(0, ch);
            eOc2d.closePath();
            eOc2d.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(30 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(95 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(165 * waterBr)},0.5)`;
            eOc2d.fill();
            // Sandy east beach (baked)
            for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 < ch; wy2 += 4) {
              const wPos = wy2 + camYBucketE;
              const beachX = eEdgeOff - noiseS(5000, wPos, 1.0) * 16 - 22;
              const beachW = 13 + noiseS(5050, wPos, 1.4) * 11;
              const sandR = Math.floor((176 + noiseS(wPos * 0.3, 500, 2) * 18) * mtnBr);
              const sandG = Math.floor((156 + noiseS(wPos * 0.3, 600, 2) * 14) * mtnBr);
              const sandB3 = Math.floor((106 + noiseS(wPos * 0.3, 700, 2) * 10) * mtnBr);
              eOc2d.fillStyle = `rgb(${sandR},${sandG},${sandB3})`;
              eOc2d.fillRect(beachX, wy2, beachW, 4);
            }
            coastCacheEast.current = { canvas: eOc, camY: camYBucketE, waterBr };
          }
          // Draw cached east coast (east of eastEdge screen position)
          const camYDriftE = g.cam.y - camYBucketE;
          ctx.drawImage(coastCacheEast.current!.canvas, eastEdge - 40, -camYDriftE);

          // East wave bands (animated)
          for (let wl = 0; wl < 2; wl++) {
            const wOffset = wl * 12 + waveT * (0.9 + wl * 0.4) + 2;
            for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 < ch; wy2 += 14) {
              const wx2 = eastEdge + Math.sin(wy2 * 0.07 + wOffset) * 8 + Math.sin(wy2 * 0.025 + wOffset * 0.6) * 10;
              const wBr2 = 0.65 + Math.sin(wy2 * 0.045 + wOffset) * 0.3;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(50 * wBr2 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(142 * wBr2 * waterBr)},${Math.floor(215 * wBr2 * waterBr)},0.5)`;
              ctx.fillRect(wx2 - 2, wy2, 12, 4);
            }
          }

          // Foam at east shore (animated)
          for (let wy2 = 0; wy2 < ch; wy2 += 6) {
            const wPos = wy2 - oy + g.cam.y;
            const foamX = eastEdge - noiseS(5000, wPos, 1.0) * 16 - Math.sin(waveT * 1.6 + wPos * 0.008) * 5;
            const foamBr = 0.5 + Math.sin(waveT * 2.2 + wy2 * 0.09) * 0.5;
            if (foamBr > 0.3) {
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${foamBr * 0.28 * waterBr})`;
              ctx.fillRect(foamX - 2, wy2, Math.floor(foamBr * 8), 2);
            }
          }

          // Seabirds near east coast (animated)
          const nearEastCoast = g.px > W - BORDER - 800;
          if (nearEastCoast) {
            for (let bi = 0; bi < 4; bi++) {
              const bTime = g.frame * 0.011 + bi * 2.1 + 3;
              const bx2 = eastEdge - 25 - Math.sin(bTime * 0.65 + bi) * 50;
              const by2 = (ch * (0.12 + bi * 0.2)) + Math.sin(bTime * 0.9 + bi) * 18;
              if (bx2 < 0 || bx2 > cw || by2 < 0 || by2 > ch) continue;
              const wingFlap = Math.sin(bTime * 3.2) * 3;
              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(235,235,245,${0.6 * waterBr})`;
              ctx.lineWidth = 1;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(bx2, by2);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx2 - 5, by2 - wingFlap, bx2 - 8, by2 - 1);
              ctx.moveTo(bx2, by2);
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx2 + 5, by2 - wingFlap, bx2 + 8, by2 - 1);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }

        // ── RIVERS: from mountains toward coast ───────────────────────────────
        // Wide bezier-curve rivers — natural winding bends
        const RIVERS = [
          { sx: 3200, sy: BORDER + 80,      ex: BORDER + 60,      ey: 5000,
            cp1x: 3600, cp1y: 1400, cp2x: 600,  cp2y: 3200 },
          { sx: 8500, sy: BORDER + 100,     ex: W - BORDER - 80,  ey: 4200,
            cp1x: 7800, cp1y: 1200, cp2x: 12200, cp2y: 2400 },
          { sx: 5800, sy: H - BORDER - 90,  ex: BORDER + 80,      ey: 8800,
            cp1x: 4200, cp1y: 11200, cp2x: 1800, cp2y: 9200 },
          { sx: 9200, sy: H - BORDER - 110, ex: W - BORDER - 70,  ey: 9400,
            cp1x: 10800, cp1y: 11800, cp2x: 12000, cp2y: 9800 },
        ];
        const riverT = g.frame * 0.012;
        for (const rv of RIVERS) {
          const sx = rv.sx + ox, sy = rv.sy + oy;
          const ex = rv.ex + ox, ey = rv.ey + oy;
          const c1x = rv.cp1x + ox, c1y = rv.cp1y + oy;
          const c2x = rv.cp2x + ox, c2y = rv.cp2y + oy;
          const bbox = [sx, ex, c1x, c2x];
          const bboxY = [sy, ey, c1y, c2y];
          if (Math.max(...bbox) < -80 || Math.min(...bbox) > cw + 80) continue;
          if (Math.max(...bboxY) < -80 || Math.min(...bboxY) > ch + 80) continue;
          const riverBr = isNight ? 0.35 : mtnBr;
          // Draw wide river body
          ctx.lineWidth = 42;
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(20 * riverBr)},${Math.floor(70 * riverBr)},${Math.floor(140 * riverBr)})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.bezierCurveTo(c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, ex, ey); ctx.stroke();
          // Lighter inner water
          ctx.lineWidth = 28;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(35 * riverBr)},${Math.floor(100 * riverBr)},${Math.floor(180 * riverBr)})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.bezierCurveTo(c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, ex, ey); ctx.stroke();
          // Animated flow lines along the river
          for (let fi = 0; fi < 3; fi++) {
            const fOff = (riverT * 0.4 + fi / 3) % 1;
            const t = fOff;
            const t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t;
            const mt = 1 - t, mt2 = mt * mt, mt3 = mt2 * mt;
            const fx = mt3 * sx + 3 * mt2 * t * c1x + 3 * mt * t2 * c2x + t3 * ex;
            const fy = mt3 * sy + 3 * mt2 * t * c1y + 3 * mt * t2 * c2y + t3 * ey;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(fx, fy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160,210,255,${0.25 * riverBr})`;
            ctx.fill();
          }
          // Shore highlight
          ctx.lineWidth = 4;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(180,230,255,${0.15 * riverBr})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.bezierCurveTo(c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, ex, ey); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
        }

        // ── Bridge structures at river/road crossings ────────────────────────
        // Each bridge is drawn as a short set of wooden planks over the river,
        // oriented along the road direction (H=horizontal road, V=vertical road).
        const BRIDGE_CROSSINGS = [
          { wx: 2369,  wy: 1800,  dir: 'H' }, // River 1 × road y=1800
          { wx: 2000,  wy: 2329,  dir: 'V' }, // River 1 × road x=2000
          { wx: 11000, wy: 2347,  dir: 'V' }, // River 2 × road x=11000
          { wx: 12257, wy: 3200,  dir: 'H' }, // River 2 × road y=3200
          { wx: 3742,  wy: 10500, dir: 'H' }, // River 3 × road y=10500
          { wx: 2000,  wy: 9737,  dir: 'V' }, // River 3 × road x=2000
          { wx: 11802, wy: 10500, dir: 'H' }, // River 4 × road y=10500
          { wx: 11000, wy: 10920, dir: 'V' }, // River 4 × road x=11000
        ];
        for (const br2 of BRIDGE_CROSSINGS) {
          const bsx = br2.wx + ox, bsy = br2.wy + oy;
          if (bsx < -60 || bsx > cw + 60 || bsy < -60 || bsy > ch + 60) continue;
          const deckBr = isNight ? 0.28 : dayBright;
          if (br2.dir === 'H') {
            // Horizontal road crossing — planks run left–right over the river
            const bW = 64, bH = 24;
            // River water fill beneath bridge
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(20,80,150,${0.55 * waterBr})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bsx - bW / 2, bsy - 5, bW, 10);
            // Bridge deck
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(140 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(100 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(50 * deckBr)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bsx - bW / 2, bsy - bH / 2, bW, bH);
            // Plank lines
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.22)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            for (let pl = -bW / 2 + 6; pl < bW / 2; pl += 8) {
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bsx + pl, bsy - bH / 2); ctx.lineTo(bsx + pl, bsy + bH / 2); ctx.stroke();
            }
            // Bridge rails
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(90 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(60 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(25 * deckBr)})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bsx - bW / 2, bsy - bH / 2 - 1); ctx.lineTo(bsx + bW / 2, bsy - bH / 2 - 1); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bsx - bW / 2, bsy + bH / 2 + 1); ctx.lineTo(bsx + bW / 2, bsy + bH / 2 + 1); ctx.stroke();
          } else {
            // Vertical road crossing — planks run top–bottom
            const bW2 = 24, bH2 = 64;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(20,80,150,${0.55 * waterBr})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bsx - 5, bsy - bH2 / 2, 10, bH2);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(140 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(100 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(50 * deckBr)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bsx - bW2 / 2, bsy - bH2 / 2, bW2, bH2);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.22)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            for (let pl = -bH2 / 2 + 6; pl < bH2 / 2; pl += 8) {
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bsx - bW2 / 2, bsy + pl); ctx.lineTo(bsx + bW2 / 2, bsy + pl); ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(90 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(60 * deckBr)},${Math.floor(25 * deckBr)})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bsx - bW2 / 2 - 1, bsy - bH2 / 2); ctx.lineTo(bsx - bW2 / 2 - 1, bsy + bH2 / 2); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bsx + bW2 / 2 + 1, bsy - bH2 / 2); ctx.lineTo(bsx + bW2 / 2 + 1, bsy + bH2 / 2); ctx.stroke();
          }
        }

        // ── Forest mist near north/south mountain borders ─────────────────────
        const mistNorth = northEdge + 120;
        const mistSouth = southEdge - 120;
        if (mistNorth > 0 && mistNorth < ch + 80) {
          for (let mx = 0; mx < cw; mx += 40) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const mistN = noiseS(wPos, 8888, 0.8);
            const mistAlpha = 0.06 + mistN * 0.08;
            const mistH = 40 + mistN * 30;
            const mistGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, mistNorth, 0, mistNorth + mistH);
            mistGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(160,180,200,${mistAlpha})`);
            mistGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(160,180,200,0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = mistGrad;
            ctx.fillRect(mx, mistNorth, 40, mistH);
          }
        }
        if (mistSouth > 0 && mistSouth < ch + 80) {
          for (let mx = 0; mx < cw; mx += 40) {
            const wPos = mx - ox + g.cam.x;
            const mistN = noiseS(wPos, 7777, 0.8);
            const mistAlpha = 0.05 + mistN * 0.07;
            const mistH = 35 + mistN * 28;
            const mistGrad2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, mistSouth - mistH, 0, mistSouth);
            mistGrad2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(160,180,200,0)');
            mistGrad2.addColorStop(1, `rgba(155,175,195,${mistAlpha})`);
            ctx.fillStyle = mistGrad2;
            ctx.fillRect(mx, mistSouth - mistH, 40, mistH);
          }
        }
      };
      drawBorderTerrain();

      const drawWastelandTerrain = () => {
        const seed = (x: number, y: number) => Math.sin(x * 0.317 + y * 0.519) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        const TREE_SPACING = 260;
        const ROCK_SPACING = 320;
        const GRASS_SPACING = 120;
        const BUSH_SPACING = 200;
        const viewL = g.cam.x - 80, viewR = g.cam.x + cw + 80;
        const viewT = g.cam.y - 80, viewB = g.cam.y + ch + 80;
        const br = dayBright;

        const inCity = (cx: number, cy: number, pad: number) => cx > CITY_LEFT - pad && cx < CITY_RIGHT + pad && cy > CITY_TOP - pad && cy < CITY_BOTTOM + pad;

        for (let wx = BORDER; wx < W - BORDER; wx += GRASS_SPACING) {
          for (let wy = BORDER; wy < H - BORDER; wy += GRASS_SPACING) {
            if (inCity(wx, wy, 100)) continue;
            if (wx < viewL || wx > viewR || wy < viewT || wy > viewB) continue;
            const s = seed(wx, wy);
            const sx2 = wx + ox, sy2 = wy + oy;
            if (s > 0.25 && s < 0.75) {
              const gShade = s > 0.5 ? [60, 140, 40] : [80, 120, 30];
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(gShade[0] * br)},${Math.floor(gShade[1] * br)},${Math.floor(gShade[2] * br)})`;
              const gw = 10 + s * 16;
              ctx.fillRect(sx2 - gw / 2, sy2 - 1, gw, 3);
              for (let bl = 0; bl < 4; bl++) {
                const bx2 = sx2 - gw / 2 + bl * (gw / 4) + seed(wx + bl, wy) * 3;
                const bladeG = 100 + Math.floor(s * 80);
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(40 * br)},${Math.floor(bladeG * br)},${Math.floor(20 * br)})`;
                ctx.fillRect(bx2, sy2 - 4 - s * 6, 2, 4 + s * 6);
              }
              if (s > 0.6) {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(220 * br)},${Math.floor(180 * br)},${Math.floor(50 * br)})`;
                ctx.fillRect(sx2 + 2, sy2 - 6, 2, 2);
              }
            }
          }
        }

        for (let wx = BORDER + 50; wx < W - BORDER; wx += TREE_SPACING) {
          for (let wy = BORDER + 50; wy < H - BORDER; wy += TREE_SPACING) {
            if (inCity(wx, wy, 200)) continue;
            if (wx < viewL || wx > viewR || wy < viewT || wy > viewB) continue;
            const s = seed(wx * 1.7, wy * 1.3);
            if (s < 0.3) continue;
            const tx = wx + (s - 0.5) * 80 + ox;
            const ty = wy + (s - 0.5) * 60 + oy;
            const treeH = 18 + s * 16;
            const canopyW = 10 + s * 10;
            const canopyH = 12 + s * 8;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.15)`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty + 3, 6, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(90 * br)},${Math.floor(60 * br)},${Math.floor(30 * br)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(tx - 2, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.6, 4, treeH - canopyH * 0.6);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(70 * br)},${Math.floor(50 * br)},${Math.floor(25 * br)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(tx - 2, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.6, 1, treeH - canopyH * 0.6);
            // Smooth ellipse canopy layers
            const g1 = Math.floor((40 + s * 15) * br), g2 = Math.floor((120 + s * 40) * br), g3 = Math.floor(25 * br);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(30 * br)},${Math.floor((100 + s * 50) * br)},${Math.floor(20 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.55, canopyW * 0.85, canopyH * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${g1},${g2},${g3})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.35, canopyW * 0.7, canopyH * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(55 * br)},${Math.floor((140 + s * 30) * br)},${Math.floor(35 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.2, canopyW * 0.5, canopyH * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        }

        // Forest density pass: extra trees inside designated FOREST_ZONES
        // to make those areas read as dense canopy instead of scrubland.
        // Loop bounds are clamped to the visible viewport (snapped to
        // FOREST_STEP) so we don't iterate the full ~36k-cell world grid
        // every frame.
        const FOREST_STEP = 70;
        const fStart = BORDER + 50;
        const fxLo = Math.max(fStart, fStart + Math.floor((viewL - fStart) / FOREST_STEP) * FOREST_STEP);
        const fxHi = Math.min(W - BORDER, viewR + FOREST_STEP);
        const fyLo = Math.max(fStart, fStart + Math.floor((viewT - fStart) / FOREST_STEP) * FOREST_STEP);
        const fyHi = Math.min(H - BORDER, viewB + FOREST_STEP);
        for (let wx = fxLo; wx < fxHi; wx += FOREST_STEP) {
          for (let wy = fyLo; wy < fyHi; wy += FOREST_STEP) {
            if (inCity(wx, wy, 200)) continue;
            const dens = getForestDensity(wx, wy);
            if (dens < 1.5) continue;
            // Probability of placing a tree scales with density (1.5 → ~12%, 4.5 → ~80%).
            const placeProb = Math.min(0.85, (dens - 1) * 0.22);
            const s2 = seed(wx * 2.3, wy * 1.9);
            if (s2 > placeProb) continue;
            const s = seed(wx * 1.7, wy * 1.3);
            const tx = wx + (s - 0.5) * 50 + ox;
            const ty = wy + (s - 0.5) * 40 + oy;
            const treeH = 16 + s * 14;
            const canopyW = 9 + s * 9;
            const canopyH = 11 + s * 7;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.18)`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty + 3, 6, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(80 * br)},${Math.floor(55 * br)},${Math.floor(28 * br)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(tx - 2, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.6, 4, treeH - canopyH * 0.6);
            // Pine-ish darker green to differentiate forest trees visually.
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(20 * br)},${Math.floor((75 + s * 35) * br)},${Math.floor(28 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.55, canopyW * 0.85, canopyH * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(28 * br)},${Math.floor((95 + s * 30) * br)},${Math.floor(34 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.3, canopyW * 0.65, canopyH * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(40 * br)},${Math.floor((125 + s * 25) * br)},${Math.floor(45 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - treeH + canopyH * 0.1, canopyW * 0.45, canopyH * 0.35, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        }

        for (let wx = BORDER + 80; wx < W - BORDER; wx += BUSH_SPACING) {
          for (let wy = BORDER + 80; wy < H - BORDER; wy += BUSH_SPACING) {
            if (inCity(wx, wy, 150)) continue;
            if (wx < viewL || wx > viewR || wy < viewT || wy > viewB) continue;
            const s = seed(wx * 3.1, wy * 2.3);
            if (s < 0.4) continue;
            const bx2 = wx + (s - 0.5) * 60 + ox;
            const by2 = wy + (s - 0.5) * 40 + oy;
            const bushW = 8 + s * 8;
            const bushH = 6 + s * 5;
            const bGreen = 90 + Math.floor(s * 60);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(30 * br)},${Math.floor(bGreen * 0.8 * br)},${Math.floor(20 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(bx2, by2 - bushH * 0.3, bushW * 0.9, bushH * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(35 * br)},${Math.floor(bGreen * br)},${Math.floor(22 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(bx2 - bushW * 0.2, by2 - bushH * 0.5, bushW * 0.6, bushH * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(45 * br)},${Math.floor(Math.min(255, bGreen * 1.1) * br)},${Math.floor(28 * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(bx2 + bushW * 0.15, by2 - bushH * 0.55, bushW * 0.5, bushH * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        }

        for (let wx = BORDER + 120; wx < W - BORDER; wx += ROCK_SPACING) {
          for (let wy = BORDER + 120; wy < H - BORDER; wy += ROCK_SPACING) {
            if (inCity(wx, wy, 150)) continue;
            if (wx < viewL || wx > viewR || wy < viewT || wy > viewB) continue;
            const s = seed(wx * 2.1, wy * 0.7);
            if (s < 0.45) continue;
            const rx = wx + (s - 0.5) * 100 + ox;
            const ry = wy + (s - 0.5) * 70 + oy;
            const rw = 6 + s * 10, rh = 5 + s * 7;
            const rockGray = Math.floor((100 + s * 50) * br);
            const rockBrown = Math.floor(s * 15 * br);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(rx, ry + 2, rw * 0.8, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${rockGray},${Math.max(0, rockGray - 10 + rockBrown)},${Math.max(0, rockGray - 25)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(rx, ry - rh * 0.3, rw, rh * 0.75, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.min(255, rockGray + 28)},${Math.min(255, rockGray + 15)},${Math.max(0, rockGray - 10)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(rx - rw * 0.18, ry - rh * 0.5, rw * 0.55, rh * 0.45, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        }
      };
      drawWastelandTerrain();

      const drawCityTerrain = () => {
        const seed = (x: number, y: number) => Math.sin(x * 0.317 + y * 0.519) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        const br = dayBright;
        const viewL = g.cam.x - 40, viewR = g.cam.x + cw + 40;
        const viewT = g.cam.y - 40, viewB = g.cam.y + ch + 40;

        const CITY_TREE_SPACING = 180;
        for (let wx = CITY_LEFT + 60; wx < CITY_RIGHT - 60; wx += CITY_TREE_SPACING) {
          for (let wy = CITY_TOP + 60; wy < CITY_BOTTOM - 60; wy += CITY_TREE_SPACING) {
            if (wx < viewL || wx > viewR || wy < viewT || wy > viewB) continue;
            const s = seed(wx * 2.3, wy * 1.7);
            if (s < 0.55) continue;
            let onBuilding = false;
            for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
              if (wx > b.x - 20 && wx < b.x + b.w + 20 && wy > b.y - 20 && wy < b.y + b.h + 20) { onBuilding = true; break; }
            }
            if (onBuilding) continue;
            const tx = wx + (s - 0.5) * 40 + ox;
            const ty = wy + (s - 0.5) * 30 + oy;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty + 2, 5, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            // Neon-noir street tree — cool slate trunk + desaturated teal canopy
            // so the sparse greenery sits in the same noir key as the buildings
            // instead of the old daytime grass-green. Colour-only.
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(54 * br)},${Math.floor(48 * br)},${Math.floor(58 * br)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(tx - 1, ty - 12, 3, 14);
            // Smooth ellipse city tree canopy
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(34 * br)},${Math.floor((86 + s * 26) * br)},${Math.floor((78 + s * 14) * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - 8, 7, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(48 * br)},${Math.floor((104 + s * 20) * br)},${Math.floor((94 + s * 12) * br)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty - 11, 5, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        }

        const PARKING_LOTS = [
          { x: CITY_LEFT + 50, y: CITY_BOTTOM - 200, w: 140, h: 60 },
          { x: CITY_RIGHT - 250, y: CITY_TOP + 40, w: 120, h: 55 },
          { x: CITY_LEFT + 400, y: CITY_TOP + 50, w: 130, h: 50 },
        ];
        for (const lot of PARKING_LOTS) {
          const lx = lot.x + ox, ly = lot.y + oy;
          if (lx + lot.w < -20 || lx > cw + 20 || ly + lot.h < -20 || ly > ch + 20) continue;
          // Neon-noir lot asphalt — cool slate instead of warm grey, matching
          // the buildings' noir key. Colour-only.
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(42 * br)},${Math.floor(44 * br)},${Math.floor(56 * br)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(lx, ly, lot.w, lot.h);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(60 * br)},${Math.floor(64 * br)},${Math.floor(80 * br)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
          ctx.strokeRect(lx, ly, lot.w, lot.h);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.12 * br})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
          const slots = Math.floor(lot.w / 25);
          for (let si = 1; si < slots; si++) {
            const sx = lx + si * 25;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, ly + 4); ctx.lineTo(sx, ly + lot.h - 4); ctx.stroke();
          }
          const parkedCount = Math.floor(seed(lot.x, lot.y) * (slots - 1)) + 1;
          for (let pi = 0; pi < parkedCount; pi++) {
            const slotIdx = Math.floor(seed(lot.x + pi * 100, lot.y) * slots);
            const carX = lx + slotIdx * 25 + 4;
            const carY = ly + 8;
            const carColors = ['rgb(120,30,30)', 'rgb(30,30,120)', 'rgb(100,100,100)', 'rgb(30,80,30)', 'rgb(80,80,40)'];
            ctx.fillStyle = carColors[Math.floor(seed(lot.x + pi, lot.y + pi) * carColors.length)];
            ctx.fillRect(carX, carY, 17, lot.h - 16);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150,200,255,${0.3 * br})`;
            ctx.fillRect(carX + 2, carY + 2, 13, 5);
          }
        }
      };
      drawCityTerrain();

      // ── World secrets: faint glyph hints when the player is nearby ──────
      // Each kind gets a different micro-glyph (◆ cache, ◊ trapdoor,
      // ▤ note, ╪ tunnel). Already-found secrets render slightly muted.
      if (!g.interior) {
        for (const sec of WORLD_SECRETS) {
          const dist = Math.hypot(g.px - sec.x, g.py - sec.y);
          if (dist > sec.radius * 2.4) continue;
          const sx = sec.x + ox, sy = sec.y + oy;
          if (sx < -20 || sx > cw + 20 || sy < -20 || sy > ch + 20) continue;
          const found = foundSecretsRef.current.has(sec.id);
          // Closer = more visible; outside radius the hint fades to ~12% alpha.
          const proximity = Math.max(0, 1 - (dist - sec.radius) / (sec.radius * 1.4));
          const alpha = found ? 0.25 : (0.15 + proximity * 0.55);
          const glyph = sec.kind === 'cache' ? '◆' : sec.kind === 'trapdoor' ? '◊' : sec.kind === 'tunnel' ? '╪' : '▤';
          const color = sec.kind === 'cache' ? '#fbbf24' : sec.kind === 'trapdoor' ? '#94a3b8' : sec.kind === 'tunnel' ? '#60a5fa' : '#f472b6';
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
          ctx.fillStyle = color;
          ctx.font = "bold 11px 'Fira Code', monospace";
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          // Subtle pulse so it reads as interactable rather than terrain.
          const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.12) * 0.08;
          ctx.translate(sx, sy);
          ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
          ctx.fillText(glyph, 0, 0);
          if (!found && dist < sec.radius) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fef3c7';
            ctx.font = "9px 'Fira Code', monospace";
            ctx.fillText('[E] INVESTIGATE', 0, 14);
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // ── Sewer system (manhole covers on city streets) ────────────────────
      for (const mh of MANHOLES) {
        const mx = mh.x + ox, my = mh.y + oy;
        if (mx < -20 || mx > cw + 20 || my < -20 || my > ch + 20) continue;
        const mBr = dayBright;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(50 * mBr)},${Math.floor(48 * mBr)},${Math.floor(42 * mBr)})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(35 * mBr)},${Math.floor(33 * mBr)},${Math.floor(28 * mBr)})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(70 * mBr)},${Math.floor(65 * mBr)},${Math.floor(55 * mBr)})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mx - 4, my); ctx.lineTo(mx + 4, my); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mx, my - 4); ctx.lineTo(mx, my + 4); ctx.stroke();
      }

      // ── Street ATMs (BANCO OMBRA self-service kiosks) ────────────────────
      for (const a of CITY_ATMS) {
        const ax = a.x + ox, ay = a.y + oy;
        if (ax < -30 || ax > cw + 30 || ay < -40 || ay > ch + 30) continue;
        const nearAtm = Math.hypot(g.px - a.x, g.py - a.y) < CITY_ATM_RANGE;
        const pulse = 0.55 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05 + a.x * 0.01) * 0.12;
        const kw = 16, kh = 24;
        const kx = ax - kw / 2, ky = ay - kh;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#101923'; ctx.fillRect(kx, ky, kw, kh);
        ctx.shadowColor = nearAtm ? 'rgba(125,211,252,.45)' : 'transparent'; ctx.shadowBlur = nearAtm ? 5 : 0;
        ctx.strokeStyle = nearAtm ? 'rgba(186,230,253,.8)' : 'rgba(100,116,139,.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = nearAtm ? 1.2 : 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(kx, ky, kw, kh);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(125,211,252,${0.16 + pulse * 0.16})`; ctx.fillRect(kx + 3, ky + 3, kw - 6, 7);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.5)';
        ctx.fillRect(kx + 5, ky + 14, 6, 1);
        ctx.fillRect(kx + 5, ky + 17, 4, 1);
        ctx.fillStyle = nearAtm ? 'rgba(125,211,252,.85)' : 'rgba(100,116,139,.7)';
        ctx.fillRect(kx + 6, ky + 21, 4, 1);
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillStyle = nearAtm ? '#bae6fd' : 'rgba(148,163,184,.65)';
        ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"';
        ctx.fillText('ATM', ax, ky - 3);
        if (nearAtm) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(186,230,253,.95)' : 'rgba(125,211,252,.45)';
          ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.fillText('[E] BANCO OMBRA', ax, ky - 11);
        }
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      }

      // ── PABLO POWER & GAS — charging stations + gas pumps ────────────────
      for (const u of [
        ...CITY_CHARGING_STATIONS.map(s => ({ ...s, mode: 'charge' as const })),
        ...CITY_GAS_PUMPS.map(p => ({ ...p, mode: 'gas' as const })),
      ]) {
        const ux = u.x + ox, uy = u.y + oy;
        if (ux < -30 || ux > cw + 30 || uy < -40 || uy > ch + 30) continue;
        const nearU = Math.hypot(g.px - u.x, g.py - u.y) < CITY_UTILITY_RANGE;
        const isGas = u.mode === 'gas';
        const col = isGas ? '255,176,32' : '52,211,238';   // amber pump / cyan charger
        const pulse = 0.55 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05 + u.x * 0.01) * 0.3;
        const pw = 14, ph = 26;
        const pxk = ux - pw / 2, pyk = uy - ph;
        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1622'; ctx.fillRect(pxk, pyk, pw, ph);
        ctx.shadowColor = `rgb(${col})`; ctx.shadowBlur = nearU ? 14 : 6;
        ctx.strokeStyle = nearU ? `rgb(${col})` : `rgba(${col},.5)`; ctx.lineWidth = nearU ? 2 : 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(pxk, pyk, pw, ph);
        // Display screen
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col},${0.25 + pulse * 0.4})`; ctx.fillRect(pxk + 3, pyk + 3, pw - 6, 7);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // Nozzle / bolt glyph
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col},.85)`;
        ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(isGas ? '⛽' : '⚡', ux, pyk + 20);
        // Label
        ctx.fillStyle = nearU ? `rgb(${col})` : `rgba(${col},.45)`;
        ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"';
        ctx.fillText(isGas ? 'GAS' : 'CHRG', ux, pyk - 3);
        if (nearU) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? `rgba(${col},.95)` : `rgba(${col},.4)`;
          ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.fillText(isGas ? '[E] GAS PUMP' : '[E] CHARGE', ux, pyk - 11);
        }
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      }

      // ── MX-75 uplink beacon (story trigger) — only while story not begun ──
      if (!g.story?.active) {
        const sbx = STORY_TRIGGER.x + ox, sby = STORY_TRIGGER.y + oy;
        if (!(sbx < -40 || sbx > cw + 40 || sby < -40 || sby > ch + 40)) {
          const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06);
          const live = g.nearStoryTrigger;
          // Ground halo
          const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(sbx, sby, 0, sbx, sby, 26);
          halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(56,189,248,${0.22 + pulse * 0.18})`);
          halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(56,189,248,0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = halo;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sbx, sby, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          // Beacon post
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,32,0.95)';
          ctx.fillRect(sbx - 3, sby - 18, 6, 18);
          // Antenna head
          ctx.fillStyle = live ? `rgba(174,242,90,${0.6 + pulse * 0.4})` : `rgba(56,189,248,${0.5 + pulse * 0.45})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sbx, sby - 20, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          // Signal rings
          ctx.strokeStyle = live ? `rgba(174,242,90,${0.5 * (1 - pulse)})` : `rgba(56,189,248,${0.4 * (1 - pulse)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sbx, sby - 20, 6 + pulse * 8, -Math.PI * 0.85, -Math.PI * 0.15); ctx.stroke();
          if (live) {
            ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(174,242,90,.9)' : 'rgba(174,242,90,.4)';
            ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('[E] MX-75', sbx, sby - 28);
          }
        }
      }

      // ── SCENE 1 — escape waypoint marker (vent first, then the camp) ──
      if (g.sceneRun && g.sceneRun.phase === 'escape') {
        const tgt = g.sceneRun.alleyReached ? (g.story?.homeBase ?? STORY_HOME) : STORY_ALLEY;
        const wx = tgt.x + ox, wy = tgt.y + oy;
        if (!(wx < -40 || wx > cw + 40 || wy < -40 || wy > ch + 40)) {
          const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(174,242,90,${0.5 + pulse * 0.4})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(wx, wy, 14 + pulse * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(174,242,90,${0.7 + pulse * 0.3})`;
          ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(g.sceneRun.alleyReached ? 'CAMP' : 'VENT', wx, wy - 18);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(wx - 5, wy - 6); ctx.lineTo(wx, wy); ctx.lineTo(wx + 5, wy - 6); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      // ── Per-city color grade ──────────────────────────────────────────────
      // Re-skins the whole scene so each city reads as a distinct part of the
      // world without re-theming every draw call. Minx (default) is skipped so
      // it stays byte-identical; themed cities get a moody atmospheric grade.
      {
        const __gradeCity = getActiveCityDef();
        if (__gradeCity.id !== DEFAULT_CITY_ID) {
          const th = __gradeCity.theme;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.30;
          ctx.fillStyle = th.hazeColor;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'overlay';
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.16;
          ctx.fillStyle = th.accent;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // ── SCENE 1 — fire-alarm red vignette while escaping the burning tower ──
      if (g.sceneRun && g.sceneRun.phase === 'escape') {
        const ap = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(g.frame * 0.12);
        const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.min(cw, ch) * 0.22, cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.max(cw, ch) * 0.62);
        vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        vg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(184,30,20,${0.16 + ap * 0.16})`);
        ctx.fillStyle = vg;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
      }

      for (const np of NEWSPAPER_WORLD_SPOTS) {
        const nx = np.x + ox, ny = np.y + oy;
        if (nx < -20 || nx > cw + 20 || ny < -20 || ny > ch + 20) continue;
        const nBr = dayBright;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(180 * nBr)},${Math.floor(170 * nBr)},${Math.floor(130 * nBr)},0.9)`;
        ctx.fillRect(nx - 5, ny - 3, 10, 6);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(40 * nBr)},${Math.floor(35 * nBr)},${Math.floor(25 * nBr)},0.7)`;
        ctx.fillRect(nx - 4, ny - 2, 8, 1);
        ctx.fillRect(nx - 4, ny, 8, 1);
        ctx.fillRect(nx - 4, ny + 2, 5, 1);
        const dist = Math.hypot(g.px - np.x, g.py - np.y);
        if (dist < 40) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(255,200,60,.9)' : 'rgba(255,200,60,.3)';
          ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] READ NEWSPAPER', nx, ny - 8);
        }
      }

      const cityTopY = CITY_TOP + oy;
      const cityBotY = CITY_BOTTOM + oy;

      // Gang territory zones (subtle fill only, no borders or labels)
      for (const gz of GANG_ZONES) {
        if (gz.id === 'minx_city') continue;
        const gx = gz.x + ox, gy = gz.y + oy;
        if (gx + gz.w < 0 || gx > cw || gy + gz.h < 0 || gy > ch) continue;
        ctx.fillStyle = gz.color;
        ctx.fillRect(gx, gy, gz.w, gz.h);
      }

      const drawRoad = (x1:number,y1:number,x2:number,y2:number,w:number,alpha:number,dashed=false) => {
        const roadBr = dayBright;
        const rGray = Math.floor(55 * roadBr);
        const isHoriz = Math.abs(y2 - y1) < Math.abs(x2 - x1);
        // Per-city streetscape — Huda paves warm sandstone walks with jade lane lines.
        const _isHuda = getActiveCityId() === 'huda_city';
        if (dashed) {
          ctx.lineWidth = w; ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${rGray + 10},${rGray + 5},${rGray})`;
          ctx.setLineDash([18,10]);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
        } else {
          ctx.lineCap = 'square';
          // Sidewalk / curb behind road (wider, concrete color)
          const sidewalkW = w + 14;
          ctx.lineWidth = sidewalkW;
          ctx.strokeStyle = _isHuda ? `rgb(${Math.floor(124 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(104 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(76 * roadBr)})` : `rgb(${Math.floor(110 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(106 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(100 * roadBr)})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
          // Curb edge lines
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.strokeStyle = _isHuda ? `rgb(${Math.floor(146 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(122 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(86 * roadBr)})` : `rgb(${Math.floor(130 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(125 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(118 * roadBr)})`;
          if (isHoriz) {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy - sidewalkW/2); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy - sidewalkW/2); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy + sidewalkW/2); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy + sidewalkW/2); ctx.stroke();
          } else {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox - sidewalkW/2,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox - sidewalkW/2,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox + sidewalkW/2,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox + sidewalkW/2,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
          }
          // Asphalt body
          ctx.lineWidth = w;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${rGray},${rGray - 5},${rGray - 8})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
          // Wet-reflection sheen — faint cyan/magenta streaks down the lanes at
          // night so the neutral asphalt picks up the buildings' neon glow. Fades
          // out by dusk; pure colour overlay, no geometry change.
          const _night = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (0.55 - roadBr) / 0.25));
          if (_night > 0) {
            const _sheen = w * 0.22;
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, _sheen);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(80,200,235,${0.06 * _night})`;
            if (isHoriz) {
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy - w*0.22); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy - w*0.22); ctx.stroke();
            } else {
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox - w*0.22,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox - w*0.22,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(220,90,200,${0.05 * _night})`;
            if (isHoriz) {
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy + w*0.22); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy + w*0.22); ctx.stroke();
            } else {
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox + w*0.22,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox + w*0.22,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
          // Lane divider lines (2 lanes)
          ctx.setLineDash([14,9]); ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.strokeStyle = _isHuda ? `rgba(${Math.floor(90 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(210 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(150 * roadBr)},0.75)` : `rgba(${Math.floor(240 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(220 * roadBr)},${Math.floor(60 * roadBr)},0.7)`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
          // Edge white lines
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.18 * roadBr})`;
          if (isHoriz) {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy - w/2 + 2); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy - w/2 + 2); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox,y1+oy + w/2 - 2); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox,y2+oy + w/2 - 2); ctx.stroke();
          } else {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox - w/2 + 2,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox - w/2 + 2,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1+ox + w/2 - 2,y1+oy); ctx.lineTo(x2+ox + w/2 - 2,y2+oy); ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
        }
      };

      // ── Crosswalk painter — draw at major intersections ────────────────────
      const drawCrosswalk = (cx2: number, cy2: number, horiz: boolean, roadW: number) => {
        const br2 = dayBright;
        const cLen = roadW + 4;
        const stripeW = 5, stripeGap = 4, numStripes = 5;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(240,238,225,${0.55 * br2})`;
        if (horiz) {
          for (let si = 0; si < numStripes; si++) {
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 + ox - cLen / 2, cy2 + oy - roadW / 2 + si * (stripeW + stripeGap), cLen, stripeW);
          }
        } else {
          for (let si = 0; si < numStripes; si++) {
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 + ox - roadW / 2 + si * (stripeW + stripeGap), cy2 + oy - cLen / 2, stripeW, cLen);
          }
        }
      };
      // ── Road network — all horizontal/vertical, no diagonals ──
      // Main central boulevard (y=6310) — widest road
      drawRoad(5620, 6310, 7420, 6310, 116, .18);
      // North belt (y=5960) — main arterial
      drawRoad(5620, 5960, 7420, 5960, 84, .14);
      // South loop (y=6710) — main arterial
      drawRoad(5620, 6710, 7420, 6710, 84, .14);
      // Central avenue (x=6350) — full N-S spine
      drawRoad(6350, 5880, 6350, 6900, 116, .18);
      // East avenue (x=7050) — full N-S
      drawRoad(7050, 5880, 7050, 6900, 84, .14);
      // West avenue (x=5960) — full N-S
      drawRoad(5960, 5880, 5960, 6900, 84, .13);
      // Commerce avenue (x=6600) — partial N-S
      drawRoad(6600, 5880, 6600, 6510, 80, .11);
      drawRoad(6600, 6710, 6600, 6900, 80, .11);
      // Far-west alley (x=5700) — short N-S
      drawRoad(5700, 5880, 5700, 6780, 75, .10);
      // Far-east alley (x=7300) — short N-S
      drawRoad(7300, 5960, 7300, 6780, 75, .10);
      // Mid-south connector (y=6510) — split east and west
      drawRoad(5620, 6510, 6450, 6510, 80, .09);
      drawRoad(6720, 6510, 7420, 6510, 80, .09);
      // Mid-north alley — east block only (y=6130)
      drawRoad(6420, 6130, 7420, 6130, 72, .08);
      // Inner north side-street (y=6080) — Shadow District cul-de-sac
      drawRoad(5620, 6080, 5960, 6080, 70, .08);
      // Inner south side-street (y=6420) — Industrial district spur
      drawRoad(5620, 6420, 5960, 6420, 70, .08);
      // Inner-west connector (x=6120) — short sections
      drawRoad(6120, 5880, 6120, 6080, 68, .08);
      drawRoad(6120, 6310, 6120, 6520, 68, .08);
      // Inner east connector (x=7160) — short section
      drawRoad(7160, 6130, 7160, 6310, 68, .08);
      // East precinct spur (y=6210) — east of east avenue
      drawRoad(7100, 6210, 7420, 6210, 68, .08);
      // South border / checkpoint road (y=6870) — partial segments
      drawRoad(5620, 6870, 6000, 6870, 65, .08);
      drawRoad(6250, 6870, 6500, 6870, 65, .08);
      // City perimeter edge marker
      drawRoad(5600, CITY_TOP, 7450, CITY_TOP, 18, .06);
      drawRoad(5600, CITY_BOTTOM, 7450, CITY_BOTTOM, 18, .06);
      drawRoad(5600, CITY_TOP, 5600, CITY_BOTTOM, 18, .06);
      drawRoad(7450, CITY_TOP, 7450, CITY_BOTTOM, 18, .06);
      // North wasteland trails (dashed, dimmer)
      drawRoad(0,1800,W,1800,10,.04,true);
      drawRoad(0,3200,W,3200,8,.03,true);
      drawRoad(2000,BORDER,2000,CITY_TOP,8,.04,true);
      drawRoad(5000,BORDER,5000,CITY_TOP,8,.04,true);
      drawRoad(6800,BORDER,6800,CITY_TOP,10,.05,true);
      drawRoad(8000,BORDER,8000,CITY_TOP,8,.04,true);
      drawRoad(11000,BORDER,11000,CITY_TOP,8,.04,true);
      // South wasteland trails (dashed, dimmer)
      drawRoad(0,9000,W,9000,10,.04,true);
      drawRoad(0,10500,W,10500,8,.03,true);
      drawRoad(2000,CITY_BOTTOM,2000,H-BORDER,8,.04,true);
      drawRoad(5000,CITY_BOTTOM,5000,H-BORDER,8,.04,true);
      drawRoad(6800,CITY_BOTTOM,6800,H-BORDER,10,.05,true);
      drawRoad(8000,CITY_BOTTOM,8000,H-BORDER,8,.04,true);
      drawRoad(11000,CITY_BOTTOM,11000,H-BORDER,8,.04,true);

      // ── Crosswalks at major intersections ─────────────────────────────────
      // Main boulevard × Central avenue
      drawCrosswalk(6350, 6310, true, 116);
      drawCrosswalk(6350, 6310, false, 116);
      // Main boulevard × East avenue
      drawCrosswalk(7050, 6310, true, 116);
      drawCrosswalk(7050, 6310, false, 84);
      // Main boulevard × West avenue
      drawCrosswalk(5960, 6310, true, 116);
      drawCrosswalk(5960, 6310, false, 84);
      // North belt × Central
      drawCrosswalk(6350, 5960, true, 84);
      drawCrosswalk(6350, 5960, false, 116);
      // South loop × Central
      drawCrosswalk(6350, 6710, true, 84);
      drawCrosswalk(6350, 6710, false, 116);

      // ── Street furniture (LOD: only near player) ───────────────────────────
      const furnitureSeedHash = (x: number, y: number, s: number) => {
        const v = Math.sin(x * 31.7 + y * 53.1 + s * 127.3) * 43758.5453;
        return v - Math.floor(v);
      };
      // Draw a lamp post at screen coords
      const drawLampPost = (lx2: number, ly2: number, lit: boolean) => {
        const lbr = dayBright;
        // Pole
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(70 * lbr)},${Math.floor(70 * lbr)},${Math.floor(65 * lbr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(lx2 - 1, ly2 - 22, 2, 22);
        // Arm
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(65 * lbr)},${Math.floor(65 * lbr)},${Math.floor(60 * lbr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(lx2 - 1, ly2 - 22, 8, 2);
        // Lamp head
        ctx.fillStyle = lit ? `rgb(${Math.floor(255 * lbr)},${Math.floor(240 * lbr)},${Math.floor(160 * lbr)})` : `rgb(${Math.floor(80 * lbr)},${Math.floor(80 * lbr)},${Math.floor(75 * lbr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(lx2 + 5, ly2 - 25, 6, 4);
        if (lit && (isNight || isDusk || isDawn)) {
          const glw = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx2 + 8, ly2 - 23, 0, lx2 + 8, ly2 - 23, 28);
          glw.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,230,120,0.3)`);
          glw.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = glw;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx2 + 8, ly2 - 23, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
      };
      // Draw a trash can
      const drawTrashCan = (tx2: number, ty2: number) => {
        const tbr = dayBright;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(50 * tbr)},${Math.floor(55 * tbr)},${Math.floor(50 * tbr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(tx2 - 3, ty2 - 6, 6, 7);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(40 * tbr)},${Math.floor(45 * tbr)},${Math.floor(40 * tbr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(tx2 - 4, ty2 - 7, 8, 2);
      };
      // Draw a bench
      const drawBench = (bx3: number, by3: number, horiz2: boolean) => {
        const bbr = dayBright;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(90 * bbr)},${Math.floor(60 * bbr)},${Math.floor(30 * bbr)})`;
        if (horiz2) {
          ctx.fillRect(bx3 - 10, by3 - 2, 20, 4);
          ctx.fillRect(bx3 - 10, by3 - 7, 20, 3);
        } else {
          ctx.fillRect(bx3 - 2, by3 - 10, 4, 20);
          ctx.fillRect(bx3 - 7, by3 - 10, 3, 20);
        }
      };
      // Draw a fire hydrant
      const drawFireHydrant = (hx2: number, hy2: number) => {
        const hbr = dayBright;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(180 * hbr)},${Math.floor(30 * hbr)},${Math.floor(20 * hbr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(hx2 - 3, hy2 - 6, 6, 7);
        ctx.fillRect(hx2 - 4, hy2 - 8, 8, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(200 * hbr)},${Math.floor(40 * hbr)},${Math.floor(30 * hbr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(hx2 - 5, hy2 - 4, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(hx2 + 2, hy2 - 4, 3, 3);
      };
      // Draw a bollard
      const drawBollard = (bx4: number, by4: number) => {
        const bbr2 = dayBright;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(200 * bbr2)},${Math.floor(180 * bbr2)},${Math.floor(20 * bbr2)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(bx4 - 2, by4 - 8, 4, 9);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(240 * bbr2)},${Math.floor(220 * bbr2)},${Math.floor(30 * bbr2)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(bx4 - 3, by4 - 10, 6, 3);
      };
      // Draw a parking meter
      const drawParkingMeter = (px5: number, py5: number) => {
        const pmBr = dayBright;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(80 * pmBr)},${Math.floor(80 * pmBr)},${Math.floor(80 * pmBr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(px5 - 1, py5 - 18, 2, 18);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(50 * pmBr)},${Math.floor(80 * pmBr)},${Math.floor(50 * pmBr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(px5 - 4, py5 - 22, 8, 6);
      };

      // Furniture placement along major roads (sidewalk zone)
      // Only render furniture for sectors near player
      const FURN_SPACING = 60;
      const furnitureLampRoads2 = [
        { horiz: true,  coord: 6310, from: 5650, to: 7400, w: 116 },
        { horiz: true,  coord: 5960, from: 5650, to: 7400, w: 84  },
        { horiz: true,  coord: 6710, from: 5650, to: 7400, w: 84  },
        { horiz: false, coord: 6350, from: 5900, to: 6880, w: 116 },
        { horiz: false, coord: 7050, from: 5900, to: 6880, w: 84  },
        { horiz: false, coord: 5960, from: 5900, to: 6880, w: 84  },
      ];
      const litLamps = (isNight || isDusk || isDawn);
      for (const fr of furnitureLampRoads2) {
        const sideOff = fr.w / 2 + 10;
        for (let ft = fr.from; ft < fr.to; ft += FURN_SPACING) {
          const side = Math.sin(ft * 0.031) > 0 ? sideOff : -sideOff;
          const fx2 = fr.horiz ? ft : fr.coord + side;
          const fy2 = fr.horiz ? fr.coord + side : ft;
          // Check LOD — only near player
          const fdist = Math.hypot(g.px - fx2, g.py - fy2);
          if (fdist > 800) continue;
          const fsx = fx2 + ox, fsy = fy2 + oy;
          if (fsx < -20 || fsx > cw + 20 || fsy < -20 || fsy > ch + 20) continue;

          const fSeed = furnitureSeedHash(fx2, fy2, 1);
          const fSeed2 = furnitureSeedHash(fx2, fy2, 2);
          if (fSeed < 0.35) {
            drawLampPost(fsx, fsy, litLamps);
          } else if (fSeed < 0.55) {
            drawTrashCan(fsx, fsy);
          } else if (fSeed < 0.70) {
            drawBench(fsx, fsy, fr.horiz);
          } else if (fSeed < 0.80) {
            drawFireHydrant(fsx, fsy);
          } else if (fSeed < 0.88) {
            drawBollard(fsx, fsy);
            if (fSeed2 > 0.5) drawBollard(fsx + (fr.horiz ? 8 : 0), fsy + (fr.horiz ? 0 : 8));
          } else {
            drawParkingMeter(fsx, fsy);
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Street lights ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      const LAMP_SPACING = 90;
      // Light roads — matched to new H/V road network (no diagonals)
      const lampRoads = [
        { horiz: true,  coord: 6310, from: 5620, to: 7420 },
        { horiz: true,  coord: 5960, from: 5620, to: 7420 },
        { horiz: true,  coord: 6710, from: 5620, to: 7420 },
        { horiz: true,  coord: 6130, from: 6420, to: 7420 },
        { horiz: true,  coord: 6080, from: 5620, to: 5960 },
        { horiz: true,  coord: 6510, from: 5620, to: 7420 },
        { horiz: false, coord: 6350, from: 5880, to: 6900 },
        { horiz: false, coord: 7050, from: 5880, to: 6900 },
        { horiz: false, coord: 5960, from: 5880, to: 6900 },
        { horiz: false, coord: 6600, from: 5880, to: 6900 },
        { horiz: false, coord: 5700, from: 5880, to: 6780 },
        { horiz: false, coord: 7300, from: 5960, to: 6780 },
      ];
      for (const lr of lampRoads) {
        const total = lr.to - lr.from;
        const count = Math.ceil(total / LAMP_SPACING);
        for (let li = 0; li < count; li++) {
          const t = lr.from + li * LAMP_SPACING + (LAMP_SPACING / 2);
          // Alternating sides of road
          const side = li % 2 === 0 ? -10 : 10;
          const lx = lr.horiz ? (t + ox) : (lr.coord + side + ox);
          const ly = lr.horiz ? (lr.coord + side + oy) : (t + oy);
          if (lx < -20 || lx > cw + 20 || ly < -20 || ly > ch + 20) continue;
          // Flicker based on frame + index + power level
          const seed = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.018 + li * 7.3 + lr.coord * 0.02);
          const pwr  = g.powerLevel / 100;
          const flickerChance = pwr < 0.5 ? Math.abs(seed) < 0.06 : false;
          const nightMult = (wt >= 20 || wt < 4) ? 1.8 : (wt >= 18) ? 1.0 + 0.8 * ((wt - 18) / 2) : (wt < 6) ? 1.0 + 0.8 * ((6 - wt) / 2) : 0.6;
          const brightness = (flickerChance ? 0.08 : (0.7 + seed * 0.2) * pwr) * nightMult;
          if (brightness < 0.05) continue;
          const wc = Math.floor(brightness * 255);
          const warmR = Math.min(255, wc + 40), warmG = Math.min(255, wc + 30), warmB = Math.max(0, wc - 60);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(80 * dayBright)},${Math.floor(80 * dayBright)},${Math.floor(75 * dayBright)})`;
          if (lr.horiz) { ctx.fillRect(lx - 1, ly, 2, Math.abs(side > 0 ? -14 : 14)); }
          else { ctx.fillRect(lx, ly - 1, Math.abs(side > 0 ? -14 : 14), 2); }
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(60 * dayBright)},${Math.floor(60 * dayBright)},${Math.floor(55 * dayBright)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(lx - 3, ly - 2, 6, 3);
          const glowR2 = 35 + brightness * 20;
          const glowR = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx, ly, 0, lx, ly, glowR2);
          glowR.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${warmR},${warmG},${warmB},${brightness * 0.55})`);
          glowR.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${warmR},${warmG},${Math.max(0, warmB - 20)},${brightness * 0.2})`);
          glowR.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = glowR; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx, ly, glowR2, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${warmR},${warmG},${Math.min(255, warmB + 40)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(lx - 2, ly - 2, 4, 3);
        }
      }

      // ── Persistent craters (scorched landscape) — drawn under everything ──
      for (const cr of g.craters) {
        const cx = cr.x + ox, cy = cr.y + oy;
        if (cx < -cr.r || cx > cw + cr.r || cy < -cr.r || cy > ch + cr.r) continue;
        const age = g.frame - cr.bornFrame;
        // Fade in from black scorch to weather-aged grey
        const fade = Math.max(0.45, 1 - age / 3600);
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, cr.r);
        grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(20,12,10,${0.85 * fade})`);
        grad.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(40,28,22,${0.55 * fade})`);
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, cr.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        // Cracked-earth speckles (deterministic per crater)
        const seed = (cr.x * 12.9898 + cr.y * 78.233);
        for (let s = 0; s < 6; s++) {
          const a = ((Math.sin(seed + s * 7.7) + 1) * 0.5) * Math.PI * 2;
          const r = ((Math.sin(seed + s * 13.1) + 1) * 0.5) * cr.r * 0.7;
          const sx = cx + Math.cos(a) * r, sy = cy + Math.sin(a) * r;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${0.4 * fade})`;
          ctx.fillRect(sx - 1, sy - 1, 2, 2);
        }
      }

      // ── Fire effects (behind buildings so only glow peeks out) ─────────────
      for (const fire of g.fires) {
        const fx = fire.x + ox, fy = fire.y + oy;
        if (fx < -120 || fx > cw + 120 || fy < -120 || fy > ch + 120) continue;
        const age = g.frame - fire.startFrame;
        const phase = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.18 + fire.x * 0.01) * 0.3 + 0.7;
        const I = fire.intensity;

        // ── Layer 1: Wide ambient glow (the "warm room" effect) ──────────────
        const fr2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(fx, fy, 0, fx, fy, 90 * I);
        fr2.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,140,40,${0.55 * phase * I})`);
        fr2.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(255,60,10,${0.28 * phase})`);
        fr2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = fr2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx, fy, 90 * I, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

        // ── Layer 2: Coal bed (stable hot core) ──────────────────────────────
        const coal = ctx.createRadialGradient(fx, fy + 4, 0, fx, fy + 4, 14 * I);
        coal.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,230,160,${0.85 * phase})`);
        coal.addColorStop(0.6, `rgba(255,90,20,${0.6 * phase})`);
        coal.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,30,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = coal; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx, fy + 4, 14 * I, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

        // ── Layer 3: Animated flame tongues (3 per fire, animated heights) ──
        ctx.save();
        for (let fl = 0; fl < 3; fl++) {
          const flickerSeed = g.frame * 0.22 + fl * 2.1 + fire.x * 0.013;
          const flameH = 18 * I + Math.sin(flickerSeed) * 6;
          const flameW = 7 * I + Math.cos(flickerSeed * 0.7) * 1.5;
          const offX = (fl - 1) * 5 * I + Math.sin(flickerSeed * 1.3) * 2;
          const baseX = fx + offX, baseY = fy + 4;
          // Outer red shell
          const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(baseX, baseY, baseX, baseY - flameH);
          fg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,60,10,${0.85 * phase})`);
          fg.addColorStop(0.6, `rgba(255,150,40,${0.7 * phase})`);
          fg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(255,230,140,0)`);
          ctx.fillStyle = fg;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(baseX - flameW, baseY);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(baseX - flameW * 0.4, baseY - flameH * 0.6, baseX, baseY - flameH);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(baseX + flameW * 0.4, baseY - flameH * 0.6, baseX + flameW, baseY);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          // Inner yellow-white core
          const fg2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(baseX, baseY, baseX, baseY - flameH * 0.7);
          fg2.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,200,100,${0.9 * phase})`);
          fg2.addColorStop(1, `rgba(255,255,200,0)`);
          ctx.fillStyle = fg2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(baseX - flameW * 0.5, baseY);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(baseX, baseY - flameH * 0.5, baseX + flameW * 0.5, baseY);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // ── Layer 4: Smoke columns ───────────────────────────────────────────
        for (let sp = 0; sp < 6; sp++) {
          const sAngle = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08 + sp * 1.5) * 0.5;
          const sy2    = fy - 20 - (age % 60) * 0.7 - sp * 9;
          const sx2    = fx + Math.sin(sAngle + sp) * 8;
          const sAlpha = Math.max(0, 0.42 - sp * 0.045);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(40,24,12,${sAlpha * phase})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx2, sy2, 4 + sp, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        }

        // ── Spawn rising embers occasionally ────────────────────────────────
        if (g.frame % 6 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.7 * I && g.embers.length < 200) {
          const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
          const sp = 1.0 + Math.random() * 1.6;
          g.embers.push({
            x: fire.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
            y: fire.y - 2,
            vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
            vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
            life: 35 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20),
            maxLife: 55,
            col: Math.random() < 0.5 ? '255,200,80' : '255,120,40',
            size: 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2,
          });
        }
      }

      // ── Shockwave rings (from explosions) ─────────────────────────────────
      for (const sw of g.shockwaves) {
        const sx = sw.x + ox, sy = sw.y + oy;
        if (sx < -sw.maxR || sx > cw + sw.maxR || sy < -sw.maxR || sy > ch + sw.maxR) continue;
        const lifeT = sw.life / sw.maxLife;
        const alpha = lifeT * 0.85;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${sw.col},${alpha})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 + (1 - lifeT) * 2;
        ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${sw.col},${alpha})`;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 14 * lifeT;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, sw.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // Inner ring (thinner, hotter colour) at half radius
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,220,${alpha * 0.5})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, sw.r * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ── Embers (sparks rising from fires & explosions) ────────────────────
      for (const e of g.embers) {
        const ex = e.x + ox, ey = e.y + oy;
        if (ex < -8 || ex > cw + 8 || ey < -8 || ey > ch + 8) continue;
        const t = e.life / e.maxLife;
        const a = Math.max(0, t);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${e.col},${a})`;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${e.col},${a})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, e.size * (0.5 + t * 0.7), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Buildings
      for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
        const bx = b.x + ox, by = b.y + oy;
        if (bx + b.w < 0 || bx > cw || by + b.h < 0 || by > ch) continue;
        const isNear = nb === b.id;
        const isLocked = g.locks.has(b.id) && !!g.locks.get(b.id)?.ownerName;

        // ── SUBWAY STATIONS — entrance art not finalized: shroud in poison ──
        // fog rather than show a placeholder. Fast travel still works — the
        // proximity entry below is unchanged, just hidden inside the gas.
        if (b.id === 'sub_west' || b.id === 'sub_central' || b.id === 'sub_east' || b.id === 'sub_north' || b.id === 'sub_power' || b.id === 'sub_under' || b.id === 'sub_bazaar') {
          const scx = bx + b.w / 2, scy = by + b.h / 2;
          const gasPulse2 = 0.05 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 850 + b.x * 0.01);
          const fogR = Math.max(b.w, b.h) * 1.2;
          // Dense toxic shroud — same palette as the world poison fog
          const fGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(scx, scy, 0, scx, scy, fogR);
          fGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(120,168,46,${0.62 + gasPulse2})`);
          fGrad.addColorStop(0.6, `rgba(110,150,40,${0.34 + gasPulse2})`);
          fGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,168,46,0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = fGrad;
          ctx.fillRect(scx - fogR, scy - fogR, fogR * 2, fogR * 2);
          // Drifting haze puffs for texture
          for (let pi = 0; pi < 5; pi++) {
            const ang = g.frame * 0.01 + pi * (Math.PI * 2 / 5);
            const rad = fogR * 0.4 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.02 + pi) * 4;
            const pxp = scx + Math.cos(ang) * rad, pyp = scy + Math.sin(ang) * rad * 0.7;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(140,180,60,${0.18 + 0.06 * Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05 + pi)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pxp, pyp, 6 + (pi % 3) * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
          // Faint proximity hint so the metro still works when stood on
          if (isNear) {
            ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(174,242,90,.85)' : 'rgba(174,242,90,.35)';
            ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('[E] METRO', scx, by - 6);
          }
          continue; // skip default building art — station is hidden in the fog
        }

        // ── SHADOW TOWER — Japanese cyberpunk supertall (tiered, neon-lit) ──
        if (b.id === 'pablo_tower') {
          const cx = bx + b.w / 2;
          const groundY = by + b.h;            // entrance plaza line
          const f = g.frame;
          // Night factor (0 by day -> ~1 deep night) drives neon intensity.
          const night = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (0.9 - dayBright) / 0.6));
          const neon = 0.45 + night * 0.55;
          const beat = 0.5 + Math.sin(f * 0.05) * 0.5;
          // Height is driven by the declared storey count (`floors`) so the
          // tower is genuinely to-scale: 120 storeys at ~4.4u each → ~528u,
          // towering far above every other structure in the city.
          const floorCount = (b as { floors?: number }).floors ?? 0;
          const rise = Math.max(300, floorCount > 0 ? floorCount * 4.4 : b.h * 1.9);

          // ── Tower plaza — small detailed apron around the base ──
          ctx.save();
          const plazaM = 78;
          const plX = bx - plazaM, plY = by - plazaM * 0.4;
          const plW = b.w + plazaM * 2, plH = b.h + plazaM * 1.1;
          const slab = ctx.createLinearGradient(plX, plY, plX, plY + plH);
          slab.addColorStop(0, `rgba(10,12,20,${0.55 + night * 0.2})`);
          slab.addColorStop(1, `rgba(6,8,14,${0.6 + night * 0.2})`);
          ctx.fillStyle = slab; ctx.fillRect(plX, plY, plW, plH);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.06 + neon * 0.1})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          for (let gx = plX; gx <= plX + plW; gx += 22) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx, plY); ctx.lineTo(gx, plY + plH); ctx.stroke(); }
          for (let gy = plY; gy <= plY + plH; gy += 22) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(plX, gy); ctx.lineTo(plX + plW, gy); ctx.stroke(); }
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(190,40,200,${0.2 + neon * 0.3})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeRect(plX, plY, plW, plH);
          // Holographic PABLO seal on the ground south of the entrance
          const sealY = by + b.h + plazaM * 0.5;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(120,230,255,${0.10 + beat * 0.06 * neon})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, sealY, 17, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, sealY, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(120,230,255,${0.18 + beat * 0.1 * neon})`;
          ctx.font = 'bold 9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('PABLO', cx, sealY + 3);
          // Neon bollards at the plaza corners
          [[plX + 14, plY + plH - 14], [plX + plW - 14, plY + plH - 14], [plX + 14, plY + 14], [plX + plW - 14, plY + 14]].forEach((p, pi) => {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,22,30,0.95)'; ctx.fillRect(p[0] - 3, p[1] - 8, 6, 10);
            ctx.fillStyle = pi % 2 ? `rgba(255,60,200,${0.5 + beat * 0.4})` : `rgba(90,220,255,${0.5 + beat * 0.4})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p[0], p[1] - 9, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          });
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.05 * neon})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, by + b.h + 10, b.w * 0.5, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();

          // Tiered body — setbacks narrowing toward the crown.
          const tiers = [
            { wf: 1.00, h: rise * 0.34 },
            { wf: 0.82, h: rise * 0.28 },
            { wf: 0.64, h: rise * 0.22 },
            { wf: 0.46, h: rise * 0.16 },
          ];
          const depthX = BUILDING_DEPTH * 0.5;
          const depthY = BUILDING_DEPTH * 0.28;
          let tierBottom = by;                 // tiers stack upward from footprint top
          for (let ti = 0; ti < tiers.length; ti++) {
            const t = tiers[ti];
            const tw = b.w * t.wf;
            const tx = cx - tw / 2;
            const tTop = tierBottom - t.h;
            // right depth face (2.5D)
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,4,16,0.95)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(tx + tw, tTop);
            ctx.lineTo(tx + tw + depthX, tTop + depthY);
            ctx.lineTo(tx + tw + depthX, tierBottom + depthY);
            ctx.lineTo(tx + tw, tierBottom);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            // front glass face
            const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(tx, tTop, tx, tierBottom);
            fg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(20,8,34,0.98)');
            fg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6,10,20,0.98)');
            ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.fillRect(tx, tTop, tw, t.h);
            // lit window grid (cyan / amber / magenta)
            const cols = Math.max(3, Math.floor(tw / 14));
            const rows = Math.max(4, Math.floor(t.h / 12));
            const cwd = (tw - 6) / cols, rhd = (t.h - 6) / rows;
            for (let wr = 0; wr < rows; wr++) {
              for (let wc = 0; wc < cols; wc++) {
                const sw = wr * 13 + wc * 7 + ti * 5;
                if ((sw + Math.floor(f * 0.02)) % 11 > 6) continue; // some floors dark
                const warm = sw % 3 === 0;
                const mag = sw % 7 === 0;
                const a = (warm ? 0.5 : 0.4) * neon * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(f * 0.05 + sw));
                ctx.fillStyle = mag ? `rgba(255,80,210,${a})` : warm ? `rgba(255,200,110,${a})` : `rgba(90,210,255,${a})`;
                ctx.fillRect(tx + 3 + wc * cwd, tTop + 3 + wr * rhd, Math.max(2, cwd - 2), Math.max(2, rhd - 2));
              }
            }
            // neon edge outline + setback ledge glow
            ctx.strokeStyle = isNear ? `rgba(56,189,248,${0.7 + beat * 0.3})` : `rgba(120,40,210,${0.4 + neon * 0.4})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeRect(tx, tTop, tw, t.h);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.25 * neon})`;
            ctx.fillRect(tx, tTop, tw, 2);
            tierBottom = tTop;
          }
          const crownY = tierBottom;

          // Penthouse crown — always lit gold, the watcher in the glass.
          const phW = b.w * 0.46;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,196,70,${0.12 + beat * 0.06})`;
          ctx.fillRect(cx - phW / 2, crownY + 4, phW, 14);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,180,50,${0.4 + beat * 0.2})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(cx - phW / 2, crownY + 4, phW, 14);
          const silX = cx + Math.sin(f * 0.008) * 4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${0.8 + Math.sin(f * 0.015) * 0.12})`;
          ctx.fillRect(silX - 3, crownY + 5, 6, 11);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(silX, crownY + 4, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

          // Vertical neon signage — シャドウ (SHADOW) + PABLO down the facade.
          ctx.save();
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.shadowColor = '#ff2cc8'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8 + beat * 6;
          ctx.font = 'bold 13px sans-serif';
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,60,200,${0.6 + beat * 0.4})`;
          ['シ', 'ャ', 'ド', 'ウ'].forEach((gl, gi) => ctx.fillText(gl, bx + b.w * 0.15, by + 22 + gi * 16));
          ctx.shadowColor = '#38bdf8';
          ctx.font = 'bold 11px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(90,220,255,${0.55 + beat * 0.35})`;
          'PABLO'.split('').forEach((gl, gi) => ctx.fillText(gl, bx + b.w * 0.85, by + 20 + gi * 14));
          ctx.restore();

          // Antenna mast + cyan beacon + blinking red aircraft warning lights.
          const mastTop = crownY - 46;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,160,200,0.7)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, crownY); ctx.lineTo(cx, mastTop); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,160,200,0.5)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 6, mastTop + 14); ctx.lineTo(cx + 6, mastTop + 14); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 4, mastTop + 26); ctx.lineTo(cx + 4, mastTop + 26); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#38bdf8'; ctx.shadowBlur = 5 + beat * 5;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(120,230,255,${0.4 + beat * 0.22})`;
