          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, mastTop, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
          if (Math.floor(f * 0.04) % 2 === 0) {
            ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = '#ff2200'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,40,20,0.9)';
            const cw2 = (b.w * 0.46) / 2;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - cw2, crownY + 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + cw2, crownY + 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
          }

          // Podium / footprint base with glowing entrance.
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,4,12,0.95)';
          ctx.fillRect(bx, by, b.w, b.h);
          ctx.strokeStyle = isNear ? 'rgba(56,189,248,0.9)' : `rgba(140,0,220,${0.4 + neon * 0.3})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = isNear ? 2.5 : 1.5; ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, b.w, b.h);
          const dW = Math.min(34, b.w * 0.22), dH = Math.min(20, b.h * 0.4);
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#38bdf8'; ctx.shadowBlur = 10 * neon;
          const dGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY - dH, 0, groundY);
          dGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(56,189,248,${0.10 + neon * 0.10})`);
          dGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(56,189,248,${0.35 + neon * 0.25})`);
          ctx.fillStyle = dGrad;
          ctx.fillRect(cx - dW / 2, groundY - dH, dW, dH);
          ctx.restore();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.06 * neon})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, groundY + 6, dW, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

          // ── Fog-warner NPC — a hazmat watcher who emerges to warn about the poison fog ──
          {
            const fw = g.fogWarner;
            const tcx = b.x + b.w / 2, tcy = b.y + b.h / 2;
            const homeX = tcx - 46, homeY = b.y + b.h + 26;
            if (!fw.init) { fw.x = homeX; fw.y = homeY; fw.init = true; }
            const northFogEdge = CITY_TOP - GAS_CITY_MARGIN;
            const nearTower = Math.hypot(g.px - tcx, g.py - tcy) < 640;
            const approachingFog = g.gasPoison || (nearTower && g.py < northFogEdge + 260);
            if (fw.cooldown > 0) fw.cooldown--;
            if (fw.state === 'idle') {
              fw.x += (homeX - fw.x) * 0.08; fw.y += (homeY - fw.y) * 0.08;
              if (approachingFog && fw.cooldown <= 0 && nearTower) { fw.state = 'out'; fw.t = 0; }
            } else if (fw.state === 'out') {
              fw.t++;
              const txp = g.px, typ = Math.max(northFogEdge + 26, g.py + 24);
              const dxp = txp - fw.x, dyp = typ - fw.y; const dd = Math.hypot(dxp, dyp) || 1;
              if (dd > 42) { fw.x += (dxp / dd) * 1.4; fw.y += (dyp / dd) * 1.4; }
              if (fw.t > 420 || (!approachingFog && fw.t > 90) || !nearTower) { fw.state = 'return'; fw.cooldown = 600; }
            } else {
              const dxp = homeX - fw.x, dyp = homeY - fw.y; const dd = Math.hypot(dxp, dyp) || 1;
              if (dd > 4) { fw.x += (dxp / dd) * 1.2; fw.y += (dyp / dd) * 1.2; } else { fw.state = 'idle'; }
            }
            if (!nearTower && fw.state === 'idle') fw.cooldown = 0;

            const wsx = fw.x + ox, wsy = fw.y + oy;
            const moving = fw.state !== 'idle';
            const wph = moving ? Math.sin(f * 0.25) * 1 : 0;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(wsx, wsy + 9, 6, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1f12';
            ctx.fillRect(wsx - 4, wsy + 2 + wph * 0.3, 3, 7);
            ctx.fillRect(wsx + 1, wsy + 2 - wph * 0.3, 3, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4a1e';
            ctx.fillRect(wsx - 5, wsy - 6, 10, 9);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220,255,90,${0.6 + beat * 0.3})`;
            ctx.fillRect(wsx - 5, wsy - 3, 10, 1.5);
            ctx.fillRect(wsx - 5, wsy + 0.5, 10, 1.5);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#caa84a';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(wsx, wsy - 9, 3.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(120,230,255,${0.5 + beat * 0.3})`;
            ctx.fillRect(wsx - 2, wsy - 11, 1.5, 1.2); ctx.fillRect(wsx + 0.5, wsy - 11, 1.5, 1.2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0d06'; ctx.fillRect(wsx - 1.5, wsy - 8, 3, 2);
            ctx.restore();

            if (fw.state === 'out') {
              const lines = ['TURN BACK — THE FOG IS LETHAL.', 'NO MASK? NO FUTURE. GO HOME.', 'THE GAS TOOK THIS CITY. DON\u2019T FEED IT.'];
              const msg = lines[Math.floor(fw.t / 140) % lines.length];
              ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'left';
              const tw2 = ctx.measureText(msg).width;
              const bxp = wsx - tw2 / 2 - 6, byp = wsy - 30, bw2 = tw2 + 12, bh2 = 15;
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,6,0.92)'; ctx.fillRect(bxp, byp, bw2, bh2);
              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(220,255,90,${0.6 + beat * 0.3})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(bxp, byp, bw2, bh2);
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(wsx - 3, byp + bh2); ctx.lineTo(wsx + 3, byp + bh2); ctx.lineTo(wsx, byp + bh2 + 4); ctx.closePath();
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,6,0.92)'; ctx.fill();
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,255,90,0.95)'; ctx.fillText(msg, bxp + 6, byp + 10);
              ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            }
          }

          // Label + interaction prompt — the name is only legible up close.
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          if (isNear) {
            ctx.font = 'bold 10px "Fira Code"';
            const nm = 'SHADOW TOWER';
            const npw = ctx.measureText(nm).width + 12;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,18,0.92)';
            ctx.fillRect(cx - npw / 2, groundY - 13, npw, 14);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.strokeRect(cx - npw / 2, groundY - 13, npw, 14);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
            ctx.fillText(nm, cx, groundY - 3);
            ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.95)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)';
            ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText('[E]', cx, groundY - dH - 6);
          } else {
            // From a distance the signage is unreadable — indistinct marks only.
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,120,255,${0.25 + neon * 0.15})`;
            const sgw = Math.min(b.w * 0.5, 30); let cxx = cx - sgw / 2;
            [0.3, 0.16, 0.32].forEach(sgf => { const w = sgw * sgf; ctx.fillRect(cxx, groundY - 6, w, 2); cxx += w + sgw * 0.08; });
          }
          ctx.textAlign = 'left';
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          continue; // skip default building drawing
        }

        // ── SAVE POINT crystal — glowing diamond ──────────────────────────
        if (b.id === 'crystal' || b.id === 'crystal2' || b.id === 'crystal3') {
          const cx2 = bx + b.w / 2, cy2 = by + b.h / 2;
          const pulse2 = 0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.07) * 0.5;
          const sz = 9 + pulse2 * 3;
          ctx.shadowColor = '#aaffff'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12 + pulse2 * 10;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(80,255,255,${0.5 + pulse2 * 0.4})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2, cy2 - sz); ctx.lineTo(cx2 + sz * 0.6, cy2); ctx.lineTo(cx2, cy2 + sz); ctx.lineTo(cx2 - sz * 0.6, cy2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,255,255,${0.4 + pulse2 * 0.4})`; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('SAVE', cx2, cy2 + sz + 8);
          if (isNear) { ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(180,255,255,.9)' : 'rgba(180,255,255,.3)'; ctx.fillText('[E] SAVE', cx2, cy2 - sz - 6); }
          continue;
        }

        // ── PUBLIC TERMINAL rendering (payphones, kiosks, vans) ─────────
        if (IS_PUBLIC_TERMINAL(b.id)) {
          const cx2 = bx + b.w / 2, cy2 = by + b.h / 2;
          const pulse2 = 0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06 + bx * 0.01) * 0.5;
          if (IS_VAN(b.id)) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.08 + pulse2 * 0.04})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bx, by, b.w, b.h);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.3 + pulse2 * 0.2})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, b.w, b.h);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.15 + pulse2 * 0.1})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bx + b.w - 8, by + 4, 6, b.h - 8);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.5 + pulse2 * 0.3})`;
            ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('VAN', cx2, cy2 + 3);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.3 + pulse2 * 0.2})`;
            ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText('TERMINAL', cx2, cy2 + 11);
          } else {
            ctx.shadowColor = '#38bdf8'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + pulse2 * 6;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,20,10,${0.85})`;
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 7, cy2 - 8, 14, 12);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.5 + pulse2 * 0.3})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeRect(cx2 - 7, cy2 - 8, 14, 12);
            const scanY = cy2 - 7 + ((g.frame * 0.5) % 10);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.06 + pulse2 * 0.04})`;
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 6, scanY, 12, 1);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.4 + pulse2 * 0.4})`;
            ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('>', cx2, cy2);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,80,40,${0.6})`;
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 3, cy2 + 5, 6, 3);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,60,30,${0.5})`;
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 5, cy2 + 8, 10, 2);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.5 + pulse2 * 0.3})`;
            ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('TERMINAL', cx2, cy2 + 18);
          }
          if (isNear) { ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.9)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)'; ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('[E] TERMINAL', cx2, by - 6); }
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          continue;
        }

        // ── Isometric building cube rendering ──────────────────────────────
        const bBr = dayBright;
        const bHash = tileHash(b.x, b.y);
        void tileHash(b.x + 50, b.y + 50);
        let wallR: number, wallG: number, wallB: number;
        let roofR: number, roofG: number, roofB: number;
        let accentR: number, accentG: number, accentB: number;
        // ── Minx City neon-noir material palette ───────────────────────────
        // Re-graded from the old earthy "generic town" tones (terracotta /
        // concrete / ochre) to the cool jewel-toned noir key of the onboarding
        // & Pledge concept art. Six buckets keep material variety (distinct
        // hue + luminance) but unify around indigo/teal/slate/plum so the city
        // reads as one cohesive world. Amber-lit windows (below) pop against
        // these cool walls for the classic neon-noir read. Colour-only change —
        // no geometry, texture, or window logic touched.
        if (isLocked) {
          // Seized / locked — kept warm rust so the "claimed" signal still reads.
          wallR = 128; wallG = 72; wallB = 52;
          roofR = 98; roofG = 54; roofB = 38;
          accentR = 172; accentG = 96; accentB = 60;
        } else if (bHash < 0.22) {
          // Indigo masonry
          wallR = 84; wallG = 74; wallB = 116; roofR = 60; roofG = 52; roofB = 88;
          accentR = 132; accentG = 108; accentB = 176;
        } else if (bHash < 0.44) {
          // Slate panel
          wallR = 96; wallG = 104; wallB = 124; roofR = 70; roofG = 78; roofB = 98;
          accentR = 128; accentG = 138; accentB = 162;
        } else if (bHash < 0.66) {
          // Teal glass / steel
          wallR = 60; wallG = 96; wallB = 116; roofR = 42; roofG = 74; roofB = 96;
          accentR = 96; accentG = 156; accentB = 184;
        } else if (bHash < 0.82) {
          // Plum plaster
          wallR = 122; wallG = 82; wallB = 112; roofR = 92; roofG = 60; roofB = 86;
          accentR = 174; accentG = 112; accentB = 156;
        } else {
          // Cool brutalist
          wallR = 58; wallG = 62; wallB = 80; roofR = 42; roofG = 46; roofB = 62;
          accentR = 86; accentG = 92; accentB = 116;
        }

        const isTower = b.w >= 50 || b.h >= 50;
        const depthX = BUILDING_DEPTH * 0.55; // right-face depth in X
        const depthY = BUILDING_DEPTH * 0.30; // right-face skew in Y

        // ── Soft cast shadow on the ground ─────────────────────────────────
        // Grounds the building so it doesn't appear to float. Drawn BEFORE the
        // roof/walls so the structure sits on top of its own shadow. The key
        // light reads from the upper-left (the right face is the dark/shadow
        // face), so the shadow projects DOWN-RIGHT. The shape is the building's
        // ground-footprint quad (front-bottom edge swept back along the depth
        // axis), translated by the light offset; softness is faked cheaply with
        // a few stacked, outward-expanded layers (no per-building gradient
        // object). Opacity scales with time of day — firm at midday, faint at
        // night — and the whole pass is viewport-culled with the building above.
        {
          const shA = 0.20 * dayBright; // subtle, day-scaled
          // Throw follows the sun: long & angled at dawn/dusk, short & near-
          // straight-down at noon, swinging right→left as the sun crosses.
          const sdx = shadowDX * 8;
          const sdy = 2 + shadowDY * 6;
          const gy = by + b.h;          // front ground line
          const fcx = bx + b.w / 2 + depthX / 2 + sdx; // footprint centroid (x)
          const fcy = gy + depthY / 2 + sdy;            // footprint centroid (y)
          const corners: [number, number][] = [
            [bx + sdx,                     gy + sdy],
            [bx + b.w + sdx,               gy + sdy],
            [bx + b.w + depthX + sdx,      gy + depthY + sdy],
            [bx + depthX + sdx,            gy + depthY + sdy],
          ];
          ctx.save();
          for (const layer of [{ e: 6, a: 0.30 }, { e: 3, a: 0.32 }, { e: 0, a: 0.38 }]) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${shA * layer.a})`;
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let ci = 0; ci < corners.length; ci++) {
              const [cxr, cyr] = corners[ci];
              const ex = cxr + (cxr - fcx > 0 ? layer.e : -layer.e);
              const ey = cyr + (cyr - fcy > 0 ? layer.e : -layer.e);
              if (ci === 0) ctx.moveTo(ex, ey); else ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
            }
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // ── Roof face (flat top viewed from slight angle) ──────────────────
        const roofSkew = 5;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(roofR * bBr)},${Math.floor(roofG * bBr)},${Math.floor(roofB * bBr)})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(bx,          by - roofSkew);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + b.w,    by - roofSkew);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + b.w + depthX, by - roofSkew + depthY);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + depthX, by - roofSkew + depthY);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        // Roof edge highlight
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(Math.min(255, roofR * bBr + 20))},${Math.floor(Math.min(255, roofG * bBr + 18))},${Math.floor(Math.min(255, roofB * bBr + 15))})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();

        // ── Front face (facing camera — most visible wall) ─────────────────
        // Base front wall
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(wallR * bBr)},${Math.floor(wallG * bBr)},${Math.floor(wallB * bBr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, b.w, b.h);

        // Brick / panel texture on front face
        if (bHash < 0.22) {
          // Brick pattern on front
          for (let bry = 0; bry < b.h; bry += 7) {
            const rowOff = (Math.floor(bry / 7) % 2) * 6;
            for (let brx = rowOff; brx < b.w; brx += 12) {
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor((wallR - 18) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallG - 14) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallB - 10) * bBr)})`;
              ctx.fillRect(bx + brx, by + bry, 11, 6);
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor((wallR + 12) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallG + 6) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallB + 5) * bBr)})`;
              ctx.fillRect(bx + brx, by + bry + 6, 12, 1);
              ctx.fillRect(bx + brx + 11, by + bry, 1, 7);
            }
          }
        } else if (bHash < 0.44) {
          // Concrete panel grid on front
          for (let py6 = 0; py6 < b.h; py6 += 14) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`;
            ctx.fillRect(bx, by + py6, b.w, 1);
          }
          for (let px6 = 0; px6 < b.w; px6 += 20) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.06)`;
            ctx.fillRect(bx + px6, by, 1, b.h);
          }
        } else if (bHash < 0.66) {
          // Glass curtain wall — horizontal blue bands
          for (let py6 = 0; py6 < b.h; py6 += 9) {
            ctx.fillStyle = py6 % 18 === 0 ? `rgba(150,190,230,${0.12 * bBr})` : `rgba(100,140,200,${0.07 * bBr})`;
            ctx.fillRect(bx, by + py6, b.w, 8);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`;
            ctx.fillRect(bx, by + py6 + 8, b.w, 1);
          }
        }

        // Front wall outline
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.15)`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(bx, by, b.w, b.h);

        // ── Right-side face (darker — shadow face) ─────────────────────────
        const sideWallR = Math.floor(wallR * 0.58 * bBr);
        const sideWallG = Math.floor(wallG * 0.58 * bBr);
        const sideWallB = Math.floor(wallB * 0.58 * bBr);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${sideWallR},${sideWallG},${sideWallB})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(bx + b.w,           by);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + b.w + depthX,  by + depthY);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + b.w + depthX,  by + b.h + depthY);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + b.w,           by + b.h);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        // Side face brick pattern
        if (bHash < 0.22) {
          for (let bry = 0; bry < b.h; bry += 7) {
            const frac = bry / b.h;
            const sxBase = bx + b.w + depthX * frac;
            const syOff = depthY * frac;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor((wallR - 25) * bBr * 0.6)},${Math.floor((wallG - 18) * bBr * 0.6)},${Math.floor((wallB - 12) * bBr * 0.6)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(sxBase, by + bry + syOff, depthX * (1 - frac) + 1, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`;
            ctx.fillRect(sxBase, by + bry + 6 + syOff, depthX * (1 - frac) + 1, 1);
          }
        }

        // ── Front face windows ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        const winW = 6, winH = 7, winGapX = 4, winGapY = 5;
        const winMarginX = 7, winMarginY = 6;
        const winCols = Math.max(1, Math.floor((b.w - winMarginX * 2) / (winW + winGapX)));
        const winRows = Math.max(1, Math.floor((b.h - winMarginY * 2 - 14) / (winH + winGapY)));
        const winStartX = bx + winMarginX + ((b.w - winMarginX * 2) - winCols * (winW + winGapX) + winGapX) / 2;
        const winStartY = by + winMarginY;
        for (let wr = 0; wr < winRows; wr++) {
          for (let wc = 0; wc < winCols; wc++) {
            const wx = winStartX + wc * (winW + winGapX);
            const wy = winStartY + wr * (winH + winGapY);
            const winLit = tileHash(b.x + wc * 17, b.y + wr * 11);
            const isLitWin = isNight ? winLit > 0.38 : winLit > 0.85;
            const winPulse = isLitWin && isNight ? 0.8 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.025 + wc + wr * 3) * 0.2 : 1;
            if (isLitWin) {
              if (isNight) {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${Math.floor(220 * winPulse)},${Math.floor(90 * winPulse)},${0.85 * winPulse})`;
              } else {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(200 * bBr)},${Math.floor(225 * bBr)},${Math.floor(245 * bBr)})`;
              }
            } else {
              ctx.fillStyle = isNight
                ? `rgb(${Math.floor(18 * bBr)},${Math.floor(24 * bBr)},${Math.floor(36 * bBr)})`
                : `rgb(${Math.floor(130 * bBr)},${Math.floor(165 * bBr)},${Math.floor(200 * bBr)})`;
            }
            ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, winW, winH);
            // Window frame
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor((wallR - 25) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallG - 22) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallB - 18) * bBr)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(wx - 1, wy - 1, winW + 2, 1);
            ctx.fillRect(wx - 1, wy + winH, winW + 2, 1);
            ctx.fillRect(wx - 1, wy, 1, winH);
            ctx.fillRect(wx + winW, wy, 1, winH);
            // Window cross-bar
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.15)`;
            ctx.fillRect(wx, wy + winH / 2 - 0.5, winW, 1);
            ctx.fillRect(wx + winW / 2 - 0.5, wy, 1, winH);
            // Night glow from lit windows
            if (isLitWin && isNight) {
              ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(255,200,80,0.5)`;
              ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,80,0.12)`;
              ctx.fillRect(wx - 2, wy - 2, winW + 4, winH + 4);
              ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            }
          }
        }

        // ── Door with frame and awning ─────────────────────────────────────
        const doorW = 10, doorH = 14;
        const doorX = bx + b.w / 2 - doorW / 2, doorY = by + b.h - doorH;
        // Awning above door
        const awningCol = isLocked ? '#aa5533' : `rgb(${Math.floor(accentR * bBr)},${Math.floor(accentG * bBr)},${Math.floor(accentB * bBr)})`;
        ctx.fillStyle = awningCol;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(doorX - 5, doorY - 3);
        ctx.lineTo(doorX + doorW + 5, doorY - 3);
        ctx.lineTo(doorX + doorW + 3, doorY + 3);
        ctx.lineTo(doorX - 3, doorY + 3);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        // Awning stripes
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`;
        for (let ast = 0; ast < doorW + 10; ast += 4) {
          ctx.fillRect(doorX - 5 + ast, doorY - 3, 2, 6);
        }
        // Door frame
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor((wallR - 30) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallG - 25) * bBr)},${Math.floor((wallB - 20) * bBr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(doorX - 1, doorY, doorW + 2, doorH + 1);
        // Door body
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(55 * bBr)},${Math.floor(38 * bBr)},${Math.floor(22 * bBr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(doorX, doorY, doorW, doorH);
        // Door panel detail
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`;
        ctx.fillRect(doorX + 1, doorY + 2, doorW - 2, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(doorX + 1, doorY + 8, doorW - 2, 4);
        // Door handle
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(180 * bBr)},${Math.floor(160 * bBr)},${Math.floor(70 * bBr)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(doorX + doorW - 3, doorY + doorH / 2 - 2, 2, 4);
        // Building signage on awning
        ctx.fillStyle = isLocked ? '#ff8c3c' : b.bright ? (isNear ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.95)') : `rgb(${Math.floor(240 * bBr)},${Math.floor(230 * bBr)},${Math.floor(210 * bBr)})`;
        ctx.font = `${b.bright ? 8 : 7}px "Fira Code"`; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        {
          // Building NAMES are intentionally not rendered — places are recognised
          // by their art/signage silhouette, not floating text labels. A few
          // indistinct signage marks stand in for the unreadable lettering, at
          // every distance, so nothing identifies a building by name in-world.
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(200 * bBr)},${Math.floor(195 * bBr)},${Math.floor(180 * bBr)},0.3)`;
          const sgw = Math.min(b.w * 0.6, 26), sy = by + 6;
          let cxx = bx + b.w / 2 - sgw / 2;
          [0.28, 0.18, 0.34].forEach(sgf => { const w = sgw * sgf; ctx.fillRect(cxx, sy, w, 2); cxx += w + sgw * 0.08; });
        }

        // ── Rooftop + architectural variety ────────────────────────────────
        const archHash = tileHash(b.x * 1.3 + 11, b.y * 1.7 + 7);
        const faceHash = tileHash(b.x * 0.9 + 29, b.y * 2.1 + 41);
        const inkR = Math.floor(38 * bBr), inkG = Math.floor(40 * bBr), inkB = Math.floor(44 * bBr);
        const metalR = Math.floor(100 * bBr), metalG = Math.floor(100 * bBr), metalB = Math.floor(95 * bBr);
        const darkMetalR = Math.floor(80 * bBr), darkMetalG = Math.floor(80 * bBr), darkMetalB = Math.floor(78 * bBr);

        // AC clusters on every tower
        if (isTower) {
          const acCount = Math.min(3, Math.floor(b.w / 30));
          for (let ai = 0; ai < acCount; ai++) {
            const acX = bx + 8 + ai * (b.w - 16) / Math.max(1, acCount - 1);
            const acY = by - roofSkew + 2;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${metalR},${metalG},${metalB})`;
            ctx.fillRect(acX - 4, acY, 8, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${darkMetalR},${darkMetalG},${darkMetalB})`;
            ctx.fillRect(acX - 3, acY + 1, 6, 2);
          }
        }

        // Archetype — one of 8 silhouettes, driven by deterministic hash
        if (archHash < 0.13 && b.w >= 32) {
          // CROWN — crenellated battlement top
          const notches = Math.max(3, Math.floor(b.w / 10));
          const notchW = (b.w / notches) * 0.6;
          const notchGap = (b.w / notches) * 0.4;
          for (let ni = 0; ni < notches; ni++) {
            const nx = bx + ni * (notchW + notchGap);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(roofR * bBr)},${Math.floor(roofG * bBr)},${Math.floor(roofB * bBr)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(nx, by - roofSkew - 4, notchW, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,.28)`;
            ctx.fillRect(nx, by - roofSkew - 4, 1, 4);
          }
        } else if (archHash < 0.26 && !isTower) {
          // PITCHED — pitched tile roof
          const peak = 9 + Math.floor(b.w / 14);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(roofR * bBr * 0.72)},${Math.floor(roofG * bBr * 0.68)},${Math.floor(roofB * bBr * 0.6)})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(bx - 2, by - roofSkew);
          ctx.lineTo(bx + b.w + 2, by - roofSkew);
          ctx.lineTo(bx + b.w / 2, by - roofSkew - peak);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,.20)`; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          for (let tr = 1; tr < 4; tr++) {
            const ty2 = by - roofSkew - (peak * tr / 4);
            const tw = (b.w + 4) * (1 - tr / 4);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(bx + (b.w - tw) / 2 - 2, ty2);
            ctx.lineTo(bx + (b.w + tw) / 2 + 2, ty2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        } else if (archHash < 0.40) {
          // SETBACK — smaller box stacked on top + blinking aircraft light
          const sbW = b.w * 0.55;
          const sbH = isTower ? 14 : 8;
          const sbX = bx + (b.w - sbW) / 2;
          const sbY = by - roofSkew - sbH;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(wallR * bBr * 0.92)},${Math.floor(wallG * bBr * 0.92)},${Math.floor(wallB * bBr * 0.92)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(sbX, sbY, sbW, sbH);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(roofR * bBr)},${Math.floor(roofG * bBr)},${Math.floor(roofB * bBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(sbX - 1, sbY - 1, sbW + 2, 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,.25)`;
          for (let sw = 2; sw < sbW - 2; sw += 5) ctx.fillRect(sbX + sw, sbY + 2, 2, sbH - 3);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${inkR},${inkG},${inkB})`;
          ctx.fillRect(sbX + sbW / 2, sbY - 9, 1, 9);
          if ((g.frame >> 4) % 2 === 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,60,60,.95)';
            ctx.fillRect(sbX + sbW / 2 - 1, sbY - 10, 2, 2);
          }
        } else if (archHash < 0.55 && b.w >= 28) {
          // BILLBOARD — rooftop neon sign
          const bbW = Math.min(b.w - 4, 44);
          const bbH = 10;
          const bbX = bx + (b.w - bbW) / 2;
          const bbY = by - roofSkew - bbH - 2;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${inkR},${inkG},${inkB})`;
          ctx.fillRect(bbX + 3, bbY + bbH, 1, 3);
          ctx.fillRect(bbX + bbW - 4, bbY + bbH, 1, 3);
          const neon: [number,number,number] = faceHash < 0.33 ? [255,80,170] : faceHash < 0.66 ? [80,220,255] : [255,200,60];
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(14 * bBr)},${Math.floor(16 * bBr)},${Math.floor(20 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(bbX, bbY, bbW, bbH);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${inkR},${inkG},${inkB})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(bbX + 0.5, bbY + 0.5, bbW - 1, bbH - 1);
          const glowA = isNight ? 0.95 : 0.55;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${neon[0]},${neon[1]},${neon[2]},${glowA})`;
          const glyphs = 4;
          for (let gi = 0; gi < glyphs; gi++) {
            const gx = bbX + 4 + gi * ((bbW - 8) / glyphs);
            ctx.fillRect(gx, bbY + 3, 4, 1);
            ctx.fillRect(gx + 1, bbY + 5, 2, 1);
            ctx.fillRect(gx, bbY + 7, 4, 1);
          }
          if (isNight) {
            ctx.shadowColor = `rgb(${neon[0]},${neon[1]},${neon[2]})`;
            ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${neon[0]},${neon[1]},${neon[2]},.5)`;
            ctx.strokeRect(bbX, bbY, bbW, bbH);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          }
        } else if (archHash < 0.68) {
          // WATER TOWER — squat cylinder w/ conical cap on legs
          const wtR = 5 + Math.floor(b.w / 22);
          const wtX = bx + b.w * (0.28 + faceHash * 0.4);
          const wtBase = by - roofSkew - 2;
          const wtY = wtBase - wtR * 2 - 4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${darkMetalR},${darkMetalG},${darkMetalB})`;
          ctx.fillRect(wtX - wtR + 1, wtY + wtR * 2, 1, 4);
          ctx.fillRect(wtX + wtR - 1, wtY + wtR * 2, 1, 4);
          ctx.fillRect(wtX, wtY + wtR * 2, 1, 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(140 * bBr)},${Math.floor(125 * bBr)},${Math.floor(100 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(wtX - wtR, wtY + 2, wtR * 2, wtR * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(115 * bBr)},${Math.floor(102 * bBr)},${Math.floor(80 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(wtX - wtR, wtY + 2);
          ctx.lineTo(wtX + wtR, wtY + 2);
          ctx.lineTo(wtX, wtY - 3);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(130,60,30,.4)`;
          ctx.fillRect(wtX - wtR + 2, wtY + 4, 1, wtR * 2 - 2);
          ctx.fillRect(wtX + 1, wtY + 6, 1, wtR * 2 - 3);
        } else if (archHash < 0.80 && b.h >= 22) {
          // VERTICAL NEON — banner mounted on front face
          const leftMount = faceHash < 0.5;
          const signX = bx + (leftMount ? 3 : b.w - 7);
          const signY = by + 4;
          const signH = Math.min(b.h - 10, 34);
          const tint: [number,number,number] = faceHash < 0.33 ? [255,70,170] : faceHash < 0.66 ? [70,210,255] : [255,180,60];
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(10 * bBr)},${Math.floor(10 * bBr)},${Math.floor(14 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(signX, signY, 4, signH);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${tint[0]},${tint[1]},${tint[2]},${isNight ? 0.95 : 0.6})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          for (let sy2 = 2; sy2 < signH - 2; sy2 += 6) {
            ctx.strokeRect(signX + 1, signY + sy2, 2, 4);
          }
          if (isNight) {
            ctx.shadowColor = `rgb(${tint[0]},${tint[1]},${tint[2]})`;
            ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${tint[0]},${tint[1]},${tint[2]},.6)`;
            ctx.strokeRect(signX, signY, 4, signH);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${inkR},${inkG},${inkB})`;
          ctx.fillRect(signX + (leftMount ? -2 : 4), signY + 4, 2, 1);
          ctx.fillRect(signX + (leftMount ? -2 : 4), signY + signH - 6, 2, 1);
        } else if (archHash < 0.92) {
          // ANTENNA RIG — cross-mast with blinking nav light
          const amX = bx + b.w * (0.32 + faceHash * 0.36);
          const amBase = by - roofSkew;
          const amTop = amBase - 20;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${inkR},${inkG},${inkB})`;
          ctx.fillRect(amX, amTop, 1, 20);
          ctx.fillRect(amX - 6, amTop + 4, 13, 1);
          ctx.fillRect(amX - 3, amTop + 9, 7, 1);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(20,20,22,.55)`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(amX, amTop);
          ctx.lineTo(amX + 9, amBase);
          ctx.moveTo(amX, amTop);
          ctx.lineTo(amX - 9, amBase);
          ctx.stroke();
          if ((g.frame >> 5) % 2 === 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,50,50,.95)';
            ctx.fillRect(amX - 1, amTop - 2, 2, 2);
          }
        } else if (b.w >= 26) {
          // DOME — half-dome observatory/shrine top
          const dR = Math.min(b.w * 0.35, 14);
          const dX = bx + b.w / 2;
          const dY = by - roofSkew;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(roofR * bBr * 0.88)},${Math.floor(roofG * bBr * 0.88)},${Math.floor(roofB * bBr * 0.88)})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(dX, dY, dR, Math.PI, 0);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,.14)`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(dX - dR * 0.3, dY, dR * 0.7, Math.PI * 1.08, Math.PI * 1.48);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${inkR},${inkG},${inkB})`;
          ctx.fillRect(dX, dY - dR - 4, 1, 4);
        } else {
          // Fallback — simple vent
          const vx2 = bx + b.w * 0.65;
          const vy2 = by - roofSkew + 1;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(85 * bBr)},${Math.floor(85 * bBr)},${Math.floor(80 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(vx2, vy2, 6, 5);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(70 * bBr)},${Math.floor(70 * bBr)},${Math.floor(68 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(vx2 - 1, vy2, 1, 5);
        }

        // ── Front-face extras — fire escape / pipe / awning / stencil ──────
        if (faceHash < 0.20 && b.h >= 24) {
          const rightSide = archHash >= 0.5;
          const fsX = bx + (rightSide ? b.w - 1 : 1);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(28 * bBr)},${Math.floor(30 * bBr)},${Math.floor(32 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          const fsSteps = Math.floor(b.h / 10);
          for (let fi = 0; fi < fsSteps; fi++) {
            const fy3 = by + 4 + fi * 10;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(fsX, fy3);
            ctx.lineTo(fsX + (fi % 2 === 0 ? 3 : -3) * (rightSide ? -1 : 1), fy3 + 5);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(42 * bBr)},${Math.floor(44 * bBr)},${Math.floor(46 * bBr)})`;
            ctx.fillRect(fsX - 2, fy3, 4, 1);
          }
        } else if (faceHash < 0.36 && b.h >= 20) {
          const pX = bx + 3 + (Math.floor(faceHash * 997) % Math.max(1, b.w - 8));
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(95 * bBr)},${Math.floor(82 * bBr)},${Math.floor(62 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(pX, by + 2, 2, b.h - 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(40,28,18,.55)`;
          ctx.fillRect(pX - 1, by + 8, 4, 1);
          ctx.fillRect(pX - 1, by + b.h - 10, 4, 1);
        } else if (faceHash < 0.50 && b.w >= 28) {
          const awW = Math.min(b.w * 0.38, 18);
          const awX = bx + (b.w - awW) / 2;
          const awY = by + b.h - 14;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${Math.floor(165 * bBr)},${Math.floor(42 * bBr)},${Math.floor(52 * bBr)})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(awX, awY);
          ctx.lineTo(awX + awW, awY);
          ctx.lineTo(awX + awW - 2, awY + 3);
          ctx.lineTo(awX + 2, awY + 3);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,235,210,.45)`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
          for (let st = 1; st < 4; st++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(awX + (awW * st / 4), awY);
            ctx.lineTo(awX + (awW * st / 4) - 0.5, awY + 3);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        } else if (faceHash < 0.60 && b.h >= 22) {
          const tagX = bx + 4;
          const tagY = by + b.h - 16;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(240 * bBr)},${Math.floor(70 * bBr)},${Math.floor(110 * bBr)},.55)`;
          ctx.font = 'bold 9px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.textAlign = 'left';
          const tagNum = Math.floor(faceHash * 899) + 100;
          ctx.fillText(String(tagNum), tagX, tagY);
        }

        // Interior silhouettes when player is nearby
        if (HAS_INTERIOR(b.id)) {
          const playerDist = Math.hypot(g.px - (b.x + b.w / 2), g.py - (b.y + b.h / 2));
          if (playerDist < 180) {
            const silAlpha = Math.max(0, 0.14 - (playerDist - 70) * 0.001);
            if (silAlpha > 0.01) {
              const silCount = Math.min(3, Math.floor(b.w / 45));
              for (let si = 0; si < silCount; si++) {
                const sx = bx + 12 + si * (b.w - 24) / Math.max(1, silCount);
                const sy = by + b.h * 0.35 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.02 + si * 2 + b.x * 0.1) * 3;
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${silAlpha})`;
                ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 5, 10);
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx + 2.5, sy - 2.5, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // Near-building highlight & interaction prompt
        if (isNear) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeRect(bx - 1, by - 1, b.w + 2, b.h + 2);
        }
        const costLbl = BUILDING_COST_LABEL[b.id];
        if (costLbl && !isLocked) {
          ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.fillStyle = costLbl === 'FREE' ? '#66ff88' : costLbl === 'SHOP' ? '#ffcc44' : '#ffaa44';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(costLbl, bx + b.w / 2, by - roofSkew - 4);
        }
        if (isLocked) {
          ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8c3c';
          ctx.fillText('🔒', bx + b.w / 2, by + b.h / 2);
        }
        if (isNear) { ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.9)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)'; ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('[E]', bx + b.w / 2, by - roofSkew - 12); }
        if (b.id === 'theater') {
          const theaterCount = [...g.peers.values()].filter(p => p.interiorBid === 'theater' || p.interiorBid === 'theater_screen').length;
          if (theaterCount > 0) {
            const pulse = 0.55 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.07) * 0.35;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.font = 'bold 7px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(239,80,60,${pulse * 0.9})`;
            ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,120,90,${pulse})`;
            ctx.fillText(`\u25B6 ${theaterCount} WATCHING`, bx + b.w / 2, by - roofSkew - 22);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.restore();
          }
        }
      }

        // ── Food stalls and stray animals (visual-only, low-GFX optional) ───
        // A tiny authored pass gives the otherwise static food/market lots a
        // lived-in read. It is intentionally outside all movement/collision and
        // economy paths; low graphics mode removes it entirely.
        if (!lowGfxEnabled()) {
          const foodHabitats = ['noodle_bar', 'food_court'] as const;
          for (let fi = 0; fi < foodHabitats.length; fi++) {
            const b = BUILDINGS.find(candidate => candidate.id === foodHabitats[fi]);
            if (!b) continue;
            const sx = b.x + b.w / 2 + ox;
            const sy = b.y - 5 + oy;
            if (sx < -36 || sx > cw + 36 || sy < -50 || sy > ch + 36) continue;
            const aromaPhase = g.frame * 0.026 + fi * 2.1;
            // Two fixed aroma curls rise from each kitchen vent. The phase and
            // lateral drift are analytic, so the detail remains deterministic.
            ctx.save();
            for (let puff = 0; puff < 2; puff++) {
              const rise = ((aromaPhase + puff * 1.8) % 5.2) / 5.2;
              const px = sx + Math.sin(aromaPhase * 1.7 + puff * 2) * (3 + rise * 5);
              const py = sy - 4 - rise * 25;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${fi ? 208 : 232},${fi ? 128 : 176},${0.23 * (1 - rise)})`;
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 2 + rise * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            }
            // A modest warm service light establishes the food habitat without
            // using a full-screen or CRT-style post-process.
            const lamp = 0.55 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.07 + fi) * 0.18;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,186,82,${lamp})`;
            ctx.fillRect(sx - 1, sy + 2, 3, 3);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,186,82,${lamp * 0.22})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sx, sy + 8, 15, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
          }

          for (const habitatDef of AMBIENT_ANIMAL_HABITATS) {
            const b = BUILDINGS.find(candidate => candidate.id === habitatDef.buildingId);
            if (!b) continue;
            const animal = ambientAnimalVisual(b, habitatDef.kind, habitatDef.phase, habitatDef.side, g.frame, g.px, g.py);
            const ax = animal.x + ox, ay = animal.y + oy;
            if (ax < -20 || ax > cw + 20 || ay < -20 || ay > ch + 20) continue;
            const step = animal.moving ? Math.sin(g.frame * 0.25 + habitatDef.phase) * 1.2 : 0;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ax, ay + 4, animal.kind === 'dog' ? 7 : 5, 1.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            if (animal.kind === 'cat') {
              ctx.fillStyle = '#8b6a4d';
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ax, ay, 5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax + animal.facing * 4, ay - 2, 2.7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
              ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3428';
              ctx.fillRect(ax - 2, ay + 2 + step, 1.5, 3); ctx.fillRect(ax + 2, ay + 2 - step, 1.5, 3);
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#8b6a4d'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ax - animal.facing * 4, ay); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ax - animal.facing * 8, ay - 5, ax - animal.facing * 9, ay - 1); ctx.stroke();
            } else {
              ctx.fillStyle = '#a9784f';
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(ax, ay, 7, 3.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax + animal.facing * 6, ay - 2, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
              ctx.fillStyle = '#5b4030';
              ctx.fillRect(ax - 4, ay + 2 + step, 2, 3); ctx.fillRect(ax + 3, ay + 2 - step, 2, 3);
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#a9784f'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ax - animal.facing * 6, ay - 1); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ax - animal.facing * 10, ay - 6, ax - animal.facing * 11, ay - 2); ctx.stroke();
            }
            if (animal.fleeing) {
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,160,.7)'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.fillText('!', ax, ay - 8);
            }
            ctx.restore();
          }
        }

      // ── World-lock indicators: red keypad glyph above any BUILDING_LOCKS
      //     building the player hasn't unlocked yet. Replaces the generic
      //     "[E] ENTER" prompt with a "[E] LOCKED" cue when in range.
      for (const wl of BUILDING_LOCKS) {
        if (unlockedBuildingsRef.current.has(wl.buildingId)) continue;
        const b = BUILDINGS.find(bb => bb.id === wl.buildingId);
        if (!b) continue;
        const bx = b.x + ox, by = b.y + oy;
        if (bx + b.w < 0 || bx > cw || by + b.h < 0 || by > ch) continue;
        const isNear = nb === b.id;
        // Pulsing red keypad icon above the building label.
        const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08) * 0.3;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(239,68,68,${pulse})`;
        ctx.font = 'bold 14px "Fira Code"';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText('🔐', bx + b.w / 2, by - 22);
        if (isNear) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#ef4444' : 'rgba(239,68,68,.5)';
          ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.fillText('[E] LOCKED', bx + b.w / 2, by - 8);
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      for (const pb of playerBuildingsRef.current) {
        const pbx = pb.x + ox, pby = pb.y + oy;
        if (pbx + pb.w < 0 || pbx > cw || pby + pb.h < 0 || pby > ch) continue;
        const pbNear = Math.hypot(g.px - (pb.x + pb.w / 2), g.py - (pb.y + pb.h / 2)) < PLAYER_BUILDING_RANGE;
        drawPlayerBuilding(ctx, pb, ox, oy, pbNear, !!g.blink, g.frame, dayBright);
      }

      // ── Shared vehicle draw helper (directional pixel art) ──
      const drawVehicleSprite = (vx: number, vy: number, type: string, facing: 'up'|'down'|'left'|'right', col?: string) => {
        const vd = getVehicleDef(type);
        const vc = col ?? vd.color;
        const va = vd.accentColor;
        const vw2 = vd.bodyW / 2, vh2 = vd.bodyH / 2;
        const isHoriz = facing === 'left' || facing === 'right';
        const fwdX = isHoriz ? (facing === 'right' ? 1 : -1) : 0;
        const fwdY = !isHoriz ? (facing === 'down' ? 1 : -1) : 0;
        // Parse the color for darkening side faces
        const hexToRgb = (hex: string): [number, number, number] => {
          const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16)||128;
          const g2 = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16)||128;
          const b2 = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16)||128;
          return [r, g2, b2];
        };
        const [vR, vG, vB] = hexToRgb(vc.startsWith('#') ? vc : '#884422');
        const sideFace = `rgb(${Math.floor(vR*0.65)},${Math.floor(vG*0.65)},${Math.floor(vB*0.65)})`;
        const roofFace = `rgb(${Math.floor(vR*0.85)},${Math.floor(vG*0.85)},${Math.floor(vB*0.85)})`;
        // Depth constants for isometric look
        const isoDepthX = 3.5, isoDepthY = 2.0;
        const bodyH3D = vd.category === 'bike' ? 5 : vd.category === 'car' ? 9 : 11;
        // Soft ground shadow — two stacked ellipses fake a penumbra so the
        // vehicle sits on the street instead of floating, matching the buildings/
        // NPC/player convention. Opacity scales with time of day and the throw is
        // nudged down-right to match the scene's upper-left key light. Drawn
        // before the body so the sprite sits on top of its own shadow.
        {
          // Sun-driven throw: offset toward the shadow direction and stretch the
          // ellipse with the shadow length so it lengthens at dawn/dusk.
          const vrx = (isHoriz ? vw2 + 4 : vh2 + 4) * (0.85 + sky.shadow.len * 0.2);
          const vsa = 0.26 * dayBright;
          const vsy = vy + (isHoriz ? vh2 : vw2) + 4;
          const vox = shadowDX * 3;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${vsa * 0.5})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(vx + 3 + vox, vsy + 1, vrx + 2, 4.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${vsa})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(vx + 2 + vox, vsy, vrx, 3.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        if (vd.category === 'bike') {
          if (isHoriz) {
            // Side shadow face (isometric depth)
            ctx.fillStyle = sideFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx + vw2, vy - vh2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX, vy - vh2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX, vy + vh2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2, vy + vh2);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            // Main body top-down
            ctx.fillStyle = vc; ctx.fillRect(vx - vw2, vy - vh2, vd.bodyW, vd.bodyH);
            // Fairing / windshield
            ctx.fillStyle = va; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2, vy - vh2 - 3, vh2 * 2, 4);
            // Engine detail
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,0.25)`;
            ctx.fillRect(vx - 3, vy - vh2 + 1, 6, vh2);
            // Headlight
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44'; ctx.fillRect(vx + fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy - 1, 2, 2);
            // Tail light
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444'; ctx.fillRect(vx - fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy - 1, 2, 2);
            // Wheels
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vw2 * 0.55, vy + vh2 + 3, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vw2 * 0.55, vy + vh2 + 3, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vw2 * 0.55, vy + vh2 + 3, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vw2 * 0.55, vy + vh2 + 3, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          } else {
            // Vertical bike
            ctx.fillStyle = sideFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx + vh2, vy - vw2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX, vy - vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX, vy + vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2, vy + vw2);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = vc; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2, vy - vw2, vd.bodyH, vd.bodyW);
            ctx.fillStyle = va; ctx.fillRect(vx - 2, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 2), 4, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44'; ctx.fillRect(vx - 1, vy + fwdY * vw2, 2, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vh2 + 2, vy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vh2 - 2, vy, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        } else if (vd.category === 'car') {
          if (isHoriz) {
            // Right side shadow face
            ctx.fillStyle = sideFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx + vw2,              vy - vh2 - bodyH3D);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy + vh2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2,              vy + vh2);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            // Window area on side face
            ctx.fillStyle = vd.windowColor.replace(')', ', 0.5)').replace('rgb', 'rgba');
            ctx.fillRect(vx + vw2 + 1, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + 2 + isoDepthY * 0.3, isoDepthX - 2, bodyH3D - 3);
            // Roof top face (skewed parallelogram)
            ctx.fillStyle = roofFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx - vw2,              vy - vh2 - bodyH3D);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2,              vy - vh2 - bodyH3D);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx - vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + isoDepthY);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            // Main car body (top view / front face)
            ctx.fillStyle = vc; ctx.fillRect(vx - vw2, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D, vd.bodyW, vd.bodyH + bodyH3D);
            // Windshield / windows
            ctx.fillStyle = vd.windowColor; ctx.fillRect(vx - vw2 * 0.35, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + 2, vd.bodyW * 0.5, bodyH3D - 2);
            // Accent stripe
            ctx.fillStyle = va; ctx.fillRect(vx - vw2, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D, vd.bodyW, 3);
            // Police light bar
            if (type === 'police_cruiser') {
              const blink2 = Math.floor(g.frame / 8) % 2;
              ctx.fillStyle = blink2 ? '#ff2200' : '#0022ff';
              ctx.fillRect(vx - 5, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D - 3, 10, 3);
              ctx.shadowColor = blink2 ? '#ff2200' : '#0022ff'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
              ctx.fillRect(vx - 5, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D - 3, 10, 3);
              ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            }
            // Taxi sign
            if (type === 'taxi') {
              ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.font = '5px monospace'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.fillText('TAXI', vx, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D - 1);
            }
            // Headlights
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffee88';
            ctx.shadowColor = '#ffee88'; ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
            ctx.fillRect(vx + fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy - vh2 - 2, 2, 3);
            ctx.fillRect(vx + fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy + vh2 - 5, 2, 3);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            // Tail lights
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3333';
            ctx.fillRect(vx - fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy - vh2 + 1, 2, 3);
            ctx.fillRect(vx - fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy + vh2 - 5, 2, 3);
            // Wheels (larger for isometric feel)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vw2 * 0.65, vy + vh2 + 2, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vw2 * 0.65, vy + vh2 + 2, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vw2 * 0.65, vy + vh2 + 2, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vw2 * 0.65, vy + vh2 + 2, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          } else {
            // Vertical car
            ctx.fillStyle = sideFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx + vh2,              vy - vw2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy + vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2,              vy + vw2);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = roofFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx - vh2,              vy - vw2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2,              vy - vw2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx - vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = vc; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2, vy - vw2, vd.bodyH, vd.bodyW);
            ctx.fillStyle = vd.windowColor; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2 + 1, vy - vw2 * 0.3, vd.bodyH - 2, vd.bodyW * 0.45);
            ctx.fillStyle = va; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 4), vd.bodyH, 4);
            if (type === 'police_cruiser') {
              const blink2 = Math.floor(g.frame / 8) % 2;
              ctx.fillStyle = blink2 ? '#ff2200' : '#0022ff';
              ctx.fillRect(vx - 4, vy + fwdY * (vw2 + 2), 8, 3);
              ctx.shadowColor = blink2 ? '#ff2200' : '#0022ff'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
              ctx.fillRect(vx - 4, vy + fwdY * (vw2 + 2), 8, 3);
              ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffee88';
            ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2 + 1, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 2), 3, 2);
            ctx.fillRect(vx + vh2 - 4, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 2), 3, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vh2 - 2, vy + vw2 * 0.55, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vh2 + 2, vy + vw2 * 0.55, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vh2 - 2, vy + vw2 * 0.55, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vh2 + 2, vy + vw2 * 0.55, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        } else {
          // Truck / van — larger, boxier
          if (isHoriz) {
            // Side shadow face
            ctx.fillStyle = sideFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx + vw2,              vy - vh2 - bodyH3D);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy + vh2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2,              vy + vh2);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            // Roof face
            ctx.fillStyle = roofFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx - vw2,              vy - vh2 - bodyH3D);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2,              vy - vh2 - bodyH3D);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx - vw2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + isoDepthY);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = vc; ctx.fillRect(vx - vw2, vy - vh2 - bodyH3D, vd.bodyW, vd.bodyH + bodyH3D);
            // Cab front section
            ctx.fillStyle = va; ctx.fillRect(vx + fwdX * (vw2 - 7), vy - vh2 - bodyH3D, 7, vd.bodyH + bodyH3D);
            ctx.fillStyle = vd.windowColor; ctx.fillRect(vx + fwdX * (vw2 - 6), vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + 2, 5, bodyH3D - 2);
            // Cargo area marking
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.strokeRect(vx - vw2 + (fwdX < 0 ? 7 : 0), vy - vh2 - bodyH3D + 1, vd.bodyW - 7, vd.bodyH + bodyH3D - 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
            ctx.fillRect(vx + fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy - 3, 2, 3);
            ctx.fillRect(vx + fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy + 1, 2, 3);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3333'; ctx.fillRect(vx - fwdX * (vw2 - 1), vy - 2, 2, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vw2 * 0.62, vy + vh2 + 3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vw2 * 0.62, vy + vh2 + 3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = sideFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx + vh2,              vy - vw2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy + vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2,              vy + vw2);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = roofFace;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(vx - vh2,              vy - vw2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2,              vy - vw2);
            ctx.lineTo(vx + vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.lineTo(vx - vh2 + isoDepthX,  vy - vw2 + isoDepthY);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = vc; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2, vy - vw2, vd.bodyH, vd.bodyW);
            ctx.fillStyle = va; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 7), vd.bodyH, 7);
            ctx.fillStyle = vd.windowColor; ctx.fillRect(vx - vh2 + 1, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 6), vd.bodyH - 2, 5);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
            ctx.fillRect(vx - 3, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 1), 3, 2);
            ctx.fillRect(vx + 1, vy + fwdY * (vw2 - 1), 3, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx - vh2 - 2, vy + vw2 * 0.62, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(vx + vh2 + 2, vy + vw2 * 0.62, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
        }
      };

      // ── Parking spot markers ──
      for (let si = 0; si < PARKING_SPOTS.length; si++) {
        const sp = PARKING_SPOTS[si];
        const spx = sp.x + ox, spy = sp.y + oy;
        if (spx < -60 || spx > cw + 60 || spy < -40 || spy > ch + 40) continue;
        const spDist = Math.hypot(g.px - sp.x, g.py - sp.y);
        const spNear = spDist < PARKING_RANGE;
        const hasParked = g.parkedLoadout.some(pl => pl.spotIdx === si);
        ctx.strokeStyle = hasParked ? '#00ffcc' : 'rgba(0,200,255,0.3)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
        ctx.strokeRect(spx - 22, spy - 14, 44, 28);
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
        if (hasParked) {
          const pl = g.parkedLoadout.find(p => p.spotIdx === si)!;
          drawVehicleSprite(spx, spy, pl.type, 'right');
          if (spNear && !g.vehicle) {
            ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(0,255,204,.85)' : 'rgba(0,255,204,.3)';
            ctx.font = '11px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('[E] RETRIEVE', spx, spy - 20);
          }
        } else if (spNear && g.vehicle) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(0,255,204,.85)' : 'rgba(0,255,204,.3)';
          ctx.font = '11px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[P] PARK HERE', spx, spy - 20);
        }
        // Parking-lot place name intentionally omitted — recognised by the
        // marked bay art; only the functional [E]/[P] prompts above remain.
      }

      // ── Parked vehicles on streets ──
      for (const pv of g.parkedVehicles) {
        if (pv.stolen) continue;
        const pvx = pv.x + ox, pvy = pv.y + oy;
        if (pvx < -30 || pvx > cw + 30 || pvy < -20 || pvy > ch + 20) continue;
        const pvDist = Math.hypot(g.px - pv.x, g.py - pv.y);
        const pvNear = pvDist < STEAL_RANGE;
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ffaa00'; ctx.shadowBlur = pvNear ? 8 : 2;
        drawVehicleSprite(pvx, pvy, pv.type, 'right');
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        if (pvNear && !g.vehicle) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(255,204,0,.85)' : 'rgba(255,204,0,.3)';
          ctx.font = '12px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] STEAL', pvx, pvy - 14);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,204,0,.6)';
          ctx.fillText(getVehicleDef(pv.type).label, pvx, pvy - 26);
        }
      }

      // ── Exited vehicles in world ──
      for (const ev of g.exitedVehicles) {
        const evx = ev.x + ox, evy = ev.y + oy;
        if (evx < -30 || evx > cw + 30 || evy < -20 || evy > ch + 20) continue;
        const evDist = Math.hypot(g.px - ev.x, g.py - ev.y);
        const evNear = evDist < 30;
        ctx.shadowColor = '#00ffcc'; ctx.shadowBlur = evNear ? 6 : 1;
        drawVehicleSprite(evx, evy, ev.type, 'right');
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        if (evNear && !g.vehicle) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(0,255,200,.85)' : 'rgba(0,255,200,.3)';
          ctx.font = '12px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] ENTER', evx, evy - 14);
        }
      }

      // ── World event beacons drawn in world space ──────────────────────────
      for (const ev of activeWorldEventsRef.current) {
        const evwx = ev.locationX + ox, evwy = ev.locationY + oy;
        if (evwx < -60 || evwx > cw + 60 || evwy < -60 || evwy > ch + 60) continue;
        const evDist = Math.hypot(g.px - ev.locationX, g.py - ev.locationY);
        const evNearby = evDist < 96;
        const evPulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.12) * 0.5;
        const evCol = ev.eventType === 'evt_blackout' ? '#ffe04b' : ev.eventType === 'evt_fire' ? '#ff6622' : ev.eventType === 'evt_robbery' ? '#ff2233' : '#22ee88';
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowColor = evCol; ctx.shadowBlur = 10 * evPulse;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `${evCol}${Math.floor(evPulse * 200).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(evwx, evwy, 18 * evPulse, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = evCol;
        ctx.font = ev.eventType === 'evt_blackout' ? '18px monospace' : ev.eventType === 'evt_fire' ? '16px monospace' : '16px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText(ev.eventType === 'evt_blackout' ? '⚡' : ev.eventType === 'evt_fire' ? '🔥' : ev.eventType === 'evt_robbery' ? '🔴' : '⛑', evwx, evwy);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        if (evNearby && !channelBarRef.current && !frozenRef.current) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? evCol : `${evCol}88`;
          ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
          ctx.fillText('[E] RESPOND', evwx, evwy - 26);
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ── Collapsed peers — draw distress beacon ────────────────────────────
      if (g.collapsedPeers && g.collapsedPeers.length > 0) {
        const now2 = Date.now();
        g.collapsedPeers = (g.collapsedPeers as any[]).filter((p: any) => p.until > now2);
        for (const cp of g.collapsedPeers as any[]) {
          const cpx = cp.x + ox, cpy = cp.y + oy;
          if (cpx < -60 || cpx > cw + 60 || cpy < -60 || cpy > ch + 60) continue;
          const cpPulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.18) * 0.5;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#ff3322'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8 * cpPulse;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,50,34,${cpPulse})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cpx, cpy, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillText('💀', cpx, cpy);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8888'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
          ctx.fillText(cp.name, cpx, cpy - 18);
          const cpDist = Math.hypot(g.px - cp.x, g.py - cp.y);
          if (cpDist < 80 && !frozenRef.current) {
            ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#ff5544' : 'rgba(255,85,68,.5)';
            ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('[E] REVIVE', cpx, cpy - 28);
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // ── Ambient traffic vehicles ──
      for (const tv of g.trafficVehicles) {
        const tvx = tv.x + ox, tvy = tv.y + oy;
        if (tvx < -30 || tvx > cw + 30 || tvy < -20 || tvy > ch + 20) continue;
        const tvFacing: 'left'|'right'|'up'|'down' = Math.abs(tv.dx) >= Math.abs(tv.dy)
          ? (tv.dx >= 0 ? 'right' : 'left')
          : (tv.dy >= 0 ? 'down' : 'up');
        drawVehicleSprite(tvx, tvy, tv.type, tvFacing, tv.color);
      }

      // ── Neon signs ──
      for (const ns of NEON_SIGNS) {
        const nsx = ns.x + ox, nsy = ns.y + oy;
        if (nsx < -60 || nsx > cw + 60 || nsy < -20 || nsy > ch + 20) continue;
        const flicker = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.15 + ns.x * 0.03) > -0.7 ? 1 : (Math.sin(g.frame * 0.5 + ns.x * 0.02) * 0.5 + 0.5);
        const nAlpha = flicker * (isNight ? 0.9 : 0.5);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = nAlpha;
        ctx.shadowColor = ns.color; ctx.shadowBlur = isNight ? 12 : 4;
        ctx.fillStyle = ns.color;
        ctx.fillRect(nsx - ns.w / 2, nsy - 4, ns.w, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
        ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(ns.text, nsx, nsy + 2);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ── Dystopian dressing — salvaged ad boards / displays / flyers / banners ──
      for (let dsi = 0; dsi < DYSTOPIAN_SIGNS.length; dsi++) {
        const ds = DYSTOPIAN_SIGNS[dsi];
        const dsx = ds.x + ox, dsy = ds.y + oy;
        if (dsx < -120 || dsx > cw + 120 || dsy < -120 || dsy > ch + 120) continue;
        const lit = isNight ? 1 : 0.62;
        ctx.save();
        if (ds.kind === 'flyer') {
          // Stapled paper flyer — slight skew, no glow, hand-typed text.
          const fh = 8 + ds.lines.length * 7;
          ctx.globalAlpha = isNight ? 0.7 : 0.85;
          ctx.fillStyle = ds.color;
          ctx.save(); ctx.translate(dsx, dsy); ctx.rotate(Math.sin(ds.x * 0.3) * 0.05);
          ctx.fillRect(-ds.w / 2, -fh / 2, ds.w, fh);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,30,20,.75)';
          ctx.fillRect(-ds.w / 2, -fh / 2, ds.w, 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,18,14,.9)'; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ds.lines.forEach((ln, li) => ctx.fillText(ln, 0, -fh / 2 + 9 + li * 7));
          // staples
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,120,130,.7)';
          ctx.fillRect(-ds.w / 2 + 2, -fh / 2 + 1, 2, 1); ctx.fillRect(ds.w / 2 - 4, -fh / 2 + 1, 2, 1);
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (ds.kind === 'banner') {
          // Sagging cloth banner strung between two poles.
          const sag = 4;
          ctx.globalAlpha = isNight ? 0.85 : 0.6;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,55,50,.8)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dsx - ds.w / 2, dsy - 6); ctx.lineTo(dsx - ds.w / 2, dsy + 8); ctx.moveTo(dsx + ds.w / 2, dsy - 6); ctx.lineTo(dsx + ds.w / 2, dsy + 8); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(18,16,20,.82)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(dsx - ds.w / 2, dsy - 4); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(dsx, dsy - 4 + sag, dsx + ds.w / 2, dsy - 4);
          ctx.lineTo(dsx + ds.w / 2, dsy + 6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(dsx, dsy + 6 + sag, dsx - ds.w / 2, dsy + 6);
          ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.globalAlpha = lit; ctx.shadowColor = ds.color; ctx.shadowBlur = isNight ? 8 : 2;
          ctx.fillStyle = ds.color; ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(ds.lines[0], dsx, dsy + 3 + sag * 0.5);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        } else if (ds.kind === 'display') {
          // Wall-mounted information display with a salvaged metal housing.
          const ch2 = 10 + ds.lines.length * 8;
          // salvaged metal housing
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(26,24,22,.95)';
          ctx.fillRect(dsx - ds.w / 2 - 3, dsy - ch2 / 2 - 3, ds.w + 6, ch2 + 6);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,8,.98)';
          ctx.fillRect(dsx - ds.w / 2, dsy - ch2 / 2, ds.w, ch2);
          ctx.globalAlpha = lit;
          ctx.fillStyle = ds.color; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ds.lines.forEach((ln, li) => ctx.fillText(ln, dsx, dsy - ch2 / 2 + 9 + li * 8));
          // dangling power wire
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,38,36,.9)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dsx + ds.w / 2 - 2, dsy + ch2 / 2);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(dsx + ds.w / 2 + 4, dsy + ch2 / 2 + 8, dsx + ds.w / 2 - 1, dsy + ch2 / 2 + 14); ctx.stroke();
        } else {
          // Big billboard on a strut — plywood + salvaged tube lighting + cables.
          const bh = 12 + ds.lines.length * 9;
          // support strut
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,28,26,.95)';
          ctx.fillRect(dsx - 2, dsy + bh / 2, 4, 26);
          // board backing
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(22,20,18,.96)';
          ctx.fillRect(dsx - ds.w / 2 - 2, dsy - bh / 2 - 2, ds.w + 4, bh + 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,13,12,.98)';
          ctx.fillRect(dsx - ds.w / 2, dsy - bh / 2, ds.w, bh);
          // tube light frame
          ctx.globalAlpha = lit;
          ctx.shadowColor = ds.color; ctx.shadowBlur = isNight ? 11 : 4;
          ctx.strokeStyle = ds.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.strokeRect(dsx - ds.w / 2 + 1, dsy - bh / 2 + 1, ds.w - 2, bh - 2);
          // text
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,250,235,.92)'; ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ds.lines.forEach((ln, li) => {
            ctx.fillStyle = li === 0 ? ds.color : 'rgba(255,250,235,.9)';
            ctx.fillText(ln, dsx, dsy - bh / 2 + 10 + li * 9);
          });
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          // exposed cable draped across the top
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(45,42,40,.9)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dsx - ds.w / 2, dsy - bh / 2);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(dsx, dsy - bh / 2 - 6, dsx + ds.w / 2, dsy - bh / 2 + 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ── Steam/smoke vents ──
      for (let vi = 0; vi < STEAM_VENTS.length; vi++) {
        const sv = STEAM_VENTS[vi];
        const svx = sv.x + ox, svy = sv.y + oy;
        if (svx < -20 || svx > cw + 20 || svy < -20 || svy > ch + 20) continue;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
        ctx.fillRect(svx - 3, svy - 2, 6, 4);
        for (let pi = 0; pi < 3; pi++) {
          const t3 = ((g.frame * 0.012 + vi * 0.4 + pi * 0.33) % 1);
          const sy3 = svy - 4 - t3 * 28;
          const sx3 = svx + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.04 + vi + pi) * 4;
          const sa = (1 - t3) * 0.35;
          const sz = 2 + t3 * 6;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,200,210,${sa})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx3, sy3, sz, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      // ── Debris particles ──
      for (const dp of g.debrisParticles) {
        const dpx = dp.x + ox, dpy = dp.y + oy;
        if (dpx < -5 || dpx > cw + 5 || dpy < -5 || dpy > ch + 5) continue;
        const da = (dp.life / dp.maxLife) * 0.7;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = da;
        ctx.fillStyle = dp.col;
        ctx.fillRect(dpx - dp.size / 2, dpy - dp.size / 2, dp.size, dp.size);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ── Campsite rendering — flickering fire + glow halo ──
      if (campsitePos) {
        const cx = campsitePos.x + ox, cy = campsitePos.y + oy;
        // warm ground halo
        const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy + 4, 6, cx, cy + 4, 48);
        halo.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,160,40,.35)');
        halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,160,40,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = halo;
        ctx.fillRect(cx - 48, cy - 44, 96, 96);
        // log ring
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(60,35,15,.9)';
        ctx.fillRect(cx - 14, cy + 6, 28, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(cx - 12, cy + 10, 24, 3);
        // flame — two triangles with flicker
        const flick = 1 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.25) * 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.08;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,180,40,.85)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - 16 * flick); ctx.lineTo(cx - 10, cy + 6); ctx.lineTo(cx + 10, cy + 6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,180,.8)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - 9 * flick); ctx.lineTo(cx - 5, cy + 6); ctx.lineTo(cx + 5, cy + 6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        if (campsiteTurret) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,200,255,.6)';
          ctx.fillRect(cx + 16, cy - 4, 4, 10);
          ctx.fillRect(cx + 14, cy - 6, 8, 3);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,80,.55)';
        ctx.font = '10px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('CAMPFIRE', cx, cy - 22);
        const campDist = Math.hypot(g.px - campsitePos.x, g.py - campsitePos.y);
        if (campDist < 80) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,80,.7)';
          ctx.font = '11px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.fillText('[E] CAMP MENU', cx, cy + 22);
        }
      }

      // ── Ambient radio spots ──
      for (const ar of AMBIENT_RADIO_SPOTS) {
        const arx = ar.x + ox, ary = ar.y + oy;
        const arDist = Math.hypot(g.px - ar.x, g.py - ar.y);
        const arAlpha = arDist < 200 ? 0.6 : 0.2;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,200,255,${arAlpha})`;
        ctx.fillRect(arx - 5, ary - 5, 10, 10);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,200,255,${arAlpha * 0.7})`;
        ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('♫', arx, ary - 8);
        if (arDist < 200) {
          sfxAmbientRadio(g.px, g.py, ar.x, ar.y);
        }
      }

      // NPCs — enhanced pixel sprite bodies with walk animation & accessories
      // worldTime is now a continuous real-dt float mirrored from the calendar,
      // so it's already smooth — no sub-tick interpolation needed.
      const worldTimeFine = ((g.worldTime ?? 0) % 24 + 24) % 24;
      // Precompute per-NPC variety seeds for accessories, skin, body type
      const npcVariety = (ni: number) => {
        const s1 = Math.sin(ni * 17.31) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        const s2 = Math.sin(ni * 43.17 + 1) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        const s3 = Math.sin(ni * 7.77 + 2) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        return { s1, s2, s3 };
      };
      const SKIN_TONES = ['#c8906c', '#a06848', '#d4a87a', '#8a5840', '#e0b890', '#7a4830'];
      for (let ni = 0; ni < NPCS.length; ni++) {
        const n = NPCS[ni];
        const isFleeing = n.reactState === 'FLEEING';
        const isSpectating = n.reactState === 'SPECTATING';
        // Determine phase for visibility/nudge logic
        const npcPhase = getNpcPhaseForNpc(n, worldTimeFine);
        // NPCs in "home" or "work" phase are inside buildings — hide them on the world map.
        // Outdoor-only roles (gang_patrol, police, corpo_military, blade_runner) patrol streets
        // even during their 'work' phase, so only hide them during 'home' (sleeping) phase.
        const isOutdoorRole = n.role === 'gang_patrol' || n.role === 'police' || n.role === 'corpo_military' || n.role === 'blade_runner';
        const hideOnMap = !isFleeing && !isSpectating && (
          npcPhase === 'home' || (npcPhase === 'work' && !isOutdoorRole)
        );
        if (hideOnMap) continue;
        let sPos = (isFleeing || isSpectating) ? { x: n.x, y: n.y } : getNpcSchedulePos(n, worldTimeFine);
        // For outdoor phases (or outdoor roles), nudge position out of building footprints
        const schedForNudge = getCachedSchedule(n);
        if (!isFleeing && !isSpectating && (npcPhase === 'wander' || npcPhase === 'commute_work' || npcPhase === 'commute_home' || schedForNudge.isErratic || isOutdoorRole)) {
          const BPAD = 6;
          for (const bld of BUILDINGS) {
            const bx1 = bld.x - BPAD, by1 = bld.y - BPAD, bx2 = bld.x + bld.w + BPAD, by2 = bld.y + bld.h + BPAD;
            if (sPos.x >= bx1 && sPos.x <= bx2 && sPos.y >= by1 && sPos.y <= by2) {
              // Nudge to nearest edge
              const dLeft = sPos.x - bx1, dRight = bx2 - sPos.x, dTop = sPos.y - by1, dBottom = by2 - sPos.y;
              const minD = Math.min(dLeft, dRight, dTop, dBottom);
              if (minD === dLeft) sPos = { x: bx1 - 1, y: sPos.y };
              else if (minD === dRight) sPos = { x: bx2 + 1, y: sPos.y };
              else if (minD === dTop) sPos = { x: sPos.x, y: by1 - 1 };
              else sPos = { x: sPos.x, y: by2 + 1 };
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        const nx2 = sPos.x + ox, ny2 = sPos.y + oy;
        if (nx2 < -14 || nx2 > cw + 14 || ny2 < -14 || ny2 > ch + 14) continue;
        const nDist = Math.hypot(g.px - sPos.x, g.py - sPos.y);
        const isNearNpc = nDist < NPC_RANGE;
        const gangPatrolColor = n.role === 'gang_patrol' ? (n.faction === 'rust_syndicate' ? '#ff3c3c' : n.faction === 'void_runners' ? '#ff8c00' : n.faction === 'static_monks' ? '#c8ff00' : n.faction === 'eastern_bloc' ? '#3c64ff' : '#888888') : null;
        const nCol = isFleeing ? '#ff4444' : isSpectating ? '#ffaa00' : gangPatrolColor ?? (n.role === 'blade_runner' ? '#cc44ff' : n.role === 'police' ? '#4488ff' : n.role === 'corpo_military' ? '#ff6644' : (NPC_COL[n.type] ?? '#7dd3fc'));
        ctx.shadowColor = nCol; ctx.shadowBlur = isNearNpc ? 6 : 0;
        const isFemale = (n as { gender?: string }).gender === 'f';
        const idle = n.idleBehavior ?? 'WALKING';
        const nv = npcVariety(ni);
        const skinTone = SKIN_TONES[Math.floor(nv.s1 * SKIN_TONES.length)];
        // Multi-frame walk cycle
        const isMoving = idle === 'WALKING' || isFleeing;
        const walkPhase = isMoving ? (g.frame * 0.12 + ni * 1.3) : 0;
        const nLLeg = isMoving ? Math.sin(walkPhase) * 3 : 0;
        const nRLeg = -nLLeg;
        const nBob = isMoving ? Math.abs(Math.sin(walkPhase)) * 1 : Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05 + ni) * 0.5;
        // Body proportions variation
        const bodyW = 7 + Math.floor(nv.s2 * 3);
        const headR = 2.5 + nv.s3 * 0.8;
        // Soft contact shadow at the feet — two stacked ellipses fake a soft
        // penumbra so NPCs sit on the ground. Opacity scales with time of day
        // and the throw is nudged down-right to match the upper-left key light;
        // shadowBlur is cleared so the ground shadow never picks up neon glow.
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        const nsa = 0.30 * dayBright;
        // Sun-driven throw: nudge toward the shadow direction and stretch with
        // the shadow length so feet shadows sweep & lengthen at dawn/dusk.
        const nox = shadowDX * 2.5;
        const nsl = 0.85 + sky.shadow.len * 0.2;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${nsa * 0.5})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(nx2 + 1 + nox, ny2 + 8.5, 6.5 * nsl, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${nsa})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(nx2 + 1 + nox, ny2 + 8, 5 * nsl, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        // Faction-aware clothing colors (computed once, used in all idle branches)
        const npcNType = n.type ?? 'human';
