        const npcIsCorpType = npcNType === 'corp' || n.role === 'corpo_worker' || n.role === 'corpo_military';
        const npcIsOutlawType = n.role === 'gang_patrol' || n.role === 'homeless' || npcNType === 'mutant';
        const npcBodyCol = npcIsCorpType ? '#1e1e2e' : npcIsOutlawType ? (nv.s2 > 0.5 ? '#6b4a28' : '#5a3d22') : (nv.s3 > 0.5 ? '#3a4a5a' : (nv.s3 > 0.25 ? '#4a3a55' : '#2e3a2e'));
        const npcLegCol = npcIsCorpType ? '#111111' : npcIsOutlawType ? '#3d2010' : (nv.s2 > 0.6 ? '#2a3d6b' : '#334466');
        if (idle === 'SITTING' && !isFleeing) {
          ctx.fillStyle = skinTone; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx2, ny2 - 4, headR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = npcBodyCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 3, ny2 - 1, 6, 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = npcLegCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 + 3, 8, 3);
          ctx.fillStyle = npcIsCorpType ? '#888877' : '#443322'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 6, ny2 + 2, 12, 3);
          if (npcIsCorpType) { ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1111'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 1, 2, 3); }
        } else if (idle === 'EATING' && !isFleeing) {
          ctx.fillStyle = skinTone; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx2, ny2 - 7, headR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = npcBodyCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 - 4, bodyW, 6);
          if (npcIsCorpType) { ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 3, 2, 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1111'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 1, 2, 4); }
          ctx.fillStyle = npcLegCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 + 2, 3, 5);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc88'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 4, ny2 - 4, 4, 3);
        } else if (idle === 'BROWSING' && !isFleeing) {
          ctx.fillStyle = skinTone; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx2, ny2 - 7, headR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = npcBodyCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 - 4, bodyW, 6);
          if (npcIsCorpType) { ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 3, 2, 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1111'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 1, 2, 4); }
          ctx.fillStyle = npcLegCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 + 2, 3, 5);
          const browseBob = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05 + ni) * 2;
          ctx.fillStyle = skinTone; ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 5, ny2 - 3 + browseBob, 2, 4);
        } else if (idle === 'TALKING' && !isFleeing) {
          ctx.fillStyle = skinTone; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx2, ny2 - 7, headR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = npcBodyCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 - 4, bodyW, 6);
          if (npcIsCorpType) { ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 3, 2, 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1111'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 1, 2, 4); }
          ctx.fillStyle = npcLegCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 + 2, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 + 2, 3, 5);
          if (g.frame % 60 < 30) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.5)'; ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('...', nx2 + 8, ny2 - 12);
          }
        } else {
          // Walking or default — faction-aware clothing (android/replicant NPCs look civilian)
          if (npcIsCorpType) {
            // Corporate suit — dark jacket, dress trousers — same for all genders
            ctx.fillStyle = '#111111'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 + 2 + nLLeg, 3, 6); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 + 2 + nRLeg, 3, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1e1e2e'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - Math.floor(bodyW / 2), ny2 - 4 + nBob, bodyW, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 3 + nBob, 2, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1111'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 1 + nBob, 2, 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1e1e2e'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - bodyW / 2 - 2, ny2 - 2 + nRLeg * 0.5, 2, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + bodyW / 2 + 1, ny2 - 2 + nLLeg * 0.5, 2, 5);
          } else if (npcIsOutlawType) {
            // Wasteland rags — dusty canvas/leather, same for all genders
            const ragCol = nv.s2 > 0.5 ? '#6b4a28' : '#5a3d22';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3d2010'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 + 2 + nLLeg, 3, 6); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 + 2 + nRLeg, 3, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = ragCol; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - Math.floor(bodyW / 2), ny2 - 4 + nBob, bodyW, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3020'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - bodyW / 2 - 2, ny2 - 2 + nRLeg * 0.5, 2, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + bodyW / 2 + 1, ny2 - 2 + nLLeg * 0.5, 2, 5);
          } else {
            // Civilian clothes — hoodie/top + jeans — same for all genders (humans and replicant NPCs)
            const civJeans = nv.s2 > 0.6 ? '#2a3d6b' : (nv.s2 > 0.3 ? '#334466' : '#3a3a4a');
            const civTop = nv.s3 > 0.5 ? '#3a4a5a' : (nv.s3 > 0.25 ? '#4a3a55' : '#2e3a2e');
            ctx.fillStyle = civJeans; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 + 2 + nLLeg, 3, 6); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 + 2 + nRLeg, 3, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = civTop; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - Math.floor(bodyW / 2), ny2 - 4 + nBob, bodyW, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = civTop; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - bodyW / 2 - 2, ny2 - 2 + nRLeg * 0.5, 2, 5); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + bodyW / 2 + 1, ny2 - 2 + nLLeg * 0.5, 2, 5);
          }
          // Head
          ctx.fillStyle = skinTone; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx2, ny2 - 7 + nBob, headR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          // Hair styles — variety based on NPC seed
          const hairStyle = Math.floor(nv.s2 * 5);
          const hairCols = ['#1a0800', '#5a3010', '#c09050', '#ee2222', '#aaaaaa'];
          const hairCol = hairCols[Math.floor(nv.s3 * hairCols.length)];
          ctx.fillStyle = hairCol;
          if (hairStyle === 0) { ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 3, ny2 - 12 + nBob, 6, 3); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx2, ny2 - 12 + nBob, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
          else if (hairStyle === 1) { ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 - 13 + nBob, 8, 4); }
          else if (hairStyle === 2) { ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 3, ny2 - 10 + nBob, 6, 2); }
          else if (hairStyle === 3) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 11 + nBob, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.arc(nx2 + 2, ny2 - 11 + nBob, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
          // else 4 = bald/shaved (no hair drawn)
        }

        // Faction accessories & detail
        if (n.role === 'police') {
          // Badge flash
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 5, 2, 3);
        } else if (n.role === 'corpo_military') {
          // Shoulder armor plates
          ctx.fillStyle = '#884422'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 7, ny2 - 6, 3, 4); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 4, ny2 - 6, 3, 4);
        } else if (n.role === 'gang_patrol') {
          // Gang bandana / scarf
          const gangScarf = gangPatrolColor ?? '#888';
          ctx.fillStyle = gangScarf; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 2, ny2 - 5, 4, 2);
        } else if (n.role === 'blade_runner') {
          // Visor
          ctx.fillStyle = '#cc44ff'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 3, ny2 - 8, 6, 2);
        } else if (n.role === 'homeless') {
          // Ragged outer layer
          ctx.fillStyle = '#887755'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 6, ny2 - 4, 1, 8); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 5, ny2 - 4, 1, 8);
        } else if (npcIsCorpType) {
          // Corporate ID badge clipped to lapel
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ccddee'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 2, ny2 - 7, 3, 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#3366ff'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 3, ny2 - 6, 1, 2);
          // Briefcase detail (carried low, varies by seed)
          if (nv.s2 > 0.5) { ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2a'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 9, ny2 + 1, 5, 4); ctx.fillStyle = '#888877'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 8, ny2 + 2, 3, 1); }
        } else if (npcIsOutlawType) {
          // Goggles or head wrap based on seed
          if (nv.s1 > 0.5) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2808'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 - 10, 8, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#886622'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 3, ny2 - 11, 6, 1);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#cc8800'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 3, ny2 - 9, 6, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 2, ny2 - 8, 2, 1); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 - 8, 2, 1);
          }
        } else if (nv.s1 > 0.7) {
          // Random accessory: hat
          ctx.fillStyle = nv.s2 > 0.5 ? '#334455' : '#553322';
          ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 - 12, 8, 2);
        } else if (nv.s1 > 0.5 && nv.s2 > 0.6) {
          // Glasses
          ctx.fillStyle = '#556688'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 4, ny2 - 8, 3, 2); ctx.fillRect(nx2 + 1, ny2 - 8, 3, 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#335577'; ctx.fillRect(nx2 - 1, ny2 - 7, 2, 1);
        }

        if (isFleeing) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,68,68,.7)'; ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('!', nx2, ny2 - 16);
        }
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // Name label — names are PRIVATE. Default shows the role; the real name
        // reveals when you stand near (talk range) or hover. Primes show gold names.
        if (nDist < 90) {
          const npcPrime = isPrimeName(n.name);
          const npcHover = !!(hoverMouseRef.current && Math.hypot(sPos.x - hoverMouseRef.current.x, sPos.y - hoverMouseRef.current.y) < 16);
          const reveal = npcPrime || npcHover || isNearNpc;
          const nm = reveal ? n.name : (n.role ?? 'civilian').replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase();
          ctx.font = `${reveal ? 'bold ' : ''}13px "Fira Code"`;
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          const tw = ctx.measureText(nm).width;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          const pillY = ny2 - 28, pillH = 16, pillR = 4;
          ctx.roundRect(nx2 - tw / 2 - 5, pillY, tw + 10, pillH, pillR);
          ctx.fill();
          if (npcPrime) { ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,200,60,.85)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,80,.97)'; }
          else if (npcHover) { ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(56,189,248,.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 7; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(236,246,255,.98)'; }
          else { ctx.fillStyle = isNearNpc ? nCol : 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)'; }
          ctx.fillText(nm, nx2, ny2 - 16);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }
        if (isNearNpc && !nb) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.85)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)';
          ctx.font = '13px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E]', nx2, ny2 - 32);
        }
        if (nDist < 120 && nDist > 40) {
          const twText = getTypewriterText(ni);
          if (twText) {
            const rumorAlpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.03 + ni) * 0.2;
            const rumorY = ny2 - 42 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.02 + ni * 2) * 2;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,220,100,${rumorAlpha})`;
            ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(`"${twText}"`, nx2, rumorY);
          } else if (g.rumorCooldown <= 0) {
            const gossip = getNearbyGossip(sPos.x, sPos.y, g.frame);
            if (gossip) {
              startTypewriter(gossip, ni, g.frame);
            } else {
              const ctxWhisper = getNpcContextualWhisper(n, g.worldTime ?? 0);
              startTypewriter(ctxWhisper, ni, g.frame);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      g.nearEmployee = null;
      for (let ei = 0; ei < g.employeeNpcs.length; ei++) {
        const emp = g.employeeNpcs[ei];
        const ex = emp.x + ox, ey = emp.y + oy;
        if (ex < -40 || ex > cw + 40 || ey < -40 || ey > ch + 40) continue;
        const eDist = Math.hypot(emp.x - g.px, emp.y - g.py);
        const isNearEmp = eDist < 40;
        if (isNearEmp) g.nearEmployee = ei;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00ccff';
        ctx.fillRect(ex - 5, ey - 14, 10, 14);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00ccff';
        ctx.fillRect(ex - 3, ey - 18, 6, 4);
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        const empLabel = `${emp.name} [${emp.role}]`;
        const etw = ctx.measureText(empLabel).width;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.6)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(ex - etw / 2 - 4, ey - 30, etw + 8, 12, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = isNearEmp ? '#00ffff' : 'rgba(0,200,255,.6)';
        ctx.fillText(empLabel, ex, ey - 20);
        if (isNearEmp) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(0,200,255,.85)' : 'rgba(0,200,255,.3)';
          ctx.font = '13px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E]', ex, ey - 36);
        }
      }

      // Online players — faction-specific sprites (skip peers in interiors)
      for (const [, op] of g.peers) {
        if (op.interiorBid) continue;
        const px2 = op.x + ox, py2 = op.y + oy;
        if (px2 < -20 || px2 > cw + 20 || py2 < -20 || py2 > ch + 20) continue;
        const spk = g.speakingSet.has(op.id);
        const opSleeping = op.sleeping ?? op.paused ?? false;
        const opCls = (op.class ?? '').toLowerCase();
        const opGlow = opCls === 'corporate' ? '#38bdf8' : opCls === 'outlaw' ? '#7dd3fc' : opCls === 'replicant' ? '#aaaacc' : '#44aaff';
        if (spk) { ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,255,180,.6)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 10; }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px2, py2 + 7, 5, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        if (opSleeping) {
          drawSleepingPeer(ctx, px2, py2, g.blink ? 1 : 0, 1);
        } else if (opCls === 'corporate') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a2a'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 4, py2 + 2, 3, 4); ctx.fillRect(px2 + 1, py2 + 2, 3, 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#333333'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 6, py2 - 7, 12, 8);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#cc0000'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 1, py2 - 5, 2, 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#d4906a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px2, py2 - 12, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        } else if (opCls === 'outlaw') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#5a4433'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 4, py2 + 2, 3, 4); ctx.fillRect(px2 + 1, py2 + 2, 3, 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#6b5533'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 6, py2 - 7, 12, 8);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7744'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 7, py2 - 8, 14, 3);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#d4906a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px2, py2 - 12, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        } else if (opCls === 'replicant') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3d6b'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 4, py2 + 2, 3, 4); ctx.fillRect(px2 + 1, py2 + 2, 3, 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4a5a'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 6, py2 - 7, 12, 8);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#2e3d4a'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 3, py2 - 7, 6, 3);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#d4906a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px2, py2 - 12, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = spk ? '#00ffcc' : '#44aaff';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px2, py2 - 9); ctx.lineTo(px2 + 6, py2 + 5); ctx.lineTo(px2 - 6, py2 + 5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        }
        if (spk) {
          const t = g.frame * 0.1;
          for (let ri = 0; ri < 3; ri++) {
            const phase = (t + ri * 0.7) % 2.1;
            const radius = 8 + phase * 10;
            const alpha = Math.max(0, 0.6 - phase * 0.28);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,255,180,${alpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px2, py2 - 6, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc';
          ctx.font = 'bold 9px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('\u266A', px2 + 10, py2 - 18);
        }
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        if (opSleeping) {
          const sleepPulse = 0.35 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08) * 0.18;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(125,211,252,${sleepPulse})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px2, py2 + 4, 18, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.font = 'bold 13px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        const opNm = op.name;
        const opTw = ctx.measureText(opNm).width;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(px2 - opTw / 2 - 5, py2 - 24, opTw + 10, 16, 4); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = spk ? '#00ffcc' : opGlow;
        ctx.fillText(opNm, px2, py2 - 12);
        if (op.hp !== undefined && op.maxHp && op.maxHp > 0) {
          const barW = 22, barH = 3, barY = py2 - 28;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.6)'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - barW / 2, barY, barW, barH);
          const hpPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, op.hp / op.maxHp));
          ctx.fillStyle = hpPct > 0.5 ? '#4ade80' : hpPct > 0.25 ? '#ffaa00' : '#ff3333';
          ctx.fillRect(px2 - barW / 2, barY, barW * hpPct, barH);
        }
        // Proximity dialog bubble — shown at any distance (we're already on-screen
        // here) unless the speaker is privacy-shrouded (interior peers are skipped
        // above, so outdoor speech is always visible).
        const opBub = g.bubbles.get(op.id);
        if (opBub && opBub.expiry > Date.now()) {
          // Distance fall-off — far speakers fade so nearby voices read clearest,
          // plus a short fade-out as the bubble expires.
          const bDist = Math.hypot(g.px - op.x, g.py - op.y);
          const distA = bDist <= 320 ? 1 : Math.max(0.22, 1 - (bDist - 320) / 1100);
          const life = opBub.expiry - Date.now();
          const timeA = life < 700 ? Math.max(0, life / 700) : 1;
          drawSpeechBubble(ctx, px2, py2 - 30,
            translationConversationRef.current && opBub.translated ? opBub.translated : opBub.text,
            distA * timeA);
        }
      }

      // Local player's own proximity bubble (world speech echoes back as proximity_chat).
      {
        const myBub = g.myId ? g.bubbles.get(g.myId) : undefined;
        if (myBub && myBub.expiry > Date.now()) {
          drawSpeechBubble(
            ctx,
            g.px + ox,
            g.py + oy - 30,
            translationConversationRef.current && myBub.translated ? myBub.translated : myBub.text,
          );
        }
      }

      // Periodic GC so expired bubbles don't accumulate over a long session
      // (player_left only prunes departed peers; speakers who stay never clean up).
      if (g.frame % 120 === 0) {
        const nowB = Date.now();
        for (const [bid, b] of g.bubbles) if (b.expiry <= nowB) g.bubbles.delete(bid);
      }

      // ── Banco Ombra collector NPC sprites ────────────────────────────────
      for (let bci = 0; bci < g.boCollectors.length; bci++) {
        const bc = g.boCollectors[bci];
        const bcsx = bc.x + ox, bcsy = bc.y + oy;
        if (bcsx < -30 || bcsx > cw + 30 || bcsy < -30 || bcsy > ch + 30) continue;
        const boWalk = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.18 + bci * 2.3) * 0.5;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowColor = '#440011'; ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
        // Head — skin tone
        ctx.fillStyle = '#d4956a';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bcsx, bcsy - 10, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        // Hair — slicked back dark
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a00';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 3, bcsy - 14, 6, 3);
        // Dark charcoal suit jacket
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a2a';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 4, bcsy - 6, 8, 7);
        // White dress shirt / collar
        ctx.fillStyle = '#eeeeee';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 1, bcsy - 6, 2, 4);
        // Red tie
        ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1100';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 0.5, bcsy - 5, 1, 5);
        // Jacket lapels (dark grey)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 4, bcsy - 6, 2, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx + 2, bcsy - 6, 2, 4);
        // Legs — dark trousers, slight walk bob
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 4, bcsy + 1, 3, 5 + boWalk);
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx + 1, bcsy + 1, 3, 5 - boWalk);
        // Shoes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a0a';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 5, bcsy + 6 + boWalk, 4, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx + 1, bcsy + 6 - boWalk, 4, 2);
        // Briefcase — carried in right hand
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aa8800';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx + 4, bcsy - 5, 6, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#886600';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx + 5, bcsy - 7, 4, 2); // handle
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc33';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx + 6, bcsy - 4, 1.5, 2.5); // clasp
        // Pocket square (white)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fillRect(bcsx - 3, bcsy - 5, 1.5, 1);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // Ambient red threat glow when close
        const boDist2 = Math.hypot(g.px - bc.x, g.py - bc.y);
        if (boDist2 < 200) {
          const boAlpha = Math.max(0, (1 - boDist2 / 200) * 0.18);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,0,0,${boAlpha})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bcsx, bcsy - 4, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
        // Label when close enough to see
        if (boDist2 < 180) {
          ctx.font = '11px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          const boLabel = g.interior ? 'STANDING BY' : 'BANCO OMBRA';
          const boTw = ctx.measureText(boLabel).width;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.7)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(bcsx - boTw / 2 - 5, bcsy - 28, boTw + 10, 14, 3); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = g.interior ? '#888888' : '#ff3333';
          ctx.fillText(boLabel, bcsx, bcsy - 18);
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ── Police patrol units ────────────────────────────────────────────────
      for (let pi = 0; pi < g.police.length; pi++) {
        const p = g.police[pi];
        const px2 = p.x + ox, py2 = p.y + oy;
        if (px2 < -20 || px2 > cw + 20 || py2 < -20 || py2 > ch + 20) continue;
        const pFlash = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.2 + pi * 1.7) > 0;
        ctx.shadowColor = pFlash ? '#4488ff' : '#ff3333'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
        // Police body — blue uniform
        ctx.fillStyle = '#cc9966'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px2, py2 - 8, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); // head
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1144cc'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 4, py2 - 5, 8, 6); // torso
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0d3399'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 4, py2 + 1, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(px2 + 1, py2 + 1, 3, 5); // legs
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe066'; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 2, py2 - 4, 4, 2); // badge
        // Light bar flicker
        const lb1 = pFlash ? '#4488ff' : '#ff2222';
        const lb2 = pFlash ? '#ff2222' : '#4488ff';
        ctx.fillStyle = lb1; ctx.fillRect(px2 - 5, py2 - 13, 4, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = lb2; ctx.fillRect(px2 + 1, py2 - 13, 4, 3);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        // Label
        const pDist = Math.hypot(g.px - p.x, g.py - p.y);
        if (pDist < 100) {
          ctx.font = '13px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          const pTw = ctx.measureText('POLICE').width;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(px2 - pTw / 2 - 5, py2 - 30, pTw + 10, 16, 4); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#88aaff';
          ctx.fillText('POLICE', px2, py2 - 18);
        }
      }

      // ── Patrol Band members ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      for (const band of g.bands) {
        for (const m of band.members) {
          if (m.dead) continue;
          const mx2 = m.x + ox, my2 = m.y + oy;
          if (mx2 < -20 || mx2 > cw + 20 || my2 < -20 || my2 > ch + 20) continue;
          const attacking = m.attackCd > 20;
          ctx.save();
          if (attacking) { ctx.shadowColor = band.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; }
          ctx.fillStyle = '#cc9966'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx2, my2 - 8, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = band.color; ctx.fillRect(mx2 - 3, my2 - 5, 6, 5);
          ctx.fillStyle = band.color; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7; ctx.fillRect(mx2 - 3, my2, 2.5, 4); ctx.fillRect(mx2 + 0.5, my2, 2.5, 4); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          if (m.weapon === 'ranged') {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#dddddd'; ctx.fillRect(mx2 + 3, my2 - 4, 5, 1.5);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa'; ctx.fillRect(mx2 + 3, my2 - 6, 1.5, 6);
          }
          if (m.hp < m.maxHp) {
            const hpPct = m.hp / m.maxHp;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; ctx.fillRect(mx2 - 6, my2 - 14, 12, 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = hpPct > 0.5 ? '#4ade80' : hpPct > 0.25 ? '#ffaa00' : '#ff4444';
            ctx.fillRect(mx2 - 6, my2 - 14, 12 * hpPct, 2);
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }
        const alive = band.members.filter(m => !m.dead);
        if (alive.length > 0) {
          const avgX = alive.reduce((s, m) => s + m.x, 0) / alive.length + ox;
          const avgY = alive.reduce((s, m) => s + m.y, 0) / alive.length + oy;
          const bDist = Math.hypot(g.px - alive[0].x, g.py - alive[0].y);
          if (bDist < 180) {
            ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            const bLabel = `${band.label} [${alive.length}]`;
            const btw = ctx.measureText(bLabel).width;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(avgX - btw / 2 - 4, avgY - 28, btw + 8, 12, 3); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = band.color;
            ctx.fillText(bLabel, avgX, avgY - 18);
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Fire overlays on burning buildings ─────────────────────────────────
      for (const fire of g.fires) {
        const bld = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === fire.bid); if (!bld) continue;
        const fbx = bld.x + ox, fby = bld.y + oy;
        if (fbx + bld.w < 0 || fbx > cw || fby + bld.h < 0 || fby > ch) continue;
        const phase2 = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.22 + fire.x * 0.01) * 0.4 + 0.6;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 * phase2 * fire.intensity;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600'; ctx.fillRect(fbx, fby, bld.w, bld.h);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        // Flame tips
        for (let ft = 0; ft < 5; ft++) {
          const fmx = fbx + (ft / 4) * bld.w;
          const fmy = fby - 4 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.3 + ft * 1.2) * 5;
          ctx.fillStyle = ft % 2 === 0 ? '#ff8800' : '#ffcc00';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(fmx, fmy); ctx.lineTo(fmx + 5, fby); ctx.lineTo(fmx - 5, fby); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff2200'; ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('🔥 FIRE', fbx + bld.w / 2, fby - 12);
      }

      // Dead bodies — fallen enemies and players
      for (const body of g.deadBodies) {
        const bx = body.x + ox, by = body.y + oy;
        if (bx < -12 || bx > cw + 12 || by < -12 || by > ch + 12) continue;
        const isPlayer = body.type === 'PLAYER';
        const bc = isPlayer ? '#cc8866' : (THREAT_COL[body.type] ?? '#ff4444');
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(bx, by + 2, 8, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = bc;
        if (isPlayer) {
          ctx.fillRect(bx - 5, by - 1, 10, 4);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx - 7, by - 1, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, by + 3, 3, 3);
          ctx.fillRect(bx - 3, by + 3, 3, 3);
        } else {
          ctx.fillRect(bx - 6, by - 1, 12, 3);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx - 7, by, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, by + 2, 4, 2);
          ctx.fillRect(bx - 4, by + 2, 4, 2);
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        if (!body.looted && body.type !== 'PLAYER' && (body.bounty ?? 0) > 0) {
          const lootDist = Math.hypot(g.px - body.x, g.py - body.y);
          const lootPulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.12) * 0.3;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,221,68,${lootPulse})`;
          ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(`ƒ${(body.bounty ?? 0).toLocaleString()}`, bx, by - 8);
          if (lootDist < 50) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,221,68,${lootPulse * 0.8})`;
            ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText('[E] LOOT', bx, by - 16);
          }
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(bx + 2, by + 1, 5, 2, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }

      // Threats — type-specific pixel shapes
      for (const t of g.threats) {
        const kbOffX = t.knockback ? t.knockback.dx : 0;
        const kbOffY = t.knockback ? t.knockback.dy : 0;
        const tx = t.x + ox + kbOffX, ty = t.y + oy + kbOffY;
        if (tx < -12 || tx > cw + 12 || ty < -12 || ty > ch + 12) continue;
        const tc = THREAT_COL[t.type] ?? '#ff4444';
        const dist2 = Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
        const chasing = t.behavior === 'HOSTILE';
        const a = chasing ? 1 : (t.behavior === 'SLEEPING' ? 0.3 : t.behavior === 'CAMPING' ? 0.45 : 0.5);
        ctx.globalAlpha = a;
        ctx.shadowColor = tc; ctx.shadowBlur = chasing ? 7 : 2;
        if (chasing) {
          const pulse = 0.3 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.12) * 0.2;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,50,30,${pulse})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty - 2, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
        // Attack wind-up telegraph — a red ring that cinches inward as the
        // enemy commits. Gives the player a fair window to dodge.
        if ((t.windup ?? 0) > 0 && (t.windupMax ?? 0) > 0) {
          const prog = 1 - (t.windup! / t.windupMax!);
          const ringR = 18 - prog * 6;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,60,40,${0.55 + prog * 0.4})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1 + prog * 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty - 2, ringR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
          // Little "!" over the head, brighter as it nears strike.
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${120 - prog * 80},${80 - prog * 60},${0.8 + prog * 0.2})`;
          ctx.font = 'bold 9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('!', tx, ty - 14);
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(tx, ty + 6, 5, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = tc;
        if (t.type === 'PROWLER') {
          // Crouching diamond — stealthy
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, ty-5); ctx.lineTo(tx+4,ty); ctx.lineTo(tx,ty+5); ctx.lineTo(tx-4,ty); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.2)'; ctx.lineWidth=.5; ctx.stroke();
        } else if (t.type === 'BORDER_GANG') {
          // Chunky person silhouette
          ctx.fillRect(tx-4, ty-6, 8, 6); // torso
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty-9, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); // head
          ctx.fillRect(tx-4, ty, 3, 5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1, ty, 3, 5); // legs
        } else if (t.type === 'RUST_SYNDICATE') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#cc3333'; ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty-7,8,7);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5544'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-10,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#cc3333'; ctx.fillRect(tx-6,ty-6,2,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+4,ty-6,2,5);
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty,3,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty,3,5);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#aa2222'; ctx.fillRect(tx-1,ty-5,2,3);
        } else if (t.type === 'VOID_RUNNERS') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#dd7700'; ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty-8,8,8);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa33'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-11,3.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#dd7700'; ctx.fillRect(tx-6,ty-7,2,6); ctx.fillRect(tx+4,ty-7,2,6);
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty,3,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty,3,5);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#bb5500'; ctx.fillRect(tx-2,ty-6,4,2);
        } else if (t.type === 'STATIC_MONKS') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#88cc11'; ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty-8,8,8);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#aaee22'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-11,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#88cc11'; ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty-7,2,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+3,ty-7,2,5);
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty,3,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty,3,5);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#668800'; ctx.fillRect(tx-1,ty-10,2,1);
        } else if (t.type === 'EASTERN_BLOC') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#3366dd'; ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty-8,10,8);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#5588ff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-11,3.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#3366dd'; ctx.fillRect(tx-7,ty-7,2,6); ctx.fillRect(tx+5,ty-7,2,6);
          ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty,3,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty,3,5);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#224499'; ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-6,6,2);
        } else if (t.type === 'MINX_CITY') {
          // MINX CITY gang — dominant gang, heavy armored soldier
          ctx.fillStyle = '#6622aa'; ctx.fillRect(tx-6,ty-9,12,10); // heavy body armor
          ctx.fillStyle = '#cc44ff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-12,4.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); // head
          ctx.fillStyle = '#6622aa'; ctx.fillRect(tx-8,ty-8,3,7); ctx.fillRect(tx+5,ty-8,3,7); // arms
          ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty+1,4,6); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty+1,4,6); // legs
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ee88ff'; ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty-7,8,2); // visor
          ctx.fillStyle = '#cc44ff'; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('MC', tx, ty-17);
          if (chasing) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#cc44ff'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(getActiveCityDef().name, tx, ty - 22);
          }
        } else if (t.type === 'MUTANT') {
          // Irregular blob
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty,6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.15)'; ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-3,2,2); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty-4,3,2);
          ctx.fillStyle=tc; ctx.fillRect(tx-8,ty-2,3,4); ctx.fillRect(tx+5,ty-3,3,5); // limbs
        } else if (t.type === 'SPY') {
          // Disguised agent — looks like a plain person (no hostile indicator until chasing)
          ctx.fillStyle = chasing ? tc : 'rgba(200,200,180,.65)';
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3, ty-7, 7, 6); // torso
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty-10, 3.5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); // head
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3, ty-1, 2.5, 5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1, ty-1, 2.5, 5); // legs
          if (chasing) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffaa'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty, 11, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffaa'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('!! SPY', tx, ty - 15);
          }
        } else if (t.type === 'PABLO_GUARD') {
          // PABLO CORP android guard — blue armored
          ctx.fillStyle = '#2244aa'; ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty-8,10,8); // body armor
          ctx.fillStyle = '#5599ff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-11,4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); // head
          ctx.fillStyle = '#2244aa'; ctx.fillRect(tx-7,ty-7,2,6); ctx.fillRect(tx+5,ty-7,2,6); // arms
          ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty,3,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty,3,5); // legs
          ctx.fillStyle = '#88aaff'; ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-6,6,2); // visor
          if (chasing) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#5599ff'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('PABLO CORP GUARD', tx, ty - 15);
          }
        } else if (t.type === 'STRAY_DOG') {
          const sbd = getDogBreed(t.breed);
          const sScale = sbd.small ? 0.82 : 1;
          ctx.save();
          if (sScale !== 1) { ctx.translate(tx, ty); ctx.scale(sScale, sScale); ctx.translate(-tx, -ty); }
          ctx.fillStyle = sbd.body;
          ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty-2,10,5);
          ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty+3,2,3); ctx.fillRect(tx-1,ty+3,2,3);
          ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty+3,2,3); ctx.fillRect(tx+3,ty+3,2,3);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx-7,ty-3,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          if (sbd.spots) { ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a'; ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-1,2,2); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty,2,2); ctx.fillRect(tx+3,ty-1,1.5,1.5); }
          ctx.fillStyle = sbd.dark;
          ctx.fillRect(tx-9,ty-6,2,2); ctx.fillRect(tx-6,ty-6,2,2);
          if (sbd.fluffy) { ctx.fillStyle = sbd.accent; ctx.fillRect(tx-9,ty-4,1.5,1.5); ctx.fillRect(tx+4,ty-3,1.5,1.5); ctx.fillRect(tx-1,ty-4,1.5,1.5); }
          ctx.fillStyle = '#111'; ctx.fillRect(tx-8,ty-4,1,1); ctx.fillRect(tx-6,ty-4,1,1);
          ctx.fillStyle = sbd.body; ctx.fillRect(tx+5,ty-3+Math.sin(g.frame*0.2)*2,4,1.5);
          ctx.restore();
          if (!g.dogCompanion.active) {
            const pDist = Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
            if (pDist < 60) {
              ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#ffaa44' : 'rgba(255,170,68,.4)';
              ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.fillText('[E] ADOPT', tx, ty - 10);
            }
          }
        } else if (t.type === 'STRAY_CAT') {
          // Leaner body, pointy ears, tail held high — breed sets the coat.
          const sbc = getCatBreed(t.breed);
          const scScale = sbc.small ? 0.85 : 1;
          ctx.save();
          if (scScale !== 1) { ctx.translate(tx, ty); ctx.scale(scScale, scScale); ctx.translate(-tx, -ty); }
          ctx.fillStyle = sbc.body;
          ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty-1,8,4);
          ctx.fillRect(tx-4,ty+3,1.5,3); ctx.fillRect(tx-1,ty+3,1.5,3);
          ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty+3,1.5,3); ctx.fillRect(tx+3,ty+3,1.5,3);
          if (sbc.spots) { ctx.fillStyle = sbc.dark; ctx.fillRect(tx-2,ty-1,2,2); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty,1.5,1.5); }
          ctx.fillStyle = sbc.dark;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx-6,ty-2,2.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx-8,ty-4); ctx.lineTo(tx-7,ty-7); ctx.lineTo(tx-6,ty-4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx-5,ty-4); ctx.lineTo(tx-4,ty-7); ctx.lineTo(tx-3,ty-4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          if (sbc.fluffy) { ctx.fillStyle = sbc.accent; ctx.fillRect(tx-8,ty-2,1.5,1.5); ctx.fillRect(tx+3,ty-1,1.5,1.5); ctx.fillRect(tx-2,ty-2,1.5,1.5); }
          ctx.fillStyle = sbc.eye; ctx.fillRect(tx-7,ty-3,1,1); ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty-3,1,1);
          ctx.fillStyle = sbc.body; ctx.fillRect(tx+4,ty-6+Math.sin(g.frame*0.18)*1.5,1.5,5);
          ctx.restore();
          if (!g.catCompanion.active) {
            const pDist = Math.hypot(g.px - t.x, g.py - t.y);
            if (pDist < 60) {
              ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#aaccff' : 'rgba(170,204,255,.4)';
              ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.fillText('[E] ADOPT', tx, ty - 10);
            }
          }
        } else if (t.type === 'VAGRANT') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#887766';
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-6,6,5);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-9,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-1,2.5,4); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty-1,2.5,4);
        } else if (t.type === 'SCAVENGER') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#99aa66';
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-7,7,6);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx,ty-10,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty-1,2.5,5); ctx.fillRect(tx+1,ty-1,2.5,5);
          ctx.fillRect(tx+4,ty-6,4,2);
        } else if (t.type === 'RAT') {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#776655';
          ctx.fillRect(tx-3,ty,6,3);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx-4,ty,2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#554433';
          ctx.fillRect(tx-5,ty-1,1,1);
          ctx.fillRect(tx+3,ty+1+Math.sin(g.frame*0.3)*1,4,1);
        } else {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx,ty-7); ctx.lineTo(tx+5,ty); ctx.lineTo(tx,ty+7); ctx.lineTo(tx-5,ty); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.2)'; ctx.fillRect(tx-2,ty-3,4,6);

        // Hit-flash: bright white overlay over the sprite immediately after
        // damage so every connected swing reads loud and clear.
        if ((t.hitFlash ?? 0) > 0) {
          const hfA = Math.min(1, (t.hitFlash ?? 0) / 8);
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.55 * hfA})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty - 2, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

        ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        if (!PASSIVE_THREATS.has(t.type)) {
          if (t.behavior === 'SLEEPING') {
            const zOff = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05) * 3;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,150,255,.7)'; ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('z', tx + 8, ty - 10 + zOff);
            ctx.fillText('Z', tx + 14, ty - 16 + zOff * 0.7);
            ctx.font = '10px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.fillText('Z', tx + 20, ty - 22 + zOff * 0.5);
          } else if (t.behavior === 'CAMPING') {
            const flicker = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.15) * 2;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,140,30,.6)'; ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,100,0,.5)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + flicker;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - 6, ty + 10); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty + 4 + flicker); ctx.lineTo(tx + 6, ty + 10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,50,.4)';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx - 3, ty + 10); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty + 6 + flicker * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(tx + 3, ty + 10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          } else if (t.behavior === 'SOCIALIZING') {
            const nearSocial = g.threats.some(o => o !== t && o.type === t.type && o.behavior === 'SOCIALIZING' && Math.hypot(o.x - t.x, o.y - t.y) < 60);
            ctx.fillStyle = nearSocial ? 'rgba(255,255,100,.5)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.35)'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            if (nearSocial) {

              ctx.fillText(laughPhase ? 'ha' : '...', tx + 10, ty - 8);
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,100,.15)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
            } else {
              ctx.fillText('...', tx + 10, ty - 8);
            }
          } else if (t.behavior === 'WORKING') {
            const hammerAng = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.1) * 0.4;
            ctx.save(); ctx.translate(tx + 8, ty - 6); ctx.rotate(hammerAng);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,180,180,.5)'; ctx.fillRect(-1, -5, 2, 5); ctx.fillRect(-2, -7, 4, 3);
            ctx.restore();
          }
        }
        if (chasing) {
          ctx.fillStyle = tc; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(t.type.replace('_',' '), tx, ty - 12);
          const barW = 26, barH = 3;
          const bx2 = tx - barW / 2, by2 = ty - 10;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#220000'; ctx.fillRect(bx2, by2, barW, barH);
          ctx.fillStyle = tc; ctx.fillRect(bx2, by2, barW * (t.hp / t.maxHp), barH);
        }
        if (g.attackFlash > 0 && dist2 < 72) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,100,${g.attackFlash / 8})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      // Apply visible recoil offset to player render — does NOT mutate
      // simulation state, just shifts the sprite (and weapon, label, muzzle
      // flash all anchored to it) backward briefly after firing.
      const px = g.px + ox + g.recoilDx, py2 = g.py + oy + g.recoilDy;
      const isFlash = g.invincible % 4 < 2;
      const pCls = char.class.toLowerCase();
      const costumeColor = (() => {
        const skinCosmeticId = equippedCosmeticsRef.current['skin'];
        if (skinCosmeticId) {
          const skinColors: Record<string, string> = {
            skin_neon_runner: '#00ccff', skin_void_ghost: '#220033', skin_chrome_executive: '#cccccc',
            skin_toxic_waste: '#44ff00', skin_bloodrush: '#cc1122', skin_gold_corp: '#ffaa00',
          };
          if (skinColors[skinCosmeticId]) return skinColors[skinCosmeticId];
        }
        const ac = g.activeCostume; if (ac === 'default') return null; const c = CLOTHES.find(cl => cl.id === ac); return c ? c.color : null;
      })();
      const costumeMeta = (() => {
        const c = CLOTHES.find(cl => cl.id === g.activeCostume);
        return c && c.style !== 'default' ? { style: c.style as string, accent: c.accent } : null;
      })();
      const factionGlow = costumeColor ?? (pCls === 'corporate' ? '#38bdf8' : pCls === 'outlaw' ? '#7dd3fc' : pCls === 'replicant' ? '#67e8f9' : '#38bdf8');
      const bodyAlpha = isFlash ? 1 : 0.3;
      ctx.globalAlpha = bodyAlpha;
      ctx.shadowColor = g.poisoned ? '#7dd3fc' : factionGlow; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      if ((g as any).inWater && !g.vehicle) {
        const ripT = g.frame * 0.08;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100,180,255,${0.25 + Math.sin(ripT) * 0.1})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let ri = 0; ri < 3; ri++) {
          const rr = 8 + ri * 5 + Math.sin(ripT + ri * 2.1) * 2;
          const ra = 0.3 - ri * 0.08;
          ctx.globalAlpha = ra;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px, py2 + 6, rr, rr * 0.35, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = bodyAlpha;
      }
      // Equipped Armory vehicle (from the loadout) — shown only when NOT already
      // mounted on an in-world g.vehicle, so the two systems never double up.
      const gearVeh = !g.vehicle ? gs.current.gearLoadout?.vehicle : undefined;
      // Soft contact shadow at the feet — grounds the player so they don't
      // float. Two stacked ellipses fake a soft penumbra; opacity scales with
      // time of day and the throw is nudged down-right to match the scene's
      // upper-left key light. Drawn at full alpha (not the invuln-flicker
      // bodyAlpha) so the shadow itself never blinks.
      {
        const mounted = !!(g.vehicle || gearVeh);
        // When mounted, the vehicle draws its own ground shadow, so suppress the
        // separate foot shadow to avoid two overlapping (heavier) shadows.
        if (!mounted) {
          // Sun-driven throw: offset toward the shadow direction and stretch
          // with the shadow length so the player's shadow sweeps & lengthens
          // through the day, collapsing to a faint pool at night.
          const psl = 0.85 + sky.shadow.len * 0.2;
          const psrx = 7 * psl, psry = 2.5;
          const psa = 0.26 * dayBright;
          const pox = shadowDX * 3;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${psa * 0.5})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px + 1.5 + pox, py2 + 9.5, psrx + 2, psry + 1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${psa})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px + 1.5 + pox, py2 + 9, psrx, psry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }
      }
      const facingDir = g.facing;
      if (g.vehicle) {
        // Draw player vehicle using the shared directional sprite helper defined above
        const pvFacing = (facingDir ?? 'right') as 'up'|'down'|'left'|'right';
        drawVehicleSprite(px, py2 + 4, g.vehicle, pvFacing);
      } else if (gearVeh) {
        drawGearVehicle(ctx, px, py2, g.frame, gearVeh);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = bodyAlpha;
      const wf = g.walkFrame;
      // Compact character sprites: ~20px tall with proper proportions
      const lLeg = Math.sin(wf / 28 * Math.PI * 2) * 3;
      const rLeg = -lLeg;
      const lArm = Math.sin(wf / 28 * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI) * 2.5;
      const rArm = -lArm;
      const bodyBob = Math.abs(Math.sin(wf / 28 * Math.PI * 2)) * 1;
      const idleBob = g.walkFrame === 0 ? Math.sin(g.idleFrame * 0.08) * 0.4 : bodyBob;

      const hairCol = _app.hairColor;
      const hairStyle = _app.hairStyle;
      const faceStyle = _app.faceStyle;

      const outfitStyle = _app.outfitStyle;

      // On office floors the character must present in business attire (a suit
      // or a business dress). This is a CONTEXTUAL swap for the work surface

      const atWorkFloor = !!g.interior && isOfficeBuilding(g.interior.bid);

      const outfitStyleEff = dressCodeSwap ? workOutfitStyle(_app) : outfitStyle;
      // Derive facing quadrant from continuous facingAngle (π/4 boundary thresholds)
      const fa = g.facingAngle;
      const facingRight = Math.cos(fa) > 0 && Math.abs(Math.cos(fa)) >= Math.abs(Math.sin(fa));
      const facingLeft  = Math.cos(fa) < 0 && Math.abs(Math.cos(fa)) >= Math.abs(Math.sin(fa));
      const facingUp    = Math.sin(fa) < 0 && Math.abs(Math.sin(fa)) > Math.abs(Math.cos(fa));
      const facingDown  = !facingRight && !facingLeft && !facingUp;

      const isoArmOff = facingRight ? 1.5 : facingLeft ? -1.5 : 0;

      const isoLeanX = facingRight ? 1 : facingLeft ? -1 : 0;
      const isoLeanY = facingDown ? 0.3 : facingUp ? -0.3 : 0;

      if (pCls === 'corporate') {
        // Shoes / feet
        ctx.fillStyle = '#111111';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 + 7 + lLeg, 3, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2 + isoLeanX, py2 + 7 + rLeg, 3, 4);
        // Trousers (legs)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1e1e1e';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 4 + isoLeanX, py2 + 1 + lLeg * 0.6, 3, 7);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 1 + isoLeanX, py2 + 1 + rLeg * 0.6, 3, 7);
        // Belt
        ctx.fillStyle = '#888877';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + idleBob, 10, 2);
        // Suit jacket body
        ctx.fillStyle = g.poisoned ? '#557722' : (costumeColor ?? outfitFallback);
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 - 8 + idleBob, 10, 8);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8e8';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + idleBob, 2, 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#cc1111';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 6 + idleBob, 2, 5);
        // Jacket lapels
        ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 - 8 + idleBob, 2, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 3 + isoLeanX, py2 - 8 + idleBob, 2, 3);
        // Shoulder pad detail
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a3a';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 6 + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + idleBob, 1, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 5 + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + idleBob, 1, 3);
        // Arms
        ctx.fillStyle = g.poisoned ? '#557722' : (costumeColor ?? outfitFallback);
        ctx.fillRect(px - 8 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + lArm + idleBob, 3, 6);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 5 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + rArm + idleBob, 3, 6);
        // Hands (skin color)
        ctx.fillStyle = skin;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 8 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + lArm + idleBob, 3, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 5 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + rArm + idleBob, 3, 2);
        // Neck
        ctx.fillStyle = skin;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 10 + idleBob, 3, 3);
        // Head
        ctx.fillStyle = skin;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px + isoLeanX, py2 - 14 + idleBob + isoLeanY, 4, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        // Eyes (facing front or sides) — face overlay applied below
        if (!facingUp) {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a00';
          ctx.fillRect(px - 3 + isoLeanX, py2 - 15 + idleBob, 1, 1);
          ctx.fillRect(px + 2 + isoLeanX, py2 - 15 + idleBob, 1, 1);
          // Mouth
          ctx.fillStyle = '#c87a55';
          ctx.fillRect(px - 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 11 + idleBob, 2, 1);
        }
        // Hair (player choice)
        drawPlayerHair(ctx, px + isoLeanX, py2 + idleBob, hairStyle, hairCol);
        // Face overlay (shades / scar / beard / etc.)
        if (!facingUp) drawPlayerFace(ctx, px + isoLeanX, py2 + idleBob, faceStyle);
      } else if (pCls === 'outlaw') {
        // Outlaw class — rugged frontier mercenary look
        // Boots — worn leather
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3d2010';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 + 7 + lLeg, 3, 5);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2 + isoLeanX, py2 + 7 + rLeg, 3, 5);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#552211';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 + 11 + lLeg, 3, 1);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2 + isoLeanX, py2 + 11 + rLeg, 3, 1);
        // Trousers — rough canvas
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a4030';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 4 + isoLeanX, py2 + 1 + lLeg * 0.6, 3, 7);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 1 + isoLeanX, py2 + 1 + rLeg * 0.6, 3, 7);
        // Ammo/belt straps
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7a6040';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + idleBob, 10, 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3020';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 2 + isoLeanX, py2 - 0.5 + idleBob, 1, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 0.5 + idleBob, 1, 2);
        // Duster coat body
        ctx.fillStyle = g.poisoned ? '#557722' : (costumeColor ?? outfitFallback);
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 - 8 + idleBob, 10, 8);
        // Vest on top of duster
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4a3020';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 3 + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + idleBob, 6, 6);
        // Duster lapel flaps
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7a5a38';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 - 8 + idleBob, 2, 5);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 3 + isoLeanX, py2 - 8 + idleBob, 2, 5);
        // Arms — rough leather sleeves
        ctx.fillStyle = g.poisoned ? '#557722' : (costumeColor ?? outfitFallback);
        ctx.fillRect(px - 8 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + lArm + idleBob, 3, 6);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 5 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + rArm + idleBob, 3, 6);
        // Hands
        ctx.fillStyle = skin;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 8 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + lArm + idleBob, 3, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 5 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + rArm + idleBob, 3, 2);

        ctx.fillRect(px - 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 10 + idleBob, 3, 3);

        if (!facingUp) drawPlayerFace(ctx, px + isoLeanX, py2 + idleBob, faceStyle);
      } else {
        // Default generic class — compact + isometric
        // Boots
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2510';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 5 + isoLeanX, py2 + 7 + lLeg, 3, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 2 + isoLeanX, py2 + 7 + rLeg, 3, 4);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3555';
        ctx.fillRect(px - 4 + isoLeanX, py2 + 1 + lLeg * 0.6, 3, 7);

        ctx.fillStyle = defCol;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 8 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + lArm + idleBob, 3, 6);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 5 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 7 + rArm + idleBob, 3, 6);
        // Hands
        ctx.fillStyle = skin;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 8 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + lArm + idleBob, 3, 2);
        ctx.fillRect(px + 5 + isoArmOff + isoLeanX, py2 - 1 + rArm + idleBob, 3, 2);
        // Neck
        ctx.fillStyle = skin;
        ctx.fillRect(px - 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 10 + idleBob, 3, 3);
        // Head
        ctx.fillStyle = skin;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px + isoLeanX, py2 - 14 + idleBob + isoLeanY, 4, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        if (!facingUp) {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a00';
          ctx.fillRect(px - 3 + isoLeanX, py2 - 15 + idleBob, 1, 1);
          ctx.fillRect(px + 2 + isoLeanX, py2 - 15 + idleBob, 1, 1);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#c87a55';
          ctx.fillRect(px - 1 + isoLeanX, py2 - 11 + idleBob, 2, 1);
        }
        // Hair (player choice)
        drawPlayerHair(ctx, px + isoLeanX, py2 + idleBob, hairStyle, hairCol);
        if (!facingUp) drawPlayerFace(ctx, px + isoLeanX, py2 + idleBob, faceStyle);
      }

      // ── Outfit-style accent (player-chosen silhouette, on top of class body) ──
      // On office floors outfitStyleEff is the enforced business silhouette; the
      // chosen color rides along so it still reads as the same character.
      if (!g.poisoned) drawPlayerOutfit(ctx, px + isoLeanX, py2 + idleBob, outfitStyleEff, costumeColor ?? outfitFallback);

      // ── Costume style accents (suit tie, punk spikes, neon trim, etc.) ──
      if (costumeMeta) drawCostumeAccents(ctx, px, py2, idleBob, isoLeanX, costumeMeta.style, costumeMeta.accent);

      // ── Equipped Armory gear overlays (outfit tint, armor plate, weapon) ──
      // Driven by the SAME loadout the combat stats come from. Outfit first
      // (sits under armor), then armor, then the weapon last so it reads on top.
      {
        const gl = gs.current.gearLoadout;
        const facingTag: 'right'|'left'|'up'|'down' = facingRight ? 'right' : facingLeft ? 'left' : facingUp ? 'up' : 'down';
        if (gl?.outfit) drawGearOutfit(ctx, px, py2, idleBob, isoLeanX, gl.outfit);
        if (gl?.armor) drawGearArmor(ctx, px, py2, idleBob, isoLeanX, gl.armor);
        if (gl?.weapon && !g.vehicle) {
          // In hand when no combat weapon is wielded; slung on the back when one
          // is, so the active in-hand weapon below never gets a second weapon on top.
          drawGearWeapon(ctx, px, py2, idleBob, rArm, facingTag, activeWeaponRef.current === 'fists', gl.weapon);
        }
      }

      // ── Visible weapon on player sprite ──
      if (!g.vehicle && activeWeaponRef.current !== 'fists') {
        const wpn = WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === activeWeaponRef.current);
        if (wpn) {
          const wHandX = facingRight ? px + 10 : facingLeft ? px - 10 : px + 9;
          const wHandY = py2 - 6 + idleBob + rArm;
          if (wpn.type === 'melee') {
            if (wpn.icon === 'sword') {
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#cccccc'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
              ctx.shadowColor = '#aaeeff'; ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
              ctx.beginPath();
              if (facingRight) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX + 10, wHandY - 8); }
              else if (facingLeft) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX - 10, wHandY - 8); }
              else { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX + 2, wHandY - 12); }
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.fillStyle = '#886644'; ctx.fillRect(wHandX - 1, wHandY, 2, 4);
              ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            } else if (wpn.icon === 'bat') {
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#885522'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
              ctx.beginPath();
              if (facingRight) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY + 2); ctx.lineTo(wHandX + 11, wHandY - 6); }
              else if (facingLeft) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY + 2); ctx.lineTo(wHandX - 11, wHandY - 6); }
              else { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY + 2); ctx.lineTo(wHandX, wHandY - 11); }
              ctx.stroke();
            } else if (wpn.icon === 'machete') {
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#ccccaa'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
              ctx.beginPath();
              if (facingRight) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX + 9, wHandY - 5); }
              else if (facingLeft) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX - 9, wHandY - 5); }
              else { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX + 1, wHandY - 10); }
              ctx.stroke();
            } else if (wpn.icon === 'katana') {
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#aaccee'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
              ctx.shadowColor = '#aaccee'; ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
              ctx.beginPath();
              if (facingRight) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX + 14, wHandY - 10); }
              else if (facingLeft) { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX - 14, wHandY - 10); }
              else { ctx.moveTo(wHandX, wHandY); ctx.lineTo(wHandX + 2, wHandY - 15); }
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.fillStyle = '#664433'; ctx.fillRect(wHandX - 1, wHandY, 2, 5);
              ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            } else if (wpn.icon === 'knuckles') {
              ctx.fillStyle = '#ddcc44';
              ctx.fillRect(facingRight ? wHandX + 2 : facingLeft ? wHandX - 5 : wHandX - 1, wHandY - 2, 4, 4);
            } else if (wpn.icon === 'chainsaw') {
              ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6622'; ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6622'; ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
              const cDir = facingRight ? 1 : facingLeft ? -1 : 0;
              ctx.fillRect(wHandX + cDir * 2, wHandY - 4, 4, 10);
              ctx.fillStyle = '#aaaaaa';
              ctx.fillRect(wHandX + cDir * 4, wHandY - 6, 2, 3);
              ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            } else {
              ctx.fillStyle = '#668866'; ctx.fillRect(wHandX - 1, wHandY - 6, 3, 8);
            }
          } else if (wpn.type === 'ranged') {
            // Ranged weapons — rotate to follow aim angle, with recoil
            // kick that tilts the barrel up briefly after each shot.
            const isLongBarrel = wpn.icon === 'rifle' || wpn.icon === 'laser' || wpn.icon === 'sniper';
            const isHeavy = wpn.icon === 'bomb' || wpn.icon === 'grenade_launcher';
            const isBulky = wpn.icon === 'shotgun';
            const barW = isLongBarrel ? 14 : isHeavy ? 12 : isBulky ? 11 : 10;
            const barH = isHeavy ? 6 : isBulky ? 5 : 4;
            const barCol = wpn.icon === 'laser' ? '#ff44aa' : wpn.icon === 'bomb' ? '#ffcc00' : wpn.icon === 'shotgun' ? '#774422' : wpn.icon === 'smg' ? '#556677' : wpn.icon === 'sniper' ? '#334433' : wpn.icon === 'grenade_launcher' ? '#446633' : wpn.icon === 'crossbow' ? '#886633' : '#334455';
            const barGlow = wpn.icon === 'laser' ? '#ff44aa' : wpn.icon === 'bomb' ? '#ffcc00' : wpn.icon === 'crossbow' ? '#886633' : '#88aacc';
            // Kick = rotate barrel away from target by up to ~25°, scaled
            // by recoil intensity. Sign is computed from the aim vector
            // (cross-product with world-up) so the barrel always tilts
            // "skyward" relative to the shot direction, regardless of
            // whether the player is facing left, right, or vertically.
            // For an aim angle θ in canvas coords (y-down), aiming right
            // (cos θ > 0) → kick rotates the barrel CCW (negative dθ);
            // aiming left → CW (positive dθ).
            const kickSign = Math.cos(g.aimAngle) >= 0 ? -1 : 1;
            const kickAng = g.gunKick * 0.45 * kickSign;
            // Pull the barrel back toward the body
            const kickBack = -g.gunKick * 3;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(wHandX, wHandY);
            ctx.rotate(g.aimAngle + kickAng);
            ctx.fillStyle = barCol; ctx.shadowColor = barGlow; ctx.shadowBlur = 2;
            ctx.fillRect(kickBack, -barH / 2, barW, barH);
            ctx.fillRect(kickBack + 4, barH / 2, 2, 4);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.restore();
          } else {
            // Fallback generic icon
            ctx.fillStyle = '#556677'; ctx.fillRect(wHandX - 2, wHandY - 4, 4, 8);
          }
        }
      }

      ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if (gamePausedRef.current) {
        const shieldPulse = 0.35 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06) * 0.15;
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100,220,255,${shieldPulse})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px, py2 - 4, 14, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100,220,255,${shieldPulse * 0.12})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(px, py2 - 4, 14, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.font = 'bold 8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100,220,255,${shieldPulse + 0.1})`;
        ctx.fillText('BREAK', px, py2 - 24);
      }
      // Attack swing arc (varies by weapon) — animated sweep that tracks
      // through the arc rather than fading a static one. Progress is 0 at
      // start of swing → 1 at end. We draw a leading "active edge" plus a
      // fading trail behind it for that satisfying motion-blur look.
      if (g.attackFlash > 0) {
        const curWpn = WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === activeWeaponRef.current) ?? WEAPONS[0];
        // Bare-fist attacks get a punch-puff instead of a swing arc.
        // Note: FISTS is type 'melee', so we have to special-case it here
        // BEFORE the generic melee arc branch — otherwise it never runs.
        const isBareFists = curWpn.icon === 'fists';
        if (isBareFists) {
          const flashMax = Math.max(1, g.attackFlashMax || 14);
          const t = 1 - (g.attackFlash / flashMax);
          const reach = 22 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t); // out then back in
          const fa = g.swingStartAngle;
          const fx = px + Math.cos(fa) * reach;
          const fy = py2 + Math.sin(fa) * reach - 4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,235,180,${0.7 * (1 - t)})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx, fy, 3 + 2 * t, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          // Faint motion line trailing the fist
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,220,${0.35 * (1 - t)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, py2 - 4); ctx.lineTo(fx, fy); ctx.stroke();
        } else if (curWpn.type === 'melee') {
          const flashMax = Math.max(1, g.attackFlashMax || 14);
          const t = 1 - (g.attackFlash / flashMax);             // 0 → 1
          const swingAngle = g.swingStartAngle;
          // Per-weapon arc width (radians) and color — heavy swing is wider.
          let arcSpan =
            curWpn.icon === 'bat'      ? 1.4 :
            curWpn.icon === 'chainsaw' ? 0.8 :
            curWpn.icon === 'sword' || curWpn.icon === 'katana' || curWpn.icon === 'machete' ? 1.2 :
            1.5;
          if (g.swingHeavy) arcSpan = Math.min(Math.PI * 0.95, arcSpan * 1.8);
          const color =
            curWpn.icon === 'katana'   ? '170,204,238' :
            curWpn.icon === 'machete'  ? '204,204,170' :
            curWpn.icon === 'sword'    ? '255,100,68'  :
            curWpn.icon === 'bat'      ? '180,120,60'  :
            curWpn.icon === 'chainsaw' ? '255,102,34'  :
            '255,255,180';
          const lineW =
            (curWpn.icon === 'bat' ? 4.5 :
             curWpn.icon === 'chainsaw' ? 3.5 :
             curWpn.icon === 'sword' || curWpn.icon === 'katana' ? 3 :
             2.5) * (g.swingHeavy ? 1.4 : 1);
          // Direction: +1 sweeps start→end normally, −1 reverses so the
          // blade reads as coming from the opposite side. Heavy swing is
          // always a top-down overhead chop (start offset = −π/2 from aim).
          const dir = g.swingDir || 1;
          const reach = g.swingHeavy ? curWpn.range * 1.25 : curWpn.range;
          const centerA = g.swingHeavy ? swingAngle - Math.PI * 0.05 : swingAngle;
          const startA = centerA - (arcSpan / 2) * dir;
          const endA   = centerA + (arcSpan / 2) * dir;
          const headA  = startA + (endA - startA) * t;
          // Trail (rear → head): drawn in 4 segments with rising alpha
          const segs = 4;
          for (let i = 0; i < segs; i++) {
            const aFrom = startA + (headA - startA) * (i / segs);
            const aTo   = startA + (headA - startA) * ((i + 1) / segs);
            const segAlpha = 0.18 + 0.6 * ((i + 1) / segs);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},${segAlpha.toFixed(2)})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = lineW;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py2, reach, aFrom, aTo); ctx.stroke();
          }
          // Leading edge — bright tip line that flicks outward
          if (t < 0.85) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${color},0.9)`; ctx.shadowBlur = g.swingHeavy ? 10 : 6;
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${color},1)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = lineW + 0.5;
            const tipX = px + Math.cos(headA) * reach;
            const tipY = py2 + Math.sin(headA) * reach;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(px + Math.cos(headA) * (reach * 0.55), py2 + Math.sin(headA) * (reach * 0.55));
            ctx.lineTo(tipX, tipY);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.restore();
          }
          // Heavy swing: extra "impact" burst at the midpoint of the arc.
          if (g.swingHeavy && t > 0.4 && t < 0.7) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${color},1)`; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${1 - t})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = lineW + 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(px, py2, reach * 0.95, centerA - 0.3, centerA + 0.3);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.restore();
          }
        } else if (activeWeaponRef.current === 'fists' || curWpn.icon === 'knuckles') {
          // Punch puff — short radial dust at fist extension
          const flashMax = Math.max(1, g.attackFlashMax || 8);
          const t = 1 - (g.attackFlash / flashMax);
          const reach = 22 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t); // out then back
          const fa = g.swingStartAngle;
          const fx = px + Math.cos(fa) * reach;
          const fy = py2 + Math.sin(fa) * reach - 4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,235,180,${0.7 * (1 - t)})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(fx, fy, 3 + 2 * t, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      // ── Muzzle flash — per-weapon shape, color, and intensity ──
      // Each gun pulls its mflashLen/mflashCol from GUN_STATS so the
      // visual punch matches the gun's profile (laser = pink burst,
      // sniper = long green flash, shotgun = wide orange star, smg =
      // tiny white pop, crossbow = nothing).
      if (g.muzzleFlash && g.muzzleFlash.life > 0) {
        const mf = g.muzzleFlash;
        const mfProfile = mf.wpnIcon ? getGunProfile(mf.wpnIcon) : { mflashLen: 14, mflashCol: '255,255,180' } as GunProfile;
        if (mfProfile.mflashLen > 0) {
          const mfAlpha = mf.life / 5;
          const mfLen = mfProfile.mflashLen + mf.life * 1.5;
          const sX = px + Math.cos(mf.angle) * 10;
          const sY = py2 + Math.sin(mf.angle) * 10;
          const eX = px + Math.cos(mf.angle) * (10 + mfLen);
          const eY = py2 + Math.sin(mf.angle) * (10 + mfLen);
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${mfProfile.mflashCol},1)`;
          ctx.shadowBlur = mf.wpnIcon === 'laser' ? 14 : mf.wpnIcon === 'sniper' ? 14 : 8;
          // Outer glow
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${mfProfile.mflashCol},${mfAlpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = mf.wpnIcon === 'shotgun' ? 6 : mf.wpnIcon === 'sniper' ? 5 : mf.wpnIcon === 'smg' ? 2.5 : 4;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sX, sY); ctx.lineTo(eX, eY); ctx.stroke();
          // Bright white core
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${mfAlpha * 0.9})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = mf.wpnIcon === 'smg' ? 1 : 1.6;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sX, sY); ctx.lineTo(eX, eY); ctx.stroke();
          // Star-burst petals on first frame for shotgun & sniper
          if (mf.life >= 4 && (mf.wpnIcon === 'shotgun' || mf.wpnIcon === 'sniper' || mf.wpnIcon === 'laser')) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${mfProfile.mflashCol},${mfAlpha * 0.7})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            for (const dA of [-0.55, -0.28, 0.28, 0.55]) {
              const a2 = mf.angle + dA;
              const lL = mfLen * (mf.wpnIcon === 'shotgun' ? 0.9 : 0.55);
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(sX, sY);
              ctx.lineTo(sX + Math.cos(a2) * lL, sY + Math.sin(a2) * lL);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
          // Bright glow ball at the muzzle origin
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${mfAlpha})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sX, sY, 2.5 + mf.life * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // ── Ejected casings ──
      // Tiny rotating brass shells flung sideways from the gun on each
      // shot. Only spawned by guns that have a casing color in
      // GUN_STATS (laser/crossbow/bomb skip).
      if (g.casings.length > 0) {
        ctx.save();
        for (const c of g.casings) {
          const cx = c.x + ox, cy = c.y + oy;
          if (cx < -10 || cx > cw + 10 || cy < -10 || cy > ch + 10) continue;
          const a = Math.min(1, c.life / 25);
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(cx, cy);
          ctx.rotate(c.rot);
          ctx.fillStyle = c.color;
          ctx.globalAlpha = a;
          ctx.fillRect(-1.5, -1, 3, 2);
          // tiny dark rim line
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,30,10,0.7)';
          ctx.fillRect(1, -1, 0.6, 2);
          ctx.restore();
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Hit impact effects — small radial sparks at impact point
      for (const he of g.hitEffects) {
        const hx = he.x + ox, hy = he.y + oy;
        if (hx < -20 || hx > cw + 20 || hy < -20 || hy > ch + 20) continue;
        const heAlpha = he.life / he.maxLife;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ff8844'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${120 + Math.floor(heAlpha * 100)},50,${heAlpha})`;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hx, hy, 2.5 * heAlpha + 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Render projectiles
      for (const p of g.projectiles) {
        const ppx = p.x + ox, ppy = p.y + oy;
        if (ppx < -10 || ppx > cw + 10 || ppy < -10 || ppy > ch + 10) continue;
        if (p.type === 'laser') {
          // Laser: long glowing beam trail with bright core
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#ff44aa'; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,100,220,${0.4 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.25) * 0.15})`; ctx.lineWidth = 5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ppx - p.dx * 6, ppy - p.dy * 6); ctx.lineTo(ppx, ppy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,200,255,${0.85 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.25) * 0.1})`; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ppx - p.dx * 4, ppy - p.dy * 4); ctx.lineTo(ppx, ppy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (p.type === 'bomb') {
          // Bomb: arc projectile with a smoke/fire trail
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#ff8800'; ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ppx, ppy, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ppx, ppy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          for (let ti = 1; ti <= 4; ti++) {
            const tx = ppx - p.dx * ti * 1.5, ty = ppy - p.dy * ti * 1.5;
            ctx.globalAlpha = (5 - ti) / 8;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(120,80,40,${0.6 - ti * 0.1})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tx, ty, 3 - ti * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          }
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (p.type === 'shotgun') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#ffaa44'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc66';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ppx, ppy, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,170,80,0.4)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ppx - p.dx * 2, ppy - p.dy * 2); ctx.lineTo(ppx, ppy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (p.type === 'sniper') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#44ff88'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(68,255,136,0.7)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ppx - p.dx * 8, ppy - p.dy * 8); ctx.lineTo(ppx, ppy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#aaffcc';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ppx, ppy, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (p.type === 'crossbow') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#886633'; ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(136,102,51,0.7)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ppx - p.dx * 3, ppy - p.dy * 3); ctx.lineTo(ppx, ppy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ccaa66';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ppx, ppy, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.restore();
        } else {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.shadowColor = '#aaccff'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,210,255,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ppx - p.dx * 3.5, ppy - p.dy * 3.5); ctx.lineTo(ppx, ppy); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ppx, ppy, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#88aaff';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ppx, ppy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // Render bombs
      for (const bm of g.bombs) {
        const bmx = bm.x + ox, bmy = bm.y + oy;
        const progress = 1 - bm.timer / 45;
        if (bm.timer > 0) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,204,0,${0.5 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.3) * 0.3})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bmx, bmy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,204,0,${0.3 * progress})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bmx, bmy, bm.radius * progress, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,0,${0.4})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bmx, bmy, bm.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      if (speaking) {
        const t = g.frame * 0.1;
        for (let ri = 0; ri < 3; ri++) {
          const phase = (t + ri * 0.7) % 2.1;
          const radius = 10 + phase * 12;
          const alpha = Math.max(0, 0.55 - phase * 0.25);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,255,180,${alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py2 - 6, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,255,180,.7)';
        ctx.font = 'bold 9px "Fira Code"';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('\u266A', px + 12, py2 - 20);
      }
      // Player name is PRIVATE — hidden by default, revealed on hover. The green
      // pulse ring already marks the player, so no label is needed at rest.
      {
        const meHover = !!(hoverMouseRef.current && Math.hypot(g.px - hoverMouseRef.current.x, g.py - hoverMouseRef.current.y) < 16);
        if (meHover) {
          ctx.font = 'bold 14px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          const pnTw = ctx.measureText(char.name).width;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(px - pnTw / 2 - 5, py2 - 36, pnTw + 10, 18, 4); ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(56,189,248,.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 7;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(236,246,255,.98)';
          ctx.fillText(char.name, px, py2 - 22);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }
      }

      // ── Dog companion sprite ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      if (dog.active && !dog.stayAt) {
        const dx2 = dog.x + ox, dy2 = dog.y + oy;
        if (dx2 > -20 && dx2 < cw + 20 && dy2 > -20 && dy2 < ch + 20) {
          const abd = getDogBreed(dog.breed);
          const bodyCol = dog.injured ? abd.bodyInjured : abd.body;
          const headCol = dog.injured ? abd.bodyInjured : abd.dark;
          const dogAlpha = dog.injured ? 0.35 : 0.9;
          ctx.globalAlpha = dogAlpha;
          ctx.shadowColor = dog.injured ? '#ff6644' : abd.accent; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(dx2, dy2 + 5, 7, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          const drawScale = abd.small ? 0.8 : 1;
          ctx.save();
          if (drawScale !== 1) { ctx.translate(dx2, dy2); ctx.scale(drawScale, drawScale); ctx.translate(-dx2, -dy2); }
          ctx.fillStyle = bodyCol;
          ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 8, dy2 - 3, 16, 7);
          ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 8, dy2 + 4, 3, 4); ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 3, dy2 + 4, 3, 4);
          ctx.fillRect(dx2 + 2, dy2 + 4, 3, 4); ctx.fillRect(dx2 + 6, dy2 + 4, 3, 4);
          if (!dog.injured && abd.spots) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
            ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 4, dy2 - 1, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(dx2 + 1, dy2, 2.5, 2.5); ctx.fillRect(dx2 + 4, dy2 - 2, 2, 2);
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = headCol;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx2 - 10, dy2 - 4, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          if (!dog.injured && abd.fluffy) {
            ctx.fillStyle = abd.accent;
            ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 13, dy2 - 5, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 7, dy2 - 7, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(dx2 + 6, dy2 - 4, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 2, dy2 - 5, 2, 2);
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = abd.accent;
          ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 12, dy2 - 8, 2, 3); ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 8, dy2 - 8, 2, 3);
