          ctx.fillStyle = '#111'; ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 11, dy2 - 5, 1.5, 1.5); ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 9, dy2 - 5, 1.5, 1.5);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#221100'; ctx.fillRect(dx2 - 11, dy2 - 3, 3, 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = headCol;
          ctx.fillRect(dx2 + 8, dy2 - 4 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.15) * 2, 5, 2);
          ctx.restore();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          if (dog.injured) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('INJURED', dx2, dy2 - 12);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa44'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(dog.name, dx2, dy2 - 12);
            const dhpPct = dog.hp / dog.maxHp;
            const barW2 = 22, barH2 = 2;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#220800'; ctx.fillRect(dx2 - barW2 / 2, dy2 - 9, barW2, barH2);
            ctx.fillStyle = dhpPct > 0.5 ? '#ffaa44' : dhpPct > 0.25 ? '#ff8800' : '#ff4444';
            ctx.fillRect(dx2 - barW2 / 2, dy2 - 9, barW2 * dhpPct, barH2);
            if (dog.sleeping) {
              const zb = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06) * 1.5;
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,200,255,.85)'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.fillText('z', dx2 + 11, dy2 - 5 + zb);
              ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.fillText('z', dx2 + 15, dy2 - 9 + zb);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Cat companion sprite ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      if (cat.active && !cat.stayAt) {
        const cx2 = cat.x + ox, cy2 = cat.y + oy;
        if (cx2 > -20 && cx2 < cw + 20 && cy2 > -20 && cy2 < ch + 20) {
          const abc = getCatBreed(cat.breed);
          const bodyCatCol = cat.injured ? abc.bodyInjured : abc.body;
          const headCatCol = cat.injured ? abc.bodyInjured : abc.dark;
          const catAlpha = cat.injured ? 0.35 : 0.9;
          ctx.globalAlpha = catAlpha;
          ctx.shadowColor = cat.injured ? '#ff6644' : abc.accent; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx2, cy2 + 5, 6, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          const catScale = abc.small ? 0.82 : 1;
          ctx.save();
          if (catScale !== 1) { ctx.translate(cx2, cy2); ctx.scale(catScale, catScale); ctx.translate(-cx2, -cy2); }
          ctx.fillStyle = bodyCatCol;
          ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 7, cy2 - 2, 14, 5);
          ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 7, cy2 + 3, 2.5, 4); ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 2, cy2 + 3, 2.5, 4);
          ctx.fillRect(cx2 + 2, cy2 + 3, 2.5, 4); ctx.fillRect(cx2 + 5, cy2 + 3, 2.5, 4);
          if (!cat.injured && abc.spots) {
            ctx.fillStyle = abc.dark;
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 3, cy2 - 1, 2.5, 2.5); ctx.fillRect(cx2 + 1, cy2, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(cx2 + 4, cy2 - 1, 1.5, 1.5);
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = headCatCol;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2 - 9, cy2 - 3, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          // pointy ears
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2 - 12, cy2 - 5); ctx.lineTo(cx2 - 11, cy2 - 9); ctx.lineTo(cx2 - 9, cy2 - 5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2 - 8, cy2 - 5); ctx.lineTo(cx2 - 7, cy2 - 9); ctx.lineTo(cx2 - 6, cy2 - 5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
          if (!cat.injured && abc.fluffy) {
            ctx.fillStyle = abc.accent;
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 12, cy2 - 3, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(cx2 + 5, cy2 - 2, 2, 2); ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 3, cy2 - 3, 2, 2);
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = abc.eye; ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 11, cy2 - 4, 1.5, 1.5); ctx.fillRect(cx2 - 9, cy2 - 4, 1.5, 1.5);
          // tail held high, swishing
          ctx.fillStyle = headCatCol;
          ctx.fillRect(cx2 + 7, cy2 - 7 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.13) * 2, 2, 6);
          ctx.restore();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          if (cat.injured) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('INJURED', cx2, cy2 - 12);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#aaccff'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(cat.name, cx2, cy2 - 12);
            const chpPct = cat.hp / cat.maxHp;
            const barW3 = 22, barH3 = 2;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#001022'; ctx.fillRect(cx2 - barW3 / 2, cy2 - 9, barW3, barH3);
            ctx.fillStyle = chpPct > 0.5 ? '#aaccff' : chpPct > 0.25 ? '#6699ff' : '#ff4444';
            ctx.fillRect(cx2 - barW3 / 2, cy2 - 9, barW3 * chpPct, barH3);
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Mila replicant companion sprite (story missions) ─────────────────
      if (g.story?.active && g.mila.task === 'follow' && g.mila.spawnAt !== 0) {
        const mx2 = g.mila.x + ox, my2 = g.mila.y + oy;
        if (mx2 > -20 && mx2 < cw + 20 && my2 > -20 && my2 < ch + 20) {
          const appear = Math.min(1, (g.frame - g.mila.spawnAt) / 22);
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(mx2, my2 + 6, 6, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + appear * 0.7;
          ctx.shadowColor = '#2acccc'; ctx.shadowBlur = 7 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.1) * 2;
          drawPlayerSprite(ctx, milaAppearance(clothOutfitColor(g.mila.outfitId)), { px: mx2, py: my2 });
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          ctx.globalAlpha = appear;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#67e8f9'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(milaLabelRef.current, mx2, my2 - 20);
          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // ── PABLO CORP android guards (city patrol) ──────────────────────────
      for (const guard of g.guards) {
        const gx2 = guard.x + ox, gy2 = guard.y + oy;
        if (gx2 < -16 || gx2 > cw + 16 || gy2 < -16 || gy2 > ch + 16) continue;
        const gdist2 = Math.hypot(g.px - guard.x, g.py - guard.y);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
        ctx.shadowColor = '#4488ff'; ctx.shadowBlur = gdist2 < 80 ? 10 : 3;
        // Ground shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(gx2, gy2+9, 6, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        // Armor body — PABLO CORP corp blue
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3388'; ctx.fillRect(gx2-5,gy2-8,10,9);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2255cc'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gx2,gy2-12,4,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#88aaff'; ctx.fillRect(gx2-3,gy2-13,6,2); // visor glow
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3388'; ctx.fillRect(gx2-7,gy2-7,2,6); ctx.fillRect(gx2+5,gy2-7,2,6); // arms
        ctx.fillRect(gx2-4,gy2+1,3,5); ctx.fillRect(gx2+1,gy2+1,3,5); // legs
        // Corp logo (small P on chest)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#88aaff'; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('P', gx2, gy2-2);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        if (gdist2 < 90) {
          ctx.font = '13px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          const gTw = ctx.measureText('PABLO CORP').width;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(gx2 - gTw / 2 - 5, gy2 - 32, gTw + 10, 16, 4); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#5599ff';
          ctx.fillText('PABLO CORP', gx2, gy2 - 20);
        }
      }

      // ── Vending machines near govt buildings ─────────────────────────────
      for (const vp of VEND_POSITIONS) {
        const bld = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === vp.bid); if (!bld) continue;
        const vx = bld.x + vp.x + ox, vy = bld.y + bld.h / 2 + vp.y + oy;
        if (vx < -20 || vx > cw + 20 || vy < -20 || vy > ch + 20) continue;
        const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08) * 0.2;
        ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
        ctx.shadowColor = '#00ffcc'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
        // Vending machine body
        ctx.fillStyle = '#003322'; ctx.fillRect(vx-7, vy-14, 14, 20);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#004433'; ctx.fillRect(vx-6, vy-13, 12, 12); // glass panel
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc'; ctx.fillRect(vx-4, vy-11, 3, 3); ctx.fillRect(vx+1, vy-11, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(vx-4, vy-7, 3, 3); ctx.fillRect(vx+1, vy-7, 3, 3); // products
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444'; ctx.fillRect(vx-4, vy+2, 8, 2); // button strip
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc'; ctx.font = '4px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('VendKing', vx, vy+8);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        // Proximity label
        if (Math.hypot(g.px - (bld.x + vp.x), g.py - (bld.y + bld.h/2 + vp.y)) < 55) {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffcc'; ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] VendKing $10', vx, vy - 18);
        }
      }

      // ── Billboard structures ──────────────────────────────────────────────
      for (const bb of BILLBOARDS) {
        const bx = bb.x + ox, by = bb.y + oy;
        if (bx < -60 || bx > cw + 60 || by < -80 || by > ch + 40) continue;
        const isNearBb = g.nearBillboard === bb.locationId;
        const bbData = billboardsDataRef.current.find((d: BillboardData) => d.locationId === bb.locationId);
        const hasOwner = bbData && bbData.ownerPlayerName;
        const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.04 + bb.x * 0.01) * 0.3;

        const postW = 6, postH = 50, screenW = 56, screenH = 32;
        const postX = bx - postW / 2, postY = by - postH;
        const scrX = bx - screenW / 2, scrY = postY - screenH - 2;

        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e'; ctx.fillRect(postX, postY, postW, postH);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(postX, postY, postW, postH);

        const scrGlow = isNearBb ? '#38bdf8' : hasOwner ? '#ff00ff' : '#00ccff';
        ctx.shadowColor = scrGlow; ctx.shadowBlur = isNearBb ? 16 : 8;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a1a'; ctx.fillRect(scrX, scrY, screenW, screenH);
        ctx.strokeStyle = scrGlow; ctx.lineWidth = isNearBb ? 2 : 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(scrX, scrY, screenW, screenH);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(scrX + 2, scrY + 2, screenW - 4, screenH - 4); ctx.clip();
        if (hasOwner && bbData.adImageUrl) {
          const adImg = bbImagesRef.current.get(bbData.adImageUrl);
          if (adImg && adImg.complete && adImg.naturalWidth > 0) {
            ctx.drawImage(adImg, scrX + 2, scrY + 2, screenW - 4, screenH - 4);
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,0,255,${pulse * 0.15})`; ctx.fillRect(scrX + 2, scrY + 2, screenW - 4, screenH - 4);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff88ff'; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('LOADING...', bx, scrY + 16);
          }
          if (bbData.adText) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; ctx.fillRect(scrX + 2, scrY + screenH - 12, screenW - 4, 10);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff88ff'; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(bbData.adText.slice(0, 12), bx, scrY + screenH - 4);
          }
        } else if (hasOwner && bbData.adText) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,0,255,${pulse * 0.15})`; ctx.fillRect(scrX + 2, scrY + 2, screenW - 4, screenH - 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#ff88ff'; ctx.font = '6px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          const lines = bbData.adText.match(/.{1,12}/g) || [bbData.adText];
          lines.slice(0, 3).forEach((line: string, i: number) => ctx.fillText(line, bx, scrY + 10 + i * 8));
        } else {
          const scanY = (g.frame * 0.5) % screenH;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,200,255,${pulse * 0.08})`; ctx.fillRect(scrX + 2, scrY + 2, screenW - 4, screenH - 4);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,200,255,0.06)`; ctx.fillRect(scrX + 2, scrY + scanY, screenW - 4, 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,200,255,${pulse * 0.7})`; ctx.font = 'bold 7px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('PABLO', bx, scrY + 13);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,200,255,${pulse * 0.4})`; ctx.font = '5px "Fira Code"';
          ctx.fillText('AD SPACE', bx, scrY + 22);
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // Billboard place-name marker intentionally omitted — recognised by the
        // structure's art; the [E] interaction prompt below is kept.
        if (isNearBb) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.9)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)';
          ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] BILLBOARD', bx, scrY - 6);
        }
      }

      // ── Floating damage / money numbers ──────────────────────────────────
      for (const fl of g.floaters) {
        const fx = fl.x + ox, fy = fl.y + oy;
        const alpha = fl.life / fl.maxLife;
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.shadowColor = fl.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
        ctx.fillStyle = fl.color;
        ctx.font = `bold ${8 + Math.round((1 - alpha) * 2)}px "Fira Code"`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(fl.text, fx, fy);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }

      // ── Coin-spill particles — gold scatter when the player takes damage.
      //    Sonic-style death throes: as a coin nears the end of its life it
      //    deteriorates — shrinking, fading, and vibrating faster and faster
      //    before it blinks out. `decay` runs 0 (fresh) → 1 (about to vanish). ─
      for (const c of g.coins) {
        // Vibrate harder the closer the coin is to disappearing.
        const decay = 1 - Math.min(1, c.life / Math.max(1, c.maxLife));
        const jitter = decay * decay * 2.4;
        const cx = c.x + ox + (Math.random() - 0.5) * jitter;
        const cy = c.y + oy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * jitter;
        if (cx < -20 || cx > cw + 20 || cy < -20 || cy > ch + 20) continue;
        // Fade over the last third of life; flicker on/off in the final frames.
        let cAlpha = Math.min(1, c.life / 16);
        if (decay > 0.82 && g.frame % 2 === 0) cAlpha *= 0.35;
        const shrink = 1 - decay * 0.55;            // deteriorate / diminish
        const wob = 0.35 + Math.abs(Math.cos(c.rot)) * 0.65;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = cAlpha;
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ffcc33'; ctx.shadowBlur = 5 * (1 - decay * 0.6);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd23f';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, 3 * wob * shrink, 3 * shrink, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,247,200,.9)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx - 0.6, cy - 0.6, 1.1 * wob * shrink, 1.1 * shrink, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.restore();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      // ── FOG OF WAR — dark shroud revealed by player exploration ─────────────
      const FOG_TILE = 80;
      const fogRevealRadius = 3 + Math.floor((g.perception ?? 5) / 3);
      const ptx = Math.floor(g.px / FOG_TILE), pty = Math.floor(g.py / FOG_TILE);
      for (let dy = -fogRevealRadius; dy <= fogRevealRadius; dy++) {
        for (let dx = -fogRevealRadius; dx <= fogRevealRadius; dx++) {
          if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= fogRevealRadius*fogRevealRadius + 1) {
            g.fogRevealed.add(`${ptx+dx},${pty+dy}`);
          }
        }
      }
      const fogCamX = g.cam.x, fogCamY = g.cam.y;
      const fogStartTX = Math.floor(fogCamX / FOG_TILE);
      const fogStartTY = Math.floor(fogCamY / FOG_TILE);
      const fogEndTX = Math.ceil((fogCamX + cw) / FOG_TILE);
      const fogEndTY = Math.ceil((fogCamY + ch) / FOG_TILE);
      for (let fty = fogStartTY; fty <= fogEndTY; fty++) {
        for (let ftx = fogStartTX; ftx <= fogEndTX; ftx++) {
          if (!g.fogRevealed.has(`${ftx},${fty}`)) {
            const sx = ftx * FOG_TILE - fogCamX, sy = fty * FOG_TILE - fogCamY;
            ctx.fillStyle = isNight ? 'rgba(5,8,25,.8)' : 'rgba(20,15,10,.65)';
            ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, FOG_TILE, FOG_TILE);
          }
        }
      }
      // ── POISON GAS FOG — toxic shroud drowning the unliberated land ──
      {
        const GAS_TILE = 96;
        const gCamX = g.cam.x, gCamY = g.cam.y;
        const _fHb = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === g.hamletBuildingId);
        const _fHomeCx = _fHb ? _fHb.x + _fHb.w / 2 : null;
        const _fHomeCy = _fHb ? _fHb.y + _fHb.h / 2 : null;
        const gStartTX = Math.floor(gCamX / GAS_TILE), gStartTY = Math.floor(gCamY / GAS_TILE);
        const gEndTX = Math.ceil((gCamX + cw) / GAS_TILE), gEndTY = Math.ceil((gCamY + ch) / GAS_TILE);
        const gasPulse = 0.04 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 900);
        for (let gty = gStartTY; gty <= gEndTY; gty++) {
          for (let gtx = gStartTX; gtx <= gEndTX; gtx++) {
            const wcx = gtx * GAS_TILE + GAS_TILE / 2, wcy = gty * GAS_TILE + GAS_TILE / 2;
            if (!gasSafeZone(wcx, wcy, _fHomeCx, _fHomeCy)) {
              const sx = gtx * GAS_TILE - gCamX, sy = gty * GAS_TILE - gCamY;
              const jit = (((gtx * 73856093) ^ (gty * 19349663)) & 255) / 255 * 0.05;
              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(120,168,46,${0.17 + gasPulse + jit})`;
              ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, GAS_TILE, GAS_TILE);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      // ── Interior transition fade overlay ──
      if (g.interiorFade > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${g.interiorFade})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw * 4, ch * 4);
      }

      // ── Atmospheric depth fog ──────────────────────────────────────────
      // Player-centred haze giving the city aerial perspective: crisp near
      // the camera, fading into a painterly noir haze with distance. Faint
      // by day, much stronger at night to match the concept art. A single
      // cheap radial gradient — no per-building cost. Same world-space idiom
      // as the night pass below: full screen is (0,0,cw,ch) and a world
      // point (wx,wy) draws at (wx+ox, wy+oy).
      {
        const fogNight = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (0.9 - dayBright) / 0.6));
        const fogStr = 0.06 + fogNight * 0.22;
        // Haze colour blends from a pale cool grey-blue by day to a muted
        // luminous indigo at night, so distant buildings melt into the haze
        // (painterly) rather than crushing to black.
        const hr = Math.round(170 - fogNight * 126);
        const hg = Math.round(180 - fogNight * 126);
        const hb = Math.round(195 - fogNight * 109);
        const fpx = g.px + ox, fpy = g.py + oy;
        const clearR = Math.min(cw, ch) * 0.30;   // crisp bubble around player
        const fogR = Math.max(cw, ch) * 0.82;     // haze saturates by here
        const fgr = ctx.createRadialGradient(fpx, fpy, clearR, fpx, fpy, fogR);
        fgr.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${hr},${hg},${hb},0)`);
        fgr.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${hr},${hg},${hb},${fogStr})`);
        ctx.fillStyle = fgr;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
      }

      // ── Light / dark atmosphere (night-gated) ──────────────────────────
      // Layered mood pass composited over the city in world space: an edge
      // vignette darkens the periphery, a warm lantern pool follows the
      // player, and additive neon/fluorescent glows bloom over buildings.
      // Fully gated on darkness so daytime stays byte-identical.
      {
        const gq = gfxQualityRef.current;
        const lume = isNight ? 1 : isDusk ? 0.55 : isDawn ? 0.4 : 0;
        if (lume > 0.01 && gq.nightLighting) {
          ctx.save();
          // Edge vignette — dark corners frame a brighter core.
          const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
            cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.min(cw, ch) * 0.34,
            cw / 2, ch / 2, Math.max(cw, ch) * 0.74,
          );
          vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(4,6,16,0)');
          // Edge alpha kept modest because the existing post-restore flat
          // night tint (rgba(8,12,45,0.28)) stacks on top of this vignette.
          vg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(3,5,14,${0.34 * lume})`);
          ctx.fillStyle = vg;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);

          // Additive light sources.
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

          // Player lantern — a warm pool that tracks the player.
          const psx = g.px + ox, psy = g.py + oy;
          const pl = ctx.createRadialGradient(psx, psy - 4, 6, psx, psy - 4, 150);
          pl.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,224,176,${0.22 * lume})`);
          pl.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255,206,150,${0.08 * lume})`);
          pl.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,206,150,0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = pl;
          ctx.fillRect(psx - 150, psy - 154, 300, 300);

          // Neon / fluorescent building glows — colour seeded per building,
          // with a subtle fluorescent flicker. Culled to on-screen footprints.
          // During rain the road turns reflective, so the same seeded neon
          // colour also smears into vertical wet-street reflections below.
          const isWet = weatherEffectsEnabled(g.weatherQuality) && (g.calendar.weather === 'RAIN' || g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN');

          // Player lantern puddle reflection — when the road is wet the warm
          // lantern catches in the puddles directly below the player as a soft
          // vertical shimmer that tracks them. Reuses the lantern colour and the
          // night-gated `lume`, so it brightens at night and fades out by day;
          // gated on rain so it vanishes the moment the rain stops. Two thin
          // gradient columns with a gentle horizontal wobble read as a rippled
          // reflection. Cheap linear-gradient fills, still additive ('lighter').
          if (isWet) {
            const refH = 96;
            for (let s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
              const sw = 18 - s * 8;
              const wob = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.06 + s * 1.7) * 3;
              const rsx = psx + wob;
              const a = (0.16 - s * 0.06) * lume;
              const rg3 = ctx.createLinearGradient(rsx, psy, rsx, psy + refH);
              rg3.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,222,170,${a})`);
              rg3.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(255,206,150,${a * 0.45})`);
              rg3.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,206,150,0)');
              ctx.fillStyle = rg3;
              ctx.fillRect(rsx - sw / 2, psy, sw, refH);
            }
          }
          // Bloom / glow gate (Settings -> Display): the additive neon building
          // glows + ground pools + wet reflections are the most expensive
          // ambient pass, so disabling Bloom skips them entirely. Default ON
          // keeps the full noir look. Vignette + lantern (above) stay.
          if (g.bloom) for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
            const bx = b.x + ox, by = b.y + oy;
            if (bx < -80 || bx > cw + 80 || by < -80 || by > ch + 80) continue;
            const hsh = tileHash(b.x, b.y);
            const col =
              hsh < 0.30 ? [70, 200, 255] :
              hsh < 0.55 ? [255, 80, 150] :
              hsh < 0.78 ? [180, 110, 255] :
                           [120, 255, 200];
            const flick = 0.84 + 0.16 * Math.sin(g.frame * 0.07 + b.x * 0.5);
            const inten = lume * flick * (0.5 + 0.5 * hsh);
            const R = 44 + hsh * 34;
            // Neon building glow — heaviest per-building pass; skipped when the
            // player turns "Bloom / glow" off (Settings → Display → VISUAL).
            if (gq.bloom) {
              const gr = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 3, bx, by, R);
              gr.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.17 * inten})`);
              gr.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0)`);
              ctx.fillStyle = gr;
              ctx.fillRect(bx - R, by - R, R * 2, R * 2);
            }

            // Neon ground-glow pool — coloured light from the building's lit
            // signage spilling onto the road/ground at its base. Flattened
            // into a shallow ellipse so it reads as a pool on the street.
            // Composite is still 'lighter' here (additive); the save only
            // brackets the temporary squash transform.
            const gpx = bx + b.w / 2, gpy = by + b.h;
            // Coloured ground-glow pool — skipped when the player turns
            // "Ground glow" off (Settings → Display → VISUAL). gpx/gpy stay
            // defined for the wet-street reflection below.
            if (gq.groundGlow) {
              const gpR = b.w * 0.55 + 24 + hsh * 16;
              const gp = ctx.createRadialGradient(gpx, gpy, 2, gpx, gpy, gpR);
              gp.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.15 * inten})`);
              gp.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${0.06 * inten})`);
              gp.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0)`);
              ctx.save();
              ctx.translate(gpx, gpy);
              ctx.scale(1, 0.4);
              ctx.translate(-gpx, -gpy);
              ctx.fillStyle = gp;
              ctx.fillRect(gpx - gpR, gpy - gpR, gpR * 2, gpR * 2);
              ctx.restore();
            }

            // Wet-street neon reflection — during rain the road mirrors the
            // building's lit signage as soft vertical streaks running down from
            // its base. A few thin gradient columns with a gentle horizontal
            // wobble read as a rippled reflection. Reuses the seeded colour and
            // the night-gated `inten`, so the smear is brightest at night and
            // fades out by day; gated on rain so it disappears when it stops.
            if (isWet) {
              const refH = b.h + 46 + hsh * 36;
              for (let s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
                const sw = 6 + s * 3;
                const sxOff = (s - 1) * (b.w * 0.24);
                const wob = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05 + b.x * 0.3 + s) * 2.5;
                const sx = gpx + sxOff + wob;
                const a = (0.11 - s * 0.025) * inten;
                const rg2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, gpy, sx, gpy + refH);
                rg2.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${a})`);
                rg2.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},${a * 0.4})`);
                rg2.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${col[0]},${col[1]},${col[2]},0)`);
                ctx.fillStyle = rg2;
                ctx.fillRect(sx - sw / 2, gpy, sw, refH);
              }
            }
          }

          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      ctx.restore();

      // Flat night / dusk / dawn tint — stacks on the atmosphere block above and
      // is part of the same "Night lighting" quality control, so it's skipped
      // when that pass is turned off (or under low-graphics mode).
      if (gfxQualityRef.current.nightLighting) {
        if (isNight) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(8,12,45,0.28)`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
        } else if (isDusk) {
          const duskT = (wt - 17) / 2;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(60,20,10,${0.08 + duskT * 0.15})`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(20,5,40,${duskT * 0.12})`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
        } else if (isDawn) {
          const dawnT = (wt - 5) / 2;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(60,30,10,${0.06 * (1 - dawnT)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(80,50,20,${0.04 * (1 - dawnT)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
        }
      }

      // ── Sun & moon (screen-space sky bodies) ───────────────────────────
      // The world is an isometric top-down view, so the sun and moon are drawn
      // as a screen-space overlay arcing across the upper band of the viewport
      // in lockstep with the world clock (`sky` from getSkyState). Each body
      // travels east (screen-left) → west (screen-right) and rises/sets along a
      // sine arc. Drawn after the night tint so the sun/moon stay bright; the
      // glow is additive ('lighter'). Cheap (a couple of radial gradients), so
      // it isn't gated behind the heavy night-lighting quality toggle.
      {
        const horizonY = ch * 0.80;       // where a body sits at the horizon
        const zenithY = ch * 0.10;         // where a body sits at its peak
        const arcLeft = cw * 0.10, arcRight = cw * 0.90;
        const bodyScreen = (b: { x: number; altitude: number }) => ({
          x: arcLeft + (arcRight - arcLeft) * b.x,
          y: horizonY - (horizonY - zenithY) * b.altitude,
        });
        ctx.save();
        if (sky.sun.visible) {
          const { x: sx, y: syy } = bodyScreen(sky.sun);
          // Low-sun (dawn/dusk) sun reddens; high noon sun is warm white-gold.
          const warm = 1 - sky.sun.altitude;            // 0 noon → 1 horizon
          const cr = 255;
          const cg = Math.round(220 - warm * 90);
          const cb = Math.round(140 - warm * 110);
          const R = 17;
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
          const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, syy, R * 0.4, sx, syy, R * 5);
          glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${cr},${cg},${cb},0.55)`);
          glow.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(${cr},${cg},${cb},0.20)`);
          glow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${cr},${cg},${cb},0)`);
          ctx.fillStyle = glow;
          ctx.fillRect(sx - R * 5, syy - R * 5, R * 10, R * 10);
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${cr},${cg},${cb})`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, syy, R, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,250,235,0.85)`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, syy, R * 0.62, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
        if (sky.moon.visible) {
          const { x: mx, y: myy } = bodyScreen(sky.moon);
          const R = 13;
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
          const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx, myy, R * 0.5, mx, myy, R * 4.5);
          glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(200,215,245,0.40)`);
          glow.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(180,200,240,0.14)`);
          glow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(180,200,240,0)`);
          ctx.fillStyle = glow;
          ctx.fillRect(mx - R * 4.5, myy - R * 4.5, R * 9, R * 9);
          ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
          ctx.fillStyle = '#dfe6f5';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, myy, R, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          // A few craters for character.
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,162,190,0.55)';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx - R * 0.35, myy - R * 0.2, R * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + R * 0.3, myy + R * 0.25, R * 0.16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx + R * 0.1, myy - R * 0.4, R * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Puddle ripple rings — expanding stroked ellipses on the road where
      // raindrops land. World-space (converted via ox/oy), squashed to read as
      // ground-plane circles, viewport-culled, and faded by remaining life so
      // they linger and clear out when the rain stops. Acid rain tints green.
      if (g.rainRipples.length) {
        const isAcidR = g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (const rp of g.rainRipples) {
          const sx = rp.x + ox, sy = rp.y + oy;
          if (sx < -20 || sx > cw + 20 || sy < -20 || sy > ch + 20) continue;
          const t = rp.life / rp.maxLife;
          const a = Math.min(1, t * 1.2) * 0.28;
          ctx.strokeStyle = isAcidR ? `rgba(150,230,40,${a})` : `rgba(140,180,245,${a})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(sx, sy, rp.r, rp.r * 0.42, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
          if (rp.r > 3) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = isAcidR ? `rgba(150,230,40,${a * 0.5})` : `rgba(140,180,245,${a * 0.5})`;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(sx, sy, rp.r * 0.55, rp.r * 0.55 * 0.42, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }

      for (const wp of g.weatherParticles) {
        if (g.calendar.weather === 'RAIN' || g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN') {
          const spd = Math.abs(wp.vy) / 6;
          const isAcid = g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN';
          ctx.strokeStyle = isAcid ? `rgba(180,255,50,${0.5 + spd * 0.15})` : `rgba(150,190,255,${0.45 + spd * 0.12})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(wp.x, wp.y); ctx.lineTo(wp.x - 1.5, wp.y - 8 * spd); ctx.stroke();
          if (wp.y > ch - 30) {
            const splashR = 2 + Math.random() * 2;
            ctx.strokeStyle = isAcid ? `rgba(160,230,40,0.25)` : `rgba(130,170,240,0.2)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(wp.x, wp.y, splashR, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
          }
        } else if (g.calendar.weather === 'SNOW') {
          const snowSize = 1.5 + Math.sin(wp.x * 0.1 + wp.y * 0.05) * 0.5;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(235,240,255,0.65)`;
          ctx.fillRect(wp.x - snowSize, wp.y - snowSize, snowSize * 2, snowSize * 2);
        }
      }
      if (g.calendar.weather === 'RAIN' || g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN') {
        const isAcid = g.calendar.weather === 'ACID_RAIN';
        ctx.fillStyle = isAcid ? `rgba(100,180,30,0.04)` : `rgba(80,120,200,0.03)`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, ch - 40, cw, 40);
      }
      if (g.calendar.weather === 'SNOW') {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(230,235,245,0.06)`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
      }

      // ── Radiation zone overlays ───────────────────────────────────────────
      for (const rz of RADIATION_ZONES) {
        const rzx = rz.x + ox, rzy = rz.y + oy;
        if (rzx + rz.w < 0 || rzx > cw || rzy + rz.h < 0 || rzy > ch) continue;
        const rcx = rzx + rz.w / 2, rcy = rzy + rz.h / 2;
        const rzRadius = Math.max(rz.w, rz.h) / 2;
        const rzGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(rcx, rcy, 0, rcx, rcy, rzRadius);
        rzGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(40,255,40,${0.06 * rz.intensity})`);
        rzGrad.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(40,255,40,${0.03 * rz.intensity})`);
        rzGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(40,255,40,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = rzGrad; ctx.fillRect(rzx, rzy, rz.w, rz.h);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(40,255,40,${0.12 * rz.intensity})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.setLineDash([6, 8]);
        ctx.strokeRect(rzx, rzy, rz.w, rz.h); ctx.setLineDash([]);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(40,255,40,${0.15 * rz.intensity})`; ctx.font = '8px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(`☢ ${rz.label}`, rcx, rzy + 12);
      }

      // ── Treasure chests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
      for (const tc of TREASURE_CHESTS) {
        if (g.openedChests.has(tc.id)) continue;
        const tcx = tc.x + ox, tcy = tc.y + oy;
        if (tcx < -15 || tcx > cw + 15 || tcy < -15 || tcy > ch + 15) continue;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B6914'; ctx.fillRect(tcx - 6, tcy - 4, 12, 8);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#DAA520'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(tcx - 6, tcy - 4, 12, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700'; ctx.fillRect(tcx - 1, tcy - 1, 2, 2);
        const tcDist = Math.hypot(g.px - tc.x, g.py - tc.y);
        if (tcDist < 50) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#FFD700' : 'rgba(255,215,0,.4)';
          ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText('[E] OPEN', tcx, tcy - 10);
        }
      }

      // ── Resource nodes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      for (const rn of resourceNodesRef.current) {
        if (g.interior) continue;
        const rnx = rn.worldX + ox, rny = rn.worldY + oy;
        if (rnx < -30 || rnx > cw + 30 || rny < -30 || rny > ch + 30) continue;
        const depleted = rn.status === 'depleted';
        const rdef = getResourceDef(rn.resourceId);
        if (!rdef) continue;
        const col = depleted ? 'rgba(120,120,120,.45)' : rdef.color;
        ctx.fillStyle = col;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(rnx, rny, depleted ? 4 : 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        if (!depleted) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(rnx, rny, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        const rnDist = Math.hypot(g.px - rn.worldX, g.py - rn.worldY);
        if (rnDist < 60 && !depleted) {
          ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#67e8f9' : 'rgba(103,232,249,.55)';
          ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(`[E] ${rdef.name.toUpperCase()}`, rnx, rny - 10);
        }
        if (!depleted) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.7)';
          ctx.font = '9px serif';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(rdef.icon, rnx, rny + 3);
        }
      }
      // ── Assay Office marker ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      {
        const aox = ASSAY_OFFICE_X + ox, aoy = ASSAY_OFFICE_Y + oy;
        if (aox > -30 && aox < cw + 30 && aoy > -30 && aoy < ch + 30) {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
          ctx.fillRect(aox - 5, aoy - 5, 10, 10);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(251,191,36,.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.strokeRect(aox - 5, aoy - 5, 10, 10);
          const aoDist = Math.hypot(g.px - ASSAY_OFFICE_X, g.py - ASSAY_OFFICE_Y);
          if (aoDist < ASSAY_OFFICE_RANGE) {
            ctx.fillStyle = g.blink ? '#fbbf24' : 'rgba(251,191,36,.5)';
            ctx.font = '9px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('[E] ASSAY OFFICE', aox, aoy - 12);
          }
        }
      }

      // ── Sewer travel overlay ──────────────────────────────────────────────
      if (g.inSewer) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.85)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
        const tunnelGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cw/2, ch/2, 0, cw/2, ch/2, 100);
        tunnelGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(20,40,20,.3)');
        tunnelGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,.95)');
        ctx.fillStyle = tunnelGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
        ctx.font = '16px "Fira Code"';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('TRAVERSING SEWER NETWORK...', cw/2, ch/2 - 20);
        ctx.font = '10px "Fira Code"';
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)';
        ctx.fillText('Dark water flows beneath Minx City.', cw/2, ch/2 + 10);
        const pipes = g.frame * 0.05;
        for (let pi = 0; pi < 8; pi++) {
          const py3 = (ch / 8) * pi + Math.sin(pipes + pi * 1.5) * 5;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,80,30,${0.08 + Math.sin(pipes + pi) * 0.04})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let px3 = 0; px3 < cw; px3 += 4) {
            ctx.lineTo(px3, py3 + Math.sin(px3 * 0.02 + pipes) * 3);
          }
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      // ── BANCO OMBRA collector — screen-edge warning indicator ────────────
      // Appears when any collector closes within 150 world units and the
      // player is not inside a safe building (own home or office).
      // Clears automatically when collectors despawn or player enters safety.
      {
        const { shouldWarn: _boWarn, nearDist: boEdNearDist, nearAngle: boEdNearAngle, nearX: boEdNearX, nearY: boEdNearY } = computeBoWarning(
          g.boCollectors, g.px, g.py, g.interior, g.hamletBuildingId ?? '', isOfficeBuilding,
        );
        if (_boWarn) {
            // Fire the alert sound once when the collector first crosses 150 units.
            // Re-arms only after the threat clears (distance >= 150 or collectors despawn).
            if (!g.boCollectorWarned) {
              g.boCollectorWarned = true;
              sfxDebtCollectorAlert();
            }
            const boPulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(g.frame * 0.18);

            // Compute how far off screen-center the collector is in screen space.
            // When the collector is near screen center (player facing them) the
            // banner fades; when the collector is off-screen the banner is full.
            // Arrow always stays at full intensity so the player can still locate them.
            const _scrOffX = boEdNearX + ox - cw / 2;
            const _scrOffY = boEdNearY + oy - ch / 2;
            const _maxReach = Math.hypot(cw / 2, ch / 2);
            const _offCenter = Math.min(Math.hypot(_scrOffX, _scrOffY) / _maxReach, 1);
            // Floor at 0.15 so the banner is never fully invisible
            const bannerFactor = Math.max(0.15, _offCenter);

            ctx.save();

            // Pulsing top-center banner — opacity scales with off-center factor
            const bannerW = 212, bannerH = 22;
            const banX = cw / 2 - bannerW / 2, banY = 14;
            ctx.globalAlpha = (0.85 + boPulse * 0.15) * bannerFactor;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(140,8,8,${0.78 + boPulse * 0.18})`;
            ctx.fillRect(banX, banY, bannerW, bannerH);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,50,50,${0.55 + boPulse * 0.45})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.strokeRect(banX, banY, bannerW, bannerH);
            ctx.shadowColor = '#ff1111'; ctx.shadowBlur = 8 * boPulse * bannerFactor;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(255,${Math.floor(48 + boPulse * 90)},48)`;
            ctx.font = 'bold 10px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('⚠ BANCO OMBRA INCOMING', cw / 2, banY + 15);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

            // Screen-edge directional arrow — clamp the unit vector to the
            // nearest screen edge, then draw a triangle pointing inward.
            // Always drawn at full intensity regardless of bannerFactor.
            const edgeMargin = 30;
            const hw2 = cw / 2 - edgeMargin;
            const hh2 = ch / 2 - edgeMargin;
            const acos2 = Math.cos(boEdNearAngle), asin2 = Math.sin(boEdNearAngle);
            const tX2 = Math.abs(acos2) > 1e-6 ? hw2 / Math.abs(acos2) : Infinity;
            const tY2 = Math.abs(asin2) > 1e-6 ? hh2 / Math.abs(asin2) : Infinity;
            const tEdge = Math.min(tX2, tY2);
            const arrowX = cw / 2 + acos2 * tEdge;
            const arrowY = ch / 2 + asin2 * tEdge;

            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + boPulse * 0.4;
            ctx.shadowColor = '#ff2020'; ctx.shadowBlur = 9 * boPulse;
            ctx.translate(arrowX, arrowY);
            ctx.rotate(boEdNearAngle);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(255,${Math.floor(40 + boPulse * 60)},40)`;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(13, 0); ctx.lineTo(-8, -7); ctx.lineTo(-5, 0); ctx.lineTo(-8, 7); ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

            // Distance label beneath the arrow
            ctx.rotate(-boEdNearAngle);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 + boPulse * 0.3;
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(255,${Math.floor(100 + boPulse * 80)},100)`;
            ctx.font = '7px "Fira Code"';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(boEdNearDist)}u`, 0, 16);

            ctx.restore();
        } else {
          // Collector backed off, player entered safety, or all despawned — re-arm so
          // the alert fires again the next time a collector closes to within 150 units.
          g.boCollectorWarned = false;
        }
      }

      // ── React minimap draw (player-centered, zoomed ~600 world units) ─────
      const mc = minimapRef.current;
      if (mc) {
        const mctx = mc.getContext('2d');
        if (mctx) {
          const mmR = 180;
          const mmD = mmR * 2;
          mc.width = mmD; mc.height = mmD;
          const mmCX = mmR, mmCY = mmR;
          const viewR = 900;
          const scale = mmR / viewR;
          const toMX = (wx: number) => mmCX + (wx - g.px) * scale;
          const toMY = (wy: number) => mmCY + (wy - g.py) * scale;

          mctx.clearRect(0, 0, mmD, mmD);
          mctx.save();
          mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(mmCX, mmCY, mmR, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.clip();

          mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,8,0,.93)'; mctx.fillRect(0, 0, mmD, mmD);
          const cityTopMY = toMY(CITY_TOP);
          const cityBotMY = toMY(CITY_BOTTOM);
          if (cityTopMY > 0) { mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(22,10,0,.88)'; mctx.fillRect(0, 0, mmD, cityTopMY); }
          if (cityBotMY < mmD) { mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(22,10,0,.88)'; mctx.fillRect(0, cityBotMY, mmD, mmD - cityBotMY); }

          for (const gz of GANG_ZONES) { mctx.fillStyle = gz.color.replace('.06', '.3').replace('.05', '.25'); mctx.fillRect(toMX(gz.x), toMY(gz.y), gz.w * scale, gz.h * scale); }

          for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
            const isLk = g.locks.has(b.id) && !!g.locks.get(b.id)?.ownerName;
            mctx.fillStyle = isLk ? 'rgba(255,130,50,.7)' : b.bright ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.9)' : 'rgba(0,180,55,.55)';
            mctx.fillRect(toMX(b.x), toMY(b.y), Math.max(3, b.w * scale), Math.max(2, b.h * scale));
          }

          for (const bb of BILLBOARDS) {
            const bmx = toMX(bb.x), bmy = toMY(bb.y);
            const owned = billboardsDataRef.current.some((d: BillboardData) => d.locationId === bb.locationId && d.ownerPlayerName);
            mctx.fillStyle = owned ? 'rgba(255,0,255,.8)' : 'rgba(0,200,255,.7)';
            mctx.beginPath(); mctx.moveTo(bmx, bmy - 3); mctx.lineTo(bmx + 2.5, bmy); mctx.lineTo(bmx, bmy + 3); mctx.lineTo(bmx - 2.5, bmy); mctx.closePath(); mctx.fill();
          }
          for (const a of CITY_ATMS) {
            const amx = toMX(a.x), amy = toMY(a.y);
            mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.95)';
            mctx.fillRect(amx - 1.6, amy - 1.6, 3.2, 3.2);
          }
          for (const s of CITY_CHARGING_STATIONS) {
            const smx = toMX(s.x), smy = toMY(s.y);
            mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(52,211,238,.95)';
            mctx.fillRect(smx - 1.4, smy - 1.4, 2.8, 2.8);
          }
          for (const p of CITY_GAS_PUMPS) {
            const pmx = toMX(p.x), pmy = toMY(p.y);
            mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,176,32,.95)';
            mctx.fillRect(pmx - 1.4, pmy - 1.4, 2.8, 2.8);
          }

          for (const n of NPCS) {
            const sp = getNpcSchedulePos(n, g.worldTime ?? 0);
            mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,30,.75)'; mctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,220,30,.4)'; mctx.shadowBlur = 3;
            mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(toMX(sp.x), toMY(sp.y), 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.fill();
          }
          mctx.shadowBlur = 0;

          const tPulse = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.12) * 0.4 + 0.6;
          const enemyDetectRange = viewR + (g.perception ?? 5) * 40;
          for (const t of g.threats) {
            const tDist = Math.hypot(t.x - g.px, t.y - g.py);
            if (tDist > enemyDetectRange) continue;
            const tc = THREAT_COL[t.type] ?? '#ff4444';
            mctx.fillStyle = tc; mctx.shadowColor = tc; mctx.shadowBlur = 4 * tPulse;
            mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(toMX(t.x), toMY(t.y), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.fill();
          }
          mctx.shadowBlur = 0;

          if (g.boCollectors.length > 0 && g.wantedLevel > 0) {
            const _mmIntBid = (g.interior as { bid: string } | null)?.bid ?? '';
            const boMmSafe = !!g.interior && (_mmIntBid === g.hamletBuildingId || isOfficeBuilding(_mmIntBid));
            if (!boMmSafe) {
              const bcPulse = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.10) * 0.4 + 0.6;
              for (const bc of g.boCollectors) {
                mctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,30,30,${bcPulse})`; mctx.shadowColor = '#ff2020'; mctx.shadowBlur = 5 * bcPulse;
                mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(toMX(bc.x), toMY(bc.y), 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.fill();
              }
              mctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            }
          }

          for (const [, op] of g.peers) {
            if (op.interiorBid) continue;
            mctx.fillStyle = '#44aaff'; mctx.shadowColor = '#44aaff'; mctx.shadowBlur = 3;
            mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(toMX(op.x), toMY(op.y), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.fill();
          }
          mctx.shadowBlur = 0;

          const qPulse = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.08) * 0.4 + 0.6;
          for (const quest of g.quests) {
            if (quest.completed) continue;
            for (const task of quest.tasks) {
              if (task.done || !task.mapMarker) continue;
              const mx = toMX(task.mapMarker.x), my = toMY(task.mapMarker.y);
              mctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,200,60,${qPulse})`; mctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
              mctx.setLineDash([3, 2]);
              mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(mx, my, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.stroke();
              mctx.setLineDash([]);
              mctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,60,${qPulse * 0.8})`;
              mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(mx, my, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.fill();
            }
          }

          // ── World event waypoints (pulsing colored blips) ─────────────────
          const evPulse = Math.sin(g.frame * 0.14) * 0.4 + 0.6;
          for (const ev of activeWorldEventsRef.current) {
            const emx = toMX(ev.locationX), emy = toMY(ev.locationY);
            const evColor = ev.eventType === 'evt_blackout' ? '#ffe04b'
              : ev.eventType === 'evt_fire' ? '#ff6622'
              : ev.eventType === 'evt_robbery' ? '#ff2233'
              : '#22ee88';
            mctx.save();
            mctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${evColor.replace('#','').match(/.{2}/g)!.map(h=>parseInt(h,16)).join(',')},${evPulse})`;
            mctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(emx, emy, 6 * evPulse, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.stroke();
            mctx.fillStyle = evColor;
            mctx.shadowColor = evColor; mctx.shadowBlur = 5;
            mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(emx, emy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.fill();
            mctx.restore();
          }

          // Fog of war — mark visited cells (perception expands reveal)
          const fogCell = 40;
          const visitR = 160 + (g.perception ?? 5) * 10;
          for (let dx = -visitR; dx <= visitR; dx += fogCell) {
            for (let dy = -visitR; dy <= visitR; dy += fogCell) {
              const cx = Math.floor((g.px + dx) / fogCell);
              const cy = Math.floor((g.py + dy) / fogCell);
              fogGridRef.current.add(`${cx},${cy}`);
            }
          }
          // Draw fog overlay on unvisited cells
          const fogStartX = Math.floor((g.px - viewR) / fogCell);
          const fogEndX = Math.ceil((g.px + viewR) / fogCell);
          const fogStartY = Math.floor((g.py - viewR) / fogCell);
          const fogEndY = Math.ceil((g.py + viewR) / fogCell);
          for (let fcx = fogStartX; fcx <= fogEndX; fcx++) {
            for (let fcy = fogStartY; fcy <= fogEndY; fcy++) {
              if (!fogGridRef.current.has(`${fcx},${fcy}`)) {
                const fx = toMX(fcx * fogCell);
                const fy = toMY(fcy * fogCell);
                mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)';
                mctx.fillRect(fx, fy, fogCell * scale, fogCell * scale);
              }
            }
          }

          // Player — white glowing triangle
          mctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; mctx.shadowColor = '#38bdf8'; mctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          mctx.beginPath(); mctx.moveTo(mmCX, mmCY - 6); mctx.lineTo(mmCX - 4, mmCY + 4); mctx.lineTo(mmCX + 4, mmCY + 4); mctx.closePath(); mctx.fill();
          mctx.shadowBlur = 0;

          // Vignette edge
          const vGrad = mctx.createRadialGradient(mmCX, mmCY, mmR * 0.65, mmCX, mmCY, mmR);
          vGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); vGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,.6)');
          mctx.fillStyle = vGrad; mctx.fillRect(0, 0, mmD, mmD);
          mctx.restore();

          // Circle border
          mctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.45)'; mctx.lineWidth = 2;
          mctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)'; mctx.shadowBlur = 10;
          mctx.beginPath(); mctx.arc(mmCX, mmCY, mmR - 1, 0, Math.PI * 2); mctx.stroke();
          mctx.shadowBlur = 0;

          // Compass labels
          mctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.6)'; mctx.textAlign = 'center'; mctx.font = 'bold 10px "Fira Code",monospace';
          mctx.fillText('N', mmCX, 14);
          mctx.fillText('S', mmCX, mmD - 6);
          mctx.font = '9px "Fira Code",monospace';
          mctx.fillText('W', 10, mmCY + 3);
          mctx.fillText('E', mmD - 10, mmCY + 3);
        }
      }


      if (g.subwayTransit) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.85)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
        ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Fira Code"'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
        ctx.fillText('METRO IN TRANSIT', cw / 2, ch / 2 - 20);
        ctx.font = '14px "Fira Code"'; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,.6)';
        const dest = g.subwayTransitDest?.label ?? '???';
        ctx.fillText(`Destination: ${dest}`, cw / 2, ch / 2 + 10);
        const dots = '.'.repeat((Math.floor(g.frame / 20) % 4) + 1);
        ctx.fillText(`Arriving${dots}`, cw / 2, ch / 2 + 35);
        for (let si = 0; si < 8; si++) {
          const sx = (Math.sin(g.frame * 0.03 + si * 0.8) * 0.5 + 0.5) * cw;
          const sy = ch / 2 + 60 + si * 4;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,248,${0.1 + Math.sin(g.frame * 0.05 + si) * 0.05})`;
          ctx.fillRect(sx - 40, sy, 80, 1);
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      if (g.policeAlertTimer > 0) {
        const alertAlpha = Math.min(0.3, g.policeAlertTimer / 450 * 0.3) * (Math.sin(g.frame * 0.15) * 0.5 + 0.5);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,0,0,${alertAlpha})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, 3); ctx.fillRect(0, ch - 3, cw, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 3, ch); ctx.fillRect(cw - 3, 0, 3, ch);
      }

      // ── Cinematic letterbox (Settings -> Display) ──
      // Black bars framing the in-world story cinematic — the Scene 1 ESCAPE
      // is the only cutscene where the world canvas is the backdrop (the rest
      // are full-screen DOM overlays). Drawn last, in screen space; the HUD is
      // a separate DOM layer above the canvas so buttons stay clear. Default
      // ON matches the Settings label ("Black bars during cutscenes").
      if (g.cinematicLetterbox && g.sceneRun?.phase === 'escape') {
        const barH = cinematicBarHeight(ch);
        if (barH > 0) {
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, barH);
          ctx.fillRect(0, ch - barH, cw, barH);
        }
      }

      scheduleNextFrame();
    };
    rafLoopRef.current = loop;
    scheduleNextFrame();
    startCrowdMurmur(); crowdMurmurActiveRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current);
      animRef.current = 0;
      if (rafLoopRef.current === loop) rafLoopRef.current = null;
      window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
      canvas.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
      stopCrowdMurmur(); crowdMurmurActiveRef.current = false;
      try { localStorage.removeItem('sm_live'); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("salaryman:radio-proximity", { detail: { gain: 1 } }));
    };
  }, [char, speaking]);

  const hpRatio = gs.current.maxHp > 0 ? hp / gs.current.maxHp : 0;
  const hpColor = hpRatio > 0.6 ? '#4ade80' : hpRatio > 0.3 ? '#ffcc00' : hpRatio > 0.15 ? '#ff8800' : '#ff2222';
  const hpGlow = hpRatio > 0.6 ? 'rgba(74,222,128,.5)' : hpRatio > 0.3 ? 'rgba(255,204,0,.5)' : hpRatio > 0.15 ? 'rgba(255,136,0,.5)' : 'rgba(255,0,0,.6)';
  const nearB = near ? BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === near) : null;
  const hudSuppressed = isPeacefulInterior();
  const handleRepairBuilding = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!nearPlayerBuilding || repairingBuilding || nearPlayerBuilding.condition?.state === 'flourishing') return;
    setRepairingBuilding(true);
    setRepairMessage(null);
    const result = await repairBuilding(nearPlayerBuilding.id, 1);
    if (result.building) {
      playerBuildingsRef.current = playerBuildingsRef.current.map((building) =>
        building.id === result.building!.id ? result.building! : building,
      );
      setNearPlayerBuilding(result.building);
      setRepairMessage(`CARE COMPLETE · ${result.building.condition?.state?.toUpperCase() ?? 'UPDATED'}`);
    } else {
      setRepairMessage(result.error ?? 'CARE UNAVAILABLE');
    }
    setRepairingBuilding(false);
    window.setTimeout(() => setRepairMessage(null), 2600);
  }, [nearPlayerBuilding, repairingBuilding]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={gameRef}
      tabIndex={0}
      onClick={() => gameRef.current?.focus()}
      style={{ width: '100vw', height: '100vh', overflow: 'hidden', background: '#060d14', position: 'relative', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", outline: 'none', ...(uiScale !== 1 ? { zoom: uiScale } : {}) }}
    >
      <style>{`
        @keyframes smfade { 0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.85)} 15%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.05)} 60%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)} 100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.03)} }
        @keyframes smblink { 0%,49%{opacity:1} 50%,100%{opacity:0} }
        @keyframes smdream { 0%{opacity:0} 18%{opacity:1} 80%{opacity:1} 100%{opacity:0} }
        @keyframes smdrift { 0%{transform:translateX(-3%) scale(1.05);opacity:.25} 50%{opacity:.5} 100%{transform:translateX(3%) scale(1.12);opacity:.15} }
        @keyframes smzzz { 0%,45%{opacity:.25} 50%,100%{opacity:1} }

      `}</style>
      {/* Canvas — full screen game world. Counter-zoomed against the root's
          UI-scale zoom so the rendered world stays 1:1 while only the HUD
          scales. Net zoom is 1, so pointer math (getBoundingClientRect) and the
          backing-buffer sizing are unaffected. */}
      <canvas ref={canvasRef} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'block', touchAction: 'none', ...(uiScale !== 1 ? { zoom: 1 / uiScale } : {}) }} />

      {nearPlayerBuilding?.condition && !hudSuppressed && !gamePaused && !isDead && (
        <div
          data-testid="building-condition-panel"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            right: 'max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px))',
            bottom: 'max(92px, calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)))',
            zIndex: 180,
            width: 'min(280px, calc(100vw - 28px))',
            padding: '10px 12px',
            border: `1px solid ${nearPlayerBuilding.condition.state === 'rotting' ? 'rgba(190,120,80,.62)' : 'rgba(120,170,130,.42)'}`,
            background: 'rgba(12,14,16,.9)',
            boxShadow: '0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.28)',
            color: 'rgba(235,230,215,.86)',
            fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 12, alignItems: 'baseline' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.58rem', letterSpacing: '.16em', color: '#d7b98e' }}>PLACE CONDITION</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.58rem', letterSpacing: '.12em', color: 'rgba(235,230,215,.55)' }}>
              {nearPlayerBuilding.condition.state.toUpperCase()} · {nearPlayerBuilding.condition.score}/100
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: '.62rem', lineHeight: 1.45, color: 'rgba(235,230,215,.7)' }}>
            {nearPlayerBuilding.condition.cues.repairAction}.
          </div>
          {repairMessage && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 7, fontSize: '.56rem', letterSpacing: '.08em', color: '#a7d7a2' }}>
              {repairMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          {nearPlayerBuilding.condition.state !== 'flourishing' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRepairBuilding}
              disabled={repairingBuilding}
              style={{
                marginTop: 9,
                width: '100%',
                padding: '7px 9px',
                border: '1px solid rgba(167,215,162,.5)',
                background: repairingBuilding ? 'rgba(167,215,162,.08)' : 'rgba(167,215,162,.14)',
                color: '#b8e0b1',
                fontSize: '.58rem',
                letterSpacing: '.13em',
                cursor: repairingBuilding ? 'wait' : 'pointer',
                fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
              }}
            >
              {repairingBuilding ? 'WORKING…' : 'DO ONE CARE JOB'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Adaptive performance prompt ─────────────────────────────────────
          Surfaced by the render-loop FPS watchdog when the frame rate stays
          low on a slow device. Accepting flips on the same low-graphics flag
          the manual Settings toggles use (turns down bloom / ground glow /
          night lighting). Dismissible and shown at most once (decision is
          persisted), so it never nags. */}
      {showPerfPrompt && (
        <div
          data-testid="perf-prompt"
          style={{ position: 'absolute', left: '50%', bottom: 22, transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 8500, maxWidth: 'min(92vw, 440px)', background: 'rgba(8,12,20,.94)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)', boxShadow: '0 0 24px rgba(56,189,248,.18)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '12px 14px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}
        >
          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.7rem', letterSpacing: '.18em', color: '#38bdf8', marginBottom: 4 }}>RUNNING SLOW?</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.62rem', lineHeight: 1.5, color: 'rgba(226,232,240,.8)' }}>
              We noticed the game is struggling on your device. Turn down the heavy visual effects for a smoother experience.
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <button
              data-testid="button-perf-improve"
              onClick={() => {
                setLowGfx(true);
                markPerfPromptDecided();
                setShowPerfPrompt(false);
                gameRef.current?.focus();
              }}
              style={{ background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.18)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.6)', color: '#38bdf8', padding: '7px 14px', fontSize: '.62rem', letterSpacing: '.14em', cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", borderRadius: 4 }}
            >
              IMPROVE PERFORMANCE
            </button>
            <button
              data-testid="button-perf-dismiss"
              onClick={() => {
                markPerfPromptDecided();
                setShowPerfPrompt(false);
                gameRef.current?.focus();
              }}
              style={{ background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.3)', color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.7)', padding: '6px 14px', fontSize: '.58rem', letterSpacing: '.14em', cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", borderRadius: 4 }}
            >
              NO THANKS
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── ASLEEP-AT-DESK OVERLAY ─────────────────────────────────────────
          Salarymen always wake at their terminal between sessions. This
          overlay blocks input until the player chooses to wake up (Go to
          Work) or stays clocked-out (Sleep & Log Out, which writes a save
          and routes them out of MINX CITY). Hidden during the very first
          onboarding so PabloOnboarding can run uncovered. */}
      {/* Collections Facility takes precedence over EVERYTHING else.
          If the player has been arrested with outstanding debt, no other UI
          (asleep overlay, onboarding modals, world canvas) is reachable
          until they work the debt to ƒ0. The CF component handles its own
          state polling and calls onReleased() when the debt clears. */}
      {inCollectionsFacility && (
        <CollectionsFacility onReleased={() => setInCollectionsFacility(false)} />
      )}

      {asleepAtDesk && gs.current.pabloOnboardingDone && !showIntroStory && !inCollectionsFacility && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, zIndex: 9000, background: 'rgba(0,4,10,.92)', backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", color: 'rgba(244,114,182,.85)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '5rem', letterSpacing: '.5em', textShadow: '0 0 24px rgba(244,114,182,.6), 0 0 48px rgba(56,189,248,.3)', animation: 'smblink 2s infinite' }}>z z z</div>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 16, fontSize: '.7rem', letterSpacing: '.3em', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.6)' }}>
            ASLEEP AT TERMINAL — MINX CITY
          </div>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: '.55rem', letterSpacing: '.2em', color: 'rgba(244,114,182,.4)', textAlign: 'center', maxWidth: 380, padding: '0 16px' }}>
            You spawn here every session. Your desk. Your capsule. Your overhead.
          </div>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 28, display: 'flex', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
            <button
              data-testid="button-go-to-work"
              onClick={() => {
                try { sessionStorage.setItem('sm_woke_this_session', '1'); } catch {}
                setAsleepAtDesk(false);
                gameRef.current?.focus();
              }}
              style={{ background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.6)', color: '#38bdf8', padding: '10px 22px', fontSize: '.75rem', letterSpacing: '.2em', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}
            >
              ▶ GO TO WORK
            </button>
            <button
              data-testid="button-sleep-and-logout"
              onClick={() => {
                // Autosave THEN log out. localStorage write is synchronous so
                // local state is durable before the redirect; the cloud save
                // is best-effort but uses navigator.sendBeacon when possible
                // so it survives page unload (regular fetch can be cancelled
                // by the redirect race). Falls back to a short delay only if
                // sendBeacon is unavailable.
                try {
                  const data = buildSaveData();
                  doSaveRef.current(data);
                  try { sessionStorage.removeItem('sm_woke_this_session'); } catch {}
                  const slot = (() => { try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sm_slot') ?? '0', 10) || 0; } catch { return 0; } })();
                  const body = JSON.stringify({ data });
                  let beaconQueued = false;
                  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && typeof navigator.sendBeacon === 'function') {
                    try {
                      const blob = new Blob([body], { type: 'application/json' });
                      beaconQueued = navigator.sendBeacon(`/api/salaryman/saves/${slot}`, blob);
                    } catch {}
                  }
                  // Either way: redirect. If beacon queued, no need to wait;
                  // otherwise give the inflight fetch a moment to land.
                  setTimeout(() => { void signOut({ redirectUrl: import.meta.env.BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/" }); }, beaconQueued ? 50 : 400);
                } catch {
                  void signOut({ redirectUrl: import.meta.env.BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/" });
                }
              }}
              style={{ background: 'rgba(244,114,182,.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(244,114,182,.4)', color: 'rgba(244,114,182,.8)', padding: '10px 22px', fontSize: '.75rem', letterSpacing: '.2em', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}
            >
              ☾ SLEEP &amp; LOG OUT
            </button>
          </div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 18, fontSize: '.45rem', letterSpacing: '.25em', color: 'rgba(120,120,140,.4)' }}>
            AUTOSAVE ACTIVE — TERMINAL VIEW READY
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── GAMEPAD CONNECTED INDICATOR ──────────────────────────────────
          Shown whenever a controller is plugged in, on any device.
          Lets the player know their Xbox/PS5 pad is being read; the
          mappings (left stick=move, A=interact, X=jump, LB/LT=sprint,
          Y=vehicle, RB=park, B=menu) are in src/hooks/useGamepad.ts. */}
      {gamepadState.connected && hudOpen && !gamePaused && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: isTouchDevice ? 6 : 10,
            right: isTouchDevice ? 'auto' : '50%',
            left: isTouchDevice ? '50%' : 'auto',
            transform: isTouchDevice ? 'translateX(-50%)' : 'translateX(50%)',
            zIndex: 150,
            background: 'rgba(0,20,30,.78)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.45)',
            color: '#22d3ee',
            fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)",
            fontSize: '.65rem',
            letterSpacing: '.18em',
            padding: '4px 10px',
            borderRadius: 4,
            boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,.18)',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 6,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: '#22d3ee', boxShadow: '0 0 6px #22d3ee' }} />
          GAMEPAD · {gamepadState.label.split('(')[0].trim().slice(0, 18).toUpperCase() || 'CONTROLLER'}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── MOBILE TOUCH CONTROLS ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {isTouchDevice && hudOpen && showMobileControls && !gamePaused && !isDead && !showMobilePhone && !showMobileBuildingDir && (
        <>
          {/* Analog movement pad. Canvas taps remain available outside it. */}
          <div
            ref={touchStickRef}
            aria-label="Movement joystick"
            role="group"
            onPointerDown={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              touchStickPointerRef.current = e.pointerId;
              e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
              updateTouchMovement(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            }}
            onPointerMove={(e) => {
              if (touchStickPointerRef.current !== e.pointerId) return;
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              updateTouchMovement(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            }}
            onPointerUp={(e) => {
              if (touchStickPointerRef.current !== e.pointerId) return;
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              resetTouchMovement();
            }}
            onPointerCancel={resetTouchMovement}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              bottom: 'calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))',
              left: 'calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px))',
              width: 116,
              height: 116,
              zIndex: 210,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.38)',
              background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(8,47,73,.45), rgba(2,12,22,.72))',
              boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 24px rgba(56,189,248,.12), 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4)',
              touchAction: 'none',
              userSelect: 'none',
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 12, border: '1px dashed rgba(56,189,248,.18)', borderRadius: '50%', pointerEvents: 'none' }} />
            <div
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                left: '50%',
                top: '50%',
                width: 42,
                height: 42,
                marginLeft: -21,
                marginTop: -21,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                border: '2px solid rgba(103,232,249,.72)',
                background: 'rgba(8,47,73,.92)',
                boxShadow: '0 0 14px rgba(34,211,238,.35)',
                transform: `translate(${touchStickOffset.x}px, ${touchStickOffset.y}px)`,
                pointerEvents: 'none',
              }}
            />
            <span style={{ position: 'absolute', left: '50%', bottom: -16, transform: 'translateX(-50%)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.48rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.38)', letterSpacing: '.12em', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
              MOVE · TAP WORLD TO WALK
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons — bottom-right */}
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 'calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))', right: 'calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px))', zIndex: 200, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <button onTouchStart={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'e' })); window.setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: 'e' })), 200); }}
              style={{ width: 60, height: 60, borderRadius: '50%', border: '2px solid rgba(34,211,238,.4)', background: 'rgba(0,20,30,.7)', color: '#22d3ee', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.2rem', fontWeight: 'bold', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation', boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,.15)' }}>
              E
            </button>
            {!hudSuppressed && (
            <button
              onTouchStart={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); startMobileAttack(); }}
              onTouchEnd={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); stopMobileAttack(); }}
              onTouchCancel={() => stopMobileAttack()}
              style={{ width: 76, height: 76, borderRadius: '50%', border: `2px solid rgba(239,68,68,${mobileAtkActive ? '.85' : '.45'})`, background: mobileAtkActive ? 'rgba(120,10,10,.85)' : 'rgba(30,0,0,.7)', color: '#ef4444', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.15rem', fontWeight: 'bold', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation', boxShadow: mobileAtkActive ? '0 0 18px rgba(239,68,68,.5)' : '0 0 10px rgba(239,68,68,.15)', transform: mobileAtkActive ? 'scale(0.93)' : 'scale(1)', transition: 'transform .06s, box-shadow .1s, background .1s' }}>
              ATK
            </button>
            )}
            <button
              onTouchStart={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setMobileSprintActive(true); }}
              onTouchEnd={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setMobileSprintActive(false); }}
              onTouchCancel={() => setMobileSprintActive(false)}
              style={{ width: 46, height: 46, borderRadius: '50%', border: `2px solid rgba(251,191,36,${mobileSprintActive ? '.7' : '.35'})`, background: mobileSprintActive ? 'rgba(251,191,36,.2)' : 'rgba(25,20,0,.7)', color: mobileSprintActive ? '#fbbf24' : 'rgba(251,191,36,.6)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.75rem', fontWeight: 'bold', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation', boxShadow: mobileSprintActive ? '0 0 14px rgba(251,191,36,.3)' : 'none', transition: 'all .1s' }}>
              RUN
            </button>
            {/* Quick actions — the common gameplay shortcuts surfaced as a
                compact grid, with secondary actions tucked behind MORE so the
                screen stays uncluttered. Each button dispatches the SAME
                synthetic key (via pressKey) as its desktop shortcut, or opens
                the existing mobile panel for TEL/INV/DIR. */}
            {mobileQuickOpen && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'flex-end', maxWidth: 150 }}>
                <MobileQuickBtn label="PABLO" color="#22d3ee" onTap={() => pressKey('p')} />
                <MobileQuickBtn label="QUEST" color="#f59e0b" onTap={() => pressKey('q')} />
                <MobileQuickBtn label="VOICE" color="#a855f7" onTap={() => pressKey('v')} />
                <MobileQuickBtn label="RADIO" color="#34d399" onTap={() => pressKey('r')} />
                <MobileQuickBtn label="TEL" color="#38bdf8" onTap={() => setShowMobilePhone(true)} />
                <MobileQuickBtn label="DIR" color="#a855f7" onTap={() => setShowMobileBuildingDir(true)} />
              </div>
            )}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'flex-end', maxWidth: 150 }}>
              <MobileQuickBtn label="MAP" color="#38bdf8" onTap={() => pressKey('m')} />
              <MobileQuickBtn label="CHAT" color="#38bdf8" onTap={() => pressKey('c')} />
              <MobileQuickBtn label="INV" color="#ffd700" onTap={() => setShowInventory(prev => !prev)} />
              <MobileQuickBtn
                label={mobileQuickOpen ? 'LESS' : 'MORE'}
                color="#94a3b8"
                onTap={() => setMobileQuickOpen(v => !v)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Zoom Controls — left edge, middle (kept clear of the right-side action buttons) */}
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 12, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', zIndex: 200, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
            <button onClick={() => { targetZoomRef.current = Math.min(ISO_ZOOM_MAX, targetZoomRef.current + 0.3); }}
              style={{ width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.25)', background: 'rgba(0,10,20,.6)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.2rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation' }}>
              +
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => { targetZoomRef.current = Math.max(ISO_ZOOM_MIN, targetZoomRef.current - 0.3); }}
              style={{ width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.25)', background: 'rgba(0,10,20,.6)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.2rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation' }}>
              −
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* ── MOBILE DIRECTORY (FLOORS + FAST TRAVEL) ─────────────────── */}
      {showMobileBuildingDir && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const bid = g.interior?.bid ?? g.hamletBuildingId;
        const bld = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === bid);
        const dir = BUILDING_FLOORS[bid];
        const bldLabel = bld?.label ?? 'BUILDING';
        const tabStyle = (active: boolean) => ({
          flex: 1, padding: '8px 0', border: 'none', borderBottom: `2px solid ${active ? '#a855f7' : 'transparent'}`,
          background: active ? 'rgba(168,85,247,.08)' : 'transparent',
          color: active ? '#a855f7' : 'rgba(148,163,184,.5)',
          fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" as const, fontSize: '.85rem', letterSpacing: '.1em',
          cursor: 'pointer', WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent' as const, touchAction: 'manipulation' as const,
        });
        return (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, zIndex: 500, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.94)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '10px 16px', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.15)' }}>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.1rem', color: '#a855f7', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>DIRECTORY</div>
              <button onClick={() => setShowMobileBuildingDir(false)}
                style={{ background: 'rgba(255,60,60,.15)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,60,60,.3)', color: '#ff4444', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.9rem', padding: '4px 12px', borderRadius: 6, WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent' }}>
                CLOSE
              </button>
            </div>
