            <div style={{ display: 'flex', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.1)' }}>
              <button onClick={() => setMobileDirTab('floors')} style={tabStyle(mobileDirTab === 'floors')}>FLOORS</button>
              <button onClick={() => setMobileDirTab('travel')} style={tabStyle(mobileDirTab === 'travel')}>FAST TRAVEL</button>
            </div>

            <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
              {mobileDirTab === 'floors' ? (
                <>
                  <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.65rem', color: 'rgba(168,85,247,.4)', letterSpacing: '.08em', marginBottom: 2 }}>{bldLabel}</div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (currentFloor === 0) { setShowMobileBuildingDir(false); return; }
                      const lobbyDef = getInterior(bid);
                      if (lobbyDef && g.interior) {
                        g.interior = { bid, def: { ...lobbyDef, id: bid, label: `${bldLabel} — LOBBY` }, px: lobbyDef.exitX + lobbyDef.exitW / 2, py: lobbyDef.exitY - 20, savedWorldX: g.interior.savedWorldX, savedWorldY: g.interior.savedWorldY };
                        setCurrentFloor(0);
                        setNarr(`> ${bldLabel} — LOBBY`);
                      }
                      setShowMobileBuildingDir(false);
                    }}
                    style={{
                      padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8,
                      border: `1px solid rgba(34,211,238,${currentFloor === 0 ? '.5' : '.15'})`,
                      background: currentFloor === 0 ? 'rgba(34,211,238,.1)' : 'rgba(0,10,20,.6)',
                      color: currentFloor === 0 ? '#22d3ee' : '#e2e8f0',
                      fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', textAlign: 'left',
                      display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
                      WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation',
                    }}>
                    <span>FL 01 — LOBBY</span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '.65rem', color: currentFloor === 0 ? '#22d3ee' : 'rgba(148,163,184,.5)' }}>
                      {currentFloor === 0 ? 'HERE' : 'GO'}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  {dir ? dir.floors.map(fl => {
                    const isCurrent = currentFloor === fl.floor;
                    const isRestricted = fl.restricted;
                    return (
                      <button key={fl.floor}
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (isCurrent) { setShowMobileBuildingDir(false); return; }
                          const _flInfo = FLOOR_PASSWORDS.get(bid)?.get(fl.floor);
                          const _isFloorOwner = !!_flInfo?.owner || (!!_flInfo?.company && !!char.company && _flInfo.company === char.company);
                          if (isRestricted && !_isFloorOwner) { setNarr(`> Floor ${fl.floor} — RESTRICTED. Access denied.`); return; }
                          // Shadow Tower gates — front-door + exec passcodes must be
                          // cleared via the elevator panel (same as desktop), so the
                          // mobile directory can't be used to bypass them.
                          if (bid === 'pablo_tower' && !towerAccess) {
                            sfxError(); setNarr('> ELEVATOR LOBBY — Front-door code required. Use the elevator panel.'); return;
                          }
                          if (isTowerExecFloor(bid, fl.floor) && !execAccess && !_isFloorOwner) {
                            sfxError(); setNarr(`> Floor ${fl.floor} — EXECUTIVE CLEARANCE required. Use the elevator panel.`); return;
                          }
                          if (_flInfo && !_isFloorOwner) {
                            sfxError(); setNarr(`> Floor ${fl.floor} — LOCKED by ${_flInfo.ownerName ?? 'another tenant'}. Use the elevator panel to enter the password.`); return;
                          }
                          if (g.interior) {
                            const offDef = generateFloorInterior(bid, fl, bldLabel);
                            g.interior = { bid, def: { ...offDef, id: bid, label: `${bldLabel} — FL ${String(fl.floor).padStart(2,'0')} ${fl.name ? '— ' + fl.name : ''}` }, px: offDef.exitX + offDef.exitW / 2, py: offDef.exitY - 20, savedWorldX: g.interior.savedWorldX, savedWorldY: g.interior.savedWorldY };
                            setCurrentFloor(fl.floor);
                            setNarr(`> Floor ${fl.floor}${fl.name ? ' — ' + fl.name : ''}`);
                          }
                          setShowMobileBuildingDir(false);
                        }}
                        style={{
                          padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8,
                          border: `1px solid ${isCurrent ? 'rgba(34,211,238,.5)' : isRestricted ? 'rgba(239,68,68,.2)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)'}`,
                          background: isCurrent ? 'rgba(34,211,238,.1)' : isRestricted ? 'rgba(30,0,0,.4)' : 'rgba(0,10,20,.6)',
                          color: isCurrent ? '#22d3ee' : isRestricted ? 'rgba(239,68,68,.5)' : '#e2e8f0',
                          fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', textAlign: 'left',
                          display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
                          WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation',
                          opacity: isRestricted ? 0.6 : 1,
                        }}>
                        <span>FL {String(fl.floor).padStart(2,'0')}{fl.name ? ` — ${fl.name}` : ''}</span>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '.65rem', color: isCurrent ? '#22d3ee' : isRestricted ? 'rgba(239,68,68,.4)' : 'rgba(148,163,184,.5)' }}>
                          {isCurrent ? 'HERE' : isRestricted ? 'LOCKED' : 'GO'}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  }) : (
                    <div style={{ padding: '16px', textAlign: 'center', color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.4)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.75rem' }}>
                      Single-floor building. Walk around to explore.
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.65rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', letterSpacing: '.08em', marginBottom: 2 }}>FAST TRAVEL — WALK TO ANOTHER BUILDING</div>
                  {BUILDINGS.filter(b => b.id !== bid && getInterior(b.id)).map(b => {
                    const isHome = g.hamletBuildingId === b.id;
                    return (
                      <button key={b.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          g.px = b.x + b.w / 2;
                          g.py = b.y + b.h + 20;
                          g.interior = null;
                          g.interiorFade = 0;
                          g.interiorFadeDir = 0;
                          g.interiorFadeCallback = null;
                          setCurrentFloor(0);
                          enterInterior(b.id);
                          setShowMobileBuildingDir(false);
                          setNarr(`> You walk to ${b.label}.`);
                        }}
                        style={{
                          padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8,
                          border: `1px solid ${isHome ? 'rgba(168,85,247,.4)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)'}`,
                          background: isHome ? 'rgba(168,85,247,.08)' : 'rgba(0,10,20,.6)',
                          color: '#e2e8f0',
                          fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', textAlign: 'left',
                          display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
                          WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent', touchAction: 'manipulation',
                        }}>
                        <span>{b.label}</span>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '.65rem', color: isHome ? '#a855f7' : 'rgba(148,163,184,.5)' }}>
                          {isHome ? 'HOME' : 'GO'}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

        const g = gs.current;
        const proximityEvents: string[] = [];

          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 8, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 180, display: 'flex', gap: '8px', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>

                  <line x1="10" y1="14" x2="10" y2="52" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.18)" strokeWidth="0.5" />
                  {/* ferrule + eraser */}
                  <rect x="6.5" y="52" width="7" height="4" fill="#c9b24a" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.3)" strokeWidth="0.4" />

                <g>
                  <defs>
                    <linearGradient id="smKatGrad" x1="0" y1="1" x2="0" y2="0">

                    <rect x="0" y={43 - r * 40} width="20" height={r * 40} fill="url(#smKatGrad)" />
                  </g>
                  <path d="M10 3 L13 43 L7 43 Z" fill="none" stroke="rgba(207,232,255,.8)" strokeWidth="0.7" />
                  <line x1="10" y1="5" x2="12.4" y2="42" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.5)" strokeWidth="0.5" />
                  {/* tsuba (guard) + tsuka (handle) */}
                  <rect x="3" y="43" width="14" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#caa53a" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.4)" strokeWidth="0.5" />
                  <rect x="8" y="46" width="4" height="16" rx="1.4" fill="#1c1410" stroke="rgba(120,90,60,.5)" strokeWidth="0.5" />
                  <line x1="8" y1="50" x2="12" y2="49" stroke="rgba(180,140,90,.5)" strokeWidth="0.5" />
                  <line x1="8" y1="54" x2="12" y2="53" stroke="rgba(180,140,90,.5)" strokeWidth="0.5" />
                  <line x1="8" y1="58" x2="12" y2="57" stroke="rgba(180,140,90,.5)" strokeWidth="0.5" />

          </div>
        );
      })()}
      {/* TOP-LEFT — health bar, wanted, gold, fiat, zone, character class */}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: isTouchDevice ? 6 : 10, left: isTouchDevice ? 6 : 10, zIndex: 100, display: hudSuppressed ? 'none' : 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: isTouchDevice ? '2px' : '4px', maxWidth: isTouchDevice ? 240 : 340, transform: isTouchDevice ? 'scale(0.8)' : 'none', transformOrigin: 'top left' }}>
        {/* ── NET WORTH HUD ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            Net worth replaces the HP arc as the headline player stat.

        {(() => {

          const nw = salary + (gs.current.savings ?? 0) + goldBalance * FIAT_PER_GOLD + propVal - (gs.current.taxDebt ?? 0);
          const comboStep = gs.current.combo?.count ?? 0;
          return (

              netWorth={nw}
              cash={salary}

            { label: 'H', value: hunger, color: hunger <= 30 ? '#ff4422' : 'rgba(255,136,68,.55)' },
            { label: 'T', value: thirst, color: thirst <= 30 ? '#ff4422' : 'rgba(68,170,255,.55)' },

          {(poisoned || gs.current.gasPoison) && (

              fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.55rem',
              color: gs.current.gasPoison ? '#aef25a' : '#d8a0ff',
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',

            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.55rem', color: '#ff9944', letterSpacing: '.06em' }}>DEBT</span>

            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.55rem', color: '#ff9944' }}>TAX DEBT ƒ{gs.current.taxDebt.toLocaleString()}</span>

              {CLASS_DISPLAY_NAME[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? char.class.toUpperCase()} · {empLabel}{empLabel.startsWith('OWNER') && verifiedSalaryStatus?.awaitingVerification ? ' · VISA PENDING' : ''}
            </span>
          </div>

            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.95rem', color: zone.startsWith('WASTELAND') ? '#7dd3fc' : '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.04em' }}>{boomerize(zone, boomerMode)}</span>

            {weatherStr && weatherStr !== 'CLEAR' && (
              <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', color: weatherStr === 'ACID_RAIN' ? '#66ff44' : weatherStr === 'SNOW' ? '#aabbff' : '#6699ff' }}>{weatherStr.replace('_', ' ')}</span>
            )}
            {weatherStr === 'CLEAR' && <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)' }}>CLEAR</span>}
            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', color: (() => { const h = gs.current.worldTime; return (h >= 6 && h < 18) ? '#ffcc44' : '#8899ff'; })() }}>
              {(() => { const wt = gs.current.worldTime; const icon = (wt >= 6 && wt < 18) ? '☀' : '☾'; const hr12 = Math.floor(wt) % 12 || 12; const mins = Math.floor((wt % 1) * 60); const ampm = wt >= 12 && wt < 24 ? 'PM' : 'AM'; return `${icon} ${hr12}:${mins.toString().padStart(2,'0')} ${ampm}`; })()}
            </span>
            <span title={`${quarterLabel(getRealQuarter())} · ${seasonStr} · ${weatherStr.replace('_', ' ')}`} style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.75rem', color: '#ffcc44', borderLeft: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', paddingLeft: '.3rem', letterSpacing: '.04em' }}>
              {quarterLabel(getRealQuarter())} · {seasonStr.slice(0,3)}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.75rem', color: tempC <= 5 ? '#88bbff' : tempC >= 30 ? '#ff8844' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.45)', borderLeft: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', paddingLeft: '.3rem' }}>
              {tempC}°C
            </span>
          </div>
          {calendarStr && (
            <div style={{ background: 'rgba(0,8,0,.92)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.25)', padding: '.25rem .5rem' }}>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.6)', letterSpacing: '.04em' }}>{calendarStr}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {/* Liberation progress compact HUD */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '5px', background: 'rgba(0,8,0,.92)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', padding: '.25rem .5rem' }}>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', letterSpacing: '.08em', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>LIB</span>
          <div style={{ width: 48, height: 4, background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', borderRadius: 1, position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, height: '100%', width: `${liberationProgress}%`, background: liberationProgress >= 75 ? '#ffcc00' : '#38bdf8', borderRadius: 1, transition: 'width 1s ease' }} />
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', color: liberationProgress >= 75 ? '#ffcc00' : '#38bdf8', minWidth: 28, textAlign: 'right' }}>{liberationProgress}%</span>

        <button onClick={() => setGoldStandardToggle(!goldStandardToggle)} style={{ background: goldStandardToggle ? 'rgba(255,215,0,.1)' : 'rgba(0,8,0,.92)', border: `1px solid ${goldStandardToggle ? 'rgba(255,215,0,.5)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.25)'}`, color: goldStandardToggle ? '#FFD700' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.55)', padding: '.25rem .6rem', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.65rem', letterSpacing: '.08em' }}>

            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', color: seasonPassIsPremium ? '#ffcc00' : 'rgba(255,204,0,.55)', letterSpacing: '.06em' }}>
              {seasonPassIsPremium ? '★' : '◆'} Q-PASS LVL {seasonPassLevel}

            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(255,204,0,.3)', letterSpacing: '.04em' }}>

            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </>)}
      </div>

      {/* ── HUD TOGGLE EYE ─ tiny always-visible button to summon controls ── */}
      {!gamePaused && !isDead && (
        <button
          onClick={() => { setHudOpen(v => !v); sfxUIClick(); }}
          title={hudOpen ? 'Hide controls (ESC)' : 'Show controls (ESC)'}
          style={{
            position: 'absolute', top: 8, right: 8, zIndex: 250,
            width: 28, height: 28, borderRadius: '50%',
            background: 'rgba(0,8,12,.7)',
            border: `1px solid rgba(56,189,248,${hudOpen ? '.6' : '.25'})`,
            color: hudOpen ? '#22d3ee' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.55)',
            fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem',
            cursor: 'pointer', WebkitTapHighlightColor: 'transparent',
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            boxShadow: hudOpen ? '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,.4)' : 'none',
            transition: 'all .15s',
          }}
        >{hudOpen ? '◉' : '○'}</button>
      )}

      {/* ── COMMS SHORTCUT ─ always-visible button to open chat / proximity ──
          Mobile already surfaces a CHAT quick-action button; this is the
          desktop equivalent so there is a persistent, visible way into COMMS
          (the keyboard 'C' shortcut still works). Sits left of the speaker
          button (top-right), with a live unread badge. Opening COMMS also lets
          you talk to nearby players via proximity chat. */}
      {!isTouchDevice && !gamePaused && !isDead && (

                  let checkFailed = false;

                    const rr = await apiFetch(`/api/salaryman/dog-name-available?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { credentials: 'include' });
                    if (rr.ok) { const jj = await rr.json(); nameAvailable = jj?.available === true; }
                    else { checkFailed = true; }
                  } catch { checkFailed = true; }

                  // The player may have cancelled (ESC) while the check was in flight.

          position: 'fixed', top: 80, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          padding: '.5rem 1.4rem',
          background: 'rgba(0,8,16,.82)',
          border: `1px solid ${quadrantBanner.q.color}`,
          boxShadow: `0 0 24px ${quadrantBanner.q.color}55`,
          color: quadrantBanner.q.color,
          fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)",
          fontSize: '.85rem',
          letterSpacing: '.22em',
          textAlign: 'center',
          zIndex: 220,
          pointerEvents: 'none',
          animation: 'sm-banner-fade 2.4s ease-in-out forwards',
        }}>
          ▌ ENTERING {quadrantBanner.q.label}
          <div style={{ marginTop: 4, fontSize: '.6rem', letterSpacing: '.14em', color: '#94a3b8' }}>{quadrantBanner.q.blurb}</div>
          <style>{`@keyframes sm-banner-fade { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -8px); } 15% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); } 85% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }`}</style>
        </div>
      )}


      {/* ── PABLO CORP ONBOARDING (first Terminal open) ──
          Defended against re-firing for users who already cleared the
          /immigration intake gate. The immigration page sets sm_save's
          pabloOnboardingDone AND markTutorialDone(); we honor either as
          authoritative. The extra isTutorialDone() check covers the
          sm_save-name-mismatch path where the saved char.name from a
          prior session doesn't match the current char.name (sm_save is
          dropped to null at load, dropping pabloOnboardingDone with it
          — but the tutorialDone localStorage key survives that drop). */}
      {showPablo && !gs.current.pabloOnboardingDone && !showIntroStory && !isTutorialDone() && (
        <PabloOnboarding
          charName={char.name}
          charClass={char.class}
          onComplete={(answers: OnboardingAnswers) => {
            gs.current.pabloOnboardingDone = true;
            gs.current.perception = answers.perception ?? 5;
            const isBiz = answers.bizPath === 'business';
            const statusLine = isBiz
              ? `Filed. ${answers.businessType.toUpperCase()} — ${answers.companyName}. Industry: ${answers.industry}. Contact: ${answers.contactEmail || 'on record'}. Workstation allocated. Don't make me regret this, ${answers.playerName}.`
              : `Filed as unemployed. No payroll, no address. The wastes are your office now, ${answers.playerName}. Try not to die before lunch.`;
            setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'pablo' as const, text: statusLine }]);

            // First-month rent on the desk terminal + sleeping capsule.
            // Comes out of starting savings; any shortfall becomes debt and
            // the tax-collector dispatcher will start sending people. We do
            // this once per player — the server endpoint is idempotent.
            (async () => {
              try {
                const startingBalance = Math.max(0, Math.floor(gs.current.savings ?? 0));
                const r = await apiFetch('/api/onboard-housing/charge', {
                  method: 'POST',
                  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                  credentials: 'include',
                  body: JSON.stringify({ startingBalance }),
                });
                if (!r.ok) return;
                const out = await r.json() as {
                  alreadyCharged: boolean; deskRent: number; capsuleRent: number;
                  paid: number; remainingBalance: number; addedToDebt: number;
                  taxCollectorIncoming: boolean;
                };
                if (out.alreadyCharged) return;
                gs.current.savings = out.remainingBalance;
                if (out.addedToDebt > 0) {
                  setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'pablo' as const, text:
                    `Desk: ƒ${out.deskRent.toLocaleString()}. Capsule: ƒ${out.capsuleRent.toLocaleString()}. ` +
                    `You paid ƒ${out.paid.toLocaleString()}. You owe ƒ${out.addedToDebt.toLocaleString()}. ` +
                    `My collectors know your face now. Don't make them work for it.`
                  }]);
                  setNarr(`> RENT DUE — ƒ${out.addedToDebt.toLocaleString()} added to debt. Tax collectors dispatched.`);
                } else {
                  setPabloMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'pablo' as const, text:
                    `Desk and capsule, paid in full. ƒ${out.paid.toLocaleString()} gone. ` +
                    `Welcome to overhead, ${answers.playerName}.`
                  }]);
                  setNarr(`> RENT PAID — desk + capsule. Remaining: ƒ${out.remainingBalance.toLocaleString()}.`);
                }
                doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
              } catch {
                // Non-fatal: silent if offline. Server will charge on next call.
              }
            })();

            setNarr(isBiz
              ? `> PABLO CORP REGISTRY — ${answers.companyName} filed under ${answers.playerName}. Workstation allocated. Progress saved.`
              : `> PABLO CORP REGISTRY — ${answers.playerName} listed UNEMPLOYED. No protections apply. Progress saved.`);
            sfxSave();
            doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── TERMINAL HUB PANEL ── */}
      {showPablo && gs.current.pabloOnboardingDone && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const VT: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const ST: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const tabS = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
          padding: '.3rem .6rem', border: active ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.7)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.12)',
          background: active ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)' : 'transparent',
          color: active ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', cursor: 'pointer', ...VT, fontSize: '.85rem', letterSpacing: '.08em',
        });
        const StatRow = ({ label, val, col, bar }: { label: string; val: React.ReactNode; col?: string; bar?: number }) => (
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '90px 1fr', gap: '.4rem', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '.18rem' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', letterSpacing: '.1em', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{label}</div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '.4rem' }}>
              <span style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '.9rem', color: col ?? '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.05em' }}>{val}</span>
              {bar !== undefined && (
                <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 4, background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)', maxWidth: 100 }}>
                  <div style={{ height: '100%', width: `${bar}%`, background: bar > 40 ? (col ?? '#38bdf8') : '#ff4444', transition: 'width .3s' }} />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
        const curZone = inCityBounds(g.px, g.py) ? getActiveCityDef().name : 'WASTELAND';
        const propertyValue = (g.propertyDeeds ?? []).reduce((sum: number, d: PropertyDeed) => sum + (d.currentValue ?? d.purchasePrice ?? 0), 0);
        const netWorth = salary + (g.savings ?? 0) + goldBalance * FIAT_PER_GOLD + propertyValue;
        const usdConversion = (netWorth * 0.012).toFixed(2);

        return (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.85)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', zIndex: 250, paddingRight: '3%' }}
            onClick={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) { setShowPablo(false); gs.current.atPublicTerminal = false; setAtPublicTerminal(false); } }}>
            <div style={{ width: 440, maxWidth: '90vw', maxHeight: '88vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', background: 'rgba(0,5,0,.99)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)', boxShadow: '0 0 40px rgba(56,189,248,.08)' }}>

              {/* ── Header ── */}
              <div style={{ padding: '.55rem .85rem', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '1.5rem', color: '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.2em' }}>{atPublicTerminal ? 'PUBLIC TERMINAL' : 'TERMINAL'}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', letterSpacing: '.12em' }}>
                    {`SALARYMAN: ${char.name.toUpperCase()} · ${char.class.toUpperCase()} · LVL ${level}`}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
                  <div style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '.85rem', color: '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.08em' }}>● ONLINE</div>
                  <button onClick={() => { setShowPablo(false); gs.current.atPublicTerminal = false; setAtPublicTerminal(false); }} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '.7rem', display: 'block', marginTop: '.15rem' }}>ESC ✕</button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ── Tabs ── */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '.2rem', padding: '.3rem .5rem', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.12)', flexShrink: 0, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {(['chat','stats','call','crm','city','share','translate','company','audio'] as const).map(t => (
                  <button key={t} onClick={() => {
                    setPabloTab(t);
                    if (t === 'company') fetchOrgData();
                  }} style={tabS(pabloTab === t)}>
                    {t === 'chat' ? '🤖 AI' : t === 'stats' ? '📊 STATS' : t === 'call' ? '📞 CALL' : t === 'crm' ? '📇 CRM' : t === 'share' ? '📺 SHARE' : t === 'translate' ? '🌐 TRANSLATE' : t === 'company' ? '🏢 COMPANY' : t === 'audio' ? '🔊 AUDIO' : '🏙 INFO'}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* ── Body ── */}
              <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', padding: '.65rem .85rem' }}>

                {/* STATS TAB — player stats, net worth, USD conversion — always accessible */}
                {pabloTab === 'stats' && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '.5rem' }}>
                    {isTrial && (
                      <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(255,165,0,.35)', background: 'rgba(255,165,0,.06)', padding: '.3rem .5rem', fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(255,165,0,.7)', letterSpacing: '.08em', marginBottom: '.2rem' }}>
                        ⏳ MX-75 TRIAL · {trialDaysLeft}d REMAINING — After trial, use physical terminals.
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.22)', letterSpacing: '.14em', marginBottom: '.1rem' }}>{salarymanTerm(getSalarymanGender(), 'upper')} STATUS</div>
                    <StatRow label="HP" val={`${Math.floor(hp)}/${g.maxHp}`} col={hpColor} bar={(hp / g.maxHp) * 100} />
                    <StatRow label="HUNGER" val={`${hunger}%`} col={hunger > 50 ? '#f59e0b' : hunger > 25 ? '#fb923c' : '#ef4444'} bar={hunger} />
                    <StatRow label="THIRST" val={`${thirst}%`} col={thirst > 50 ? '#38bdf8' : thirst > 25 ? '#fb923c' : '#ef4444'} bar={thirst} />
                    <StatRow label="ENERGY" val={`${energy}%`} col={energy > 50 ? '#22d3ee' : energy > 25 ? '#fb923c' : '#ef4444'} bar={energy} />
                    <StatRow label="SKILL PTS" val={<><span style={{ color: '#ff88ff' }}>{gs.current.skillPoints ?? 0} SP</span>{gs.current.skillPoints > 0 ? <a href="/skills" style={{ marginLeft: '.4rem', color: 'rgba(255,136,255,.6)', fontSize: '.5rem', letterSpacing: '.05em' }}>SPEND →</a> : null}</>} col="#ff88ff" />
                    <StatRow label="DEF" val={(CLASS_STATS[char.class.toLowerCase()] ?? CLASS_STATS.corporate).defBonus} col="#44aaff" />
                    <StatRow label="PERCEPTION" val={gs.current.perception ?? 5} col="#cc88ff" />
                    {poisoned && <StatRow label="STATUS" val="POISONED" col="#7dd3fc" />}
                    <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', paddingTop: '.4rem', marginTop: '.2rem' }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(255,215,0,.35)', letterSpacing: '.14em', marginBottom: '.25rem' }}>FINANCES</div>
                      <StatRow label="EMPLOYMENT" val={`${empLabel}${empLabel.startsWith('OWNER') && verifiedSalaryStatus?.awaitingVerification ? ' · WORK VISA PENDING' : ''}`} col={empLabel.startsWith('OWNER') ? (verifiedSalaryStatus?.awaitingVerification ? '#fbbf24' : '#88cc44') : empLabel !== 'UNEMPLOYED' ? '#67e8f9' : '#ff6644'} />
                      <StatRow label="CHECKING" val={`ƒ${salary.toLocaleString()}`} col="#38bdf8" />
                      <StatRow label="SAVINGS" val={`ƒ${(g.savings ?? 0).toLocaleString()}`} col="#38bdf8" />
                      <StatRow label="GOLD" val={`${goldBalance}oz (ƒ${(goldBalance * FIAT_PER_GOLD).toLocaleString()})`} col="#FFD700" />
                      {propertyValue > 0 && <StatRow label="PROPERTY" val={`ƒ${propertyValue.toLocaleString()}`} col="#cc88ff" />}
                      <StatRow label="NET WORTH" val={`ƒ${netWorth.toLocaleString()}`} col="#FFD700" />
                      <StatRow label="USD VALUE" val={`~$${usdConversion}`} col="#67e8f9" />
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', paddingTop: '.4rem', marginTop: '.2rem' }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.22)', letterSpacing: '.14em', marginBottom: '.25rem' }}>LOCATION</div>
                      <StatRow label="ZONE" val={curZone} col={curZone === getActiveCityDef().name ? '#38bdf8' : '#7dd3fc'} />
                      {calendarStr && <StatRow label="CALENDAR" val={calendarStr} />}
                      {weatherStr && <StatRow label="WEATHER" val={weatherStr.replace('_', ' ')} col={weatherStr === 'ACID_RAIN' ? '#66ff44' : weatherStr === 'SNOW' ? '#aabbff' : '#38bdf8'} />}
                      <StatRow label="SEASON" val={seasonStr} col={seasonStr === 'WINTER' ? '#88bbff' : seasonStr === 'SUMMER' ? '#ff8844' : '#38bdf8'} />
                      <StatRow label="TEMP" val={`${tempC}°C`} col={tempC <= 5 ? '#88bbff' : tempC >= 30 ? '#ff8844' : '#38bdf8'} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* PHONE CALL TAB */}
                {pabloTab === 'call' && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '.5rem' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.22)', letterSpacing: '.14em', marginBottom: '.1rem' }}>TTC · THE TELEPHONE COMPANY</div>
                    {phoneCall.status === 'incoming' && (
                      <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(255,100,100,.5)', background: 'rgba(255,50,50,.08)', padding: '.5rem', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '.35rem' }}>
                        <div style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '1rem', color: '#ff6644', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>INCOMING CALL</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '.6rem', color: 'rgba(255,100,100,.8)' }}>From: {phoneCall.peerName}</div>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '.4rem' }}>
                          <button onClick={() => phoneCall.peerId && handlePhoneCallAccept(phoneCall.peerId)} style={{ flex: 1, padding: '.35rem', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)', color: '#38bdf8', cursor: 'pointer', ...VT, fontSize: '.85rem' }}>ACCEPT</button>
                          <button onClick={() => phoneCall.peerId && handlePhoneCallDecline(phoneCall.peerId)} style={{ flex: 1, padding: '.35rem', background: 'rgba(255,50,50,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,50,50,.4)', color: '#ff4444', cursor: 'pointer', ...VT, fontSize: '.85rem' }}>DECLINE</button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {phoneCall.status === 'ringing' && (
                      <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(255,200,60,.4)', background: 'rgba(255,200,60,.06)', padding: '.5rem', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                        <div style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '1rem', color: '#ffcc44', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>CALLING {phoneCall.peerName}...</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,60,.5)', marginTop: '.3rem' }}>Waiting for answer...</div>
                        <button onClick={handlePhoneCallEnd} style={{ marginTop: '.4rem', padding: '.25rem .6rem', background: 'rgba(255,50,50,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,50,50,.4)', color: '#ff4444', cursor: 'pointer', ...VT, fontSize: '.75rem' }}>CANCEL</button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {phoneCall.status === 'connected' && (
                      <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.06)', padding: '.5rem', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                        <div style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '1rem', color: '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>CONNECTED</div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '.6rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.7)', marginTop: '.2rem' }}>In call with {phoneCall.peerName}</div>
                        <button onClick={() => { handlePhoneCallEnd(); leaveVideoCall(); }} style={{ marginTop: '.4rem', padding: '.3rem .8rem', background: 'rgba(255,50,50,.12)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,50,50,.5)', color: '#ff4444', cursor: 'pointer', ...VT, fontSize: '.85rem' }}>END CALL</button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {phoneCall.status === 'idle' && (
                      <>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', marginBottom: '.2rem' }}>Select a player to call. Both parties must be at a terminal or have a terminal device.</div>
                        {online.length === 0 ? (
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.18)', padding: '.5rem', textAlign: 'center' }}>No other players online.</div>
                        ) : (
                          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '.25rem' }}>
                            {online.map(p => (
                              <button key={p.id} onClick={() => { handlePhoneCallInvite(p.id); upsertCrmContact(p); }} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '.35rem .5rem', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.03)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', color: '#38bdf8', cursor: 'pointer', ...ST, fontSize: '.58rem' }}>
                                <span>{p.name}</span>
                                <span style={{ color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', fontSize: '.48rem' }}>CALL →</span>
                              </button>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </>
                    )}
                    <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', paddingTop: '.4rem', marginTop: '.3rem' }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', letterSpacing: '.12em', marginBottom: '.3rem' }}>TTC · POWER DIALER</div>
                      <PhoneDialer userId={char?.name ?? 'player'} callerName={char?.name ?? undefined} compact />
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', paddingTop: '.3rem', marginTop: '.2rem', fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                      {`TTC ALPHA ${__BUILD_VERSION__} · CRM Power Dialer + PSTN via Twilio`}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* IN-GAME CRM TAB */}
                {pabloTab === 'crm' && (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '.5rem' }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.22)', letterSpacing: '.14em' }}>CONTACTS</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(100,200,255,.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(100,200,255,.25)', padding: '1px 6px', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>IN GAME</div>
                    </div>
                    {crmContacts.length === 0 ? (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.18)', padding: '1rem', textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 1.8 }}>
                        No contacts yet. Interact with other players to add them to your CRM.<br/>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.12)' }}>Contacts are added automatically when you chat, call, or trade with players.</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '.3rem', maxHeight: 300, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                        {crmContacts.map(contact => (
                          <div key={contact.id} style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', padding: '.4rem .5rem', background: crmEditId === contact.id ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.05)' : 'transparent' }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '.2rem' }}>
                              <div>
                                <span style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '.8rem', color: '#38bdf8' }}>{contact.name}</span>
                                <span style={{ fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', marginLeft: '.4rem' }}>{contact.playerClass.toUpperCase()}</span>
                              </div>
                              <button onClick={() => { setCrmEditId(crmEditId === contact.id ? null : contact.id); if (crmEditId !== contact.id) { setCrmNoteInput(contact.notes); setCrmCatInput(contact.category); } }} style={{ fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', padding: '1px 5px', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                                {crmEditId === contact.id ? 'CLOSE' : 'EDIT'}
                              </button>
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.25)', display: 'flex', gap: '.5rem' }}>
                              <span>Met: {new Date(contact.firstMet).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                              <span>Seen: {new Date(contact.lastSeen).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                              <span>×{contact.interactionCount}</span>
                            </div>
                            {contact.tags.length > 0 && (
                              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '.2rem', marginTop: '.2rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                                {contact.tags.map((tag, ti) => (
                                  <span key={ti} style={{ fontSize: '.38rem', padding: '1px 4px', background: 'rgba(100,200,255,.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(100,200,255,.2)', color: 'rgba(100,200,255,.6)' }}>
                                    {tag}
                                    {crmEditId === contact.id && <span onClick={() => setCrmContacts(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === contact.id ? { ...c, tags: c.tags.filter((_, i) => i !== ti) } : c))} style={{ marginLeft: 3, cursor: 'pointer', color: '#ff4444' }}>×</span>}
                                  </span>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {contact.category !== 'general' && (
                              <div style={{ fontSize: '.4rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,60,.4)', marginTop: '.15rem' }}>Category: {contact.category}</div>
                            )}
                            {contact.notes && !crmEditId && (
                              <div style={{ fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', marginTop: '.15rem', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>"{contact.notes}"</div>
                            )}
                            {crmEditId === contact.id && (
                              <div style={{ marginTop: '.3rem', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '.25rem', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', paddingTop: '.3rem' }}>
                                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '.2rem' }}>
                                  <input value={crmTagInput} onChange={e => setCrmTagInput(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => { e.stopPropagation(); if (e.key === 'Enter' && crmTagInput.trim()) { setCrmContacts(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === contact.id ? { ...c, tags: [...c.tags, crmTagInput.trim().toUpperCase()] } : c)); setCrmTagInput(''); } }} placeholder="Add tag..." style={{ flex: 1, background: 'rgba(0,8,0,.9)', border: '1px solid rgba(100,200,255,.2)', color: 'rgba(100,200,255,.7)', fontSize: '.42rem', padding: '2px 5px', outline: 'none', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }} />
                                  <button onClick={() => { if (crmTagInput.trim()) { setCrmContacts(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === contact.id ? { ...c, tags: [...c.tags, crmTagInput.trim().toUpperCase()] } : c)); setCrmTagInput(''); } }} style={{ fontSize: '.38rem', background: 'rgba(100,200,255,.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(100,200,255,.2)', color: 'rgba(100,200,255,.5)', cursor: 'pointer', padding: '1px 5px' }}>+TAG</button>
                                </div>

W.webkitSpeechRecognition) as (new () => { continuous: boolean; interimResults: boolean; lang: string; onresult: ((ev: { results: ArrayLike<{ 0: { transcript: string } }> }) => void) | null; onend: (() => void) | null; onerror: (() => void) | null; start: () => void; stop: () => void }) | undefined;
                        if (!SRCtor) {
                          setTranslatorResult('Speech recognition not supported in this browser.');
                          return;
                        }
                        setTranslatorListening(true);
                        const recognition = new SRCtor();
                        translatorRecRef.current = recognition;
                        recognition.continuous = false;

                        recognition.onresult = (ev) => {

                    try {

              {([[PABLO_PRODUCTS.FREE_TIER.name, ['PABLO', 'World access']], [`${PABLO_PRODUCTS.PRO_TIER.name} — $4–6/mo`, [PABLO_PRODUCTS.PABLO_AI_PRO.short, PABLO_PRODUCTS.LIVE_LISTEN.short, PABLO_PRODUCTS.SCAN_SCREEN.short, PABLO_PRODUCTS.SAY_THIS.short, PABLO_PRODUCTS.CONTACTS.short]]] as [string, string[]][]).map(([t, f]) => (
                <div key={t} style={{ border: t === PABLO_PRODUCTS.FREE_TIER.name ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)', padding: '.7rem', background: t !== PABLO_PRODUCTS.FREE_TIER.name ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.05)' : 'transparent' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.95rem', color: t === PABLO_PRODUCTS.FREE_TIER.name ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.45)' : '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.1em', marginBottom: '.35rem' }}>{t}</div>

                </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '.55rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <button onClick={() => { setShowStore(false); navigate('/pricing'); }} style={{ flex: 1, padding: '.55rem', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.6)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1rem', letterSpacing: '.15em', cursor: 'pointer' }}>{`GET ${PABLO_PRODUCTS.PRO_TIER.name}`}</button>
              <button onClick={() => { setShowStore(false); setNarr(`> PABLO CORP device active [${PABLO_PRODUCTS.FREE_TIER.short}]. Press [P] to open it.`); }} style={{ padding: '.55rem .85rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.18)', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.38)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>{PABLO_PRODUCTS.FREE_TIER.short}</button>
            </div>
            {orgData && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: '.65rem', padding: '.4rem .6rem', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.03)', fontSize: '.48rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
                🏢 Your company <strong style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }}>{orgData.org?.name}</strong> may cover this. Ask your manager to enable company billing in the Terminal → COMPANY tab.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── SHADOW TOWER — OFFICE RENTAL ── */}
      {showOffice && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,3,0,.94)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 300 }}>

            {char.hasBusiness && char.bizType === 'real' && (

              <div style={{ marginBottom: '.8rem', padding: '.4rem .7rem', border: '1px solid rgba(255,200,60,.25)', background: 'rgba(255,200,60,.04)', textAlign: 'center' }}>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '.52rem', color: 'rgba(140,0,220,.7)', letterSpacing: '.08em', marginTop: '.15rem' }}>FLOORS 1–39 — REAL ENTERPRISE LEASE ONLY. FLOOR 40+ RESTRICTED.</div>
              </div>

                {rentedOffice && (
                  <button onClick={() => { const lk = lockMap.get('pablo_tower'); setPwPrompt({ bid: 'pablo_tower', label: 'SHADOW TOWER', mode: lk ? 'enter' : 'set' }); setShowOffice(false); }} style={{ fontSize: '.48rem', padding: '2px 7px', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.22)', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.45)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}>
                    {lockMap.get('pablo_tower') ? '🔒 LOCKED' : 'SET CODE'}

            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '.55rem', marginBottom: '1.1rem' }}>
              {OFFICE_TIERS.map(({ label, price, desc }) => {
                const isRented = rentedOffice === label;
                const canAfford = salary >= price;
                return (
                  <div key={label} style={{ border: isRented ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.65)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.16)', padding: '.7rem', background: isRented ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.06)' : 'transparent', position: 'relative' }}>

                    <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.95rem', color: isRented ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.62)', letterSpacing: '.07em', marginBottom: '.18rem' }}>{label}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '.62rem', color: isRented ? '#38bdf8' : canAfford ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.52)' : 'rgba(255,100,100,.5)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", marginBottom: '.28rem' }}>ƒ{price.toLocaleString()} FIAT</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '.52rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.32)', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>{desc}</div>
                    <button onClick={() => {
                      if (isRented) { localStorage.removeItem('sm_office'); setRentedOffice(null); setNarr('> Lease cancelled.'); return; }
                      if (char.bizType !== 'real') { sfxError(); setNarr('> SHADOW TOWER — Office leases require a registered REAL ENTERPRISE. Fictitious entities operate from storefronts.'); return; }
                      if (!canAfford) { setNarr(`> Need ƒ${price.toLocaleString()} FIAT. Have ƒ${salary.toLocaleString()}.`); return; }
                      const officeSlug = label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_|_$/g, '');
                      void performGameplayFiatAction(`office_lease_${officeSlug}`, `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:office-modal:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`).then(paid => {
                        if (!paid || paid.duplicate) return;
                        recordBizRevenue('office_rent', price);
                        localStorage.setItem('sm_office', label); setRentedOffice(label);
                        setNarr(`> ${label} leased. ƒ${price.toLocaleString()} FIAT deducted. Set a security code from the lease panel.`);
                      });
                    }} style={{ marginTop: '.45rem', width: '100%', padding: '.28rem', background: isRented ? 'rgba(255,50,50,.06)' : canAfford && char.bizType === 'real' ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.07)' : 'transparent', border: isRented ? '1px solid rgba(255,80,80,.28)' : canAfford && char.bizType === 'real' ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.38)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.08)', color: isRented ? 'rgba(255,80,80,.62)' : canAfford && char.bizType === 'real' ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.16)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', letterSpacing: '.08em', cursor: (canAfford && char.bizType === 'real') || isRented ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}>
                      {isRented ? 'CANCEL' : char.bizType !== 'real' ? 'REAL BIZ REQUIRED' : canAfford ? 'RENT' : 'NO FUNDS'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.48rem', color: 'rgba(140,0,220,.35)', lineHeight: 1.7, borderTop: '1px solid rgba(140,0,220,.12)', paddingTop: '.6rem' }}>
              Real enterprise tenants may set a security code. Fictitious entities operate from storefronts — not the tower. Floors 40+ are permanently sealed by order of SENIOR PABLO. Do not inquire about the penthouse.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PASSWORD ── */}
      {pwPrompt && (
        <PwPrompt label={pwPrompt.label} onCancel={() => { setPwPrompt(null); setPendingBid(null); }}
          onOk={pw => { if (pwPrompt.mode === 'set') wsSend({ type: 'building_lock_set', buildingId: pwPrompt.bid, password: pw }); else wsSend({ type: 'building_lock_check', buildingId: pwPrompt.bid, password: pw }); }} />
      )}

      {showWhiteboard && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(3,8,18,.95)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 500 }}>
          <div style={{ width: 420, maxWidth: '92vw', maxHeight: '80vh', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)', background: 'rgba(0,10,0,.98)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <div style={{ padding: '.55rem .85rem', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.3rem', color: '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.15em' }}>WHITEBOARD</div>
              <button onClick={() => setShowWhiteboard(false)} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '.8rem' }}>ESC ✕</button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', padding: '.6rem', minHeight: 200, background: 'rgba(240,240,245,.95)' }}>
              {whiteboardLines.length === 0 && <div style={{ color: 'rgba(100,100,100,.5)', fontSize: '.7rem', fontStyle: 'italic', textAlign: 'center', paddingTop: '2rem' }}>Empty whiteboard. Start writing below.</div>}
              {whiteboardLines.map((line, i) => (
                <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: '.75rem', color: '#1a1a2e', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", lineHeight: 1.6, padding: '2px 4px', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(200,60,60,.15)' }}>{line}</div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ padding: '.5rem', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', display: 'flex', gap: '.4rem' }}>
              <input value={whiteboardInput} onChange={e => setWhiteboardInput(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && whiteboardInput.trim()) { setWhiteboardLines(prev => [...prev, `[${char.name}] ${whiteboardInput.trim()}`]); setWhiteboardInput(''); } }} placeholder="Write on the whiteboard..." autoFocus style={{ flex: 1, padding: '.4rem .5rem', background: 'rgba(0,10,0,.9)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.3)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', outline: 'none' }} />
              <button onClick={() => { if (whiteboardInput.trim()) { setWhiteboardLines(prev => [...prev, `[${char.name}] ${whiteboardInput.trim()}`]); setWhiteboardInput(''); } }} style={{ padding: '.4rem .7rem', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.9rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>POST</button>
              <button onClick={() => setWhiteboardLines([])} style={{ padding: '.4rem .5rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(255,60,60,.3)', color: 'rgba(255,60,60,.6)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>CLEAR</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showScreenShare && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(3,8,18,.95)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 500 }}>
          <div style={{ width: 440, maxWidth: '92vw', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)', background: 'rgba(0,10,0,.98)', padding: '1.4rem' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '.8rem' }}>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.3rem', color: '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.15em' }}>SCREEN SHARE</div>
              <button onClick={() => setShowScreenShare(false)} style={{ background: 'transparent', border: 'none', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '.8rem' }}>ESC ✕</button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', letterSpacing: '.08em', marginBottom: '.6rem' }}>Share a URL or screen content with nearby salarymen</div>
            <input value={screenShareUrl} onChange={e => setScreenShareUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder="Paste URL to share..." autoFocus style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.5rem .6rem', background: 'rgba(0,10,0,.9)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.3)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box', marginBottom: '.6rem' }} />
            {screenShareUrl && (
              <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', background: 'rgba(5,12,22,.5)', padding: '.6rem', marginBottom: '.6rem' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', letterSpacing: '.1em', marginBottom: '.3rem' }}>PREVIEW</div>
                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 200, background: '#0a0a0a', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                  {/^https?:\/\//.test(screenShareUrl) ? (
                    <iframe src={screenShareUrl} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', border: 'none' }} title="Screen Share" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" />
                  ) : (
                    <div style={{ color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)', fontSize: '.7rem' }}>Enter a valid URL to preview</div>
                  )}
                </div>

              <button onClick={() => { if (screenShareUrl.trim()) { setNarr(`> SCREEN SHARE — Broadcasting: ${screenShareUrl.trim()}`); setShowScreenShare(false); } }} style={{ flex: 1, padding: '.45rem', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.95rem', letterSpacing: '.1em', cursor: 'pointer' }}>SHARE</button>
              <button onClick={() => setShowScreenShare(false)} style={{ padding: '.45rem .7rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>CANCEL</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {elevatorPrompt && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(3,8,18,.95)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 500 }}>
          <div style={{ width: 360, maxWidth: '90vw', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.5)', background: 'rgba(0,8,12,.98)', padding: '1.4rem' }}>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.3rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.9)', letterSpacing: '.15em', marginBottom: '.3rem' }}>▲▼ ELEVATOR</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.35)', letterSpacing: '.1em', marginBottom: '.8rem' }}>
              {BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === elevatorPrompt.bid)?.label ?? elevatorPrompt.bid}
            </div>
            {elevatorPrompt.mode === 'select' && (
              <div>

                  if (currentFloor === 0) { setElevatorPrompt(null); setNarr('> Lobby — You are already here.'); return; }
                  const g = gs.current; if (!g.interior) return;
                  const lobbyKey = BUILDING_INTERIOR_MAP[g.interior.bid] ?? '_lobby';
                  const lobbyDef = INTERIOR_DEFS[lobbyKey] ?? INTERIOR_DEFS['_lobby'];
                  g.interior = { bid: g.interior.bid, def: { ...lobbyDef, id: g.interior.bid, label: `${BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === g.interior!.bid)?.label ?? 'BUILDING'} — LOBBY` }, px: lobbyDef.exitX + lobbyDef.exitW / 2, py: lobbyDef.exitY - 20, savedWorldX: g.interior.savedWorldX, savedWorldY: g.interior.savedWorldY };
                  setCurrentFloor(0); setElevatorPrompt(null); setNarr('> Elevator — Returning to lobby.');
                }} style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.45rem .6rem', marginBottom: '.3rem', background: currentFloor === 0 ? 'rgba(0,200,255,.06)' : 'transparent', border: `1px solid rgba(0,200,255,${currentFloor === 0 ? '.25' : '.15'})`, color: `rgba(0,200,255,${currentFloor === 0 ? '.8' : '.6'})`, fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.75rem', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left' }}>FL 01 — LOBBY {currentFloor === 0 ? '(current)' : ''}</button>
                {(() => {
                  const dir = BUILDING_FLOORS[elevatorPrompt.bid];
                  const dirFloors = dir ? dir.floors.filter(f => f.floor > 1).map(f => f.floor) : [2, 3, 4, 5];
                  const floorList = dirFloors.length > 0 ? dirFloors : [2, 3, 4, 5];
                  return floorList.map(fl => {
                    const flInfo = FLOOR_PASSWORDS.get(elevatorPrompt.bid)?.get(fl);
                    const hasPw = !!flInfo;
                    const isFloorOwner = !!flInfo?.owner;
                    const isCurrent = currentFloor === fl;
                    const bfloor = dir?.floors.find(f => f.floor === fl);
                    const floorHasBusiness = !!gs.current.businesses?.some(
                      (biz: OwnedBusiness) => biz.buildingId === elevatorPrompt.bid && biz.floor === fl,
                    );
                    // Corporate/office floors and registered business floors
                    // are never anonymous open-plan space. If a server restart
                    // dropped an in-memory lock, the first visit must restore
                    // the password instead of silently opening the floor.
                    const requiresFloorPassword = isOfficeBuilding(elevatorPrompt.bid) || floorHasBusiness;
                    return (
                      <div key={fl}>
                        <button onClick={() => {
                          if (isCurrent) { setElevatorPrompt(null); setNarr(`> Floor ${fl} — You are already here.`); return; }
                          const _isOrgOwnerOfFloor = !!flInfo?.owner || (!!flInfo?.company && !!char.company && flInfo.company === char.company);
                          if (bfloor?.restricted && !_isOrgOwnerOfFloor) {
                            sfxError(); setNarr(`> ACCESS DENIED — FL ${fl}: ${bfloor.name}. Clearance required.`); setElevatorPrompt(null); return;
                          }
                          // Executive-suite band requires an executive passcode
                          // (cleared once per session) unless you already hold the floor.
                          if (isTowerExecFloor(elevatorPrompt.bid, fl) && !execAccess && !isFloorOwner && !_isOrgOwnerOfFloor) {
                            setElevatorPrompt(prev => prev ? { ...prev, floor: fl, mode: 'exec_pw' } : null); setElevatorPw(''); setElevatorPwError('');
                            return;
                          }
                          if (requiresFloorPassword && !hasPw) {
                            setElevatorPrompt(prev => prev ? { ...prev, floor: fl, mode: 'set_pw' } : null);
                            setElevatorPw('');
                            setElevatorPwError('');
                            setNarr(`> FLOOR ${fl} — This office/business floor requires a password before it can open.`);
                            return;
                          }
                          if (hasPw && !isFloorOwner) {
                            setElevatorPrompt(prev => prev ? { ...prev, floor: fl, mode: 'enter_pw' } : null); setElevatorPw(''); setElevatorPwError('');
                          } else if (hasPw && isFloorOwner) {
                            wsRef.current?.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'floor_lock_check', buildingId: elevatorPrompt.bid, floor: fl, password: '' }));
                          } else {
                            const g = gs.current;
                            if (g.interior) {
                              const offDef = bfloor ? generateFloorInterior(elevatorPrompt.bid, bfloor, dir?.label ?? elevatorPrompt.bid) : INTERIOR_DEFS['_office_floor']!;
                              g.interior = { bid: g.interior.bid, def: { ...offDef, id: g.interior.bid, label: `${BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === g.interior!.bid)?.label ?? 'BUILDING'} — FL ${String(fl).padStart(2,'0')} ${bfloor ? '— ' + bfloor.name : '(VACANT)'}` }, px: offDef.exitX + offDef.exitW / 2, py: offDef.exitY - 20, savedWorldX: g.interior.savedWorldX, savedWorldY: g.interior.savedWorldY };
                            }
                            setCurrentFloor(fl); setElevatorPrompt(null); setNarr(`> Floor ${fl}${bfloor ? ' — ' + bfloor.name : ' — Vacant office'}. Use elevator to claim with a password.`);
                          }
                        }} style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.45rem .6rem', marginBottom: '.3rem', background: isCurrent ? 'rgba(0,200,255,.06)' : bfloor?.restricted ? 'rgba(255,40,40,.04)' : 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${bfloor?.restricted ? 'rgba(255,40,40,.3)' : `rgba(0,200,255,${isCurrent ? '.25' : '.15'})`}`, color: bfloor?.restricted ? 'rgba(255,80,80,.7)' : `rgba(0,200,255,${isCurrent ? '.8' : '.6'})`, fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.75rem', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left' }}>
                          FL {String(fl).padStart(2, '0')} {hasPw && flInfo?.label ? '— ' + flInfo.label.substring(0, 22) : bfloor ? '— ' + bfloor.name.substring(0, 22) : ''} {isCurrent ? '(current)' : bfloor?.restricted ? '🔒 RESTRICTED' : hasPw ? (isFloorOwner ? '🔒 YOUR OFFICE' : `🔒 ${flInfo?.ownerName ?? 'RENTED'}${flInfo?.company ? ' / ' + flInfo.company : ''}`) : isTowerExecFloor(elevatorPrompt.bid, fl) ? '🛡 EXEC SUITE' : 'VACANT'}
                        </button>
                        {!isCurrent && !hasPw && !bfloor?.restricted && !(isTowerExecFloor(elevatorPrompt.bid, fl) && !execAccess) && (

                  <button disabled={orgDoorBusy} onClick={submitOrgDoorSave} style={{ flex: 1, padding: '.4rem', background: 'rgba(0,200,120,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,120,.5)', color: 'rgba(0,200,120,.9)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.9rem', cursor: orgDoorBusy ? 'wait' : 'pointer' }}>{orgDoorBusy ? '…' : (orgDoorPrompt.hasLock ? 'UPDATE LOCK' : 'SET LOCK')}</button>
                  <button onClick={() => setOrgDoorPrompt(null)} style={{ padding: '.4rem .6rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,120,.15)', color: 'rgba(0,200,120,.3)', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.85rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>CANCEL</button>

'wait' : 'pointer' }}>REMOVE LOCK</button>

                              for (const _b of _g.businesses) _b.lastActivityAt = Date.now();

                          setFloorPanel(null);

                          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Welcome. Your accounts are now accessible. PAX PABLO CORP.');

                          setFloorPanel(null);
                          setShowAdminDept(fl.action); frozenRef.current = true;
                          const deptNames: Record<string, string> = { open_records: 'RECORDS & ARCHIVES', open_permits: 'PERMITS & ZONING', open_revenue: 'REVENUE & TAXATION' };
                          setNarr(`> DEPT. OF ${deptNames[fl.action]} — Floor ${fl.floor}. ${fl.desc}`);

                        const g = gs.current;

                        const floorOccupant = g.floorOccupancy?.[floorKey];
                        const isMyOwnedFloor = floorOccupant === char.name;

                        const def = generateFloorInterior(floorPanel.bid, fl, floorPanel.dir.label, isMyOwnedFloor, myBiz?.companyName);
                        g.interiorFade = 0;
                        g.interiorFadeDir = 1;

                      style={{
                        marginTop: '.4rem', width: '100%', padding: '.4rem', cursor: fl.restricted ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',

                        border: `1px solid ${fl.restricted ? 'rgba(255,60,60,.4)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)'}`,

                        fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.8rem', letterSpacing: '.12em',
                      }}
                    >
                      {fl.restricted ? '🔒 RESTRICTED' : `▸ VISIT FLOOR ${fl.floor}`}
                    </button>
                    {!fl.restricted && (() => {
                      const g = gs.current;
                      const floorKey = `${floorPanel.bid}_${fl.floor}`;
                      const floorOccupant = g.floorOccupancy?.[floorKey];
                      const isMyOwnedFloor = floorOccupant === char.name;
                      const unassignedBiz = (g.businesses ?? []).find(b => !b.floor);
                      if (!floorOccupant && unassignedBiz) {
                        return (
                          <button
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              const g2 = gs.current;
                              const fk = `${floorPanel.bid}_${fl.floor}`;
                              if (!g2.floorOccupancy) g2.floorOccupancy = {};
                              g2.floorOccupancy[fk] = char.name;
                              const bizIdx = (g2.businesses ?? []).findIndex(b => !b.floor);
                              if (bizIdx >= 0 && g2.businesses) {
                                g2.businesses[bizIdx] = { ...g2.businesses[bizIdx], buildingId: floorPanel.bid, floor: fl.floor };
                              }
                              setNarr(`> FLOOR ${fl.floor} CLAIMED — "${unassignedBiz.companyName}" is now headquartered here. Key card issued.`);
                              setFloorPanel(prev => prev ? { ...prev, selectedFloor: fi } : null);
                            }}

                          >★ CLAIM FLOOR — {unassignedBiz.companyName}</button>

                      }
                      if (isMyOwnedFloor) {
                        const myBiz2 = (g.businesses ?? []).find(b => b.buildingId === floorPanel.bid && b.floor === fl.floor);
                        return (
                          <button
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              const g2 = gs.current;
                              const fk = `${floorPanel.bid}_${fl.floor}`;

                              if (g2.businesses) {

                                if (bidx >= 0) g2.businesses[bidx] = { ...g2.businesses[bidx], floor: null };

                              setFloorPanel(prev => prev ? { ...prev, selectedFloor: fi } : null);

                    })()}

            })}
            <div style={{ marginTop: '.8rem', fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.2)', textAlign: 'center', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>CLICK FLOOR TO EXPAND · ESC TO EXIT BUILDING</div>

      {/* ── POWER GRID HUD INDICATOR ── */}
      {powerPct < 100 && (

'255,60,60' : '255,140,0'},.5)`, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.8)', padding: '.3rem .55rem', color: powerPct < 30 ? '#ff4444' : '#ffaa00', letterSpacing: '.1em', animation: powerPct < 30 ? 'smfade 0.6s steps(1) infinite alternate' : 'none' }}>
          ⚡ POWER {powerPct}%{powerPct < 30 ? ' — BLACKOUT' : ' — REDUCED'}

      {/* ── BILLS HUD PANEL ── */}
      {(() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const wsRentCost = 500;
        const hasWorkstation = g.ownedItems.has('workstation_furn');
        const loanPrincipal = g.loan ? g.loan.amount : 0;
        const loanInterest = g.loan ? g.loan.interest : 0;
        const loanDue = loanPrincipal + loanInterest;
        const loanOverdue = g.loan && g.frame > g.loan.dueAt;
        const loanPenaltyRate = '5%/cycle';
        const loanPenaltyAmt = loanOverdue ? Math.floor(loanPrincipal * 0.05) : 0;
        const realEstateCount = g.realEstate?.length ?? 0;
        if (!hasWorkstation && !g.loan && realEstateCount <= 0 && !g.officeTerminalRenting) return null;
        const billCol = loanOverdue ? '#ff4444' : '#ffaa00';

          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: powerPct < 100 ? '5.2rem' : '3.5rem', left: '.8rem', zIndex: 200, fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.48rem', border: `1px solid ${billCol}44`, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.85)', padding: '.3rem .55rem', color: billCol, letterSpacing: '.08em', maxWidth: 220 }}>

                {loanOverdue && <div style={{ color: '#ff4444', fontSize: '.42rem' }}>PENALTY: −ƒ{loanPenaltyAmt.toLocaleString()} ({loanPenaltyRate})</div>}
              </>
            )}
            {realEstateCount > 0 && <>
              <div style={{ color: '#cc44ff', fontSize: '.42rem', letterSpacing: '.12em', marginTop: '.15rem' }}>REAL ESTATE PORTFOLIO</div>
              {(() => { const counts: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const r of g.realEstate) counts[r] = (counts[r] ?? 0) + 1; return Object.entries(counts).map(([id, c]) => { const inc = REAL_ESTATE_INCOME[id] ?? 0; const name = VEND_CATALOG.find(v => v.id === 'realestate')?.items.find(i => i.id === id)?.name ?? id.toUpperCase(); return <div key={id} style={{ color: '#67e8f9', fontSize: '.42rem' }}>{name}{c > 1 ? ` x${c}` : ''}: +ƒ{(inc * c).toLocaleString()}/cycle</div>; }); })()}

' (+10% NEON)' : ''}</div>
            </>}

      {/* ── SHADOW RADIO HUD ── The app-wide player lives in OfficeRadio. */}
      <RadioHud visible={radioVisible} on={radioOn} fading={radioFading} topOffset={powerPct < 100 ? '5.2rem' : '3.5rem'} onToggle={handleRadioToggle} />

            </div>

                  const idempotencyKey = stableRequestId('world-job-start', `${slot}:${jobPanel.bid}:${gameplayFiatSession.current}:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
                  void apiFetch('/api/gameplay/jobs/start', {

                    if (!response.ok || !data.ok || !data.job) {

                      seconds: data.job.durationMs / 1000, progress: 0,
                      runId: data.job.runId, completesAt: data.job.completesAt,
                    });
                  }).catch(() => { sfxError(); setNarr('> NETWORK ERROR — Job could not be started.'); });
                }} style={{ flex: 1, padding: '.6rem', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)', color: '#38bdf8', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.2rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>
