                  disabled={jobPanel.progress < jobPanel.seconds}
                  onClick={() => void completeQuickJob(jobPanel.runId!)}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.7rem', background: jobPanel.progress >= jobPanel.seconds ? 'rgba(255,221,68,.12)' : 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(255,221,68,.45)', color: jobPanel.progress >= jobPanel.seconds ? '#ffdd44' : 'rgba(255,221,68,.35)', cursor: jobPanel.progress >= jobPanel.seconds ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.2rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}
                >
                  {jobPanel.progress >= jobPanel.seconds ? 'END SHIFT' : 'SHIFT IN PROGRESS'}
                </button>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', fontSize: '.6rem', color: '#ffdd44', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>JOB IN PROGRESS — SERVER TIMING</div>
              )
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── VENDING MACHINE SHOP ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showStorage && <StorageLockerOverlay onClose={() => setShowStorage(false)} />}

      {/* ── HARVEST PROGRESS BAR ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {harvestInfo && (() => {
        const elapsed = (Date.now() - harvestStartRef.current) / 1000;
        const pct = Math.min(100, (elapsed / harvestInfo.seconds) * 100);
        return (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 100, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 800, background: 'rgba(0,8,12,.92)', border: '1px solid rgba(103,232,249,.35)', padding: '.6rem 1.2rem', minWidth: 220, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: '.4rem', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.6rem', color: '#67e8f9', letterSpacing: '.12em' }}>HARVESTING</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem' }}>{harvestInfo.icon} {harvestInfo.name}</div>
            <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 6, background: 'rgba(103,232,249,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(103,232,249,.2)', borderRadius: 2, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <div style={{ height: '100%', width: `${pct}%`, background: '#67e8f9', borderRadius: 2, transition: 'width .25s linear' }} />
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(103,232,249,.5)' }}>[ESC] to cancel</div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* ── ASSAY OFFICE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showAssayOffice && (
        <AssayOfficeModal
          onClose={() => { setShowAssayOffice(false); frozenRef.current = false; gameRef.current?.focus(); }}
          onSold={() => { setResourceInventoryRefresh(t => t + 1); }}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── RESOURCE INVENTORY ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showResourceInventory && (
        <ResourceInventoryPanel
          refreshTick={resourceInventoryRefresh}
          onClose={() => { setShowResourceInventory(false); frozenRef.current = false; gameRef.current?.focus(); }}
          onSell={() => { setShowResourceInventory(false); setShowAssayOffice(true); }}
        />
      )}
      {utilityStation && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const vid = g.vehicle;
        const vehicleInfo = vid
          ? {
              id: vid,
              label: vid.replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase(),
              power: vehiclePower(vid),
              gas: g.vehicleGas[vid] ?? 0,
              cap: vehicleGasCap(vid),
            }
          : null;
        return (
          <UtilityStation
            mode={utilityStation}
            onClose={() => { setUtilityStation(null); frozenRef.current = false; sfxUIClick(); }}
            refuel={{
              vehicleInfo,
              homeGas: g.homeGas ?? 0,
              homeGasCap: HOME_GAS_CAP,
              onRefuelVehicle: (units) => {
                if (!g.vehicle) return;
                const cap = vehicleGasCap(g.vehicle);
                g.vehicleGas[g.vehicle] = Math.min(cap, (g.vehicleGas[g.vehicle] ?? 0) + units);
                doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
              },
              onRefuelHome: (units) => {
                g.homeGas = Math.min(HOME_GAS_CAP, (g.homeGas ?? 0) + units);
                doSaveRef.current(buildSaveData());
              },
            }}
          />
        );
      })()}
      {showVend && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        // Machine mode is the florin-only food/drink dispenser: it only ever
        // shows the FOOD category (consumables that restore stamina), with no
        // category tabs. Store mode (pablo_store / armory) shows the full catalog.
        const cat = vendMode === 'machine'
          ? (VEND_CATALOG.find(c => c.id === 'food') ?? VEND_CATALOG[0])
          : (VEND_CATALOG.find(c => c.id === vendTab) ?? VEND_CATALOG[0]);
        const doVendBuy = async (item: VendItem) => {
          const goldReq = (item as any).goldPrice as number | undefined;
          if (goldReq && goldReq > 0) {
            sfxError();
            setNarr(`> GOLD PURCHASE UNAVAILABLE — ${item.name} cannot be sold until this machine supports server-ledger settlement.`);
            return;
          }
          if (vendMode === 'machine') {
            try {
              const slotIndex = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sm_slot') ?? '0', 10);
              const response = await apiFetch('/api/vending/food/purchase', {
                method: 'POST',
                credentials: 'include',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ itemId: item.id, slotIndex, requestId: crypto.randomUUID() }),
              });
              const result = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
              if (!response.ok) {
                sfxError();
                setNarr(response.status === 402
                  ? `> INSUFFICIENT FIAT — Need ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()}.`
                  : `> VENDKING — ${result.error ?? 'Transaction failed.'}`);
                return;
              }
              const data = result.data && typeof result.data === 'object' ? result.data : {};
              if (typeof data.hunger === 'number') { g.hunger = data.hunger; setHunger(g.hunger); }
              if (typeof data.thirst === 'number') { g.thirst = data.thirst; setThirst(g.thirst); }
              if (typeof data.energy === 'number') { g.energy = data.energy; setEnergy(g.energy); }
              if (typeof data.hp === 'number') { g.hp = data.hp; setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); }
              if (typeof data.poisoned === 'boolean') { g.poisoned = data.poisoned; setPoisoned(g.poisoned); }
              if (typeof data.powerLevel === 'number') g.powerLevel = data.powerLevel;
              sfxCoin();
              setNarr(`> VendKing — ${item.name} used. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} FIAT spent.`);
            } catch {
              sfxError();
              setNarr('> VENDKING — Network error. No FIAT was charged.');
            }
            return;
          }
          if (g.salary < item.price) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FIAT — Need ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()}.`); return; }
          if (item.id === 'pablo_device' && !g.hasDevice) { sfxError(); setNarr('> REPAIR KIT — You don\'t have a device to repair. Find one first.'); return; }
          if (item.id === 'pablo_device' && !g.deviceBroken) { sfxError(); setNarr('> REPAIR KIT — Your device is already working fine.'); return; }
          if (!item.consumable && item.id.startsWith('furn_')) {
            const fId = item.id.slice(5);
            if (g.ownedFurniture.includes(fId)) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> ALREADY OWNED — ${item.name} is in your furniture inventory.`); return; }
          } else if (!item.consumable && g.ownedItems.has(item.id)) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> ALREADY OWNED — ${item.name} is in your inventory.`); return; }
          const paid = await performGameplayFiatAction(`world_item_${item.id}`, `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:vend:${item.id}:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
          if (!paid || paid.duplicate) return;
          sfxCoin(); recordBizRevenue('vending_food', item.price);
          // ── Apply effects ──────────────────────────────────────
          if (item.consumable) {
            if (item.id === 'pablo_device') {
              g.deviceBroken = false; g.deviceDurability = 100; setDeviceBroken(false);
              setNarr(`> VendKing — ${item.name} applied. Device restored to full durability. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} FIAT spent.`);
              return;
            }
            if (item.effect) {
              const parts = item.effect.split(' ');
              for (const p of parts) {
                if (p.startsWith('hunger'))  { g.hunger  = Math.min(100, g.hunger  + parseInt(p.slice(6)));  setHunger(g.hunger);  }
                if (p === 'thirst-10')       { g.thirst  = Math.max(0, g.thirst - 10); setThirst(g.thirst); }
                else if (p.startsWith('thirst'))  { g.thirst  = Math.min(100, g.thirst  + parseInt(p.slice(6)));  setThirst(g.thirst);  }
                if (p.startsWith('energy'))  { g.energy  = Math.min(100, g.energy  + parseInt(p.slice(6)));  setEnergy(g.energy);  }
                if (p.startsWith('hp') && p !== 'hprisk5')      { g.hp      = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp  + parseInt(p.slice(2)));  setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); }
                if (p === 'hprisk5' && Math.random() < 0.1)     { g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 5); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: 'BAD BATCH −5 HP', color: '#ff4444', life: 60, maxLife: 60 }); }
                if (p === 'cure_poison')     { g.poisoned = false; g.poisonTick = 0; setPoisoned(false); }
                if (p.startsWith('power'))   { const pv = parseInt(p.slice(5)); g.powerLevel = Math.min(100, g.powerLevel + pv); }
              }
            }
            setNarr(`> VendKing — ${item.name} used. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} FIAT spent.`);
            return;
          }
          // Non-consumable items
          g.ownedItems.add(item.id);
          setOwnedItems(new Set(g.ownedItems));
          if (item.id === 'netrunner_deck') { g.terminalDiscount = true; }
          if (item.id === 'radio_implant') { g.hasRadioImplant = true; showRadio(); }
          if (item.id === 'campsite_kit') { setCampsitePos({ x: g.px, y: g.py }); setNarr('> CAMPSITE DEPLOYED at your current location. Press [E] near campsite to rest and save.'); return; }
          if (item.id === 'campsite_turret') {
            if (!campsitePos) { sfxError(); setNarr('> NO CAMPSITE — Deploy a campsite first before installing a turret.'); return; }
            setCampsiteTurret(true); setNarr('> TURRET INSTALLED at your campsite. +50% defense bonus against raids.');
            return;
          }
          if (VEHICLE_SPEED[item.id]) {
            // Always activate the purchased vehicle (player explicitly chose it);
            // speed comparison only matters for steals/finds, not purchases
            g.vehicle = item.id;
            if (!g.ownedVehicles.includes(item.id)) g.ownedVehicles.push(item.id);
          }
          if (WEAPON_TIER[item.id] && (WEAPON_TIER[item.id] ?? 0) > g.weaponTier) {
            g.weaponTier = WEAPON_TIER[item.id] ?? 0;
          }
          if (REAL_ESTATE_INCOME[item.id]) { g.realEstate.push(item.id); }
          // ── Furniture purchase ──────────────────────────────────────────────
          if (item.id.startsWith('furn_')) {
            const furnitureId = item.id.slice(5);
            if (!g.ownedFurniture.includes(furnitureId)) { g.ownedFurniture.push(furnitureId); }
            setNarr(`> FURNITURE SHOP — ${item.name} purchased. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} FIAT spent. Enter decoration mode [F] in your home to place it.`);
            return;
          }
          setNarr(`> VendKing — ${item.name} acquired. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} FIAT spent. Check your inventory.`);
        };
        const S2: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const VT2: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        return (
          <div style={{ position:'absolute', inset:0, background:'rgba(0,0,0,.93)', display:'flex', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', zIndex:360 }}
            onClick={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setShowVend(false); }}>
            <div style={{ width:760, maxHeight:'90vh', display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.35)', background:'rgba(0,6,2,.98)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)" }}>
              {/* Header */}
              <div style={{ padding:'1rem 1.2rem .6rem', borderBottom:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'center', flexShrink:0 }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ ...VT2, fontSize:'1.7rem', color:'#38bdf8', letterSpacing:'.18em' }}>VendKing</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.42rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', letterSpacing:'.12em' }}>PABLO CORP AUTOMATED RETAIL · 24 REGIONAL NODES · FIAT ONLY</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>
                  <div style={{ ...VT2, fontSize:'1.1rem', color:'#38bdf8' }}>ƒ{salary.toLocaleString()}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.4rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.3)' }}>FIAT BALANCE</div>
                  <button onClick={() => setShowVend(false)} style={{ marginTop:'.3rem', padding:'.2rem .6rem', background:'transparent', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', cursor:'pointer', ...VT2, fontSize:'.95rem' }}>ESC</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Category tabs — hidden in machine mode (food/drink only) */}
              {vendMode !== 'machine' && (
              <div style={{ display:'flex', borderBottom:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.12)', flexShrink:0, overflowX:'auto' }}>
                {VEND_CATALOG.map(c => (
                  <button key={c.id} onClick={() => setVendTab(c.id as typeof vendTab)}
                    style={{ padding:'.45rem .9rem', background: vendTab === c.id ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)' : 'transparent', border:'none', borderRight:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', color: vendTab === c.id ? c.col : 'rgba(56,189,248,.28)', cursor:'pointer', ...VT2, fontSize:'1rem', letterSpacing:'.1em', whiteSpace:'nowrap', flexShrink:0 }}>
                    {c.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              )}
              {/* Items grid */}
              <div style={{ flex:1, overflowY:'auto', padding:'.8rem 1rem', scrollbarWidth:'thin', scrollbarColor:'rgba(56,189,248,.2) transparent' }}>
                {(
                  <div style={{ display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', gap:'.5rem' }}>
                    {cat.items.map(item => {
                      const owned = g.ownedItems.has(item.id);
                      const goldReq = (item as any).goldPrice as number | undefined;
                      const isGoldOnly = goldReq !== undefined && goldReq > 0;
                      const canAfford = isGoldOnly ? g.goldBalance >= goldReq : g.salary >= item.price;
                      const isReEstate = cat.id === 'realestate';
                      const alreadyHas = !item.consumable && owned;
                      return (
                        <div key={item.id} style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'1fr auto', gap:'.6rem', alignItems:'center', padding:'.6rem .7rem', border:`1px solid ${alreadyHas ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.25)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.12)'}`, background: alreadyHas ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.04)' : 'transparent' }}>
                          <div>
                            <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'.5rem', marginBottom:'.2rem' }}>
                              <span style={{ ...VT2, fontSize:'1.05rem', color: alreadyHas ? '#38bdf8' : cat.col, letterSpacing:'.08em' }}>{item.name}</span>
                              {alreadyHas && <span style={{ fontSize:'.38rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.5)', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.25)', padding:'1px 5px' }}>OWNED</span>}
                              {isReEstate && <span style={{ fontSize:'.38rem', color:'rgba(204,68,255,.6)', border:'1px solid rgba(204,68,255,.2)', padding:'1px 5px' }}>PASSIVE INCOME</span>}
                              {isGoldOnly && <span style={{ fontSize:'.38rem', color:'rgba(255,215,0,.7)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.25)', padding:'1px 5px' }}>GOLD ONLY</span>}
                              {item.consumable && <span style={{ fontSize:'.38rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', padding:'1px 5px' }}>CONSUMABLE</span>}
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize:'.46rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', lineHeight:1.6 }}>{item.desc}</div>
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', alignItems:'flex-end', gap:'.3rem', flexShrink:0 }}>
                            <div style={{ ...VT2, fontSize:'1rem', color: canAfford ? (isGoldOnly ? '#ffd700' : '#38bdf8') : 'rgba(255,80,80,.6)' }}>{isGoldOnly ? `${goldReq}oz GOLD` : `ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()}`}</div>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => doVendBuy(item)}
                              disabled={alreadyHas}
                              style={{ padding:'.25rem .7rem', background: alreadyHas ? 'transparent' : canAfford ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)' : 'transparent', border:`1px solid ${alreadyHas ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)' : canAfford ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)' : 'rgba(255,80,80,.3)'}`, color: alreadyHas ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.25)' : canAfford ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(255,80,80,.5)', cursor: alreadyHas ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', ...VT2, fontSize:'.95rem', letterSpacing:'.08em', ...S2 }}>
                              {alreadyHas ? 'OWNED' : canAfford ? 'BUY' : isGoldOnly ? 'NEED GOLD' : 'EARN FIAT'}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              {/* Owned items strip */}
              {ownedItems.size > 0 && (
                <div style={{ padding:'.5rem 1rem', borderTop:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', flexShrink:0 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.4rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.25)', letterSpacing:'.1em', marginBottom:'.3rem' }}>INVENTORY</div>
                  <div style={{ display:'flex', flexWrap:'wrap', gap:'.3rem' }}>
                    {[...ownedItems].map(id => {
                      const found = VEND_CATALOG.flatMap(c => c.items).find(i => i.id === id);
                      return found ? <span key={id} style={{ fontSize:'.42rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.5)', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.18)', padding:'2px 7px' }}>{found.name}</span> : null;
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* ── COMMODITY TRADE TERMINAL ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showTrade && (() => {
        const isCity = marketCatalog?.location === 'city';
        const cp = marketCatalog?.prices ?? commodityPrices.current;
        const maxCargo = marketCatalog?.capacity ?? MAX_CARGO;
        const marketReady = marketCatalog !== null;
        const totalCargo = Object.values(gs.current.cargo).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        const loc = marketReady ? (isCity ? 'MINX TRADE EXCHANGE' : 'BLACK EXCHANGE — WASTELAND') : 'LINKING MARKET UPLINK';
        const executeTrade = async (cid: string, side: 'buy' | 'sell') => {
          const c = COMMODITIES.find(x => x.id === cid)!;
          const slot = (() => { try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sm_slot') ?? '0', 10) || 0; } catch { return 0; } })();
          try {
            const quoteResponse = await apiFetch('/api/gameplay/market/quote', {
              method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ slot, commodityId: cid, side, quantity: 1 }),
            });
            const quoteData = await quoteResponse.json() as {
              ok?: boolean; error?: string;
              quote?: { quoteId: string; unitPriceFiat: number; totalFiat: number };
            };
            if (!quoteResponse.ok || !quoteData.ok || !quoteData.quote) {
              sfxError(); setNarr(`> QUOTE FAILED — ${quoteData.error ?? 'Exchange unavailable.'}`); return;
            }
            const idempotencyKey = stableRequestId('world-market-execute', quoteData.quote.quoteId);
            const executionResponse = await apiFetch('/api/gameplay/market/execute', {
              method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ quoteId: quoteData.quote.quoteId, idempotencyKey }),
            });
            const data = await executionResponse.json() as {
              ok?: boolean; error?: string;
              wallet?: { newBalance?: number; balance?: number };
              cargo?: { items: Record<string, number>; totalQuantity: number; capacity: number };
              quote?: { totalFiat: number; unitPriceFiat: number };
            };
            if (!executionResponse.ok || !data.ok || !data.cargo || !data.wallet) {
              sfxError(); setNarr(`> TRADE FAILED — ${data.error ?? 'Exchange rejected the trade.'}`); return;
            }
            const balance = data.wallet.newBalance ?? data.wallet.balance;
            if (typeof balance === 'number') reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(balance);
            gs.current.cargo = { ...data.cargo.items };
            setCargo({ ...data.cargo.items });
            sfxCoin();
            const exactPrice = data.quote?.totalFiat ?? quoteData.quote.totalFiat;
            setNarr(side === 'buy'
              ? `> BOUGHT 1x ${c.name} [ƒ${exactPrice.toLocaleString()} FIAT]. Cargo: ${data.cargo.totalQuantity}/${data.cargo.capacity}. Haul to ${isCity ? 'the Wasteland' : CITY_NAME} and sell for profit.`
              : `> SOLD 1x ${c.name} [+ƒ${exactPrice.toLocaleString()} FIAT]. Balance: ƒ${(balance ?? gs.current.salary).toLocaleString()}.`);
          } catch {
            sfxError(); setNarr('> NETWORK ERROR — Trade could not be completed.');
          }
        };
        const doBuy = (cid: string) => executeTrade(cid, 'buy');
        const doSell = (cid: string) => executeTrade(cid, 'sell');
        const bestRoutes = COMMODITIES.map(c => {
          const cityProfit = cp[c.id].wasteSell - cp[c.id].cityBuy;
          const wasteProfit = cp[c.id].citySell - cp[c.id].wasteBuy;
          return { name: c.name, id: c.id, cityRoute: cityProfit, wasteRoute: wasteProfit };
        }).filter(r => (isCity ? r.cityRoute : r.wasteRoute) > 0)
          .sort((a, b) => (isCity ? b.cityRoute - a.cityRoute : b.wasteRoute - a.wasteRoute))
          .slice(0, 3);
        return (
          <div style={{ position:'absolute', inset:0, background:'rgba(0,0,0,.93)', display:'flex', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', zIndex:360 }}
            onClick={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setShowTrade(null); }}>
            <div style={{ width:720, maxHeight:'88vh', overflow:'auto', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.35)', background:'rgba(0,6,2,.98)', padding:'1.2rem', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)" }}>
              {/* Header */}
              <div style={{ display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'flex-start', marginBottom:'.8rem' }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'1.6rem', color:'#38bdf8', letterSpacing:'.18em' }}>{loc}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.42rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', letterSpacing:'.12em', marginTop:'.15rem' }}>
                    COMMODITY EXCHANGE · PRICES FLUCTUATE · {isCity ? 'BUY CITY → SELL WASTELAND' : 'BUY WASTELAND → SELL CITY'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'1.1rem', color:'#38bdf8' }}>CARGO {totalCargo}/{maxCargo}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.42rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', marginTop:'.1rem' }}>ƒ{salary.toLocaleString()} FIAT</div>
                  <button onClick={() => setShowTrade(null)} style={{ marginTop:'.3rem', padding:'.2rem .6rem', background:'transparent', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', cursor:'pointer', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.95rem' }}>ESC</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Best routes banner */}
              {bestRoutes.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{ border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.12)', padding:'.5rem .7rem', marginBottom:'.8rem', background:'rgba(56,189,248,.03)' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.42rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', letterSpacing:'.14em', marginBottom:'.3rem' }}>ROUTE ANALYSIS — TOP TRADES FROM HERE</div>
                  <div style={{ display:'flex', gap:'1.2rem', flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
                    {bestRoutes.map(r => (
                      <div key={r.id} style={{ fontSize:'.48rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.55)' }}>
                        {r.name} → <span style={{ color:'#38bdf8' }}>+ƒ{(isCity ? r.cityRoute : r.wasteRoute).toLocaleString()}/unit</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              {/* Commodity rows */}
              <div style={{ display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', gap:'.45rem' }}>
                <div style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'1fr 100px 100px 100px 50px', gap:'.3rem', fontSize:'.4rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.25)', letterSpacing:'.1em', paddingBottom:'.3rem', borderBottom:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)' }}>
                  <div>COMMODITY</div><div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>BUY</div><div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>SELL</div><div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>BEST SELL</div><div style={{ textAlign:'center' }}>HOLD</div>
                </div>
                {COMMODITIES.map(c => {
                  const buyPrice  = isCity ? cp[c.id].cityBuy  : cp[c.id].wasteBuy;
                  const sellPrice = isCity ? cp[c.id].citySell : cp[c.id].wasteSell;
                  const remSell   = isCity ? cp[c.id].wasteSell : cp[c.id].citySell;
                  const held = gs.current.cargo[c.id] || 0;
                  const canBuy = marketReady && gs.current.salary >= buyPrice && totalCargo < maxCargo;
                  const canSell = marketReady && held > 0;
                  const profit = remSell - buyPrice;
                  return (
                    <div key={c.id} style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'1fr 100px 100px 100px 50px', gap:'.3rem', alignItems:'center', padding:'.4rem .3rem', border:held > 0 ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.22)' : '1px solid transparent', background:held > 0 ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.03)' : 'transparent' }}>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'.4rem' }}>
                          <span style={{ fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.95rem', color: c.illegal ? 'rgba(255,180,0,.8)' : '#38bdf8', letterSpacing:'.07em' }}>{c.name}</span>
                          {c.illegal && <span style={{ fontSize:'.35rem', padding:'1px 4px', border:'1px solid rgba(255,160,0,.4)', color:'rgba(255,160,0,.6)', letterSpacing:'.08em' }}>CONTRABAND</span>}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize:'.4rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.28)', marginTop:'.05rem', lineHeight:1.5 }}>{c.desc}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>
                        <button onClick={() => doBuy(c.id)} style={{ width:'100%', padding:'.22rem .3rem', background: canBuy ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)' : 'transparent', border: canBuy ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', color: canBuy ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.2)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.82rem', cursor: canBuy ? 'pointer' : 'default', letterSpacing:'.05em' }}>
                          ƒ{buyPrice.toLocaleString()}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>
                        <button onClick={() => doSell(c.id)} style={{ width:'100%', padding:'.22rem .3rem', background: canSell ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)' : 'transparent', border: canSell ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', color: canSell ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.18)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.82rem', cursor: canSell ? 'pointer' : 'default', letterSpacing:'.05em' }}>
                          {canSell ? `+ƒ${sellPrice.toLocaleString()}` : '——'}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ textAlign:'right', fontSize:'.48rem', color: profit > 0 ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.55)' : 'rgba(255,80,80,.45)' }}>
                        {profit > 0 ? `+ƒ${profit.toLocaleString()}` : `–ƒ${Math.abs(profit).toLocaleString()}`}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ textAlign:'center', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'1.1rem', color: held > 0 ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.2)' }}>
                        {held > 0 ? held : '·'}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              {/* Cargo manifest */}
              {totalCargo > 0 && (
                <div style={{ marginTop:'.8rem', borderTop:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', paddingTop:'.6rem' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.42rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.25)', letterSpacing:'.12em', marginBottom:'.35rem' }}>CARGO MANIFEST</div>
                  <div style={{ display:'flex', gap:'.8rem', flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
                    {Object.entries(gs.current.cargo).filter(([,q]) => q > 0).map(([id, qty]) => {
                      const c = COMMODITIES.find(x => x.id === id)!;
                      if (!c) return null;
                      const sellHere = isCity ? cp[id].citySell : cp[id].wasteSell;
                      return (
                        <div key={id} style={{ fontSize:'.48rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.55)', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.18)', padding:'.22rem .5rem' }}>
                          {qty}× {c.name} → sell here for ƒ{sellHere.toLocaleString()}/unit
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              <div style={{ marginTop:'.7rem', fontSize:'.38rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.15)', letterSpacing:'.08em' }}>
                BUY = you pay · SELL = you receive · BEST SELL = value at the other exchange · Max cargo {maxCargo} units · ESC to close
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* ── WORLD DESIGNER (admin) ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showWorldDesigner && <WorldBuildDesigner onClose={() => setShowWorldDesigner(false)} />}

      {/* ── MAP PANEL (M key) ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showMap && (() => {
        const baseVR = 300, baseVRy = 250;
        const mapVR = baseVR / mapZoom, mapVRy2 = baseVRy / mapZoom;
        const vbX = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - mapVR * 2, gs.current.px - mapVR));
        const vbY = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - mapVRy2 * 2, gs.current.py - mapVRy2));
        return (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.92)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 360 }}
          onClick={() => { setShowMap(false); setMapZoom(1); }}>
          <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '90vw', maxWidth: 1200, height: '80vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.3)', background: 'rgba(0,6,2,.98)', padding: '1.2rem', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", boxSizing: 'border-box' }}
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '.8rem', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.8rem', color: '#38bdf8', letterSpacing: '.2em' }}>{getActiveCityDef().name} MAP</div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '.5rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <button onClick={() => setMapZoom(z => Math.min(4, z * 1.5))} style={{ padding: '.2rem .5rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.65rem' }}>+</button>
                <button onClick={() => setMapZoom(z => Math.max(0.25, z / 1.5))} style={{ padding: '.2rem .5rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.65rem' }}>−</button>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)' }}>{Math.round(mapZoom * 100)}%</span>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>SERVER: {getActiveCityDef().name}</div>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowMap(false); setMapZoom(1); }} style={{ padding: '.2rem .5rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.5rem' }}>ESC</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* LAYER TOGGLE — subterranean / ground / above-ground + infra overlays */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '.3rem', marginBottom: '.5rem', flexShrink: 0, alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.45)', letterSpacing: '.1em', marginRight: '.3rem' }}>LAYER:</span>
              {([
                { id: 'under',   label: 'SUBTERRANEAN', hue: '#b580ff' },
                { id: 'surface', label: 'GROUND',       hue: '#38bdf8' },
                { id: 'aerial',  label: 'ABOVE-GROUND', hue: '#ff8cff' },
                { id: 'power',   label: 'POWER GRID',   hue: '#ffbb33' },
                { id: 'net',     label: 'INTERNET',     hue: '#33ffcc' },
              ] as const).map(opt => {
                const active = mapLayer === opt.id;
                return (
                  <button key={opt.id} onClick={() => setMapLayer(opt.id)}
                    style={{ padding: '.25rem .55rem', background: active ? `${opt.hue}22` : 'transparent', border: `1px solid ${active ? opt.hue : 'rgba(56,189,248,.18)'}`, color: active ? opt.hue : 'rgba(56,189,248,.55)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.55rem', letterSpacing: '.08em' }}>
                    {opt.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <svg width="100%" style={{ flex: 1, display: 'block', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', background: '#00020a', cursor: 'crosshair' }} viewBox={`${vbX} ${vbY} ${mapVR * 2} ${mapVRy2 * 2}`} preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
              onWheel={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setMapZoom(z => e.deltaY < 0 ? Math.min(4, z * 1.2) : Math.max(0.25, z / 1.2)); }}
              onClick={(evt) => {
                const svg = evt.currentTarget;
                const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
                pt.x = evt.clientX; pt.y = evt.clientY;
                const svgP = pt.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM()!.inverse());
                const tx = Math.max(BORDER + 10, Math.min(W - BORDER - 10, svgP.x));
                const ty = Math.max(BORDER + 10, Math.min(H - BORDER - 10, svgP.y));
                gs.current.px = tx; gs.current.py = ty;
                setShowMap(false);
                setNarr(`> MAP TRAVEL — Moved to grid (${Math.floor(tx / 100)}, ${Math.floor(ty / 100)}).`);
              }}>
              <rect x={0} y={0} width={W} height={CITY_TOP} fill="rgba(10,5,0,.8)" />
              <rect x={0} y={CITY_TOP} width={W} height={CITY_BOTTOM - CITY_TOP} fill="rgba(0,10,3,.8)" />
              <rect x={0} y={CITY_BOTTOM} width={W} height={H - CITY_BOTTOM} fill="rgba(10,5,0,.8)" />
              <rect x={0} y={0} width={BORDER} height={H} fill="rgba(0,30,80,.5)" />
              <rect x={W - BORDER} y={0} width={BORDER} height={H} fill="rgba(0,30,80,.5)" />
              <rect x={0} y={0} width={W} height={BORDER} fill="rgba(80,60,30,.5)" />
              <rect x={0} y={H - BORDER} width={W} height={BORDER} fill="rgba(80,60,30,.5)" />
              <line x1={0} y1={CITY_TOP} x2={W} y2={CITY_TOP} stroke="rgba(56,189,248,.2)" strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="10 5" />
              <line x1={0} y1={CITY_BOTTOM} x2={W} y2={CITY_BOTTOM} stroke="rgba(56,189,248,.2)" strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="10 5" />
              <text x={vbX + 10} y={CITY_TOP - 8} fill="rgba(255,130,50,.35)" fontSize={12} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">NORTH WASTELAND</text>
              <text x={vbX + 10} y={CITY_TOP + 16} fill="rgba(56,189,248,.35)" fontSize={12} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">{getActiveCityDef().name}</text>
              <text x={vbX + 10} y={CITY_BOTTOM - 8} fill="rgba(56,189,248,.35)" fontSize={12} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">{getActiveCityDef().name}</text>
              <text x={vbX + 10} y={CITY_BOTTOM + 16} fill="rgba(255,130,50,.35)" fontSize={12} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">SOUTH WASTELAND</text>
              <g opacity={mapLayer === 'surface' ? 1 : 0.28}>
              {CITY_ZONES.map(z => (
                <rect key={z.id} x={z.x} y={z.y} width={z.w} height={z.h} fill={z.color} stroke="none" />
              ))}
              {BUILDINGS.map(b => {
                const scale = getBuildingScale(b.id);
                const isTower = scale === 'tower';
                const isLarge = scale === 'large';
                const zone = CITY_ZONES.find(z => b.x >= z.x && b.x < z.x + z.w && b.y >= z.y && b.y < z.y + z.h);
                const zoneFill = zone?.type === 'residential' ? 'rgba(0,180,80,.18)' : zone?.type === 'industrial' ? 'rgba(180,120,0,.18)' : zone?.type === 'transit' ? 'rgba(0,160,200,.18)' : b.bright ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.28)' : 'rgba(0,180,55,.14)';
                const zoneStroke = isTower ? 'rgba(160,80,255,.9)' : isLarge ? 'rgba(0,200,255,.55)' : b.bright ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.22)';
                const strokeW = isTower ? 2 : isLarge ? 1.5 : 1;
                return (
                  <g key={b.id}>
                    {isTower && <rect x={b.x - 2} y={b.y - 2} width={b.w + 4} height={b.h + 4} fill="none" stroke="rgba(120,0,200,.25)" strokeWidth={4} />}
                    <rect x={b.x} y={b.y} width={b.w} height={b.h} fill={zoneFill} stroke={zoneStroke} strokeWidth={strokeW} />
                    {isTower && <rect x={b.x + 2} y={b.y + 2} width={b.w - 4} height={b.h - 4} fill="none" stroke="rgba(180,100,255,.2)" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="4 3" />}
                    <text x={b.x + b.w / 2} y={b.y + b.h / 2 + 3} textAnchor="middle" fill={isTower ? 'rgba(200,150,255,.9)' : isLarge ? 'rgba(0,200,255,.8)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.7)'} fontSize={isTower ? 8 : 7} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">{cityBuildingLabel(b).substring(0,14)}</text>
                  </g>
                );
              })}
              {BILLBOARDS.map(bb => (
                <g key={bb.locationId}>
                  <rect x={bb.x - 4} y={bb.y - 4} width={8} height={8} fill="rgba(0,200,255,.2)" stroke="rgba(0,200,255,.5)" strokeWidth={1} />
                  <text x={bb.x} y={bb.y + 3} textAnchor="middle" fill="rgba(0,200,255,.6)" fontSize={5} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">BB</text>
                </g>
              ))}
              </g>
              {/* ── INFRASTRUCTURE OVERLAYS ─────────────────────────────── */}
              {mapLayer === 'power' && (() => {
                const nodeById: Record<string, GridNode> = {};
                GRID_NODES.forEach(n => { nodeById[n.id] = n; });
                // Assign each city building to nearest substation/reactor for feeder lines
                const cityPower = GRID_NODES.filter(n => n.kind !== 'generator');
                const feeders: { bx: number; by: number; nx: number; ny: number }[] = [];
                for (const b of BUILDINGS) {
                  const bcx = b.x + b.w / 2, bcy = b.y + b.h / 2;
                  if (!inCityBounds(bcx, bcy)) continue;
                  let best = cityPower[0], bd = Infinity;
                  for (const n of cityPower) {
                    const d = (n.x - bcx) ** 2 + (n.y - bcy) ** 2;
                    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = n; }
                  }
                  feeders.push({ bx: bcx, by: bcy, nx: best.x, ny: best.y });
                }
                return (
                  <g>
                    {/* Feeder lines — thin amber */}
                    {feeders.map((f, i) => (
                      <line key={`fd${i}`} x1={f.nx} y1={f.ny} x2={f.bx} y2={f.by} stroke="rgba(255,187,51,.22)" strokeWidth={0.6} />
                    ))}
                    {/* High-voltage trunk lines — bold amber with dashes */}
                    {GRID_TRUNKS.map(([a, b], i) => {
                      const na = nodeById[a], nb = nodeById[b];
                      if (!na || !nb) return null;
                      return <line key={`tr${i}`} x1={na.x} y1={na.y} x2={nb.x} y2={nb.y} stroke="#ffbb33" strokeWidth={2.5} strokeDasharray="14 6" opacity={0.85} />;
                    })}
                    {/* Nodes */}
                    {GRID_NODES.map(n => {
                      const r = n.kind === 'reactor' ? 16 : n.kind === 'substation' ? 10 : 7;
                      const col = n.kind === 'reactor' ? '#ff5577' : n.kind === 'substation' ? '#ffbb33' : '#aa7722';
                      return (
                        <g key={n.id}>
                          {n.kind === 'reactor' && <circle cx={n.x} cy={n.y} r={r + 10} fill="none" stroke={col} strokeWidth={1} opacity={0.35} strokeDasharray="3 2" />}
                          <polygon points={`${n.x},${n.y - r} ${n.x + r},${n.y} ${n.x},${n.y + r} ${n.x - r},${n.y}`} fill="rgba(0,0,0,.8)" stroke={col} strokeWidth={1.6} />
                          <text x={n.x} y={n.y + 2} textAnchor="middle" fill={col} fontSize={8} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">⚡</text>
                          <text x={n.x} y={n.y + r + 10} textAnchor="middle" fill={col} fontSize={7} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)" opacity={0.85}>{n.label}</text>
                          <text x={n.x} y={n.y + r + 19} textAnchor="middle" fill={col} fontSize={6} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)" opacity={0.55}>{n.kw.toLocaleString()} kW</text>
                        </g>
                      );
                    })}
                  </g>
                );
              })()}
              {mapLayer === 'net' && (() => {
                const nodeById: Record<string, NetTower> = {};
                INTERNET_TOWERS.forEach(t => { nodeById[t.id] = t; });
                return (
                  <g>
                    {/* Coverage halos */}
                    {INTERNET_TOWERS.map(t => (
                      <circle key={`cov${t.id}`} cx={t.x} cy={t.y} r={t.range} fill="rgba(51,255,204,.05)" stroke="rgba(51,255,204,.22)" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="3 4" />
                    ))}
                    {/* Fiber trunks */}
                    {FIBER_TRUNKS.map(([a, b], i) => {
                      const na = nodeById[a], nb = nodeById[b];
                      if (!na || !nb) return null;
                      return <line key={`fb${i}`} x1={na.x} y1={na.y} x2={nb.x} y2={nb.y} stroke="#33ffcc" strokeWidth={2} opacity={0.75} />;
                    })}
                    {/* Tower markers — triangle + signal waves */}
                    {INTERNET_TOWERS.map(t => (
                      <g key={t.id}>
                        <polygon points={`${t.x},${t.y - 12} ${t.x + 9},${t.y + 6} ${t.x - 9},${t.y + 6}`} fill="rgba(0,0,0,.8)" stroke="#33ffcc" strokeWidth={1.6} />
                        <circle cx={t.x} cy={t.y - 10} r={2} fill="#33ffcc" />
                        <path d={`M${t.x - 6},${t.y - 14} Q${t.x},${t.y - 22} ${t.x + 6},${t.y - 14}`} stroke="#33ffcc" strokeWidth={1} fill="none" opacity={0.6} />
                        <path d={`M${t.x - 10},${t.y - 16} Q${t.x},${t.y - 28} ${t.x + 10},${t.y - 16}`} stroke="#33ffcc" strokeWidth={0.8} fill="none" opacity={0.35} />
                        <text x={t.x} y={t.y + 16} textAnchor="middle" fill="#33ffcc" fontSize={7} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">{t.label}</text>
                        <text x={t.x} y={t.y + 24} textAnchor="middle" fill="#33ffcc" fontSize={6} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)" opacity={0.6}>{t.band}</text>
                      </g>
                    ))}
                  </g>
                );
              })()}
              {mapLayer === 'under' && (() => {
                // Subterranean — subway approximated as E-W + N-S trunks through city center,
                // sewer mains follow zones, utility tunnels mirror power trunks.
                const cx = (CITY_LEFT + CITY_RIGHT) / 2, cy = (CITY_TOP + CITY_BOTTOM) / 2;
                const nodeById: Record<string, GridNode> = {};
                GRID_NODES.forEach(n => { nodeById[n.id] = n; });
                return (
                  <g>
                    {/* Dark sub-surface band across whole map */}
                    <rect x={vbX} y={vbY} width={mapVR * 2} height={mapVRy2 * 2} fill="rgba(80,20,120,.05)" />
                    {/* Sewer mains — magenta, dashed along zone grids */}
                    {CITY_ZONES.map(z => (
                      <g key={`sw${z.id}`}>
                        <line x1={z.x + 10} y1={z.y + z.h / 2} x2={z.x + z.w - 10} y2={z.y + z.h / 2} stroke="rgba(170,60,200,.35)" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="4 3" />
                        <line x1={z.x + z.w / 2} y1={z.y + 10} x2={z.x + z.w / 2} y2={z.y + z.h - 10} stroke="rgba(170,60,200,.35)" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="4 3" />
                      </g>
                    ))}
                    {/* Utility tunnels — follow power trunks, dotted purple */}
                    {GRID_TRUNKS.map(([a, b], i) => {
                      const na = nodeById[a], nb = nodeById[b];
                      if (!na || !nb) return null;
                      return <line key={`ut${i}`} x1={na.x} y1={na.y} x2={nb.x} y2={nb.y} stroke="#b580ff" strokeWidth={1.6} strokeDasharray="2 4" opacity={0.65} />;
                    })}
                    {/* Subway lines — two bold trunks + stops */}
                    <line x1={CITY_LEFT - 60} y1={cy} x2={CITY_RIGHT + 60} y2={cy} stroke="#ff55ff" strokeWidth={3} opacity={0.7} />
                    <line x1={cx} y1={CITY_TOP - 40} x2={cx} y2={CITY_BOTTOM + 40} stroke="#55ffff" strokeWidth={3} opacity={0.7} />
                    {[CITY_LEFT, CITY_LEFT + 300, cx, CITY_RIGHT - 300, CITY_RIGHT].map((sx, i) => (
                      <g key={`ew${i}`}>
                        <circle cx={sx} cy={cy} r={5} fill="#00020a" stroke="#ff55ff" strokeWidth={1.8} />
                        <text x={sx} y={cy - 10} textAnchor="middle" fill="#ff55ff" fontSize={6} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">STN {i + 1}</text>
                      </g>
                    ))}
                    {[CITY_TOP, CITY_TOP + 250, cy, CITY_BOTTOM - 250, CITY_BOTTOM].map((sy, i) => (
                      <g key={`ns${i}`}>
                        <circle cx={cx} cy={sy} r={5} fill="#00020a" stroke="#55ffff" strokeWidth={1.8} />
                      </g>
                    ))}
                    <text x={CITY_LEFT - 50} y={cy - 14} fill="#ff55ff" fontSize={8} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)" opacity={0.8}>RED LINE — E/W</text>
                    <text x={cx + 10} y={CITY_TOP - 46} fill="#55ffff" fontSize={8} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)" opacity={0.8}>BLUE LINE — N/S</text>
                  </g>
                );
              })()}
              {mapLayer === 'aerial' && (() => {
                // Above-ground — tower silhouettes pop, skybridges link tower clusters,
                // rooftop helipads marked on the tallest buildings.
                const towers = BUILDINGS.filter(b => getBuildingScale(b.id) === 'tower');
                // Cluster skybridges: link each tower to its nearest tower neighbour (mutual)
                const bridges: { a: typeof towers[number]; b: typeof towers[number] }[] = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < towers.length; i++) {
                  let best = -1, bd = Infinity;
                  for (let j = 0; j < towers.length; j++) {
                    if (i === j) continue;
                    const dx = towers[i].x - towers[j].x, dy = towers[i].y - towers[j].y;
                    const d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                    if (d < bd && d < 180 * 180) { bd = d; best = j; }
                  }
                  if (best > i) bridges.push({ a: towers[i], b: towers[best] });
                }
                return (
                  <g>
                    {/* Skybridges — bright pink lines between tower roofs */}
                    {bridges.map((br, i) => (
                      <line key={`sb${i}`} x1={br.a.x + br.a.w / 2} y1={br.a.y + br.a.h / 2} x2={br.b.x + br.b.w / 2} y2={br.b.y + br.b.h / 2} stroke="#ff8cff" strokeWidth={1.8} opacity={0.75} strokeDasharray="6 3" />
                    ))}
                    {/* Tower silhouettes with helipads */}
                    {towers.map(t => {
                      const cx2 = t.x + t.w / 2, cy2 = t.y + t.h / 2;
                      return (
                        <g key={`tw${t.id}`}>
                          <rect x={t.x - 1} y={t.y - 1} width={t.w + 2} height={t.h + 2} fill="rgba(255,140,255,.18)" stroke="#ff8cff" strokeWidth={1.5} />
                          <circle cx={cx2} cy={cy2} r={6} fill="rgba(0,0,0,.85)" stroke="#ff8cff" strokeWidth={1.4} />
                          <text x={cx2} y={cy2 + 2.5} textAnchor="middle" fill="#ff8cff" fontSize={7} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">H</text>
                          <text x={cx2} y={t.y - 4} textAnchor="middle" fill="#ff8cff" fontSize={7} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)" opacity={0.85}>{t.label.substring(0, 14)}</text>
                        </g>
                      );
                    })}
                    {/* Note strip for the layer */}
                    <text x={vbX + 12} y={vbY + 20} fill="#ff8cff" fontSize={10} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)" opacity={0.65}>ABOVE-GROUND · SKYBRIDGES · HELIPADS</text>
                  </g>
                );
              })()}
              {storyActive && gs.current.story?.homeBase && (
                <g>
                  <circle cx={gs.current.story.homeBase.x} cy={gs.current.story.homeBase.y} r={10} fill="none" stroke="#aef25a" strokeWidth={1.5} opacity={0.8} />
                  <polygon points={`${gs.current.story.homeBase.x},${gs.current.story.homeBase.y - 7} ${gs.current.story.homeBase.x + 6},${gs.current.story.homeBase.y + 5} ${gs.current.story.homeBase.x - 6},${gs.current.story.homeBase.y + 5}`} fill="#aef25a" opacity={0.9} />
                  <text x={gs.current.story.homeBase.x} y={gs.current.story.homeBase.y + 18} textAnchor="middle" fill="#aef25a" fontSize={8} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">{gs.current.story.homeBase.label}</text>
                </g>
              )}
              <circle cx={gs.current.px} cy={gs.current.py} r={8} fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" strokeWidth={2} />
              <circle cx={gs.current.px} cy={gs.current.py} r={4} fill="#38bdf8" />
              <text x={gs.current.px} y={gs.current.py - 12} textAnchor="middle" fill="#38bdf8" fontSize={10} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">{char.name}</text>
              {gs.current.threats.map((t, ti) => (
                <circle key={ti} cx={t.x} cy={t.y} r={5} fill={THREAT_COL[t.type] ?? '#ff4444'} opacity={0.6} />
              ))}
              {gs.current.threats.filter(t => t.type === 'SPY').map((t, ti) => (
                <circle key={`spy${ti}`} cx={t.x} cy={t.y} r={8} fill="none" stroke="#ffffaa" strokeWidth={1} strokeDasharray="4 2" />
              ))}
              {quests.filter(q => !q.completed).flatMap(q => q.tasks.filter(t => !t.done && t.mapMarker)).map((task, ti) => (
                <g key={`quest${ti}`}>
                  <circle cx={task.mapMarker!.x} cy={task.mapMarker!.y} r={10} fill="none" stroke="#ffcc44" strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="6 3" />
                  <circle cx={task.mapMarker!.x} cy={task.mapMarker!.y} r={4} fill="#ffcc44" opacity={0.8} />
                  <text x={task.mapMarker!.x} y={task.mapMarker!.y - 14} textAnchor="middle" fill="#ffcc44" fontSize={7} fontFamily="var(--font-sans)">{task.mapMarker!.label}</text>
                </g>
              ))}
            </svg>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', marginTop: '.6rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              {[['#38bdf8','CITY BUILDING'],['rgba(200,150,255,.9)','TOWER'],['rgba(0,200,255,.8)','LARGE BLDG'],['rgba(0,180,80,.4)','RESIDENTIAL'],['rgba(180,120,0,.4)','INDUSTRIAL'],['rgba(255,130,50,.6)','LOCKED'],['#00ccff','BILLBOARD'],['#ff4444','THREAT'],['#ffffaa','SPY'],['#5599ff','PABLO CORP GUARD'],['#ffcc44','MISSION']].map(([c,l]) => (
                <div key={l} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '.3rem' }}>
                  <div style={{ width: 8, height: 8, background: c, borderRadius: 1 }} />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', letterSpacing: '.07em' }}>{l}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginTop: '.5rem', fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.2)', letterSpacing: '.07em', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              PLAYER: ({Math.round(gs.current.px)}, {Math.round(gs.current.py)}) · {zone} · LVL {level} · ƒ{salary.toLocaleString()} FIAT · Click map to travel · [M] or [ESC] to close
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* ── DECORATION MODE CATALOG PANEL ───────────────────────────────────── */}
      {decorMode && decorCatalogOpen && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const ownedFurnSet = new Set(g.ownedFurniture);
        const categories: FurnitureCategory[] = ['seating','beds','desks','storage','lighting','wall_art','plants','electronics','rugs','kitchen','decor'];
        const catLabels: Record<FurnitureCategory,string> = { seating:'Seating', beds:'Beds', desks:'Desks', storage:'Storage', lighting:'Lighting', wall_art:'Wall Art', plants:'Plants', electronics:'Electronics', rugs:'Rugs', kitchen:'Kitchen', decor:'Decor' };
        const filteredItems = FURNITURE_CATALOG.filter(fi => !decorCategory || fi.category === decorCategory);
        const selectedOwned = decorSelectedItem ? ownedFurnSet.has(decorSelectedItem.id) : false;
        return (
          <div style={{ position:'absolute', inset:0, background:'rgba(0,0,0,.82)', display:'flex', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', zIndex:370 }}
            onClick={() => setDecorCatalogOpen(false)}>
            <div style={{ width:640, maxHeight:'85vh', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.35)', background:'rgba(0,4,8,.98)', padding:'1.2rem', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', overflow:'hidden' }}
              onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div style={{ color:'rgb(56,189,248)', fontSize:'.85rem', letterSpacing:'.15em', borderBottom:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', paddingBottom:'.5rem', marginBottom:'.5rem', display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'center' }}>
                FURNITURE CATALOG
                <span style={{ fontSize:'.6rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.5)', letterSpacing:'.08em' }}>{ownedFurnSet.size} OWNED — Purchase from VendKing to unlock</span>
              </div>
              {decorSelectedItem && (
                <div style={{ background: selectedOwned ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)' : 'rgba(255,100,0,.06)', border:`1px solid ${selectedOwned?'rgba(56,189,248,.3)':'rgba(255,150,0,.4)'}`, padding:'.5rem', marginBottom:'.6rem', fontSize:'.7rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.9)' }}>
                  <div style={{ display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'flex-start' }}>
                    <b style={{ color:'rgb(56,189,248)' }}>SELECTED: {decorSelectedItem.name}</b>
                    <span style={{ fontSize:'.6rem', color: selectedOwned ? 'rgb(56,189,248)' : 'rgb(255,140,0)', padding:'.1rem .4rem', border:`1px solid ${selectedOwned?'rgba(56,189,248,.4)':'rgba(255,140,0,.4)'}`, background: selectedOwned ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)' : 'rgba(255,140,0,.1)' }}>
                      {selectedOwned ? '✓ OWNED' : `ƒ${decorSelectedItem.price.toLocaleString()} — BUY FROM SHOP`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ color:'rgba(0,200,255,.8)', fontSize:'.62rem' }}>{decorSelectedItem.desc}</span>
                  {decorSelectedItem.wallMounted && <span style={{ marginLeft:'.5rem', color:'rgba(255,200,0,.7)', fontSize:'.58rem' }}>WALL-MOUNT (top wall only)</span>}
                  <div style={{ marginTop:'.4rem', display:'flex', gap:'.5rem', flexWrap:'wrap' }}>
                    {decorSelectedItem.variants.map(v => (
                      <button key={v.id} onClick={() => setDecorSelectedVariant(v.id)}
                        style={{ padding:'.2rem .5rem', border:`1px solid ${decorSelectedVariant===v.id?'rgb(56,189,248)':'rgba(56,189,248,.25)'}`, background:decorSelectedVariant===v.id?'rgba(56,189,248,.2)':'transparent', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.9)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.6rem', cursor:'pointer', display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'.3rem' }}>
                        <span style={{ width:10, height:10, display:'inline-block', background:v.color, border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)', flexShrink:0 }} />
                        {v.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ marginTop:'.4rem', color:'rgba(0,200,255,.6)', fontSize:'.6rem' }}>
                    Size: {decorSelectedItem.gridW}×{decorSelectedItem.gridH} tiles · Rotation: {decorRotation}° · [R] to rotate
                  </div>
                  {selectedOwned ? (
                    <button onClick={() => { setDecorCatalogOpen(false); setNarr(`> PLACE ${decorSelectedItem.name.toUpperCase()} — Click on interior floor to place. [R] rotate.`); }}
                      style={{ marginTop:'.5rem', padding:'.3rem .8rem', background:'rgba(56,189,248,.2)', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)', color:'rgb(56,189,248)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.65rem', cursor:'pointer' }}>
                      PLACE ITEM →
                    </button>

                    <div style={{ marginTop:'.5rem', fontSize:'.6rem', color:'rgba(255,140,0,.8)' }}>
                      Purchase from VendKing to unlock placement.
