                </div>
              )}
              <div style={{ display:'flex', gap:'.3rem', flexWrap:'wrap', marginBottom:'.5rem' }}>
                <button onClick={() => setDecorCategory(null)}
                  style={{ padding:'.2rem .5rem', border:`1px solid ${!decorCategory?'rgb(56,189,248)':'rgba(56,189,248,.25)'}`, background:!decorCategory?'rgba(56,189,248,.15)':'transparent', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.9)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.6rem', cursor:'pointer' }}>
                  ALL
                </button>
                {categories.map(cat => (
                  <button key={cat} onClick={() => setDecorCategory(cat)}
                    style={{ padding:'.2rem .5rem', border:`1px solid ${decorCategory===cat?'rgb(56,189,248)':'rgba(56,189,248,.25)'}`, background:decorCategory===cat?'rgba(56,189,248,.15)':'transparent', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.9)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)", fontSize:'.6rem', cursor:'pointer' }}>
                    {catLabels[cat]}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div style={{ overflowY:'auto', flex:1, display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'repeat(3,1fr)', gap:'.5rem' }}>
                {filteredItems.map(fi => {
                  const isSelected = decorSelectedItem?.id === fi.id;
                  const isOwned = ownedFurnSet.has(fi.id);
                  const primaryVariant = fi.variants[0];
                  return (
                    <div key={fi.id} onClick={() => { setDecorSelectedItem(fi); setDecorSelectedVariant(fi.variants[0]?.id ?? ''); }}
                      style={{ border:`1px solid ${isSelected?'rgb(56,189,248)':isOwned?'rgba(56,189,248,.3)':'rgba(56,189,248,.12)'}`, background:isSelected?'rgba(56,189,248,.1)':isOwned?'rgba(56,189,248,.05)':'rgba(56,189,248,.02)', padding:'.5rem', cursor:'pointer', transition:'border-color .15s', position:'relative' }}>
                      {isOwned && <span style={{ position:'absolute', top:3, right:3, fontSize:'.45rem', color:'rgb(56,189,248)', background:'rgba(56,189,248,.15)', padding:'1px 3px' }}>OWNED</span>}
                      <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'.4rem', marginBottom:'.3rem' }}>
                        <div style={{ width:20, height:20, background:primaryVariant?.color??'#333', border:`1px solid ${isOwned?'rgba(56,189,248,.4)':'rgba(255,255,255,.2)'}`, flexShrink:0 }} />
                        <div style={{ color:isSelected?'rgb(56,189,248)':isOwned?'rgba(56,189,248,.9)':'rgba(56,189,248,.6)', fontSize:'.65rem', fontWeight:'bold', lineHeight:1.2 }}>{fi.name}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ color:'rgba(0,200,255,.5)', fontSize:'.5rem', marginBottom:'.2rem' }}>{fi.desc}</div>
                      <div style={{ color:isOwned?'rgba(56,189,248,.5)':'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', fontSize:'.5rem' }}>
                        {fi.gridW}×{fi.gridH} · {isOwned ? 'READY TO PLACE' : `ƒ${fi.price.toLocaleString()}`}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              <div style={{ marginTop:'.7rem', borderTop:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', paddingTop:'.5rem', color:'rgba(0,200,255,.5)', fontSize:'.6rem' }}>
                [O] or [Esc] close · Buy items from VendKing · Select owned item → choose variant → PLACE ITEM
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* ── BILLBOARD MARKETPLACE PANEL ────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showBillboard && (() => {
        const bbInfo = billboardsData.find(d => d.locationId === showBillboard.locationId);
        const owned = bbInfo?.ownerPlayerName;
        const isOwner = owned === char.name;
        const expired = bbInfo?.expired;
        const price = bbInfo?.priceFlorin ?? 5000;
        return (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.92)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 370 }}
            onClick={() => setShowBillboard(null)}>
            <div style={{ width: 420, border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.3)', background: 'rgba(0,4,8,.98)', padding: '1.2rem', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}
              onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '.8rem' }}>
                <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.6rem', color: '#00ccff', letterSpacing: '.15em' }}>BILLBOARD MARKETPLACE</div>
                <button onClick={() => setShowBillboard(null)} style={{ padding: '.2rem .5rem', background: 'transparent', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.2)', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.4)', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.5rem' }}>ESC</button>
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 1, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(0,200,255,.3), transparent)', marginBottom: '.8rem' }} />
              <div style={{ fontSize: '.6rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.6)', marginBottom: '.4rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>SLOT: {showBillboard.label}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.35)', marginBottom: '.3rem' }}>Location ID: {showBillboard.locationId}</div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', marginBottom: '.6rem' }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.15)', padding: '.5rem', background: 'rgba(0,10,20,.5)' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.3)', marginBottom: '.3rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>STATUS</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: owned && !expired ? '#ff00ff' : '#00ccff' }}>
                    {owned && !expired ? `OWNED by ${owned}` : 'AVAILABLE'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.15)', padding: '.5rem', background: 'rgba(0,10,20,.5)' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.3)', marginBottom: '.3rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>PRICE (7 DAYS)</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: '#ffdd44' }}>ç{price.toLocaleString()} FIAT</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              {(bbInfo?.adText || bbInfo?.adImageUrl) && (
                <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(255,0,255,.2)', padding: '.5rem', marginBottom: '.6rem', background: 'rgba(255,0,255,.03)' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(255,0,255,.4)', marginBottom: '.2rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>CURRENT AD</div>
                  {bbInfo.adImageUrl && (
                    <img src={bbInfo.adImageUrl} alt="Billboard ad" style={{ width: '100%', maxHeight: 120, objectFit: 'contain', marginBottom: '.3rem', border: '1px solid rgba(255,0,255,.15)' }}
                      onError={(e) => { (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none'; }} />
                  )}
                  {bbInfo.adText && <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: '#ff88ff', wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>{bbInfo.adText}</div>}
                </div>
              )}
              {bbInfo?.rentedUntil && !expired && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.3)', marginBottom: '.5rem' }}>
                  Expires: {new Date(bbInfo.rentedUntil).toLocaleDateString()}
                </div>
              )}
              {(!owned || expired) && (
                <button onClick={() => { if (bbInfo) purchaseBillboard(bbInfo.id); }}
                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.5rem', background: 'rgba(0,200,255,.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.4)', color: '#00ccff', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.1rem', letterSpacing: '.12em', cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: '.5rem' }}>
                  BUY SLOT — ç{price.toLocaleString()} FIAT
                </button>
              )}
              {isOwner && !expired && (
                <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', padding: '.5rem', background: 'rgba(0,10,5,.5)' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.45rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', marginBottom: '.4rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>UPDATE YOUR AD</div>
                  <input value={bbAdText} onChange={e => setBbAdText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Ad text (max 60 chars)"
                    maxLength={60}
                    style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.3rem', background: 'rgba(0,10,5,.8)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.45rem', marginBottom: '.3rem', boxSizing: 'border-box' }} />
                  <input value={bbAdUrl} onChange={e => setBbAdUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder="Image URL (optional)"
                    style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.3rem', background: 'rgba(0,10,5,.8)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.45rem', marginBottom: '.4rem', boxSizing: 'border-box' }} />
                  <button onClick={() => { if (bbInfo) updateBillboardContent(bbInfo.id); }}
                    style={{ width: '100%', padding: '.4rem', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.06)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.3)', color: '#38bdf8', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1rem', letterSpacing: '.1em', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    UPDATE AD
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              <div style={{ marginTop: '.6rem', fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.2)', letterSpacing: '.08em' }}>
                Billboard ads display for all players in Minx City. · Florin currency only. · [ESC] to close
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}


      {/* ── WEAPONS WHEEL — bottom-right dual-slot display ─────────────── */}
      {hudOpen && !hudSuppressed && (
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 14, right: 14, zIndex: 150, pointerEvents: 'all' }}>
        <div
          onClick={() => setShowWeapons(v => !v)}
          style={{
            width: 80, height: 80, borderRadius: 8,
            background: showWeapons ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.14)' : 'rgba(0,5,0,.92)',
            border: `2px solid ${showWeapons ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.6)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.28)'}`,
            display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            cursor: 'pointer', boxShadow: '0 0 14px rgba(56,189,248,.15)',
            transition: 'all .15s ease', gap: 2,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.9rem', color: WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === activeWeapon)?.color ?? '#38bdf8' }}>⚔</span>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.45rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.7)', letterSpacing: '.02em' }}>{activeWeapon}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ width: '70%', height: 1, background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)' }} />
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.9rem', color: WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === secondaryWeapon)?.color ?? '#38bdf8' }}>🔫</span>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.45rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.7)', letterSpacing: '.02em' }}>{secondaryWeapon}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        {showWeapons && (() => {
          const iconMap: Record<string, string> = { fists: '✊', sword: '⚔', gun: '🔫', laser: '⚡', bomb: '💣', knife: '🔪', revolver: '🔫', pistol: '🔫', rifle: '🎯' };
          const available = WEAPONS.filter(w => unlockedWeapons.has(w.id));
          const meleeWpns = available.filter(w => w.type === 'melee');
          const rangedWpns = available.filter(w => w.type === 'ranged');
          const renderSlot = (label: string, wpns: typeof WEAPONS, current: string, onSelect: (id: string) => void) => (
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.45rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', letterSpacing: '.12em', padding: '3px 4px', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.12)', marginBottom: '2px' }}>{label}</div>
              {wpns.map(w => {
                const isActive = current === w.id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={w.id}
                    onClick={() => onSelect(w.id)}
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '.4rem',
                      padding: '.3rem .45rem', cursor: 'pointer',
                      background: isActive ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.14)' : 'transparent',
                      border: `1px solid ${isActive ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)'}`,
                      transition: 'all .1s ease',
                    }}
                  >
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '1.1rem', width: 22, textAlign: 'center' }}>{iconMap[w.icon] ?? '?'}</span>
                    <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                      <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.95rem', color: isActive ? w.color : 'rgba(56,189,248,.7)', letterSpacing: '.06em', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
                        {isActive ? '▸ ' : ''}{w.label}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', marginTop: 1 }}>+{w.atkBonus} ATK</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
              {wpns.length === 0 && <div style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.2)', padding: '.3rem .45rem' }}>No {label.toLowerCase()} weapons</div>}
            </div>
          );
          return (
            <div style={{
              position: 'absolute', bottom: 88, right: 0, width: 210,
              background: 'rgba(0,5,0,.97)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)',
              boxShadow: '0 0 24px rgba(56,189,248,.12)', padding: '.35rem',
              display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '3px',
            }}>
              {renderSlot('MELEE SLOT [SPACE]', meleeWpns, activeWeapon, (id) => {
                setActiveWeapon(id); activeWeaponRef.current = id;
                setNarr(`> MELEE EQUIPPED: ${WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === id)?.label}. ${WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === id)?.desc}`);
              })}
              <div style={{ height: 1, background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)', margin: '4px 0' }} />
              {renderSlot('RANGED SLOT [F]', rangedWpns, secondaryWeapon, (id) => {
                setSecondaryWeapon(id); secondaryWeaponRef.current = id;
                setNarr(`> RANGED EQUIPPED: ${WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === id)?.label}. ${WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === id)?.desc}`);
              })}
            </div>
          );
        })()}
      </div>
      )}

      {/* ── MERCHANT PANEL ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showMerchant && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const VTM: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const doMerchBuy = async (item: MerchantItem) => {
          if (g.salary < item.price) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FIAT — Need ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()}.`); return; }
          if (g.ownedItems.has(item.id)) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> ALREADY OWNED — ${item.name} is in your inventory.`); return; }
          const paid = await performGameplayFiatAction(`world_item_${item.id}`, `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:merchant:${item.id}:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
          if (!paid || paid.duplicate) return;
          sfxCoin(); recordBizRevenue(item.effect.startsWith('passport_') ? 'passport' : 'merchant_weapon', item.price);
          g.ownedItems.add(item.id); setOwnedItems(new Set(g.ownedItems));
          if (item.effect.startsWith('unlock_')) {
            const wpnId = item.effect.replace('unlock_', '');
            unlockedWeaponsRef.current.add(wpnId);
            setUnlockedWeapons(new Set(unlockedWeaponsRef.current));
            const purchasedWpnDef = WEAPONS.find(w => w.id === wpnId);
            if (purchasedWpnDef && purchasedWpnDef.type === 'ranged') {
              setSecondaryWeapon(wpnId); secondaryWeaponRef.current = wpnId;
            } else {
              setActiveWeapon(wpnId); activeWeaponRef.current = wpnId;
            }
            wsSend({ type: 'weapon_purchase', weaponId: wpnId, cost: item.price });
            const slotLabel = purchasedWpnDef && purchasedWpnDef.type === 'ranged' ? 'ranged slot' : 'melee slot';
            setNarr(`> ${item.name} unlocked! Weapon equipped to ${slotLabel}. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} FIAT spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'maxhp20') {
            g.maxHp += 20; g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + 20); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp));
            setNarr(`> HP UP — Max HP increased by 20. Current: ${g.maxHp}. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'maxhp40') {
            g.maxHp += 40; g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + 40); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp));
            setNarr(`> HP UP II — Max HP increased by 40. Current: ${g.maxHp}. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'speed10') {
            setNarr(`> SPEED BOOST applied. +10% movement speed. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'atk5') {
            g.level += 0; // ATK is level-based; we'll grant bonus via ownedItems check
            setNarr(`> ATK BOOST — +5 base attack permanently. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'armor15') {
            setNarr(`> ARMOR PLATE equipped. Incoming damage reduced by 15%. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'passport_basic_city') {
            g.passport = 'basic_city'; setPassport('basic_city');
            setNarr(`> FORGED CITY PASSPORT acquired. Checkpoint access granted (crossing fee applies). ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'passport_full_city') {
            g.passport = 'full_city'; setPassport('full_city');
            setNarr(`> FORGED FULL PASSPORT acquired. Priority checkpoint access — no crossing fee. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'passport_wasteland') {
            g.passport = 'wasteland'; setPassport('wasteland');
            setNarr(`> WASTELAND PERMIT acquired. Outer sector transit authorized. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'work_permit') {
            void performGameplayFiatAction('workstation_cycle', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:workstation-cycle:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
            setNarr(`> WORK PERMIT filed. +500 FIAT signing bonus deposited. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else if (item.effect === 'identity_scrub') {
            setNarr(`> IDENTITY SCRUB complete. Criminal record erased. All faction hostility reset. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} spent.`);
          } else {
            setNarr(`> ${item.name} acquired. ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} FIAT spent.`);
          }
        };
        return (
          <div style={{ position:'absolute', inset:0, background:'rgba(0,0,0,.93)', display:'flex', alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', zIndex:360 }}
            onClick={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) { setShowMerchant(null); frozenRef.current = false; } }}>
            <div style={{ width:500, maxHeight:'85vh', display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.35)', background:'rgba(0,6,2,.98)', fontFamily:"var(--font-sans)" }}>
              <div style={{ padding:'1rem 1.2rem .6rem', borderBottom:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)', display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'center', flexShrink:0 }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ ...VTM, fontSize:'1.5rem', color:'#38bdf8', letterSpacing:'.14em' }}>{showMerchant.name} — MERCHANT</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.42rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', letterSpacing:'.12em' }}>{showMerchant.items.some(i => i.effect.startsWith('passport_')) ? 'DOCUMENTS · FORGERIES · FIAT ONLY' : 'WEAPONS · UPGRADES · FIAT ONLY'}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign:'right' }}>
                  <div style={{ ...VTM, fontSize:'1.1rem', color:'#38bdf8' }}>ƒ{salary.toLocaleString()}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize:'.4rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.3)' }}>FIAT BALANCE</div>
                  <button onClick={() => { setShowMerchant(null); frozenRef.current = false; }} style={{ marginTop:'.3rem', padding:'.2rem .6rem', background:'transparent', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2)', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', cursor:'pointer', ...VTM, fontSize:'.95rem' }}>ESC</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex:1, overflowY:'auto', padding:'.8rem 1rem' }}>
                <div style={{ display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', gap:'.5rem' }}>
                  {showMerchant.items.map(item => {
                    const owned = g.ownedItems.has(item.id);
                    const canAfford = g.salary >= item.price;
                    return (
                      <div key={item.id} style={{ display:'grid', gridTemplateColumns:'1fr auto', gap:'.6rem', alignItems:'center', padding:'.6rem .7rem', border:`1px solid ${owned ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.25)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.12)'}`, background: owned ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.04)' : 'transparent' }}>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{ display:'flex', alignItems:'center', gap:'.5rem', marginBottom:'.2rem' }}>
                            <span style={{ ...VTM, fontSize:'1.05rem', color: owned ? '#38bdf8' : '#ff9900', letterSpacing:'.08em' }}>{item.name}</span>
                            {owned && <span style={{ fontSize:'.38rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.5)', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.25)', padding:'1px 5px' }}>OWNED</span>}
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize:'.46rem', color:'rgba(56,189,248,.4)', lineHeight:1.6 }}>{item.desc}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', alignItems:'flex-end', gap:'.3rem', flexShrink:0 }}>
                          <div style={{ ...VTM, fontSize:'1rem', color: canAfford ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(255,80,80,.6)' }}>ƒ{item.price.toLocaleString()}</div>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => doMerchBuy(item)}
                            disabled={owned}
                            style={{ padding:'.25rem .7rem', background: owned ? 'transparent' : canAfford ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)' : 'transparent', border:`1px solid ${owned ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.15)' : canAfford ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.4)' : 'rgba(255,80,80,.3)'}`, color: owned ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.25)' : canAfford ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(255,80,80,.5)', cursor: owned ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', ...VTM, fontSize:'.95rem', letterSpacing:'.08em' }}>
                            {owned ? 'OWNED' : canAfford ? 'BUY' : 'NO FIAT'}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* Level-up popup removed — SALARYMAN has no levels/XP (net-worth economy). */}

      {lootPanel && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: '15%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 400, pointerEvents: 'auto', minWidth: 220, maxWidth: 320 }} onClick={() => setLootPanel(null)}>
          <div style={{ background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.92)', border: `1px solid ${lootPanel.money < 0 ? '#ff2222' : '#38bdf8'}`, borderRadius: 4, padding: '12px 16px', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.7rem', letterSpacing: '.15em', color: lootPanel.money < 0 ? '#ff4444' : '#38bdf8', marginBottom: 8, textAlign: 'center' }}>
              {lootPanel.money < 0 ? '▼ LOOT LOST ▼' : '▲ LOOT ACQUIRED ▲'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: '#889', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>{lootPanel.source}</div>
            {lootPanel.money !== 0 && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: '.65rem', color: lootPanel.money < 0 ? '#ff6644' : '#ffdd44', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                {lootPanel.money < 0 ? `−ƒ${Math.abs(lootPanel.money).toLocaleString()}` : `+ƒ${lootPanel.money.toLocaleString()}`} FIAT
              </div>
            )}
            {lootPanel.items.map((it, i) => (
              <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: '#67e8f9', textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 2 }}>
                + {it.name}{it.desc ? ` — ${it.desc}` : ''}
              </div>
            ))}
            <div style={{ fontSize: '.4rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.3)', textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 8, letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>TAP TO DISMISS</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── BANCO OMBRA TERMINAL ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showBank && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const VTB: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const STB: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const tabBtn = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
          padding: '.4rem .75rem', border: active ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.7)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.15)',
          background: active ? 'rgba(56,189,248,.08)' : 'transparent',
          color: active ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.35)', cursor: 'pointer', ...VTB, fontSize: '.95rem', letterSpacing: '.08em',
        });
        const inp: React.CSSProperties = {
          background: 'rgba(0,8,0,.95)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.3)', color: '#38bdf8',
          padding: '.4rem .65rem', outline: 'none', ...STB, fontSize: '.85rem', caretColor: '#38bdf8', boxSizing: 'border-box',
        };
        const actBtn = (enabled: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
          padding: '.45rem 1.2rem', border: enabled ? '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.5)' : '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)',
          background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.06)', color: enabled ? '#38bdf8' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.2)',
          cursor: enabled ? 'pointer' : 'default', ...VTB, fontSize: '1.1rem', letterSpacing: '.1em', whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        });
        const doDeposit = () => {
          const amt = parseInt(bankDepAmt) || 0;
          if (amt <= 0 || amt > g.salary) { sfxError(); setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Insufficient checking balance.'); return; }
          const tax = amt >= 5000 ? Math.floor(amt * 0.12) : 0;
          // Client-side savings transfers are retired: Banco Ombra owns account
          // transfers and the wallet cache is refreshed from its response.
          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Use the bank terminal to transfer FIAT between accounts.');
          return;
          g.savings += (amt - tax); setSavings(g.savings);
          if (tax > 0) addBankTx('PABLO CORP DEPOSIT TAX (12%)', -tax, g.salary, 'deposit_tax');
          addBankTx('CHECKING → SAVINGS DEPOSIT', -amt, g.salary, 'general');
          setBankDepAmt(''); sfxCoin();
          setNarr(`> DEPOSITED ƒ${amt.toLocaleString()} to SAVINGS.${tax > 0 ? ` PABLO CORP TAX: ƒ${tax.toLocaleString()}.` : ' No tax.'} Savings: ƒ${g.savings.toLocaleString()}.`);
        };
        const consolidateSavings = async () => {
          const requested = bankDepAmt.trim() || 'all';
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch('/api/economy/bank/consolidate-savings', {
              method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ amount: requested === 'all' ? 'all' : Number(requested) }),
            });
            const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!r.ok) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> SAVINGS CONSOLIDATION — ${j.error ?? 'TRANSFER FAILED'}.`); return; }
            const checking = j.accounts?.find((a: { kind: string }) => a.kind === 'checking');
            const savingsAccount = j.accounts?.find((a: { kind: string }) => a.kind === 'savings');
            reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(Number(checking?.balance ?? 0));
            setSavings(Number(savingsAccount?.balance ?? 0));
            setBankDepAmt('');
            sfxCoin();
            setNarr(`> FIAT CONSOLIDATED — ƒ${Number(j.consolidated ?? 0).toLocaleString()} MOVED TO HIGH-YIELD SAVINGS. NO MONEY CREATED.`);
            void refreshServerFiat();
          } catch { sfxError(); setNarr('> SAVINGS CONSOLIDATION — NETWORK ERROR.'); }
        };
        const startAtmTopup = async (packId: string) => {
          setBankTopupBusy(packId);
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch('/api/stripe/create-topup-session', {
              method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ packId, source: 'atm', requestId: stableRequestId('atm-fiat-topup', packId) }),
            });
            const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!r.ok || !j.url) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> CARD → FIAT — ${j.error ?? 'PAYMENT COULD NOT START'}.`); return; }
            window.location.href = j.url;
          } catch { sfxError(); setNarr('> CARD → FIAT — NETWORK ERROR. NO PAYMENT STARTED.'); }
          finally { setBankTopupBusy(null); }
        };
        const startConnectOnboarding = async () => {
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch('/api/stripe/connect/onboard', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include' });
            const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!r.ok || !j.url) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> STRIPE CONNECT — ${j.error ?? 'ONBOARDING COULD NOT START'}.`); return; }
            window.location.href = j.url;
          } catch { sfxError(); setNarr('> STRIPE CONNECT — NETWORK ERROR.'); }
        };
        const cashoutToStripe = async () => {
          const amountFiat = Math.round(Number(cashoutAmt));
          if (!Number.isInteger(amountFiat) || amountFiat <= 0) { sfxError(); setNarr('> CASH-OUT — ENTER A FIAT AMOUNT.'); return; }
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch('/api/stripe/connect/cashout', {
              method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ amountFiat, requestId: stableRequestId('fiat-cashout', String(amountFiat)) }),
            });
            const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
            if (!r.ok) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> CASH-OUT — ${j.error ?? 'TRANSFER FAILED'}.`); return; }
            setCashoutAmt('');
            setNarr(`> CASH-OUT SENT — ƒ${amountFiat.toLocaleString()} → $${(Number(j.netUsdCents) / 100).toFixed(2)} USD. 5% SURCHARGE RETAINED BY PABLO CORP.`);
            void refreshServerFiat();
          } catch { sfxError(); setNarr('> CASH-OUT — NETWORK ERROR.'); }
        };
        const doWithdraw = () => {
          const amt = parseInt(bankWithAmt) || 0;
          if (amt <= 0 || amt > g.savings) { sfxError(); setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Insufficient savings balance.'); return; }
          const { fee, net } = calcAtmFee(amt, ATM_WITHDRAW_FEE_RATE);
          g.savings -= amt;
          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Currency settlement is server-authoritative. Use the bank terminal.');
          return;
          setSavings(g.savings); setSalary(g.salary);
          addBankTx('SAVINGS → CHECKING WITHDRAWAL', net, g.salary, 'general');
          addBankTx(`ATM WITHDRAWAL FEE (${(ATM_WITHDRAW_FEE_RATE * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`, -fee, g.salary, 'atm_fee');
          setBankWithAmt(''); sfxCoin();
          setNarr(`> WITHDREW ƒ${amt.toLocaleString()} from SAVINGS. ATM Fee: ƒ${fee.toLocaleString()} (${(ATM_WITHDRAW_FEE_RATE * 100).toFixed(0)}%). Received: ƒ${net.toLocaleString()}.`);
        };

        // Credit-score-aware lending: better scores cut the interest multiplier
        // and unlock larger principals. Defaults assume mid credit when offline.
        const creditScore = creditInfo?.score ?? 680;
        const creditRateMult = creditScore >= 740 ? 0.8 : creditScore >= 670 ? 1.0 : creditScore >= 580 ? 1.3 : 1.7;
        const maxLoanAmount = creditScore >= 740 ? Infinity : creditScore >= 670 ? 250000 : creditScore >= 580 ? 50000 : 10000;
        const adjInterest = (tier: typeof LOAN_TIERS[number]) => Math.floor(calcLoanInterest(tier) * creditRateMult);
        const enrollPlan = async (term: number) => {
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch('/api/credit/plan/enroll', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ term }) });
            if (!r.ok) { sfxError(); const e = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); setNarr(`> RESTRUCTURE DENIED — ${e.error ?? 'unable to enroll'}.`); return; }
            const j = await r.json();
            setDebtPlan(j.plan);
            sfxCoin();
            setNarr(`> DEBT RESTRUCTURED — ƒ${(j.plan?.balance ?? 0).toLocaleString()} over ${j.plan?.term ?? 0} installments of ƒ${(j.plan?.installment ?? 0).toLocaleString()}. Pablo's collector stands down.`);
            void refreshCredit(true);
          } catch { sfxError(); }
        };
        const payInstallment = async () => {
          const inst = debtPlan?.installment ?? 0;
          if (!inst) return;
          if (g.salary < inst) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FUNDS — Need ƒ${inst.toLocaleString()} for this installment.`); return; }
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch('/api/credit/plan/pay', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
            if (!r.ok) {
              sfxError();
              const e = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
              if (r.status === 402 && typeof e.required === 'number') setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FUNDS — Late fees raised this installment to ƒ${e.required.toLocaleString()}.`);
              void refreshCredit(true);
              return;
            }
            const j = await r.json();
            if (typeof j.newBalance === 'number') reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(j.newBalance);
            addBankTx('DEBT PLAN INSTALLMENT', -j.paid, g.salary, 'loan_interest');
            setDebtPlan(j.plan ?? { active: false });
            sfxCoin();
            setNarr(j.done
              ? '> DEBT CLEARED — Payment plan complete. Account standing: CLEAR.'
              : `> INSTALLMENT PAID — ƒ${j.paid.toLocaleString()}. Remaining: ƒ${(j.plan?.balance ?? 0).toLocaleString()}.`);
            void refreshCredit(true);
          } catch { sfxError(); }
        };
        const payoffPlan = async () => {
          const bal = debtPlan?.balance ?? 0;
          if (!bal) return;
          if (g.salary < bal) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FUNDS — Need ƒ${bal.toLocaleString()} to clear the balance.`); return; }
          try {
            const r = await apiFetch('/api/credit/plan/payoff', { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
            if (!r.ok) {
              sfxError();
              const e = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
              if (r.status === 402 && typeof e.required === 'number') setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FUNDS — Late fees raised the balance to ƒ${e.required.toLocaleString()}.`);
              void refreshCredit(true);
              return;
            }
            const j = await r.json();
            if (typeof j.newBalance === 'number') reconcileAuthoritativeSalary(j.newBalance);
            addBankTx('DEBT PLAN PAYOFF', -j.paid, g.salary, 'loan_interest');
            setDebtPlan({ active: false });
            sfxCoin();
            setNarr(`> DEBT PAID IN FULL — ƒ${j.paid.toLocaleString()}. Account standing: CLEAR.`);
            void refreshCredit(true);
          } catch { sfxError(); }
        };
        const doLoan = (tier: typeof LOAN_TIERS[number]) => {
          if (g.loan) { sfxError(); setNarr('> CREDIT DENIED — Active loan outstanding. Repay before borrowing again.'); return; }
          if (tier.amount > maxLoanAmount) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> CREDIT DENIED — Score ${creditScore} qualifies for up to ƒ${maxLoanAmount.toLocaleString()}. Raise your standing for larger lines.`); return; }
          // Proof of income required for loans ≥ ƒ25,000 — must have a game job or
          // registered business. Org membership salary counts as employment.
          const hasLoanIncome = !!(g.employedSalary && g.employedSalary > 0) || (gs.current.businesses ?? []).length > 0 || !!(char as any).orgId;
          if (!hasLoanIncome && tier.amount >= 25_000) {
            sfxError();
            setNarr('> LOAN DENIED — Loans ≥ ƒ25,000 require proof of income. Get employed or register a business first.');
            return;
          }
          const interest = adjInterest(tier);
          const origFee  = calcOriginationFee(tier);
          const received  = tier.amount - origFee;
          const loan = { amount: tier.amount, interest, issuedAt: g.frame, dueAt: g.frame + tier.durationFrames };
          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Loans are issued only through server banking.'); return;
          setBankLoan(loan);
          if (origFee > 0) addBankTx(`ORIGINATION FEE (${(tier.originationFeeRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`, -origFee, g.salary, 'loan_origination');
          addBankTx(`LOAN ISSUED @ ${(tier.baseInterestRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%${tier.compounding ? ' COMPOUND' : ' FLAT'}`, received, g.salary, 'general');
          sfxCoin();
          const durationMin = Math.round(tier.durationFrames / 60 / 60);
          setNarr(`> LOAN APPROVED — ƒ${tier.amount.toLocaleString()} · Int: ƒ${interest.toLocaleString()}${tier.compounding ? ' (compound)' : ''} · Fee: ƒ${origFee.toLocaleString()} · Repay within ~${durationMin} min. Late = penalty.`);
        };
        const doRepay = () => {
          const loan = g.loan; if (!loan) return;
          const totalDue = loan.amount + loan.interest;
          if (g.salary < totalDue) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FUNDS — Need ƒ${totalDue.toLocaleString()}.`); return; }
          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Loan payoff must be made through server banking.'); return;
          g.loan = null; setBankLoan(null);
          addBankTx(`LOAN REPAID ƒ${loan.amount.toLocaleString()} + ƒ${loan.interest.toLocaleString()} INT`, -totalDue, g.salary, 'loan_interest');
          sfxCoin();
          setNarr(`> LOAN REPAID — ƒ${totalDue.toLocaleString()} FIAT. Account standing: CLEAR. Debt collectors stand down.`);
          void refreshCredit(true);
        };
        const doWire = () => {
          const amt = parseInt(bankWireAmt) || 0;
          const to = bankWireTo.trim().toUpperCase();
          if (!to || amt <= 0) { sfxError(); return; }
          const fee = Math.ceil(amt * 0.03);
          if (amt + fee > g.salary) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> INSUFFICIENT FUNDS — Need ƒ${(amt+fee).toLocaleString()} (inc. 3% tax).`); return; }
          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Wire transfers must be made through server banking.'); return;
          addBankTx(`WIRE → ${to}`, -amt, g.salary, 'general');
          addBankTx('PABLO CORP WIRE TAX (3%)', -fee, g.salary, 'wire_tax');
          wsSend({ type: 'wire', to, amount: amt, from: char?.name ?? 'BANCO OMBRA' });
          setBankWireAmt(''); setBankWireTo(''); sfxCoin();
          setNarr(`> WIRE SENT — ƒ${amt.toLocaleString()} → ${to}. Fee: ƒ${fee.toLocaleString()}. PABLO CORP logged it.`);

        const isOverdue = bankLoan ? g.frame > bankLoan.dueAt : false;

          atm_fee: '#ff8844', loan_interest: '#ff6666', loan_origination: '#ffaa44',
          property_tax: '#ff4488', resale_fee: '#ff88cc', exchange_spread: '#88aaff',
          deposit_tax: '#ffaa44', wire_tax: '#ffcc44', income: '#44ff88', general: 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)',
        };

                          const scores = hist.map(h => h.score);

                          ? `Late fee ${((debtPlan.lateFeeRate ?? 0.05) * 100).toFixed(0)}% per missed cycle — pay now or default reverts your full debt to collections.`
                          : "On schedule. Pablo's collector stands down while you keep paying."}

                  ) : (debtPlan && (debtPlan.debt ?? 0) > 0) ? (
                    <div style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(255,140,60,.3)', padding: '.75rem' }}>

                    </div>

                    <>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.28)', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>AVAILABLE CREDIT — SELECT AMOUNT</div>
                      {/* Income requirement notice */}
                      {(() => {
                        const hasLoanIncome = !!(g.employedSalary && g.employedSalary > 0) || (gs.current.businesses ?? []).length > 0 || !!(char as any).orgId;

                    const lastY = toY(values[values.length - 1]).toFixed(1);

                          <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(180,140,255,.25)', letterSpacing: '.1em', width: 64 }}>CATEGORY</div>

                          <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(180,140,255,.25)', letterSpacing: '.1em', textAlign: 'right' }}>PAID</div>
                        </div>
                        {pledgePurchases.map((p, i) => (
                          <div key={p.id} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'auto 1fr auto', gap: '.5rem', padding: '.25rem .45rem', background: i%2===0 ? 'rgba(180,140,255,.03)' : 'transparent', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(180,140,255,.05)', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '.38rem', color: 'rgba(180,140,255,.6)', border: '1px solid rgba(180,140,255,.25)', padding: '1px 4px', width: 64, textAlign: 'center', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{(p.category || '').replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '.46rem', color: 'rgba(200,170,255,.6)', letterSpacing: '.03em' }}>{p.name}</div>
                            <div style={{ ...VTB, fontSize: '.9rem', color: '#b48cff', textAlign: 'right' }}>${(p.amountCents / 100).toFixed(2)}</div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>)}
              </div>
              {/* Footer */}
              <div style={{ padding: '.4rem 1.1rem', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.1)', fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(56,189,248,.12)', letterSpacing: '.06em', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                <span>BANCO OMBRA IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DEPOSITS SEIZED BY PABLO CORP DURING MARTIAL LAW PERIODS. ALL TRANSACTIONS FINAL.</span>
                <span>ESC TO CLOSE</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* ── HAMLET SPAWN / WAKE UP ── */}
      {showIndoorStart && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const hamletBid = g.hamletBuildingId;
        const isUnemployed = char.bizType === 'unemployed' || !char.hasBusiness;
        const hamletB = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === hamletBid);

        const isCampsite = CAMPSITE_IDS.includes(hamletBid);

                ? `${hamletLabel} — YOUR HAMLET`
                : (() => { const ht = HOUSING_TIERS.find(t => t.id === gs.current.housingTier); return ht ? ht.label : 'YOUR ROOM'; })()}

            <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.7rem', color: `${spawnColor}.5)`, lineHeight: 2, marginBottom: '1.5rem', letterSpacing: '.04em' }}>

                isShelter ? (<>
                  The shelter is cold. Concrete walls. A single overhead light buzzes.<br/>
                  Your cot is wedged between twenty others. Someone coughs in the dark.<br/>
                  No PABLO CORP device. No corporate shield. Just the city and your wits.<br/>
                  The door is unlocked. The street waits outside.
                </>) : isCampsite ? (<>
                  The campsite fire has burned to embers. Wasteland wind rattles the tarp.<br/>
                  Your pack is where you left it. Nothing stolen — this time.<br/>
                  No company name above your head. No one looking for you.<br/>
                  You can hear the city hum from here. Or you can walk further out.
                </>) : (<>
                  The bunker hatch creaks. Emergency lighting casts long shadows.<br/>
                  Pre-collapse supplies line the walls. Someone patched the ventilation.<br/>
                  PABLO CORP forgot this place exists. That's why you're here.<br/>
                  Time to move.
                </>)
              ) : (<>
                Fluorescent light buzzes overhead. The curtains don't fully close.<br/>
                Through the gap: SHADOW TOWER's silhouette against a green-black sky.<br/>
                Your PABLO CORP device blinks on the nightstand. A notification pulses.<br/>
                The building intercom crackles: "...all residents... PABLO CORP advisory..."<br/>
                You're already dressed. You were expecting this.

              onClick={() => {

                const spawnBid = g.hamletBuildingId;
                const spawnB = BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === spawnBid) ?? BUILDINGS.find(b => b.id === 'minx_arms')!;
                g.px = spawnB.x + spawnB.w / 2;
                g.py = spawnB.y + spawnB.h + 20;
                const def = getInterior(spawnBid);
                if (def) {
                  let spawnIx = def.exitX + def.exitW / 2;
                  let spawnIy = def.exitY - 20;
                  const spawnICol = (ipx: number, ipy: number) => {
                    if (ipx < PSIZE + 6 || ipx > def.width - PSIZE - 6 || ipy < PSIZE + 20 || ipy > def.height - PSIZE) return true;
                    for (const obj of def.objects) {
                      if (obj.type === 'window' || obj.type === 'plant') continue;
                      if (ipx + PSIZE > obj.x && ipx - PSIZE < obj.x + obj.w && ipy + PSIZE > obj.y && ipy - PSIZE < obj.y + obj.h) return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                  };
                  if (spawnICol(spawnIx, spawnIy)) {
                    for (let r = 8; r <= 200; r += 8) {
                      let escaped = false;
                      for (const [ox, oy] of [[0,r],[0,-r],[r,0],[-r,0],[r,r],[-r,r],[r,-r],[-r,-r]]) {
                        if (!spawnICol(spawnIx + ox, spawnIy + oy)) { spawnIx += ox; spawnIy += oy; escaped = true; break; }
                      }
                      if (escaped) break;
                    }
                  }
                  g.interior = {

'rgba(255,200,60,.5)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,.5)'}`, color: accentColor, fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.4rem', letterSpacing: '.18em', cursor: 'pointer' }}
            >
              WAKE UP

'linear-gradient(90deg,#22dd66,#55ffaa)' : channelBar.eventType === 'evt_fire' ? 'linear-gradient(90deg,#ff5533,#ffcc22)' : 'linear-gradient(90deg,#3388ff,#88ccff)', transition: 'width .12s linear' }} />

          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', maxWidth: 520, padding: '2rem' }}>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '1.6rem', color: '#ff6644', letterSpacing: '.15em', marginBottom: '1rem', textShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(255,60,30,.4)' }}>YOU DIED DURING YOUR LAST SESSION.</div>

'THE LAB' : '1999'}...`}</div>}>

                    setShowSecretLabPrompt(null);
                    setShowSoundLab(true);
                  } else {
                    setNarr('> WRONG PASSWORD.');
                  }
                }}
                  style={{ padding: '6px 18px', background: 'rgba(56,189,248,.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.3)', color: '#38bdf8', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.5rem', letterSpacing: '.08em', borderRadius: '3px' }}>ENTER</button>
              </div>
            </>)}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showNewspaper && (() => {
        const np = showNewspaper;
        return (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, zIndex: 700, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.82)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}>
            <div style={{ width: '700px', maxWidth: '96vw', maxHeight: '92vh', background: '#f5f0e0', color: '#1a1a1a', borderRadius: '3px', overflow: 'auto', boxShadow: '0 0 40px rgba(255,200,60,.15)', border: '2px solid #2a2a2a' }}>
              <div style={{ background: '#1a1a1a', color: '#f5f0e0', padding: '10px 16px', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '2rem', fontWeight: 'bold', letterSpacing: '.3em', lineHeight: 1.1 }}>THE MINX</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', letterSpacing: '.15em', opacity: .6, marginTop: '2px' }}>INDEPENDENT UNDERGROUND PRESS — ISSUE #{np.issue} — {np.season} EDITION — PRICE: FREE (100 FIAT TO KEEP)</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: '14px 18px' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 'bold', lineHeight: 1.2, borderBottom: '2px solid #1a1a1a', paddingBottom: '6px', marginBottom: '4px' }}>{np.headline}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '.7rem', fontStyle: 'italic', color: '#555', marginBottom: '12px' }}>{np.subhead}</div>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: np.articles.length > 3 ? '1fr 1fr' : '1fr', gap: '10px', marginBottom: '14px' }}>
                  {np.articles.map((a, i) => (
                    <div key={i} style={{ borderLeft: '2px solid #ccc', paddingLeft: '8px' }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.72rem', fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: '3px', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>{a.title}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '.58rem', lineHeight: 1.5, color: '#333' }}>{a.body}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #aaa', paddingTop: '8px', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.6rem', fontWeight: 'bold', marginBottom: '4px', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>WEATHER REPORT</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', color: '#444', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{np.weather}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '6px', marginBottom: '10px', borderTop: '1px solid #aaa', paddingTop: '8px' }}>
                  {np.ads.map((ad, i) => (
                    <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: '#555', background: '#ece7d5', padding: '4px 6px', border: '1px dashed #bbb' }}>{ad}</div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '.55rem', fontStyle: 'italic', color: '#444', borderTop: '1px solid #aaa', paddingTop: '8px', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{np.editorial}</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '12px', padding: '10px 16px', borderTop: '1px solid #ccc', background: '#ece7d5' }}>
                <button onClick={() => {
                  const g = gs.current;
                  if (g.salary < 100) { setNarr('> NOT ENOUGH FIAT — You need 100 FIAT to keep this newspaper.'); return; }
                  if (g.inventory.length >= INVENTORY_MAX_SLOTS) { setNarr('> INVENTORY FULL — No room for the newspaper.'); return; }
                  const itemId = `newspaper_${np.issue}_${Date.now()}`;
                  void performGameplayFiatAction('newspaper_purchase', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:newspaper:${np.issue}:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`).then(paid => {
                    if (!paid || paid.duplicate) return;
                    const newItem: InventoryItem = { id: itemId, name: `THE MINX #${np.issue}`, desc: `${np.season} edition of THE MINX underground newspaper.`, icon: '📰', stackable: false, qty: 1, value: 50 };
                    g.inventory.push(newItem);
                    setInventory([...g.inventory]);
                    setNarr(`> PURCHASED — THE MINX Issue #${np.issue} (${np.season}) added to inventory. -100 FIAT`);
                    setShowNewspaper(null);
                    gameRef.current?.focus();
                  });
                }} style={{ padding: '6px 18px', background: '#1a1a1a', color: '#f5f0e0', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.65rem', letterSpacing: '.08em' }}>KEEP COPY — 100 FIAT</button>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowNewspaper(null); gameRef.current?.focus(); }} style={{ padding: '6px 18px', background: 'transparent', color: '#1a1a1a', border: '1px solid #1a1a1a', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.65rem', letterSpacing: '.08em' }}>CLOSE</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* ── CAMP PANEL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
          Opens when [E] is pressed near a campfire (or automatically when
          the player presses [B] to make camp). Four actions:
          REST — heal + save (with raid risk, unchanged from before)
          EAT  — consume any food/consumable in inventory
          COOK — convert raw meat → cooked meat (better stats)
          BREAK CAMP — extinguish and pick up the fire. */}
      {showCamp && campsitePos && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const VT: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const STM: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        // Helper to apply an effect string ("hunger30 hp10 ...") to player state.
        const applyEffect = (eff: string) => {
          const parts = eff.split(' ');
          for (const p of parts) {
            if (p.startsWith('hunger'))      { g.hunger = Math.min(100, g.hunger + parseInt(p.slice(6))); setHunger(g.hunger); }
            else if (p === 'thirst-10')       { g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - 10); setThirst(g.thirst); }
            else if (p.startsWith('thirst'))  { g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + parseInt(p.slice(6))); setThirst(g.thirst); }
            else if (p.startsWith('energy'))  { g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + parseInt(p.slice(6))); setEnergy(g.energy); }
            else if (p.startsWith('hp') && p !== 'hprisk5') { g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + parseInt(p.slice(2))); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); }
            else if (p === 'hprisk5' && Math.random() < 0.25) { g.hp = Math.max(1, g.hp - 5); setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: 'BAD BATCH −5 HP', color: '#ff4444', life: 60, maxLife: 60 }); }
            else if (p === 'cure_poison')     { g.poisoned = false; g.poisonTick = 0; setPoisoned(false); }
          }
        };
        // Food = any inventory item that has an effect string defined via
        // ANIMAL_DROPS_BY_ID / COOKED_FOODS. Purchased consumables carry
        // their effect via the vending machine menu but, once owned, we
        // only track the id; for now we list wild food first-class and
        // fall back to any item whose id matches a known food dictionary.
        const foodDict: Record<string, string> = {};
        for (const d of ANIMAL_DROPS) foodDict[d.id] = d.effect;
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(COOKED_FOODS)) foodDict[k] = v.effect;
        // Include a few base-game consumables by id so purchased rations also work here
        foodDict.ration_pack = 'hunger40 thirst10';
        foodDict.purified_water = 'thirst50';
        foodDict.synth_ramen = 'hunger50 energy15';
        foodDict.nutri_pack = 'hunger60 thirst60';
        foodDict.cooked_meat = COOKED_FOODS.cooked_meat.effect;
        foodDict.cooked_game = COOKED_FOODS.cooked_game.effect;
        const foods = g.inventory
          .map((it, idx) => ({ it, idx }))
          .filter(({ it }) => foodDict[it.id] !== undefined);
        const cookables = g.inventory
          .map((it, idx) => ({ it, idx, drop: ANIMAL_DROPS_BY_ID[it.id] }))
          .filter(({ drop }) => drop && drop.cooked);
        const consumeAt = (idx: number) => {
          const item = g.inventory[idx];
          if (!item) return;
          const eff = foodDict[item.id];
          if (!eff) { sfxError(); return; }
          applyEffect(eff);
          // Pets share the meal — eating restores their stamina too.
          let fedPet = false;
          for (const pet of [g.dogCompanion, g.catCompanion]) {
            if (!pet.active || pet.injured) continue;
            pet.stamina = Math.min(100, pet.stamina + 30);
            fedPet = true;
          }
          sfxHeal();
          setNarr(`> ATE ${item.name}.${fedPet ? ' Shared a bite with your companion.' : ''}`);
          if (item.qty > 1) item.qty -= 1;
          else g.inventory.splice(idx, 1);
          setInventory([...g.inventory]);
        };
        const cookAt = (idx: number) => {
          const raw = g.inventory[idx];
          const drop = raw && ANIMAL_DROPS_BY_ID[raw.id];
          if (!raw || !drop || !drop.cooked) { sfxError(); return; }
          const cookedDef = COOKED_FOODS[drop.cooked];
          if (!cookedDef) { sfxError(); return; }
          if (raw.qty > 1) raw.qty -= 1; else g.inventory.splice(idx, 1);
          addStackToInventory(g.inventory, { id: cookedDef.id, name: cookedDef.name, desc: cookedDef.desc, icon: cookedDef.icon, stackable: true, qty: 1, value: cookedDef.value });
          setInventory([...g.inventory]);
          sfxHeal();
          setNarr(`> COOKED — ${raw.name} → ${cookedDef.name}. Fire crackles.`);
        };
        const restAtCamp = () => {
          g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + 30); g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + 30); g.hunger = Math.max(0, g.hunger - 5); g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - 5);
          setHp(g.hp); setEnergy(g.energy); setHunger(g.hunger); setThirst(g.thirst);
          sfxSave(); doSave({ name: char.name, class: char.class, level: g.level, exp: g.exp, salary: g.salary });
          const raidChance = g.realEstate.some((r: string) => r.startsWith('lot_')) ? 0.05 : 0.15;
          const defenseBonus = campsiteTurret ? 0.5 : 0;
          if (Math.random() < raidChance * (1 - defenseBonus)) {
            const loot = Math.floor(g.salary * 0.05);
            void performGameplayFiatAction('robbery_loss', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:robbery:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
            setNarr(`> CAMP RAIDED — Scavengers hit you while you slept! Lost ƒ${loot.toLocaleString()} FIAT.${campsiteTurret ? ' Turret reduced losses.' : ' Install a TURRET for defense.'}`);
          } else {
            setNarr(`> RESTED — HP +30, Energy +30. Progress saved.${campsiteTurret ? ' Turret active.' : ''}`);
          }
          setShowCamp(false);
        };
        const breakCamp = () => {
          setCampsitePos(null);
          setCampsiteTurret(false);
          setShowCamp(false);
          sfxUIClick();
          setNarr('> CAMP BROKEN — Fire extinguished.');
        };
        const btnBase: React.CSSProperties = {
          padding: '.5rem .8rem', border: '1px solid rgba(255,200,80,.4)', background: 'rgba(20,10,0,.85)',
          color: '#ffcc66', cursor: 'pointer', ...STM, fontSize: '.85rem', letterSpacing: '.08em',
          transition: 'all .15s',
        };
        const rowStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '.35rem .5rem', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,200,80,.12)',
          ...VT, fontSize: '.95rem', color: '#ffd488',
        };
        return (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, zIndex: 400, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.7)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}
            onClick={() => setShowCamp(false)}>
            <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{
              width: 'min(520px, 92vw)', maxHeight: '86vh', overflowY: 'auto',
              background: 'rgba(15,8,2,.96)',
              border: '2px solid rgba(255,160,40,.55)',
              boxShadow: '0 0 40px rgba(255,160,40,.25), inset 0 0 30px rgba(255,100,20,.08)',
              padding: '1.1rem 1.2rem',
            }}>
              <div style={{ ...STM, fontSize: '.7rem', letterSpacing: '.22em', color: 'rgba(255,200,80,.5)', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                ░ MINX CITY SURVIVAL ░
              </div>
              <div style={{ ...VT, fontSize: '1.4rem', color: '#ffcc66', textShadow: '0 0 6px rgba(255,160,40,.5)', marginBottom: '.8rem', letterSpacing: '.04em' }}>
                CAMPFIRE
              </div>
              {/* Action row */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, marginBottom: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <button style={btnBase} onClick={restAtCamp}>◉ REST &amp; SAVE</button>
                <button style={{ ...btnBase, borderColor: 'rgba(255,120,80,.4)', color: '#ff9966' }} onClick={breakCamp}>✕ BREAK CAMP</button>
              </div>
              {/* COOK section */}
              <div style={{ ...STM, fontSize: '.6rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,80,.5)', letterSpacing: '.18em', marginBottom: 4 }}>▸ COOK OVER FIRE</div>
              <div style={{ background: 'rgba(30,15,0,.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,160,40,.2)', padding: '.3rem .4rem', marginBottom: 14, minHeight: 44 }}>
                {cookables.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ ...VT, color: 'rgba(255,200,80,.35)', fontSize: '.85rem', padding: '.3rem' }}>
                    No raw meat to cook. Hunt an animal first.
                  </div>
                ) : cookables.map(({ it, idx }) => (
                  <div key={idx} style={rowStyle}>
                    <span>{it.icon} {it.name} ×{it.qty}</span>
                    <button style={{ ...btnBase, padding: '.2rem .5rem', fontSize: '.7rem' }} onClick={() => cookAt(idx)}>COOK</button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {/* EAT section */}
              <div style={{ ...STM, fontSize: '.6rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,80,.5)', letterSpacing: '.18em', marginBottom: 4 }}>▸ EAT FROM PACK</div>
              <div style={{ background: 'rgba(30,15,0,.5)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,160,40,.2)', padding: '.3rem .4rem', minHeight: 44 }}>
                {foods.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ ...VT, color: 'rgba(255,200,80,.35)', fontSize: '.85rem', padding: '.3rem' }}>
                    Nothing edible in your pack. Hunt, forage, or buy rations.
                  </div>
                ) : foods.map(({ it, idx }) => (
                  <div key={idx} style={rowStyle}>
                    <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{it.icon} {it.name} ×{it.qty}</span>
                    <span style={{ ...STM, fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,80,.5)', marginRight: 8 }}>{foodDict[it.id]}</span>
                    <button style={{ ...btnBase, padding: '.2rem .5rem', fontSize: '.7rem' }} onClick={() => consumeAt(idx)}>EAT</button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div style={{ ...STM, fontSize: '.55rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,80,.3)', letterSpacing: '.12em', marginTop: 12, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                [ESC] / click outside to close • [B] anywhere to pitch a new camp
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {showInventory && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const inShop = g.interior && (g.interior.bid === 'pawn_shop' || g.interior.bid === 'market');
        const sellItem = (idx: number) => {
          const item = g.inventory[idx];
          if (!item) return;
          void performGameplayFiatAction('inventory_sale', `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:inventory-sale:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
          g.inventory.splice(idx, 1);
          setSalary(g.salary);
          setInventory([...g.inventory]);
          sfxCoin();
          setNarr(`> SOLD — ${item.name} for ${item.value} FIAT. "Pleasure doing business."`);
        };
        return (
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, zIndex: 700, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.78)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}
            onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) { setShowInventory(false); gameRef.current?.focus(); } }}>
            <div style={{ width: '520px', maxWidth: '96vw', background: 'rgba(10,12,18,.96)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,255,200,.25)', borderRadius: '4px', boxShadow: '0 0 30px rgba(0,255,200,.08)' }}>
              <div style={{ padding: '10px 16px', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(0,255,200,.15)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'rgba(0,255,200,.8)', fontSize: '.8rem', letterSpacing: '.15em' }}>INVENTORY ({inventory.length}/{INVENTORY_MAX_SLOTS}){inShop ? ' — SELL MODE' : ''}</span>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowInventory(false); gameRef.current?.focus(); }} style={{ background: 'none', border: '1px solid rgba(255,60,60,.4)', color: 'rgba(255,60,60,.7)', padding: '2px 10px', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.6rem' }}>CLOSE [ESC]</button>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: '12px', display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${INVENTORY_GRID_COLS}, 1fr)`, gap: '6px', minHeight: '200px' }}>
                {Array.from({ length: INVENTORY_MAX_SLOTS }).map((_, i) => {
                  const item = inventory[i];
                  return (
                    <div key={i}
                      onClick={() => { if (item && inShop) sellItem(i); }}
                      style={{
                        aspectRatio: '1', background: item ? 'rgba(0,255,200,.06)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.02)',
                        border: item ? (inShop ? '1px solid rgba(255,200,60,.35)' : '1px solid rgba(0,255,200,.2)') : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)',
                        borderRadius: '3px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                        cursor: item && inShop ? 'pointer' : 'default', position: 'relative', transition: 'border-color .15s',
                      }}
                      title={item ? `${item.name}\n${item.desc}\nValue: ${item.value} FIAT${inShop ? '\nClick to sell' : ''}` : 'Empty slot'}
                    >
                      {item && (
                        <>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem' }}>{item.icon}</span>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(0,255,200,.7)', marginTop: '2px', textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 1.2, maxWidth: '90%', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{item.name}</span>
                          {item.qty > 1 && <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: '2px', right: '4px', fontSize: '.42rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,60,.8)' }}>x{item.qty}</span>}
                          {inShop && <span style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: '2px', fontSize: '.38rem', color: 'rgba(255,200,60,.8)' }}>SELL {item.value}F</span>}
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: '8px 12px', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(0,255,200,.1)' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '.5rem', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.3)' }}>{inShop ? 'Click items to sell | ESC to close' : 'HOVER for details | Visit PAWN SHOP or MARKET to sell items | [I] to toggle'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {hologramNotification && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 60, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 800, fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
          <div style={{ background: 'rgba(0,10,30,.95)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.5)', padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: '4px', boxShadow: '0 0 20px rgba(0,200,255,.2)', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.9)', fontSize: '.55rem', letterSpacing: '.1em', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            ▓ {hologramNotification} ▓
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {videoCallRoom && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 10, right: 10, zIndex: 750, fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", width: '340px', maxWidth: '40vw' }}>
          <div style={{ background: 'rgba(8,8,14,.94)', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.3)', borderRadius: '6px', overflow: 'hidden', boxShadow: '0 0 25px rgba(0,200,255,.1)' }}>
            <div style={{ padding: '6px 10px', borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.15)', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', background: 'rgba(0,200,255,.06)' }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.8)', fontSize: '.6rem', letterSpacing: '.1em' }}>VIDEO CALL — {videoCallPeers.length + 1} participant{videoCallPeers.length !== 0 ? 's' : ''}{videoCallPeers.some(p => p.isGuest) ? ` · ${videoCallPeers.filter(p => p.isGuest).length} HOLOGRAM` : ''}</span>
              <button onClick={leaveVideoCall} style={{ background: 'rgba(255,60,60,.15)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,60,60,.4)', color: 'rgba(255,60,60,.8)', padding: '2px 8px', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: '.5rem', borderRadius: '3px' }}>END [ESC]</button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: videoCallPeers.length > 1 ? '1fr 1fr' : '1fr', gap: '3px', padding: '4px' }}>
              <div style={{ aspectRatio: '4/3', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.6)', borderRadius: '3px', overflow: 'hidden', position: 'relative', border: '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.15)' }}>
                {vcStream && videoEnabled ? (
                  <video ref={el => { if (el && vcStream) { el.srcObject = vcStream; el.muted = true; el.play().catch(() => {}); } }} autoPlay muted playsInline style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', transform: 'scaleX(-1)' }} />
                ) : (
                  <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '4px' }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem' }}>👤</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '.45rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.5)' }}>{videoEnabled ? '' : 'CAMERA OFF'}</div>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 2, left: 4, fontSize: '.4rem', color: 'rgba(0,200,255,.7)', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.6)', padding: '1px 4px', borderRadius: '2px' }}>YOU{!audioEnabled ? ' (MUTED)' : ''}</div>
              </div>
              {videoCallPeers.map(peer => (
                <div key={peer.id} style={{ aspectRatio: '4/3', background: peer.isGuest ? 'rgba(0,10,30,.8)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,.6)', borderRadius: '3px', overflow: 'hidden', position: 'relative', border: peer.isGuest ? '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.35)' : '1px solid rgba(0,200,255,.1)', boxShadow: peer.isGuest ? '0 0 12px rgba(0,150,255,.15) inset' : 'none' }}>
                  {peer.stream ? (
                    <video ref={el => { if (el && peer.stream) { el.srcObject = peer.stream; el.play().catch(() => {}); } }} autoPlay playsInline style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', filter: peer.isGuest ? 'brightness(0.9) saturate(0.85)' : 'none', opacity: peer.isGuest ? 0.82 : 1 }} />
                  ) : (

      {/* ── MERCHANT SHOP PANEL ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showMerchantShop && (() => {

        const allItems = VEND_CATALOG.flatMap(c => c.items);
        const shopItems = merchant.inventory.map(id => allItems.find(i => i.id === id)).filter(Boolean) as VendItem[];
        const doBuy = async (item: VendItem) => {
          if (g.salary < item.price) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> ${merchant.name} — Not enough FIAT.`); return; }
          if (g.ownedItems.has(item.id) && !item.consumable) { sfxError(); setNarr(`> ${merchant.name} — Already owned.`); return; }
          const paid = await performGameplayFiatAction(`world_item_${item.id}`, `${gameplayFiatSession.current}:shop:${item.id}:${++gameplayFiatInteraction.current}`);
          if (!paid || paid.duplicate) return;
          recordBizRevenue(item.consumable ? 'vending_food' : 'merchant_weapon', item.price);
          if (item.consumable && item.effect) {
            const fx = item.effect;
            if (fx.includes('hunger')) { const m = fx.match(/hunger(\d+)/); if (m) g.hunger = Math.min(100, g.hunger + parseInt(m[1])); }
            if (fx.includes('thirst-')) { const m = fx.match(/thirst-(\d+)/); if (m) g.thirst = Math.max(0, g.thirst - parseInt(m[1])); }
            else if (fx.includes('thirst')) { const m = fx.match(/thirst(\d+)/); if (m) g.thirst = Math.min(100, g.thirst + parseInt(m[1])); }
            if (fx.includes('energy')) { const m = fx.match(/energy(\d+)/); if (m) g.energy = Math.min(100, g.energy + parseInt(m[1])); }
            if (fx.includes('hprisk')) { if (Math.random() < 0.1) { g.hp = Math.max(0, g.hp - 5); g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 20, text: 'BAD BATCH −5 HP', color: '#ff4444', life: 60, maxLife: 60 }); } }
            else if (fx.includes('hp')) { const m = fx.match(/hp(\d+)/); if (m) g.hp = Math.min(g.maxHp, g.hp + parseInt(m[1])); }

            if (fx.includes('rad_block')) { g.radiationLevel = 0; }
            if (fx.includes('power')) { const m = fx.match(/power(\d+)/); if (m) g.powerLevel = Math.min(100, g.powerLevel + parseInt(m[1])); }
            setHp(Math.floor(g.hp)); setHunger(Math.floor(g.hunger)); setThirst(Math.floor(g.thirst)); setEnergy(Math.floor(g.energy));
          } else {
            g.ownedItems.add(item.id);

          g.floaters.push({ x: g.px, y: g.py - 30, text: `−ƒ${item.price.toLocaleString()} ${item.name}`, color: '#ffcc00', life: 60, maxLife: 60 });

                  <div key={item.id} style={{ border:'1px solid rgba(255,204,0,.2)', padding:'.5rem .6rem', marginBottom:'.3rem', display:'flex', justifyContent:'space-between', alignItems:'center' }}>
                    <div style={{ flex:1 }}>
                      <div style={{ ...VT2, fontSize:'1rem', color: owned ? 'rgba(255,204,0,.3)' : '#ffcc00' }}>{item.name} {owned ? '(OWNED)' : ''}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize:'.45rem', color:'rgba(255,204,0,.35)', marginTop:'.1rem' }}>{item.desc}</div>

                      <button onClick={() => doSellStock(stock)} disabled={held <= 0}

      {/* ── HOUSING MANAGEMENT PANEL ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showHousingPanel && (() => {
        const g = gs.current;
        const VT2: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" };
        const currentTier = HOUSING_TIERS.find(t => t.id === g.housingTier) ?? HOUSING_TIERS[0];
        const daysSinceRent = Math.floor((Date.now() - g.rentPaidAt) / 86400000);
        const currentCycleDays = RENT_PERIOD_DAYS(currentTier);
        const daysUntilDue = Math.max(0, currentCycleDays - daysSinceRent);

        const playerWealth = (g.salary ?? 0) + (g.savings ?? 0);

        const TIER_COLOR: Record<string, string> = { shelter: 'rgba(180,100,60,.6)', apartment: 'rgba(0,200,255,.6)', house: 'rgba(120,255,100,.6)', villa: 'rgba(200,100,255,.6)' };

          if (tier.id === g.housingTier) return false;
          if (tier.minBizType === 'real' && char.bizType !== 'real') return false;
          if (tier.minBizType === 'minx' && (!char.hasBusiness)) return false;
          if (tier.wealthMin && playerWealth < tier.wealthMin) return false;
          return true;

          if (tier.minBizType === 'minx' && !char.hasBusiness) return 'REGISTERED BUSINESS REQUIRED';

          if (tierIdx >= 2) {
            const homeReqLevel = 10 + 10 * (tierIdx - 1);
            const homeReqGold = 10 * (tierIdx - 1);
            if (g.level < homeReqLevel || homeGoldNetWorth < homeReqGold) {
              return `LOCKED — Requires Level ${homeReqLevel} (you: ${g.level}) & ${homeReqGold}oz gold net worth (you: ${homeGoldNetWorth.toFixed(1)}oz)`;

          return null;

          setNarr('> BANCO OMBRA — Zone-adjusted rent must be paid through the bank property desk.');

                </div>

                      RENT: ƒ{effectiveRent(currentTier).toLocaleString()} / {currentTier.rentPeriod === 'week' ? 'week' : 'night'} {zoneRentMult !== 1 ? <span style={{ color:'rgba(255,200,0,.5)' }}>(zone x{zoneRentMult.toFixed(1)})</span> : null} · {daysUntilDue > 0 ? `DUE IN ${daysUntilDue} DAY${daysUntilDue !== 1 ? 'S' : ''}` : 'OVERDUE'}
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={doPayRent} disabled={g.salary < effectiveRent(currentTier) || daysUntilDue > 3}
                      style={{ marginTop:'.3rem', padding:'.3rem .8rem', background:'rgba(56,189,248,.08)', border:'1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.3)', color:'#38bdf8', cursor:'pointer', ...VT2, fontSize:'.9rem' }}>
                      PAY RENT EARLY — ƒ{effectiveRent(currentTier).toLocaleString()}

                FIAT WEALTH: <span style={{ color:'rgba(56,189,248,.6)' }}>ƒ{playerWealth.toLocaleString()}</span> · GOLD NET WORTH: <span style={{ color:'rgba(255,215,0,.6)' }}>{homeGoldNetWorth.toFixed(1)}oz</span> · LEVEL: <span style={{ color:'rgba(0,200,255,.6)' }}>{g.level}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding:'.4rem .6rem', border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)', background:'rgba(255,255,255,.01)', marginBottom:'.8rem', fontSize:'.38rem', color:'rgba(255,255,255,.25)' }}>
                CITY ZONE: {getBuildingZone(g.hamletBuildingId ?? 'bunker')?.name ?? 'UNZONED'} · ZONE RENT INDEX: x{getZoneRentMultiplier(g.hamletBuildingId ?? 'bunker').toFixed(1)}
              </div>

              </div>

        const depthLabels = ['INITIAL CONTACT', 'FOLLOW-UP', 'DEEP INTEL', 'CLASSIFIED'];
        const depthLabel = depthLabels[Math.min(depthLevel, depthLabels.length - 1)];
        const depthColor = depthLevel === 0 ? 'rgba(51,255,170,.4)' : depthLevel === 1 ? 'rgba(255,204,0,.5)' : depthLevel >= 2 ? 'rgba(255,100,100,.5)' : 'rgba(51,255,170,.4)';
        const handleChoice = (nextId: string | null, fromShopNode?: boolean) => {
          if (!nextId || !gs.current.activeDialogue) {
            setShowDialoguePanel(false); setDialogueNode(null);
            gs.current.activeDialogue = null; gs.current.activeDialogueNode = null;
            const pending = pendingNpcActionRef.current;
            pendingNpcActionRef.current = null;
            if (fromShopNode && pending?.type === 'newspaper') {
              setShowNewspaper(THE_MINX_ISSUES[pending.seasonIdx] ?? THE_MINX_ISSUES[0]);
            } else if (fromShopNode && pending?.type === 'merchant') {
              setShowMerchant({ name: pending.name, items: pending.items });

            }
            return;
          }
          const next = gs.current.activeDialogue.nodes[nextId];
          if (next) {
            setDialogueNode(next);
            gs.current.activeDialogueNode = nextId;
            sfxNpcMurmur(dialogueNpcSeed);
            // Major NPCs voice their dialogue line through their assigned ElevenLabs voice
            if (next.text && dialogueNpcName) speakNpcLine(dialogueNpcName, next.text);
